`modules/boot_config/entry.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 2909d63a
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/blob.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "internal/rol3.hpp"
#include "util/win32.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::boot_config
{

namespace
{

using PfnWow64EnableFsRedirection_t = BOOLEAN( WINAPI * )( BOOLEAN );

} // namespace

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 8B BC 24
int RunBootConfig( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	auto szKernel32 = MakeRol3String( "Kernel32.dll" );
	auto szAdvapi32 = MakeRol3String( "Advapi32.dll" );
	auto szWow64Enable = MakeRol3String( "Wow64EnableWow64FsRedirection" );
	auto szValueName = MakeRol3String( "Element" );
	auto szKeyPath =
	    MakeRol3String( "BCD00000000\\Objects\\{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}\\Elements\\00000000" );
	static_assert( sizeof( szKeyPath.m_rgChars ) == sizeof( KeyPath_t ) );

	// @note / sapdragon: incoming capacity is ignored, it always writes the whole report
	memset( &report, 0, sizeof( report ) );
	*pcubOutput = sizeof( report );
	report.m_unMagic = k_unReportMagic;
	report.m_unVersion = 2;

	EScanStatus eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
	if ( bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
	{
		szKernel32.Decode();
		const HMODULE hKernel32 = g_pImports->GetModuleHandleA( szKernel32.Get() );
		if ( hKernel32 )
		{
			szAdvapi32.Decode();
			eStatus = EScanStatus::Ok;
			// @note / sapdragon: only kept loaded until the end, nothing is resolved from it
			const HMODULE hAdvapi32 = g_pImports->LoadLibraryExA( szAdvapi32.Get(), nullptr, 0 );

			szWow64Enable.Decode();
			const auto pfnWow64Enable = reinterpret_cast<PfnWow64EnableFsRedirection_t>(
			    g_pImports->GetProcAddress( hKernel32, szWow64Enable.Get() ) );
			u32 unWow64Disabled = 0;
			if ( pfnWow64Enable )
				unWow64Disabled = pfnWow64Enable( FALSE );

			char szSystemDirectory[520];
			if ( g_pImports->GetSystemDirectoryA( szSystemDirectory, sizeof( szSystemDirectory ) ) )
			{
				const wchar_t wszRoot[4] = { static_cast<wchar_t>( szSystemDirectory[0] ), L':', L'\\', 0 };
				g_pImports->GetVolumeInformationW( wszRoot, nullptr, 0,
				                                   reinterpret_cast<LPDWORD>( &report.m_unVolumeSerial ), nullptr,
				                                   nullptr, nullptr, 0 );

				memcpy( szKeyPath.m_rgChars + offsetof( KeyPath_t, m_rgchGuid ), input.m_rgchEncodedGuid,
				        sizeof( input.m_rgchEncodedGuid ) );
				szKeyPath.DecodeAll();
				szValueName.Decode();
				memcpy( report.m_szCurrentGuid, szKeyPath.m_rgChars + offsetof( KeyPath_t, m_rgchGuid ),
				        sizeof( report.m_szCurrentGuid ) );

				ReadElement( szKeyPath.Get(), "12000002", szValueName.Get(), true, &report.m_Element12000002,
				             &report.m_Element12000002.m_unPathHash );
				report.m_unStatus12000002 = report.m_Element12000002.m_ubOpenStatus;
				memcpy( report.m_szValue12000002, report.m_Element12000002.m_szValue,
				        sizeof( report.m_szValue12000002 ) );
				report.m_unFileIndexLow12000002 = report.m_Element12000002.m_unFileIndexLow;
				report.m_unFileIndexHigh12000002 = report.m_Element12000002.m_unFileIndexHigh;

				ReadElement( szKeyPath.Get(), "22000011", szValueName.Get(), true, &report.m_Element22000011, nullptr );
				report.m_unStatus22000011 = report.m_Element22000011.m_ubOpenStatus;
				memcpy( report.m_szValue22000011, report.m_Element22000011.m_szValue,
				        sizeof( report.m_szValue22000011 ) );
				report.m_unFileIndexLow22000011 = report.m_Element22000011.m_unFileIndexLow;
				report.m_unFileIndexHigh22000011 = report.m_Element22000011.m_unFileIndexHigh;

				ReadElement( szKeyPath.Get(), "22000012", szValueName.Get(), true, &report.m_Element22000012, nullptr );
				report.m_unStatus22000012 = report.m_Element22000012.m_ubOpenStatus;
				memcpy( report.m_szValue22000012, report.m_Element22000012.m_szValue,
				        sizeof( report.m_szValue22000012 ) );
				report.m_unFileIndexLow22000012 = report.m_Element22000012.m_unFileIndexLow;
				report.m_unFileIndexHigh22000012 = report.m_Element22000012.m_unFileIndexHigh;

				ReadElement( szKeyPath.Get(), "12000004", szValueName.Get(), false, &report.m_Element12000004,
				             &report.m_Element12000004.m_unDescriptionHash );
				report.m_unStatus12000004 = report.m_Element12000004.m_ubOpenStatus;
				memcpy( report.m_szValue12000004, report.m_Element12000004.m_szValue,
				        sizeof( report.m_szValue12000004 ) );

				HKEY hKey;
				DWORD cubValue;

				memcpy( szKeyPath.m_rgChars + offsetof( KeyPath_t, m_rgchElementId ), "12000030",
				        sizeof( KeyPath_t::m_rgchElementId ) );
				report.m_unStatus12000030 =
				    g_pImports->RegOpenKeyExA( HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, szKeyPath.Get(), 0, KEY_QUERY_VALUE, &hKey );
				if ( !report.m_unStatus12000030 )
				{
					// @note / sapdragon: the buffer is never cleared, the copy below takes 32 bytes whatever the value length
					u8 rgubValue[260];
					cubValue = sizeof( rgubValue );
					report.m_unStatus12000030 =
					    g_pImports->RegQueryValueExA( hKey, szValueName.Get(), nullptr, nullptr, rgubValue, &cubValue );
					if ( !report.m_unStatus12000030 )
						memcpy( report.m_szValue12000030, rgubValue, sizeof( report.m_szValue12000030 ) );
					g_pImports->RegCloseKey( hKey );
				}

				memcpy( szKeyPath.m_rgChars + offsetof( KeyPath_t, m_rgchElementId ), "25000020",
				        sizeof( KeyPath_t::m_rgchElementId ) );
				report.m_unStatus25000020 =
				    g_pImports->RegOpenKeyExA( HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, szKeyPath.Get(), 0, KEY_QUERY_VALUE, &hKey );
				if ( !report.m_unStatus25000020 )
				{
					cubValue = sizeof( report.m_ulValue25000020 );
					const LSTATUS nStatus = g_pImports->RegQueryValueExA(
					    hKey, szValueName.Get(), nullptr, nullptr,
					    reinterpret_cast<LPBYTE>( &report.m_ulValue25000020 ), &cubValue );
					report.m_unStatus25000020 = nStatus;
					g_pImports->RegCloseKey( hKey );
				}

				memcpy( szKeyPath.m_rgChars + offsetof( KeyPath_t, m_rgchElementId ), "16000049",
				        sizeof( KeyPath_t::m_rgchElementId ) );
				report.m_unStatus16000049 =
				    g_pImports->RegOpenKeyExA( HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, szKeyPath.Get(), 0, KEY_QUERY_VALUE, &hKey );
				if ( !report.m_unStatus16000049 )
				{
					cubValue = sizeof( report.m_unValue16000049 );
					const LSTATUS nStatus = g_pImports->RegQueryValueExA(
					    hKey, szValueName.Get(), nullptr, nullptr,
					    reinterpret_cast<LPBYTE>( &report.m_unValue16000049 ), &cubValue );
					report.m_unStatus16000049 = nStatus;
					g_pImports->RegCloseKey( hKey );
				}

				memcpy( szKeyPath.m_rgChars + offsetof( KeyPath_t, m_rgchElementId ), "16000048",
				        sizeof( KeyPath_t::m_rgchElementId ) );
				report.m_unStatus16000048 =
				    g_pImports->RegOpenKeyExA( HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, szKeyPath.Get(), 0, KEY_QUERY_VALUE, &hKey );
				if ( !report.m_unStatus16000048 )
				{
					cubValue = sizeof( report.m_unValue16000048 );
					const LSTATUS nStatus = g_pImports->RegQueryValueExA(
					    hKey, szValueName.Get(), nullptr, nullptr,
					    reinterpret_cast<LPBYTE>( &report.m_unValue16000048 ), &cubValue );
					report.m_unStatus16000048 = nStatus;
					g_pImports->RegCloseKey( hKey );
				}

				EnumerateObjects( report, szKeyPath.Get(), szValueName.Get() );
			}
			else
			{
				eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( util::GetLastError( g_pImports ) );
			}

			if ( unWow64Disabled )
				pfnWow64Enable( TRUE );
			if ( hAdvapi32 )
				g_pImports->FreeLibrary( hAdvapi32 );
		}
		else
		{
			eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( util::GetLastError( g_pImports ) );
		}
	}

	bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();
	report.m_eStatus = eStatus;
	return 0;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::boot_config

#include "internal/module_data.inl"

            0xF0, 0xFD, 0xD8, 0xCE, 0x6C, 0x1B, 0xF8, 0x60, 0xE5, 0x66, 0xBD );
```

`modules/boot_config/internal/module_data.inl`:


```cpp
// @binary: 2909d63a
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "util/hashing.hpp"
#include "util/strings.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::boot_config
{

namespace
{

constexpr u32 k_cchPathMax = 0xFFFF;

// @orig: 53 56 57 8B D9 E8
char *ConcatPath( char *pszDst, const char *pszSrc ) noexcept
{
	const u32 cchDst = util::StrLenA( pszDst );
	u32 cchSrc = util::StrLenA( pszSrc );
	if ( cchSrc > k_cchPathMax )
		cchSrc = k_cchPathMax;
	memcpy( pszDst + cchDst, pszSrc, cchSrc );
	pszDst[cchDst + cchSrc] = 0;
	return pszDst;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 55 8B EC 81 EC
int ReadElement( char *pszKeyPath, const char *pszElementId, const char *pszValueName, bool bFileCheck,
                 Element_t *pElement, u32 *punHash ) noexcept
{
	char szValue[260];
	char szPath[520];
	BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION info;
	HKEY hKey;

	memcpy( pszKeyPath + offsetof( KeyPath_t, m_rgchElementId ), pszElementId, sizeof( KeyPath_t::m_rgchElementId ) );
	LSTATUS nStatus = g_pImports->RegOpenKeyExA( HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, pszKeyPath, 0, KEY_QUERY_VALUE, &hKey );
	pElement->m_ubOpenStatus = static_cast<u8>( nStatus );
	if ( nStatus )
		return nStatus;

	DWORD cubValue = sizeof( szValue );
	nStatus = g_pImports->RegQueryValueExA( hKey, pszValueName, nullptr, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<LPBYTE>( szValue ),
	                                        &cubValue );
	pElement->m_ubQueryStatus = static_cast<u8>( nStatus );
	if ( nStatus )
	{
		g_pImports->RegCloseKey( hKey );
		return nStatus;
	}

	szValue[sizeof( szValue ) - 1] = 0;
	const int cchValue = static_cast<int>( util::StrLenA( szValue ) );
	const int cchFree = static_cast<int>( sizeof( pElement->m_szValue ) ) - pElement->m_cubValue;
	if ( cchValue <= cchFree )
	{
		memcpy( pElement->m_szValue + pElement->m_cubValue, szValue, cchValue );
		pElement->m_cubValue += static_cast<u8>( cchValue );
		if ( pElement->m_cubValue < sizeof( pElement->m_szValue ) )
		{
			pElement->m_szValue[pElement->m_cubValue] = 0;
			++pElement->m_cubValue;
		}
	}
	else if ( cchFree > 0 )
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: when it does not fit it keeps the end of the text, not the start
		memcpy( pElement->m_szValue + pElement->m_cubValue, szValue + ( cchValue - cchFree ), cchFree );
		pElement->m_cubValue += static_cast<u8>( cchFree );
	}

	if ( punHash && cchValue )
		*punHash = util::hashing::PathHashBytes( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( szValue ), cchValue );

	if ( g_pImports->GetSystemDirectoryA( szPath, sizeof( szPath ) ) && bFileCheck )
	{
		ConcatPath( szPath, "\\" );
		if ( szValue[0] == '\\' )
			util::CopyA( szPath + 2, szValue, k_cchPathMax );
		else
			ConcatPath( szPath, szValue );

		const HANDLE hFile = g_pImports->CreateFileA( szPath, 0, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
		                                              nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
		if ( hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		{
			pElement->m_ubFileOpenError = static_cast<u8>( g_pImports->GetLastError() );
		}
		else
		{
			if ( g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle( hFile, &info ) )
			{
				pElement->m_unFileIndexLow = info.nFileIndexLow;
				pElement->m_unFileIndexHigh = info.nFileIndexHigh;
			}
			else
			{
				pElement->m_ubFileInfoError = static_cast<u8>( g_pImports->GetLastError() );
			}
			g_pImports->CloseHandle( hFile );
		}
	}

	g_pImports->RegCloseKey( hKey );
	return nStatus;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 33 DB
void EnumerateObjects( Report_t &report, char *pszKeyPath, const char *pszValueName ) noexcept
{
	char szObjectsPath[sizeof( KeyPath_t::m_rgchObjects ) + 2]{};
	char szClass[260]{};
	char szSubKey[500];
	FILETIME ftSubKey;
	DWORD cchClass = sizeof( szClass );
	DWORD cSubKeys = 0;
	DWORD cchMaxSubKey, cchMaxClass, cValues, cchMaxValueName, cubMaxValue, cubSecurity;
	HKEY hKey = nullptr;

	memcpy( szObjectsPath, pszKeyPath, sizeof( KeyPath_t::m_rgchObjects ) );
	report.m_unObjectsOpenStatus = g_pImports->RegOpenKeyExA( HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, szObjectsPath, 0, KEY_READ, &hKey );
	if ( report.m_unObjectsOpenStatus )
		return;

	report.m_unObjectsQueryStatus = g_pImports->RegQueryInfoKeyA(
	    hKey, szClass, &cchClass, nullptr, &cSubKeys, &cchMaxSubKey, &cchMaxClass, &cValues, &cchMaxValueName,
	    &cubMaxValue, &cubSecurity, &report.m_ftObjectsLastWrite );
	report.m_cSubKeys = cSubKeys;
	report.m_cValues = cValues;
	if ( !cSubKeys )
		return;

	for ( DWORD iSubKey = 0; iSubKey < cSubKeys; ++iSubKey )
	{
		DWORD cchSubKey = sizeof( szSubKey );
		if ( g_pImports->RegEnumKeyExA( hKey, iSubKey, szSubKey, &cchSubKey, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, &ftSubKey ) )
			continue;

		u32 cObjects = report.m_cObjects;
		if ( cObjects < ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgObjects ) )
		{
			memcpy( pszKeyPath + offsetof( KeyPath_t, m_rgchGuid ), szSubKey + 1, sizeof( KeyPath_t::m_rgchGuid ) );
			memcpy( report.m_rgszObjectGuid[report.m_cObjects], szSubKey + 1, sizeof( report.m_rgszObjectGuid[0] ) );

			Element_t *pObject = &report.m_rgObjects[report.m_cObjects];
			ReadElement( pszKeyPath, "12000002", pszValueName, true, pObject, &pObject->m_unPathHash );
			ReadElement( pszKeyPath, "12000004", pszValueName, false, pObject, &pObject->m_unDescriptionHash );
			cObjects = report.m_cObjects;
		}
		report.m_cObjects = cObjects + 1;
	}
}

} // namespace vac::workers::boot_config
```

`modules/boot_config/internal/rol3.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "core/types.hpp"

// @note / sapdragon: valve keeps these on the stack rotated right by three, rotates them back after bootstrap

namespace vac::workers::boot_config
{

constexpr char Ror3( char chValue ) noexcept
{
	const u8 ubValue = static_cast<u8>( chValue );
	return static_cast<char>( static_cast<u8>( ( ubValue >> 3 ) | ( ubValue << 5 ) ) );
}

constexpr char Rol3( char chValue ) noexcept
{
	const u8 ubValue = static_cast<u8>( chValue );
	return static_cast<char>( static_cast<u8>( ( ubValue << 3 ) | ( ubValue >> 5 ) ) );
}

template <usize cChars>
struct Rol3String_t
{
	char m_rgChars[cChars];

	consteval explicit Rol3String_t( const char ( &rgChars )[cChars] ) : m_rgChars{}
	{
		for ( usize iChar = 0; iChar + 1 < cChars; ++iChar )
			m_rgChars[iChar] = Ror3( rgChars[iChar] );
	}

	void Decode() noexcept
	{
		for ( char *pChar = m_rgChars; *pChar; ++pChar )
			*pChar = Rol3( *pChar );
	}

	void DecodeAll() noexcept
	{
		for ( char &chValue : m_rgChars )
			chValue = Rol3( chValue );
	}

	[[nodiscard]] char *Get() noexcept { return m_rgChars; }
};

template <usize cChars>
consteval auto MakeRol3String( const char ( &rgChars )[cChars] )
{
	return Rol3String_t<cChars>{ rgChars };
}

} // namespace vac::workers::boot_config
```

```cpp
// @binary: f418b1dc
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/blob.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::cpuid
{

// @orig: 55 8B 6C 24 ? B8
int RunCpuid( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	if ( *pcubOutput < sizeof( Report_t ) )
		return 4;

	*pcubOutput = sizeof( Report_t );
	memset( &report, 0, sizeof( Report_t ) );
	report.m_unReserved18 = 0;
	report.m_unMagic = k_unReportMagic;

	EScanStatus eStatus;
	int nResult;
	if ( bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
	{
		HANDLE hThread = g_pImports->GetCurrentThread();
		const DWORD_PTR ulAffinityPrevious = g_pImports->SetThreadAffinityMask( hThread, 1 );
		eStatus = Collect( report );
		g_pImports->SetThreadAffinityMask( hThread, ulAffinityPrevious );
		nResult = 0;
		*pcubOutput = offsetof( Report_t, m_rgRecords ) + report.m_cRecords * sizeof( CpuidRecord_t );
	}
	else
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
		nResult = 1;
	}

	bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();
	report.m_eStatus = eStatus;
	return nResult;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::cpuid
```

```cpp
{

constexpr u32 k_unEflagsId = 0x200000;

constinit bool s_bCpuidSupported = false;

// @note / sapdragon: the hypervisor range goes before the extended one, the order is part of the report
constexpr u32 k_rgunBaseLeaves[] = { 0x00000000, 0x40000000, 0x80000000 };

constexpr LeafRule_t k_rgLeafRules[] = {
    { 0x00000004, ContinueCacheSubleaf },
    { 0x00000007, ContinueSubleafBelowFirstEax },
    { 0x0000000B, ContinueEaxOrEbx },
    { 0x0000000D, ContinueXsave },
    { 0x0000000F, ContinueRdtMonitoring },
    { 0x00000010, ContinueRdtAllocation },
    { 0x00000014, ContinueSubleafBelowFirstEax },
    { 0x00000017, ContinueSubleafBelowFirstEax },
    { 0x00000018, ContinueSubleafBelowFirstEax },
    { 0x8000001D, ContinueCacheSubleaf },
};

} // namespace

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 83 3D
int Cpuid( u32 *punEax, u32 *punEbx, u32 *punEcx, u32 *punEdx ) noexcept
{
	if ( !s_bCpuidSupported )
	{
		const unsigned long ulFlagsSaved = __readeflags();
		const unsigned long ulFlagsBefore = __readeflags();
		__writeeflags( ulFlagsBefore ^ k_unEflagsId );
		const unsigned long ulFlagsAfter = __readeflags();
		__writeeflags( ulFlagsSaved );
		if ( ( ( ulFlagsBefore ^ ulFlagsAfter ) & k_unEflagsId ) == 0 )
			return 0;
		s_bCpuidSupported = true;
	}

	int rgnRegisters[4];
	__cpuidex( rgnRegisters, static_cast<int>( *punEax ), static_cast<int>( *punEcx ) );
	*punEax = static_cast<u32>( rgnRegisters[0] );
	*punEcx = static_cast<u32>( rgnRegisters[2] );
	*punEbx = static_cast<u32>( rgnRegisters[1] );
	*punEdx = static_cast<u32>( rgnRegisters[3] );
	return 1;
}

// @orig: 8B 44 24 ? 6A ? F6 40
BOOL __cdecl ContinueCacheSubleaf( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent ) noexcept
{
	return ( pCurrent->m_unEax & 0xF ) != 0;
}

// @orig: 8B 44 24 ? 8B 48
BOOL __cdecl ContinueSubleafBelowFirstEax( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent ) noexcept
{
	return pCurrent->m_unSubleaf < pFirst->m_unEax;
}

// @orig: 8B 44 24 ? 83 78 ? ? 75 ? 83 78
BOOL __cdecl ContinueEaxOrEbx( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent ) noexcept
{
	return pCurrent->m_unEax != 0 || pCurrent->m_unEbx != 0;
}

// @orig: 8B 44 24 ? 33 C9 83 78
BOOL __cdecl ContinueXsave( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent ) noexcept
{
	return ( pCurrent->m_unSubleaf <= 1 || pCurrent->m_unEax != 0 || pCurrent->m_unEbx != 0 || pCurrent->m_unEcx != 0 ||
	         pCurrent->m_unEdx != 0 ) &&
	       ( pCurrent->m_unSubleaf != 0 || pCurrent->m_unEax != 0 );
}

// @orig: f418b1dc:0x10002C90 (no unique signature)
BOOL __cdecl ContinueRdtMonitoring( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent ) noexcept
{
	return pCurrent->m_unSubleaf == 0 && ( pCurrent->m_unEdx & 6 ) != 0;
}

// @orig: f418b1dc:0x10002CA7 (no unique signature)
BOOL __cdecl ContinueRdtAllocation( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent ) noexcept
{
	return pCurrent->m_unSubleaf == 0 && ( pCurrent->m_unEbx & 6 ) != 0;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 8B 6C 24
EAppendResult AppendLeaf( Report_t &report, u32 *pcRecords, u32 *punMaxLeaf, u32 unLeaf,
                          PfnContinue_t pfnContinue ) noexcept
{
	const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst = &report.m_rgRecords[*pcRecords];
	u32 unSubleaf = 0;
	for ( ;; )
	{
		CpuidRecord_t *pRecord = &report.m_rgRecords[*pcRecords];
		if ( *pcRecords >= k_cMaxRecords )
			return EAppendResult::RecordsFull;

		pRecord->m_unLeaf = unLeaf;
		pRecord->m_unEax = unLeaf;
		pRecord->m_unSubleaf = unSubleaf;
		pRecord->m_unEcx = unSubleaf;
		++unSubleaf;
		if ( Cpuid( &pRecord->m_unEax, &pRecord->m_unEbx, &pRecord->m_unEcx, &pRecord->m_unEdx ) == 0 )
			return EAppendResult::CpuidUnsupported;

		if ( static_cast<u16>( unLeaf ) == 0 )
			*punMaxLeaf = pRecord->m_unEax;
		++*pcRecords;

		if ( pfnContinue == nullptr || !pfnContinue( pFirst, pRecord ) )
			return EAppendResult::Appended;
	}
}

// @orig: 51 51 53 55 56 33 F6
EScanStatus Collect( Report_t &report ) noexcept
{
	EScanStatus eStatus = EScanStatus::Ok;
	u32 cRecords = 0;
	u32 unMaxLeaf;

	for ( const u32 unBaseLeaf : k_rgunBaseLeaves )
	{
		u32 unLeaf = unBaseLeaf;
		unMaxLeaf = unLeaf;
		do
		{
			PfnContinue_t pfnContinue = nullptr;
			for ( const LeafRule_t &rule : k_rgLeafRules )
			{
				if ( unLeaf < rule.m_unLeaf )
					break;
				if ( unLeaf == rule.m_unLeaf )
					pfnContinue = rule.m_pfnContinue;
			}

			const EAppendResult eAppended = AppendLeaf( report, &cRecords, &unMaxLeaf, unLeaf, pfnContinue );
			if ( eAppended != EAppendResult::Appended )
			{
				if ( eAppended == EAppendResult::RecordsFull )
					eStatus = EScanStatus::RecordOverflow;
				else if ( eAppended == EAppendResult::CpuidUnsupported )
					eStatus = EScanStatus::CpuidUnsupported;
				else
					eStatus = EScanStatus::InternalError;
				report.m_cRecords = cRecords;
				return eStatus;
			}
			++unLeaf;
		} while ( unLeaf <= unMaxLeaf );
	}

	report.m_cRecords = cRecords;
	return eStatus;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::cpuid
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "bootstrap/imports.hpp"
#include "core/layout.hpp"
#include "core/packets.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::cpuid
{

inline constexpr u32 k_unModuleId = 0x023429C3;
inline constexpr u32 k_unReportMagic = 0xDECBE74A;
inline constexpr u32 k_cMaxRecords = 169;

enum class EAppendResult
{
	Appended,
	RecordsFull,
	CpuidUnsupported,
};

#pragma pack( push, 1 )
struct Input_t
{
	u8 m_rgubBootstrap[8];
	u8 m_rgubReserved[152];
};

struct CpuidRecord_t
{
	u32 m_unLeaf;
	u32 m_unSubleaf;
	u32 m_unEax;
	u32 m_unEbx;
	u32 m_unEcx;
	u32 m_unEdx;
};

struct Report_t
{
	u8 m_rgubDispatcher[16];
	u32 m_unMagic;
	EScanStatus m_eStatus;
	u32 m_unReserved18;
	u32 m_cRecords;
	u8 m_rgubReserved20[8];
	CpuidRecord_t m_rgRecords[k_cMaxRecords];
};
#pragma pack( pop )
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( Input_t, k_cubEncryptedConfig );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_unMagic, 0x10 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_eStatus, 0x14 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_unReserved18, 0x18 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_cRecords, 0x1C );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_rgRecords, 0x28 );
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( CpuidRecord_t, 24 );
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( Report_t, k_cubReport );

using PfnContinue_t = BOOL( __cdecl * )( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent );

struct LeafRule_t
{
	u32 m_unLeaf;
	PfnContinue_t m_pfnContinue;
};

int Cpuid( u32 *punEax, u32 *punEbx, u32 *punEcx, u32 *punEdx ) noexcept;
BOOL __cdecl ContinueCacheSubleaf( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent ) noexcept;
BOOL __cdecl ContinueSubleafBelowFirstEax( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent ) noexcept;
BOOL __cdecl ContinueEaxOrEbx( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent ) noexcept;
BOOL __cdecl ContinueXsave( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent ) noexcept;
BOOL __cdecl ContinueRdtMonitoring( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent ) noexcept;
BOOL __cdecl ContinueRdtAllocation( const CpuidRecord_t *pFirst, const CpuidRecord_t *pCurrent ) noexcept;

                          PfnContinue_t pfnContinue ) noexcept;

} // namespace vac::workers::cpuid
```

```cpp
// @binary: 40e4df95
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/blob.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "util/strings.hpp"
#include "util/win32.hpp"
#include "util/xor_string.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::devices
{

namespace
{

constexpr u8 k_unStringKey = 0x3E;
constexpr char k_szSeparator[] = "\n";

} // namespace

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53
int RunDevices( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	memset( &report, 0, offsetof( Report_t, m_rgDevices ) );
	*pcubOutput = offsetof( Report_t, m_rgDevices );
	report.m_unMagic = k_unReportMagic;

	EScanStatus eStatus = EScanStatus::Ok;
	if ( !bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
	}
	else
	{
		HDEVINFO hDeviceInfo =
		    g_pImports->SetupDiGetClassDevsA( nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, DIGCF_PRESENT | DIGCF_ALLCLASSES );
		if ( hDeviceInfo == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		{
			eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( util::GetLastError( g_pImports ) );
		}
		else
		{
			char *pszBuffer =
			    static_cast<char *>( g_pImports->HeapAlloc( g_pImports->GetProcessHeap(), 0, k_cubPropertyBuffer ) );
			if ( pszBuffer == nullptr )
			{
				eStatus = EScanStatus::HeapAllocFailed;
			}
			else
			{
				memset( pszBuffer, 0, k_cubPropertyBuffer );

				SP_DEVINFO_DATA deviceInfo;
				deviceInfo.cbSize = sizeof( deviceInfo );
				for ( DWORD iDevice = 0;; ++iDevice )
				{
					if ( g_pImports->SetupDiEnumDeviceInfo( hDeviceInfo, iDevice, &deviceInfo ) == 0 )
					{
						eStatus = EScanStatus::Ok;
						break;
					}

					DWORD unRegType;
					*pszBuffer = 0;
					if ( g_pImports->SetupDiGetDeviceRegistryPropertyA(
					         hDeviceInfo, &deviceInfo, SPDRP_HARDWAREID, &unRegType,
					         reinterpret_cast<PBYTE>( pszBuffer ), k_cubPropertyLimit, nullptr ) == 0 )
					{
						eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( util::GetLastError( g_pImports ) );
						if ( eStatus != static_cast<EScanStatus>( ERROR_INVALID_DATA ) &&
						     eStatus != static_cast<EScanStatus>( ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER ) )
						{
							if ( eStatus != static_cast<EScanStatus>( ERROR_NO_SUCH_DEVINST ) )
								break;
							report.m_eFlags |= EReportFlags::NoSuchDevInst;
						}
					}
					if ( *pszBuffer == 0 )
						continue;

					const u32 cchHardwareIds = util::StrLenA( pszBuffer );
					u32 cchSeparator = util::StrLenA( k_szSeparator );
					if ( cchSeparator > 0xFFFF )
						cchSeparator = 0xFFFF;
					memcpy( &pszBuffer[cchHardwareIds], k_szSeparator, cchSeparator );
					pszBuffer[cchHardwareIds + cchSeparator] = 0;

					const u32 cchBuffered = util::StrLenA( pszBuffer );
					char *pszCompatibleIds = &pszBuffer[cchBuffered];
					unRegType = 0;
					if ( g_pImports->SetupDiGetDeviceRegistryPropertyA(
					         hDeviceInfo, &deviceInfo, SPDRP_COMPATIBLEIDS, &unRegType,
					         reinterpret_cast<PBYTE>( pszCompatibleIds ), k_cubPropertyLimit - cchBuffered,
					         nullptr ) == 0 )
					{
						eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( util::GetLastError( g_pImports ) );
						if ( eStatus != static_cast<EScanStatus>( ERROR_INVALID_DATA ) &&
						     eStatus != static_cast<EScanStatus>( ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER ) )
						{
							if ( eStatus != static_cast<EScanStatus>( ERROR_NO_SUCH_DEVINST ) )
								break;
							report.m_eFlags |= EReportFlags::NoSuchDevInst;
						}
					}

					if ( unRegType == REG_MULTI_SZ )
					{
						char *pszEnd = pszCompatibleIds + util::StrLenA( pszCompatibleIds );
						for ( ;; )
						{
							*pszEnd = '\n';
							if ( pszEnd[1] == 0 )
								break;
							pszEnd += util::StrLenA( pszEnd );
						}
					}

					auto szVen = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "VEN_" );
					auto szDev = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "DEV_" );
					auto szCc = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "CC_" );
					szVen.Decode();
					szDev.Decode();
					szCc.Decode();

					u32 unVendor = 0;
					u32 unDevice = 0;
					u32 unCcValue = 0;
					u32 unClass = 0;
					EDeviceKind eKind;
					char *pszVen = FindString( pszBuffer, szVen.Get() );
					char *pszDev = FindString( pszBuffer, szDev.Get() );
					char *pszCc = FindString( pszBuffer, szCc.Get() );
					if ( pszCc != nullptr )
					{
						for ( ;; )
						{
							if ( ParseHex( pszCc + 3, 6, &unCcValue ) == 0 )
							{
								unClass = unCcValue >> 8;
								break;
							}
							pszCc = FindString( pszCc + 3, szCc.Get() );
							if ( pszCc == nullptr )
							{
								unClass = unCcValue;
								break;
							}
						}
					}

					if ( pszVen == nullptr || pszDev == nullptr || ParseHex( pszVen + 4, 4, &unVendor ) != 0 ||
					     ParseHex( pszDev + 4, 4, &unDevice ) != 0 )
					{
						auto szVid = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "VID_" );
						auto szPid = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "PID_" );
						auto szDevClass = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "DevClass_" );
						auto szClass = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "\\Class_" );
						auto szSubClass = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "SubClass_" );
						auto szProt = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "Prot_" );
						szVid.Decode();
						szPid.Decode();
						szDevClass.Decode();
						szClass.Decode();
						szSubClass.Decode();
						szProt.Decode();

						u32 cchDevClass = 9;
						pszVen = FindString( pszBuffer, szVid.Get() );
						pszDev = FindString( pszBuffer, szPid.Get() );
						char *pszDevClass = FindString( pszBuffer, szDevClass.Get() );
						if ( pszDevClass == nullptr )
						{
							pszDevClass = FindString( pszBuffer, szClass.Get() );
							cchDevClass = 7;
						}
						char *pszSubClass = FindString( pszBuffer, szSubClass.Get() );
						char *pszProt = FindString( pszBuffer, szProt.Get() );
						if ( pszVen == nullptr || pszDev == nullptr )
							continue;

						unVendor = 0;
						unDevice = 0;
						u32 unProtocol = 0;
						u32 unSubClass = 0;
						u32 unDevClass = 0;
						if ( ParseHex( pszVen + 4, 4, &unVendor ) != 0 || ParseHex( pszDev + 4, 4, &unDevice ) != 0 )
							continue;

						if ( pszDevClass != nullptr )
							ParseHex( pszDevClass + cchDevClass, 2, &unDevClass );
						if ( pszSubClass != nullptr )
							ParseHex( pszSubClass + 9, 2, &unSubClass );
						if ( pszProt != nullptr )
							ParseHex( pszProt + 5, 2, &unProtocol );

						unClass = static_cast<u8>( unSubClass ) |
						          ( ( static_cast<u8>( unDevClass ) | ( static_cast<u8>( unProtocol ) << 8 ) ) << 8 );
						eKind = EDeviceKind::Usb;
					}
					else
					{
						eKind = EDeviceKind::Pci;
					}

					u32 iEntry = 0;
					for ( ; iEntry < report.m_cDevices; ++iEntry )
					{
						const DeviceEntry_t &entry = report.m_rgDevices[iEntry];
						if ( entry.m_unVendorId == unVendor && entry.m_unDeviceId == unDevice &&
						     static_cast<u16>( unClass ) == static_cast<u16>( entry.m_unKindAndClass >> 8 ) )
							break;
					}
					if ( iEntry != report.m_cDevices )
						continue;

					if ( report.m_cDevices >= ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgDevices ) )
					{
						eStatus = EScanStatus::TooManyDevices;
						break;
					}

					// @note / sapdragon: the report is only cleared up to the header, so the kind goes in over whatever is there
					DeviceEntry_t &entry = report.m_rgDevices[report.m_cDevices];
					entry.m_unKindAndClass = static_cast<u32>( eKind ) | ( entry.m_unKindAndClass & 0xFFFFFFF0 );
					entry.m_unKindAndClass = ( unClass << 8 ) | static_cast<u8>( entry.m_unKindAndClass );
					entry.m_unVendorId = static_cast<u16>( unVendor );
					entry.m_unDeviceId = static_cast<u16>( unDevice );
					++report.m_cDevices;
				}

				g_pImports->HeapFree( g_pImports->GetProcessHeap(), 0, pszBuffer );
			}
			g_pImports->SetupDiDestroyDeviceInfoList( hDeviceInfo );
		}
	}

	bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();
	report.m_eStatus = eStatus;
	*pcubOutput = ( 8 * report.m_cDevices + 39 ) & 0xFFFFFFF8;
	return 0;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::devices
```

`modules/devices/internal/text.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 40e4df95
#include "internal/types.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::devices
{

// @orig: 51 51 53 55 56 57 8B FA
int ParseHex( const char *pszText, u32 cDigits, u32 *punValue ) noexcept
{
	u32 unValue = 0;
	for ( u32 iDigit = 0; iDigit < cDigits; ++iDigit )
	{
		const char chText = pszText[iDigit];
		if ( chText == 0 )
			return 2;

		char chLower = static_cast<char>( chText + 32 );
		if ( static_cast<unsigned>( chText - 'A' ) > 25u )
			chLower = chText;

		u32 unNibble;
		if ( static_cast<unsigned>( chLower - '0' ) <= 9u )
		{
			unNibble = static_cast<u32>( chLower - '0' );
		}
		else
		{
			if ( static_cast<unsigned>( chLower - 'a' ) > 5u )
				return 3;
			unNibble = static_cast<u32>( chLower - 'a' + 10 );
		}

		unValue += unNibble << ( 4 * ( cDigits - iDigit ) - 4 );
	}

	*punValue = unValue;
	return 0;
}

// @orig: 53 56 57 8B FA 8B C1
char *FindString( char *pszHaystack, const char *pszNeedle ) noexcept
{
	char *pszStart = pszHaystack;
	for ( ;; )
	{
		char *pszChar = pszStart;
		const char *pszWanted = pszNeedle;
		while ( *pszWanted && *pszChar == *pszWanted )
		{
			++pszChar;
			++pszWanted;
		}
		if ( !*pszWanted )
			return pszStart;
		if ( !*pszStart )
			return nullptr;
		++pszStart;
	}
}

} // namespace vac::workers::devices

```

```cpp
// @binary: 2023d8c3
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/blob.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::driver_inventory
{

// @orig: 8B 44 24 ? B9 ? ? ? ? 39 08 73 ? 6A ? 58 C3 53 56 8B 74 24 ? 57 51 6A ? 56 89 08 E8 ? ? ? ? 8B 4C 24 ? 83 C4 ? 33 DB
int RunDriverInventory( const Input_t &input, DriverInventoryReport_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	if ( *pcubOutput < sizeof( report ) )
		return static_cast<int>( EWorkerResult::OutputTooSmall );

	*pcubOutput = sizeof( report );
	memset( &report, 0, sizeof( report ) );
	report.m_unMagic = k_unDriverInventoryMagic;
	report.m_unVersion = 1;

	EWorkerResult eResult = EWorkerResult::BootstrapFailed;
	EScanStatus eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
	if ( bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
	{
		eStatus = CollectDriverServiceInventory( report, g_pImports );
		eResult = EWorkerResult::Collected;
	}

	bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();
	report.m_eStatus = eStatus;
	return static_cast<int>( eResult );
}

// @orig: 8B 44 24 ? B9 ? ? ? ? 39 08 73 ? 6A ? 58 C3 53 56 8B 74 24 ? 57 51 6A ? 56 89 08 E8 ? ? ? ? 8B 4C 24 ? 83 C4 ? 83 66
int RunServiceImageDigest( const Input_t &input, ServiceDigestReport_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	if ( *pcubOutput < sizeof( report ) )
		return static_cast<int>( EWorkerResult::OutputTooSmall );

	*pcubOutput = sizeof( report );
	memset( &report, 0, sizeof( report ) );
	report.m_unVersion = 0;
	report.m_unMagic = k_unServiceDigestMagic;

	EWorkerResult eResult = EWorkerResult::BootstrapFailed;
	EScanStatus eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
	if ( bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
	{
		eStatus = CollectServiceImageDigests( report, g_pImports );
		eResult = EWorkerResult::Collected;
	}

	bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();
	report.m_eStatus = eStatus;
	return static_cast<int>( eResult );
}
```

```cpp
constexpr u32 k_cubServices = 0x10000;

// @note / sapdragon: hash of the first five bytes of the name: "mpksl", defender's driver with a random suffix
constexpr u32 k_unVersionedFolderHash = 0xDC8AF399;

struct ScratchRow_t
{
	u32 m_unNameHash;
	u32 m_unNameTextHash;
	u32 m_unPathTextHash;

// @note / sapdragon: variadic in the original, the arguments are a plain va_list on x86
// @orig: 8D 44 24 ? 50 FF 74 24 ? FF 74 24
void FormatGroupPath( wchar_t *pwszOut, const wchar_t *pwszGroup, const wchar_t *pwszDisplayName ) noexcept
{
	const wchar_t *rgpwszArguments[] = { pwszGroup, pwszDisplayName };
	wvsprintfW( pwszOut, L"[%s]\\%s", reinterpret_cast<va_list>( rgpwszArguments ) );
}

// @orig: 0F B7 01 66 85 C0
const wchar_t *FindBackslash( const wchar_t *pwszText ) noexcept
{
	for ( ; *pwszText; ++pwszText )
	{
		if ( *pwszText == L'\\' )
			return pwszText;
	}
	return nullptr;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 33 DB
EScanStatus CollectDriverServiceInventory( DriverInventoryReport_t &report, const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	EScanStatus eStatus = EScanStatus::Ok;
	SC_HANDLE hService = nullptr;
	HANDLE hDirectory = nullptr;
	ScratchRow_t *pRows = nullptr;
	QUERY_SERVICE_CONFIGW *pConfig = nullptr;
	ENUM_SERVICE_STATUSW *pServices = nullptr;
	DWORD unResume = 0;
	DWORD cubNeeded;
	DWORD cServices;

	// @note / sapdragon: left uninitialized on purpose. the prefix hash below can read stale bytes on short names
	u8 rgubText[260];
	u8 rgubObjectName[128];
	wchar_t wszGroupPath[128];

	StringTable_t pathTable;
	StringTable_t nameTable;
	StringTable_t indexTable;
	InitStringTable( pathTable );
	InitStringTable( nameTable );
	InitStringTable( indexTable );
	HashVector_t pathHashes{};
	HashVector_t nameHashes{};

	SC_HANDLE hManager = pImports->OpenSCManagerA( nullptr, nullptr, SC_MANAGER_ENUMERATE_SERVICE );
	if ( !hManager )
	{
		eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
		goto cleanup;
	}

	pServices = static_cast<ENUM_SERVICE_STATUSW *>( util::HeapAlloc( k_cubServices ) );
	if ( !pServices )
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::NotEnoughMemory;
		goto cleanup;
	}
	memset( pServices, 0, k_cubServices );

	{
		const BOOL bEnumerated = pImports->EnumServicesStatusW( hManager, SERVICE_DRIVER, SERVICE_ACTIVE, pServices,
		                                                        k_cubServices, &cubNeeded, &cServices, &unResume );
		const u32 unEnumError = pImports->GetLastError();
		if ( !bEnumerated && unEnumError != ERROR_MORE_DATA )
		{
			eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
			goto cleanup;
		}
	}

	report.m_cServices = cServices;
	if ( cServices > ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgEntries ) )
		cServices = ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgEntries );

	// @note / sapdragon: 32 bytes a service, rows take 16. with zero services the zero-size block still gets object rows
	pRows = static_cast<ScratchRow_t *>( util::HeapAlloc( 32 * cServices ) );
	report.m_cEntries = 0;
	if ( !pRows )
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::NotEnoughMemory;
		goto cleanup;
	}

	pConfig = static_cast<QUERY_SERVICE_CONFIGW *>( util::HeapAlloc( k_cubConfig ) );
	if ( !pConfig )
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::NotEnoughMemory;
		goto cleanup;
	}

	for ( u32 iService = 0; iService < cServices; ++iService )
	{
		const wchar_t *pwszServiceName = pServices[iService].lpServiceName;
		hService = pImports->OpenServiceW( hManager, pwszServiceName, SERVICE_QUERY_CONFIG | SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS );
		if ( !hService )
		{
			eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
			goto cleanup;
		}
		if ( !pImports->QueryServiceConfigW( hService, pConfig, k_cubConfig, &cubNeeded ) )
		{
			eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
			goto cleanup;
		}
		pImports->CloseServiceHandle( hService );

		u32 unPathTextHash = 0;
		u32 unNameTextHash = 0;
		wchar_t *pwszPath = pConfig->lpBinaryPathName;
		if ( !*pwszPath )
		{
			FormatGroupPath( wszGroupPath, pConfig->lpLoadOrderGroup, pConfig->lpDisplayName );
			pwszPath = wszGroupPath;
		}

		if ( FindBackslash( pwszPath ) )
		{
			const wchar_t *pwszBase = util::wstr::BaseName( pwszPath );
			if ( pwszBase )
			{
				// @note / sapdragon: writes before the string when the only backslash is the first char. valve's
				pwszPath[pwszBase - pwszPath - 1] = 0;

				util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( pImports, pwszServiceName, reinterpret_cast<char *>( rgubText ),
				                                   sizeof( rgubText ) );
				if ( util::hashing::PathHashBytes( rgubText, 5 ) == k_unVersionedFolderHash )
				{
					wchar_t *pwszSlash = pwszPath + util::wstr::Length( pwszPath ) + 1;
					while ( pwszSlash != pwszPath )
					{
						if ( *--pwszSlash == L'\\' )
						{
							*pwszSlash = 0;
							break;
						}
					}
				}

				util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( pImports, pwszPath, reinterpret_cast<char *>( rgubText ),
				                                   sizeof( rgubText ) );
				u32 cubText = util::StrLenA( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( rgubText ) );
				unPathTextHash = util::hashing::PathHashBytes( rgubText, cubText );
				AddString( pathTable, unPathTextHash, rgubText, cubText );
				PushHash( pathHashes, unPathTextHash );

				util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( pImports, pwszServiceName, reinterpret_cast<char *>( rgubText ),
				                                   sizeof( rgubText ) );
				cubText = util::StrLenA( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( rgubText ) );
				unNameTextHash = util::hashing::PathHashBytes( rgubText, cubText );
				AddString( nameTable, unNameTextHash, rgubText, cubText );
				PushHash( nameHashes, unNameTextHash );
			}
		}

		util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( pImports, pwszServiceName, reinterpret_cast<char *>( rgubText ),
		                                   sizeof( rgubText ) );
		ScratchRow_t &row = pRows[report.m_cEntries];
		row.m_unNameHash =
		    util::hashing::PathHashBytes( rgubText, util::StrLenA( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( rgubText ) ) );
		row.m_unPathTextHash = unPathTextHash;
		row.m_unNameTextHash = unNameTextHash;
		row.m_eFlags = EDriverEntryFlags::Service;
		++report.m_cEntries;
	}

	{
		UNICODE_STRING name;
		name.Length = sizeof( k_wszDriverDirectory ) - sizeof( wchar_t );
		name.MaximumLength = sizeof( k_wszDriverDirectory );
		name.Buffer = const_cast<PWSTR>( k_wszDriverDirectory );

		OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES attributes;
		attributes.Length = sizeof( attributes );
		attributes.RootDirectory = nullptr;
		attributes.ObjectName = &name;
		attributes.Attributes = OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE;
		attributes.SecurityDescriptor = nullptr;
		attributes.SecurityQualityOfService = nullptr;

		// @note / sapdragon: the directory handle is never closed. valve's leak
		if ( pImports->NtOpenDirectoryObject( &hDirectory, READ_CONTROL | k_unDirectoryQuery, &attributes ) >= 0 )
		{
			ULONG unContext = 0;
			ULONG cubReturned = 0;
			auto *pObject = reinterpret_cast<ObjectDirectoryEntry_t *>( pConfig );
			BOOLEAN bRestart = TRUE;
			while ( pImports->NtQueryDirectoryObject( hDirectory, pConfig, k_cubConfig, TRUE, bRestart, &unContext,
			                                          &cubReturned ) >= 0 )
			{
				bRestart = FALSE;
				++report.m_cDriverObjects;

				util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( pImports, pObject->m_Name.Buffer,
				                                   reinterpret_cast<char *>( rgubObjectName ),
				                                   sizeof( rgubObjectName ) );
				const u32 unHash = util::hashing::PathHashBytes(
				    rgubObjectName, util::StrLenA( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( rgubObjectName ) ) );

				u32 iRow = 0;
				for ( ; iRow < report.m_cEntries; ++iRow )
				{
					if ( pRows[iRow].m_unNameHash == unHash )
						break;
				}

				if ( iRow < report.m_cEntries )
				{
					pRows[iRow].m_eFlags |= EDriverEntryFlags::DriverObject;
				}
				else if ( report.m_cEntries < ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgEntries ) )
				{
					ScratchRow_t &row = pRows[report.m_cEntries];
					row.m_unNameHash = unHash;
					row.m_unNameTextHash = unHash;
					AddString( nameTable, unHash, rgubObjectName,
					           util::StrLenA( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( rgubObjectName ) ) );
					PushHash( nameHashes, unHash );

					const u32 cubNoPath = util::StrLenA( k_szNoPath );
					row.m_unPathTextHash =
					    util::hashing::PathHashBytes( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( k_szNoPath ), cubNoPath );
					AddString( pathTable, row.m_unPathTextHash, k_szNoPath, cubNoPath );
					PushHash( pathHashes, row.m_unPathTextHash );
					row.m_eFlags = EDriverEntryFlags::DriverObject;
					++report.m_cEntries;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	{
		const i32 cubStrings = static_cast<i32>( sizeof( report.m_rgubEntriesAndStrings ) - 1 -
		                                         sizeof( DriverEntry_t ) * report.m_cEntries );
		u8 *pubStrings =
		    reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( report.m_rgubEntriesAndStrings ) + sizeof( DriverEntry_t ) * report.m_cEntries;
		PackDriverStringTables( nameTable, pathTable, pathHashes, nameHashes, cubStrings, pubStrings );
		pubStrings[cubStrings] = 0;
	}

	hService = nullptr;

	{
		// @note / sapdragon: the emitted flags live in the hash vectors, which skip rows without strings
		u32 iHash = 0;
		for ( u32 iRow = 0; iRow < report.m_cEntries; ++iRow )
		{
			const ScratchRow_t &row = pRows[iRow];
			if ( row.m_unNameTextHash && !nameHashes.m_punData[iHash] )
				AddString( indexTable, row.m_unNameTextHash, nullptr, 0 );
			if ( row.m_unPathTextHash && !pathHashes.m_punData[iHash] )
				AddString( indexTable, row.m_unPathTextHash, nullptr, 0 );

			DriverEntry_t &entry = report.m_rgEntries[iRow];
			entry.m_unNameHash = row.m_unNameHash;
			entry.m_nNameString = static_cast<i16>( FindStringByHash( indexTable, row.m_unNameTextHash ) );
			entry.m_nPathString = static_cast<i16>( FindStringByHash( indexTable, row.m_unPathTextHash ) );
			entry.m_eFlags = row.m_eFlags;

			if ( row.m_unNameTextHash )
				++iHash;
		}
	}

cleanup:
	util::HeapFree( pRows );
	util::HeapFree( pConfig );
	util::HeapFree( pServices );
	pImports->CloseServiceHandle( hService );
	pImports->CloseServiceHandle( hManager );
	if ( nameHashes.m_punData )
		util::HeapFree( nameHashes.m_punData );
	if ( pathHashes.m_punData )
		util::HeapFree( pathHashes.m_punData );
	DestroyStringTable( indexTable );
	DestroyStringTable( nameTable );
	DestroyStringTable( pathTable );
	return eStatus;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::driver_inventory
```

```cpp
// @binary: 2023d8c3
#include "internal/pe_file.hpp"
#include "internal/string_table.hpp"
#include "core/vac_util.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "file/file.hpp"
#include "pe/pe.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::driver_inventory
{

namespace
{

constexpr u32 k_cubPage = 0x1000;
constexpr char k_szOverlaySection[] = ".extra";

} // namespace

// @orig: 53 33 DB 56 8B F1
void CPeFile::Init( const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	m_pImports = pImports;
	m_hFile = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
	m_cubValid = 0;
	m_ulWindowBase = 0;
	m_ibCursor = 0;
	m_pSections = nullptr;
	m_pubRelocations = nullptr;
	m_cubRelocations = 0;
	m_ulRelocationDelta = 0;
	m_bPe64 = false;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 86
void CPeFile::Close() noexcept
{
	if ( m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
	{
		m_pImports->CloseHandle( m_hFile );
		m_hFile = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
	}
	m_cubValid = 0;
	m_ulWindowBase = 0;
	m_ibCursor = 0;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 E8
bool CPeFile::Attach( HANDLE hFile ) noexcept
{
	Close();
	m_hFile = hFile;
	m_szName[0] = 0;
	return m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
}

// @orig: inlined
void CPeFile::SlideWindow() noexcept
{
	memcpy( m_rgubWindow, m_rgubWindow + k_cubPage, k_cubPage );
	m_ulWindowBase += k_cubPage;
	m_ibCursor -= k_cubPage;
}

// @orig: 51 51 53 55 8B 6C 24
u8 *CPeFile::ReadWindow( u32 cubWanted ) noexcept
{
	if ( cubWanted > k_cubPage )
		return nullptr;

	if ( m_ibCursor + cubWanted >= m_cubValid )
	{
		u32 cubKept = 0;
		u32 cubToRead;
		if ( m_ibCursor + cubWanted == m_cubValid )
		{
			if ( m_cubValid == sizeof( m_rgubWindow ) )
			{
				SlideWindow();
				cubKept = k_cubPage;
			}
			cubToRead = cubKept;
		}
		else if ( m_cubValid == 0 )
		{
			cubToRead = sizeof( m_rgubWindow );
		}
		else
		{
			if ( m_cubValid < sizeof( m_rgubWindow ) )
				return nullptr;
			SlideWindow();
			cubKept = k_cubPage;
			cubToRead = k_cubPage;
		}

		if ( cubToRead )
		{
			// @note / sapdragon: the return value is ignored, only the count matters
			DWORD cubRead = 0;
			m_pImports->ReadFile( m_hFile, m_rgubWindow + cubKept, cubToRead, &cubRead, nullptr );
			m_cubValid = cubRead + cubKept;
		}

		if ( m_ibCursor + cubWanted > m_cubValid )
			return nullptr;
	}

	u8 *pubData = m_rgubWindow + m_ibCursor;
	m_ibCursor += cubWanted;
	return pubData;
}

// @orig: 51 51 55 56 33 F6
bool CPeFile::Read( void *pOut, i32 cubWanted ) noexcept
{
	i32 cubDone = 0;
	if ( !cubWanted )
		return true;

	do
	{
		i32 cubChunk = cubWanted - cubDone;
		if ( cubChunk > static_cast<i32>( k_cubPage ) )
			cubChunk = k_cubPage;

		const u8 *pubChunk = ReadWindow( cubChunk );
		if ( !pubChunk )
			return false;

		memcpy( static_cast<u8 *>( pOut ) + cubDone, pubChunk, cubChunk );
		cubDone += cubChunk;
	} while ( cubDone != cubWanted );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 56
bool CPeFile::Seek( u32 ibFile ) noexcept
{
	if ( m_ulWindowBase + m_ibCursor == ibFile )
		return true;

	if ( ibFile >= m_ulWindowBase && ibFile < m_ulWindowBase + m_cubValid )
	{
		m_ibCursor = static_cast<u32>( ibFile - m_ulWindowBase );
		return true;
	}

	m_ibCursor = ibFile % k_cubPage;
	m_ulWindowBase = ibFile - m_ibCursor;
	m_cubValid = 0;
	if ( m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && m_pImports->SetFilePointer( m_hFile, static_cast<LONG>( m_ulWindowBase ),
	                                                                    nullptr, FILE_BEGIN ) != m_ulWindowBase )
	{
		Close();
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 57 BD
EScanStatus CPeFile::ParseHeaders() noexcept
{
	if ( !Read( &m_DosHeader, sizeof( m_DosHeader ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	if ( m_DosHeader.e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;
	if ( !Read( m_rgubDosStub, sizeof( m_rgubDosStub ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	if ( !Seek( m_DosHeader.e_lfanew ) )
		return EScanStatus::SeekFailed;

	u32 unSignature;
	if ( !Read( &unSignature, sizeof( unSignature ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	if ( unSignature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;

	if ( !Read( &m_RawFileHeader, sizeof( m_RawFileHeader ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	memcpy( &m_FileHeader, &m_RawFileHeader, sizeof( m_FileHeader ) );

	if ( ( m_FileHeader.Machine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386 && m_FileHeader.Machine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64 ) ||
	     m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections > pe::k_cMaxSections )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;

	if ( m_FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader == sizeof( m_Optional64 ) )
	{
		if ( !Read( &m_Optional64, sizeof( m_Optional64 ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
		if ( m_Optional64.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC )
			return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
		m_bPe64 = true;
	}
	else if ( m_FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader == sizeof( m_Optional32 ) )
	{
		if ( !Read( &m_Optional32, sizeof( m_Optional32 ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
		if ( m_Optional32.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC )
			return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
	}
	else
	{
		return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
	}

	const u32 cSections = m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
	m_pSections = static_cast<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *>( util::HeapAlloc( sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) * cSections ) );
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		if ( !Read( &m_pSections[iSection], sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	}
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

EScanStatus CPeFile::Open( u32 unVolumeSerial, u64 ulFileId, u32 *punLastError ) noexcept
{
	Reset();

	HANDLE hFile = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
	const EScanStatus eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>(
	    file::OpenByVolumeAndId( m_pImports, unVolumeSerial, ulFileId, FILE_GENERIC_READ, &hFile, punLastError ) );
	if ( eStatus != EScanStatus::Ok )
		return eStatus;

	if ( !Attach( hFile ) )
	{
		*punLastError = m_pImports->GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::OpenFailed;
	}
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 51 53 55 56 8B F1 57 83 BE
EScanStatus CPeFile::ParseAndAppendOverlay() noexcept
{
	if ( m_hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return EScanStatus::NoFile;

	const EScanStatus eStatus = ParseHeaders();
	if ( eStatus != EScanStatus::Ok )
	{
		Reset();
		return eStatus;
	}

	u32 ibRawEnd = 0;
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const u32 ibSectionEnd = m_pSections[iSection].SizeOfRawData + m_pSections[iSection].PointerToRawData;
		if ( ibSectionEnd > ibRawEnd )
			ibRawEnd = ibSectionEnd;
	}

	const u32 cubFile = file::GetFileSizeOrZero( m_pImports, m_hFile );
	const u32 unAlignment = m_bPe64 ? m_Optional64.SectionAlignment : m_Optional32.SectionAlignment;
	if ( ibRawEnd < cubFile )
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: not pe::AppendOverlaySection. this one reads before the array with zero sections and
		// faults on a zero alignment, valve never checks either
		++m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
		const u32 cubOverlay = cubFile - ibRawEnd;
		m_pSections = static_cast<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *>(
		    Reallocate( m_pSections, sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) * m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections ) );

		IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &overlay = m_pSections[m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections - 1];
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &last = m_pSections[m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections - 2];

		u32 cubSpan = last.Misc.VirtualSize;
		if ( cubSpan < last.SizeOfRawData )
			cubSpan = unAlignment + last.SizeOfRawData - 1 - ( unAlignment + last.SizeOfRawData - 1 ) % unAlignment;
		const u32 unEnd = unAlignment + cubSpan + last.VirtualAddress - 1;

		memset( &overlay, 0, sizeof( overlay ) );
		overlay.PointerToRawData = ibRawEnd;
		overlay.Characteristics = IMAGE_SCN_MEM_DISCARDABLE;
		overlay.SizeOfRawData = cubOverlay;
		overlay.VirtualAddress = unEnd - unEnd % unAlignment;
		overlay.Misc.VirtualSize = unAlignment + cubOverlay - 1 - ( unAlignment + cubOverlay - 1 ) % unAlignment;
		memcpy( overlay.Name, k_szOverlaySection, sizeof( k_szOverlaySection ) );
	}
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 53 56 57 8B F1
void CPeFile::Reset() noexcept
{
	Close();
	if ( m_pSections )
		util::HeapFree( m_pSections );
	if ( m_pubRelocations )
		util::HeapFree( m_pubRelocations );

	m_ulRelocationDelta = 0;
	m_pSections = nullptr;
	m_pubRelocations = nullptr;
	m_cubRelocations = 0;
	m_bPe64 = false;
}

// @orig: 51 56 8B F1 57 80 BE
bool CPeFile::LoadRelocations() noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory = m_bPe64 ? m_Optional64.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC]
	                                                : m_Optional32.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC];
	m_cubRelocations = directory.Size;
	if ( !m_cubRelocations )
		return true;

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection =
	    pe::FindSectionByRva( m_pSections, m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections, directory.VirtualAddress );
	u32 unRvaToFile = 0;
	if ( pSection && m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		unRvaToFile = pSection->VirtualAddress - pSection->PointerToRawData;

	if ( !Seek( directory.VirtualAddress - unRvaToFile ) )
		return false;

	m_pubRelocations = static_cast<u8 *>( util::HeapAlloc( m_cubRelocations ) );
	return Read( m_pubRelocations, m_cubRelocations );
}

// @orig: 8B 81 ? ? ? ? 0B 81 ? ? ? ? 74 ? B0
bool CPeFile::IsRelocated() const noexcept
{
	return m_ulRelocationDelta != 0;
}

// @note / sapdragon: not pe::ApplyRelocationsForHash. this one fails on unknown types and patches the window in
// place, so a value crossing the chunk end is already patched when the next chunk reads it
// @orig: 51 51 8B 44 24
bool CPeFile::ApplyRelocations( u8 *pubChunk, u32 unChunkRva, u32 cubChunk, i32 *pibCursor ) noexcept
{
	if ( m_bPe64 )
		return false;

	const u32 unChunkEnd = unChunkRva + cubChunk;
	for ( i32 ibBlock = *pibCursor; ibBlock < m_cubRelocations; ibBlock = *pibCursor )
	{
		const auto *pBlock = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION *>( m_pubRelocations + ibBlock );
		const u32 unPageRva = pBlock->VirtualAddress;
		if ( unPageRva >= unChunkEnd )
			break;

		const i32 cEntries = static_cast<i32>( ( pBlock->SizeOfBlock - sizeof( IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION ) ) >> 1 );
		if ( unPageRva + k_cubPage > unChunkRva && cEntries )
		{
			const auto *punEntry = reinterpret_cast<const u16 *>( pBlock + 1 );
			i32 iEntry = 0;
			do
			{
				const u32 unEntry = punEntry[iEntry];
				const u32 unPatchRva = unPageRva + ( unEntry & 0xFFF );
				if ( unPatchRva >= unChunkRva )
				{
					if ( unPatchRva >= unChunkEnd )
						return true;

					const u32 unType = unEntry >> 12;
					if ( unType )
					{
						if ( unType != IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGHLOW )
							return false;

						u8 *pubValue = pubChunk + unPatchRva - unChunkRva;
						const u32 unValue =
						    *reinterpret_cast<const u32 *>( pubValue ) - static_cast<u32>( m_ulRelocationDelta );
						memcpy( pubValue, &unValue, sizeof( unValue ) );
					}
				}
				++iEntry;
			} while ( iEntry < cEntries );
		}

		*pibCursor = pBlock->SizeOfBlock + ibBlock;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 8B 45
void CPeFile::HashRange( const u8 *pubChunk, u32 unRva, u32 cubChunk, crypto::hash::Md5_t &md5 ) noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY *pDirectories = m_bPe64 ? m_Optional64.DataDirectory : m_Optional32.DataDirectory;
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &iat = pDirectories[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IAT];
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &exports = pDirectories[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT];

	pe::RangePair_t iatSplit;
	pe::RangePair_t first;
	pe::RangePair_t second;
	pe::SplitAroundDirectory( iat.VirtualAddress, iat.Size, unRva, unRva + cubChunk, iatSplit );
	pe::SplitAroundDirectory( exports.VirtualAddress, exports.Size, iatSplit.m_rgunStart[0], iatSplit.m_rgunEnd[0],
	                          first );
	pe::SplitAroundDirectory( exports.VirtualAddress, exports.Size, iatSplit.m_rgunStart[1], iatSplit.m_rgunEnd[1],
	                          second );

	const u32 rgunStarts[] = { first.m_rgunStart[0], first.m_rgunStart[1], second.m_rgunStart[0],
	                           second.m_rgunStart[1] };
	const u32 rgunEnds[] = { first.m_rgunEnd[0], first.m_rgunEnd[1], second.m_rgunEnd[0], second.m_rgunEnd[1] };
	for ( u32 iRange = 0; iRange < 4; ++iRange )
	{
		if ( rgunEnds[iRange] > rgunStarts[iRange] )
			md5.Update( pubChunk + rgunStarts[iRange] - unRva, rgunEnds[iRange] - rgunStarts[iRange] );
	}
}

// @orig: 80 B9 ? ? ? ? ? 74 ? 8B 81 ? ? ? ? 8B 91
u64 CPeFile::GetImageBase() const noexcept
{
	return m_bPe64 ? m_Optional64.ImageBase : m_Optional32.ImageBase;
}

// @orig: 51 53 8B 5C 24 ? 55 56
bool CPeFile::BeginSectionStream( const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section ) noexcept
{
	if ( IsRelocated() && !m_pubRelocations && !LoadRelocations() )
		return false;

	if ( !Seek( section.PointerToRawData ) )
		return false;

	m_ibRelocationCursor = 0;
	m_unSectionRva = section.VirtualAddress;
	m_cubSectionLeft = section.SizeOfRawData;
	return true;
}

// @orig: 51 51 53 55 56 8B F1
bool CPeFile::HashNextSectionChunk( crypto::hash::Md5_t &md5 ) noexcept
{
	i32 cubChunk = m_cubSectionLeft;
	if ( !cubChunk )
		return false;
	if ( cubChunk > static_cast<i32>( k_cubPage ) )
		cubChunk = k_cubPage;

	u8 *pubChunk = ReadWindow( cubChunk );
	if ( !pubChunk )
		return false;
	if ( IsRelocated() && !m_bPe64 && !ApplyRelocations( pubChunk, m_unSectionRva, cubChunk, &m_ibRelocationCursor ) )
		return false;

	HashRange( pubChunk, m_unSectionRva, cubChunk, md5 );
	m_unSectionRva += cubChunk;
	m_cubSectionLeft -= cubChunk;
	return m_cubSectionLeft != 0;
}

// @orig: 56 FF 74 24 ? 8B F1 FF 74 24
bool CPeFile::HashSectionStream( const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section, crypto::hash::Md5_t &md5 ) noexcept
{
	if ( !BeginSectionStream( section ) )
		return false;

	while ( HashNextSectionChunk( md5 ) )
	{
	}
	return m_cubSectionLeft == 0;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56
bool CPeFile::HashHeadersAndSelectedSection( crypto::hash::Md5_t &md5, u8 *pubDigest ) noexcept
{
	m_ulRelocationDelta = GetImageBase() - pe::k_unRelocationBase;

	md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &m_DosHeader ), sizeof( m_DosHeader ) );
	md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &m_RawFileHeader ), sizeof( m_RawFileHeader ) );

	if ( m_bPe64 )
	{
		IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 optional;
		memcpy( &optional, &m_Optional64, sizeof( optional ) );
		optional.ImageBase = 0;
		md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &optional ), sizeof( optional ) );
	}
	else
	{
		IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32 optional;
		memcpy( &optional, &m_Optional32, sizeof( optional ) );
		optional.ImageBase = 0;
		md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &optional ), sizeof( optional ) );
	}

	if ( !m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections )
		return false;

	// @note / sapdragon: the overlay section can be selected but its metadata is not hashed, it is not on disk
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < m_RawFileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = m_pSections[iSection];
		md5.Update( section.Name, sizeof( section.Name ) );
		md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &section.VirtualAddress ), sizeof( section.VirtualAddress ) );
		md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &section.SizeOfRawData ), sizeof( section.SizeOfRawData ) );
	}

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSelected = pe::SelectHashSection( m_pSections, m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections );
	if ( !pSelected || !HashSectionStream( *pSelected, md5 ) )
		return false;

	md5.Final( pubDigest );
	return true;
}
```

```cpp
// @binary: 2023d8c3
#include "internal/pe_file.hpp"
#include "internal/string_table.hpp"
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/vac_util.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "crypto/hash/md5.hpp"
#include "file/file.hpp"
#include "util/encoding.hpp"
#include "util/hashing.hpp"
#include "util/strings.hpp"
#include "util/wstr.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::driver_inventory
{

namespace
{

constexpr u32 k_cubServices = 0x10000;
constexpr u32 k_cubConfig = 0x1000;

constexpr wchar_t k_wszNtPrefix[] = L"\\??\\";
constexpr wchar_t k_wszSystemRoot[] = L"\\SystemRoot";
constexpr wchar_t k_wszSystemDirectory[] = L"\\SystemDirectory";
constexpr wchar_t k_wszWindows[] = L"\\windows";
constexpr wchar_t k_wszSystem32[] = L"system32";
constexpr wchar_t k_wszNative[] = L"native";

// @note / sapdragon: same neighbours as valve's frame, so a path longer than the buffer runs into the reader
struct ImageFrame_t
{
	wchar_t m_wszPath[256];
	CPeFile m_File;
};

wchar_t UpperChar( wchar_t wchChar ) noexcept
{
	return static_cast<wchar_t>(
	    reinterpret_cast<uptr>( CharUpperW( reinterpret_cast<LPWSTR>( static_cast<uptr>( wchChar ) ) ) ) );
}

// @orig: FF 74 24 ? 52
int CompareNoCase( const wchar_t *pwszA, const wchar_t *pwszB, int cChars ) noexcept
{
	return CompareStringW( LOCALE_SYSTEM_DEFAULT, NORM_IGNORECASE, pwszA, cChars, pwszB, cChars ) - CSTR_EQUAL;
}

// @note / sapdragon: always reads the full 512 bytes of the source first, even past its end
// @orig: 56 57 8B F2 8B F9
void CopyPath( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc ) noexcept
{
	memcpy( pwszDst, pwszSrc, sizeof( ImageFrame_t::m_wszPath ) );
	const u32 cChars = util::wstr::Length( pwszSrc );
	if ( cChars < ARRAYSIZE( ImageFrame_t::m_wszPath ) )
		memset( pwszDst + cChars, 0, sizeof( wchar_t ) * ( ARRAYSIZE( ImageFrame_t::m_wszPath ) - cChars ) );
}

// @note / sapdragon: not wstr::Cat, the limit counts what gets added and leaves no room for the terminator
// @orig: 53 55 56 8B 35 ? ? ? ? 8B E9
void AppendPath( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc, u32 cMaxChars ) noexcept
{
	const u32 cDst = util::wstr::Length( pwszDst );
	u32 cSrc = util::wstr::Length( pwszSrc );
	if ( cSrc > cMaxChars )
		cSrc = cMaxChars;
	memcpy( pwszDst + cDst, pwszSrc, sizeof( wchar_t ) * cSrc );
	pwszDst[cSrc + cDst] = 0;
}

// @orig: 56 57 8B FA 33 C0
void ExpandServiceImagePath( const wchar_t *pwszImage, wchar_t *pwszOut ) noexcept
{
	*pwszOut = 0;

	int nDifference = 0;
	for ( u32 iChar = 0; iChar < ARRAYSIZE( k_wszNtPrefix ) - 1; ++iChar )
	{
		if ( !pwszImage[iChar] || pwszImage[iChar] != k_wszNtPrefix[iChar] )
		{
			nDifference = pwszImage[iChar] - k_wszNtPrefix[iChar];
			break;
		}
	}
	if ( !nDifference )
	{
		CopyPath( pwszOut, pwszImage + ( ARRAYSIZE( k_wszNtPrefix ) - 1 ) );
		return;
	}

	const wchar_t *pwszRoot;
	u32 cPrefix;
	if ( !CompareNoCase( pwszImage, k_wszSystemRoot, ARRAYSIZE( k_wszSystemRoot ) - 1 ) )
	{
		pwszRoot = g_pSession->m_wszWindowsDirectory;
		cPrefix = ARRAYSIZE( k_wszSystemRoot ) - 1;
	}
	else if ( !CompareNoCase( pwszImage, k_wszSystemDirectory, ARRAYSIZE( k_wszSystemDirectory ) - 1 ) )
	{
		pwszRoot = g_pSession->m_wszSystemDirectory;
		cPrefix = ARRAYSIZE( k_wszSystemDirectory ) - 1;
	}
	else if ( !CompareNoCase( pwszImage, k_wszWindows, ARRAYSIZE( k_wszWindows ) - 1 ) )
	{
		pwszRoot = g_pSession->m_wszWindowsDirectory;
		cPrefix = ARRAYSIZE( k_wszWindows ) - 1;
	}
	else
	{
		CopyPath( pwszOut, pwszImage );
		return;
	}

	CopyPath( pwszOut, pwszRoot );
	AppendPath( pwszOut, pwszImage + cPrefix, ARRAYSIZE( ImageFrame_t::m_wszPath ) - util::wstr::Length( pwszOut ) );
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 8B 35
wchar_t *FindSystem32( wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	u32 cLeft = util::wstr::Length( pwszPath );
	if ( cLeft < ARRAYSIZE( k_wszSystem32 ) - 1 )
		return nullptr;

	for ( ;; )
	{
		if ( UpperChar( *pwszPath ) == UpperChar( k_wszSystem32[0] ) )
		{
			u32 iChar = 1;
			while ( k_wszSystem32[iChar] && UpperChar( pwszPath[iChar] ) == UpperChar( k_wszSystem32[iChar] ) )
				++iChar;
			if ( !k_wszSystem32[iChar] )
				return pwszPath;
		}

		++pwszPath;
		if ( --cLeft < ARRAYSIZE( k_wszSystem32 ) - 1 )
			return nullptr;
	}
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC A1
bool GetFileId( const SystemImports_t *pImports, const wchar_t *pwszPath, u32 *punVolumeSerial,
                u64 *pulFileId ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle )
		return false;

	HANDLE hFile = pImports->CreateFileW( pwszPath, FILE_GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
	                                      FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
	if ( hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return false;

	BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION information;
	const BOOL bQueried = pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle( hFile, &information );
	pImports->CloseHandle( hFile );
	if ( !bQueried )
		return false;

	*punVolumeSerial = information.dwVolumeSerialNumber;
	*pulFileId = ( static_cast<u64>( information.nFileIndexHigh ) << 32 ) | information.nFileIndexLow;
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 E4 ? B8
EScanStatus CollectServiceImageDigests( ServiceDigestReport_t &report, const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	EScanStatus eStatus = EScanStatus::Ok;
	SC_HANDLE hService = nullptr;
	QUERY_SERVICE_CONFIGW *pConfig = nullptr;
	ENUM_SERVICE_STATUSW *pServices = nullptr;
	DWORD unResume = 0;
	DWORD cubNeeded;
	DWORD cServices;
	u8 rgubName[64];
	ImageFrame_t frame;

	// @note / sapdragon: built and destroyed, never used. it is in the original too
	StringTable_t rgUnusedTables[3];
	InitStringTable( rgUnusedTables[2] );
	InitStringTable( rgUnusedTables[1] );
	InitStringTable( rgUnusedTables[0] );

	SC_HANDLE hManager = pImports->OpenSCManagerA( nullptr, nullptr, SC_MANAGER_ENUMERATE_SERVICE );
	if ( !hManager )
	{
		eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
		goto cleanup;
	}

	pServices = static_cast<ENUM_SERVICE_STATUSW *>( util::HeapAlloc( k_cubServices ) );
	if ( !pServices )
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::NotEnoughMemory;
		goto cleanup;
	}
	memset( pServices, 0, k_cubServices );

	{
		const BOOL bEnumerated = pImports->EnumServicesStatusW( hManager, SERVICE_DRIVER, SERVICE_ACTIVE, pServices,
		                                                        k_cubServices, &cubNeeded, &cServices, &unResume );
		const u32 unEnumError = pImports->GetLastError();
		if ( !bEnumerated && unEnumError != ERROR_MORE_DATA )
		{
			eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
			goto cleanup;
		}
	}

	report.m_cEntries = 0;
	if ( cServices > ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgEntries ) )
		cServices = ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgEntries );

	pConfig = static_cast<QUERY_SERVICE_CONFIGW *>( util::HeapAlloc( k_cubConfig ) );
	if ( !pConfig )
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::NotEnoughMemory;
		goto cleanup;
	}

	for ( u32 iService = 0; iService < cServices; ++iService )
	{
		hService = pImports->OpenServiceW( hManager, pServices[iService].lpServiceName,
		                                   SERVICE_QUERY_CONFIG | SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS );
		if ( !hService || !pImports->QueryServiceConfigW( hService, pConfig, k_cubConfig, &cubNeeded ) )
		{
			eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
			goto cleanup;
		}
		pImports->CloseServiceHandle( hService );
		hService = nullptr;

		// @note / sapdragon: the hash goes in before the file is opened and the slot is reused when that fails,
		// so the last failed service stays visible past the end of the entries
		ServiceDigestEntry_t &entry = report.m_rgEntries[report.m_cEntries];
		util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( pImports, pServices[iService].lpServiceName,
		                                   reinterpret_cast<char *>( rgubName ), sizeof( rgubName ) );
		entry.m_unServiceNameHash =
		    util::hashing::PathHashBytes( rgubName, util::StrLenA( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( rgubName ) ) );

		wchar_t *pwszPath = frame.m_wszPath;
		memset( pwszPath, 0, sizeof( frame.m_wszPath ) );
		ExpandServiceImagePath( pConfig->lpBinaryPathName, pwszPath );

		wchar_t *pwszSystem32 = FindSystem32( pwszPath );
		if ( pwszSystem32 )
		{
			wchar_t *pwszTail = pwszSystem32 + ( ARRAYSIZE( k_wszSystem32 ) - 1 );
			memmove( pwszTail + 1, pwszTail, sizeof( wchar_t ) * util::wstr::Length( pwszTail ) );
			memcpy( pwszSystem32 + 3, k_wszNative, sizeof( wchar_t ) * util::wstr::Length( k_wszNative ) );
		}

		if ( pwszPath[1] != L':' )
		{
			const wchar_t *pwszWindows = g_pSession->m_wszWindowsDirectory;
			const u32 cWindows = util::wstr::Length( pwszWindows );
			memmove( pwszPath + 1 + cWindows, pwszPath, sizeof( wchar_t ) * util::wstr::Length( pwszPath ) );
			memmove( pwszPath, pwszWindows, sizeof( wchar_t ) * cWindows );
			pwszPath[cWindows] = L'\\';
		}

		u32 unVolumeSerial = 0;
		u64 ulFileId = 0;
		if ( !GetFileId( pImports, pwszPath, &unVolumeSerial, &ulFileId ) )
			continue;

		CPeFile &peFile = frame.m_File;
		peFile.Init( pImports );

		// @note / sapdragon: a failed hash leaves status zero and the last error of the open
		u32 unLastError = 0;
		const EScanStatus eOpenStatus = peFile.Open( unVolumeSerial, ulFileId, &unLastError );
		entry.m_unLastError = unLastError;
		entry.m_rgunZero[0] = 0;
		entry.m_rgunZero[1] = 0;
		entry.m_eStatus = eOpenStatus;
		if ( eOpenStatus == EScanStatus::Ok )
		{
			const EScanStatus eParseStatus = peFile.ParseAndAppendOverlay();
			entry.m_eStatus = eParseStatus;
			if ( eParseStatus == EScanStatus::Ok )
			{
				crypto::hash::Md5_t md5;
				u8 rgubDigest[crypto::hash::k_cubMd5Digest];
				if ( peFile.HashHeadersAndSelectedSection( md5, rgubDigest ) )
					memcpy( entry.m_rgubDigest, rgubDigest, sizeof( entry.m_rgubDigest ) );
			}
		}

		const u32 cEntries = ++report.m_cEntries;
		peFile.Reset();
		peFile.Close();
		if ( cEntries >= ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgEntries ) )
			goto cleanup;
	}

cleanup:
	util::HeapFree( pConfig );
	util::HeapFree( pServices );
	pImports->CloseServiceHandle( hService );
	pImports->CloseServiceHandle( hManager );
	DestroyStringTable( rgUnusedTables[0] );
	DestroyStringTable( rgUnusedTables[1] );
	DestroyStringTable( rgUnusedTables[2] );
	return eStatus;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::driver_inventory
```

```cpp
// @binary: 2023d8c3
#include "internal/string_table.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/imports.hpp"
#include "core/vac_util.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::driver_inventory
{

namespace
{

constexpr i32 k_cMaxStrings = 500;
constexpr i32 k_cubStringText = 0x4000;

} // namespace

// @orig: 52 85 C9 74
void *Reallocate( void *pMemory, usize cubSize ) noexcept
{
	if ( pMemory )
		return HeapReAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), 0, pMemory, cubSize );
	return HeapAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), 0, cubSize );
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 56
static void EnsureHashCapacity( HashVector_t &hashes ) noexcept
{
	if ( hashes.m_cHashes == hashes.m_cCapacity )
	{
		hashes.m_cCapacity += 128;
		hashes.m_punData = static_cast<u32 *>( Reallocate( hashes.m_punData, hashes.m_cCapacity * sizeof( u32 ) ) );
	}
}

// @orig: 56 57 8B F9 E8
void PushHash( HashVector_t &hashes, u32 unHash ) noexcept
{
	EnsureHashCapacity( hashes );
	hashes.m_punData[hashes.m_cHashes++] = unHash;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 B9
void InitStringTable( StringTable_t &table ) noexcept
{
	table.m_pchText = static_cast<char *>( util::HeapAlloc( k_cubStringText ) );
	table.m_pchTextEnd = table.m_pchText;
	table.m_pEntries = static_cast<StringEntry_t *>( util::HeapAlloc( sizeof( StringEntry_t ) * k_cMaxStrings ) );
	table.m_cubText = 0;
	table.m_cEntries = 0;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 4E
void DestroyStringTable( StringTable_t &table ) noexcept
{
	util::HeapFree( table.m_pchText );
	util::HeapFree( table.m_pEntries );
}

// @orig: 53 8B 5C 24 ? 33 C0
void AddString( StringTable_t &table, u32 unHash, const void *pubText, i32 cubText ) noexcept
{
	for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < table.m_cEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		if ( table.m_pEntries[iEntry].m_unHash == unHash )
		{
			++table.m_pEntries[iEntry].m_cUses;
			return;
		}
	}

	if ( table.m_cEntries >= k_cMaxStrings )
		return;

	StringEntry_t &entry = table.m_pEntries[table.m_cEntries];
	entry.m_unHash = unHash;
	entry.m_cUses = 1;
	entry.m_pszText = nullptr;
	entry.m_cubText = cubText;
	entry.m_bSelected = false;

	if ( pubText && cubText + table.m_cubText + 1 < k_cubStringText )
	{
		memcpy( table.m_pchTextEnd, pubText, cubText );
		table.m_pchTextEnd[cubText] = 0;
		entry.m_pszText = table.m_pchTextEnd;
		table.m_pchTextEnd += cubText + 1;
		table.m_cubText += cubText + 1;
	}
	++table.m_cEntries;
}

// @orig: 8B 11 33 C0 56
i32 FindStringByHash( const StringTable_t &table, u32 unHash ) noexcept
{
	for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < table.m_cEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		if ( table.m_pEntries[iEntry].m_unHash == unHash )
			return iEntry;
	}
	return -1;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 55 8B E9
void SortStringsByUses( StringTable_t &table ) noexcept
{
	for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < table.m_cEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		for ( i32 iOther = iEntry + 1; iOther < table.m_cEntries; ++iOther )
		{
			if ( table.m_pEntries[iEntry].m_cUses < table.m_pEntries[iOther].m_cUses )
			{
				const StringEntry_t entry = table.m_pEntries[iEntry];
				table.m_pEntries[iEntry] = table.m_pEntries[iOther];
				table.m_pEntries[iOther] = entry;
			}
		}
	}
}

// @orig: 53 8B D9 33 D2
bool EmitString( const StringTable_t &table, u32 unHash, u8 **ppubBlob, i32 *pcubBlob ) noexcept
{
	for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < table.m_cEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		const StringEntry_t &entry = table.m_pEntries[iEntry];
		if ( entry.m_unHash == unHash && entry.m_cubText < *pcubBlob )
		{
			u8 *pubBlob = *ppubBlob;
			*pcubBlob = *pcubBlob - entry.m_cubText - 1;
			memcpy( pubBlob, entry.m_pszText, entry.m_cubText + 1 );
			*ppubBlob = pubBlob + entry.m_cubText + 1;
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 55 57
void PackDriverStringTables( StringTable_t &names, StringTable_t &paths, HashVector_t &pathHashes,
                             HashVector_t &nameHashes, i32 cubBlob, u8 *pubBlob ) noexcept
{
	if ( !paths.m_cEntries )
		return;

	i32 cubBudget = cubBlob;
	SortStringsByUses( paths );

	// @note / sapdragon: starts at the least used path and walks back to the most used one, whole strings only.
	// a name that does not fit stops that row, but the names it already picked stay picked
	i32 iPath = ( 100 * paths.m_cEntries - 100 ) / 100;
	const i32 iLastPath = ( iPath + 1 ) % paths.m_cEntries;
	for ( i32 cVisited = 0; cVisited < paths.m_cEntries; ++cVisited )
	{
		for ( u32 iRow = 0; iRow < pathHashes.m_cHashes; ++iRow )
		{
			if ( FindStringByHash( paths, pathHashes.m_punData[iRow] ) != iPath )
				continue;

			const i32 iName = FindStringByHash( names, nameHashes.m_punData[iRow] );
			if ( !names.m_pEntries[iName].m_bSelected )
			{
				cubBudget -= names.m_pEntries[iName].m_cubText + 1;
				if ( cubBudget < 0 )
					break;
				if ( iName >= 0 && iName < names.m_cEntries )
					names.m_pEntries[iName].m_bSelected = true;
			}
		}

		cubBudget -= paths.m_pEntries[iPath].m_cubText + 1;
		if ( cubBudget < 0 )
			break;
		if ( iPath >= 0 && iPath < paths.m_cEntries )
			paths.m_pEntries[iPath].m_bSelected = true;
		if ( iPath == iLastPath )
			break;
		iPath = iPath - 1 >= 0 ? iPath - 1 : paths.m_cEntries - 1;
	}

	i32 cubLeft = cubBlob;
	for ( u32 iRow = 0; iRow < pathHashes.m_cHashes; ++iRow )
	{
		const i32 iName = FindStringByHash( names, nameHashes.m_punData[iRow] );
		if ( iName >= 0 && names.m_pEntries[iName].m_bSelected )
		{
			if ( iName < names.m_cEntries )
				names.m_pEntries[iName].m_bSelected = false;
			if ( EmitString( names, nameHashes.m_punData[iRow], &pubBlob, &cubLeft ) )
				nameHashes.m_punData[iRow] = 0;
		}

		const i32 iPathRow = FindStringByHash( paths, pathHashes.m_punData[iRow] );
		if ( iPathRow >= 0 && paths.m_pEntries[iPathRow].m_bSelected )
		{
			if ( iPathRow < paths.m_cEntries )
				paths.m_pEntries[iPathRow].m_bSelected = false;

			// @note / sapdragon: a hash that is also a name counts as emitted, the path text never goes in
			const u32 unHash = pathHashes.m_punData[iRow];
			if ( FindStringByHash( names, unHash ) >= 0 || EmitString( paths, unHash, &pubBlob, &cubLeft ) )
				pathHashes.m_punData[iRow] = 0;
		}
	}
}

} // namespace vac::workers::driver_inventory
```

```cpp
// Scripted differential test against the original module.
//
//     driver_inventory_regression.exe [original module.dll]
//
// A live run ends at the first QueryServiceConfigW failure, and on the machine this was written on that is the fifth
// service, so it never reaches the object walk or the string packer. Here both collectors run against the same mocked
// import table.
// Each case compares the status, all 4096 report bytes, and the full sequence of logged API calls.
//
// Without an argument it looks for the DLL in ..\vac-research next to the repository. When the DLL is missing only the
// checks that do not need it run, and the summary says so.

void Fail( const std::string &message )
{
	if ( s_cFailures < 40 )
		std::printf( "FAIL: %s\n", message.c_str() );
	++s_cFailures;
}

{
	if ( !bOk )
		Fail( pszMessage );
}

std::string Narrow( const wchar_t *pwsz )
{
	if ( !pwsz )
		return "(null)";
	char rgchBuffer[1024]{};
	WideCharToMultiByte( CP_UTF8, 0, pwsz, -1, rgchBuffer, sizeof( rgchBuffer ) - 1, nullptr, nullptr );
	return rgchBuffer;
}

	     std::to_string( unAccess ) );
	if ( s_pScenario->m_unManagerError )
	{
		s_unLastError = s_pScenario->m_unManagerError;
		return nullptr;
	}
	return k_hManager;
```
