// @binary: 33211402
#include "../scanner.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "file/file.hpp"
#include "util/xor_string.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::image_scan
{

namespace
{

using PfnWow64DisableWow64FsRedirection_t = BOOL( WINAPI * )( void ** );

} // namespace

// @orig: 33211402:0x1000AC52 (no unique signature)
void *AllocBytes( u32 cub ) noexcept
{
	return HeapAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), 0, cub );
}

// @orig: 33211402:0x1000AC63 (no unique signature)
void FreeBytes( void *pv ) noexcept
{
	HeapFree( GetProcessHeap(), 0, pv );
}

// @orig: 52 85 C9 74
void *ReallocBytes( void *pv, u32 cub ) noexcept
{
	if ( pv )
		return HeapReAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), 0, pv, cub );
	return HeapAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), 0, cub );
}

// @orig: 56 33 F6 57 8B FA
int CompareNameBounded( const char *pszA, const char *pszB, u32 cMaxChars ) noexcept
{
	for ( u32 iChar = 0; iChar < cMaxChars; ++iChar )
	{
		const u8 unA = static_cast<u8>( pszA[iChar] );
		if ( !unA || unA != static_cast<u8>( pszB[iChar] ) )
			return unA - static_cast<u8>( pszB[iChar] );
	}
	return 0;
}

// @orig: 53 55 57 8B E9
int ComparePathPrefix( const wchar_t *pwszA, const wchar_t *pwszB, u32 cMaxChars ) noexcept
{
	u32 cCharsA = static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( pwszA ) );
	u32 cCharsB = static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( pwszB ) );
	if ( cCharsA > cMaxChars )
		cCharsA = cMaxChars;
	if ( cCharsB > cMaxChars )
		cCharsB = cMaxChars;
	return CompareStringW( LOCALE_SYSTEM_DEFAULT, NORM_IGNORECASE, pwszA, static_cast<int>( cCharsA ), pwszB,
	                       static_cast<int>( cCharsB ) ) -
	       CSTR_EQUAL;
}

// @note / sapdragon: not vac::util::wstr::Copy. this reads cChars from the source no matter how short it is, fills
// the rest with zeros and does not terminate a full copy
// @orig: 53 56 57 8B 7C 24 ? 8B F2
void CopyWideFill( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc, u32 cChars ) noexcept
{
	memcpy( pwszDst, pwszSrc, cChars * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
	const u32 cCopied = static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( pwszSrc ) );
	if ( cChars > cCopied )
		memset( pwszDst + cCopied, 0, ( cChars - cCopied ) * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
}

// @orig: 53 55 56 8B 35
static void AppendWideBounded( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc, u32 cMaxChars ) noexcept
{
	const u32 cCharsDst = static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( pwszDst ) );
	u32 cCharsSrc = static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( pwszSrc ) );
	if ( cCharsSrc > cMaxChars )
		cCharsSrc = cMaxChars;
	memcpy( pwszDst + cCharsDst, pwszSrc, cCharsSrc * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
	pwszDst[cCharsDst + cCharsSrc] = 0;
}

// @orig: 53 56 57 8B FA
bool ResolveSpecialPath( const wchar_t *pwszPath, wchar_t *pwszResolved ) noexcept
{
	constexpr wchar_t k_wszNtPrefix[] = L"\\??\\";

	*pwszResolved = 0;

	u32 iChar = 0;
	while ( iChar < 4 && pwszPath[iChar] && pwszPath[iChar] == k_wszNtPrefix[iChar] )
		++iChar;
	if ( iChar == 4 )
	{
		CopyWideFill( pwszResolved, pwszPath + 4, MAX_PATH );
		return true;
	}

	const wchar_t *pwszRest;
	if ( !ComparePathPrefix( pwszPath, L"\\SystemRoot", 11 ) )
	{
		CopyWideFill( pwszResolved, g_pSession->m_wszWindowsDirectory, MAX_PATH );
		pwszRest = pwszPath + 11;
	}
	else if ( !ComparePathPrefix( pwszPath, L"\\SystemDirectory", 16 ) )
	{
		CopyWideFill( pwszResolved, g_pSession->m_wszSystemDirectory, MAX_PATH );
		pwszRest = pwszPath + 16;
	}
	else if ( !ComparePathPrefix( pwszPath, L"\\windows", 8 ) )
	{
		CopyWideFill( pwszResolved, g_pSession->m_wszWindowsDirectory, MAX_PATH );
		pwszRest = pwszPath + 8;
	}
	else
	{
		CopyWideFill( pwszResolved, pwszPath, MAX_PATH );
		return false;
	}

	AppendWideBounded( pwszResolved, pwszRest, MAX_PATH - static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( pwszResolved ) ) );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 33 C0
bool DevicePathToDos( wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	wchar_t wszDrives[MAX_PATH];
	wszDrives[0] = 0;
	if ( !g_pImports->GetLogicalDriveStringsW( 250, wszDrives ) )
		return false;

	wchar_t wszDevice[MAX_PATH];
	wchar_t wszDrive[] = L"C:";
	const wchar_t *pwszDrive = wszDrives;
	u32 cDeviceChars;
	for ( ;; )
	{
		wszDrive[0] = *pwszDrive;
		if ( g_pImports->QueryDosDeviceW( wszDrive, wszDevice, ARRAYSIZE( wszDevice ) ) )
		{
			cDeviceChars = static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( wszDevice ) );
			if ( cDeviceChars < ARRAYSIZE( wszDevice ) && !ComparePathPrefix( pwszPath, wszDevice, cDeviceChars ) )
				break;
		}

		while ( *pwszDrive++ )
			;
		if ( !*pwszDrive )
			return false;
	}

	wchar_t wszResolved[MAX_PATH];
	wszResolved[0] = 0;
	lstrcatW( wszResolved, wszDrive );
	lstrcatW( wszResolved, pwszPath + cDeviceChars );
	CopyWideFill( pwszPath, wszResolved, MAX_PATH );
	return true;
}

// @note / sapdragon: the cookie is never handed back, the worker returns with redirection off
// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 6A
bool DisableWow64FsRedirection() noexcept
{
	auto szDisable = util::MakeXorString<0x37>( "Wow64DisableWow64FsRedirection" );
	szDisable.Decode();

	const HMODULE hKernel32 = g_pImports->GetModuleHandleA( "kernel32.dll" );
	if ( !hKernel32 )
		return false;

	const auto pfnDisable = reinterpret_cast<PfnWow64DisableWow64FsRedirection_t>(
	    g_pImports->GetProcAddress( hKernel32, szDisable.Get() ) );
	if ( !pfnDisable )
		return false;

	void *pvCookie;
	pfnDisable( &pvCookie );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC A1
bool GetFileVolumeAndIndex( const wchar_t *pwszPath, u32 *punVolumeSerial, u64 *pulFileIndex ) noexcept
{
	if ( !g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle )
		return false;

	const HANDLE hFile = g_pImports->CreateFileW( pwszPath, FILE_GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
	                                              FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
	if ( hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return false;

	BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION info;
	const BOOL bOk = g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle( hFile, &info );
	g_pImports->CloseHandle( hFile );
	if ( !bOk )
		return false;

	*punVolumeSerial = info.dwVolumeSerialNumber;
	*pulFileIndex = ( static_cast<u64>( info.nFileIndexHigh ) << 32 ) | info.nFileIndexLow;
	return true;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::image_scan

	u32 m_unSignature;
	u8 m_rgubGuidAge[20];
};
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( CodeViewHeader_t, 24 );

} // namespace

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 57 8B F1
EScanStatus ExtractPdbInfo( ScannerContext_t *pCtx ) noexcept
{
	memset( &pCtx->m_DebugDirectory, 0, sizeof( pCtx->m_DebugDirectory ) );
	memset( pCtx->m_rgubPdbGuid, 0, sizeof( pCtx->m_rgubPdbGuid ) );
	memset( pCtx->m_szPdbPath, 0, sizeof( pCtx->m_szPdbPath ) );

	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory = pCtx->m_bPe64
	                                            ? pCtx->m_OptionalHeader64.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_DEBUG]
	                                            : pCtx->m_OptionalHeader32.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_DEBUG];
	if ( !directory.Size )
		return EScanStatus::NoDebugDirectory;

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection =
	    pe::FindSectionByRva( pCtx->m_pSections, pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections, directory.VirtualAddress );
	if ( !pSection )
		return EScanStatus::NoDebugSection;

	u32 ibFileDelta = 0;
	if ( pCtx->m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		ibFileDelta = pSection->VirtualAddress - pSection->PointerToRawData;

	if ( !ReaderSeek( pCtx, directory.VirtualAddress - ibFileDelta, false ) )
		return EScanStatus::SeekFailed;

	SetReaderClamp( pCtx, pSection->VirtualAddress, pSection->VirtualAddress + pSection->Misc.VirtualSize );

	// @note / sapdragon: a short read ends the search and the function still returns zero
	u32 cubLeft = directory.Size;
	bool bFound = false;
	while ( !bFound && cubLeft >= sizeof( IMAGE_DEBUG_DIRECTORY ) )
	{
		memset( &pCtx->m_DebugDirectory, 0, sizeof( pCtx->m_DebugDirectory ) );
		if ( !ReaderReadBytes( pCtx, &pCtx->m_DebugDirectory, sizeof( pCtx->m_DebugDirectory ) ) )
			break;
		cubLeft -= sizeof( IMAGE_DEBUG_DIRECTORY );
		bFound = pCtx->m_DebugDirectory.Type == IMAGE_DEBUG_TYPE_CODEVIEW;
	}

	if ( bFound && ReaderSeek( pCtx, pCtx->m_DebugDirectory.AddressOfRawData - ibFileDelta, false ) )
	{
		const u32 cubCodeView = pCtx->m_DebugDirectory.SizeOfData;
		u32 unSignature;
		if ( cubCodeView >= sizeof( unSignature ) && ReaderReadBytes( pCtx, &unSignature, sizeof( unSignature ) ) &&
		     unSignature == k_unRsdsSignature && cubCodeView >= sizeof( CodeViewHeader_t ) )
		{
			u8 rgubGuidAge[sizeof( CodeViewHeader_t::m_rgubGuidAge )];
			if ( ReaderReadBytes( pCtx, rgubGuidAge, sizeof( rgubGuidAge ) ) )
			{
				u32 cubPath = cubCodeView - sizeof( CodeViewHeader_t );
				memcpy( pCtx->m_rgubPdbGuid, rgubGuidAge, sizeof( pCtx->m_rgubPdbGuid ) );
				if ( cubPath > sizeof( pCtx->m_szPdbPath ) )
					cubPath = sizeof( pCtx->m_szPdbPath );
				ReaderReadBytes( pCtx, pCtx->m_szPdbPath, cubPath );
				pCtx->m_szPdbPath[sizeof( pCtx->m_szPdbPath ) - 1] = 0;
			}
		}
	}

	SetReaderClamp( pCtx, 0, 0 );
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

#include "../scanner.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::image_scan
{

namespace
{

void StoreHashResult( u32 *pcubField, const HybridHash_t &hash ) noexcept
{
	*pcubField ^= ( hash.m_cubTotal ^ *pcubField ) & k_unByteCountMask;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 8B F9
void DumpModuleInfo( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, ModuleReport_t *pModule ) noexcept
{
	pModule->m_cSections = static_cast<u8>( pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections );
	pModule->m_unTimeDateStamp = pCtx->m_FileHeader.TimeDateStamp;
	if ( pCtx->m_bPe64 )
	{
		pModule->m_unEntryPoint = pCtx->m_OptionalHeader64.AddressOfEntryPoint;
		pModule->m_unCheckSum = pCtx->m_OptionalHeader64.CheckSum;
	}
	else
	{
		pModule->m_unEntryPoint = pCtx->m_OptionalHeader32.AddressOfEntryPoint;
		pModule->m_unCheckSum = pCtx->m_OptionalHeader32.CheckSum;
	}

	HybridHash_t hash;
	hash.m_eMode = EHashMode::Md5;
	ResetHybridHash( &hash );

	if ( !pCtx->m_bPe64 )
	{
		pCtx->m_bLoadedImagePass = 1;
		if ( HashAllSections( pCtx, &hash ) )
		{
			StoreHashResult( &pModule->m_cubLoadedImage, hash );
			memcpy( pModule->m_rgubLoadedImageMd5, hash.m_rgubDigest, sizeof( hash.m_rgubDigest ) );
		}
		else
		{
			pModule->m_cubLoadedImage |= k_unFailedFlag;
		}
		pCtx->m_bLoadedImagePass = 0;
		ResetHybridHash( &hash );
	}

	if ( HashAllSections( pCtx, &hash ) )
	{
		StoreHashResult( &pModule->m_cubImageHash, hash );
		memcpy( pModule->m_rgubImageMd5, hash.m_rgubDigest, sizeof( hash.m_rgubDigest ) );
	}
	else
	{
		pModule->m_cubImageHash |= k_unFailedFlag;
	}
	ResetHybridHash( &hash );

	u32 cReported = ARRAYSIZE( pModule->m_rgSections );
	if ( pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections <= ARRAYSIZE( pModule->m_rgSections ) )
		cReported = pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;

	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cReported; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection = &pCtx->m_pSections[iSection];
		ResetHybridHash( &hash );
		if ( iSection < pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections && HashSectionWithFixups( pCtx, pSection, &hash ) )
		{
			if ( HasFlag( hash.m_eMode, EHashMode::Md5 ) )
				hash.m_Md5.Final( hash.m_rgubDigest );
			StoreHashResult( &pModule->m_rgcubSections[iSection], hash );
			memcpy( pModule->m_rgubSectionMd5[iSection], hash.m_rgubDigest, sizeof( hash.m_rgubDigest ) );
		}
		else
		{
			pModule->m_rgcubSections[iSection] |= k_unFailedFlag;
		}

		SectionRecord_t &record = pModule->m_rgSections[iSection];
		memcpy( record.m_rgchName, pSection->Name, sizeof( record.m_rgchName ) );
		record.m_unCharacteristics = pSection->Characteristics;
		record.m_cubRaw = pSection->SizeOfRawData;
		record.m_unReserved = 0;
		record.m_unVirtualAddress = pSection->VirtualAddress;
	}

	u32 cubIcon = 0;
	if ( HashBestIconResource( pCtx, pModule->m_rgubIconMd5, &cubIcon ) )
		pModule->m_cubIcon ^= ( cubIcon ^ pModule->m_cubIcon ) & k_unByteCountMask;
	else
		pModule->m_cubIcon |= k_unFailedFlag;

	pModule->m_cReportedHashes = static_cast<u8>( cReported + 4 );

	if ( ExtractPdbInfo( pCtx ) == EScanStatus::Ok )
		util::CopyA( pModule->m_szPdbPath, pCtx->m_szPdbPath, sizeof( pModule->m_szPdbPath ) );

	ResetHybridHash( &hash );
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 53
void DumpPeHeaders( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, PeHeadersReport_t *pPeHeaders ) noexcept
{
	memset( pPeHeaders, 0, sizeof( *pPeHeaders ) );
	memcpy( &pPeHeaders->m_FileHeader, &pCtx->m_RawFileHeader, sizeof( pPeHeaders->m_FileHeader ) );
	memcpy( pPeHeaders->m_rgubOptionalHeader,
	        pCtx->m_bPe64 ? static_cast<const void *>( &pCtx->m_OptionalHeader64 ) : &pCtx->m_OptionalHeader32,
	        sizeof( pPeHeaders->m_rgubOptionalHeader ) );
	memcpy( pPeHeaders->m_rgubDosStub, pCtx->m_rgubDosStub, sizeof( pPeHeaders->m_rgubDosStub ) );

	// @note / sapdragon: the overlay can open with a WIN_CERTIFICATE. a sane one means an embedded signature, so the
	// catalog lookup is skipped
	bool bLookUpCatalog = true;
	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pExtra = FindExtraSection( pCtx );
	if ( pExtra &&
	     ReaderSeek( pCtx, pCtx->m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ? pExtra->PointerToRawData : pExtra->VirtualAddress,
	                 false ) )
	{
		const u8 *pubWindow = ReaderWindow( pCtx, sizeof( pPeHeaders->m_rgubOverlayHead ) );
		if ( pubWindow )
		{
			memcpy( pPeHeaders->m_rgubOverlayHead, pubWindow, sizeof( pPeHeaders->m_rgubOverlayHead ) );

			const auto *pCertificate = reinterpret_cast<const WIN_CERTIFICATE *>( pPeHeaders->m_rgubOverlayHead );
			if ( pCertificate->dwLength >= offsetof( WIN_CERTIFICATE, bCertificate ) &&
			     ( pCertificate->wRevision == WIN_CERT_REVISION_1_0 ||
			       pCertificate->wRevision == WIN_CERT_REVISION_2_0 ) )
			{
				if ( pCertificate->wCertificateType )
					bLookUpCatalog = pCertificate->wCertificateType > WIN_CERT_TYPE_TS_STACK_SIGNED;
			}
		}
	}

	pPeHeaders->m_bVerified = VerifySignatureAndCatalog( pCtx, bLookUpCatalog );
	pPeHeaders->m_bCatalogValid = pCtx->m_bCatalogValid;
	pPeHeaders->m_unWinTrustStatus = pCtx->m_unWinTrustStatus;
	pPeHeaders->m_unWinTrustLastError = pCtx->m_unWinTrustLastError;

	if ( pCtx->m_bCatalogValid )
	{
		u32 cubPath = util::StrLenA( pCtx->m_szCatalogPath ) + 1;
		if ( cubPath > sizeof( pPeHeaders->m_szCatalogPath ) )
			cubPath = sizeof( pPeHeaders->m_szCatalogPath );
		memcpy( pPeHeaders->m_szCatalogPath, pCtx->m_szCatalogPath, cubPath );
		pPeHeaders->m_szCatalogPath[sizeof( pPeHeaders->m_szCatalogPath ) - 1] = 0;
	}
	else
	{
		memcpy( &pPeHeaders->m_Issuer, &pCtx->m_Issuer, sizeof( pPeHeaders->m_Issuer ) );
		memcpy( &pPeHeaders->m_Signer, &pCtx->m_Signer, sizeof( pPeHeaders->m_Signer ) );
	}
}

const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *FindExtraSection( const ScannerContext_t *pCtx ) noexcept
{
	const u32 cSections = pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection = &pCtx->m_pSections[iSection];
		if ( !CompareNameBounded( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( pSection->Name ), k_szExtraSection,
		                          sizeof( pSection->Name ) ) )
			return pSection;
	}
	return nullptr;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? BA
EScanStatus ParsePeHeader( ScannerContext_t *pCtx ) noexcept
{
	SetReaderClamp( pCtx, 0, 0x1000 );

	if ( !ReaderReadBytes( pCtx, &pCtx->m_DosHeader, sizeof( pCtx->m_DosHeader ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	if ( pCtx->m_DosHeader.e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;

	if ( !ReaderReadBytes( pCtx, pCtx->m_rgubDosStub, sizeof( pCtx->m_rgubDosStub ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;

	if ( !ReaderSeek( pCtx, static_cast<u32>( pCtx->m_DosHeader.e_lfanew ), false ) )
		return EScanStatus::SeekFailed;

	u32 unSignature;
	if ( !ReaderReadBytes( pCtx, &unSignature, sizeof( unSignature ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	if ( unSignature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;

	if ( !ReaderReadBytes( pCtx, &pCtx->m_RawFileHeader, sizeof( pCtx->m_RawFileHeader ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	memcpy( &pCtx->m_FileHeader, &pCtx->m_RawFileHeader, sizeof( pCtx->m_FileHeader ) );

	const WORD unMachine = pCtx->m_FileHeader.Machine;
	if ( ( unMachine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386 && unMachine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64 ) ||
	     pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections > pe::k_cMaxSections )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;

	const WORD cubOptionalHeader = pCtx->m_FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader;
	if ( cubOptionalHeader == sizeof( IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 ) )
	{
		if ( !ReaderReadBytes( pCtx, &pCtx->m_OptionalHeader64, sizeof( pCtx->m_OptionalHeader64 ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
		if ( pCtx->m_OptionalHeader64.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC )
			return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
		pCtx->m_bPe64 = 1;
	}
	else if ( cubOptionalHeader == sizeof( IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32 ) )
	{
		if ( !ReaderReadBytes( pCtx, &pCtx->m_OptionalHeader32, sizeof( pCtx->m_OptionalHeader32 ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
		if ( pCtx->m_OptionalHeader32.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC )
			return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
	}
	else
	{
		return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
	}

	const u32 cSections = pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
	pCtx->m_pSections = static_cast<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *>( AllocBytes( sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) * cSections ) );
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		if ( !ReaderReadBytes( pCtx, &pCtx->m_pSections[iSection], sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	}

	pCtx->m_ulRelocationBase = pCtx->m_bPe64 ? pCtx->m_OptionalHeader64.ImageBase : pCtx->m_OptionalHeader32.ImageBase;
	SetReaderClamp( pCtx, 0, 0 );
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 53 56 57 8B D9 E8
EScanStatus SetMemoryMapping( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, u64 ulBase, u32 cubMapped, HANDLE hProcess ) noexcept
{
	CleanupScannerContext( pCtx );
	pCtx->m_ulRelocationBase = ulBase;
	pCtx->m_cubMapped = cubMapped;
	CloseReader( pCtx );
	pCtx->m_ulMappedBase = ulBase;
	pCtx->m_hProcess = hProcess;
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 51 56 57
EScanStatus OpenFileById( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, u32 unVolumeSerial, u64 ulFileId, u32 *punLastError ) noexcept
{
	CleanupScannerContext( pCtx );

	HANDLE hFile = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
	const EScanStatus eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>(
	    file::OpenByVolumeAndId( g_pImports, unVolumeSerial, ulFileId, FILE_GENERIC_READ, &hFile, punLastError ) );
	if ( eStatus != EScanStatus::Ok )
		return eStatus;

	if ( AttachFileHandle( pCtx, hFile ) )
		return EScanStatus::Ok;

	*punLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
	return EScanStatus::OpenFailed;
}

// @note / sapdragon: adds a fake .extra section for whatever follows the last one. m_RawFileHeader keeps the real count
// @orig: 51 53 55 56 8B F1
EScanStatus DeepPeScan( ScannerContext_t *pCtx ) noexcept
{
	if ( pCtx->m_hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return EScanStatus::NoFile;

	const EScanStatus eStatus = ParsePeHeader( pCtx );
	if ( eStatus != EScanStatus::Ok )
	{
		CleanupScannerContext( pCtx );
		return eStatus;
	}

	u32 ibSectionsEnd = 0;
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const u32 ibEnd = pCtx->m_pSections[iSection].PointerToRawData + pCtx->m_pSections[iSection].SizeOfRawData;
		if ( ibEnd > ibSectionsEnd )
			ibSectionsEnd = ibEnd;
	}

	const u32 cubFile = file::GetFileSizeOrZero( g_pImports, pCtx->m_hFile );
	const u32 cubAlignment =
	    pCtx->m_bPe64 ? pCtx->m_OptionalHeader64.SectionAlignment : pCtx->m_OptionalHeader32.SectionAlignment;
	if ( ibSectionsEnd < cubFile )
	{
		const u32 cubOverlay = cubFile - ibSectionsEnd;
		++pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
		pCtx->m_pSections = static_cast<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *>(
		    ReallocBytes( pCtx->m_pSections, sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) * pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections ) );

		IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pExtra = &pCtx->m_pSections[pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections - 1];
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pLast = pExtra - 1;
		u32 cubLast = pLast->Misc.VirtualSize;
		if ( cubLast < pLast->SizeOfRawData )
			cubLast =
			    cubAlignment + pLast->SizeOfRawData - 1 - ( cubAlignment + pLast->SizeOfRawData - 1 ) % cubAlignment;
		const u32 unVirtualEnd = cubAlignment + cubLast + pLast->VirtualAddress - 1;

		memset( pExtra, 0, sizeof( *pExtra ) );
		pExtra->PointerToRawData = ibSectionsEnd;
		pExtra->Characteristics = IMAGE_SCN_MEM_DISCARDABLE;
		pExtra->SizeOfRawData = cubOverlay;
		pExtra->VirtualAddress = unVirtualEnd - unVirtualEnd % cubAlignment;
		pExtra->Misc.VirtualSize = cubAlignment + cubOverlay - 1 - ( cubAlignment + cubOverlay - 1 ) % cubAlignment;
		memcpy( pExtra->Name, k_szExtraSection, sizeof( k_szExtraSection ) );
	}
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 53 56 57 8B F1
void CleanupScannerContext( ScannerContext_t *pCtx ) noexcept
{
	CloseReader( pCtx );

	if ( pCtx->m_pSections )
		FreeBytes( pCtx->m_pSections );

	if ( pCtx->m_cResourceEntries > 0 )
	{
		if ( pCtx->m_ppResourceData )
		{
			for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < pCtx->m_cResourceEntries; ++iEntry )
			{
				if ( pCtx->m_ppResourceData[iEntry] )
					FreeBytes( pCtx->m_ppResourceData[iEntry] );
			}
			FreeBytes( pCtx->m_ppResourceData );
		}
		if ( pCtx->m_pResourceTable )
			FreeBytes( pCtx->m_pResourceTable );
	}

	for ( i32 iBuffer = 0; iBuffer < pCtx->m_cSectionBuffers; ++iBuffer )
		FreeBytes( pCtx->m_rgpSectionBuffers[iBuffer] );

	if ( pCtx->m_pubRelocations )
		FreeBytes( pCtx->m_pubRelocations );

	if ( pCtx->m_ppSectionData )
	{
		for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
		{
			if ( pCtx->m_ppSectionData[iSection] )
				FreeBytes( pCtx->m_ppSectionData[iSection] );
		}
		FreeBytes( pCtx->m_ppSectionData );
	}

	pCtx->m_ulRelocationBase = 0;
	pCtx->m_cubMapped = 0;
	pCtx->m_pSections = nullptr;
	pCtx->m_ppSectionData = nullptr;
	pCtx->m_cResourceEntries = 0;
	pCtx->m_ppResourceData = nullptr;
	pCtx->m_pResourceTable = nullptr;
	pCtx->m_cSectionBuffers = 0;
	pCtx->m_pubRelocations = nullptr;
	pCtx->m_cubRelocations = 0;
	pCtx->m_bUnused4 = 0;
	pCtx->m_unUnused3 = 0;
	pCtx->m_ulImageDelta = 0;
	pCtx->m_bZeroRelocations = 0;
	pCtx->m_bPe64 = 0;
	memset( pCtx->m_rgpSectionBuffers, 0, sizeof( pCtx->m_rgpSectionBuffers ) );
	pCtx->m_cRelocationsApplied = 0;
}

// @orig: 51 53 8B D9 89 5C 24
void GroupIconVisitData( ResourceFilter_t *pFilter, const IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY *, const u8 *pubData,
                         u32 cubData ) noexcept
{
	if ( pFilter->m_eState == EFilterState::Done || !pubData || cubData < sizeof( GroupIconHeader_t ) )
		return;

	const u32 cEntries = reinterpret_cast<const GroupIconHeader_t *>( pubData )->m_cEntries;
	if ( static_cast<u16>( cubData ) < sizeof( GroupIconEntry_t ) * cEntries + sizeof( GroupIconHeader_t ) ||
	     !cEntries )
		return;

	u32 unLargestArea = 0;
	const u8 *pubBest = nullptr;
	const u8 *pubEntry = pubData + sizeof( GroupIconHeader_t );
	for ( u32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < cEntries; ++iEntry, pubEntry += sizeof( GroupIconEntry_t ) )
	{
		const u32 unArea = pubEntry[0] * pubEntry[1];
		if ( unArea > unLargestArea )
		{
			unLargestArea = unArea;
			pubBest = pubEntry;
		}
	}
	if ( !pubBest )
		return;

	pFilter->m_unIconId = reinterpret_cast<const GroupIconEntry_t *>( pubBest )->m_unId;
	pFilter->m_eState = EFilterState::Done;
	memcpy( pFilter->m_IconDirectory.m_rgubHeader, pubData, sizeof( pFilter->m_IconDirectory.m_rgubHeader ) );
	pFilter->m_IconDirectory.m_cImages = 1;
	memcpy( pFilter->m_IconDirectory.m_rgubEntry, pubBest, sizeof( pFilter->m_IconDirectory.m_rgubEntry ) );
	pFilter->m_IconDirectory.m_ibImage = sizeof( IconDirectory_t );
}

// @orig: 56 57 8B F9 8D 77

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 8B 5C 24 ? 55 56 57 8B 7C 24
bool ReadResourceDataEntry( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, u32 ibEntry, u8 **ppubData, u32 *pcubData ) noexcept
{
	*pcubData = 0;
	*ppubData = nullptr;
	if ( !ReaderSeek( pCtx, ibEntry, false ) )
		return false;

	const u8 *pubWindow = ReaderWindow( pCtx, sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DATA_ENTRY ) );
	if ( !pubWindow )
		return false;

	IMAGE_RESOURCE_DATA_ENTRY entry;
	memcpy( &entry, pubWindow, sizeof( entry ) );
	if ( !entry.Size )
		return false;

	const u32 ibData =
	    pe::RvaToFileOffset( pCtx->m_pSections, pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections, entry.OffsetToData );
	if ( ibData == pe::k_unInvalidOffset || !ReaderSeek( pCtx, ibData, false ) )
		return false;

	*pcubData = entry.Size;
	*ppubData = static_cast<u8 *>( AllocBytes( entry.Size ) );
	if ( !ReaderReadBytes( pCtx, *ppubData, entry.Size ) )
	{
		FreeBytes( *ppubData );
		*ppubData = nullptr;
		*pcubData = 0;
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 51 51 53 55 56 57 6A
bool WalkResourceDirectory( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, ResourceFilter_t *pFilter, u32 ibRoot, u32 ibDirectory ) noexcept
{
	if ( !ReaderSeek( pCtx, ibDirectory, false ) )
		return false;

	const auto *pWindow =
	    reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY *>( ReaderWindow( pCtx, sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY ) ) );
	if ( !pWindow )
		return false;

	const u32 cubEntries =
	    ( pWindow->NumberOfIdEntries + pWindow->NumberOfNamedEntries ) * sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY );
	if ( !ReaderSeek( pCtx, ibDirectory, false ) )
		return false;

	const u8 *pubWindow = ReaderWindow( pCtx, cubEntries + sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY ) );
	if ( !pubWindow )
		return false;

	auto *pDirectory = static_cast<IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY *>( AllocBytes( sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY ) ) );
	memcpy( pDirectory, pubWindow, sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY ) );

	auto *pEntries = static_cast<IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY *>( AllocBytes( cubEntries ) );
	memcpy( pEntries, pubWindow + sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY ), cubEntries );

	for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < pDirectory->NumberOfNamedEntries + pDirectory->NumberOfIdEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		const IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY *pEntry = &pEntries[iEntry];
		if ( static_cast<i32>( pEntry->OffsetToData ) < 0 )
		{
			if ( pFilter->m_pTable->m_pfnEnterDirectory( pFilter, pEntry ) )
			{
				WalkResourceDirectory( pCtx, pFilter, ibRoot, ibRoot + ( pEntry->OffsetToData & 0x7FFFFFFF ) );
				pFilter->m_pTable->m_pfnLeaveDirectory( pFilter );
			}
		}
		else
		{
			u8 *pubData = nullptr;
			u32 cubData = 0;
			if ( ReadResourceDataEntry( pCtx, ibRoot + pEntry->OffsetToData, &pubData, &cubData ) )
			{
				pFilter->m_pTable->m_pfnVisitData( pFilter, pEntry, pubData, cubData );
				FreeBytes( pubData );
			}
		}
	}

	FreeBytes( pDirectory );
	FreeBytes( pEntries );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 51 56 8B F1 B8
bool WalkResourceDirectoryRoot( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, ResourceFilter_t *pFilter ) noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory =
	    pCtx->m_bPe64 ? pCtx->m_OptionalHeader64.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_RESOURCE]
	                  : pCtx->m_OptionalHeader32.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_RESOURCE];
	if ( !directory.Size )
		return false;

	const u32 ibRoot =
	    pe::RvaToFileOffset( pCtx->m_pSections, pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections, directory.VirtualAddress );
	if ( ibRoot == pe::k_unInvalidOffset )
		return false;
	return WalkResourceDirectory( pCtx, pFilter, ibRoot, ibRoot );
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 6A
bool HashBestIconResource( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, u8 *pubDigest, u32 *pcubIcon ) noexcept
{
	bool bResult = false;
	memset( pubDigest, 0, 16 );
	if ( pCtx->m_hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return false;

	ResourceFilter_t groupFilter;
	groupFilter.m_pTable = &k_GroupIconFilterTable;
	groupFilter.m_eState = EFilterState::Root;
	groupFilter.m_unIconId = 0;
	if ( !WalkResourceDirectoryRoot( pCtx, &groupFilter ) || groupFilter.m_eState != EFilterState::Done )
		return false;

	IconHashFilter_t iconFilter;
	iconFilter.m_Filter.m_pTable = &k_IconFilterTable;
	iconFilter.m_Filter.m_eState = EFilterState::Root;
	iconFilter.m_Filter.m_unIconId = groupFilter.m_unIconId;
	iconFilter.m_Filter.m_IconDirectory = groupFilter.m_IconDirectory;
	ConstructHybridHash( &iconFilter.m_Hash );

	if ( WalkResourceDirectoryRoot( pCtx, &iconFilter.m_Filter ) &&
	     iconFilter.m_Filter.m_eState == EFilterState::Done &&
	     GetHybridHashResult( &iconFilter.m_Hash, pubDigest ) == 16 )
	{
		bResult = true;
		*pcubIcon = iconFilter.m_Hash.m_cubTotal;
	}

	ResetHybridHash( &iconFilter.m_Hash );
	return bResult;
}

bool LoadBaseRelocTable( ScannerContext_t *pCtx ) noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory = GetDirectory( pCtx, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC );
	pCtx->m_cubRelocations = directory.Size;
	if ( !pCtx->m_cubRelocations )
		return true;

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection =
	    pe::FindSectionByRva( pCtx->m_pSections, pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections, directory.VirtualAddress );

	if ( !ReaderSeek( pCtx, directory.VirtualAddress - ibFileDelta, false ) )
		return false;

// @orig: 8B 81 ? ? ? ? 0B 81 ? ? ? ? 74 ? B0
bool HasRelocationDelta( const ScannerContext_t *pCtx ) noexcept
{
	if ( pCtx->m_ulImageDelta )
		return true;
	if ( pCtx->m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return false;
	return pCtx->m_ulMappedBase != GetImageBase( pCtx );
}

// @note / sapdragon: only moves on to the next block, so a block crossing the chunk end gets continued by the next call
// @orig: 83 EC ? 8B 44 24
bool NormalizeRelocationsInChunk( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, u8 *pubChunk, u32 unChunkRva, u32 cubChunk,
                                  u32 *pibCursor ) noexcept
{
	const u32 unChunkEnd = unChunkRva + cubChunk;
	u32 ibCursor = *pibCursor;
	while ( ibCursor < pCtx->m_cubRelocations )
	{
		const auto *pBlock = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION *>( pCtx->m_pubRelocations + ibCursor );
		const u32 unPageRva = pBlock->VirtualAddress;
		if ( !unPageRva || !pBlock->SizeOfBlock || unPageRva >= unChunkEnd )
			break;

		const u32 cEntries = ( pBlock->SizeOfBlock - sizeof( IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION ) ) >> 1;
		if ( !cEntries )
			break;

		if ( unPageRva + 0x1000 > unChunkRva )
		{
			const auto *punEntries = reinterpret_cast<const u16 *>( pBlock + 1 );
			for ( u32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < cEntries; ++iEntry )
			{
				const u16 unEntry = punEntries[iEntry];
				const u32 unRva = unPageRva + ( unEntry & 0xFFF );
				if ( unRva < unChunkRva )
					continue;
				if ( unRva >= unChunkEnd )
					return true;

				const u32 unType = unEntry >> 12;
				if ( unType == IMAGE_REL_BASED_ABSOLUTE )
					continue;

				u8 *pubTarget = pubChunk + ( unRva - unChunkRva );
				if ( unType == IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGHLOW )
				{
					const u32 unValue =
					    *reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubTarget ) - static_cast<u32>( pCtx->m_ulImageDelta );
					++pCtx->m_cRelocationsApplied;
					*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubTarget ) = pCtx->m_bZeroRelocations ? 0 : unValue;
				}
				else if ( unType == IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64 )
				{
					u64 ulValue = 0;
					if ( !pCtx->m_bZeroRelocations )
						ulValue =
						    *reinterpret_cast<u64 *>( pubTarget ) + pCtx->m_ulImageDelta - pCtx->m_ulRelocationBase;
					++pCtx->m_cRelocationsApplied;
					*reinterpret_cast<u64 *>( pubTarget ) = ulValue;
				}
				else
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		ibCursor = pBlock->SizeOfBlock + *pibCursor;
		*pibCursor = ibCursor;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 80 B9 ? ? ? ? ? BA
void HashExcludingIat( const ScannerContext_t *pCtx, const u8 *pubChunk, u32 unChunkRva, u32 cubChunk,
                       HybridHash_t *pHash ) noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory = GetDirectory( pCtx, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IAT );
	const u32 unChunkEnd = unChunkRva + cubChunk;

	u32 unCutStart = unChunkRva;
	if ( directory.VirtualAddress > unChunkRva )
		unCutStart = directory.VirtualAddress;

	u32 unCutEnd = unChunkEnd;
	if ( directory.VirtualAddress + directory.Size < unChunkEnd )
		unCutEnd = directory.VirtualAddress + directory.Size;

	if ( unCutStart < unCutEnd )
	{
		if ( unCutStart > unChunkRva )
			UpdateHybridHash( pHash, pubChunk, unCutStart - unChunkRva );
		if ( unCutEnd < unChunkEnd )
			UpdateHybridHash( pHash, pubChunk + ( unCutEnd - unChunkRva ), unChunkEnd - unCutEnd );
	}
	else
	{
		UpdateHybridHash( pHash, pubChunk, cubChunk );
	}
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 8B 45
void HashExcludingIatAndExports( const ScannerContext_t *pCtx, const u8 *pubChunk, u32 unChunkRva, u32 cubChunk,
                                 HybridHash_t *pHash ) noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &iat = GetDirectory( pCtx, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IAT );
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &exports = GetDirectory( pCtx, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT );

	pe::RangePair_t outer;
	pe::SplitAroundDirectory( iat.VirtualAddress, iat.Size, unChunkRva, unChunkRva + cubChunk, outer );

	pe::RangePair_t rgInner[2];
	pe::SplitAroundDirectory( exports.VirtualAddress, exports.Size, outer.m_rgunStart[0], outer.m_rgunEnd[0],
	                          rgInner[0] );
	pe::SplitAroundDirectory( exports.VirtualAddress, exports.Size, outer.m_rgunStart[1], outer.m_rgunEnd[1],
	                          rgInner[1] );

	for ( const pe::RangePair_t &inner : rgInner )
	{
		for ( u32 iRange = 0; iRange < 2; ++iRange )
		{
			const u32 unStart = inner.m_rgunStart[iRange];
			const u32 unEnd = inner.m_rgunEnd[iRange];
			if ( unEnd > unStart )
				UpdateHybridHash( pHash, pubChunk + ( unStart - unChunkRva ), unEnd - unStart );
		}
	}
}

// @orig: 51 53 8B 5C 24
bool PrepareSectionReaderForHash( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection,
                                  const HybridHash_t *pHash ) noexcept
{
	const u32 unRva = pSection->VirtualAddress;
	const u32 cubRaw = pSection->SizeOfRawData;

	if ( !HasRelocationDelta( pCtx ) && pHash &&
	     ( pHash->m_eMode == EHashMode::Md5Rebased || pHash->m_eMode == EHashMode::Md5RebasedAlt ) )
		pCtx->m_ulImageDelta = GetImageBase( pCtx );

	if ( HasRelocationDelta( pCtx ) )
	{
		if ( !pCtx->m_pubRelocations && !LoadBaseRelocTable( pCtx ) )
			return false;
		if ( !pCtx->m_ulImageDelta )
			pCtx->m_ulImageDelta = pCtx->m_ulMappedBase - GetImageBase( pCtx );
	}

	u32 ibOffset = unRva;
	if ( pCtx->m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		ibOffset = pSection->PointerToRawData;
	if ( !ReaderSeek( pCtx, ibOffset, false ) )
		return false;

	pCtx->m_ibRelocationCursor = 0;
	pCtx->m_unSectionRva = unRva;
	pCtx->m_cubSection = cubRaw;
	return true;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 C7 46
void ConstructHybridHash( HybridHash_t *pHash ) noexcept
{
	pHash->m_eMode = EHashMode::Md5;
	ResetHybridHash( pHash );
}

// @orig: E8 ? ? ? ? 33 C0 6A
void ResetHybridHash( HybridHash_t *pHash ) noexcept
{
	pHash->m_Md5.Init();
	pHash->m_unLfsr = 0;
	pHash->m_cubTotal = 0;
	memset( pHash->m_rgubDigest, 0, sizeof( pHash->m_rgubDigest ) );
}

// @orig: 51 56 8B F1 57 8B 7C 24
void UpdateHybridHash( HybridHash_t *pHash, const void *pvData, u32 cubData ) noexcept
{
	pHash->m_cubTotal += cubData;
	if ( HasFlag( pHash->m_eMode, EHashMode::Md5 ) )
		pHash->m_Md5.Update( static_cast<const u8 *>( pvData ), cubData );
	else if ( pHash->m_eMode == EHashMode::Lfsr )
		pHash->m_unLfsr =
		    crypto::hash::Hash488781ED_t::Of( static_cast<const u8 *>( pvData ), cubData, pHash->m_unLfsr );
}

// @orig: F6 41 ? ? 74
u32 GetHybridHashResult( const HybridHash_t *pHash, void *pvDst ) noexcept
{
	if ( HasFlag( pHash->m_eMode, EHashMode::Md5 ) )
	{
		memcpy( pvDst, pHash->m_rgubDigest, sizeof( pHash->m_rgubDigest ) );
		return sizeof( pHash->m_rgubDigest );
	}
	if ( pHash->m_eMode == EHashMode::Lfsr )
	{
		memcpy( pvDst, &pHash->m_unLfsr, sizeof( pHash->m_unLfsr ) );
		return sizeof( pHash->m_unLfsr );
	}
	return 0;
}

// @note / sapdragon: a failed normalize returns without freeing the chunk, the original leaks it too
// @orig: 51 53 55 56 57 FF 74 24
bool HashSectionWithFixups( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection, HybridHash_t *pHash ) noexcept
{
	if ( !PrepareSectionReaderForHash( pCtx, pSection, pHash ) )
		return false;

	u32 cubChunk = 0;
	u8 *pubChunk = nullptr;
	const u32 iSection = static_cast<u32>( pSection - pCtx->m_pSections );
	if ( iSection < pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = pCtx->m_pSections[iSection];
		u32 ibOffset = section.VirtualAddress;
		const u32 cubRaw = section.SizeOfRawData;
		if ( pCtx->m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
			ibOffset = section.PointerToRawData;
		pubChunk = static_cast<u8 *>( AllocBytes( section.SizeOfRawData ) );
		cubChunk = ReaderReadAt( pCtx, ibOffset, pubChunk, cubRaw );
	}

	if ( HasRelocationDelta( pCtx ) &&
	     !NormalizeRelocationsInChunk( pCtx, pubChunk, pCtx->m_unSectionRva, cubChunk, &pCtx->m_ibRelocationCursor ) )
		return false;

	if ( pCtx->m_bLoadedImagePass )
		HashExcludingIat( pCtx, pubChunk, pCtx->m_unSectionRva, cubChunk, pHash );
	else
		HashExcludingIatAndExports( pCtx, pubChunk, pCtx->m_unSectionRva, cubChunk, pHash );

	if ( pubChunk )
		FreeBytes( pubChunk );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 8B BC 24
bool HashAllSections( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, HybridHash_t *pHash ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pHash )
		return false;

	if ( !pCtx->m_bLoadedImagePass )
	{
		const u64 ulBase = pCtx->m_hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ? pCtx->m_ulMappedBase : GetImageBase( pCtx );
		if ( pCtx->m_bPe64 )
		{
			pCtx->m_ulRelocationBase = ulBase;
			pCtx->m_ulImageDelta = k_ulNormalizedImageBase;
		}
		else
		{
			pCtx->m_ulImageDelta = ulBase - k_ulNormalizedImageBase;
		}
	}

	UpdateHybridHash( pHash, &pCtx->m_DosHeader, sizeof( pCtx->m_DosHeader ) );
	UpdateHybridHash( pHash, pCtx->m_bLoadedImagePass ? &pCtx->m_FileHeader : &pCtx->m_RawFileHeader,
	                  sizeof( IMAGE_FILE_HEADER ) );

	IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 optionalHeader64;
	IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32 optionalHeader32;
	memcpy( &optionalHeader64, &pCtx->m_OptionalHeader64, sizeof( optionalHeader64 ) );
	memcpy( &optionalHeader32, &pCtx->m_OptionalHeader32, sizeof( optionalHeader32 ) );
	if ( !pCtx->m_bLoadedImagePass )
	{
		optionalHeader64.ImageBase = 0;
		optionalHeader32.ImageBase = 0;
	}

	if ( pCtx->m_bPe64 )
		UpdateHybridHash( pHash, &optionalHeader64, sizeof( optionalHeader64 ) );
	else
		UpdateHybridHash( pHash, &optionalHeader32, sizeof( optionalHeader32 ) );

	const u32 cSections = pCtx->m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
	if ( !cSections )
		return false;

	bool bFoundText = false;
	u32 cubLargest = 0;
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection = &pCtx->m_pSections[iSection];

		// @note / sapdragon: the normal pass leaves the synthetic .extra out by using the raw count
		if ( iSection < pCtx->m_RawFileHeader.NumberOfSections || pCtx->m_bLoadedImagePass )
		{
			UpdateHybridHash( pHash, pSection->Name, sizeof( pSection->Name ) );
			UpdateHybridHash( pHash, &pSection->VirtualAddress, sizeof( pSection->VirtualAddress ) );
			UpdateHybridHash( pHash, &pSection->SizeOfRawData, sizeof( pSection->SizeOfRawData ) );
		}

		const bool bExecutable = ( pSection->Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE ) != 0;
		if ( !CompareNameBounded( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( pSection->Name ), ".text", 5 ) && bExecutable )
		{
			bFoundText = true;
			pSelected = pSection;
		}
		else if ( !bFoundText && bExecutable && pSection->SizeOfRawData > cubLargest )
		{
			cubLargest = pSection->SizeOfRawData;
			pSelected = pSection;
		}
	}

	if ( !pSelected || !HashSectionWithFixups( pCtx, pSelected, pHash ) )
		return false;

	if ( HasFlag( pHash->m_eMode, EHashMode::Md5 ) )
		pHash->m_Md5.Final( pHash->m_rgubDigest );
	return true;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::image_scan

`modules/image_scan/internal/pe/stream_scan.cpp`:

// @binary: 33211402
#include "../scanner.hpp"
#include "stream_scan_tables.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

constexpr u32 k_cubStreamChunk = 0x40000;
constexpr u32 k_iFirstLongHash = 4;
constexpr u32 k_cRotatingHashes = 3;
constexpr u32 k_cubPage = 0x1000;

enum class EByteClass : u32
{
	None = 0,
	Zero = 1,
	SmallConstant = 2,
	NearOffset = 3,
	FunctionStart = 4,
	Lookup = 5,
	Text = 8,
	Separator = 9,
};

enum class EFunctionProlog : u32
{
	PushEbpMovEbpEsp = 0xEC8B55,
	PushEdiMovEdiEcx = 0xF98B57,
};

// @note / sapdragon: the original keeps these on the stack and never reads them back
struct StreamStats_t
{
	u32 m_cZeros;
	u32 m_cPadding;
	u32 m_cMatchTries;
	u32 m_cProlog;
	u32 m_cSmallConstant;
	u32 m_cNearOffset;
	u32 m_rgunUnused[2];
	u32 m_cubCode;
	u32 m_cubData;
};

#pragma pack( push, 1 )

{
	u64 m_ulBase;
	u32 m_ibMatch;
	u32 m_unHash;
	u32 m_unUnused;
	u16 m_unTag;
	u8 m_cchMatch;
	u8 m_cSeen;
};
struct StreamPatternScanner_t
{
	u32 m_unReserved0;
	u64 m_ulBase;
	u8 m_rgubUnused0[12];
	u16 m_unTag;
	u8 m_rgubUnused1[2];

VAC_LAYOUT( StreamPatternScanner_t, m_pPatterns, 0x28 );
VAC_LAYOUT( StreamPatternScanner_t, m_pszText, 0x38 );
VAC_LAYOUT( StreamPatternScanner_t, m_cubTextLeft, 0x40 );

// @orig: 8B 51 ? 56 85 D2
int LookupStreamPatternHash( const StreamPatternScanner_t *pScanner, u32 unHash ) noexcept
{
	if ( pScanner->m_cCustomHashes && pScanner->m_punCustomHashes )
	{
		for ( u32 iHash = 0; iHash < pScanner->m_cCustomHashes; ++iHash )
		{
			if ( pScanner->m_punCustomHashes[iHash] == unHash )
				return static_cast<int>( iHash );
		}
		return -1;
	}

	for ( u32 iHash = unHash % ARRAYSIZE( k_rgunPatternHashes );;
	      iHash = ( iHash + 1 ) % ARRAYSIZE( k_rgunPatternHashes ) )
	{
		const u32 unCandidate = k_rgunPatternHashes[iHash];
		if ( !unCandidate )
			return -1;
		if ( unCandidate == unHash )
			return k_rgunPatternIds[iHash];
	}
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 57 6A
int CopyPrintableRuns( const u8 *pubSource, u32 cubSource, char *pszDst, u32 *pcubTailDropped ) noexcept
{
	u8 rgubCompact[64];
	const i32 cubLimit = cubSource <= sizeof( rgubCompact ) ? static_cast<i32>( cubSource ) : sizeof( rgubCompact );

	i32 cubCompact = 0;
	for ( i32 ib = 0; ib < cubLimit; ++ib )
	{
		if ( pubSource[ib] )
			rgubCompact[cubCompact++] = pubSource[ib];
	}

	int cubCopied = 0;
	i32 iRunStart = -1;
	for ( i32 ib = 0; ib < cubCompact; )
	{
		const u8 unClass = k_rgunSignedByteClass[128 + static_cast<i8>( rgubCompact[ib] )];
		if ( unClass >= static_cast<u8>( EByteClass::Text ) && iRunStart == -1 )
			iRunStart = ib;
		++ib;
		*pcubTailDropped = 0;
		if ( unClass >= static_cast<u8>( EByteClass::Text ) && ib != cubCompact )
			continue;

		if ( iRunStart >= 0 )
		{
			const i32 cubRun = ib - iRunStart;
			if ( cubRun < 4 )
			{
				*pcubTailDropped = static_cast<u32>( cubRun );
			}
			else
			{
				memcpy( pszDst, &rgubCompact[iRunStart], static_cast<u32>( cubRun ) );
				pszDst += cubRun;
				cubCopied += cubRun;
			}
			iRunStart = -1;
		}
	}
	return cubCopied;
}

// @orig: 53 8B D9 55 8B 6B
void AppendNearbyAsciiRuns( StreamPatternScanner_t *pScanner, const u8 *pubChunk, u32 cubChunk, u32 ibMatchEnd,
                            u32 cubMatch, u32 *pibCursor ) noexcept
{
	char *pszText = pScanner->m_pszText;
	if ( !pszText )
		return;

	const i32 cubTextLeft = pScanner->m_cubTextLeft;
	i32 cubWanted = cubTextLeft - 1;
	if ( cubTextLeft >= static_cast<i32>( cubMatch + 33 ) )
		cubWanted = static_cast<i32>( cubMatch + 32 );

	u32 ibStart = 0;
	if ( static_cast<i32>( ibMatchEnd - cubMatch - 16 ) >= 0 )
		ibStart = ibMatchEnd - cubMatch - 16;

	u32 ibFrom = *pibCursor;
	const i32 cubOverlap = static_cast<i32>( *pibCursor - ibStart );
	i32 cubCopy = cubWanted - cubOverlap;
	if ( cubOverlap <= 0 )
	{
		ibFrom = ibStart;
		cubCopy = cubWanted;
	}
	if ( cubCopy <= 0 )
		return;

	u32 cubTailDropped = 0;
	*pibCursor = static_cast<u32>( cubCopy ) + ibFrom;
	u32 cubAvailable = cubChunk - ibFrom;
	if ( static_cast<i32>( static_cast<u32>( cubCopy ) + ibFrom - cubChunk ) <= 0 )
		cubAvailable = static_cast<u32>( cubCopy );

	const int cubCopied = CopyPrintableRuns( &pubChunk[ibFrom], cubAvailable, pszText, &cubTailDropped );
	*pibCursor -= cubTailDropped;
	pszText[cubCopied] = 0;
	pScanner->m_cubTextLeft -= cubCopied;
	pScanner->m_pszText = pszText + cubCopied;
	if ( pScanner->m_cubTextLeft < 20 )
		pScanner->m_pszText = nullptr;
}

// @note / sapdragon: the match list is always null in this build, so this does nothing
// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 4E
void RecordStreamPatternMatch( StreamPatternScanner_t *pScanner, u32 unHash, u32 ibMatch, u8 cchMatch ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pScanner->m_pMatches || !pScanner->m_cMaxMatches )
		return;

	for ( u32 iMatch = 0; iMatch < pScanner->m_cMatches; ++iMatch )
	{
		StreamMatch_t &match = pScanner->m_pMatches[iMatch];
		if ( match.m_unHash != unHash )
			continue;
		if ( match.m_ibMatch == ibMatch && match.m_ulBase == pScanner->m_ulBase )
			return;
		if ( match.m_cSeen != 0xFF )
			++match.m_cSeen;
		if ( match.m_cSeen >= 0x10 )
			return;
		break;
	}

	if ( pScanner->m_cMatches < pScanner->m_cMaxMatches )
	{
		StreamMatch_t &match = pScanner->m_pMatches[pScanner->m_cMatches];
		match.m_ulBase = pScanner->m_ulBase;
		match.m_unUnused = 0;
		match.m_unTag = pScanner->m_unTag;
		match.m_unHash = unHash;
		match.m_ibMatch = ibMatch;
		match.m_cSeen = 1;
		match.m_cchMatch = cchMatch;
		++pScanner->m_cMatches;
	}
}

void SetPatternBit( const StreamPatternScanner_t *pScanner, int nPattern ) noexcept
{
	if ( nPattern < 256 && pScanner->m_pPatterns )
		pScanner->m_pPatterns->m_rgunPatternBits[nPattern >> 5] |= 1u << ( nPattern % 32 );
}

// @note / sapdragon: eight rolling hashes over byte classes. the last four see every second byte too, for utf-16
// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 8B E9
void ScanStreamPatterns( StreamPatternScanner_t *pScanner, const u8 *pubChunk, u32 cubChunk ) noexcept
{
	u32 rgcchMatch[8] = {};
	u32 rgunHash[ARRAYSIZE( rgcchMatch )];
	for ( u32 &unHash : rgunHash )
		unHash = util::hashing::k_unHashSeed;

	u32 unRawHash = util::hashing::k_unHashSeed;
	EByteClass ePreviousClass = EByteClass::None;
	u32 iRotate = 0;
	u32 ibCursor = 0;
	u32 iPage = 0;
	u32 cZerosInPage = 0;
	i32 cCodeHits = 0;

	for ( u32 ib = 0; ib < cubChunk; ++ib )
	{
		unRawHash = pubChunk[ib] + 33 * unRawHash;
		const EByteClass eClass = static_cast<EByteClass>( k_rgunByteClass[pubChunk[ib]] );

		if ( eClass > EByteClass::Separator )
		{
			for ( u32 iHash = 0; iHash < ARRAYSIZE( rgunHash ); ++iHash )
			{
				++rgcchMatch[iHash];
				rgunHash[iHash] = static_cast<u32>( eClass ) + 33 * rgunHash[iHash];
			}
		}
		else
		{
			u32 cchLast = 0;
			for ( u32 iHash = 0; iHash < ARRAYSIZE( rgunHash ); ++iHash )
			{
				u32 cchMatch = rgcchMatch[iHash];
				if ( cchMatch >= 3 && cchMatch != cchLast )
				{
					if ( pScanner->m_pStats )
						++pScanner->m_pStats->m_cMatchTries;

					const u32 cchRun = cchMatch;
					const int nPattern = LookupStreamPatternHash( pScanner, rgunHash[iHash] );
					if ( nPattern >= 0 )
					{
						if ( iHash >= k_iFirstLongHash )
							cchMatch = 2 * cchMatch - 1;
						RecordStreamPatternMatch( pScanner, rgunHash[iHash], ib - cchMatch,
						                          static_cast<u8>( cchMatch ) );
						SetPatternBit( pScanner, nPattern );
						AppendNearbyAsciiRuns( pScanner, pubChunk, cubChunk, ib,
						                       iHash < k_iFirstLongHash ? cchMatch : 2 * cchMatch, &ibCursor );
					}
					cchLast = cchRun;
				}
			}

			if ( eClass == EByteClass::Separator )
			{
				for ( u32 iHash = 0; iHash < ARRAYSIZE( rgunHash ); ++iHash )
				{
					++rgcchMatch[iHash];
					rgunHash[iHash] = static_cast<u32>( EByteClass::Separator ) + 33 * rgunHash[iHash];
				}
				rgcchMatch[iRotate] = 0;
				rgcchMatch[k_iFirstLongHash + iRotate] = 0;
				rgunHash[iRotate] = util::hashing::k_unHashSeed;
				rgunHash[k_iFirstLongHash + iRotate] = util::hashing::k_unHashSeed;
				iRotate = ( iRotate + 1 ) % k_cRotatingHashes;
			}
			else
			{
				for ( u32 iHash = 0; iHash < k_cRotatingHashes; ++iHash )
				{
					rgcchMatch[iHash] = 0;
					rgunHash[iHash] = util::hashing::k_unHashSeed;
				}

				bool bResetLong = true;
				if ( eClass == EByteClass::Zero )
				{
					rgcchMatch[3] = 0;
					rgunHash[3] = util::hashing::k_unHashSeed;
					bResetLong = ePreviousClass == EByteClass::Zero;
				}
				else
				{
					++rgcchMatch[3];
					rgunHash[3] = static_cast<u32>( eClass ) + 33 * rgunHash[3];
				}

				if ( bResetLong )
				{
					for ( u32 iHash = k_iFirstLongHash; iHash < k_iFirstLongHash + k_cRotatingHashes; ++iHash )
					{
						rgcchMatch[iHash] = 0;
						rgunHash[iHash] = util::hashing::k_unHashSeed;
					}
					if ( eClass == EByteClass::Zero && ePreviousClass == EByteClass::Zero )
					{
						rgcchMatch[7] = 0;
						rgunHash[7] = util::hashing::k_unHashSeed;
					}
					else
					{
						++rgcchMatch[7];
						rgunHash[7] = static_cast<u32>( eClass ) + 33 * rgunHash[7];
					}
				}

				StreamStats_t *pStats = pScanner->m_pStats;
				if ( pStats )
				{
					bool bLookUp = false;
					if ( eClass == EByteClass::Zero )
					{
						++pStats->m_cZeros;
						++cZerosInPage;
					}
					else if ( eClass == EByteClass::SmallConstant )
					{
						if ( cubChunk - ib >= 2 && !pubChunk[ib + 2] && pubChunk[ib + 1] <= 0x20 &&
						     !( pubChunk[ib + 1] & 3 ) )
						{
							++pStats->m_cSmallConstant;
							++cCodeHits;
							bLookUp = true;
						}
					}
					else if ( eClass == EByteClass::NearOffset )
					{
						if ( cubChunk - ib >= 4 )
						{
							const i32 nOffset = *reinterpret_cast<const i32 *>( &pubChunk[ib + 1] );
							if ( nOffset < 0x80000 && static_cast<u32>( nOffset ) > 0xFFF80000u )
							{
								++pStats->m_cNearOffset;
								++cCodeHits;
							}
						}
					}
					else if ( eClass == EByteClass::FunctionStart )
					{
						// @note / sapdragon: reads a dword from the aligned offset, up to 3 bytes past a short chunk.
						// these reset the raw hash, so the prologs are part of what the patterns match
						const u32 unWord = *reinterpret_cast<const u32 *>( &pubChunk[ib & ~3u] );
						if ( unWord == 0xCCCCCCCC && ( ib & 3 ) == 3 )
						{
							++pStats->m_cPadding;
							unRawHash = util::hashing::k_unHashSeed;
						}
						const EFunctionProlog eProlog = static_cast<EFunctionProlog>( unWord & 0xFFFFFF );
						if ( eProlog == EFunctionProlog::PushEbpMovEbpEsp ||
						     eProlog == EFunctionProlog::PushEdiMovEdiEcx )
						{
							unRawHash = util::hashing::k_unHashSeed;
							++pStats->m_cProlog;
							++cCodeHits;
						}
					}
					else if ( eClass == EByteClass::Lookup )
					{
						bLookUp = true;
					}

					if ( bLookUp )
					{
						const int nPattern = LookupStreamPatternHash( pScanner, unRawHash );
						if ( nPattern >= 0 )
						{
							// @note / sapdragon: the original indexes its match lengths with the pattern id here, a wild
							// stack read that goes nowhere since the match list is null. dropped along with the read
							RecordStreamPatternMatch( pScanner, unRawHash, ib, 0 );
							SetPatternBit( pScanner, nPattern );
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		ePreviousClass = eClass;
		const u32 iNextPage = ( ib + 1 ) >> 12;
		if ( iNextPage != iPage )
		{
			StreamStats_t *pStats = pScanner->m_pStats;
			if ( pStats )
			{
				if ( cubChunk == k_cubPage )
					pStats->m_cubData += k_cubPage - cZerosInPage;
				else if ( cZerosInPage != k_cubPage )
					pStats->m_cubData += k_cubPage;
				if ( cCodeHits > 50 )
					pStats->m_cubCode += k_cubPage;
			}
			iPage = iNextPage;
			cCodeHits = 0;
			cZerosInPage = 0;
		}
	}
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 89 4C 24
bool HashStreamAndScanPatterns( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, u32 cubStream, ModuleReport_t *pModule,
                                PatternReport_t *pPatterns ) noexcept
{
	crypto::hash::Md5_t md5;

	StreamStats_t stats = {};
	StreamPatternScanner_t scanner{};
	scanner.m_pPatterns = pPatterns;
	scanner.m_pStats = &stats;
	scanner.m_pszText = &pPatterns->m_szText[pPatterns->m_cubText];
	scanner.m_cubTextLeft = static_cast<i32>( sizeof( pPatterns->m_szText ) - pPatterns->m_cubText );

	u8 *pubChunk = static_cast<u8 *>( AllocBytes( k_cubStreamChunk ) );
	if ( !pubChunk )
	{
		pModule->m_cubStream |= k_unFailedFlag;
		return false;
	}

	u32 ibOffset = 0;
	u32 cubTotal = 0;
	while ( cubStream )
	{
		const u32 cubRead =
		    ReaderReadAt( pCtx, ibOffset, pubChunk, cubStream < k_cubStreamChunk ? cubStream : k_cubStreamChunk );
		if ( !cubRead )
			break;

		md5.Update( pubChunk, cubRead );
		ibOffset += cubRead;
		ScanStreamPatterns( &scanner, pubChunk, cubRead );
		cubTotal += cubRead;
		cubStream -= cubRead;
	}
	FreeBytes( pubChunk );

	pPatterns->m_cubText = sizeof( pPatterns->m_szText ) - static_cast<u32>( scanner.m_cubTextLeft );
	pModule->m_cubStream ^= ( cubTotal ^ pModule->m_cubStream ) & k_unByteCountMask;
	if ( cubTotal )
	{
		md5.Final( pModule->m_rgubStreamMd5 );
		if ( !pModule->m_cReportedHashes )
			pModule->m_cReportedHashes = 1;
	}
	return true;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::image_scan

// @binary: 33211402
#include "../scanner.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "process/capture_flags.hpp"
#include "process/process.hpp"

constexpr u32 k_cubPeb64Name = ( MAX_PATH - 1 ) * sizeof( wchar_t );
constexpr u32 k_cMaxModules = 1000;

void CopyNameToProbe64( const ProcessProbe_t *pProbe, const nt::UnicodeString64_t &name, wchar_t *pwszDst,
                        u32 cDstChars, bool *pbOk ) noexcept
{
	u32 cubName = k_cubPeb64Name;
	if ( name.m_cubLength < k_cubPeb64Name )
		cubName = name.m_cubLength;

	wchar_t rgwchName[MAX_PATH];
	memset( rgwchName, 0, sizeof( rgwchName ) );

	u64 cubRead = 0;
	ReadTargetMemory( pProbe->m_hProcess, name.m_ulBuffer, rgwchName, cubName, &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != cubName )
	{
		*pbOk = false;
		return;
	}

	rgwchName[name.m_cubLength > cubName ? 259 : name.m_cubLength >> 1] = 0;
	CopyWideFill( pwszDst, rgwchName, cDstChars );
}

void CopyNameToProbe32( const ProcessProbe_t *pProbe, const nt::UnicodeString32_t &name, wchar_t *pwszDst,
                        u32 cDstChars, bool *pbOk ) noexcept
{
	u32 cubName = name.m_cubLength;
	if ( cubName >= 2046 )
		cubName = 2046;

	wchar_t rgwchName[1024];
	memset( rgwchName, 0, sizeof( rgwchName ) );

	SIZE_T cubRead = 0;
	g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( pProbe->m_hProcess,
	                               reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>( name.m_ulBuffer ) ), rgwchName,
	                               cubName, &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != cubName )
	{
		*pbOk = false;
		return;
	}

	rgwchName[name.m_cubLength > cubName ? 1023 : name.m_cubLength >> 1] = 0;
	CopyWideFill( pwszDst, rgwchName, cDstChars );
}

void AppendModule( ProcessProbe_t *pProbe, const ProbeModule_t &module ) noexcept
{
	pProbe->m_pModules = static_cast<ProbeModule_t *>(
	    ReallocBytes( pProbe->m_pModules, sizeof( ProbeModule_t ) * ( pProbe->m_cModules + 1 ) ) );
	memcpy( &pProbe->m_pModules[pProbe->m_cModules], &module, sizeof( module ) );
	++pProbe->m_cModules;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 8A 84 24 ? ? ? ? 53 55 8B D9
EScanStatus WalkProcess64( ProcessProbe_t *pProbe, u32 unPid, EProbeFlags eFlags ) noexcept
{
	pProbe->m_unPid = unPid;
	pProbe->m_cModules = 0;
	pProbe->m_cThreads = 0;
	pProbe->m_ulCreationTime = 0;

	FILETIME creationTime;
	FILETIME exitTime;
	FILETIME kernelTime;
	FILETIME userTime;
	if ( g_pImports->GetProcessTimes( pProbe->m_hProcess, &creationTime, &exitTime, &kernelTime, &userTime ) )
	{
		pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Times64;
		memcpy( &pProbe->m_ulCreationTime, &creationTime, sizeof( creationTime ) );
	}

	const HANDLE hProcess = pProbe->m_hProcess;
	pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Entered64;

	nt::ProcessBasicInformation64_t basicInfo;
	ULONG cubReturned = 0;
	BOOL bCrossBitness = FALSE;
	if ( IsCrossBitnessProcess( hProcess, &bCrossBitness ) && bCrossBitness )
	{
		if ( g_pImports->NtWow64QueryInformationProcess64 )
			g_pImports->NtWow64QueryInformationProcess64( hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation, &basicInfo,
			                                              sizeof( basicInfo ), &cubReturned );
	}
	else if ( g_pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess )
	{
		ULONG cubNative = 0;
		g_pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess( hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation, &basicInfo, sizeof( basicInfo ),
		                                       &cubNative );
		cubReturned = cubNative;
	}
	if ( cubReturned != sizeof( basicInfo ) )
	{
		GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::BasicInfoFailed;
	}

	pProbe->m_unParentPid = static_cast<u32>( basicInfo.m_ulInheritedFromUniqueProcessId );
	pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::BasicInfo64;
	if ( !basicInfo.m_ulPebBaseAddress )
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;

	pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebAddress64;

	nt::Peb64_t peb;
	u64 cubRead = 0;
	ReadTargetMemory( pProbe->m_hProcess, basicInfo.m_ulPebBaseAddress, &peb, sizeof( nt::Peb64_t ), &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != sizeof( nt::Peb64_t ) )
		return EScanStatus::PebReadFailed;
	pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebRead64;

	if ( HasFlag( eFlags, EProbeFlags::Parameters ) )
	{
		u8 rgubParameters[nt::Arch64_t::k_cubProcessParametersSnapshot];
		ReadTargetMemory( pProbe->m_hProcess, peb.m_ulProcessParameters, rgubParameters, sizeof( rgubParameters ),
		                  &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != sizeof( rgubParameters ) )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;

		const auto &parameters = *reinterpret_cast<const nt::ProcessParameters64_t *>( rgubParameters );
		bool bOk = true;
		CopyNameToProbe64( pProbe, parameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath, pProbe->m_wszCurrentDirectory,
		                   ARRAYSIZE( pProbe->m_wszCurrentDirectory ), &bOk );
		if ( !bOk )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		CopyNameToProbe64( pProbe, parameters.m_ImagePathName, pProbe->m_wszImagePath,
		                   ARRAYSIZE( pProbe->m_wszImagePath ), &bOk );
		if ( !bOk )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		CopyNameToProbe64( pProbe, parameters.m_CommandLine, pProbe->m_wszCommandLine,
		                   ARRAYSIZE( pProbe->m_wszCommandLine ), &bOk );
		if ( !bOk )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}

	if ( HasFlag( eFlags, EProbeFlags::Modules ) )
	{
		nt::PebLdrData64_t ldr;
		ReadTargetMemory( pProbe->m_hProcess, peb.m_ulLdr, &ldr, nt::Arch64_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != nt::Arch64_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot )
		{
			pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrReadFailed;
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		}

		pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrRead64;
		const u64 ulFirstEntry = ldr.m_InLoadOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
		if ( !ulFirstEntry )
		{
			pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrEmpty64;
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		}

		u8 rgubEntry[nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot];
		const auto &entry = *reinterpret_cast<const nt::LdrDataTableEntry64_t *>( rgubEntry );
		ReadTargetMemory( pProbe->m_hProcess, ulFirstEntry, rgubEntry, sizeof( rgubEntry ), &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != sizeof( rgubEntry ) )
		{
			pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntryFailed64;
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		}
		pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntry64;

		u32 iLoadOrder = 1;
		for ( u32 iModule = 0; iModule < k_cMaxModules; ++iModule )
		{
			ProbeModule_t module;
			memset( &module, 0, sizeof( module ) );
			module.m_iLoadOrder = iLoadOrder++;
			const u32 cubName = entry.m_FullDllName.m_cubLength;
			module.m_ulBase = entry.m_ulDllBase;
			module.m_cubImage = entry.m_cubSizeOfImage;
			if ( cubName >= k_cubPeb64Name )
			{
				pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameTooLong;
			}
			else
			{
				wchar_t rgwchName[262];
				cubRead = 0;
				ReadTargetMemory( pProbe->m_hProcess, entry.m_FullDllName.m_ulBuffer, rgwchName, cubName, &cubRead );
				if ( cubRead != cubName )
				{
					pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameReadFailed;
				}
				else
				{
					rgwchName[cubName >> 1] = 0;
					CopyWideFill( module.m_wszFullName, rgwchName, ARRAYSIZE( module.m_wszFullName ) );
					const wchar_t *pwszBaseName = util::wstr::BaseName( module.m_wszFullName );
					if ( pwszBaseName )
						CopyWideFill( module.m_wszBaseName, pwszBaseName, ARRAYSIZE( module.m_wszBaseName ) );
				}
			}
			AppendModule( pProbe, module );

			const u64 ulNext = entry.m_InLoadOrderLinks.m_ulFlink;
			if ( !ulNext || ulNext == ulFirstEntry )
				break;
			ReadTargetMemory( pProbe->m_hProcess, ulNext, rgubEntry, sizeof( rgubEntry ), &cubRead );
			if ( cubRead != sizeof( rgubEntry ) || !entry.m_ulDllBase )
				break;
		}
	}
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 8A 45
bool ReadNextLdrEntry( ProcessProbe_t *pProbe, u32 unFirstEntry, nt::LdrDataTableEntry32_t *pEntry,
                       EProbeFlags eFlags ) noexcept
{
	const bool bInitOrder = HasFlag( eFlags, EProbeFlags::InitOrder );
	u32 unNext;
	if ( HasFlag( eFlags, EProbeFlags::LoadOrder ) )
		unNext = pEntry->m_InLoadOrderLinks.m_ulFlink;
	else if ( bInitOrder )
		unNext = pEntry->m_InInitializationOrderLinks.m_ulFlink;
	else
		unNext = pEntry->m_InMemoryOrderLinks.m_ulFlink;

	if ( !unNext || unNext == unFirstEntry )
		return false;

	if ( !HasFlag( eFlags, EProbeFlags::LoadOrder ) )
		unNext -= bInitOrder ? offsetof( nt::LdrDataTableEntry32_t, m_InInitializationOrderLinks )
		                     : offsetof( nt::LdrDataTableEntry32_t, m_InMemoryOrderLinks );

	SIZE_T cubRead = 0;
	g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( pProbe->m_hProcess, reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>( unNext ) ),
	                               pEntry, nt::Arch32_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot, &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != nt::Arch32_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot )
	{
		pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::EntryReadFailed;
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

// @note / sapdragon: the probe holds Peb32_t, whose Ldr and parameters sit at 0x0C and 0x10. the old rebuild read them
// 4 bytes off. the module size in this branch really is a constant, and the list end is the first entry
// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 8A 84 24 ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 8B B4 24 ? ? ? ? 8B D9 57 88 44 24 ? 33 ED
EScanStatus WalkProcess( ProcessProbe_t *pProbe, u32 unPid, EProbeFlags eFlags ) noexcept
{
	pProbe->m_eFlags = process::ECaptureFlags::None;
	pProbe->m_ulCreationTime = 0;

	pProbe->m_hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );
	if ( ( g_pSession->m_OsVersion.dwPlatformId != VER_PLATFORM_WIN32_NT ||
	       g_pSession->m_OsVersion.dwMajorVersion < 6 ) &&
	     ( !pProbe->m_hProcess || pProbe->m_hProcess == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ) )
	{
		pProbe->m_hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );
	}

	if ( !pProbe->m_hProcess )
	{
		pProbe->m_unLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::ProcessOpenFailed;
	}

	pProbe->m_unPid = unPid;
	pProbe->m_cModules = 0;
	pProbe->m_cThreads = 0;
	pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Opened;

	u32 iLoadOrder = 1;
	FILETIME creationTime;
	FILETIME exitTime;
	FILETIME kernelTime;
	FILETIME userTime;
	if ( g_pImports->GetProcessTimes( pProbe->m_hProcess, &creationTime, &exitTime, &kernelTime, &userTime ) )
	{
		pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Times;
		memcpy( &pProbe->m_ulCreationTime, &creationTime, sizeof( creationTime ) );
	}

	BOOL bCrossBitness = FALSE;
	IsCrossBitnessProcess( GetCurrentProcess(), &bCrossBitness );
	pProbe->m_bSelfWow64 = bCrossBitness != FALSE;
	bCrossBitness = FALSE;
	IsCrossBitnessProcess( pProbe->m_hProcess, &bCrossBitness );
	pProbe->m_bCrossBitness = bCrossBitness != FALSE;

	g_pImports->CloseHandle( pProbe->m_hProcess );
	pProbe->m_hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ, FALSE, unPid );
	if ( !pProbe->m_hProcess )
	{
		pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::ReopenFailed;
		pProbe->m_unLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReopenFailed;
	}

	pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Reopened;
	if ( pProbe->m_bCrossBitness )
	{
		pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Cross64;
		return WalkProcess64( pProbe, unPid, eFlags );
	}

	nt::ProcessBasicInformation32_t basicInfo;
	ULONG cubReturned = 0;
	g_pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess( pProbe->m_hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation, &basicInfo, sizeof( basicInfo ),
	                                       &cubReturned );
	if ( cubReturned != sizeof( basicInfo ) )
		return EScanStatus::BasicInfoFailed;

	pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::BasicInfo;
	pProbe->m_unParentPid = basicInfo.m_ulInheritedFromUniqueProcessId;

	if ( !basicInfo.m_ulPebBaseAddress )
	{
		wchar_t rgwchImageName[MAX_PATH];
		rgwchImageName[ARRAYSIZE( rgwchImageName ) - 1] = 0;
		cubReturned = iLoadOrder;
		g_pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess( pProbe->m_hProcess, ProcessImageFileName, rgwchImageName,
		                                       sizeof( rgwchImageName ), &cubReturned );
		if ( cubReturned )
			CopyWideFill( pProbe->m_wszImagePath, rgwchImageName + sizeof( UNICODE_STRING ) / sizeof( wchar_t ),
			              ARRAYSIZE( pProbe->m_wszImagePath ) );
		return EScanStatus::NoPeb;
	}

	pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebAddress;

	SIZE_T cubRead = 0;
	g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( pProbe->m_hProcess,
	                               reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>( basicInfo.m_ulPebBaseAddress ) ),
	                               &pProbe->m_Peb, sizeof( nt::Peb32_t ), &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != sizeof( nt::Peb32_t ) )
		return EScanStatus::PebReadFailed;
	pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebRead;

	if ( HasFlag( eFlags, EProbeFlags::Parameters ) )
	{
		g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory(
		    pProbe->m_hProcess,
		    reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>( pProbe->m_Peb.m_ulProcessParameters ) ),
		    &pProbe->m_ProcessParameters, nt::Arch32_t::k_cubProcessParametersSnapshot, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != nt::Arch32_t::k_cubProcessParametersSnapshot )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;

		bool bOk = true;
		CopyNameToProbe32( pProbe, pProbe->m_ProcessParameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath, pProbe->m_wszCurrentDirectory,
		                   ARRAYSIZE( pProbe->m_wszCurrentDirectory ), &bOk );
		if ( !bOk )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		CopyNameToProbe32( pProbe, pProbe->m_ProcessParameters.m_ImagePathName, pProbe->m_wszImagePath,
		                   ARRAYSIZE( pProbe->m_wszImagePath ), &bOk );
		if ( !bOk )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		CopyNameToProbe32( pProbe, pProbe->m_ProcessParameters.m_CommandLine, pProbe->m_wszCommandLine,
		                   ARRAYSIZE( pProbe->m_wszCommandLine ), &bOk );
		if ( !bOk )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}

	u8 rgubLdr[nt::Arch32_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot];
	g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( pProbe->m_hProcess,
	                               reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>( pProbe->m_Peb.m_ulLdr ) ),
	                               rgubLdr, sizeof( rgubLdr ), &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != sizeof( rgubLdr ) )
	{
		pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrReadFailed;
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}
	pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrRead;

	if ( HasFlag( eFlags, EProbeFlags::Modules ) )
	{
		const auto &ldr = *reinterpret_cast<const nt::PebLdrData32_t *>( rgubLdr );

		nt::LdrDataTableEntry32_t entry;
		entry.m_InLoadOrderLinks.m_ulFlink = ldr.m_InLoadOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
		entry.m_InInitializationOrderLinks.m_ulFlink = ldr.m_InInitializationOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
		entry.m_InMemoryOrderLinks.m_ulFlink = ldr.m_InMemoryOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;

		u32 unFirstEntry = ldr.m_InLoadOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
		if ( !HasFlag( eFlags, EProbeFlags::LoadOrder ) )
		{
			unFirstEntry = HasFlag( eFlags, EProbeFlags::InitOrder ) ? ldr.m_InInitializationOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink
			                                                         : ldr.m_InMemoryOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
		}

		if ( !ReadNextLdrEntry( pProbe, 0, &entry, eFlags ) )
		{
			pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntryFailed;
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		}
		pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntry;

		i32 cLeft = k_cMaxModules;
		for ( ;; )
		{
			--cLeft;

			ProbeModule_t module;
			memset( &module, 0, sizeof( module ) );
			const u32 cubName = entry.m_FullDllName.m_cubLength;
			module.m_ulBase = static_cast<u64>( static_cast<i64>( static_cast<i32>( entry.m_ulDllBase ) ) );
			module.m_iLoadOrder = iLoadOrder++;
			module.m_cubImage = 0x1000;
			if ( cubName >= k_cubPeb64Name )
			{
				pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameTooLong;
			}
			else
			{
				wchar_t rgwchName[MAX_PATH];
				cubRead = 0;
				g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory(
				    pProbe->m_hProcess,
				    reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>( entry.m_FullDllName.m_ulBuffer ) ), rgwchName,
				    cubName, &cubRead );
				if ( cubRead == cubName )
				{
					rgwchName[cubName >> 1] = 0;
					CopyWideFill( module.m_wszFullName, rgwchName, ARRAYSIZE( module.m_wszFullName ) );
					const wchar_t *pwszBaseName = util::wstr::BaseName( module.m_wszFullName );
					if ( pwszBaseName )
						CopyWideFill( module.m_wszBaseName, pwszBaseName, ARRAYSIZE( module.m_wszBaseName ) );
				}
				else
				{
					pProbe->m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameReadFailed;
				}
			}
			AppendModule( pProbe, module );

			if ( !ReadNextLdrEntry( pProbe, unFirstEntry, &entry, eFlags ) || !entry.m_ulDllBase )
				break;
			if ( cLeft <= 0 )
			{
				--cLeft;
				break;
			}
		}
		if ( !cLeft )
			return EScanStatus::TooManyModules;
	}
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::image_scan

bool QueryThreadStartAddress( HANDLE hThread, u32 *punStartAddress ) noexcept
{
	u32 unStartAddress;
	if ( g_pImports->NtQueryInformationThread( hThread, static_cast<THREADINFOCLASS>( 9 ), &unStartAddress,
	                                           sizeof( unStartAddress ), nullptr ) < 0 )
		return false;
	*punStartAddress = unStartAddress;
	return true;
}

// @orig: 53 55 56 57 8B F9 33 F6 39 B7
ProbeModule_t *FindModuleByPath( const ProcessProbe_t *pProbe, const wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	for ( i32 iModule = 0; iModule < pProbe->m_cModules; ++iModule )
	{
		ProbeModule_t *pModule = &pProbe->m_pModules[iModule];
		if ( !ComparePathPrefix( pModule->m_wszFullName, pwszPath, 520 ) )
			return pModule;
	}
	return nullptr;
}

// @orig: 53 55 56 8B B1
ProbeModule_t *FindModuleByAddress( const ProcessProbe_t *pProbe, u64 ulAddress ) noexcept
{
	for ( i32 iModule = 0; iModule < pProbe->m_cModules; ++iModule )
	{
		ProbeModule_t *pModule = &pProbe->m_pModules[iModule];
		if ( ulAddress >= pModule->m_ulBase && ulAddress < pModule->m_ulBase + pModule->m_cubImage )
			return pModule;
	}
	return nullptr;
}

// @orig: 56 68 ? ? ? ? 8B F1
void InitProbe( ProcessProbe_t *pProbe ) noexcept
{
	memset( pProbe, 0, sizeof( *pProbe ) );
	pProbe->m_hProcess = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 8A 84 24 ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 8B B4 24 ? ? ? ? 8B D9 57 88 44 24 ? A1
EScanStatus ToolhelpSnapshot( ProcessProbe_t *pProbe, u32 unPid, EProbeFlags eFlags ) noexcept
{
	pProbe->m_hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ, FALSE, unPid );
	if ( !pProbe->m_hProcess )
	{
		pProbe->m_unLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReopenFailed;
	}

	const bool bSnapModules = HasFlag( eFlags, EProbeFlags::Modules );
	const bool bSnapThreads = HasFlag( eFlags, EProbeFlags::Threads );
	if ( !bSnapModules && !bSnapThreads )
		return EScanStatus::Ok;

	DWORD unSnapshotFlags = bSnapThreads ? TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD : 0;
	if ( bSnapModules )
		unSnapshotFlags |= TH32CS_SNAPMODULE;

	const HANDLE hSnapshot =
	    g_pImports->CreateToolhelp32Snapshot( unSnapshotFlags, unSnapshotFlags != TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD ? unPid : 0 );
	if ( hSnapshot == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
	{
		pProbe->m_unLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}

	pProbe->m_cModules = 0;
	pProbe->m_cThreads = 0;
	pProbe->m_unPid = unPid;

	// @note / sapdragon: unreachable, both workers pass flags without this bit. the counts and the target are Valve's:
	// they copy the exe path and then the module name over the same field, past its end
	if ( bSnapModules )
	{
		MODULEENTRY32W entry;
		entry.dwSize = sizeof( entry );
		if ( g_pImports->Module32FirstW( hSnapshot, &entry ) )
		{
			pProbe->m_pModules = static_cast<ProbeModule_t *>( AllocBytes( sizeof( ProbeModule_t ) ) );
			do
			{
				ProbeModule_t module;
				memset( &module, 0, sizeof( module ) );
				module.m_ulBase = static_cast<u64>(
				    static_cast<i64>( static_cast<i32>( reinterpret_cast<uptr>( entry.modBaseAddr ) ) ) );
				module.m_cubImage = entry.modBaseSize;
				CopyWideFill( module.m_wszFullName, entry.szExePath, 520 );
				CopyWideFill( module.m_wszFullName, entry.szModule, 512 );

				pProbe->m_pModules = static_cast<ProbeModule_t *>(
				    ReallocBytes( pProbe->m_pModules, sizeof( ProbeModule_t ) * ( pProbe->m_cModules + 1 ) ) );
				memcpy( &pProbe->m_pModules[pProbe->m_cModules], &module, sizeof( module ) );
				++pProbe->m_cModules;
			} while ( g_pImports->Module32NextW( hSnapshot, &entry ) );
		}
	}

	if ( bSnapThreads )
	{
		THREADENTRY32 entry;
		entry.dwSize = sizeof( entry );
		if ( g_pImports->Thread32First( hSnapshot, &entry ) )
		{
			pProbe->m_cThreads = 0;
			do
			{
				if ( entry.th32OwnerProcessID == pProbe->m_unPid )
					++pProbe->m_cThreads;
			} while ( g_pImports->Thread32Next( hSnapshot, &entry ) );
		}

		if ( pProbe->m_cThreads > 0 )
		{
			pProbe->m_pThreads =
			    static_cast<ProbeThread_t *>( AllocBytes( sizeof( ProbeThread_t ) * pProbe->m_cThreads ) );

			entry.dwSize = sizeof( entry );
			g_pImports->Thread32First( hSnapshot, &entry );
			ProbeThread_t *pThread = pProbe->m_pThreads;
			do
			{
				if ( entry.th32OwnerProcessID == pProbe->m_unPid )
				{
					memcpy( &pThread->m_Entry, &entry, sizeof( entry ) );
					if ( g_pImports->OpenThread && g_pImports->NtQueryInformationThread )
					{
						const HANDLE hThread =
						    g_pImports->OpenThread( THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, pThread->m_Entry.th32ThreadID );
						if ( hThread )
						{
							QueryThreadStartAddress( hThread, &pThread->m_unStartAddress );
							CloseHandle( hThread );
						}
					}
					++pThread;
				}
				entry.dwSize = sizeof( entry );
			} while ( g_pImports->Thread32Next( hSnapshot, &entry ) );

			const u32 cubStacks = 24 * static_cast<u32>( pProbe->m_cThreads );
			pProbe->m_pThreadStacks = AllocBytes( cubStacks );
			memset( pProbe->m_pThreadStacks, 0, cubStacks );
		}
	}

	g_pImports->CloseHandle( hSnapshot );

	if ( bSnapThreads && !pProbe->m_cThreads )
		return EScanStatus::NoThreads;
	if ( !bSnapModules || pProbe->m_cModules )
		return EScanStatus::Ok;
	return EScanStatus::TooManyModules;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 8E
void CleanupProbe( ProcessProbe_t *pProbe ) noexcept
{
	if ( pProbe->m_pModules )
		FreeBytes( pProbe->m_pModules );
	pProbe->m_pModules = nullptr;
	pProbe->m_cModules = 0;

	if ( pProbe->m_pThreads )
		FreeBytes( pProbe->m_pThreads );
	if ( pProbe->m_pThreadStacks )
		FreeBytes( pProbe->m_pThreadStacks );
	if ( pProbe->m_pUnusedTableA )
		FreeBytes( pProbe->m_pUnusedTableA );
	if ( pProbe->m_pUnusedTableB )
		FreeBytes( pProbe->m_pUnusedTableB );

	if ( pProbe->m_hProcess != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && pProbe->m_hProcess )
		g_pImports->CloseHandle( pProbe->m_hProcess );

	memset( pProbe, 0, sizeof( *pProbe ) );
	pProbe->m_hProcess = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::image_scan

// @binary: 33211402
#include "../scanner.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::image_scan
{

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 E4 ? 83 EC
bool WalkProcessRegion( HANDLE hProcess, RegionWalk_t *pWalk ) noexcept
{
	bool bReservedGap = false;

	pWalk->m_ulFirstCommitted = 0;
	pWalk->m_ulCommittedEnd = 0;
	pWalk->m_ulContiguousEnd = 0;
	pWalk->m_cubTotal = 0;
	pWalk->m_unProtectMask = 0;
	pWalk->m_unExecutableProtectMask = 0;
	pWalk->m_cRegions = 0;
	pWalk->m_cCommitted = 0;
	pWalk->m_cubContiguous = 0;

	if ( pWalk->m_ulCursor && pWalk->m_ulNext <= pWalk->m_ulCursor )
		return false;

	pWalk->m_ulCursor = pWalk->m_ulNext;
	pWalk->m_ulCurrent = pWalk->m_ulNext;
	if ( QueryTargetRegion( hProcess, pWalk->m_ulNext, &pWalk->m_First ) != sizeof( pWalk->m_First ) )
	{
		pWalk->m_unLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
		return false;
	}
	if ( pWalk->m_First.RegionSize == MAXDWORD )
		return false;

	u64 ulAddress = pWalk->m_ulNext;
	pWalk->m_ulCurrent = ulAddress;

	MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION64 info;
	u32 cubInfo = QueryTargetRegion( hProcess, ulAddress, &info );
	pWalk->m_ulNext = ulAddress;
	for ( ;; )
	{
		if ( cubInfo != sizeof( info ) )
		{
			pWalk->m_unLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
			return true;
		}
		if ( info.AllocationBase != pWalk->m_First.AllocationBase )
			return true;

		const u64 ulEnd = ulAddress + info.RegionSize;
		if ( info.State == MEM_FREE )
		{
			pWalk->m_cubTotal += info.RegionSize;
			pWalk->m_ulNext = ulEnd;
			pWalk->m_unProtectMask |= info.Protect;
			++pWalk->m_cRegions;
			return true;
		}

		if ( info.State == MEM_RESERVE )
		{
			if ( pWalk->m_ulFirstCommitted )
			{
				pWalk->m_cubTotal += info.RegionSize;
				bReservedGap = true;
			}
			++pWalk->m_cRegions;
		}
		else if ( info.State == MEM_COMMIT )
		{
			pWalk->m_ulCommittedEnd = ulEnd;
			if ( !bReservedGap )
			{
				pWalk->m_cubContiguous += info.RegionSize;
				pWalk->m_ulContiguousEnd = ulEnd;
			}
			if ( !pWalk->m_ulFirstCommitted )
				pWalk->m_ulFirstCommitted = ulAddress;
			pWalk->m_cubTotal += info.RegionSize;
			pWalk->m_unProtectMask |= info.Protect;
			if ( info.Protect & ( PAGE_EXECUTE | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE | PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY ) )
				pWalk->m_unExecutableProtectMask |= info.Protect;
			++pWalk->m_cRegions;
			++pWalk->m_cCommitted;
		}

		if ( ulEnd <= ulAddress )
			return true;

		pWalk->m_ulCurrent = ulEnd;
		ulAddress = ulEnd;
		cubInfo = QueryTargetRegion( hProcess, ulEnd, &info );
		pWalk->m_ulNext = ulEnd;
	}
}

// @note / sapdragon: nothing allocates the scratch in this build, and these free arguments would fail anyway
// @orig: 56 8B F1 83 7E ? ? 74 ? A1 ? ? ? ? 68
void ReleaseScanSession( ScanSession_t *pSession ) noexcept
{
	if ( pSession->m_pvScratch )
	{
		g_pImports->VirtualFree( pSession->m_pvScratch, 0x400000, MEM_FREE );
		pSession->m_pvScratch = nullptr;
	}
}

} // namespace vac::workers::image_scan
