```cpp
// @binary: 33211402
#include "thread_report.hpp"
#include "../scanner.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/scan_status.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::image_scan
{

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 E4 ? B8 ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? 8B 45 ? 56
int RunThreadReport( const Input_t &input, ThreadReport_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	if ( *pcubOutput < k_cubReport )
		return 4;

	*pcubOutput = k_cubReport;
	memset( &report, 0, k_cubReport );
	memset( &report, 0, k_cubReport );

	if ( !bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
	{
		report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
		return 0;
	}

	report.m_unMagic = k_unThreadReportMagic;
	report.m_unReserved = 0;
	report.m_unPid = input.m_unPid;

	ProcessProbe_t probe;
	InitProbe( &probe );

	EProbeFlags ePermuted;
	const EProbeFlags eFlags = *PermuteScanAccessFlags( &ePermuted, EScanAccess::Threads );
	const EScanStatus eStatus = ToolhelpSnapshot( &probe, input.m_unPid, eFlags );

	report.m_unLastError = probe.m_unLastError;
	report.m_eFlags = probe.m_eFlags;
	report.m_cModules = static_cast<u32>( probe.m_cModules );

	wchar_t wszMappedName[k_cMaxMappedNameChars];
	wszMappedName[0] = 0;
	report.m_eStatus = eStatus;

	if ( probe.m_cThreads > static_cast<i32>( ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgRecords ) ) )
		probe.m_cThreads = ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgRecords );

	if ( eStatus == EScanStatus::Ok )
	{
		for ( i32 iThread = 0; iThread < probe.m_cThreads; ++iThread )
		{
			ThreadRecord_t &record = report.m_rgRecords[iThread];
			record.m_unThreadId = probe.m_pThreads[iThread].m_Entry.th32ThreadID;

			// @note / sapdragon: sign extended on purpose, the query only ever returned the low half
			const u64 ulStart =
			    static_cast<u64>( static_cast<i64>( static_cast<i32>( probe.m_pThreads[iThread].m_unStartAddress ) ) );
			record.m_ulStartAddress = ulStart;

			const ProbeModule_t *pModule = FindModuleByAddress( &probe, ulStart );

			MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION64 region;
			region.Protect = 0;
			region.AllocationBase = 0;
			QueryTargetRegion( probe.m_hProcess, ulStart, &region );

			wszMappedName[0] = 0;
			QueryTargetMappedName( probe.m_hProcess, record.m_ulStartAddress, wszMappedName );

			EThreadMemoryFlags eMemoryFlags = static_cast<EThreadMemoryFlags>(
			    static_cast<u32>( region.AllocationBase ) | ( region.Protect & 0xFFF ) );
			if ( wszMappedName[0] )
				eMemoryFlags |= EThreadMemoryFlags::MappedName;
			if ( pModule )
				eMemoryFlags |= EThreadMemoryFlags::InModule;

			record.m_eMemoryFlags = eMemoryFlags;
			++report.m_cRecords;
		}
	}

	CleanupProbe( &probe );
	*pcubOutput = ( sizeof( ThreadRecord_t ) * report.m_cRecords + offsetof( ThreadReport_t, m_rgRecords ) + 7 ) & ~7u;
	bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();
	return 0;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::image_scan
```

```cpp
// @binary: 33211402
#include "../scanner.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "util/encoding.hpp"
#include "verify/cert_chain.hpp"

#include <SoftPub.h>
#include <mscat.h>

namespace vac::workers::image_scan
{

namespace
{

using PfnCryptCATAdminAcquireContext_t = BOOL( WINAPI * )( HCATADMIN *, const GUID *, DWORD );
using PfnCryptCATAdminAcquireContext2_t = BOOL( WINAPI * )( HCATADMIN *, const GUID *, PCWSTR, void *, DWORD );
using PfnCryptCATAdminCalcHashFromFileHandle_t = BOOL( WINAPI * )( HANDLE, DWORD *, BYTE *, DWORD );
using PfnCryptCATAdminCalcHashFromFileHandle2_t = BOOL( WINAPI * )( HCATADMIN, HANDLE, DWORD *, BYTE *, DWORD );
using PfnCryptCATAdminReleaseContext_t = BOOL( WINAPI * )( HCATADMIN, DWORD );
using PfnCryptCATAdminEnumCatalogFromHash_t = HCATINFO( WINAPI * )( HCATADMIN, BYTE *, DWORD, DWORD, HCATINFO * );
using PfnCryptCATCatalogInfoFromContext_t = BOOL( WINAPI * )( HCATINFO, CATALOG_INFO *, DWORD );
using PfnCryptCATAdminReleaseCatalogContext_t = BOOL( WINAPI * )( HCATADMIN, HCATINFO, DWORD );

constinit PfnCryptCATAdminAcquireContext_t s_pfnAcquireContext = nullptr;
constinit PfnCryptCATAdminAcquireContext2_t s_pfnAcquireContext2 = nullptr;
constinit PfnCryptCATAdminCalcHashFromFileHandle_t s_pfnCalcHash = nullptr;
constinit PfnCryptCATAdminCalcHashFromFileHandle2_t s_pfnCalcHash2 = nullptr;
constinit PfnCryptCATAdminReleaseContext_t s_pfnReleaseContext = nullptr;
constinit PfnCryptCATAdminEnumCatalogFromHash_t s_pfnEnumCatalog = nullptr;
constinit PfnCryptCATCatalogInfoFromContext_t s_pfnCatalogInfo = nullptr;
constinit PfnCryptCATAdminReleaseCatalogContext_t s_pfnReleaseCatalog = nullptr;

constexpr GUID k_DriverActionVerify = DRIVER_ACTION_VERIFY;

struct FileView_t
{
	HANDLE m_hMapping;
	void *m_pView;
	u64 m_cubFile;
	u32 m_unLastError;

#pragma pack( push, 1 )
struct CatalogLookup_t
{
	HCATADMIN m_hAdmin;
	HCATINFO m_hCatalog;
	BYTE *m_pubHash;
	DWORD m_cubHash;
	WINTRUST_CATALOG_INFO m_CatalogInfo;
	CATALOG_INFO m_Info;

#pragma pack( pop )
VAC_LAYOUT( CatalogLookup_t, m_CatalogInfo, 0x10 );

// @orig: 56 8B F1 57 33 FF 8D 46
void OpenFileView( FileView_t *pView, HANDLE hFile ) noexcept
{
	pView->m_hMapping = nullptr;
	pView->m_cubFile = 0;
	pView->m_pView = nullptr;
	g_pImports->GetFileSizeEx( hFile, reinterpret_cast<PLARGE_INTEGER>( &pView->m_cubFile ) );

	pView->m_hMapping = g_pImports->CreateFileMappingW( hFile, nullptr, PAGE_READONLY, 0, 0, nullptr );
	if ( !pView->m_hMapping ||
	     !( pView->m_pView = g_pImports->MapViewOfFile( pView->m_hMapping, FILE_MAP_READ, 0, 0, 0 ) ) )
		pView->m_unLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 83 7E ? ? 74 ? A1 ? ? ? ? FF 76
void CloseFileView( const FileView_t *pView ) noexcept
{
	if ( pView->m_pView )
		g_pImports->UnmapViewOfFile( pView->m_pView );
	if ( pView->m_hMapping )
		g_pImports->CloseHandle( pView->m_hMapping );
}

// @note / sapdragon: the library handle is never freed, the catalog functions stay valid for the next call
// @orig: A1 ? ? ? ? 56 68
bool LoadCatalogFunctions() noexcept
{
	const HMODULE hWinTrust = g_pImports->LoadLibraryA( "wintrust.dll" );
	if ( !hWinTrust )
		return false;

	s_pfnAcquireContext = reinterpret_cast<PfnCryptCATAdminAcquireContext_t>(
	    g_pImports->GetProcAddress( hWinTrust, "CryptCATAdminAcquireContext" ) );
	s_pfnAcquireContext2 = reinterpret_cast<PfnCryptCATAdminAcquireContext2_t>(
	    g_pImports->GetProcAddress( hWinTrust, "CryptCATAdminAcquireContext2" ) );
	s_pfnCalcHash = reinterpret_cast<PfnCryptCATAdminCalcHashFromFileHandle_t>(
	    g_pImports->GetProcAddress( hWinTrust, "CryptCATAdminCalcHashFromFileHandle" ) );
	s_pfnCalcHash2 = reinterpret_cast<PfnCryptCATAdminCalcHashFromFileHandle2_t>(
	    g_pImports->GetProcAddress( hWinTrust, "CryptCATAdminCalcHashFromFileHandle2" ) );
	s_pfnReleaseContext = reinterpret_cast<PfnCryptCATAdminReleaseContext_t>(
	    g_pImports->GetProcAddress( hWinTrust, "CryptCATAdminReleaseContext" ) );
	s_pfnEnumCatalog = reinterpret_cast<PfnCryptCATAdminEnumCatalogFromHash_t>(
	    g_pImports->GetProcAddress( hWinTrust, "CryptCATAdminEnumCatalogFromHash" ) );
	s_pfnCatalogInfo = reinterpret_cast<PfnCryptCATCatalogInfoFromContext_t>(
	    g_pImports->GetProcAddress( hWinTrust, "CryptCATCatalogInfoFromContext" ) );
	s_pfnReleaseCatalog = reinterpret_cast<PfnCryptCATAdminReleaseCatalogContext_t>(
	    g_pImports->GetProcAddress( hWinTrust, "CryptCATAdminReleaseCatalogContext" ) );
	return true;
}

// @note / sapdragon: the hash buffer is never freed, and a second failure of the old API leaks it right here
// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 06
void CloseCatalogLookup( const CatalogLookup_t *pLookup ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pLookup->m_hAdmin )
		return;
	if ( pLookup->m_hCatalog )
		s_pfnReleaseCatalog( pLookup->m_hAdmin, pLookup->m_hCatalog, 0 );
	s_pfnReleaseContext( pLookup->m_hAdmin, 0 );
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 56 57
bool CalcCatalogHash( const CatalogLookup_t *pLookup, HANDLE hFile, BYTE **ppubHash, DWORD *pcubHash ) noexcept
{
	DWORD cubHash = 32;
	BYTE *pubHash = static_cast<BYTE *>( AllocBytes( 32 ) );
	if ( s_pfnCalcHash2 )
	{
		if ( !s_pfnCalcHash2( pLookup->m_hAdmin, hFile, &cubHash, pubHash, 0 ) )
		{
			FreeBytes( pubHash );
			pubHash = static_cast<BYTE *>( AllocBytes( cubHash ) );
			if ( !s_pfnCalcHash2( pLookup->m_hAdmin, hFile, &cubHash, pubHash, 0 ) )
			{
				FreeBytes( pubHash );
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	else if ( !s_pfnCalcHash( hFile, &cubHash, pubHash, 0 ) )
	{
		FreeBytes( pubHash );
		pubHash = static_cast<BYTE *>( AllocBytes( cubHash ) );
		if ( !s_pfnCalcHash( hFile, &cubHash, pubHash, 0 ) )
			return false;
	}

	*ppubHash = pubHash;
	*pcubHash = cubHash;
	return true;
}

// @note / sapdragon: the struct size written below is the size of the catalog path buffer, not of the struct. keep it
// @orig: 53 55 56 57 8B F1 E8 ? ? ? ? 84 C0
bool FindCatalogForFile( CatalogLookup_t *pLookup, HANDLE hFile ) noexcept
{
	if ( !LoadCatalogFunctions() )
		return false;

	BOOL bAcquired;
	if ( s_pfnAcquireContext2 )
	{
		bAcquired = s_pfnAcquireContext2( &pLookup->m_hAdmin, &k_DriverActionVerify, nullptr, nullptr, 0 );
	}
	else
	{
		if ( !s_pfnAcquireContext )
			return false;
		bAcquired = s_pfnAcquireContext( &pLookup->m_hAdmin, &k_DriverActionVerify, 0 );
	}
	if ( !bAcquired )
		return false;

	if ( CalcCatalogHash( pLookup, hFile, &pLookup->m_pubHash, &pLookup->m_cubHash ) && s_pfnEnumCatalog )
		pLookup->m_hCatalog = s_pfnEnumCatalog( pLookup->m_hAdmin, pLookup->m_pubHash, pLookup->m_cubHash, 0, nullptr );

	if ( !pLookup->m_hCatalog || !s_pfnCatalogInfo || !s_pfnCatalogInfo( pLookup->m_hCatalog, &pLookup->m_Info, 0 ) )
		return false;

	pLookup->m_CatalogInfo.cbStruct = sizeof( pLookup->m_Info );
	pLookup->m_CatalogInfo.pcwszCatalogFilePath = pLookup->m_Info.wszCatalogFile;
	pLookup->m_CatalogInfo.pbCalculatedFileHash = pLookup->m_pubHash;
	pLookup->m_CatalogInfo.cbCalculatedFileHash = pLookup->m_cubHash;
	pLookup->m_CatalogInfo.pcwszMemberFilePath = nullptr;
	pLookup->m_CatalogInfo.pcwszMemberTag = nullptr;
	return true;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 8B F1
bool VerifySignatureAndCatalog( ScannerContext_t *pCtx, bool bLookUpCatalog ) noexcept
{
	pCtx->m_unWinTrustStatus = 0;
	pCtx->m_unWinTrustLastError = ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE;
	if ( pCtx->m_hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return false;

	WINTRUST_FILE_INFO fileInfo;
	memset( &fileInfo, 0, sizeof( fileInfo ) );
	fileInfo.cbStruct = sizeof( fileInfo );
	fileInfo.hFile = pCtx->m_hFile;
	fileInfo.pcwszFilePath = L"";

	GUID action = WINTRUST_ACTION_GENERIC_VERIFY_V2;

	WINTRUST_DATA data;
	memset( &data, 0, sizeof( data ) );
	data.cbStruct = sizeof( data );
	data.fdwRevocationChecks = WTD_REVOKE_NONE;
	data.dwStateAction = WTD_STATEACTION_VERIFY;
	data.dwProvFlags = WTD_CACHE_ONLY_URL_RETRIEVAL;
	data.dwUIChoice = WTD_UI_NONE;

	CatalogLookup_t lookup;
	memset( &lookup, 0, sizeof( lookup ) );
	pCtx->m_bCatalogValid = 0;
	pCtx->m_szCatalogPath[0] = 0;

	if ( bLookUpCatalog && FindCatalogForFile( &lookup, pCtx->m_hFile ) )
	{
		pCtx->m_bCatalogValid = 1;
		if ( lookup.m_CatalogInfo.pcwszCatalogFilePath )
		{
			util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, lookup.m_CatalogInfo.pcwszCatalogFilePath,
			                                   pCtx->m_szCatalogPath, sizeof( pCtx->m_szCatalogPath ) );
			pCtx->m_szCatalogPath[sizeof( pCtx->m_szCatalogPath ) - 1] = 0;
		}
		data.dwUnionChoice = WTD_CHOICE_CATALOG;
		data.pCatalog = &lookup.m_CatalogInfo;
	}
	else
	{
		data.dwUnionChoice = WTD_CHOICE_FILE;
		data.pFile = &fileInfo;
	}

	pCtx->m_unWinTrustStatus = static_cast<u32>( g_pImports->WinVerifyTrust( nullptr, &action, &data ) );
	pCtx->m_unWinTrustLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();

	memset( &pCtx->m_Signer, 0, sizeof( pCtx->m_Signer ) );
	memset( &pCtx->m_Issuer, 0, sizeof( pCtx->m_Issuer ) );
	pCtx->m_unMappingLastError = 0;
	pCtx->m_unCertLastError = 0;

	FileView_t view;
	OpenFileView( &view, pCtx->m_hFile );
	if ( view.m_pView )
	{
		verify::CertContextSet_t certificates;
		(void)verify::OpenCertificateContextFromBlob( g_pImports, &certificates, view.m_pView,
		                                              static_cast<u32>( view.m_cubFile ),
		                                              CERT_QUERY_CONTENT_FLAG_PKCS7_SIGNED_EMBED );
		if ( certificates.m_hMsg )
			verify::ExtractCertChain( g_pImports, &certificates, &pCtx->m_Signer, &pCtx->m_Issuer );
		else
			pCtx->m_unCertLastError = certificates.m_unLastError;
		verify::ReleaseCertContext( g_pImports, &certificates );
	}
	else
	{
		pCtx->m_unMappingLastError = view.m_unLastError;
	}

	data.dwStateAction = WTD_STATEACTION_CLOSE;
	g_pImports->WinVerifyTrust( nullptr, &action, &data );
	CloseFileView( &view );
	CloseCatalogLookup( &lookup );
	return true;
}
```

`modules/image_scan_threads/tests/thread_fixture.cpp`:

```cpp
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>

static DWORD WINAPI parked( void * )
{
	Sleep( INFINITE );
	return 0;
}
int main( int argc, char **argv )
{
	unsigned count = argc > 1 ? static_cast<unsigned>( std::strtoul( argv[1], nullptr, 10 ) ) : 1;
	if ( count > 320 )
		return 2;
	for ( unsigned i = 0; i < count; ++i )
	{
		LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE start = parked;
		// Suspended threads let us test start addresses without executing them.
		if ( i == 0 || i == 1 )
		{
			void *wanted = i == 1 ? reinterpret_cast<void *>( 0x90000000ull ) : nullptr;
			void *page = VirtualAlloc( wanted, 4096, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE );
			if ( !page )
				return 3;
			*static_cast<unsigned char *>( page ) = 0xC3;
			start = reinterpret_cast<LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE>( page );
		}
		HANDLE thread = CreateThread( nullptr, 0, start, nullptr, CREATE_SUSPENDED, nullptr );
		if ( !thread )
			return 4;
		CloseHandle( thread );
	}
	std::puts( "ready" );
	std::fflush( stdout );
	Sleep( INFINITE );
	return 0;
}
```

`modules/payload_executor/entry.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 60e41c53
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/blob.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"
#include "crypto/hash/crc32.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::payload_executor
{
// @orig: 51 8B 44 24
int RunPayloadExecutor( Input_t &input, Report_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	if ( *pcubOutput < 0xFD0 )
		return 4;
	*pcubOutput = k_cubReport;
	// @note / sapdragon: the second memset is valve's, it does nothing but it stays
	memset( &report, 0, k_cubReport );
	memset( &report, 0, 0xFD0 );
	if ( !bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
	{
		report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
		return 0;
	}
	const auto *pImports = g_pImports;
	u8 *pubData = nullptr;
	if ( HasFlag( input.m_eFlags, EPayloadFlags::Allocate ) )
	{
		pubData =
		    static_cast<u8 *>( pImports->VirtualAlloc( nullptr, input.m_cubAllocation, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE ) );
		report.m_unAllocatedMemory = static_cast<u32>( reinterpret_cast<uptr>( pubData ) );
		report.m_eFlags |= EPayloadFlags::Allocate;
		report.m_cubData = input.m_cubAllocation;
	}
	if ( HasFlag( input.m_eFlags, EPayloadFlags::ExistingPointer ) )
	{
		pubData = reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( static_cast<uptr>( input.m_unDataPointer ) );
		report.m_eFlags |= EPayloadFlags::ExistingPointer;
	}
	report.m_unBaseCrc32 = crypto::hash::Crc32_t::Of( k_rgubBase, sizeof( k_rgubBase ) );
	if ( HasFlag( input.m_eFlags, EPayloadFlags::Decrypt ) )
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: capacity really is 0, so any non empty result ends in error 3 and the crc still runs
		// over the required size. the error code then overwrites the bool
		u32 cubPlain = 0, unError = 0;
		report.m_unDecryptResult =
		    DecryptPayload( input.m_rgubPackedBlob, input.m_cubPacked, pubData, &cubPlain, &unError );
		report.m_cubData = cubPlain;
		report.m_unDecryptedCrc32 = crypto::hash::Crc32_t::Of( pubData, cubPlain );
		report.m_eFlags |= EPayloadFlags::Decrypt;
		report.m_unDecryptResult = report.m_unDecryptStatus = unError;
	}
	if ( HasFlag( input.m_eFlags, EPayloadFlags::MakeExecutable ) )
	{
		DWORD unOldProtect = 0;
		pImports->VirtualProtect( pubData, input.m_cubAllocation, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, &unOldProtect );
		report.m_eFlags |= EPayloadFlags::MakeExecutable;
	}
	if ( HasFlag( input.m_eFlags, EPayloadFlags::Call ) )
	{
		using Entry_t = void( __cdecl * )( ModuleSession_t *, u32 *, Report_t * );
		reinterpret_cast<Entry_t>( pubData + input.m_ibEntry )( g_pSession, &input.m_unDataPointer, &report );
		report.m_eFlags |= EPayloadFlags::Call;
	}
	if ( HasFlag( input.m_eFlags, EPayloadFlags::Free ) )
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: valve really passes MEM_FREE here, not MEM_RELEASE. don't fix it
		::VirtualFree( pubData, input.m_cubAllocation, MEM_FREE );
		report.m_eFlags |= EPayloadFlags::Free;
	}
	bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();
	return 0;
}
} // namespace vac::workers::payload_executor

#include "internal/module_data.inl"

VAC_WORKER( vac::workers::payload_executor::RunPayloadExecutor, vac::workers::payload_executor::k_unModuleId, 1, 0xC4,
            0xDA, 0xF0, 0xA4, 0x89, 0x24, 0x9C, 0x0B, 0xA5, 0x20, 0x56, 0x60, 0xC9, 0x28, 0x2D, 0x0A, 0x78, 0x2F, 0xF7,
            0x25, 0xA6, 0x24, 0xBA, 0x36, 0x00, 0x29, 0x26, 0x6F, 0x9B, 0xD2, 0xFC, 0x1B );
```

```cpp
// @binary: 60e41c53
#include "types.hpp"
#include "crypto/bigint/bigint.hpp"
#include "util/asn1.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::payload_executor
{
const u8 k_rgubBase[0x4000] = {
#include "base.inc"
};
namespace
{
// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 57 8D 44 24
bool ParsePrivateKey( const u8 *pubKey, u32 cubKey, const u8 *&pubModulus, u32 &cubModulus, const u8 *&pubExponent,
                      u32 &cubExponent ) noexcept
{
	using util::EAsn1Tag;
	using util::ParseTlv;
	static constexpr u8 k_rgubPrivateKeyPrefix[] = { 2,    1,    0,    0x30, 0x0D, 6, 9, 0x2A, 0x86,
	                                                 0x48, 0x86, 0xF7, 0x0D, 1,    1, 1, 5,    0 };
	const u8 *pubValue = nullptr;
	u32 cubValue = 0;
	if ( !ParseTlv( EAsn1Tag::Sequence, pubKey, cubKey, pubValue, cubValue ) ||
	     cubValue <= sizeof( k_rgubPrivateKeyPrefix ) ||
	     memcmp( pubValue, k_rgubPrivateKeyPrefix, sizeof( k_rgubPrivateKeyPrefix ) ) )
		return false;
	if ( !ParseTlv( EAsn1Tag::OctetString, pubValue + sizeof( k_rgubPrivateKeyPrefix ),
	                cubValue - sizeof( k_rgubPrivateKeyPrefix ), pubKey, cubKey ) ||
	     !cubKey )
		return false;
	if ( !ParseTlv( EAsn1Tag::Sequence, pubKey, cubKey, pubValue, cubValue ) )
		return false;
	const u8 *pubCursor = pubValue;
	u32 cubRemaining = cubValue;
	auto ParseInteger = [&]( const u8 *&pubInteger, u32 &cubInteger )
	{
		if ( !ParseTlv( EAsn1Tag::Integer, pubCursor, cubRemaining, pubInteger, cubInteger ) )
			return false;
		const u32 cubConsumed = static_cast<u32>( pubInteger - pubCursor ) + cubInteger;
		pubCursor += cubConsumed;
		cubRemaining -= cubConsumed;
		return true;
	};
	const u8 *pubIgnored = nullptr;
	u32 cubIgnored = 0;
	return ParseInteger( pubIgnored, cubIgnored ) && ParseInteger( pubModulus, cubModulus ) &&
	       ParseInteger( pubIgnored, cubIgnored ) && ParseInteger( pubExponent, cubExponent );
}
} // namespace

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 E4 ? 81 EC ? ? ? ? 8B 55
bool DecryptPayload( const u8 *pubPacked, u32 cubPacked, u8 *pubOutput, u32 *pcubOutput, u32 *punError ) noexcept
{
	*punError = 0;
	const u8 *pubModulus = nullptr;
	const u8 *pubExponent = nullptr;
	u32 cubModulus = 0, cubExponent = 0;
	if ( !ParsePrivateKey( pubPacked, cubPacked, pubModulus, cubModulus, pubExponent, cubExponent ) )
	{
		*punError = 1;
		return false;
	}
	crypto::bigint::Bignum_t base, exponent, modulus;
	base.SetBytes( k_rgubBase, sizeof( k_rgubBase ) );
	exponent.SetBytes( pubExponent, cubExponent );
	modulus.SetBytes( pubModulus, cubModulus );
	bool bSuccess = false;
	if ( ( ( modulus.m_cBits + 7u ) & ~7u ) <= 8192 )
	{
		base.ModExp( exponent, modulus );
		const u32 cubResult = ( base.m_cBits + 7 ) >> 3;
		if ( cubResult > 1024 )
			*punError = 2;
		else if ( cubResult > *pcubOutput )
		{
			*punError = 3;
			*pcubOutput = cubResult;
		}
		else
		{
			const u32 cubPadding = *pcubOutput - cubResult;
			memset( pubOutput, 0, cubPadding );
			const auto *pubResult = reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( base.m_punData );
			for ( u32 ib = 0; ib < cubResult; ++ib )
				pubOutput[cubPadding + ib] = pubResult[cubResult - 1 - ib];
			bSuccess = true;
		}
	}
	else
		*punError = 2;
	modulus.Destroy();
	exponent.Destroy();
	base.Destroy();
	return bSuccess;
}
} // namespace vac::workers::payload_executor
```

```cpp
#include "../internal/types.hpp"
#include <windows.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
#include <array>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>

using namespace vac;
using namespace vac::workers::payload_executor;
using Worker = int (__cdecl*)(const u8*, u8*, u32*);
using Packer = bool (__cdecl*)(const u8*, u32, u8*, u32*, u32*);
static unsigned cases = 0, failures = 0;
static u8 seed[32];
static u8 scratch[4096];
static LONG CALLBACK exceptionLog(PEXCEPTION_POINTERS e) {
    std::printf("exception %08lx at %p\n",e->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode,e->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionAddress);
    std::fflush(stdout); return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

static void check(const char* name, bool ok) {
    ++cases; if (!ok) ++failures;
    std::printf("%s %s\n", ok ? "OK" : "DIFF", name); std::fflush(stdout);
}
static Worker worker(HMODULE dll) {
    auto* base = reinterpret_cast<u8*>(dll);
    const auto* dos = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER*>(base);
    const auto* nt = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS*>(base + dos->e_lfanew);
    const auto* sections = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++i) {
        if (sections[i].Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE) continue;
        for (unsigned j = 0; j + 48 <= sections[i].Misc.VirtualSize; j += 4) {
            auto* p = base + sections[i].VirtualAddress + j;
            if (*reinterpret_cast<u32*>(p+4) == k_unModuleId && *reinterpret_cast<u32*>(p+8) == 1) {
                auto fn = *reinterpret_cast<Worker*>(p+12);
                if (reinterpret_cast<u8*>(fn) >= base && reinterpret_cast<u8*>(fn) < base + nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage) return fn;
            }
        }
    }
    return nullptr;
}
static std::vector<u8> tlv(u8 tag, const std::vector<u8>& body) {
    std::vector<u8> result{tag};
    if (body.size()<128) result.push_back(static_cast<u8>(body.size()));
    else if (body.size()<256) { result.push_back(0x81); result.push_back(static_cast<u8>(body.size())); }
    else { result.push_back(0x82); result.push_back(static_cast<u8>(body.size()>>8)); result.push_back(static_cast<u8>(body.size())); }
    result.insert(result.end(),body.begin(),body.end()); return result;
}
static void append(std::vector<u8>& a, const std::vector<u8>& b) { a.insert(a.end(),b.begin(),b.end()); }
static std::vector<u8> packed(const std::vector<u8>& mod, const std::vector<u8>& exp) {
    auto inner = tlv(2,{0}); append(inner,tlv(2,mod)); append(inner,tlv(2,{3})); append(inner,tlv(2,exp));
    std::vector<u8> outer{2,1,0,0x30,0x0D,6,9,0x2A,0x86,0x48,0x86,0xF7,0x0D,1,1,1,5,0};
    append(outer,tlv(4,tlv(0x30,inner))); return tlv(0x30,outer);
}
static void __cdecl callback(ModuleSession_t* session, u32* pointer, Report_t* out) {
    std::memcpy(out->m_rgubReserved,session,sizeof(*session));
    std::memcpy(out->m_rgubReserved+sizeof(*session),pointer,4);
    *pointer = 0x1234ABCD;
    out->m_rgubReserved[sizeof(*session)+4] = 0x5A;
}
static bool initOriginal(HMODULE dll) {
    auto fn = reinterpret_cast<u8*>(dll)+0x35CE;
    Input_t input{}; std::memcpy(input.m_rgubBootstrap,seed,32);
    auto p = &input;
    bool ok;
    __asm { mov ecx,p
            call fn
            mov ok,al }
    return ok;
}
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    std::puts("executor parity runner starting"); std::fflush(stdout);
    AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1,exceptionLog);
    if (argc!=4) return 2;
    // Keep the SDK's library set loaded on both sides. Otherwise loader holes
    // can change VirtualAlloc's returned address between sequential calls.
    for (const char* name : {"advapi32.dll","crypt32.dll","version.dll","psapi.dll",
                            "wintrust.dll","setupapi.dll","secur32.dll","userenv.dll",
                            "iphlpapi.dll","dbghelp.dll"}) LoadLibraryA(name);
    std::ifstream inputFile(argv[3],std::ios::binary);
    inputFile.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(seed),32);
    if (!inputFile) return 3;
    HMODULE original=LoadLibraryA(argv[1]);
    std::printf("original=%p\n",original); std::fflush(stdout);
    HMODULE rebuild=LoadLibraryA(argv[2]);
    std::printf("rebuild=%p\n",rebuild); std::fflush(stdout);
    if (!original || !rebuild) { std::printf("load error %lu\n",GetLastError()); return 4; }
    Worker oldWorker=worker(original), newWorker=worker(rebuild);
    std::printf("workers %p %p\n",oldWorker,newWorker); std::fflush(stdout);
    if (!oldWorker || !newWorker) return 5;
    auto oldPacker=reinterpret_cast<Packer>(reinterpret_cast<u8*>(original)+0x2435);
    auto cleanup=reinterpret_cast<void(__cdecl*)()>(reinterpret_cast<u8*>(original)+0x368E);
    auto* stubPage=static_cast<u8*>(VirtualAlloc(nullptr,4096,MEM_RESERVE|MEM_COMMIT,PAGE_READWRITE));
    if (!stubPage) return 6;
    // __cdecl stub: write a fixed marker to output.m_rgubReserved and return.
    const u8 stub[]={0x8B,0x44,0x24,0x0C,0xC7,0x40,0x30,0x5A,0x5A,0xA5,0xA5,0xC3};
    std::memcpy(stubPage+32,stub,sizeof(stub));
    auto runWorker=[&](const char* name, u32 flags, u32 allocSize, u32 cap,
                       const std::vector<u8>& blob, bool useCallback=false) {
        Input_t initial{}; std::memcpy(initial.m_rgubBootstrap,seed,32);
        initial.m_eFlags=static_cast<EPayloadFlags>(flags); initial.m_cubAllocation=allocSize;
        initial.m_unDataPointer=static_cast<u32>(reinterpret_cast<uptr>(useCallback ? reinterpret_cast<void*>(callback) : scratch));
        const bool stubCall = (flags & static_cast<u32>(EPayloadFlags::Call)) && !useCallback;
        if (stubCall) { initial.m_unDataPointer=static_cast<u32>(reinterpret_cast<uptr>(stubPage)); initial.m_ibEntry=32; }
        initial.m_cubPacked=static_cast<u32>(blob.size());
        if (blob.size()>100) return;
        std::memcpy(initial.m_rgubPackedBlob,blob.data(),blob.size());
        Input_t a=initial,b=initial;
        std::array<u8,8192> left{},right{};
        u32 sa=cap,sb=cap;
        std::memset(scratch,0xA5,sizeof(scratch));
        if (stubCall) { DWORD old; VirtualProtect(stubPage,4096,PAGE_READWRITE,&old); }
        int ra=oldWorker(reinterpret_cast<u8*>(&a),left.data(),&sa);
        if (cap>=0xFD0) {
            auto& out=*reinterpret_cast<Report_t*>(left.data());
            if (out.m_unAllocatedMemory) VirtualFree(reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uptr>(out.m_unAllocatedMemory)),0,MEM_RELEASE);
        }
        std::memset(scratch,0xA5,sizeof(scratch));
        if (stubCall) { DWORD old; VirtualProtect(stubPage,4096,PAGE_READWRITE,&old); }
        int rb=newWorker(reinterpret_cast<u8*>(&b),right.data(),&sb);
        if (cap>=0xFD0) {
            auto& out=*reinterpret_cast<Report_t*>(right.data());
            if (out.m_unAllocatedMemory) VirtualFree(reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<uptr>(out.m_unAllocatedMemory)),0,MEM_RELEASE);
        }
        bool ok=ra==rb && sa==sb && left==right && std::memcmp(&a,&b,sizeof(a))==0;
        if (!ok) {
            std::printf("ret=%d/%d size=%u/%u\n",ra,rb,sa,sb);
            unsigned shown=0;
            for (unsigned i=0;i<4096 && shown<16;++i) if(left[i]!=right[i]) {
                std::printf("  +%x %02x/%02x\n",i,left[i],right[i]); ++shown;
            }
        }
        check(name,ok);
    };
    // Warm both import resolvers before comparing address-bearing allocations.
    runWorker("noop",0,0,4096,{});
    for (u32 cap : {0u,0xFCFu,0xFD0u,4096u,8192u}) runWorker(("capacity_"+std::to_string(cap)).c_str(),0,0,cap,{});
    for (u32 flags : {1u,0x80u,0xFFFFFF81u,4u,16u,64u,4u|16u,4u|64u})
        runWorker(("flags_"+std::to_string(flags)).c_str(),flags,0,4096,{});
    for (u32 size : {0u,1u,4096u,0x4000u,0xFFFFFFFFu})
        runWorker(("allocate_"+std::to_string(size)).c_str(),2,size,4096,{});
    for (u32 flags : {2u|16u,2u|64u,2u|16u|64u,2u|4u,2u|4u|16u})
        runWorker(("combined_"+std::to_string(flags)).c_str(),flags,4096,4096,{});
    runWorker("callback_session",4|32,0,4096,{},true);
    runWorker("protect_and_call_stub",4|16|32,4096,4096,{});
    runWorker("protect_call_failed_release",4|16|32|64,4096,4096,{});
    for (auto bytes : {std::vector<u8>{},std::vector<u8>{0},std::vector<u8>{0x30,0},
                       std::vector<u8>{0x30,0x80},std::vector<u8>{0x30,0x82,0xFF,0xFF}})
        runWorker(("worker_bad_blob_"+std::to_string(bytes.size())+"_"+std::to_string(cases)).c_str(),8,0,4096,bytes);
    for (u8 n : {u8(1),u8(2),u8(3),u8(17),u8(251)})
        runWorker(("worker_rsa_"+std::to_string(n)).c_str(),4|8,4096,4096,packed({n},{3}));

    auto runPacker=[&](const std::string& name,const std::vector<u8>& blob,u32 cap) {
        if (!initOriginal(original)) { check("original bootstrap",false); return; }
        std::array<u8,2048> a,b; a.fill(0xA5); b.fill(0xA5);
        u32 sa=cap,sb=cap,ea=0x77777777,eb=ea;
        bool ra=oldPacker(blob.data(),static_cast<u32>(blob.size()),a.data(),&sa,&ea);
        cleanup();
        bool rb=DecryptPayload(blob.data(),static_cast<u32>(blob.size()),b.data(),&sb,&eb);
        if (ra!=rb || sa!=sb || ea!=eb || a!=b)
            std::printf("packer ret=%d/%d size=%u/%u err=%u/%u\n",ra,rb,sa,sb,ea,eb);
        check(name.c_str(),ra==rb && sa==sb && ea==eb && a==b);
    };
    for (u8 n : {u8(0),u8(1),u8(2),u8(3),u8(17),u8(251)})
        for (u8 d : {u8(0),u8(1),u8(3),u8(17)})
            for (u32 cap : {0u,1u,16u})
                runPacker("rsa_"+std::to_string(n)+"_"+std::to_string(d)+"_"+std::to_string(cap),packed({n},{d}),cap);
    auto good=packed({0,0x80,1},{1,0,1});
    for (unsigned length=0;length<good.size();++length)
        runPacker("truncated_"+std::to_string(length),std::vector<u8>(good.begin(),good.begin()+length),16);
    for (unsigned pos=0;pos<good.size();++pos) {
        auto bad=good; bad[pos]^=0x80;
        runPacker("mutated_"+std::to_string(pos),bad,16);
    }
    std::vector<u8> huge(1025,0); huge[0]=1;
    runPacker("modulus_8193_bits",packed(huge,{1}),16);
    VirtualFree(stubPage,0,MEM_RELEASE);
    std::printf("RESULT %u cases, %u failures\n",cases,failures);
    return failures ? 1 : 0;
}
```

```cpp
{

int RunFileIdentity( FileInput_t &input, FileReport_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	if ( *pcubOutput < offsetof( FileReport_t, m_rgubUnused2 ) )
		return 4;

	*pcubOutput = k_cubReport;
	memset( &report, 0, k_cubReport );
	memset( &report.m_eOpenStatus, 0,
	        offsetof( FileReport_t, m_rgubUnused2 ) - offsetof( FileReport_t, m_eOpenStatus ) );

	if ( !bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
	{
		report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
		return 0;
	}

	wchar_t wszPath[k_cPathChars];
	g_pImports->MultiByteToWideChar( CP_UTF8, 0, input.m_szPath, -1, wszPath, k_cPathChars );

	PeFile_t file;
	InitPeFile( file );

	const u32 cchPath = BoundedPathLength( input.m_szPath );
	if ( static_cast<i32>( cchPath ) > 0 )
	{
		util::CopyA( report.m_szPath, input.m_szPath, sizeof( report.m_szPath ) );

		const EScanStatus eOpenStatus = OpenPeFile( file, wszPath );
		report.m_eOpenStatus = eOpenStatus;
		if ( eOpenStatus != EScanStatus::Ok )
		{
			report.m_unOpenError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
		}
		else
		{
			report.m_cubFile = vac::file::GetFileSizeOrZero( g_pImports, file.m_hFile );
			report.m_ePeStatus = ParsePeFile( file );
			ResetPeFile( file );
		}

		if ( !QueryFileIdentity( wszPath, false, &report.m_unVolume, &report.m_FileId ) )
			report.m_unIdentityError = g_pImports->GetLastError();

		// @note / sapdragon: this cuts the utf-8 input but keeps querying the wide copy from above, so every
		// ancestor gets the id of the full path. looks wrong, it is what the original does
		char *const pszStart = input.m_szPath;
		char *pszChar = pszStart + cchPath - 1;
		u32 cAncestors = 0;
		while ( pszChar > pszStart )
		{
			if ( cAncestors > ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgAncestors ) - 1 )
				break;

			while ( *pszChar != '\\' )
			{
				--pszChar;
				if ( pszChar <= pszStart )
					break;
			}
			if ( pszChar <= pszStart )
				break;

			if ( *pszChar == '\\' )
			{
				u32 unVolume = 0;
				FileId_t fileId{};
				pszChar[1] = 0;
				QueryFileIdentity( wszPath, true, &unVolume, &fileId );
				report.m_rgAncestors[cAncestors] = fileId;
				++cAncestors;
				--pszChar;
			}
		}
	}

	ResetPeFile( file );
	ClosePeFile( file );
	return 0;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 E4 ? B8 ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? 8B 45 ? 53 BB
int RunDirectoryInventory( const DirectoryInput_t &input, DirectoryReport_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	if ( *pcubOutput < sizeof( DirectoryReport_t ) )
		return 4;

	*pcubOutput = k_cubReport;
	memset( &report, 0, k_cubReport );
	memset( &report, 0, k_cubReport );
	report.m_unMagic = k_unDirectoryMagic;
	report.m_unVersion = 2;

	if ( !bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
	{
		report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
		return 0;
	}

	wchar_t wszPath[MAX_PATH];
	const wchar_t *pwszPath = wszPath;
	const u32 unVolume = input.m_unVolume;
	const FileId_t fileId = input.m_FileId;
	const u32 unIncludeMask = input.m_unIncludeMask;
	const u32 unExcludeMask = input.m_unExcludeMask;
	DWORD cProfileChars = MAX_PATH;
	g_pImports->MultiByteToWideChar( CP_UTF8, 0, input.m_szPath, -1, wszPath, ARRAYSIZE( wszPath ) );
	report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::Ok;

	wchar_t wszProfile[MAX_PATH];
	if ( !wszPath[0] && !( fileId.m_unHigh | fileId.m_unLow ) && !unVolume )
	{
		ProcessCapture_t capture;
		InitProcessCapture( capture );

		u32 unFoundPid = 0;
		u32 cFound = 0;
		FindProfileProcess( &unFoundPid, &cFound );

		const u32 unProfilePid = cFound == 1 ? unFoundPid : g_pImports->GetCurrentProcessId();
		report.m_unProfilePid = unProfilePid;

		bool bFailedOpen = false;
		const HANDLE hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, unProfilePid );
		if ( hProcess == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		{
			report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::ProcessReopenFailed;
			bFailedOpen = true;
		}
		else
		{
			// @note / sapdragon: neither this token nor the process handle is ever closed. a leak in the original, keep it
			HANDLE hToken = nullptr;
			wszProfile[0] = 0;
			if ( g_pImports->OpenProcessToken( hProcess, TOKEN_QUERY, &hToken ) )
			{
				if ( g_pImports->GetUserProfileDirectoryW )
				{
					if ( g_pImports->GetUserProfileDirectoryW( hToken, wszProfile, &cProfileChars ) )
					{
						report.m_cProfileChars = cProfileChars;
						pwszPath = cProfileChars - 1 <= MAX_PATH - 2 ? wszProfile : wszPath;
					}
					else
					{
						report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::TokenFailed;
						report.m_unInfoError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					// @note / sapdragon: valve reuses the no file code for the missing import
					report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::NoFile;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::TokenFailed;
				bFailedOpen = true;
			}
		}

		if ( bFailedOpen )
			report.m_unOpenError = g_pImports->GetLastError();

		if ( wszProfile[0] )
		{
			report.m_unProfileHash =
			    util::hashing::PathHashBytes( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( wszProfile ), cProfileChars );

			const wchar_t *pwszName = util::wstr::BaseName( wszProfile );
			if ( pwszName )
			{
				char szName[264];
				util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, pwszName, szName, MAX_PATH );
				report.m_unProfileNameHash =
				    util::hashing::PathHashBytes( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( szName ), util::StrLenA( szName ) );
			}
		}

		FreeProcessCapture( capture );
	}

	if ( report.m_eStatus == EScanStatus::Ok )
	{
		report.m_unReserved = 0;

		const u16 unScanStatus =
		    EnumerateDirectory( report, unIncludeMask, unExcludeMask, pwszPath, unVolume, fileId, 0 );
		report.m_unScanStatus = unScanStatus;
		report.m_cSkippedInRoot = report.m_cSkipped;
		if ( unScanStatus )
			report.m_unOpenError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
		else
			ExpandDirectories( report, unIncludeMask, unExcludeMask );
	}

	return 0;
}
```

```cpp
// @binary: a8848995
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/vac_util.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "file/file.hpp"
#include "util/encoding.hpp"
#include "util/hashing.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::process_file_identity
{

namespace
{

constexpr u32 k_cubDirectoryBuffer = 0x40000;

// @orig: 53 55 8B E9 56 57 8B 7D
EEntryFlags ClassifyEntry( const FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFO &entry, u32 unNowHigh ) noexcept
{
	const u32 unAttributes = entry.FileAttributes;
	EEntryFlags eFlags = ( unAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY ) ? EEntryFlags::Directory : EEntryFlags::None;
	if ( unAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY )
		eFlags |= EEntryFlags::ReadOnly;
	if ( unAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN )
		eFlags |= EEntryFlags::Hidden;
	if ( unAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SYSTEM )
		eFlags |= EEntryFlags::System;
	if ( unAttributes & ~static_cast<u32>( FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY | FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN | FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SYSTEM |
	                                       FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY ) )
		eFlags |= EEntryFlags::OtherAttributes;

	if ( entry.AllocationSize.HighPart > 0 || entry.AllocationSize.LowPart > 0x1000000 )
		eFlags |= EEntryFlags::Large;
	else if ( !entry.AllocationSize.LowPart )
		eFlags |= EEntryFlags::Empty;
	else if ( entry.AllocationSize.LowPart < 0x1000 )
		eFlags |= EEntryFlags::Small;

	if ( entry.LastWriteTime.QuadPart == entry.CreationTime.QuadPart )
		eFlags |= EEntryFlags::NeverWritten;

	const u32 unCreationHigh = static_cast<u32>( entry.CreationTime.HighPart );
	if ( unCreationHigh <= unNowHigh )
	{
		const u32 unAge = unNowHigh - unCreationHigh;
		if ( unAge < 0x10 )
			eFlags |= EEntryFlags::AgeTier0;
		if ( unAge < 0x191 )
			eFlags |= EEntryFlags::AgeTier1;
		if ( unAge < 0xAFD )
			eFlags |= EEntryFlags::AgeTier2;
		if ( unAge < 0x2F17 )
			eFlags |= EEntryFlags::AgeTier3;
	}
	return eFlags;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 83 4C 24
u16 EnumerateDirectory( DirectoryReport_t &report, u32 unIncludeMask, u32 unExcludeMask, const wchar_t *pwszPath,
                        u32 unVolume, FileId_t fileId, u8 iParent ) noexcept
{
	if ( !g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandleEx )
		return static_cast<u16>( EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed );

	FILETIME now;
	g_pImports->GetSystemTimeAsFileTime( &now );

	HANDLE hDirectory = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
	if ( unVolume && ( fileId.m_unLow || fileId.m_unHigh ) )
	{
		u32 unLastError = 0;
		const u64 ulFileId = ( static_cast<u64>( fileId.m_unHigh ) << 32 ) | fileId.m_unLow;
		static_cast<void>(
		    file::OpenByVolumeAndId( g_pImports, unVolume, ulFileId, FILE_GENERIC_READ, &hDirectory, &unLastError ) );
	}
	else
	{
		if ( !pwszPath || !*pwszPath )
			return static_cast<u16>( EScanStatus::OpenFailed );

		// @note / sapdragon: the template handle really is INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE in the original
		hDirectory =
		    g_pImports->CreateFileW( pwszPath, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
		                             nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE );
	}
	if ( hDirectory == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return static_cast<u16>( EScanStatus::OpenFailed );

	// @note / sapdragon: leaves the directory open on failure. same as the original
	auto *pubBuffer = static_cast<u8 *>( util::HeapAlloc( k_cubDirectoryBuffer ) );
	if ( !pubBuffer )
		return static_cast<u16>( EScanStatus::OutOfMemory );

	wchar_t wszName[1024];
	char szName[1024];
	BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION info;

	for ( ;; )
	{
		if ( !g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle( hDirectory, &info ) )
		{
			report.m_unInfoError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
			break;
		}

		if ( !report.m_unVolume )
		{
			report.m_unVolume = info.dwVolumeSerialNumber;
			report.m_RootId.m_unLow = info.nFileIndexLow;
			report.m_RootId.m_unHigh = info.nFileIndexHigh;
		}
		if ( report.m_unVolume != info.dwVolumeSerialNumber )
		{
			report.m_unMismatchedVolume = info.dwVolumeSerialNumber;
			break;
		}

		memset( pubBuffer, 0, k_cubDirectoryBuffer );
		const BOOL bQueried = g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandleEx( hDirectory, FileIdBothDirectoryInfo, pubBuffer,
		                                                                k_cubDirectoryBuffer );
		if ( bQueried )
		{
			const u8 *pubEntry = pubBuffer;
			for ( ;; )
			{
				const auto &entry = *reinterpret_cast<const FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFO *>( pubEntry );
				const u32 ibNext = entry.NextEntryOffset;
				const bool bDirectory = ( entry.FileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY ) != 0;

				memset( wszName, 0, sizeof( wszName ) );
				const u32 cubNameCopied = entry.FileNameLength < sizeof( wszName ) - sizeof( wchar_t )
				                              ? entry.FileNameLength
				                              : sizeof( wszName ) - sizeof( wchar_t );
				memcpy( wszName, entry.FileName, cubNameCopied );
				util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, wszName, szName, sizeof( szName ) );

				// @note / sapdragon: an approximation of seconds since 1970. the signed shift matters for older files, keep it
				const u64 ulSinceEpoch = static_cast<u64>( entry.CreationTime.QuadPart ) + 0xFE624E212AC18000;
				const i32 nHigh = static_cast<i32>( ulSinceEpoch >> 32 );
				const u32 unCreationTime = 429 * static_cast<u32>( nHigh ) +
				                           static_cast<u32>( ulSinceEpoch ) / 10000000 + static_cast<u32>( nHigh >> 1 );

				const EEntryFlags eFlags = ClassifyEntry( entry, now.dwHighDateTime );
				const u32 cubName = entry.FileNameLength;
				EEntryFlags eTestedFlags = eFlags;

				bool bSkip = false;
				if ( unIncludeMask )
				{
					if ( !HasFlag( eFlags, static_cast<EEntryFlags>( unIncludeMask ) ) )
						bSkip = true;
					else if ( HasFlag( static_cast<EEntryFlags>( unIncludeMask ), EEntryFlags::Directory ) )
						eTestedFlags = eFlags & static_cast<EEntryFlags>( ~static_cast<u16>( EEntryFlags::Empty ) );
				}

				if ( !bSkip )
				{
					if ( unExcludeMask && HasFlag( eTestedFlags, static_cast<EEntryFlags>( unExcludeMask ) ) )
						bSkip = true;
					else if ( bDirectory && ( ( cubName == 2 && wszName[0] == L'.' ) ||
					                          ( cubName == 4 && wszName[0] == L'.' && wszName[1] == L'.' ) ) )
						bSkip = true;
				}

				if ( bSkip )
				{
					++report.m_cSkipped;
				}
				else
				{
					DirectoryRecord_t &record = report.m_rgRecords[report.m_cRecords];
					record.m_FileId.m_unLow = static_cast<u32>( entry.FileId.LowPart );
					record.m_FileId.m_unHigh = static_cast<u32>( entry.FileId.HighPart );
					record.m_unNameHash =
					    util::hashing::PathHashBytes( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( szName ), cubNameCopied / 2 );
					record.m_eFlags = eFlags;
					record.m_iParent = iParent;
					record.m_unCreationTime = unCreationTime;
					if ( bDirectory )
					{
						++report.m_cDirectories;
						record.m_iDirectory = static_cast<u8>( report.m_cDirectories );
					}
					else
					{
						record.m_iDirectory = 0;
					}

					if ( ++report.m_cRecords >= ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgRecords ) )
						break;
				}

				pubEntry += ibNext;
				if ( !ibNext )
					break;
			}
		}

		if ( report.m_cRecords >= ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgRecords ) || !bQueried )
			break;
	}

	util::HeapFree( pubBuffer );
	g_pImports->CloseHandle( hDirectory );
	return 0;
}

// @orig: 51 53 55 56 8B F1 33 DB
void ExpandDirectories( DirectoryReport_t &report, u32 unIncludeMask, u32 unExcludeMask ) noexcept
{
	if ( report.m_cRecords >= ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgRecords ) )
		return;

	for ( u32 iRecord = 0; iRecord < report.m_cRecords; ++iRecord )
	{
		const DirectoryRecord_t &record = report.m_rgRecords[iRecord];
		if ( HasFlag( record.m_eFlags, EEntryFlags::Directory ) )
		{
			++report.m_cExpanded;
			report.m_iExpanded = static_cast<u16>( iRecord );

			const u16 unStatus = EnumerateDirectory( report, unIncludeMask, unExcludeMask, nullptr, report.m_unVolume,
			                                         record.m_FileId, record.m_iDirectory );
			report.m_unExpandStatus = unStatus;
			if ( unStatus )
			{
				report.m_unOpenError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
				return;
			}
		}

		if ( report.m_cRecords >= ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgRecords ) )
			return;
	}
}
```

```cpp
constexpr const wchar_t *k_rgpwszVersionFields[] = {
    L"FileDescription", L"ProductName",     L"InternalName", L"Comments",    L"LegalCopyright",   L"CompanyName",
    L"ProductVersion",  L"LegalTrademarks", L"PrivateBuild", L"FileVersion", L"OriginalFilename", L"SpecialBuild" };

// @orig: FF 74 24 ? 52
int CompareNoCaseN( const wchar_t *pwszA, const wchar_t *pwszB, int cChars ) noexcept
{
	return CompareStringW( LOCALE_SYSTEM_DEFAULT, NORM_IGNORECASE, pwszA, cChars, pwszB, cChars ) - CSTR_EQUAL;
}

// @note / sapdragon: wcsncpy with its usual traps. always reads cChars from the source and does not terminate
// when the source fills it
// @orig: 53 56 57 8B 7C 24 ? 8B F2
void CopyWideFixed( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc, u32 cChars ) noexcept
{
	memcpy( pwszDst, pwszSrc, cChars * sizeof( wchar_t ) );

	const u32 cSource = lstrlenW( pwszSrc );
	if ( cChars > cSource )
		memset( pwszDst + cSource, 0, ( cChars - cSource ) * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
}

// @orig: 53 55 56 8B 35
void CatWideBounded( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc, u32 cMaxChars ) noexcept
{
	const u32 cDst = lstrlenW( pwszDst );
	u32 cSrc = lstrlenW( pwszSrc );
	if ( cSrc > cMaxChars )
		cSrc = cMaxChars;

	memcpy( pwszDst + cDst, pwszSrc, cSrc * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
	pwszDst[cSrc + cDst] = 0;
}

// @orig: 52 85 C9 74
void *ReallocateHeap( void *pMemory, usize cubSize ) noexcept
{
	if ( pMemory )
		return ::HeapReAlloc( ::GetProcessHeap(), 0, pMemory, cubSize );
	return ::HeapAlloc( ::GetProcessHeap(), 0, cubSize );
}

// @orig: 51 33 D2 56 BE
u32 BoundedPathLength( const char *pszPath ) noexcept
{
	u32 cChars = 0;
	while ( pszPath[cChars] && cChars < sizeof( FileInput_t::m_szPath ) )
		++cChars;
	return cChars;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 33 C0
bool NtDeviceToDosPath( wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	wchar_t wszDrives[MAX_PATH];
	wszDrives[0] = 0;
	if ( !g_pImports->GetLogicalDriveStringsW( 250, wszDrives ) )
		return false;

	wchar_t wszResult[MAX_PATH];
	wchar_t wszDevice[MAX_PATH];
	wchar_t wszDrive[] = L"C:";
	const wchar_t *pwchDrive = wszDrives;
	wchar_t wchDrive = wszDrives[0];
	u32 cDeviceChars;
	for ( ;; )
	{
		wszDrive[0] = wchDrive;
		if ( g_pImports->QueryDosDeviceW( wszDrive, wszDevice, ARRAYSIZE( wszDevice ) ) )
		{
			cDeviceChars = lstrlenW( wszDevice );
			if ( cDeviceChars < ARRAYSIZE( wszDevice ) && !CompareNoCaseN( pwszPath, wszDevice, cDeviceChars ) )
				break;
		}

		while ( *pwchDrive++ )
			;
		wchDrive = *pwchDrive;
		if ( !wchDrive )
			return false;
	}

	// @note / sapdragon: no bound on the result, a path past the buffer runs over the stack. valve's bug, keep it
	wszResult[0] = 0;
	lstrcatW( wszResult, wszDrive );
	lstrcatW( wszResult, &pwszPath[cDeviceChars] );
	CopyWideFixed( pwszPath, wszResult, k_cPathChars );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 8D 44 24
u32 CollectVersionStrings( const wchar_t *pwszPath, char *pszOutput ) noexcept
{
	DWORD unHandle = 0;
	const DWORD cubVersion = g_pImports->GetFileVersionInfoSizeW( pwszPath, &unHandle );
	if ( !cubVersion )
		return 0;

	void *pVersion = util::HeapAlloc( cubVersion );
	if ( !pVersion )
		return 0;

	u32 cubLeft = sizeof( ProcessReport_t::m_szVersionStrings );
	u32 cubWritten = 0;
	if ( g_pImports->GetFileVersionInfoW( pwszPath, 0, cubVersion, pVersion ) )
	{
		void *pRoot = nullptr;
		UINT cubRoot = 0;
		if ( g_pImports->VerQueryValueW( pVersion, L"\\", &pRoot, &cubRoot ) )
		{
			void *pTranslations = nullptr;
			UINT cubTranslations = 0;
			if ( g_pImports->VerQueryValueW( pVersion, L"\\VarFileInfo\\Translation", &pTranslations,
			                                 &cubTranslations ) )
			{
				const auto *punTranslations = static_cast<const u16 *>( pTranslations );
				for ( u32 iTranslation = 0; iTranslation < cubTranslations >> 2; ++iTranslation )
				{
					for ( const wchar_t *pwszField : k_rgpwszVersionFields )
					{
						wchar_t wszQuery[200];
						wsprintfW( wszQuery, L"\\StringFileInfo\\%04x%04x\\%s", punTranslations[iTranslation * 2],
						           punTranslations[iTranslation * 2 + 1], pwszField );

						void *pValue = nullptr;
						UINT cValueChars = 0;
						const BOOL bFound = g_pImports->VerQueryValueW( pVersion, wszQuery, &pValue, &cValueChars );

						// @note / sapdragon: the value goes into the query buffer unchecked, so a long version string
						// runs over the stack. valve's bug, keep it
						memcpy( wszQuery, pValue, cValueChars * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
						wszQuery[cValueChars] = 0;
						lstrcatW( wszQuery, L" " );

						if ( bFound && cubLeft > cValueChars + 1 )
						{
							// @note / sapdragon: the capacity is the char count, not the bytes left. utf-8 text gets cut
							util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, wszQuery, pszOutput, cValueChars );

							const u32 cubString = util::StrLenA( pszOutput ) + 1;
							cubLeft -= cubString;
							cubWritten += cubString;
							pszOutput += cubString;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	util::HeapFree( pVersion );
	return cubWritten;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 8A DA
bool QueryFileIdentity( const wchar_t *pwszPath, bool bDirectory, u32 *punVolume, FileId_t *pFileId ) noexcept
{
	if ( !g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle )
		return false;

	const HANDLE hFile =
	    g_pImports->CreateFileW( pwszPath, FILE_GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
	                             bDirectory ? FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS : FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
	if ( hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return false;

	if ( bDirectory )
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: leaves the handle open when the import is missing. same as the original
		if ( !g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandleEx )
			return false;

		alignas( FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFO ) u8 rgubInfo[132];
		memset( rgubInfo, 0, sizeof( rgubInfo ) );
		const BOOL bQueried =
		    g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandleEx( hFile, FileIdBothDirectoryInfo, rgubInfo, sizeof( rgubInfo ) );

		*punVolume = 0;
		if ( bQueried && g_pImports->GetVolumeInformationByHandleW )
			g_pImports->GetVolumeInformationByHandleW( hFile, nullptr, 0, reinterpret_cast<LPDWORD>( punVolume ),
			                                           nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, 0 );

		g_pImports->CloseHandle( hFile );
		if ( !bQueried )
		{
			g_pImports->GetLastError();
			return false;
		}

		memcpy( pFileId, &reinterpret_cast<const FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFO *>( rgubInfo )->FileId, sizeof( *pFileId ) );
	}
	else
	{
		BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION info;
		const BOOL bQueried = g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle( hFile, &info );
		g_pImports->CloseHandle( hFile );
		if ( !bQueried )
			return false;

		*punVolume = info.dwVolumeSerialNumber;
		pFileId->m_unLow = info.nFileIndexLow;
		pFileId->m_unHigh = info.nFileIndexHigh;
	}

	return true;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::process_file_identity
```

```cpp
constexpr u32 k_cubReadLimit = 0x1000;
constexpr u32 k_unRsdsSignature = 0x53445352;

enum class EVisitorState : i32
{
	Root = 0,
	TypeDirectory = 1,
	NameDirectory = 2,
	Done = 3,
};

struct RsdsHeader_t
{
	u32 m_unSignature;
	u8 m_rgubGuid[16];
	u32 m_unAge;
};
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( RsdsHeader_t, 24 );

// @note / sapdragon: the original context can also run a checksum, only md5 is ever selected in this binary
struct HashContext_t
{
	crypto::hash::Md5_t m_Md5;
	u8 m_rgubDigest[crypto::hash::k_cubMd5Digest];
	u32 m_cubHashed;
};

struct ResourceEntry_t
{
	u32 m_unName;
	u32 m_unOffset;
};
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( ResourceEntry_t, 8 );

#pragma pack( push, 1 )
struct GroupIconEntry_t
{
	u8 m_unWidth;
	u8 m_unHeight;
	u8 m_rgubUnused[10];
	u16 m_unId;
};
VAC_LAYOUT( GroupIconEntry_t, m_unId, 12 );
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( GroupIconEntry_t, 14 );

struct GroupIconDirectory_t
{
	u16 m_unReserved;
	u16 m_unType;
	u16 m_cEntries;
	GroupIconEntry_t m_rgEntries[1];
};
VAC_LAYOUT( GroupIconDirectory_t, m_rgEntries, 6 );
#pragma pack( pop )

// @note / sapdragon: valve's are two small classes with a vtable. no virtual here, so a table by hand
struct ResourceVisitor_t;

struct ResourceVisitorTable_t
{
	bool ( *m_pfnEnterDirectory )( ResourceVisitor_t &visitor, const ResourceEntry_t &entry ) noexcept;
	void ( *m_pfnVisitData )( ResourceVisitor_t &visitor, const u8 *pubData, u32 cubData ) noexcept;
	void ( *m_pfnLeaveDirectory )( ResourceVisitor_t &visitor ) noexcept;
};

struct ResourceVisitor_t
{
	const ResourceVisitorTable_t *m_pTable;
	EVisitorState m_eState;
	u32 m_unIconId;
	HashContext_t m_Hash;
};

// @orig: E8 ? ? ? ? 33 C0 6A
void ResetHash( HashContext_t &hash ) noexcept
{
	hash.m_Md5.Init();
	hash.m_cubHashed = 0;
	memset( hash.m_rgubDigest, 0, sizeof( hash.m_rgubDigest ) );
}

// @orig: 51 56 8B F1 57 8B 7C 24
void UpdateHash( HashContext_t &hash, const void *pData, u32 cubData ) noexcept
{
	hash.m_cubHashed += cubData;
	hash.m_Md5.Update( static_cast<const u8 *>( pData ), cubData );
}

const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &GetDirectory( const PeFile_t &file, u32 iDirectory ) noexcept
{
	const void *pOptionalHeader = file.m_bPe64 ? static_cast<const void *>( &file.m_OptionalHeader64 )
	                                           : static_cast<const void *>( &file.m_OptionalHeader32 );
	return *pe::GetDataDirectory( pOptionalHeader, file.m_bPe64 != 0, iDirectory );
}

bool IsPeFileOpen( const PeFile_t &file ) noexcept
{
	return file.m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
}

// @orig: 8B 81 ? ? ? ? 0B 81 ? ? ? ? 74 ? 8B 81
void SetReadRange( PeFile_t &file, u32 unStart, u32 unEnd ) noexcept
{
	if ( file.m_ulMappedBase && ( !file.m_hProcess || file.m_hProcess == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ) )
	{
		file.m_ulRangeStart = unStart;
		file.m_ulRangeEnd = unEnd;
	}
}

// @orig: 51 51 53 55 8B 6C 24
u8 *ReadWindow( PeFile_t &file, u32 cubRead ) noexcept
{
	if ( cubRead > k_cubReadLimit )
		return nullptr;

	if ( file.m_ibCursor + cubRead >= file.m_cubWindow )
	{
		u32 ibFill = 0;
		u32 cubFill;
		if ( file.m_ibCursor + cubRead == file.m_cubWindow )
		{
			if ( file.m_cubWindow == sizeof( file.m_rgubWindow ) )
			{
				memcpy( file.m_rgubWindow, file.m_rgubWindow + k_cubReadLimit, k_cubReadLimit );
				ibFill = k_cubReadLimit;
				file.m_ulWindowBase += k_cubReadLimit;
				file.m_ibCursor -= k_cubReadLimit;
			}
			cubFill = ibFill;
		}
		else if ( !file.m_cubWindow )
		{
			cubFill = sizeof( file.m_rgubWindow );
		}
		else
		{
			if ( file.m_cubWindow < sizeof( file.m_rgubWindow ) )
				return nullptr;

			memcpy( file.m_rgubWindow, file.m_rgubWindow + k_cubReadLimit, k_cubReadLimit );
			ibFill = k_cubReadLimit;
			cubFill = k_cubReadLimit;
			file.m_ulWindowBase += k_cubReadLimit;
			file.m_ibCursor -= k_cubReadLimit;
		}

		if ( cubFill )
		{
			u32 cubFilled;
			if ( IsPeFileOpen( file ) )
			{
				DWORD cubGot = 0;
				g_pImports->ReadFile( file.m_hFile, file.m_rgubWindow + ibFill, cubFill, &cubGot, nullptr );
				cubFilled = cubGot;
			}
			else
			{
				// @note / sapdragon: reading a closed file falls through to the memory path. nothing maps an image in
				// this binary, so this faults on the unset base. same in the original
				const u32 unWindowBase = static_cast<u32>( file.m_ulWindowBase );
				const u32 unStart = unWindowBase + ibFill;
				if ( file.m_ulRangeEnd || file.m_ulRangeStart )
				{
					if ( unStart >= file.m_ulRangeStart )
					{
						if ( static_cast<u64>( unStart + cubFill ) > file.m_ulRangeEnd )
							cubFill = static_cast<u32>( file.m_ulRangeEnd ) - unStart;
					}
					else
					{
						cubFill = 0;
					}
				}
				const uptr unSource = ibFill + unWindowBase + static_cast<u32>( file.m_ulMappedBase );
				memcpy( file.m_rgubWindow + ibFill, reinterpret_cast<const void *>( unSource ), cubFill );
				cubFilled = cubFill;
			}
			file.m_cubWindow = cubFilled + ibFill;
		}

		if ( file.m_ibCursor + cubRead > file.m_cubWindow )
			return nullptr;
	}

	u8 *pubResult = file.m_rgubWindow + file.m_ibCursor;
	file.m_ibCursor += cubRead;
	return pubResult;
}

// @orig: 51 51 55 56 33 F6
bool ReadBytes( PeFile_t &file, void *pOutput, u32 cubOutput ) noexcept
{
	u32 ibOutput = 0;
	while ( ibOutput != cubOutput )
	{
		const u32 cubChunk = cubOutput - ibOutput > k_cubReadLimit ? k_cubReadLimit : cubOutput - ibOutput;
		const u8 *pubChunk = ReadWindow( file, cubChunk );
		if ( !pubChunk )
			return false;

		memcpy( static_cast<u8 *>( pOutput ) + ibOutput, pubChunk, cubChunk );
		ibOutput += cubChunk;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 56 57 89 4D
bool SeekPeFile( PeFile_t &file, u32 ibOffset ) noexcept
{
	if ( file.m_ulWindowBase + file.m_ibCursor == ibOffset )
		return true;

	if ( ibOffset >= file.m_ulWindowBase && ibOffset < file.m_ulWindowBase + file.m_cubWindow )
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: a seek inside the window does not read again, so bytes patched by relocations stay
		// patched for the next digest. that is why the digests match, do not "fix" it
		file.m_ibCursor = ibOffset - static_cast<u32>( file.m_ulWindowBase );
		return true;
	}

	file.m_ibCursor = ibOffset % k_cubReadLimit;
	const u32 unWindowBase = ibOffset - file.m_ibCursor;
	file.m_ulWindowBase = unWindowBase;
	file.m_cubWindow = 0;
	if ( IsPeFileOpen( file ) &&
	     unWindowBase !=
	         g_pImports->SetFilePointer( file.m_hFile, static_cast<LONG>( unWindowBase ), nullptr, FILE_BEGIN ) )
	{
		ClosePeFile( file );
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 53 56 57 8B FA 33 C0
bool ExpandSystemPrefix( const wchar_t *pwszPath, wchar_t *pwszOutput ) noexcept
{
	static constexpr wchar_t k_wszNtPrefix[] = L"\\??\\";

	*pwszOutput = 0;

	bool bNtPrefix = true;
	for ( u32 iChar = 0; iChar < 4; ++iChar )
	{
		if ( !pwszPath[iChar] || pwszPath[iChar] != k_wszNtPrefix[iChar] )
		{
			bNtPrefix = false;
			break;
		}
	}
	if ( bNtPrefix )
	{
		CopyWideFixed( pwszOutput, pwszPath + 4, MAX_PATH );
		return true;
	}

	const wchar_t *pwszDirectory;
	u32 cPrefixChars;
	if ( !CompareNoCaseN( pwszPath, L"\\SystemRoot", 11 ) )
	{
		pwszDirectory = g_pSession->m_wszWindowsDirectory;
		cPrefixChars = 11;
	}
	else if ( !CompareNoCaseN( pwszPath, L"\\SystemDirectory", 16 ) )
	{
		pwszDirectory = g_pSession->m_wszSystemDirectory;
		cPrefixChars = 16;
	}
	else if ( !CompareNoCaseN( pwszPath, L"\\windows", 8 ) )
	{
		pwszDirectory = g_pSession->m_wszWindowsDirectory;
		cPrefixChars = 8;
	}
	else
	{
		CopyWideFixed( pwszOutput, pwszPath, MAX_PATH );
		return false;
	}

	CopyWideFixed( pwszOutput, pwszDirectory, MAX_PATH );
	CatWideBounded( pwszOutput, pwszPath + cPrefixChars, MAX_PATH - lstrlenW( pwszOutput ) );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 8B F1
bool OpenWithPrefixFallback( PeFile_t &file, const wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	ClosePeFile( file );

	file.m_hFile = g_pImports->CreateFileW( pwszPath, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
	                                        FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
	wchar_t wszExpanded[MAX_PATH];
	if ( file.m_hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && ExpandSystemPrefix( pwszPath, wszExpanded ) )
		file.m_hFile = g_pImports->CreateFileW( wszExpanded, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
		                                        FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );

	util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, pwszPath, file.m_szPath, 259 );
	return file.m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
}

// @orig: 56 33 F6 57 8B FA
int CompareN( const char *pszA, const char *pszB, u32 cChars ) noexcept
{
	for ( u32 iChar = 0; iChar < cChars; ++iChar )
	{
		const u8 unChar = static_cast<u8>( pszA[iChar] );
		if ( !unChar || unChar != static_cast<u8>( pszB[iChar] ) )
			return unChar - static_cast<u8>( pszB[iChar] );
	}
	return 0;
}

// @orig: 53 0F B7 99 ? ? ? ? 56
const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *FindOverlaySection( const PeFile_t &file ) noexcept
{
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = file.m_pSections[iSection];
		if ( !CompareN( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( section.Name ), k_szOverlaySection, IMAGE_SIZEOF_SHORT_NAME ) )
			return &section;
	}
	return nullptr;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 57 BD
EScanStatus ParseHeaders( PeFile_t &file ) noexcept
{
	SetReadRange( file, 0, k_cubReadLimit );

	if ( !ReadBytes( file, &file.m_DosHeader, sizeof( file.m_DosHeader ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	if ( file.m_DosHeader.e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;

	if ( !ReadBytes( file, file.m_rgubDosStub, sizeof( file.m_rgubDosStub ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;

	if ( !SeekPeFile( file, file.m_DosHeader.e_lfanew ) )
		return EScanStatus::SeekFailed;

	u32 unSignature;
	if ( !ReadBytes( file, &unSignature, sizeof( unSignature ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	if ( unSignature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;

	if ( !ReadBytes( file, &file.m_OriginalFileHeader, sizeof( file.m_OriginalFileHeader ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	file.m_FileHeader = file.m_OriginalFileHeader;

	if ( ( file.m_FileHeader.Machine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386 &&
	       file.m_FileHeader.Machine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64 ) ||
	     file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections > 64 )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;

	if ( file.m_FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader == sizeof( file.m_OptionalHeader64 ) )
	{
		if ( !ReadBytes( file, &file.m_OptionalHeader64, sizeof( file.m_OptionalHeader64 ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
		if ( file.m_OptionalHeader64.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC )
			return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
		file.m_bPe64 = 1;
	}
	else if ( file.m_FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader == sizeof( file.m_OptionalHeader32 ) )
	{
		if ( !ReadBytes( file, &file.m_OptionalHeader32, sizeof( file.m_OptionalHeader32 ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
		if ( file.m_OptionalHeader32.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC )
			return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
	}
	else
	{
		return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
	}

	const u32 cSections = file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
	file.m_pSections =
	    static_cast<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *>( util::HeapAlloc( sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) * cSections ) );
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		if ( !ReadBytes( file, &file.m_pSections[iSection], sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	}

	file.m_ulImageBase = file.m_bPe64 ? file.m_OptionalHeader64.ImageBase : file.m_OptionalHeader32.ImageBase;
	SetReadRange( file, 0, 0 );
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

u32 GetImageChecksum( const PeFile_t &file ) noexcept
{
	return file.m_bPe64 ? file.m_OptionalHeader64.CheckSum : file.m_OptionalHeader32.CheckSum;
}

// @orig: 51 56 8B F1 57 80 BE
bool LoadRelocations( PeFile_t &file ) noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory = GetDirectory( file, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC );
	file.m_cubRelocations = directory.Size;
	if ( !directory.Size )
		return true;

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection =
	    pe::FindSectionByRva( file.m_pSections, file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections, directory.VirtualAddress );
	u32 ibDelta = 0;
	if ( pSection && IsPeFileOpen( file ) )
		ibDelta = pSection->VirtualAddress - pSection->PointerToRawData;

	if ( !SeekPeFile( file, directory.VirtualAddress - ibDelta ) )
		return false;

	file.m_pubRelocations = static_cast<u8 *>( util::HeapAlloc( file.m_cubRelocations ) );
	return ReadBytes( file, file.m_pubRelocations, file.m_cubRelocations );
}

// @orig: 8B 81 ? ? ? ? 0B 81 ? ? ? ? 74 ? B0
bool NeedsRelocation( const PeFile_t &file ) noexcept
{
	if ( file.m_ulRelocationDelta )
		return true;
	if ( IsPeFileOpen( file ) )
		return false;
	if ( file.m_bPe64 )
		return file.m_ulMappedBase != file.m_OptionalHeader64.ImageBase;
	return file.m_ulMappedBase != file.m_OptionalHeader32.ImageBase;
}

// @orig: 51 51 8B 44 24
bool ApplyRelocations( PeFile_t &file, u8 *pubChunk, u32 unRva, u32 cubChunk ) noexcept
{
	if ( file.m_bPe64 )
		return false;

	const u32 unEnd = cubChunk + unRva;
	for ( u32 ibBlock = file.m_ibRelocationCursor; ibBlock < file.m_cubRelocations;
	      file.m_ibRelocationCursor = ibBlock )
	{
		const auto *pBlock = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION *>( file.m_pubRelocations + ibBlock );
		if ( pBlock->VirtualAddress >= unEnd )
			break;

		const auto *punEntries = reinterpret_cast<const u16 *>( pBlock + 1 );
		const i32 cEntries = static_cast<i32>( ( pBlock->SizeOfBlock - sizeof( IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION ) ) >> 1 );
		if ( pBlock->VirtualAddress + 0x1000 > unRva )
		{
			for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < cEntries; ++iEntry )
			{
				const u16 unEntry = punEntries[iEntry];
				const u32 unTarget = pBlock->VirtualAddress + ( unEntry & 0xFFF );
				if ( unTarget < unRva )
					continue;
				if ( unTarget >= unEnd )
					return true;

				const u32 unType = unEntry >> 12;
				if ( !unType )
					continue;
				if ( unType != IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGHLOW )
					return false;

				// @note / sapdragon: a value crossing the chunk end gets patched too, the window has the room
				auto *punValue = reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubChunk + unTarget - unRva );
				++file.m_cRelocationsApplied;
				*punValue -= static_cast<u32>( file.m_ulRelocationDelta );
			}
		}

		ibBlock = pBlock->SizeOfBlock + file.m_ibRelocationCursor;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 8B 45
void HashAroundDirectories( const PeFile_t &file, HashContext_t &hash, const u8 *pubChunk, u32 unRva,
                            u32 cubChunk ) noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &iat = GetDirectory( file, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IAT );
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &exports = GetDirectory( file, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT );

	pe::RangePair_t aroundIat;
	pe::RangePair_t rgParts[2];
	pe::SplitAroundDirectory( iat.VirtualAddress, iat.Size, unRva, unRva + cubChunk, aroundIat );
	pe::SplitAroundDirectory( exports.VirtualAddress, exports.Size, aroundIat.m_rgunStart[0], aroundIat.m_rgunEnd[0],
	                          rgParts[0] );
	pe::SplitAroundDirectory( exports.VirtualAddress, exports.Size, aroundIat.m_rgunStart[1], aroundIat.m_rgunEnd[1],
	                          rgParts[1] );

	for ( const pe::RangePair_t &part : rgParts )
	{
		for ( u32 iRange = 0; iRange < 2; ++iRange )
		{
			if ( part.m_rgunEnd[iRange] > part.m_rgunStart[iRange] )
				UpdateHash( hash, pubChunk + part.m_rgunStart[iRange] - unRva,
				            part.m_rgunEnd[iRange] - part.m_rgunStart[iRange] );
		}
	}
}

// @orig: 80 B9 ? ? ? ? ? 74 ? 8B 81 ? ? ? ? 8B 91
u64 GetHeaderImageBase( const PeFile_t &file ) noexcept
{
	return file.m_bPe64 ? file.m_OptionalHeader64.ImageBase : file.m_OptionalHeader32.ImageBase;
}

// @orig: 51 53 8B 5C 24 ? 55 56
bool BeginSectionHash( PeFile_t &file, const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section ) noexcept
{
	if ( NeedsRelocation( file ) )
	{
		if ( !file.m_pubRelocations && !LoadRelocations( file ) )
			return false;
		if ( !file.m_ulRelocationDelta )
			file.m_ulRelocationDelta = file.m_ulMappedBase - GetHeaderImageBase( file );
	}

	if ( !SeekPeFile( file, IsPeFileOpen( file ) ? section.PointerToRawData : section.VirtualAddress ) )
		return false;

	file.m_ibRelocationCursor = 0;
	file.m_unSectionRva = section.VirtualAddress;
	file.m_cubSectionRemaining = section.SizeOfRawData;
	return true;
}

// @orig: 51 51 53 55 56 8B F1
bool HashNextChunk( PeFile_t &file, HashContext_t &hash ) noexcept
{
	if ( !file.m_cubSectionRemaining )
		return false;

	// @note / sapdragon: a signed compare in the original. a size past 2 GB is not clamped and the read then refuses it
	i32 nChunk = static_cast<i32>( file.m_cubSectionRemaining );
	if ( nChunk > static_cast<i32>( k_cubReadLimit ) )
		nChunk = k_cubReadLimit;
	const u32 cubChunk = static_cast<u32>( nChunk );

	u8 *pubChunk = ReadWindow( file, cubChunk );
	if ( !pubChunk )
		return false;
	if ( NeedsRelocation( file ) && !file.m_bPe64 &&
	     !ApplyRelocations( file, pubChunk, file.m_unSectionRva, cubChunk ) )
		return false;

	const u32 unRva = file.m_unSectionRva;
	if ( file.m_bLayoutDigest )
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: this one leaves out the IAT without the 4 extra bytes the other digest skips
		const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &iat = GetDirectory( file, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IAT );
		const u32 unIatEnd = iat.VirtualAddress + iat.Size;
		const u32 unCutStart = iat.VirtualAddress > unRva ? iat.VirtualAddress : unRva;
		const u32 unCutEnd = unIatEnd < unRva + cubChunk ? unIatEnd : unRva + cubChunk;
		if ( unCutStart < unCutEnd )
		{
			if ( unCutStart > unRva )
				UpdateHash( hash, pubChunk, unCutStart - unRva );
			if ( unCutEnd < unRva + cubChunk )
				UpdateHash( hash, pubChunk + unCutEnd - unRva, unRva + cubChunk - unCutEnd );
		}
		else
		{
			UpdateHash( hash, pubChunk, cubChunk );
		}
	}
	else
	{
		HashAroundDirectories( file, hash, pubChunk, unRva, cubChunk );
	}

	file.m_unSectionRva += cubChunk;
	file.m_cubSectionRemaining -= cubChunk;
	return file.m_cubSectionRemaining != 0;
}

// @orig: 56 FF 74 24 ? 8B F1 FF 74 24
bool HashSection( PeFile_t &file, const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section, HashContext_t &hash ) noexcept
{
	if ( !BeginSectionHash( file, section ) )
		return false;

	while ( HashNextChunk( file, hash ) )
		;
	return !file.m_cubSectionRemaining;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 8B BC 24
bool HashImage( PeFile_t &file, HashContext_t &hash, bool bSectionOnly ) noexcept
{
	if ( !file.m_bLayoutDigest )
	{
		const u64 ulBase = IsPeFileOpen( file ) ? GetHeaderImageBase( file ) : file.m_ulMappedBase;

		// @note / sapdragon: the layout digest skips this and reuses the delta of the digest before it
		file.m_ulRelocationDelta = ulBase - pe::k_unRelocationBase;
	}

	if ( !bSectionOnly )
	{
		UpdateHash( hash, &file.m_DosHeader, sizeof( file.m_DosHeader ) );
		UpdateHash( hash, file.m_bLayoutDigest ? &file.m_FileHeader : &file.m_OriginalFileHeader,
		            sizeof( IMAGE_FILE_HEADER ) );

		IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 optional64;
		IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32 optional32;
		memcpy( &optional64, &file.m_OptionalHeader64, sizeof( optional64 ) );
		memcpy( &optional32, &file.m_OptionalHeader32, sizeof( optional32 ) );
		if ( !file.m_bLayoutDigest )
		{
			optional64.ImageBase = 0;
			optional32.ImageBase = 0;
		}

		if ( file.m_bPe64 )
			UpdateHash( hash, &optional64, sizeof( optional64 ) );
		else
			UpdateHash( hash, &optional32, sizeof( optional32 ) );
	}

	if ( !file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections )
		return false;

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSelected = nullptr;
	u32 cubLargest = 0;
	bool bFoundText = false;
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = file.m_pSections[iSection];
		if ( !bSectionOnly && ( iSection < file.m_OriginalFileHeader.NumberOfSections || file.m_bLayoutDigest ) )
		{
			UpdateHash( hash, section.Name, IMAGE_SIZEOF_SHORT_NAME );
			UpdateHash( hash, &section.VirtualAddress, sizeof( section.VirtualAddress ) );
			UpdateHash( hash, &section.SizeOfRawData, sizeof( section.SizeOfRawData ) );
		}

		if ( !CompareN( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( section.Name ), ".text", 5 ) &&
		     ( section.Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE ) )
		{
			bFoundText = true;
			pSelected = &section;
		}
		if ( !bFoundText && ( section.Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE ) && section.SizeOfRawData > cubLargest )
		{
			pSelected = &section;
			cubLargest = section.SizeOfRawData;
		}
	}

	if ( !pSelected || !HashSection( file, *pSelected, hash ) )
		return false;

	hash.m_Md5.Final( hash.m_rgubDigest );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 57 8B F1
EScanStatus ParseDebugDirectory( PeFile_t &file ) noexcept
{
	memset( &file.m_DebugDirectory, 0, sizeof( file.m_DebugDirectory ) );
	memset( file.m_rgubPdbGuid, 0, sizeof( file.m_rgubPdbGuid ) );
	memset( file.m_szPdbPath, 0, sizeof( file.m_szPdbPath ) );

	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory = GetDirectory( file, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_DEBUG );
	if ( !directory.Size )
		return EScanStatus::NoDebugDirectory;

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection =
	    pe::FindSectionByRva( file.m_pSections, file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections, directory.VirtualAddress );
	if ( !pSection )
		return EScanStatus::NoDebugSection;

	u32 ibDelta = 0;
	if ( IsPeFileOpen( file ) )
		ibDelta = pSection->VirtualAddress - pSection->PointerToRawData;
	if ( !SeekPeFile( file, directory.VirtualAddress - ibDelta ) )
		return EScanStatus::SeekFailed;

	SetReadRange( file, pSection->VirtualAddress, pSection->VirtualAddress + pSection->Misc.VirtualSize );

	u32 cubLeft = directory.Size;
	while ( cubLeft >= sizeof( IMAGE_DEBUG_DIRECTORY ) )
	{
		memset( &file.m_DebugDirectory, 0, sizeof( file.m_DebugDirectory ) );
		if ( !ReadBytes( file, &file.m_DebugDirectory, sizeof( file.m_DebugDirectory ) ) )
			break;

		cubLeft -= sizeof( IMAGE_DEBUG_DIRECTORY );
		if ( file.m_DebugDirectory.Type == IMAGE_DEBUG_TYPE_CODEVIEW )
			break;
	}

	if ( file.m_DebugDirectory.Type == IMAGE_DEBUG_TYPE_CODEVIEW &&
	     SeekPeFile( file, file.m_DebugDirectory.AddressOfRawData - ibDelta ) )
	{
		const u32 cubData = file.m_DebugDirectory.SizeOfData;
		u32 unSignature;
		if ( cubData >= sizeof( unSignature ) && ReadBytes( file, &unSignature, sizeof( unSignature ) ) &&
		     unSignature == k_unRsdsSignature && cubData >= sizeof( RsdsHeader_t ) )
		{
			u8 rgubGuidAndAge[20];
			if ( ReadBytes( file, rgubGuidAndAge, sizeof( rgubGuidAndAge ) ) )
			{
				memcpy( file.m_rgubPdbGuid, rgubGuidAndAge, sizeof( file.m_rgubPdbGuid ) );

				u32 cubPath = cubData - sizeof( RsdsHeader_t );
				if ( cubPath > sizeof( file.m_szPdbPath ) )
					cubPath = sizeof( file.m_szPdbPath );
				ReadBytes( file, file.m_szPdbPath, cubPath );
				file.m_szPdbPath[sizeof( file.m_szPdbPath ) - 1] = 0;
			}
		}
	}

	SetReadRange( file, 0, 0 );
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 8B 5C 24 ? 55 56 57 8B 7C 24
bool ReadResourceData( PeFile_t &file, u32 ibEntry, u8 **ppubData, u32 *pcubData ) noexcept
{
	*pcubData = 0;
	*ppubData = nullptr;
	if ( !SeekPeFile( file, ibEntry ) )
		return false;

	const u8 *pubEntry = ReadWindow( file, sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DATA_ENTRY ) );
	if ( !pubEntry )
		return false;

	IMAGE_RESOURCE_DATA_ENTRY entry;
	memcpy( &entry, pubEntry, sizeof( entry ) );
	if ( !entry.Size )
		return false;

	const u32 ibData = pe::RvaToFileOffset( file.m_pSections, file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections, entry.OffsetToData );
	if ( ibData == pe::k_unInvalidOffset || !SeekPeFile( file, ibData ) )
		return false;

	*ppubData = static_cast<u8 *>( util::HeapAlloc( entry.Size ) );
	*pcubData = entry.Size;
	if ( !ReadBytes( file, *ppubData, entry.Size ) )
	{
		util::HeapFree( *ppubData );
		*ppubData = nullptr;
		*pcubData = 0;
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 51 51 53 55 56 57 6A
bool WalkResourceDirectory( PeFile_t &file, ResourceVisitor_t &visitor, u32 ibRoot, u32 ibDirectory ) noexcept
{
	if ( !SeekPeFile( file, ibDirectory ) )
		return false;

	const auto *pPeek =
	    reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY *>( ReadWindow( file, sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY ) ) );
	if ( !pPeek )
		return false;

	const u32 cubEntries = sizeof( ResourceEntry_t ) * ( pPeek->NumberOfIdEntries + pPeek->NumberOfNamedEntries );
	if ( !SeekPeFile( file, ibDirectory ) )
		return false;

	const u8 *pubDirectory = ReadWindow( file, cubEntries + sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY ) );
	if ( !pubDirectory )
		return false;

	auto *pDirectory = static_cast<IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY *>( util::HeapAlloc( sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY ) ) );
	memcpy( pDirectory, pubDirectory, sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY ) );
	auto *pEntries = static_cast<ResourceEntry_t *>( util::HeapAlloc( cubEntries ) );
	memcpy( pEntries, pubDirectory + sizeof( IMAGE_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY ), cubEntries );

	const i32 cEntries = pDirectory->NumberOfIdEntries + pDirectory->NumberOfNamedEntries;
	for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < cEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		const ResourceEntry_t &entry = pEntries[iEntry];
		if ( entry.m_unOffset & IMAGE_RESOURCE_DATA_IS_DIRECTORY )
		{
			if ( visitor.m_pTable->m_pfnEnterDirectory( visitor, entry ) )
			{
				WalkResourceDirectory( file, visitor, ibRoot,
				                       ( entry.m_unOffset & ~IMAGE_RESOURCE_DATA_IS_DIRECTORY ) + ibRoot );
				visitor.m_pTable->m_pfnLeaveDirectory( visitor );
			}
		}
		else
		{
			u8 *pubData = nullptr;
			u32 cubData = 0;
			if ( ReadResourceData( file, entry.m_unOffset + ibRoot, &pubData, &cubData ) )
			{
				visitor.m_pTable->m_pfnVisitData( visitor, pubData, cubData );
				util::HeapFree( pubData );
			}
		}
	}

	util::HeapFree( pDirectory );
	util::HeapFree( pEntries );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 51 56 8B F1 B8
bool WalkResources( PeFile_t &file, ResourceVisitor_t &visitor ) noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory = GetDirectory( file, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_RESOURCE );
	if ( !directory.Size )
		return false;

	const u32 ibRoot =
	    pe::RvaToFileOffset( file.m_pSections, file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections, directory.VirtualAddress );
	if ( ibRoot == pe::k_unInvalidOffset )
		return false;

	return WalkResourceDirectory( file, visitor, ibRoot, ibRoot );
}

// @orig: 83 79 ? ? 75 ? 8B 44 24 ? 83 38 ? 7C ? 66 83 38 ? 75 ? C7 41 ? ? ? ? ? B0 ? EB ? 83 79 ? ? 75 ? C7 41
bool EnterGroupIconDirectory( ResourceVisitor_t &visitor, const ResourceEntry_t &entry ) noexcept
{
	if ( visitor.m_eState == EVisitorState::Root )
	{
		if ( static_cast<i32>( entry.m_unName ) >= 0 &&
		     static_cast<u16>( entry.m_unName ) == reinterpret_cast<uptr>( RT_GROUP_ICON ) )

			return true;
		}
	}
	else if ( visitor.m_eState == EVisitorState::TypeDirectory )

		visitor.m_eState = EVisitorState::NameDirectory;
		return true;
	}

}

// @orig: 53 8B D9 83 7B
void SelectLargestIcon( ResourceVisitor_t &visitor, const u8 *pubData, u32 cubData ) noexcept
{
	if ( visitor.m_eState == EVisitorState::Done || !pubData ||
	     cubData < offsetof( GroupIconDirectory_t, m_rgEntries ) )
		return;

	const auto *pGroup = reinterpret_cast<const GroupIconDirectory_t *>( pubData );
	const u32 cIcons = pGroup->m_cEntries;
	if ( static_cast<u16>( cubData ) <
	         sizeof( GroupIconEntry_t ) * cIcons + offsetof( GroupIconDirectory_t, m_rgEntries ) ||
	     !cIcons )
		return;

	const GroupIconEntry_t *pLargest = nullptr;
	u32 cLargestPixels = 0;
	for ( u32 iIcon = 0; iIcon < cIcons; ++iIcon )
	{
		const GroupIconEntry_t &icon = pGroup->m_rgEntries[iIcon];
		const u32 cPixels = icon.m_unWidth * icon.m_unHeight;
		if ( cPixels > cLargestPixels )
		{
			cLargestPixels = cPixels;
			pLargest = &icon;
		}
	}

	if ( pLargest )
	{
		visitor.m_unIconId = pLargest->m_unId;
		visitor.m_eState = EVisitorState::Done;
	}
}

// @orig: 8B 41 ? 85 C0 78
void LeaveResourceDirectory( ResourceVisitor_t &visitor ) noexcept
{
	if ( visitor.m_eState == EVisitorState::Root || visitor.m_eState == EVisitorState::TypeDirectory )
		visitor.m_eState = EVisitorState::Root;
	else if ( visitor.m_eState == EVisitorState::NameDirectory )
		visitor.m_eState = EVisitorState::TypeDirectory;
}

// @note / sapdragon: only reachable through the vtable, so the export has no function here and no @orig can resolve
void HashIconData( ResourceVisitor_t &visitor, const u8 *pubData, u32 cubData ) noexcept
{
	ResetHash( visitor.m_Hash );
	UpdateHash( visitor.m_Hash, pubData, cubData );
	visitor.m_Hash.m_Md5.Final( visitor.m_Hash.m_rgubDigest );
	visitor.m_eState = EVisitorState::Done;
}

                                                     LeaveResourceDirectory };
constexpr ResourceVisitorTable_t k_IconVisitor{ EnterIconDirectory, HashIconData, LeaveResourceDirectory };

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 6A
bool HashLargestIcon( PeFile_t &file, u8 *pubDigest, u32 *pcubIcon ) noexcept
{
	memset( pubDigest, 0, crypto::hash::k_cubMd5Digest );
	if ( !IsPeFileOpen( file ) )
		return false;
```
