```cpp
	visitor.m_pTable = &k_GroupIconVisitor;
	visitor.m_eState = EVisitorState::Root;
	visitor.m_unIconId = 0;

		return false;

	visitor.m_eState = EVisitorState::Root;

	{
		memcpy( pubDigest, visitor.m_Hash.m_rgubDigest, sizeof( visitor.m_Hash.m_rgubDigest ) );
		bHashed = true;
		*pcubIcon = visitor.m_Hash.m_cubHashed;
	}
	ResetHash( visitor.m_Hash );

void VerifySignature( PeFile_t &file ) noexcept
{
	file.m_unTrustStatus = 0;
	file.m_unTrustError = ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE;
	if ( !IsPeFileOpen( file ) )
		return;

	WINTRUST_FILE_INFO fileInfo{};
	fileInfo.cbStruct = sizeof( fileInfo );
	fileInfo.pcwszFilePath = L"";
	fileInfo.hFile = file.m_hFile;

	WINTRUST_DATA trustData{};
	trustData.cbStruct = sizeof( trustData );
	trustData.dwProvFlags = WTD_CACHE_ONLY_URL_RETRIEVAL;
	trustData.dwUnionChoice = WTD_CHOICE_FILE;
	trustData.dwStateAction = WTD_STATEACTION_VERIFY;
	trustData.pFile = &fileInfo;
	trustData.dwUIChoice = WTD_UI_NONE;

	GUID action = k_GuidVerifyV2;
	file.m_unTrustStatus = g_pImports->WinVerifyTrust( nullptr, &action, &trustData );
	file.m_unTrustError = g_pImports->GetLastError();

	trustData.dwStateAction = WTD_STATEACTION_CLOSE;
	g_pImports->WinVerifyTrust( nullptr, &action, &trustData );

	memset( &file.m_Signer, 0, sizeof( file.m_Signer ) );
	memset( &file.m_Issuer, 0, sizeof( file.m_Issuer ) );

	// @orig: inlined
	LARGE_INTEGER liSize{};
	g_pImports->GetFileSizeEx( file.m_hFile, &liSize );
	const HANDLE hMapping = g_pImports->CreateFileMappingW( file.m_hFile, nullptr, PAGE_READONLY, 0, 0, nullptr );
	const void *pView = hMapping ? g_pImports->MapViewOfFile( hMapping, FILE_MAP_READ, 0, 0, 0 ) : nullptr;
	if ( pView )
	{
		verify::CertContextSet_t set;
		static_cast<void>( verify::OpenCertificateContextFromBlob( g_pImports, &set, pView, liSize.LowPart,
		                                                           CERT_QUERY_CONTENT_FLAG_PKCS7_SIGNED_EMBED ) );
		if ( set.m_hMsg )
			verify::ExtractCertChain( g_pImports, &set, &file.m_Signer, &file.m_Issuer );
		verify::ReleaseCertContext( g_pImports, &set );
		g_pImports->UnmapViewOfFile( pView );
	}
	if ( hMapping )
		g_pImports->CloseHandle( hMapping );
}

// @orig: 51 53 55 56 8B F1 57 83 BE
EScanStatus ParsePeFile( PeFile_t &file ) noexcept
{
	if ( !IsPeFileOpen( file ) )
		return EScanStatus::NoFile;

	const EScanStatus eStatus = ParseHeaders( file );
	if ( eStatus != EScanStatus::Ok )
	{
		ResetPeFile( file );
		return eStatus;
	}

	u32 ibRawEnd = 0;
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = file.m_pSections[iSection];
		const u32 ibEnd = section.SizeOfRawData + section.PointerToRawData;
		if ( ibEnd > ibRawEnd )
			ibRawEnd = ibEnd;
	}

	const u32 cubFile = vac::file::GetFileSizeOrZero( g_pImports, file.m_hFile );
	const u32 cubAlignment =
	    file.m_bPe64 ? file.m_OptionalHeader64.SectionAlignment : file.m_OptionalHeader32.SectionAlignment;
	if ( ibRawEnd < cubFile )
	{
		++file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
		const u32 cubOverlay = cubFile - ibRawEnd;
		const u32 cSections = file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
		file.m_pSections = static_cast<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *>(
		    ReallocateHeap( file.m_pSections, sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) * cSections ) );

		// @note / sapdragon: no section before it reads in front of the block, and a zero alignment divides by zero.
		// the original has both
		IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &overlay = file.m_pSections[cSections - 1];
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &previous = file.m_pSections[static_cast<i32>( cSections ) - 2];
		u32 cubPrevious = previous.Misc.VirtualSize;
		if ( cubPrevious < previous.SizeOfRawData )
			cubPrevious = cubAlignment + previous.SizeOfRawData - 1 -
			              ( cubAlignment + previous.SizeOfRawData - 1 ) % cubAlignment;
		const u32 unNextRva = cubAlignment + cubPrevious + previous.VirtualAddress - 1;

		memset( &overlay, 0, sizeof( overlay ) );
		overlay.PointerToRawData = ibRawEnd;
		overlay.Characteristics = IMAGE_SCN_MEM_DISCARDABLE;
		overlay.SizeOfRawData = cubOverlay;
		overlay.VirtualAddress = unNextRva - unNextRva % cubAlignment;
		overlay.Misc.VirtualSize = cubAlignment + cubOverlay - 1 - ( cubAlignment + cubOverlay - 1 ) % cubAlignment;
		memcpy( overlay.Name, k_szOverlaySection, sizeof( k_szOverlaySection ) );
	}
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

void BuildImageFingerprints( PeFile_t &file, ImageFingerprints_t &fingerprints ) noexcept
{
	HashContext_t hash;
	ResetHash( hash );
	if ( HashImage( file, hash, true ) )
		memcpy( fingerprints.m_rgubCodeDigest, hash.m_rgubDigest, sizeof( hash.m_rgubDigest ) );

	ResetHash( hash );
	if ( HashImage( file, hash, false ) )
		memcpy( fingerprints.m_rgubImageDigest, hash.m_rgubDigest, sizeof( hash.m_rgubDigest ) );

	fingerprints.m_unCheckSum = GetImageChecksum( file );
	fingerprints.m_unVlvSignature = 0;
	fingerprints.m_unTimeDateStamp = file.m_FileHeader.TimeDateStamp;
	if ( util::Read32( file.m_rgubDosStub ) == k_unVlvSignature )
		fingerprints.m_unVlvSignature = k_unVlvSignature;

	ResetHash( hash );
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 8B F9
void BuildImageDetails( PeFile_t &file, ImageDetails_t &details ) noexcept
{
	details.m_cSections = static_cast<u8>( file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections );
	details.m_unTimeDateStamp = file.m_FileHeader.TimeDateStamp;
	details.m_unEntryPoint =
	    file.m_bPe64 ? file.m_OptionalHeader64.AddressOfEntryPoint : file.m_OptionalHeader32.AddressOfEntryPoint;
	details.m_unCheckSum = GetImageChecksum( file );

	HashContext_t hash;
	ResetHash( hash );
	file.m_bLayoutDigest = 1;
	if ( HashImage( file, hash, false ) )
	{
		details.m_LayoutDigestSize.m_cubHashed = hash.m_cubHashed;
		memcpy( details.m_rgubLayoutDigest, hash.m_rgubDigest, sizeof( hash.m_rgubDigest ) );
	}
	else
	{
		details.m_LayoutDigestSize.m_bFailed = 1;
	}
	file.m_bLayoutDigest = 0;

	ResetHash( hash );
	if ( HashImage( file, hash, false ) )
	{
		details.m_ImageDigestSize.m_cubHashed = hash.m_cubHashed;
		memcpy( details.m_rgubImageDigest, hash.m_rgubDigest, sizeof( hash.m_rgubDigest ) );
	}
	else
	{
		details.m_ImageDigestSize.m_bFailed = 1;
	}
	ResetHash( hash );

	u32 cReported = file.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
	if ( cReported > ARRAYSIZE( details.m_rgSections ) )
		cReported = ARRAYSIZE( details.m_rgSections );

	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cReported; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = file.m_pSections[iSection];

		ResetHash( hash );
		if ( HashSection( file, section, hash ) )
		{
			hash.m_Md5.Final( hash.m_rgubDigest );
			details.m_rgSectionDigestSizes[iSection].m_cubHashed = hash.m_cubHashed;
			memcpy( details.m_rgrgubSectionDigests[iSection], hash.m_rgubDigest, sizeof( hash.m_rgubDigest ) );
		}
		else
		{
			details.m_rgSectionDigestSizes[iSection].m_bFailed = 1;
		}

		SectionRow_t &row = details.m_rgSections[iSection];
		memcpy( row.m_rgubName, section.Name, IMAGE_SIZEOF_SHORT_NAME );
		row.m_unCharacteristics = section.Characteristics;
		row.m_cubRawData = section.SizeOfRawData;
		row.m_unZero = 0;
		row.m_unVirtualAddress = section.VirtualAddress;
	}

	u32 cubIcon = 0;
	if ( HashLargestIcon( file, details.m_rgubIconDigest, &cubIcon ) )
		details.m_IconDigestSize.m_cubHashed = cubIcon;
	else
		details.m_IconDigestSize.m_bFailed = 1;

	details.m_cReportedSections = static_cast<u8>( cReported + 4 );

	if ( ParseDebugDirectory( file ) == EScanStatus::Ok )
		util::CopyA( details.m_szPdbPath, file.m_szPdbPath, sizeof( details.m_szPdbPath ) );

	ResetHash( hash );
}

// @orig: 51 56 57 68
void ExportImageHeaders( PeFile_t &file, ImageHeaders_t &headers ) noexcept
{
	memset( &headers, 0, sizeof( headers ) );
	memcpy( &headers.m_FileHeader, &file.m_OriginalFileHeader, sizeof( headers.m_FileHeader ) );
	memcpy( headers.m_rgubOptionalHeader,
	        file.m_bPe64 ? static_cast<const void *>( &file.m_OptionalHeader64 )
	                     : static_cast<const void *>( &file.m_OptionalHeader32 ),
	        sizeof( headers.m_rgubOptionalHeader ) );
	memcpy( headers.m_rgubDosStub, file.m_rgubDosStub, sizeof( headers.m_rgubDosStub ) );

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pOverlay = FindOverlaySection( file );
	if ( pOverlay )
	{
		const u32 ibOverlay = IsPeFileOpen( file ) ? pOverlay->PointerToRawData : pOverlay->VirtualAddress;
		if ( SeekPeFile( file, ibOverlay ) )
		{
			const u8 *pubOverlay = ReadWindow( file, sizeof( headers.m_rgubOverlayStart ) );
			if ( pubOverlay )
				memcpy( headers.m_rgubOverlayStart, pubOverlay, sizeof( headers.m_rgubOverlayStart ) );
		}
	}

	VerifySignature( file );
	headers.m_unTrustStatus = file.m_unTrustStatus;
	headers.m_unTrustError = file.m_unTrustError;
	memcpy( &headers.m_Issuer, &file.m_Issuer, sizeof( headers.m_Issuer ) );
	memcpy( &headers.m_Signer, &file.m_Signer, sizeof( headers.m_Signer ) );
}
```

```cpp
bool IsCrossBitnessTarget( HANDLE hProcess ) noexcept
{
	if ( !g_pImports->IsWow64Process )
		return false;

	BOOL bSelfWow64 = FALSE;
	BOOL bTargetWow64 = FALSE;
	g_pImports->IsWow64Process( g_pImports->GetCurrentProcess(), &bSelfWow64 );
	if ( !bSelfWow64 )
		return false;
	if ( hProcess == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return true;

	g_pImports->IsWow64Process( hProcess, &bTargetWow64 );
	return !bTargetWow64;
}

	{
		if ( g_pImports->NtWow64QueryVirtualMemory64 )
			return g_pImports->NtWow64QueryVirtualMemory64( hProcess, reinterpret_cast<PVOID64>( ulAddress ),
			                                                k_unMemoryMappedFilename, pOutput, k_cubMappedNameQuery,
			                                                pcubOutput );
	}
	else if ( g_pImports->NtQueryVirtualMemory )
	{
		ULONG cubOutput = 0;
		const NTSTATUS nStatus =
		    g_pImports->NtQueryVirtualMemory( hProcess, reinterpret_cast<void *>( static_cast<uptr>( ulAddress ) ),
		                                      k_unMemoryMappedFilename, pOutput, k_cubMappedNameQuery, &cubOutput );
		*pcubOutput = cubOutput;
		return nStatus;
	}
	return 0;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 81 EC
u32 GetMappedFilePath( HANDLE hProcess, u64 ulAddress, wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	wchar_t rgwchBuffer[540];
	u64 cubOutput = k_cubMappedNameQuery;
	if ( QueryMappedFileName( hProcess, ulAddress, rgwchBuffer, &cubOutput ) )
	{
		g_pImports->GetLastError();
		return 0;
	}

	*pwszPath = 0;
	if ( cubOutput <= sizeof( UNICODE_STRING ) )
		return 0;

	const u32 cChars = static_cast<u32>( cubOutput ) >> 1;
	if ( cChars >= 0x200 )
		return 0;

	// @note / sapdragon: skips a 32-bit UNICODE_STRING even when the target is 64-bit, where the header is twice as
	// big. the name comes out as garbage then, keep it
	rgwchBuffer[cChars] = 0;
	CopyWideFixed( pwszPath, rgwchBuffer + sizeof( UNICODE_STRING ) / sizeof( wchar_t ), k_cPathChars );
	return cChars;
}

// @orig: inlined
bool ReadParameterString32( HANDLE hProcess, const nt::UnicodeString32_t &string, wchar_t *pwszOutput,
                            SIZE_T *pcubRead ) noexcept
{
	// @note / sapdragon: 260 chars are used, the rest is there because CopyWideFixed reads the whole count
	wchar_t wszBuffer[500];
	const u32 cubString = string.m_cubLength < k_cubMaxRemoteString ? string.m_cubLength : k_cubMaxRemoteString;
	memset( wszBuffer, 0, sizeof( wszBuffer ) );

	g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( hProcess, reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>( string.m_ulBuffer ) ),
	                               wszBuffer, cubString, pcubRead );
	if ( *pcubRead != cubString )
		return false;

	wszBuffer[string.m_cubLength > cubString ? MAX_PATH - 1 : string.m_cubLength >> 1] = 0;
	CopyWideFixed( pwszOutput, wszBuffer, ARRAYSIZE( wszBuffer ) );
	return true;
}

// @orig: inlined
bool ReadParameterString64( HANDLE hProcess, const nt::UnicodeString64_t &string, wchar_t *pwszOutput,
                            u64 *pcubRead ) noexcept
{
	wchar_t wszBuffer[500];
	const u32 cubString = string.m_cubLength < k_cubMaxRemoteString ? string.m_cubLength : k_cubMaxRemoteString;
	memset( wszBuffer, 0, sizeof( wszBuffer ) );

	ReadVirtualMemory( hProcess, string.m_ulBuffer, wszBuffer, cubString, pcubRead );
	if ( *pcubRead != cubString )
		return false;

	wszBuffer[string.m_cubLength > cubString ? MAX_PATH - 1 : string.m_cubLength >> 1] = 0;
	CopyWideFixed( pwszOutput, wszBuffer, ARRAYSIZE( wszBuffer ) );
	return true;
}

// @orig: inlined
void AppendModuleRecord( ProcessCapture_t &capture, const ModuleRecord_t &record ) noexcept
{
	capture.m_pModules = static_cast<ModuleRecord_t *>(
	    ReallocateHeap( capture.m_pModules, sizeof( ModuleRecord_t ) * ( capture.m_cModules + 1 ) ) );
	capture.m_pModules[capture.m_cModules] = record;
	++capture.m_cModules;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 8A 84 24 ? ? ? ? 53 55 8B D9
EScanStatus CaptureProcess64( ProcessCapture_t &capture, u32 unPid, ECaptureOptions eOptions ) noexcept
{
	capture.m_unPid = unPid;
	capture.m_CreationTime = {};
	capture.m_cModules = 0;

	FILETIME creation, exit, kernel, user;
	if ( g_pImports->GetProcessTimes( capture.m_hProcess, &creation, &exit, &kernel, &user ) )
	{
		capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::Times64;
		capture.m_CreationTime = creation;
	}

	const HANDLE hProcess = capture.m_hProcess;
	capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::Entered64;

	nt::ProcessBasicInformation64_t basic;
	ULONG cubBasic = 0;
	if ( IsCrossBitnessTarget( hProcess ) )
	{
		if ( g_pImports->NtWow64QueryInformationProcess64 )
			g_pImports->NtWow64QueryInformationProcess64( hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation, &basic, sizeof( basic ),
			                                              &cubBasic );
	}
	else if ( g_pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess )
	{
		ULONG cubReturned = 0;
		g_pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess( hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation, &basic, sizeof( basic ),
		                                       &cubReturned );
		cubBasic = cubReturned;
	}
	if ( cubBasic != sizeof( basic ) )
	{
		::GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::BasicInfoFailed;
	}

	capture.m_unParentPid = static_cast<u32>( basic.m_ulInheritedFromUniqueProcessId );
	capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::BasicInfo64;
	if ( !basic.m_ulPebBaseAddress )
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;

	u64 cubRead = 0;
	capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebAddress64;

	nt::Peb64_t peb;
	ReadVirtualMemory( hProcess, basic.m_ulPebBaseAddress, &peb, sizeof( nt::Peb64_t ), &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != sizeof( nt::Peb64_t ) )
		return EScanStatus::PebReadFailed;
	capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebRead64;

	if ( HasFlag( eOptions, ECaptureOptions::Parameters ) )
	{
		union
		{
			nt::ProcessParameters64_t m_Parameters;
			u8 m_rgub[nt::Arch64_t::k_cubProcessParametersSnapshot];
		} parameters;
		ReadVirtualMemory( hProcess, peb.m_ulProcessParameters, &parameters,
		                   nt::Arch64_t::k_cubProcessParametersSnapshot, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != nt::Arch64_t::k_cubProcessParametersSnapshot )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;

		if ( !ReadParameterString64( hProcess, parameters.m_Parameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath,
		                             capture.m_wszCurrentDirectory, &cubRead ) )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		if ( !ReadParameterString64( hProcess, parameters.m_Parameters.m_ImagePathName, capture.m_wszImagePath,
		                             &cubRead ) )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		if ( !ReadParameterString64( hProcess, parameters.m_Parameters.m_CommandLine, capture.m_wszCommandLine,
		                             &cubRead ) )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}

	if ( HasFlag( eOptions, ECaptureOptions::Modules ) )
	{
		nt::PebLdrData64_t ldr;
		ReadVirtualMemory( hProcess, peb.m_ulLdr, &ldr, nt::Arch64_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != nt::Arch64_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot )
		{
			capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrReadFailed;
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		}

		capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrRead64;
		const u64 ulFirst = ldr.m_InLoadOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
		if ( !ulFirst )
		{
			capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrEmpty64;
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		}

		nt::LdrDataTableEntry64_t entry;
		ReadVirtualMemory( hProcess, ulFirst, &entry, nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot )
		{
			capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntryFailed64;
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		}
		capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntry64;

		ModuleRecord_t record;
		wchar_t wszName[262];
		for ( u32 iModule = 0; iModule < k_cMaxModules; ++iModule )
		{
			memset( &record, 0, sizeof( record ) );
			const u32 cubName = entry.m_FullDllName.m_cubLength;
			record.m_ulBase = entry.m_ulDllBase;
			record.m_unTag = entry.m_cubSizeOfImage;
			if ( cubName >= k_cubMaxRemoteString )
			{
				capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameTooLong;
			}
			else
			{
				cubRead = 0;
				ReadVirtualMemory( hProcess, entry.m_FullDllName.m_ulBuffer, wszName, cubName, &cubRead );
				if ( cubRead != cubName )
				{
					capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameReadFailed;
				}
				else
				{
					wszName[cubName >> 1] = 0;
					CopyWideFixed( record.m_wszPath, wszName, ARRAYSIZE( record.m_wszPath ) );
					const wchar_t *pwszBase = util::wstr::BaseName( record.m_wszPath );
					if ( pwszBase )
						CopyWideFixed( record.m_wszName, pwszBase, ARRAYSIZE( record.m_wszName ) );
				}
			}

			AppendModuleRecord( capture, record );

			const u64 ulNext = entry.m_InLoadOrderLinks.m_ulFlink;
			if ( !ulNext || ulNext == ulFirst )
				break;

			ReadVirtualMemory( hProcess, ulNext, &entry, nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot, &cubRead );
			if ( cubRead != nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot || !entry.m_ulDllBase )
				break;
		}
	}

	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 8B 54 24 ? 8B C2
ECaptureOptions EncodeCaptureFlags( ECaptureRequest eRequest ) noexcept
{
	const u16 unRequest = static_cast<u16>( eRequest );
	ECaptureOptions eOptions = ECaptureOptions::None;
	if ( unRequest & static_cast<u16>( ECaptureRequest::Modules ) )
		eOptions |= ECaptureOptions::Modules;
	if ( unRequest & static_cast<u16>( ECaptureRequest::Unused040 ) )
		eOptions |= ECaptureOptions::Unused02;
	if ( unRequest & static_cast<u16>( ECaptureRequest::Parameters ) )
		eOptions |= ECaptureOptions::Parameters;
	if ( unRequest & static_cast<u16>( ECaptureRequest::Unused080 ) )
		eOptions |= ECaptureOptions::Unused08;
	if ( unRequest & static_cast<u16>( ECaptureRequest::Unused100 ) )
		eOptions |= ECaptureOptions::Unused10;
	if ( unRequest & static_cast<u16>( ECaptureRequest::Unused200 ) )
		eOptions |= ECaptureOptions::Unused20;
	return eOptions;
}

// @orig: 56 68 ? ? ? ? 8B F1
void InitProcessCapture( ProcessCapture_t &capture ) noexcept
{
	memset( &capture, 0, sizeof( capture ) );
	capture.m_hProcess = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 8E
void FreeProcessCapture( ProcessCapture_t &capture ) noexcept
{
	if ( capture.m_pModules )
		::HeapFree( ::GetProcessHeap(), 0, capture.m_pModules );
	capture.m_pModules = nullptr;
	capture.m_cModules = 0;

	if ( capture.m_hProcess != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && capture.m_hProcess )
		g_pImports->CloseHandle( capture.m_hProcess );

	memset( &capture, 0, sizeof( capture ) );
	capture.m_hProcess = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 8A 84 24 ? ? ? ? 53 55 56
EScanStatus CaptureProcess( ProcessCapture_t &capture, u32 unPid, ECaptureOptions eOptions ) noexcept
{
	capture.m_eProgress = process::ECaptureFlags::None;
	capture.m_CreationTime = {};

	capture.m_hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );
	if ( ( g_pSession->m_OsVersion.dwPlatformId != VER_PLATFORM_WIN32_NT ||
	       g_pSession->m_OsVersion.dwMajorVersion < 6 ) &&
	     ( !capture.m_hProcess || capture.m_hProcess == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ) )
	{
		capture.m_hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );
	}

	if ( !capture.m_hProcess )
	{
		capture.m_unLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::ProcessOpenFailed;
	}

	capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::Opened;
	capture.m_unPid = unPid;
	capture.m_cModules = 0;

	FILETIME creation, exit, kernel, user;
	if ( g_pImports->GetProcessTimes( capture.m_hProcess, &creation, &exit, &kernel, &user ) )
	{
		capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::Times;
		capture.m_CreationTime = creation;
	}

	capture.m_bSelfIsWow64 = IsCrossBitnessTarget( ::GetCurrentProcess() );
	capture.m_bTargetIsNative64 = IsCrossBitnessTarget( capture.m_hProcess );

	g_pImports->CloseHandle( capture.m_hProcess );
	capture.m_hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ, FALSE, unPid );
	if ( !capture.m_hProcess )
	{
		capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::ReopenFailed;
		capture.m_unLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReopenFailed;
	}

	capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::Reopened;
	if ( capture.m_bTargetIsNative64 )
	{
		capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::Cross64;
		return CaptureProcess64( capture, unPid, eOptions );
	}

	nt::ProcessBasicInformation32_t basic;
	ULONG cubBasic = 0;
	g_pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess( capture.m_hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation, &basic, sizeof( basic ),
	                                       &cubBasic );
	if ( cubBasic != sizeof( basic ) )
		return EScanStatus::BasicInfoFailed;

	const HANDLE hProcess = capture.m_hProcess;
	capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::BasicInfo;
	capture.m_unParentPid = basic.m_ulInheritedFromUniqueProcessId;

	if ( !basic.m_ulPebBaseAddress )
	{
		wchar_t rgwchImageName[MAX_PATH];
		ULONG cubImageName = 0;
		rgwchImageName[MAX_PATH - 1] = 0;
		g_pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess( hProcess, ProcessImageFileName, rgwchImageName, sizeof( rgwchImageName ),
		                                       &cubImageName );
		if ( cubImageName )
			CopyWideFixed( capture.m_wszImagePath, rgwchImageName + sizeof( UNICODE_STRING ) / sizeof( wchar_t ),
			               ARRAYSIZE( capture.m_wszImagePath ) );
		return EScanStatus::NoPeb;
	}

	SIZE_T cubRead = 0;
	capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebAddress;
	g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( hProcess,
	                               reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>( basic.m_ulPebBaseAddress ) ),
	                               &capture.m_Peb, sizeof( nt::Peb32_t ), &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != sizeof( nt::Peb32_t ) )
		return EScanStatus::PebReadFailed;
	capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebRead;

	if ( HasFlag( eOptions, ECaptureOptions::Parameters ) )
	{
		g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory(
		    hProcess, reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>( capture.m_Peb.m_ulProcessParameters ) ),
		    capture.m_rgubParameters, nt::Arch32_t::k_cubProcessParametersSnapshot, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != nt::Arch32_t::k_cubProcessParametersSnapshot )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;

		if ( !ReadParameterString32( hProcess, capture.m_Parameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath,
		                             capture.m_wszCurrentDirectory, &cubRead ) )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		if ( !ReadParameterString32( hProcess, capture.m_Parameters.m_ImagePathName, capture.m_wszImagePath,
		                             &cubRead ) )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		if ( !ReadParameterString32( hProcess, capture.m_Parameters.m_CommandLine, capture.m_wszCommandLine,
		                             &cubRead ) )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}

	nt::PebLdrData32_t ldr;
	g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( hProcess,
	                               reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>( capture.m_Peb.m_ulLdr ) ), &ldr,
	                               offsetof( nt::PebLdrData32_t, m_InInitializationOrderModuleList ), &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != offsetof( nt::PebLdrData32_t, m_InInitializationOrderModuleList ) )
	{
		capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrReadFailed;
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}

	const u32 unFirst = ldr.m_InMemoryOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
	capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrRead;
	if ( !unFirst )
	{
		capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrEmpty64;
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}

	if ( HasFlag( eOptions, ECaptureOptions::Modules ) )
	{
		nt::LdrDataTableEntry32_t entry;
		g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( hProcess,
		                               reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>(
		                                   unFirst - offsetof( nt::LdrDataTableEntry32_t, m_InMemoryOrderLinks ) ) ),
		                               &entry, nt::Arch32_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot, &cubRead );
		capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntry;
		if ( cubRead != nt::Arch32_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot )
		{
			capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntryFailed64;
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		}

		ModuleRecord_t record;
		wchar_t wszName[k_cubMaxRemoteString / sizeof( wchar_t ) + 1];
		i32 cLeft = k_cMaxModules;
		for ( ;; )
		{
			--cLeft;
			memset( &record, 0, sizeof( record ) );
			const u32 cubName = entry.m_FullDllName.m_cubLength;

			// @note / sapdragon: the base goes through a signed int on the way to 64 bits, like the original
			record.m_ulBase = static_cast<u64>( static_cast<i64>( static_cast<i32>( entry.m_ulDllBase ) ) );
			record.m_unTag = 0x1000;
			if ( cubName >= k_cubMaxRemoteString )
			{
				capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameTooLong;
			}
			else
			{
				cubRead = 0;
				g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory(
				    hProcess, reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>( entry.m_FullDllName.m_ulBuffer ) ),
				    wszName, cubName, &cubRead );
				if ( cubRead == cubName )
				{
					wszName[cubName >> 1] = 0;
					CopyWideFixed( record.m_wszPath, wszName, ARRAYSIZE( record.m_wszPath ) );
					const wchar_t *pwszBase = util::wstr::BaseName( record.m_wszPath );
					if ( pwszBase )
						CopyWideFixed( record.m_wszName, pwszBase, ARRAYSIZE( record.m_wszName ) );
				}
				else
				{
					capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameReadFailed;
				}
			}

			AppendModuleRecord( capture, record );

			const u32 unNext = entry.m_InMemoryOrderLinks.m_ulFlink;
			if ( !unNext || unNext == unFirst )
				break;

			g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( hProcess,
			                               reinterpret_cast<const void *>( static_cast<uptr>(
			                                   unNext - offsetof( nt::LdrDataTableEntry32_t, m_InMemoryOrderLinks ) ) ),
			                               &entry, nt::Arch32_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot, &cubRead );
			if ( cubRead != nt::Arch32_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot )
			{
				capture.m_eProgress |= process::ECaptureFlags::EntryReadFailed;
				break;
			}
			if ( !entry.m_ulDllBase )
				break;
			if ( cLeft <= 0 )
			{
				--cLeft;
				break;
			}
		}

		if ( !cLeft )
			return EScanStatus::TooManyModules;
	}

	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC B8
bool GetFirstModulePath( u32 unPid, wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	ProcessCapture_t capture;
	InitProcessCapture( capture );
	CaptureProcess( capture, unPid, EncodeCaptureFlags( ECaptureRequest::Modules ) );

	const ModuleRecord_t *pModule = static_cast<i32>( capture.m_cModules ) > 0 ? capture.m_pModules : nullptr;
	bool bFound = false;
	if ( pModule )
	{
		if ( GetMappedFilePath( capture.m_hProcess, pModule->m_ulBase, pwszPath ) )
			NtDeviceToDosPath( pwszPath );
		else
			CopyWideFixed( pwszPath, pModule->m_wszPath, k_cPathChars );
		bFound = true;
	}

	FreeProcessCapture( capture );
	return bFound;
}

// @orig: A1 ? ? ? ? 81 EC
void FindProfileProcess( u32 *punPid, u32 *pcFound ) noexcept
{
	process::ForEachSnapshotProcess(
	    g_pImports,
	    [&]( const PROCESSENTRY32W &entry )
	    {
		    char szName[MAX_PATH];
		    util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, entry.szExeFile, szName, sizeof( szName ) );
		    if ( util::hashing::PathHashBytes( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( szName ), util::StrLenA( szName ) ) ==
		         k_unProfileProcessHash )
		    {
			    ++*pcFound;
			    *punPid = entry.th32ProcessID;
		    }
		    return true;
	    } );
}
```

`modules/process_memory_map/entry.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 8d88e017
#include "internal/process_context.hpp"
#include "internal/report_builder.hpp"
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/blob.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
{

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 E4 ? B8 ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? 8B 45
int RunProcessMemoryMap( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	if ( *pcubOutput < sizeof( Report_t ) )
		return 4;

	*pcubOutput = sizeof( Report_t );
	memset( &report, 0, sizeof( Report_t ) );
	memset( &report, 0, sizeof( Report_t ) );

	if ( bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
	{
		report.m_unPid = input.m_unPid;
		report.m_unScanType = 5;

		ProcessContext_t context;
		memset( &context, 0, sizeof( context ) );
		context.m_hProcess = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;

		const EScanStatus eStatus = OpenProcessAndCaptureLdr( context, report.m_unPid, g_pImports, g_pSession );
		report.m_unLastError = context.m_unLastError;
		report.m_eCaptureFlags = context.m_eCaptureFlags;
		report.m_eStatus = eStatus;
		report.m_eFlags = ( context.m_bSelfWow64 ? EReportFlags::SelfWow64 : EReportFlags::None ) |
		                  ( report.m_eFlags & static_cast<EReportFlags>( 0xFFFC ) ) |
		                  ( context.m_bCross64 ? EReportFlags::Cross64 : EReportFlags::None );
		if ( eStatus == EScanStatus::Ok )
		{
			report.m_ulCreateTime = context.m_ulCreateTime;
			report.m_cRecords = 0;
			report.m_cubStrings = 0;
			report.m_eStatus = ScanProcess( context, report, input.m_unScanStart, input.m_nMaxHashes,
			                                input.m_nTrimRatio, input.m_unMinHashBase, g_pImports );
		}

		ReleaseProcessContext( context, g_pImports );
		bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();
	}
	else
	{
		report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
	}
	return 0;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
```

`modules/process_memory_map/internal/image_hash.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 8d88e017
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "crypto/hash/md5.hpp"
#include "internal/pe_reader.hpp"
#include "internal/report_builder.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
{

namespace
{

// @note / sapdragon: only a read of zero bytes ends the loop, a read that keeps failing spins forever. valve's
// @orig: B8 ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? A1
u32 HashWholeFile( const wchar_t *pwszPath, u8 *pubDigest, const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	const HANDLE hFile = pImports->CreateFileW( pwszPath, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
	                                            FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
	if ( hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return 0;

	crypto::hash::Md5_t md5;
	u8 rgubChunk[4096];
	u32 cubTotal = 0;
	for ( ;; )
	{
		DWORD cubRead = 0;
		if ( pImports->ReadFile( hFile, rgubChunk, sizeof( rgubChunk ), &cubRead, nullptr ) && !cubRead )
			break;
		md5.Update( rgubChunk, cubRead );
		cubTotal += cubRead;
	}

	pImports->CloseHandle( hFile );
	md5.Final( pubDigest );
	return cubTotal;
}

// @orig: 53 55 56 8B F1 57 8B 7C 24
void AddImageHash( ReportBuilder_t &builder, u64 ulBase, EHashSource eSource,
                   const BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION &information, const u8 *pubDigest ) noexcept
{
	u8 *pubHash = builder.m_pubHashWrite;
	if ( builder.m_bWideRecords )
	{
		auto *pRecord = reinterpret_cast<ImageHashRecord64_t *>( pubHash );
		pRecord->m_unBaseAndSource = static_cast<u32>( ulBase ) | static_cast<u32>( eSource );
		pRecord->m_unBaseHigh = static_cast<u32>( ulBase >> 32 );
		pRecord->m_unVolumeSerial = information.dwVolumeSerialNumber;
		pRecord->m_unFileIndexLow = information.nFileIndexLow;
		pRecord->m_unFileIndexHigh = information.nFileIndexHigh;
		memcpy( pRecord->m_rgubDigest, pubDigest, crypto::hash::k_cubMd5Digest );
		builder.m_pubHashWrite = pubHash + sizeof( ImageHashRecord64_t );
	}
	else
	{
		auto *pRecord = reinterpret_cast<ImageHashRecord32_t *>( pubHash );
		pRecord->m_unBaseAndSource = static_cast<u32>( eSource ) | static_cast<u32>( ulBase );
		pRecord->m_unVolumeSerial = information.dwVolumeSerialNumber;
		pRecord->m_unFileIndexLow = information.nFileIndexLow;
		pRecord->m_unFileIndexHigh = information.nFileIndexHigh;
		memcpy( pRecord->m_rgubDigest, pubDigest, crypto::hash::k_cubMd5Digest );
		builder.m_pubHashWrite = pubHash + sizeof( ImageHashRecord32_t );
	}
	++builder.m_cHashes;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: B8 ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? 53 55
bool HashImageIntoTable( ReportBuilder_t &builder, const ProcessContext_t &context, const AllocationWalk_t &walk,
                         const wchar_t *pwszPath, const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	CPeReader memoryReader( pImports );
	u8 rgubDigest[crypto::hash::k_cubMd5Digest];
	memset( rgubDigest, 0, sizeof( rgubDigest ) );

	BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION information;
	memset( &information, 0, sizeof( information ) );

	bool bHashed = false;
	EHashSource eSource = EHashSource::RawFile;
	if ( *pwszPath )
	{
		const HANDLE hFile = pImports->CreateFileW( pwszPath, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
		                                            FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
		if ( hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && hFile )
		{
			if ( !pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle( hFile, &information ) )
			{
				information.dwVolumeSerialNumber = 0;
				information.nFileIndexLow = 0;
				information.nFileIndexHigh = 0;
			}

			CPeReader fileReader( pImports );
			fileReader.Release();
			if ( !fileReader.AttachFile( hFile ) || fileReader.ParseFile() != EScanStatus::Ok )
			{
				// @note / sapdragon: a failed parse already closed it, so this closes the handle twice. valve's
				pImports->CloseHandle( hFile );
			}
			else if ( fileReader.HashImage( rgubDigest ) )
			{
				bHashed = true;
				eSource = EHashSource::NormalizedFile;
			}

			if ( !bHashed && HashWholeFile( pwszPath, rgubDigest, pImports ) )
				bHashed = true;

			fileReader.Release();
			fileReader.CloseSource();
		}
	}

	if ( !bHashed && memoryReader.ParseProcessImage( walk.m_ulFirstCommitted, context.m_hProcess ) == EScanStatus::Ok &&
	     memoryReader.HashImage( rgubDigest ) )
	{
		eSource |= EHashSource::Memory;
		bHashed = true;
	}

	if ( bHashed )
		AddImageHash( builder, walk.m_First.AllocationBase, eSource, information, rgubDigest );

	memoryReader.Release();
	memoryReader.CloseSource();
	return bHashed;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
```

`modules/process_memory_map/internal/lz4_block.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 8d88e017
#include "compress/lz4.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "internal/report_builder.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
{

// @orig: 80 B9 ? ? ? ? ? 8B 41 ? 8B 51
i32 GetPlainSize( ReportBuilder_t &builder ) noexcept
{
	const i32 cubTables = builder.m_bWideRecords
	                          ? builder.m_cHashes * static_cast<i32>( sizeof( ImageHashRecord64_t ) ) +
	                                builder.m_cRecords * static_cast<i32>( sizeof( ModuleRecord64_t ) )
	                          : builder.m_cHashes * static_cast<i32>( sizeof( ImageHashRecord32_t ) ) +
	                                builder.m_cRecords * static_cast<i32>( sizeof( ModuleRecord32_t ) );
	builder.m_cubPlain = cubTables + builder.m_cubStrings;
	return builder.m_cubPlain;
}

// @orig: 80 B9 ? ? ? ? ? 8B 41 ? 75
i32 GetRecordBytes( const ReportBuilder_t &builder ) noexcept
{
	return builder.m_bWideRecords ? builder.m_cRecords * static_cast<i32>( sizeof( ModuleRecord64_t ) )
	                              : builder.m_cRecords * static_cast<i32>( sizeof( ModuleRecord32_t ) );
}

// @note / sapdragon: the size can be over the limit, only a block that fits gets written
// @orig: 55 8B EC B8 ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? 53
i32 CompressRecords( ReportBuilder_t &builder, u8 *pubOutput ) noexcept
{
	u8 rgubPlain[11200];
	const i32 cubHashes =
	    builder.m_cHashes *
	    static_cast<i32>( builder.m_bWideRecords ? sizeof( ImageHashRecord64_t ) : sizeof( ImageHashRecord32_t ) );
	const i32 cubRecords = GetRecordBytes( builder );
	memcpy( rgubPlain, builder.m_pubHashes, cubHashes );
	memcpy( rgubPlain + cubHashes, builder.m_pubRecords, cubRecords );
	memcpy( rgubPlain + cubHashes + cubRecords, builder.m_rgchStrings, builder.m_cubStrings );

	const i32 cubPlain = cubHashes + cubRecords + builder.m_cubStrings;
	builder.m_cubPlain = cubPlain;

	// @note / sapdragon: lz4::Compress wants the worst case output, valve only has 11200 and aborts when it runs out.
	// a bigger buffer gives the same bytes, a block that doesn't fit counts as a failure. the abort check itself is a
	// little stricter near the limit, so a block of almost 11200 bytes can differ. it needs a near incompressible report
	u8 rgubCompressed[compress::lz4::CompressBound( sizeof( rgubPlain ) )];
	i32 cubCompressed;
	if ( cubPlain )
	{
		cubCompressed = compress::lz4::Compress( rgubPlain, rgubCompressed, cubPlain, sizeof( rgubCompressed ) );
		if ( cubCompressed > static_cast<i32>( sizeof( rgubPlain ) ) )
			cubCompressed = 0;
	}
	else
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: valve's lz4 emits one zero token for empty input, lz4::Compress returns 0 instead
		rgubCompressed[0] = 0;
		cubCompressed = 1;
	}

	if ( cubCompressed && cubCompressed <= static_cast<i32>( sizeof( Report_t::m_rgubCompressed ) ) )
		memcpy( pubOutput, rgubCompressed, cubCompressed );
	return cubCompressed;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
```

```cpp
// @binary: 8d88e017
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "internal/report_builder.hpp"
#include "util/encoding.hpp"
#include "util/hashing.hpp"
#include "util/strings.hpp"
#include "util/wstr.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
{

// @orig: 33 C0 88 01 88 81
void ResetPathEntry( PathEntry_t &entry ) noexcept
{
	entry.m_szDirectory[0] = 0;
	entry.m_szBaseName[0] = 0;
	entry.m_cchDirectory = 0;
	entry.m_cchBaseName = 0;
	entry.m_bInSystemDirectory = false;
	entry.m_bInWindowsDirectory = false;
	entry.m_unDirectoryHash = 0;
	entry.m_unBaseNameHash = 0;
	entry.m_bHasPath = false;
}

// @orig: 8B 54 24 ? 81 EC
void BuildPathEntry( PathEntry_t &entry, const wchar_t *pwszPath, const SystemDirectories_t &directories,
                     const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	wchar_t wszDirectory[MAX_PATH];
	CopyWideFilled( wszDirectory, pwszPath, MAX_PATH );

	wchar_t *pwszBaseName = const_cast<wchar_t *>( util::wstr::BaseName( wszDirectory ) );
	entry.m_bHasPath = true;
	if ( pwszBaseName > wszDirectory )
		pwszBaseName[-1] = 0;

	util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( pImports, wszDirectory, entry.m_szDirectory, MAX_PATH );
	util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( pImports, pwszBaseName, entry.m_szBaseName, MAX_PATH );
	entry.m_cchDirectory = static_cast<i32>( util::StrLenA( entry.m_szDirectory ) );
	entry.m_cchBaseName = static_cast<i32>( util::StrLenA( entry.m_szBaseName ) );

	if ( lstrlenW( wszDirectory ) >= directories.m_cchSystem )
	{
		wszDirectory[directories.m_cchSystem] = 0;
		if ( lstrcmpiW( directories.m_wszSystem, wszDirectory ) == 0 )
			entry.m_bInSystemDirectory = true;
	}
	if ( lstrlenW( wszDirectory ) >= directories.m_cchWindows )
	{
		wszDirectory[directories.m_cchWindows] = 0;
		if ( lstrcmpiW( directories.m_wszWindows, wszDirectory ) == 0 )
			entry.m_bInWindowsDirectory = true;
	}

	entry.m_unDirectoryHash =
	    util::hashing::PathHashBytes( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( entry.m_szDirectory ), entry.m_cchDirectory );
	entry.m_unBaseNameHash =
	    util::hashing::PathHashBytes( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( entry.m_szBaseName ), entry.m_cchBaseName );
}

// @orig: 8B 54 24 ? 8B 44 24 ? 53
bool AppendRecord( ReportBuilder_t &builder, u64 ulBase, u8 unRegionCount, u32 unDirectoryHash, u32 unBaseNameHash,
                   u32 cubImage, ERecordFlags eFlags, u16 unLdrIndex ) noexcept
{
	u8 *pubRecord = builder.m_pubRecordWrite;
	builder.m_pubLastRecord = pubRecord;

	const u32 unTag = HasFlag( eFlags, ERecordFlags::InLdr ) ? ( unLdrIndex & 0xFFFu ) : unRegionCount;
	if ( builder.m_bWideRecords )
	{
		auto *pRecord = reinterpret_cast<ModuleRecord64_t *>( pubRecord );
		pRecord->m_unBaseAndTag = static_cast<u32>( ulBase ) | unTag;
		pRecord->m_unBaseHigh = static_cast<u32>( ulBase >> 32 );
		pRecord->m_unSizeAndFlags = static_cast<u32>( eFlags ) | cubImage;
		pRecord->m_unDirectoryHash = unDirectoryHash;
		pRecord->m_unBaseNameHash = unBaseNameHash;
		builder.m_pubRecordWrite = pubRecord + sizeof( ModuleRecord64_t );
	}
	else
	{
		auto *pRecord = reinterpret_cast<ModuleRecord32_t *>( pubRecord );
		pRecord->m_unBaseAndTag = static_cast<u32>( ulBase ) | unTag;
		pRecord->m_unSizeAndFlags = static_cast<u32>( eFlags ) | cubImage;
		pRecord->m_unDirectoryHash = unDirectoryHash;
		pRecord->m_unBaseNameHash = unBaseNameHash;
		builder.m_pubRecordWrite = pubRecord + sizeof( ModuleRecord32_t );
	}

	return ++builder.m_cRecords != builder.m_cMaxRecords;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
```

```cpp
// @binary: 8d88e017
#include "internal/pe_reader.hpp"

constexpr u32 k_unValveStubMagic = 0x564C56;

// @note / sapdragon: strncmp, but it stops as soon as the section name ends
// @orig: 56 33 F6 57 8B FA
int CompareName( const char *pszName, const char *pszOther, u32 cchMax ) noexcept
{
	for ( u32 iChar = 0; iChar < cchMax; ++iChar )
	{
		const u8 unChar = static_cast<u8>( pszName[iChar] );
		if ( !unChar || unChar != static_cast<u8>( pszOther[iChar] ) )
			return unChar - static_cast<u8>( pszOther[iChar] );
	}
	return 0;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 53 33 DB 56 8B F1
CPeReader::CPeReader( const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
    : m_pImports( pImports ), m_ulWindowOffset( 0 ), m_ibCursor( 0 ), m_cubValid( 0 ), m_hFile( INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ),
      m_hProcess( nullptr ), m_ulRemoteBase( 0 ), m_ulRelocationDelta( 0 ), m_bPe64( false ), m_pSections( nullptr ),
      m_pubRelocations( nullptr ), m_cubRelocations( 0 ), m_cubSectionLeft( 0 ), m_unSectionRva( 0 ),
      m_ibRelocationCursor( 0 )
{
}

// @orig: 83 B9 ? ? ? ? ? 0F 95 C0
bool CPeReader::IsFile() const noexcept
{
	return m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 86
void CPeReader::CloseSource() noexcept
{
	if ( m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
	{
		m_pImports->CloseHandle( m_hFile );
		m_hFile = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
	}
	m_cubValid = 0;
	m_ulWindowOffset = 0;
	m_ibCursor = 0;
	m_hProcess = nullptr;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 E8
bool CPeReader::AttachFile( HANDLE hFile ) noexcept
{
	CloseSource();
	m_hFile = hFile;
	return m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
}

// @note / sapdragon: the source is always a file or the handle from OpenProcess, so valve's third branch that
// memcpys from a raw pointer in this process and its range limit can't run here. left out
// @orig: 51 51 53 55 8B 6C 24
u8 *CPeReader::ReadChunk( u32 cub ) noexcept
{
	if ( cub > k_cubPage )
		return nullptr;

	u32 ibCursor = m_ibCursor;
	const u32 cubValid = m_cubValid;
	if ( ibCursor + cub >= cubValid )
	{
		u32 ibFill = 0;
		u32 cubWanted = sizeof( m_rgubWindow );
		if ( ibCursor + cub == cubValid )
		{
			if ( cubValid == sizeof( m_rgubWindow ) )
			{
				memcpy( m_rgubWindow, m_rgubWindow + k_cubPage, k_cubPage );
				m_ulWindowOffset += k_cubPage;
				ibFill = k_cubPage;
				m_ibCursor -= k_cubPage;
				ibCursor = m_ibCursor;
			}
			cubWanted = ibFill;
		}
		else if ( cubValid )
		{
			if ( cubValid < sizeof( m_rgubWindow ) )
				return nullptr;

			memcpy( m_rgubWindow, m_rgubWindow + k_cubPage, k_cubPage );
			m_ulWindowOffset += k_cubPage;
			ibFill = k_cubPage;
			cubWanted = k_cubPage;
			m_ibCursor -= k_cubPage;
		}

		if ( cubWanted )
		{
			u32 cubGot;
			if ( IsFile() )
			{
				DWORD cubRead = 0;
				m_pImports->ReadFile( m_hFile, m_rgubWindow + ibFill, cubWanted, &cubRead, nullptr );
				cubGot = cubRead;
			}
			else
			{
				const u64 ulAddress = m_ulWindowOffset + m_ulRemoteBase + ibFill;
				u64 cubRead = 0;
				ReadVirtualMemory( m_pImports, m_hProcess, ulAddress, m_rgubWindow + ibFill, cubWanted, &cubRead );
				cubGot = static_cast<u32>( cubRead );
				if ( !cubRead && cubWanted > k_cubPage )
				{
					ReadVirtualMemory( m_pImports, m_hProcess, ulAddress, m_rgubWindow + ibFill, k_cubPage, &cubRead );
					cubGot = static_cast<u32>( cubRead );
					if ( !cubRead )
						return nullptr;
				}
			}
			ibCursor = m_ibCursor;
			m_cubValid = cubGot + ibFill;
		}

		if ( ibCursor + cub > m_cubValid )
			return nullptr;
	}

	m_ibCursor = ibCursor + cub;
	return m_rgubWindow + ibCursor;
}

// @orig: 51 51 55 56 33 F6
bool CPeReader::Read( void *pOutput, u32 cub ) noexcept
{
	u32 ibDone = 0;
	if ( !cub )
		return true;

	do
	{
		u32 cubChunk = cub - ibDone;
		if ( cubChunk > k_cubPage )
			cubChunk = k_cubPage;

		const u8 *pubChunk = ReadChunk( cubChunk );
		if ( !pubChunk )
			return false;

		memcpy( static_cast<u8 *>( pOutput ) + ibDone, pubChunk, cubChunk );
		ibDone += cubChunk;
	} while ( ibDone != cub );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 56 57
bool CPeReader::Seek( u32 ibOffset ) noexcept
{
	if ( m_ulWindowOffset + m_ibCursor == ibOffset )
		return true;

	if ( ibOffset < m_ulWindowOffset || ibOffset >= m_ulWindowOffset + m_cubValid )
	{
		m_ibCursor = ibOffset % k_cubPage;
		m_ulWindowOffset = ibOffset - m_ibCursor;
		m_cubValid = 0;
		if ( IsFile() && m_pImports->SetFilePointer( m_hFile, static_cast<LONG>( m_ulWindowOffset ), nullptr,
		                                             FILE_BEGIN ) != static_cast<DWORD>( m_ulWindowOffset ) )
		{
			CloseSource();
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	m_ibCursor = ibOffset - static_cast<u32>( m_ulWindowOffset );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 53 0F B7 99
const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *CPeReader::FindSectionByName( const char *pszName ) const noexcept
{
	const u32 cSections = m_FileHeaderWithOverlay.NumberOfSections;
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		if ( CompareName( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( m_pSections[iSection].Name ), pszName,
		                  IMAGE_SIZEOF_SHORT_NAME ) == 0 )
			return &m_pSections[iSection];
	}
	return nullptr;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 57 BD
EScanStatus CPeReader::ParseHeaders() noexcept
{
	if ( !Read( &m_DosHeader, sizeof( m_DosHeader ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	if ( m_DosHeader.e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;

	if ( !Read( m_rgubDosStub, sizeof( m_rgubDosStub ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;

	if ( !Seek( static_cast<u32>( m_DosHeader.e_lfanew ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::SeekFailed;

	u32 unSignature;
	if ( !Read( &unSignature, sizeof( unSignature ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	if ( unSignature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;

	if ( !Read( &m_FileHeader, sizeof( m_FileHeader ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	memcpy( &m_FileHeaderWithOverlay, &m_FileHeader, sizeof( m_FileHeader ) );

	if ( ( m_FileHeaderWithOverlay.Machine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386 &&
	       m_FileHeaderWithOverlay.Machine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64 ) ||
	     m_FileHeaderWithOverlay.NumberOfSections > pe::k_cMaxSections )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;

	const u16 cubOptional = m_FileHeaderWithOverlay.SizeOfOptionalHeader;
	if ( cubOptional == sizeof( m_Optional64 ) )
	{
		if ( !Read( &m_Optional64, sizeof( m_Optional64 ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
		if ( m_Optional64.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC )
			return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
		m_bPe64 = true;
	}
	else if ( cubOptional == sizeof( m_Optional32 ) )
	{
		if ( !Read( &m_Optional32, sizeof( m_Optional32 ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
		if ( m_Optional32.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC )
			return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
	}
	else
	{
		return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
	}

	// @note / sapdragon: one more slot than valve, which grows the array for .extra later
	const u32 cSections = m_FileHeaderWithOverlay.NumberOfSections;
	m_pSections =
	    static_cast<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *>( util::HeapAlloc( sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) * ( cSections + 1 ) ) );
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		if ( !Read( &m_pSections[iSection], sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	}

	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 53 56 57 8B D9 E8
void CPeReader::AttachProcess( u64 ulBase, HANDLE hProcess ) noexcept
{
	Release();
	CloseSource();
	m_ulRemoteBase = ulBase;
	m_hProcess = hProcess;
}

// @orig: 51 56 57 8B F1
EScanStatus CPeReader::ParseProcessImage( u64 ulBase, HANDLE hProcess ) noexcept
{
	Release();
	AttachProcess( ulBase, hProcess );

	const EScanStatus eStatus = ParseHeaders();
	if ( eStatus != EScanStatus::Ok )
	{
		Release();
		return eStatus;
	}
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @note / sapdragon: only the file path gets ".extra", memory has no overlay. it never gets hashed, the reason it
// exists is that LoadRelocations can find its table in it
// @orig: 51 53 55 56 8B F1 57 83 BE
EScanStatus CPeReader::ParseFile() noexcept
{
	if ( !IsFile() )
		return EScanStatus::NoFile;

	const EScanStatus eStatus = ParseHeaders();
	if ( eStatus != EScanStatus::Ok )
	{
		Release();
		return eStatus;
	}

	u32 cSections = m_FileHeaderWithOverlay.NumberOfSections;
	const u32 cubFile = file::GetFileSizeOrZero( m_pImports, m_hFile );
	const u32 unAlignment = m_bPe64 ? m_Optional64.SectionAlignment : m_Optional32.SectionAlignment;
	// @note / sapdragon: false means overlay plus zero alignment, where valve divides by zero and dies. we treat it as
	// a bad image so the caller falls back to the raw hash
	if ( !pe::AppendOverlaySection( m_pSections, &cSections, cubFile, unAlignment ) )
	{
		Release();
		return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
	}
	m_FileHeaderWithOverlay.NumberOfSections = static_cast<WORD>( cSections );
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @note / sapdragon: valve's version also frees a few arrays that nothing in this binary ever fills
// @orig: 53 56 57 8B F1
void CPeReader::Release() noexcept
{
	CloseSource();
	util::HeapFree( m_pSections );
	util::HeapFree( m_pubRelocations );
	m_pSections = nullptr;
	m_pubRelocations = nullptr;
	m_cubRelocations = 0;
	m_ulRelocationDelta = 0;
	m_bPe64 = false;
}

// @orig: 51 56 8B F1 57 80 BE
bool CPeReader::LoadRelocations() noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory =
	    *pe::GetDataDirectory( m_bPe64 ? static_cast<const void *>( &m_Optional64 ) : &m_Optional32, m_bPe64,
	                           IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC );
	m_cubRelocations = directory.Size;
	if ( !m_cubRelocations )
		return true;

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection =
	    pe::FindSectionByRva( m_pSections, m_FileHeaderWithOverlay.NumberOfSections, directory.VirtualAddress );
	u32 cubToFile = 0;
	if ( pSection && IsFile() )
		cubToFile = pSection->VirtualAddress - pSection->PointerToRawData;

	if ( !Seek( directory.VirtualAddress - cubToFile ) )
		return false;

	m_pubRelocations = static_cast<u8 *>( util::HeapAlloc( m_cubRelocations ) );
	return Read( m_pubRelocations, m_cubRelocations );
}

// @orig: 8B 81 ? ? ? ? 0B 81 ? ? ? ? 74 ? B0
bool CPeReader::IsRelocated() const noexcept
{
	if ( m_ulRelocationDelta )
		return true;
	if ( IsFile() )
		return false;
	return m_ulRemoteBase != GetImageBase();
}

// @note / sapdragon: pe::ApplyRelocationsForHash is not this. valve fails on an unknown type and patches a dword that
// crosses the chunk end, the overflow sits in the window and goes into the next chunk's hash. a bad block size is not
// checked either, it hangs or faults just like the original
// @orig: 51 51 8B 44 24
bool CPeReader::ApplyRelocations( u8 *pubChunk, u32 unChunkRva, u32 cubChunk ) noexcept
{
	const u32 unChunkEnd = unChunkRva + cubChunk;
	if ( m_bPe64 )
		return false;

	u32 ibBlock = m_ibRelocationCursor;
	while ( ibBlock < m_cubRelocations )
	{
		const auto *punBlock = reinterpret_cast<const u32 *>( m_pubRelocations + ibBlock );
		const u32 unPageRva = punBlock[0];
		if ( unPageRva >= unChunkEnd )
			break;

		const auto *punEntry = reinterpret_cast<const u16 *>( punBlock + 2 );
		const i32 cEntries = static_cast<i32>( ( punBlock[1] - sizeof( IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION ) ) >> 1 );
		if ( unPageRva + k_cubPage > unChunkRva )
		{
			for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < cEntries; ++iEntry )
			{
				const u32 unEntry = punEntry[iEntry];
				const u32 unPatchRva = unPageRva + ( unEntry & 0xFFF );
				if ( unPatchRva < unChunkRva )
					continue;
				if ( unPatchRva >= unChunkEnd )
					return true;

				const u32 unType = unEntry >> 12;
				if ( unType == IMAGE_REL_BASED_ABSOLUTE )
					continue;
				if ( unType != IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGHLOW )
					return false;

				u8 *pubValue = pubChunk + ( unPatchRva - unChunkRva );
				const u32 unValue = util::Read32( pubValue ) - static_cast<u32>( m_ulRelocationDelta );
				memcpy( pubValue, &unValue, sizeof( unValue ) );
			}
		}

		ibBlock += punBlock[1];
		m_ibRelocationCursor = ibBlock;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 8B 45
void CPeReader::HashRangeAroundDirectories( const u8 *pubChunk, u32 unChunkRva, u32 cubChunk,
                                            crypto::hash::Md5_t &md5 ) const noexcept
{
	const void *pOptional = m_bPe64 ? static_cast<const void *>( &m_Optional64 ) : &m_Optional32;
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &iat = *pe::GetDataDirectory( pOptional, m_bPe64, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IAT );
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &exports = *pe::GetDataDirectory( pOptional, m_bPe64, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT );

	pe::RangePair_t iatSplit;
	pe::SplitAroundDirectory( iat.VirtualAddress, iat.Size, unChunkRva, unChunkRva + cubChunk, iatSplit );

	pe::RangePair_t first;
	pe::RangePair_t second;
	pe::SplitAroundDirectory( exports.VirtualAddress, exports.Size, iatSplit.m_rgunStart[0], iatSplit.m_rgunEnd[0],
	                          first );
	pe::SplitAroundDirectory( exports.VirtualAddress, exports.Size, iatSplit.m_rgunStart[1], iatSplit.m_rgunEnd[1],
	                          second );

	const u32 rgunStarts[4] = { first.m_rgunStart[0], first.m_rgunStart[1], second.m_rgunStart[0],
	                            second.m_rgunStart[1] };
	const u32 rgunEnds[4] = { first.m_rgunEnd[0], first.m_rgunEnd[1], second.m_rgunEnd[0], second.m_rgunEnd[1] };
	for ( u32 iRange = 0; iRange < 4; ++iRange )
	{
		if ( rgunEnds[iRange] > rgunStarts[iRange] )
			md5.Update( pubChunk + rgunStarts[iRange] - unChunkRva, rgunEnds[iRange] - rgunStarts[iRange] );
	}
}

// @orig: 80 B9 ? ? ? ? ? 74 ? 8B 81 ? ? ? ? 8B 91
u64 CPeReader::GetImageBase() const noexcept
{
	return m_bPe64 ? m_Optional64.ImageBase : m_Optional32.ImageBase;
}

// @orig: 51 53 8B 5C 24
bool CPeReader::BeginSection( const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section ) noexcept
{
	if ( IsRelocated() )
	{
		if ( !m_pubRelocations && !LoadRelocations() )
			return false;
		if ( !m_ulRelocationDelta )
			m_ulRelocationDelta = m_ulRemoteBase - GetImageBase();
	}

	if ( !Seek( IsFile() ? section.PointerToRawData : section.VirtualAddress ) )
		return false;

	m_ibRelocationCursor = 0;
	m_unSectionRva = section.VirtualAddress;
	m_cubSectionLeft = section.SizeOfRawData;
	return true;
}

// @orig: 51 51 53 55 56 8B F1
bool CPeReader::HashNextChunk( crypto::hash::Md5_t &md5 ) noexcept
{
	u32 cubChunk = m_cubSectionLeft;
	if ( !cubChunk )
		return false;
	if ( static_cast<i32>( cubChunk ) > static_cast<i32>( k_cubPage ) )
		cubChunk = k_cubPage;

	u8 *pubChunk = ReadChunk( cubChunk );
	if ( !pubChunk )
		return false;
	if ( IsRelocated() && !m_bPe64 && !ApplyRelocations( pubChunk, m_unSectionRva, cubChunk ) )
		return false;

	HashRangeAroundDirectories( pubChunk, m_unSectionRva, cubChunk, md5 );

	m_unSectionRva += cubChunk;
	m_cubSectionLeft -= cubChunk;
	return m_cubSectionLeft != 0;
}

// @orig: 56 FF 74 24 ? 8B F1 FF 74 24
bool CPeReader::HashSection( const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section, crypto::hash::Md5_t &md5 ) noexcept
{
	if ( !BeginSection( section ) )
		return false;

	while ( HashNextChunk( md5 ) )
	{
	}
	return m_cubSectionLeft == 0;
}

// @note / sapdragon: valve's hash context can also do a CRC, and this function has a raw mode that keeps the load
// address in the hash. both callers always pass plain MD5 and normalized
// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 8B BC 24
bool CPeReader::HashImage( u8 *pubDigest ) noexcept
{
	crypto::hash::Md5_t md5;

	const u64 ulBase = IsFile() ? GetImageBase() : m_ulRemoteBase;
	m_ulRelocationDelta = ulBase - pe::k_unRelocationBase;

	md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &m_DosHeader ), sizeof( m_DosHeader ) );
	md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &m_FileHeader ), sizeof( m_FileHeader ) );

	IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 optional64;
	IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32 optional32;
	memcpy( &optional64, &m_Optional64, sizeof( optional64 ) );
	memcpy( &optional32, &m_Optional32, sizeof( optional32 ) );
	optional64.ImageBase = 0;
	optional32.ImageBase = 0;
	if ( m_bPe64 )
		md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &optional64 ), sizeof( optional64 ) );
	else
		md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &optional32 ), sizeof( optional32 ) );

	const u32 cSections = m_FileHeaderWithOverlay.NumberOfSections;
	if ( !cSections )
		return false;

	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections && iSection < m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = m_pSections[iSection];
		md5.Update( section.Name, IMAGE_SIZEOF_SHORT_NAME );
		md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &section.VirtualAddress ), sizeof( section.VirtualAddress ) );
		md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &section.SizeOfRawData ), sizeof( section.SizeOfRawData ) );
	}

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSelected = pe::SelectHashSection( m_pSections, cSections );
	if ( !pSelected || !HashSection( *pSelected, md5 ) )
		return false;

	md5.Final( pubDigest );
	return true;
}

bool CPeReader::HasValveStub() const noexcept
{
	return util::Read32( m_rgubDosStub ) == k_unValveStubMagic && util::Read32( m_rgubDosStub + 4 ) == 1 &&
	       util::Read32( m_rgubDosStub + 8 ) != 0;
}

u32 CPeReader::GetSizeOfImage() const noexcept
{
	return m_bPe64 ? m_Optional64.SizeOfImage : m_Optional32.SizeOfImage;
}
```

```cpp
// @binary: 8d88e017
#include "internal/process_context.hpp"
#include "core/vac_util.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "util/wstr.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
{

namespace
{

constexpr u32 k_cubMaxLdrName = 0x206;
constexpr i32 k_cMaxLdrEntries = 1000;

struct LdrName_t
{
	wchar_t m_rgwch[( k_cubMaxLdrName + 8 ) / sizeof( wchar_t )];
};

void StoreLdrName( LdrModule_t &module, LdrName_t &name, u32 cubName ) noexcept
{
	name.m_rgwch[cubName >> 1] = 0;
	CopyWideFilled( module.m_wszFullPath, name.m_rgwch, MAX_PATH );
	// @note / sapdragon: valve's copy reads past the string into the stack here. only the path is ever read back
	const wchar_t *pwszBase = util::wstr::BaseName( module.m_wszFullPath );
	if ( pwszBase )
		util::wstr::Copy( module.m_wszBaseName, pwszBase, 256 );
}

void AppendLdrModule( ProcessContext_t &context, const LdrModule_t &module ) noexcept
{
	context.m_pModules = static_cast<LdrModule_t *>(
	    ResizeOrAlloc( context.m_pModules, sizeof( LdrModule_t ) * ( context.m_cModules + 1 ) ) );
	context.m_pModules[context.m_cModules] = module;
	++context.m_cModules;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 8A 84 24 ? ? ? ? 53 55 8B D9
EScanStatus CaptureLdr64( ProcessContext_t &context, u32 unPid, const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	context.m_unPid = unPid;
	context.m_ulCreateTime = 0;
	context.m_cModules = 0;
	context.m_pModules = nullptr;

	FILETIME rgTimes[4];
	if ( pImports->GetProcessTimes( context.m_hProcess, &rgTimes[0], &rgTimes[1], &rgTimes[2], &rgTimes[3] ) )
	{
		context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Times64;
		memcpy( &context.m_ulCreateTime, &rgTimes[0], sizeof( context.m_ulCreateTime ) );
	}

	const HANDLE hProcess = context.m_hProcess;
	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Entered64;

	nt::ProcessBasicInformation64_t basic;
	ULONG cubBasic = 0;
	if ( IsCross64( pImports, hProcess ) )
	{
		if ( pImports->NtWow64QueryInformationProcess64 )
			pImports->NtWow64QueryInformationProcess64( hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation, &basic, sizeof( basic ),
			                                            &cubBasic );
	}
	else if ( pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess )
	{
		ULONG cubNative = 0;
		pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess( hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation, &basic, sizeof( basic ), &cubNative );
		cubBasic = cubNative;
	}
	if ( cubBasic != sizeof( basic ) )
		return EScanStatus::BasicInfoFailed;

	context.m_unParentPid = static_cast<u32>( basic.m_ulInheritedFromUniqueProcessId );
	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::BasicInfo64;
	if ( !basic.m_ulPebBaseAddress )
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;

	u64 cubRead = 0;
	nt::Peb64_t peb;
	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebAddress64;
	ReadVirtualMemory( pImports, hProcess, basic.m_ulPebBaseAddress, &peb, sizeof( nt::Peb64_t ), &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != sizeof( nt::Peb64_t ) )
		return EScanStatus::PebReadFailed;
	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebRead64;

	nt::PebLdrData64_t ldr;
	ReadVirtualMemory( pImports, hProcess, peb.m_ulLdr, &ldr, nt::Arch64_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot, &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != nt::Arch64_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot )
	{
		context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrReadFailed;
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}
	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrRead64;

	const u64 ulFirst = ldr.m_InLoadOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
	if ( !ulFirst )
	{
		context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrEmpty64;
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}

	nt::LdrDataTableEntry64_t entry;
	ReadVirtualMemory( pImports, hProcess, ulFirst, &entry, nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot, &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot )
	{
		context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntryFailed64;
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}
	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntry64;

	u32 unIndex = 1;
	for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < k_cMaxLdrEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		LdrModule_t module;
		memset( &module, 0, sizeof( module ) );
		module.m_unIndex = unIndex;
		module.m_ulBase = entry.m_ulDllBase;
		module.m_cubImage = entry.m_cubSizeOfImage;
		++unIndex;

		const u32 cubName = entry.m_FullDllName.m_cubLength;
		if ( cubName >= k_cubMaxLdrName )
		{
			context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameTooLong;
		}
		else
		{
			LdrName_t name;
			cubRead = 0;
			ReadVirtualMemory( pImports, hProcess, entry.m_FullDllName.m_ulBuffer, name.m_rgwch, cubName, &cubRead );
			if ( cubRead != cubName )
				context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameReadFailed;
			else
				StoreLdrName( module, name, cubName );
		}

		AppendLdrModule( context, module );

		const u64 ulNext = entry.m_InLoadOrderLinks.m_ulFlink;
		if ( !ulNext || ulNext == ulFirst )
			break;

		ReadVirtualMemory( pImports, hProcess, ulNext, &entry, nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot )
			break;
		// @note / sapdragon: the list head reads as an entry with no DllBase, that is the real end of the list
		if ( !entry.m_ulDllBase )
			break;
	}
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 8A 45
bool ReadNextLdrEntry32( ProcessContext_t &context, u32 unStop, nt::LdrDataTableEntry32_t &entry,
                         const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	const u32 unNext = entry.m_InLoadOrderLinks.m_ulFlink;
	if ( !unNext || unNext == unStop )
		return false;

	SIZE_T cubRead = 0;
	pImports->ReadProcessMemory( context.m_hProcess, reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>( static_cast<uptr>( unNext ) ), &entry,
	                             nt::Arch32_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot, &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != nt::Arch32_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot )
	{
		context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::EntryReadFailed;
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}
```
