```cpp
void *ResizeOrAlloc( void *pMemory, usize cubSize ) noexcept
{
	if ( pMemory )
		return ::HeapReAlloc( ::GetProcessHeap(), 0, pMemory, cubSize );
	return ::HeapAlloc( ::GetProcessHeap(), 0, cubSize );
}

// @note / sapdragon: copies all cChars even past the terminator, then clears the tail. a source that long is left
// without a terminator. not wstr::Copy
// @orig: 53 56 57 8B 7C 24
void CopyWideFilled( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc, u32 cChars ) noexcept
{
	memcpy( pwszDst, pwszSrc, cChars * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
	const u32 cchSrc = static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( pwszSrc ) );
	if ( cChars > cchSrc )
		memset( pwszDst + cchSrc, 0, ( cChars - cchSrc ) * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
}

// @orig: 53 55 57 8B E9
int CompareNoCase( const wchar_t *pwszA, const wchar_t *pwszB, u32 cMaxChars ) noexcept
{
	u32 cchA = static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( pwszA ) );
	u32 cchB = static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( pwszB ) );
	if ( cchA > cMaxChars )
		cchA = cMaxChars;
	if ( cchB > cMaxChars )
		cchB = cMaxChars;
	return CompareStringW( LOCALE_SYSTEM_DEFAULT, NORM_IGNORECASE, pwszA, static_cast<int>( cchA ), pwszB,
	                       static_cast<int>( cchB ) ) -
	       CSTR_EQUAL;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 56
bool IsCross64( const SystemImports_t *pImports, HANDLE hProcess ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pImports->IsWow64Process )
		return false;

	BOOL bSelf = FALSE;
	BOOL bTarget = FALSE;
	pImports->IsWow64Process( pImports->GetCurrentProcess(), &bSelf );
	if ( !bSelf )
		return false;
	if ( hProcess == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return true;
	pImports->IsWow64Process( hProcess, &bTarget );
	return !bTarget;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 51 56
NTSTATUS QueryVirtualMemory( const SystemImports_t *pImports, HANDLE hProcess, u64 ulAddress,
                             EMemoryInformationClass eClass, void *pOutput, u32 cubOutput, u64 *pcubReturned ) noexcept
{
	if ( IsCross64( pImports, hProcess ) )
	{
		if ( pImports->NtWow64QueryVirtualMemory64 )
			return pImports->NtWow64QueryVirtualMemory64( hProcess, reinterpret_cast<PVOID64>( ulAddress ),
			                                              static_cast<DWORD>( eClass ), pOutput, cubOutput,
			                                              reinterpret_cast<PULONG64>( pcubReturned ) );
	}
	else if ( pImports->NtQueryVirtualMemory )
	{
		ULONG cubReturned = 0;
		const NTSTATUS nStatus =
		    pImports->NtQueryVirtualMemory( hProcess, reinterpret_cast<void *>( static_cast<uptr>( ulAddress ) ),
		                                    static_cast<DWORD>( eClass ), pOutput, cubOutput, &cubReturned );
		*pcubReturned = cubReturned;
		return nStatus;
	}
	return 0;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 51 83 65
NTSTATUS ReadVirtualMemory( const SystemImports_t *pImports, HANDLE hProcess, u64 ulAddress, void *pOutput,
                            u32 cubOutput, u64 *pcubRead ) noexcept
{
	if ( IsCross64( pImports, hProcess ) )
	{
		if ( pImports->NtWow64ReadVirtualMemory64 )
			return pImports->NtWow64ReadVirtualMemory64( hProcess, reinterpret_cast<PVOID64>( ulAddress ), pOutput,
			                                             cubOutput, reinterpret_cast<PULONG64>( pcubRead ) );
	}
	else if ( pImports->NtReadVirtualMemory )
	{
		ULONG cubRead = 0;
		const NTSTATUS nStatus = pImports->NtReadVirtualMemory(
		    hProcess, reinterpret_cast<void *>( static_cast<uptr>( ulAddress ) ), pOutput, cubOutput, &cubRead );
		*pcubRead = cubRead;
		return nStatus;
	}
	return 0;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 56 8D 45
u32 QueryBasicInformation( const SystemImports_t *pImports, HANDLE hProcess, u64 ulAddress,
                           MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION64 *pInformation ) noexcept
{
	u64 cubReturned = 0;
	if ( IsCross64( pImports, hProcess ) )
	{
		QueryVirtualMemory( pImports, hProcess, ulAddress, EMemoryInformationClass::Basic, pInformation,
		                    sizeof( MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION64 ), &cubReturned );
		return static_cast<u32>( cubReturned );
	}

	MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION32 native;
	QueryVirtualMemory( pImports, hProcess, ulAddress, EMemoryInformationClass::Basic, &native, sizeof( native ),
	                    &cubReturned );
	if ( cubReturned != sizeof( native ) )
		return static_cast<u32>( cubReturned );

	// @note / sapdragon: both addresses are sign extended, so a large address aware target gets a high dword of all
	// ones. the region size is not
	pInformation->AllocationBase = static_cast<u64>( static_cast<i64>( static_cast<i32>( native.AllocationBase ) ) );
	pInformation->AllocationProtect = native.AllocationProtect;
	pInformation->BaseAddress = static_cast<u64>( static_cast<i64>( static_cast<i32>( native.BaseAddress ) ) );
	pInformation->RegionSize = native.RegionSize;
	pInformation->Protect = native.Protect;
	pInformation->State = native.State;
	pInformation->Type = native.Type;
	return sizeof( MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION64 );
}

// @note / sapdragon: the name always comes from offset 8, the native UNICODE_STRING layout, also for a 64-bit target
// @orig: 55 8B EC 81 EC
u32 GetMappedFileName( const SystemImports_t *pImports, HANDLE hProcess, u64 ulAddress, wchar_t *pwszName ) noexcept
{
	wchar_t rgwchBuffer[( 8 + 1072 ) / sizeof( wchar_t )];
	const u32 cubQuery = sizeof( UNICODE_STRING ) + MAX_PATH * sizeof( wchar_t );
	u64 cubReturned = cubQuery;
	if ( QueryVirtualMemory( pImports, hProcess, ulAddress, EMemoryInformationClass::MappedFilename, rgwchBuffer,
	                         cubQuery, &cubReturned ) != 0 )
	{
		pImports->GetLastError();
		return 0;
	}

	*pwszName = 0;
	if ( cubReturned <= 8 )
		return 0;

	const u32 cchReturned = static_cast<u32>( cubReturned ) >> 1;
	if ( cchReturned >= MAX_PATH )
		return 0;

	rgwchBuffer[cchReturned] = 0;
	CopyWideFilled( pwszName, rgwchBuffer + 4, MAX_PATH );
	return cchReturned;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 33 C0
bool DevicePathToDosPath( const SystemImports_t *pImports, wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	wchar_t wszDrives[MAX_PATH];
	wszDrives[0] = 0;
	if ( !pImports->GetLogicalDriveStringsW( 250, wszDrives ) )
		return false;

	const wchar_t *pwchDrive = wszDrives;
	wchar_t wszDrive[4] = L"C:";
	wchar_t wszDevice[MAX_PATH];
	u32 cchDevice;
	wchar_t wchDrive = wszDrives[0];
	for ( ;; )
	{
		wszDrive[0] = wchDrive;
		if ( pImports->QueryDosDeviceW( wszDrive, wszDevice, MAX_PATH ) )
		{
			cchDevice = static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( wszDevice ) );
			if ( cchDevice < MAX_PATH && CompareNoCase( pwszPath, wszDevice, cchDevice ) == 0 )
				break;
		}
		while ( *pwchDrive++ )
		{
		}
		wchDrive = *pwchDrive;
		if ( !wchDrive )
			return false;
	}

	wchar_t wszJoined[MAX_PATH];
	wszJoined[0] = 0;
	lstrcatW( wszJoined, wszDrive );
	lstrcatW( wszJoined, &pwszPath[cchDevice] );
	CopyWideFilled( pwszPath, wszJoined, MAX_PATH );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 8A 84 24 ? ? ? ? 53 55 56
EScanStatus OpenProcessAndCaptureLdr( ProcessContext_t &context, u32 unPid, const SystemImports_t *pImports,
                                      const ModuleSession_t *pSession ) noexcept
{
	context.m_eCaptureFlags = process::ECaptureFlags::None;
	context.m_ulCreateTime = 0;

	context.m_hProcess = pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );
	if ( ( pSession->m_OsVersion.dwPlatformId != VER_PLATFORM_WIN32_NT ||
	       pSession->m_OsVersion.dwMajorVersion < HIBYTE( _WIN32_WINNT_VISTA ) ) &&
	     ( !context.m_hProcess || context.m_hProcess == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ) )
		context.m_hProcess = pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );

	if ( !context.m_hProcess )
	{
		context.m_unLastError = pImports->GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::ProcessOpenFailed;
	}

	context.m_unPid = unPid;
	context.m_cModules = 0;
	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Opened;
	context.m_pModules = nullptr;

	FILETIME rgTimes[4];
	if ( pImports->GetProcessTimes( context.m_hProcess, &rgTimes[0], &rgTimes[1], &rgTimes[2], &rgTimes[3] ) )
	{
		context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Times;
		memcpy( &context.m_ulCreateTime, &rgTimes[0], sizeof( context.m_ulCreateTime ) );
	}

	context.m_bSelfWow64 = IsCross64( pImports, ::GetCurrentProcess() );
	context.m_bCross64 = IsCross64( pImports, context.m_hProcess );
	pImports->CloseHandle( context.m_hProcess );

	context.m_hProcess = pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ, FALSE, unPid );
	if ( !context.m_hProcess )
	{
		context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::ReopenFailed;
		context.m_unLastError = pImports->GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReopenFailed;
	}
	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Reopened;

	if ( context.m_bCross64 )
	{
		context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Cross64;
		return CaptureLdr64( context, unPid, pImports );
	}

	nt::ProcessBasicInformation32_t basic;
	ULONG cubBasic = 0;
	pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess( context.m_hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation, &basic, sizeof( basic ),
	                                     &cubBasic );
	if ( cubBasic != sizeof( basic ) )
		return EScanStatus::BasicInfoFailed;

	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::BasicInfo;
	context.m_unParentPid = basic.m_ulInheritedFromUniqueProcessId;
	if ( !basic.m_ulPebBaseAddress )
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: valve stores this name in a field nothing reads back
		u8 rgubImageName[520];
		ULONG cubImageName = 1;
		pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess( context.m_hProcess, ProcessImageFileName, rgubImageName,
		                                     sizeof( rgubImageName ), &cubImageName );
		return EScanStatus::NoPeb;
	}

	SIZE_T cubRead = 0;
	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebAddress;
	pImports->ReadProcessMemory( context.m_hProcess,
	                             reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>( static_cast<uptr>( basic.m_ulPebBaseAddress ) ),
	                             &context.m_Peb, sizeof( nt::Peb32_t ), &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != sizeof( nt::Peb32_t ) )
		return EScanStatus::PebReadFailed;
	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebRead;

	nt::PebLdrData32_t ldr;
	pImports->ReadProcessMemory( context.m_hProcess,
	                             reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>( static_cast<uptr>( context.m_Peb.m_ulLdr ) ), &ldr,
	                             nt::Arch32_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot, &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != nt::Arch32_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot )
	{
		context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrReadFailed;
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}
	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrRead;

	const u32 unStop = ldr.m_InLoadOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
	nt::LdrDataTableEntry32_t entry;
	entry.m_InLoadOrderLinks.m_ulFlink = unStop;
	if ( !ReadNextLdrEntry32( context, 0, entry, pImports ) )
	{
		context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntryFailed;
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}
	context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntry;

	u32 unIndex = 1;
	i32 cEntriesLeft = k_cMaxLdrEntries;
	for ( ;; )
	{
		--cEntriesLeft;

		LdrModule_t module;
		memset( &module, 0, sizeof( module ) );
		// @note / sapdragon: 4096 and not SizeOfImage, this path only matches an address in the first page of a
		// module. the base is sign extended too
		module.m_ulBase = static_cast<u64>( static_cast<i64>( static_cast<i32>( entry.m_ulDllBase ) ) );
		module.m_unIndex = unIndex++;
		module.m_cubImage = 0x1000;

		const u32 cubName = entry.m_FullDllName.m_cubLength;
		if ( cubName >= k_cubMaxLdrName )
		{
			context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameTooLong;
		}
		else
		{
			LdrName_t name;
			cubRead = 0;
			pImports->ReadProcessMemory(
			    context.m_hProcess, reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>( static_cast<uptr>( entry.m_FullDllName.m_ulBuffer ) ),
			    name.m_rgwch, cubName, &cubRead );
			if ( cubRead == cubName )
				StoreLdrName( module, name, cubName );
			else
				context.m_eCaptureFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameReadFailed;
		}

		AppendLdrModule( context, module );

		if ( !ReadNextLdrEntry32( context, unStop, entry, pImports ) || !entry.m_ulDllBase )
			break;
		if ( cEntriesLeft <= 0 )
		{
			--cEntriesLeft;
			break;
		}
	}

	// @note / sapdragon: only when entry 1000 was the last one read, running over the limit reports success
	return cEntriesLeft == 0 ? EScanStatus::TooManyModules : EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 8E
void ReleaseProcessContext( ProcessContext_t &context, const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	util::HeapFree( context.m_pModules );
	context.m_pModules = nullptr;
	context.m_cModules = 0;

	if ( context.m_hProcess != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && context.m_hProcess )
		pImports->CloseHandle( context.m_hProcess );

	memset( &context, 0, sizeof( context ) );
	context.m_hProcess = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
}

// @orig: 8B 44 24 ? 3B 81
const LdrModule_t *GetLdrModule( const ProcessContext_t &context, i32 iModule ) noexcept
{
	return iModule < context.m_cModules ? &context.m_pModules[iModule] : nullptr;
}

// @orig: 53 55 56 8B B1
const LdrModule_t *FindLdrModuleContaining( const ProcessContext_t &context, u64 ulAddress ) noexcept
{
	for ( i32 iModule = 0; iModule < context.m_cModules; ++iModule )
	{
		const LdrModule_t &module = context.m_pModules[iModule];
		if ( ulAddress >= module.m_ulBase && ulAddress < module.m_ulBase + module.m_cubImage )
			return &module;
	}
	return nullptr;
}

// @orig: 53 55 56 57 8B F9 33 F6 39 B7
const LdrModule_t *FindLdrModuleByPath( const ProcessContext_t &context, const wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	for ( i32 iModule = 0; iModule < context.m_cModules; ++iModule )
	{
		const LdrModule_t &module = context.m_pModules[iModule];
		if ( CompareNoCase( module.m_wszFullPath, pwszPath, 520 ) == 0 )
			return &module;
	}
	return nullptr;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 E4 ? 83 EC
bool WalkAllocation( const SystemImports_t *pImports, HANDLE hProcess, AllocationWalk_t &walk ) noexcept
{
	bool bReservedAfterCommit = false;
	const u64 ulPrevious = walk.m_ulPreviousStart;
	walk.m_ulFirstCommitted = 0;
	walk.m_ulLastCommitEnd = 0;
	walk.m_ulCommitPrefixEnd = 0;
	walk.m_cubTotal = 0;
	walk.m_unProtectUnion = 0;
	walk.m_unExecuteProtectUnion = 0;
	walk.m_cRegions = 0;
	walk.m_cCommittedRegions = 0;
	walk.m_cubCommitPrefix = 0;
	if ( ulPrevious && walk.m_ulCursor <= ulPrevious )
		return false;

	walk.m_ulPreviousStart = walk.m_ulCursor;
	walk.m_ulQueryAddress = walk.m_ulCursor;
	if ( QueryBasicInformation( pImports, hProcess, walk.m_ulCursor, &walk.m_First ) !=
	     sizeof( MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION64 ) )
	{
		walk.m_unLastError = pImports->GetLastError();
		return false;
	}
	if ( walk.m_First.RegionSize == 0xFFFFFFFFu )
		return false;

	u64 ulAddress = walk.m_ulCursor;
	walk.m_ulQueryAddress = ulAddress;
	MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION64 region;
	u32 cubQueried = QueryBasicInformation( pImports, hProcess, ulAddress, &region );
	walk.m_ulCursor = ulAddress;
	for ( ;; )
	{
		if ( cubQueried != sizeof( MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION64 ) )
		{
			walk.m_unLastError = pImports->GetLastError();
			return true;
		}
		if ( region.AllocationBase != walk.m_First.AllocationBase )
			return true;

		const u64 ulNext = ulAddress + region.RegionSize;
		if ( region.State == MEM_FREE )
		{
			walk.m_cubTotal += region.RegionSize;
			walk.m_ulCursor = ulNext;
			walk.m_unProtectUnion |= region.Protect;
			++walk.m_cRegions;
			return true;
		}

		if ( region.State == MEM_RESERVE )
		{
			if ( walk.m_ulFirstCommitted )
			{
				walk.m_cubTotal += region.RegionSize;
				bReservedAfterCommit = true;
			}
			++walk.m_cRegions;
		}
		else if ( region.State == MEM_COMMIT )
		{
			walk.m_ulLastCommitEnd = ulNext;
			if ( !bReservedAfterCommit )
			{
				walk.m_cubCommitPrefix += region.RegionSize;
				walk.m_ulCommitPrefixEnd = ulNext;
			}
			if ( !walk.m_ulFirstCommitted )
				walk.m_ulFirstCommitted = ulAddress;
			walk.m_cubTotal += region.RegionSize;
			walk.m_unProtectUnion |= region.Protect;
			if ( region.Protect & k_unPageExecuteAny )
				walk.m_unExecuteProtectUnion |= region.Protect;
			++walk.m_cRegions;
			++walk.m_cCommittedRegions;
		}

		if ( ulNext <= ulAddress )
			return true;

		walk.m_ulQueryAddress = ulNext;
		ulAddress = ulNext;
		cubQueried = QueryBasicInformation( pImports, hProcess, ulNext, &region );
		walk.m_ulCursor = ulNext;
	}
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "nt/nt.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
{

inline constexpr u32 k_unPageExecuteAny =
    PAGE_EXECUTE | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE | PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY;

enum class EMemoryInformationClass : DWORD
{
	Basic = 0,
	MappedFilename = 2,
};

struct LdrModule_t
{
	u32 m_cubImage;
	u64 m_ulBase;
	u32 m_unIndex;
	wchar_t m_wszBaseName[256];
	wchar_t m_wszFullPath[MAX_PATH];
};
VAC_LAYOUT( LdrModule_t, m_ulBase, 0x08 );
VAC_LAYOUT( LdrModule_t, m_unIndex, 0x10 );
VAC_LAYOUT( LdrModule_t, m_wszBaseName, 0x14 );
VAC_LAYOUT( LdrModule_t, m_wszFullPath, 0x214 );
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( LdrModule_t, 0x420 );
```

`modules/process_memory_map/internal/scan.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 8d88e017
#include "core/vac_util.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "internal/pe_reader.hpp"
#include "internal/report_builder.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
{

namespace
{

i32 CurrentStringRatio( const ReportBuilder_t &builder ) noexcept
{
	return builder.m_cubStrings ? GetRecordBytes( builder ) / builder.m_cubStrings : 1000;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 E4 ? B8 ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? 33 C0
EScanStatus ScanProcess( const ProcessContext_t &context, Report_t &report, u32 unScanStart, i32 nMaxHashes,
                         i32 nTrimRatio, u32 unMinHashBase, const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	report.m_cRecords = 0;
	report.m_cubStrings = 0;
	report.m_cHashesPacked = 0;
	report.m_cubCompressed = 0;
	report.m_cubPlain = 0;
	report.m_eFlags =
	    ( report.m_eFlags & static_cast<EReportFlags>( ~static_cast<u16>( EReportFlags::WideRecords ) ) ) |
	    ( context.m_bCross64 ? EReportFlags::WideRecords : EReportFlags::None );

	ReportBuilder_t builder;
	builder.m_cMaxRecords = k_cMaxRecords;
	builder.m_cubStrings = sizeof( builder.m_rgchStrings );
	builder.m_pubRecords = builder.m_rgubRecords;
	builder.m_pubRecordWrite = builder.m_rgubRecords;
	builder.m_pubLastRecord = builder.m_rgubRecords;
	builder.m_pubHashes = builder.m_rgubHashes;
	builder.m_pubHashWrite = builder.m_rgubHashes;
	builder.m_StringEnds.m_prgun = nullptr;
	builder.m_StringEnds.m_cCapacity = 0;
	builder.m_StringEnds.m_c = 0;
	builder.m_cRecords = 0;
	builder.m_cHashes = 0;
	builder.m_bWideRecords = context.m_bCross64;
	builder.m_cMaxHashes = nMaxHashes < k_cMaxHashes ? nMaxHashes : k_cMaxHashes;
	builder.m_ulMinHashBase = unMinHashBase;

	StringTable_t directoryTable;
	StringTable_t baseNameTable;
	InitStringTable( directoryTable );
	InitStringTable( baseNameTable );

	report.m_unScanStart = unScanStart;
	report.m_cLdrModules = static_cast<u16>( context.m_cModules > 0xFFFF ? 0xFFFF : context.m_cModules );
	report.m_cNamedOrPe = 0;
	report.m_cLdrMatches = 0;

	U32Vector_t directoryHashes;
	U32Vector_t baseNameHashes;
	memset( &directoryHashes, 0, sizeof( directoryHashes ) );
	memset( &baseNameHashes, 0, sizeof( baseNameHashes ) );

	AllocationWalk_t walk;
	memset( &walk, 0, sizeof( walk ) );
	walk.m_ulCursor = unScanStart;

	SystemDirectories_t directories;
	pImports->GetWindowsDirectoryW( directories.m_wszWindows, MAX_PATH );
	directories.m_cchWindows = lstrlenW( directories.m_wszWindows );
	pImports->GetSystemDirectoryW( directories.m_wszSystem, MAX_PATH );
	directories.m_cchSystem = lstrlenW( directories.m_wszSystem );

	i32 iNextLdrModule = 0;
	i32 nFoldedPages = 0;
	i32 cCleanRegions = 0;
	bool bPreviousClean = true;

	for ( ;; )
	{
		const LdrModule_t *pLdrModule;
		wchar_t wszLdrPath[MAX_PATH];
		wchar_t wszMappedPath[MAX_PATH];
		for ( ;; )
		{
			if ( !context.m_bCross64 || pImports->NtWow64QueryVirtualMemory64 )
			{
				if ( !WalkAllocation( pImports, context.m_hProcess, walk ) )
					goto scan_done;
			}
			else
			{
				// @note / sapdragon: no 64-bit query on this system, so the LDR list is all there is to walk
				const LdrModule_t *pNext = GetLdrModule( context, iNextLdrModule );
				if ( !pNext )
					goto scan_done;
				++iNextLdrModule;
				walk.m_ulFirstCommitted = pNext->m_ulBase;
				walk.m_First.BaseAddress = pNext->m_ulBase;
				walk.m_First.AllocationBase = pNext->m_ulBase;
				walk.m_cubCommitPrefix = pNext->m_cubImage;
			}

			pLdrModule = FindLdrModuleContaining( context, walk.m_ulFirstCommitted );
			wszLdrPath[0] = 0;
			if ( pLdrModule )
				CopyWideFilled( wszLdrPath, pLdrModule->m_wszFullPath, MAX_PATH );

			wszMappedPath[0] = 0;
			if ( GetMappedFileName( pImports, context.m_hProcess, walk.m_ulFirstCommitted, wszMappedPath ) )
				DevicePathToDosPath( pImports, wszMappedPath );

			if ( ( walk.m_unExecuteProtectUnion & k_unPageExecuteAny ) || pLdrModule )
				break;
		}

		PathEntry_t ldrEntry;
		PathEntry_t mappedEntry;
		ResetPathEntry( ldrEntry );
		ResetPathEntry( mappedEntry );

		u32 unDirectoryHash = 0;
		u32 unBaseNameHash = 0;
		bool bSecondRecord = false;
		if ( wszLdrPath[0] )
		{
			BuildPathEntry( ldrEntry, wszLdrPath, directories, pImports );
			AddString( directoryTable, ldrEntry.m_unDirectoryHash, ldrEntry.m_szDirectory, ldrEntry.m_cchDirectory );
			PushU32( directoryHashes, ldrEntry.m_unDirectoryHash );
			AddString( baseNameTable, ldrEntry.m_unBaseNameHash, ldrEntry.m_szBaseName, ldrEntry.m_cchBaseName );
			PushU32( baseNameHashes, ldrEntry.m_unBaseNameHash );
			unDirectoryHash = ldrEntry.m_unDirectoryHash;
			unBaseNameHash = ldrEntry.m_unBaseNameHash;
		}

		const u32 unLdrDirectoryHash = unDirectoryHash;
		if ( wszMappedPath[0] )
		{
			BuildPathEntry( mappedEntry, wszMappedPath, directories, pImports );
			if ( ldrEntry.m_unDirectoryHash != mappedEntry.m_unDirectoryHash ||
			     ldrEntry.m_unBaseNameHash != mappedEntry.m_unBaseNameHash )
			{
				AddString( directoryTable, mappedEntry.m_unDirectoryHash, mappedEntry.m_szDirectory,
				           mappedEntry.m_cchDirectory );
				PushU32( directoryHashes, mappedEntry.m_unDirectoryHash );
				AddString( baseNameTable, mappedEntry.m_unBaseNameHash, mappedEntry.m_szBaseName,
				           mappedEntry.m_cchBaseName );
				PushU32( baseNameHashes, mappedEntry.m_unBaseNameHash );
				if ( !unDirectoryHash )
					unDirectoryHash = mappedEntry.m_unDirectoryHash;
				if ( unBaseNameHash )
				{
					bSecondRecord = true;
				}
				else
				{
					unBaseNameHash = mappedEntry.m_unBaseNameHash;
					bSecondRecord = unLdrDirectoryHash != 0;
				}
			}
		}

		CPeReader headerReader( pImports );

		ERecordFlags eFlags = ERecordFlags::None;
		u32 cubImage = static_cast<u32>( walk.m_cubCommitPrefix );
		if ( ldrEntry.m_bInSystemDirectory || mappedEntry.m_bInSystemDirectory )
		{
			eFlags = ERecordFlags::SystemDirectory;
			bSecondRecord = false;
		}
		if ( ldrEntry.m_bInWindowsDirectory || mappedEntry.m_bInWindowsDirectory )
			eFlags |= ERecordFlags::WindowsDirectory;

		const LdrModule_t *pPathMatch = nullptr;
		if ( ldrEntry.m_bHasPath )
		{
			eFlags |= ERecordFlags::Named;
			pPathMatch = FindLdrModuleByPath( context, wszLdrPath );
		}
		else if ( mappedEntry.m_bHasPath )
		{
			eFlags |= ERecordFlags::Named;
			pPathMatch = FindLdrModuleByPath( context, wszMappedPath );
		}
		else if ( walk.m_unProtectUnion & PAGE_READONLY )
		{
			eFlags |= ERecordFlags::Odd;
		}

		if ( pLdrModule )
		{
			eFlags |= ERecordFlags::InLdr;
			++report.m_cLdrMatches;
		}
		if ( pPathMatch )
			eFlags |= ERecordFlags::PathInLdr;
		if ( walk.m_unExecuteProtectUnion & PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE )
			eFlags |= ERecordFlags::WritableExecute;

		const EScanStatus ePeStatus = headerReader.ParseProcessImage( walk.m_ulFirstCommitted, context.m_hProcess );
		if ( ePeStatus == EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader )
		{
			eFlags |= ERecordFlags::Odd;
		}
		else if ( ePeStatus == EScanStatus::Ok )
		{
			eFlags |= headerReader.FindSectionByName( ".text" ) ? ERecordFlags::PeImageWithText : ERecordFlags::PeImage;
			if ( !headerReader.FindSectionByName( ".data" ) )
				eFlags |= ERecordFlags::Odd;
			if ( !headerReader.FindSectionByName( ".reloc" ) )
				eFlags |= ERecordFlags::Odd;
			if ( headerReader.IsPe64() )
				eFlags |= ERecordFlags::Pe64;
			if ( headerReader.HasValveStub() )
				eFlags |= ERecordFlags::ValveStub;

			const u32 cubRounded = ( headerReader.GetSizeOfImage() + 0xFFF ) & 0xFFFFF000u;
			if ( cubRounded > cubImage )
				cubImage = cubRounded;
		}

		bool bClean = false;
		if ( !HasFlag( eFlags, ERecordFlags::NotClean ) && walk.m_cubTotal == 0x1000 )
		{
			++cCleanRegions;
			bClean = true;
		}

		if ( bPreviousClean && bClean )
		{
			i32 nPages = static_cast<i32>( walk.m_cRegions ) + nFoldedPages;
			if ( nPages > 255 )
				nPages = 255;
			nFoldedPages = nPages;

			// @note / sapdragon: the first clean region has no record yet, this writes into the unused array and the
			// next append overwrites it. the wide path also wipes the high dword of the base. valve's
			if ( builder.m_bWideRecords )
			{
				auto *pRecord = reinterpret_cast<ModuleRecord64_t *>( builder.m_pubLastRecord );
				if ( !HasFlag( static_cast<ERecordFlags>( pRecord->m_unSizeAndFlags ), ERecordFlags::InLdr ) )
				{
					pRecord->m_unBaseAndTag = ( pRecord->m_unBaseAndTag & 0xFFFFFF00u ) | static_cast<u8>( nPages );
					pRecord->m_unBaseHigh = 0;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				auto *pRecord = reinterpret_cast<ModuleRecord32_t *>( builder.m_pubLastRecord );
				if ( !HasFlag( static_cast<ERecordFlags>( pRecord->m_unSizeAndFlags ), ERecordFlags::InLdr ) )
					pRecord->m_unBaseAndTag = ( pRecord->m_unBaseAndTag & 0xFFFFFF00u ) | static_cast<u8>( nPages );
			}
		}
		else
		{
			bPreviousClean = bClean;
			nFoldedPages = static_cast<i32>( walk.m_cRegions );

			const u16 unLdrIndex = pLdrModule ? static_cast<u16>( pLdrModule->m_unIndex ) : 0;
			const u64 ulBase = walk.m_First.AllocationBase;
			const u8 unRegionCount = static_cast<u8>( walk.m_cRegions );
			bool bRoomLeft = AppendRecord( builder, ulBase, unRegionCount, unDirectoryHash, unBaseNameHash, cubImage,
			                               eFlags, unLdrIndex );
			if ( bSecondRecord && bRoomLeft )
				bRoomLeft =
				    AppendRecord( builder, ulBase, static_cast<u8>( nFoldedPages ), mappedEntry.m_unDirectoryHash,
				                  mappedEntry.m_unBaseNameHash, cubImage, eFlags, unLdrIndex );

			if ( ldrEntry.m_bHasPath || mappedEntry.m_bHasPath || ePeStatus == EScanStatus::Ok )
			{
				if ( builder.m_cHashes < builder.m_cMaxHashes && ulBase > builder.m_ulMinHashBase )
					HashImageIntoTable( builder, context, walk, wszLdrPath[0] ? wszLdrPath : wszMappedPath, pImports );
				++report.m_cNamedOrPe;
			}

			if ( !bRoomLeft )
			{
				headerReader.Release();
				headerReader.CloseSource();
				break;
			}
		}

		headerReader.Release();
		headerReader.CloseSource();
	}

scan_done:
	report.m_cCleanRegions = static_cast<u16>( cCleanRegions > 0xFFFF ? 0xFFFF : cCleanRegions );
	builder.m_cubStrings = 0;
	report.m_cRecordsScanned = builder.m_cRecords;
	report.m_unScanEnd = static_cast<u32>( walk.m_ulQueryAddress );
	report.m_unLastError = walk.m_unLastError;

	const i32 nTrim = nTrimRatio > 0 ? nTrimRatio : 6;
	if ( nTrim < 100 )
		builder.m_cubStrings = PackStrings( baseNameTable, directoryTable, directoryHashes, baseNameHashes,
		                                    builder.m_StringEnds, builder.m_rgchStrings );

	report.m_cHashesPacked = 0;
	report.m_cubCompressed = 0;
	report.m_cRecords = 0;
	report.m_cubStrings = 0;

	i32 cubPlain;
	for ( ;; )
	{
		const i32 cubCompressed = CompressRecords( builder, report.m_rgubCompressed );
		i32 nBudget;
		if ( cubCompressed )
		{
			if ( cubCompressed <= static_cast<i32>( sizeof( report.m_rgubCompressed ) ) )
			{
				report.m_cHashesPacked = static_cast<u8>( builder.m_cHashes );
				report.m_cRecords = static_cast<u16>( builder.m_cRecords );
				report.m_cubStrings = static_cast<u16>( builder.m_cubStrings );
				report.m_cubCompressed = cubCompressed;
				cubPlain = builder.m_cubPlain;
				break;
			}

			const i32 cubUncompressed = GetPlainSize( builder );
			nBudget = ( cubCompressed - static_cast<i32>( sizeof( report.m_rgubCompressed ) ) ) *
			          ( 100 * cubUncompressed / cubCompressed ) / 120;
		}
		else
		{
			nBudget = GetPlainSize( builder ) / 2;
		}

		if ( !nBudget )
			nBudget = 1;
		else if ( nBudget < 0 )
			continue;

		bool bStuck = false;
		for ( ;; )
		{
			i32 nRatio = CurrentStringRatio( builder );
			i32 cubRemoved = 0;

			if ( nRatio <= nTrim )
			{
				while ( nBudget > 0 )
				{
					if ( builder.m_StringEnds.m_c > 0 )
					{
						const i32 cubBefore = builder.m_cubStrings;
						--builder.m_StringEnds.m_c;
						builder.m_cubStrings =
						    static_cast<i32>( builder.m_StringEnds.m_prgun[builder.m_StringEnds.m_c] );
						const i32 cubDelta = cubBefore - builder.m_cubStrings;
						cubRemoved += cubDelta;
						nBudget -= cubDelta;
						nRatio = CurrentStringRatio( builder );
						if ( nRatio <= nTrim )
							continue;
					}
					break;
				}
			}

			if ( nRatio > nTrim )
			{
				// @note / sapdragon: no zero check on the divide. with strings off (trim ratio 100 and up) and a report
				// that doesn't fit, valve's dll dies right here with a divide by zero, and so does this
				i32 nRecordRatio;
				do
				{
					if ( nBudget <= 0 || builder.m_cRecords <= 0 )
						break;
					const i32 cubBefore = GetRecordBytes( builder );
					--builder.m_cRecords;
					const i32 cubAfter = GetRecordBytes( builder );
					cubRemoved += cubBefore - cubAfter;
					nBudget -= cubBefore - cubAfter;
					nRecordRatio = cubAfter / builder.m_cubStrings;
				} while ( nRecordRatio > nTrim );
			}

			if ( !cubRemoved )
			{
				bStuck = true;
				break;
			}
			if ( nBudget <= 0 )
				break;
		}

		if ( bStuck )
		{
			cubPlain = GetPlainSize( builder );
			report.m_eFlags |= EReportFlags::TrimFailed;
			break;
		}
	}

	report.m_cubPlain = cubPlain;
	report.m_cHashes = static_cast<u16>( builder.m_cHashes );
	report.m_cRecordsPacked = builder.m_cRecords;

	util::HeapFree( baseNameHashes.m_prgun );
	util::HeapFree( directoryHashes.m_prgun );
	util::HeapFree( baseNameTable.m_pchStorage );
	util::HeapFree( baseNameTable.m_pEntries );
	util::HeapFree( directoryTable.m_pchStorage );
	util::HeapFree( directoryTable.m_pEntries );
	util::HeapFree( builder.m_StringEnds.m_prgun );
	return EScanStatus::ScanDone;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
```

`modules/process_memory_map/internal/string_blob.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 8d88e017
#include "core/vac_util.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "internal/report_builder.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
{

namespace
{

constexpr u32 k_cubStringStorage = 0x4000;
constexpr i32 k_cMaxStrings = 500;

// @orig: 8B 11 33 C0 56
i32 FindString( const StringTable_t &table, u32 unHash ) noexcept
{
	for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < table.m_cEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		if ( table.m_pEntries[iEntry].m_unHash == unHash )
			return iEntry;
	}
	return -1;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 55 8B E9
void SortStrings( StringTable_t &table ) noexcept
{
	for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < table.m_cEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		for ( i32 iOther = iEntry + 1; iOther < table.m_cEntries; ++iOther )
		{
			StringEntry_t &entry = table.m_pEntries[iEntry];
			StringEntry_t &other = table.m_pEntries[iOther];
			if ( entry.m_cUses < other.m_cUses || ( entry.m_cUses == other.m_cUses && entry.m_nRank < other.m_nRank ) )
			{
				const StringEntry_t temporary = entry;
				entry = other;
				other = temporary;
			}
		}
	}
}

// @orig: 8B 44 24 ? 53 55
bool EmitString( const StringTable_t &table, i32 iEntry, char **ppchOutput, i32 *pcubLeft ) noexcept
{
	if ( iEntry < 0 || iEntry >= table.m_cEntries )
		return false;

	const StringEntry_t &entry = table.m_pEntries[iEntry];
	if ( !entry.m_pszText )
		return false;
	if ( entry.m_cchText >= *pcubLeft )
		return false;

	*pcubLeft = *pcubLeft - entry.m_cchText - 1;
	memcpy( *ppchOutput, entry.m_pszText, entry.m_cchText + 1 );
	*ppchOutput += entry.m_cchText + 1;
	return true;
}

// @note / sapdragon: ranks a string by the most used shorter string that shares its first 8 chars
// @orig: 83 EC ? 56 57 8B F9
void RankStrings( StringTable_t &table ) noexcept
{
	for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < table.m_cEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		StringEntry_t &entry = table.m_pEntries[iEntry];
		if ( !entry.m_pszText )
			continue;

		for ( i32 iOther = 0; iOther < table.m_cEntries; ++iOther )
		{
			const StringEntry_t &other = table.m_pEntries[iOther];
			if ( !other.m_pszText || iOther == iEntry || other.m_cchText >= entry.m_cchText ||
			     other.m_cUses <= entry.m_nRank || other.m_cchText < 0 )
				continue;

			i32 cchShared = 0;
			i32 iChar = 0;
			do
			{
				if ( entry.m_pszText[iChar] != other.m_pszText[iChar] )
					break;
				++cchShared;
				++iChar;
			} while ( iChar <= other.m_cchText );

			if ( cchShared >= 8 )
				entry.m_nRank = other.m_cUses;
		}
	}
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 56
void GrowU32Vector( U32Vector_t &vector ) noexcept
{
	if ( static_cast<i32>( vector.m_cCapacity ) == vector.m_c )
	{
		vector.m_cCapacity += 128;
		vector.m_prgun = static_cast<u32 *>( ResizeOrAlloc( vector.m_prgun, vector.m_cCapacity * sizeof( u32 ) ) );
	}
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 56 57 8B F9 E8
void PushU32( U32Vector_t &vector, u32 unValue ) noexcept
{
	GrowU32Vector( vector );
	vector.m_prgun[vector.m_c++] = unValue;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 B9
void InitStringTable( StringTable_t &table ) noexcept
{
	table.m_pchStorage = static_cast<char *>( util::HeapAlloc( k_cubStringStorage ) );
	table.m_pchWrite = table.m_pchStorage;
	table.m_pEntries = static_cast<StringEntry_t *>( util::HeapAlloc( k_cMaxStrings * sizeof( StringEntry_t ) ) );
	table.m_cubUsed = 0;
	table.m_cEntries = 0;
}

// @orig: 53 8B 5C 24 ? 33 C0
void AddString( StringTable_t &table, u32 unHash, const char *pszText, i32 cchText ) noexcept
{
	for ( i32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < table.m_cEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		if ( table.m_pEntries[iEntry].m_unHash == unHash )
		{
			++table.m_pEntries[iEntry].m_cUses;
			return;
		}
	}

	if ( table.m_cEntries >= k_cMaxStrings )
		return;

	StringEntry_t &entry = table.m_pEntries[table.m_cEntries];
	entry.m_unHash = unHash;
	entry.m_cUses = 1;
	entry.m_pszText = nullptr;
	entry.m_cchText = cchText;
	entry.m_bEmitted = false;
	entry.m_nRank = 0;
	if ( pszText && cchText + table.m_cubUsed + 1 < static_cast<i32>( k_cubStringStorage ) )
	{
		memcpy( table.m_pchWrite, pszText, cchText );
		table.m_pchWrite[cchText] = 0;
		entry.m_pszText = table.m_pchWrite;
		table.m_pchWrite += cchText + 1;
		table.m_cubUsed += cchText + 1;
	}
	++table.m_cEntries;
}

// @note / sapdragon: directories go out from least to most used, each after the base names first seen with it
// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 8B D9
i32 PackStrings( StringTable_t &baseNames, StringTable_t &directories, const U32Vector_t &directoryHashes,
                 const U32Vector_t &baseNameHashes, U32Vector_t &stringEnds, char *pchOutput ) noexcept
{
	const i32 cubOutput = sizeof( ReportBuilder_t::m_rgchStrings );
	i32 cubLeft = cubOutput;
	if ( !directories.m_cEntries )
		return 0;

	RankStrings( directories );
	SortStrings( directories );

	for ( i32 iDirectory = directories.m_cEntries - 1; iDirectory >= 0; --iDirectory )
	{
		for ( i32 iPair = 0; iPair < directoryHashes.m_c; ++iPair )
		{
			if ( FindString( directories, directoryHashes.m_prgun[iPair] ) != iDirectory )
				continue;

			// @note / sapdragon: a full base name table gives -1 and reads the entry before the array. emit refuses it
			// after that, so it is only a stray read
			const i32 iBaseName = FindString( baseNames, baseNameHashes.m_prgun[iPair] );
			if ( baseNames.m_pEntries[iBaseName].m_bEmitted || !baseNames.m_pEntries[iBaseName].m_pszText )
				continue;

			if ( EmitString( baseNames, iBaseName, &pchOutput, &cubLeft ) )
				PushU32( stringEnds, cubOutput - cubLeft );
			if ( iBaseName >= 0 && iBaseName < baseNames.m_cEntries )
				baseNames.m_pEntries[iBaseName].m_bEmitted = true;
			if ( cubLeft < 0 )
				return cubOutput - cubLeft;
		}

		if ( EmitString( directories, iDirectory, &pchOutput, &cubLeft ) )
			PushU32( stringEnds, cubOutput - cubLeft );
		if ( iDirectory < directories.m_cEntries )
			directories.m_pEntries[iDirectory].m_bEmitted = true;
		if ( cubLeft < 0 )
			break;
	}
	return cubOutput - cubLeft;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map
```

`modules/process_memory_map/tests/compare_crafted.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import struct
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
import compare_vac_worker as compare

ORIGINAL = ROOT.parent / "vac-research/ptr_0x0D2058E8_crc_8d88e017_ProcessScan_QVM_PEB"
TARGET = ROOT / "build/tests/process_memory_map_regression.exe"
FIXTURE = ROOT / "build/process_memory_map_crafted_files"
DUMPS = ROOT / "build/vac_cmp_process_memory_map_crafted"
SOURCE_NAMES = {0: "raw file", 4: "memory", 8: "normalized file"}


def lz4_decompress(data: bytes, size: int) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    i = 0
    while i < len(data):
        token = data[i]
        i += 1
        length = token >> 4
        if length == 15:
            while True:
                extra = data[i]
                i += 1
                length += extra
                if extra != 255:
                    break
        out += data[i:i + length]
        i += length
        if i >= len(data) or len(out) >= size:
            break
        offset = data[i] | data[i + 1] << 8
        i += 2
        length = token & 15
        if length == 15:
            while True:
                extra = data[i]
                i += 1
                length += extra
                if extra != 255:
                    break
        length += 4
        for _ in range(length):
            out.append(out[-offset])
    return bytes(out)


def summarize(report: bytes) -> None:
    count_hashes = report[0x48]
    records, strings = struct.unpack_from("<HH", report, 0x4C)
    compressed, plain = struct.unpack_from("<II", report, 0x50)
    wide = bool(struct.unpack_from("<H", report, 0x4A)[0] & 4)
    blob = lz4_decompress(report[0x58:0x58 + compressed], plain)
    width = 36 if wide else 32
    print(f"  status={struct.unpack_from('<I', report, 0x10)[0]} records={records} hashes={count_hashes} strings={strings} plain={plain}")
    tally: dict[str, int] = {}
    for row in range(count_hashes):
        source = struct.unpack_from("<I", blob, row * width)[0] & 0xFFF
        name = SOURCE_NAMES.get(source, hex(source))
        tally[name] = tally.get(name, 0) + 1
    print("  hash rows by source:", tally)
    record_width = 20 if wide else 16
    flags = [struct.unpack_from("<I", blob, count_hashes * width + i * record_width + record_width - 4)[0] & 0xFFF
             for i in range(records)]
    print("  record flags seen:", sorted({hex(x) for x in flags}))


def main() -> int:
    FIXTURE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target = subprocess.Popen([str(TARGET), "--crafted-target", str(FIXTURE)], stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                              stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True)
    failures = 0
    try:
        ready = target.stdout.readline().strip()
        if ready != "ready":
            print(f"target failed: {ready}")
            return 2
        cases = [
            ("all_hashes", ["--patch-u32", "0x68=32", "--patch-u32", "0x70=0"]),
            ("high_scan_start", ["--patch-u32", "0x68=32", "--patch-u32", "0x70=0", "--patch-u32", "0x64=0x10000"]),
            ("no_hashes", ["--patch-u32", "0x68=0"]),
            ("trim_one", ["--patch-u32", "0x68=32", "--patch-u32", "0x70=0", "--patch-u32", "0x6c=1"]),
        ]
        for name, patches in cases:
            dump = DUMPS / name
            print(f"== {name}")
            result = compare.main([
                "--original", str(ORIGINAL / "module.dll"),
                "--rebuild", str(ROOT / "build/Release/Win32/process_memory_map.dll"),
                "--packet", str(ORIGINAL / "inputVacPacket_ScanId_4.bin"),
                "--patch-u32", f"0x60={target.pid}",
                "--hexdump", "0",
                "--dump-dir", str(dump),
            ] + patches)
            print(f"  compare exit={result}")
            failures += result != 0
            original = dump / "original_worker.bin"
            if original.exists():
                summarize(original.read_bytes())
    finally:
        target.terminate()
        target.wait()
    print(f"failures={failures}")
    return 1 if failures else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

`modules/process_memory_map/tests/regression.cpp`:

```cpp
// Native checks of the rewrite. Without arguments it runs the unit checks. The two target modes keep a process alive
// for the differential runs: analysis/8d88e017/compare_live.py --pressure and tests/compare_crafted.py.
#include "internal/pe_reader.hpp"
#include "internal/process_context.hpp"
#include "internal/report_builder.hpp"

#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "crypto/hash/md5.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace vac;
using namespace vac::workers::process_memory_map;

namespace
{

int g_cFailures = 0;

void Check( bool bOk, const char *pszMessage )
{
	if ( !bOk )
	{
		++g_cFailures;
		std::printf( "FAIL: %s\n", pszMessage );
	}
}

const MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION32 g_rgRegions[] = {
    { 0x10000, 0x10000, 0, 0x1000, MEM_RESERVE, 0, MEM_PRIVATE },
    { 0x11000, 0x10000, 0, 0x1000, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READONLY, MEM_PRIVATE },
    { 0x12000, 0x10000, 0, 0x2000, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ, MEM_PRIVATE },
    { 0x14000, 0x10000, 0, 0x1000, MEM_RESERVE, 0, MEM_PRIVATE },
    { 0x15000, 0x10000, 0, 0x1000, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE, MEM_PRIVATE },
    { 0x16000, 0x16000, 0, 0x1000, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE, MEM_PRIVATE },
};

NTSTATUS NTAPI QueryMock( HANDLE, void *pAddress, DWORD, void *pOutput, ULONG cubOutput, PULONG pcubReturned )
{
	const auto ulAddress = reinterpret_cast<uptr>( pAddress );
	for ( const auto &region : g_rgRegions )
	{
		if ( ulAddress >= region.BaseAddress && ulAddress < region.BaseAddress + region.RegionSize &&
		     cubOutput == sizeof( region ) )
		{
			std::memcpy( pOutput, &region, sizeof( region ) );
			*pcubReturned = sizeof( region );
			return 0;
		}
	}
	*pcubReturned = 0;
	return static_cast<NTSTATUS>( 0xC000000Du );
}

void CheckAllocationWalk()
{
	SystemImports_t imports{};
	imports.NtQueryVirtualMemory = QueryMock;
	imports.GetLastError = ::GetLastError;

	AllocationWalk_t walk{};
	walk.m_ulCursor = 0x10000;
	Check( WalkAllocation( &imports, reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( 1 ), walk ), "aggregate allocation" );
	Check( walk.m_ulFirstCommitted == 0x11000 && walk.m_ulCursor == 0x16000, "committed base and next allocation" );
	Check( walk.m_cubCommitPrefix == 0x3000 && walk.m_cubTotal == 0x5000, "prefix and total span" );
	Check( walk.m_cRegions == 5 && walk.m_unProtectUnion == 0x26 && walk.m_unExecuteProtectUnion == 0x20,
	       "region count and protection union" );

	SetLastError( 1234 );
	AllocationWalk_t failed{};
	failed.m_ulCursor = 0xFFFFF000;
	Check( !WalkAllocation( &imports, reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( 1 ), failed ), "invalid query fails" );
	Check( GetLastError() == 1234 && failed.m_unLastError == 1234, "NT query failure keeps the Win32 error" );
}

int g_nCaptureStage = 0;

NTSTATUS NTAPI QueryProcessMock( HANDLE, PROCESSINFOCLASS eClass, void *pOutput, ULONG, PULONG pcubReturned )
{
	if ( eClass != ProcessBasicInformation )
	{
		*pcubReturned = 0;
		return 0;
	}
	auto *pBasic = static_cast<nt::ProcessBasicInformation32_t *>( pOutput );
	std::memset( pBasic, 0, sizeof( *pBasic ) );
	*pcubReturned = g_nCaptureStage ? sizeof( *pBasic ) : 0;
	if ( g_nCaptureStage >= 2 )
		pBasic->m_ulPebBaseAddress = 0x1000;
	return 0;
}

constexpr wchar_t k_wszLdrName[] = L"C:\\mock\\one.dll";

BOOL WINAPI ReadMock( HANDLE, LPCVOID pAddress, LPVOID pOutput, SIZE_T cubOutput, SIZE_T *pcubRead )
{
	*pcubRead = 0;
	const auto ulAddress = reinterpret_cast<uptr>( pAddress );
	if ( ulAddress == 0x1000 && g_nCaptureStage >= 3 && cubOutput == sizeof( nt::Peb32_t ) )
	{
		std::memset( pOutput, 0, cubOutput );
		static_cast<nt::Peb32_t *>( pOutput )->m_ulLdr = 0x2000;
	}
	else if ( ulAddress == 0x2000 && g_nCaptureStage >= 4 && cubOutput == nt::Arch32_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot )
	{
		std::memset( pOutput, 0, cubOutput );
		if ( g_nCaptureStage >= 5 )
			static_cast<nt::PebLdrData32_t *>( pOutput )->m_InLoadOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink = 0x3000;
	}
	else if ( ulAddress == 0x3000 && g_nCaptureStage >= 6 && cubOutput == nt::Arch32_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot )
	{
		auto *pEntry = static_cast<nt::LdrDataTableEntry32_t *>( pOutput );
		std::memset( pEntry, 0, cubOutput );
		pEntry->m_InLoadOrderLinks.m_ulFlink = 0x4000;
		pEntry->m_ulDllBase = 0x90000000;
		pEntry->m_cubSizeOfImage = 0x5000;
		pEntry->m_FullDllName.m_cubLength = sizeof( k_wszLdrName ) - sizeof( wchar_t );
		pEntry->m_FullDllName.m_ulBuffer = 0x5000;
	}
	else if ( ulAddress == 0x4000 && g_nCaptureStage >= 6 && cubOutput == nt::Arch32_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot )
	{
		std::memset( pOutput, 0, cubOutput ); // The list head, no DllBase.
	}
	else if ( ulAddress == 0x5000 && g_nCaptureStage >= 6 )
	{
		std::memcpy( pOutput, k_wszLdrName, cubOutput );
	}
	else
	{
		return FALSE;
	}
	*pcubRead = cubOutput;
	return TRUE;
}

HANDLE WINAPI OpenMock( DWORD, BOOL, DWORD )
{
	return reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( 1 );
}
BOOL WINAPI CloseMock( HANDLE )
{
	return TRUE;
}
BOOL WINAPI TimesMock( HANDLE, LPFILETIME, LPFILETIME, LPFILETIME, LPFILETIME )
{
	return FALSE;
}

void CheckLdrCapture()
{
	SystemImports_t imports{};
	imports.OpenProcess = OpenMock;
	imports.CloseHandle = CloseMock;
	imports.GetProcessTimes = TimesMock;
	imports.GetLastError = ::GetLastError;
	imports.NtQueryInformationProcess = QueryProcessMock;
	imports.ReadProcessMemory = ReadMock;

	ModuleSession_t session{};
	session.m_OsVersion.dwPlatformId = 2;
	session.m_OsVersion.dwMajorVersion = 10;

	constexpr u32 k_unOpenFlags = 0x5;
	const EScanStatus rgeStatus[] = { EScanStatus::BasicInfoFailed,   EScanStatus::NoPeb,
	                                  EScanStatus::PebReadFailed,     EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed,
	                                  EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed, EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed };
	const u32 rgunFlags[] = { 0, 8, 0x18, 0x20038, 0xC0078, 0x4C0078 };
	for ( g_nCaptureStage = 0; g_nCaptureStage < 6; ++g_nCaptureStage )
	{
		ProcessContext_t context{};
		const EScanStatus eStatus = OpenProcessAndCaptureLdr( context, 1234, &imports, &session );
		Check( eStatus == rgeStatus[g_nCaptureStage], "LDR failure status" );
		Check( static_cast<u32>( context.m_eCaptureFlags ) == ( rgunFlags[g_nCaptureStage] | k_unOpenFlags ),
		       "LDR failure capture flags" );
		Check( context.m_cModules == 0 && context.m_unLastError == 0, "LDR failure keeps zero result fields" );
	}

	g_nCaptureStage = 6;
	ProcessContext_t context{};
	context.m_hProcess = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
	Check( OpenProcessAndCaptureLdr( context, 1234, &imports, &session ) == EScanStatus::Ok, "LDR capture succeeds" );
	Check( context.m_cModules == 1, "the list head is not a module" );
	Check( context.m_pModules[0].m_cubImage == 0x1000, "32-bit entries record one page, not SizeOfImage" );
	Check( context.m_pModules[0].m_ulBase == 0xFFFFFFFF90000000ull, "32-bit bases are sign extended" );
	Check( context.m_pModules[0].m_unIndex == 1, "module index starts at one" );
	Check( std::wcscmp( context.m_pModules[0].m_wszFullPath, k_wszLdrName ) == 0, "module path" );
	Check( std::wcscmp( context.m_pModules[0].m_wszBaseName, L"one.dll" ) == 0, "module base name" );
	ReleaseProcessContext( context, &imports );
}

constexpr u32 k_ibNtHeaders = 0x100;
constexpr u32 k_ibOptionalHeader = k_ibNtHeaders + 4 + sizeof( IMAGE_FILE_HEADER );
constexpr u32 k_cubHeaders = 0x400;
constexpr u32 k_unFileAlignment = 0x200;
constexpr u32 k_unSectionAlignment = 0x1000;
constexpr u32 k_unTextRva = 0x1000;
constexpr u32 k_cubText = 0x3000;

struct Reloc_t
{
	u32 m_unRva;
	u16 m_unType;
};

struct Crafted_t
{
	std::vector<u8> m_rgubFile;
	u32 m_unImageBase = 0;
};

std::vector<u8> BuildRelocationTable( const std::vector<Reloc_t> &relocs )
{
	std::vector<u8> table;
	for ( size_t i = 0; i < relocs.size(); )
	{
		const u32 unPage = relocs[i].m_unRva & 0xFFFFF000u;
		std::vector<u16> rgunEntries;
		while ( i < relocs.size() && ( relocs[i].m_unRva & 0xFFFFF000u ) == unPage )
		{
			rgunEntries.push_back( static_cast<u16>( ( relocs[i].m_unType << 12 ) | ( relocs[i].m_unRva & 0xFFF ) ) );
			++i;
		}
		if ( rgunEntries.size() & 1 )
			rgunEntries.push_back( 0 );
		const u32 cubBlock = 8 + static_cast<u32>( rgunEntries.size() ) * 2;
		table.insert( table.end(), reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &unPage ),
		              reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &unPage ) + 4 );
		table.insert( table.end(), reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &cubBlock ),
		              reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &cubBlock ) + 4 );
		table.insert( table.end(), reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( rgunEntries.data() ),
		              reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( rgunEntries.data() ) + rgunEntries.size() * 2 );
	}
	return table;
}

struct PeOptions_t
{
	bool m_bPe64 = false;
	u32 m_unImageBase = 0x20000000;
	const char *m_pszTextName = ".text";
	std::vector<Reloc_t> m_Relocs;
	bool m_bRelocationSection = true;
	bool m_bRelocationsInOverlay = false;
	u32 m_cubOverlay = 0;
	bool m_bValveStub = false;
	u16 m_unOptionalMagic = 0;
	u32 m_unRelocationVaOverride = 0;
	IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY m_Iat{};
	IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY m_Export{};
	u32 m_cSectionsOverride = 0xFFFF;
	bool m_bFlat = false; // Raw offsets equal the RVAs, so a flat file mapping reads like a loaded image.
};

Crafted_t BuildPe( const PeOptions_t &options )
{
	const std::vector<u8> relocations = BuildRelocationTable( options.m_Relocs );
	const u32 cubOptional = options.m_bPe64 ? sizeof( IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 ) : sizeof( IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32 );
	const u32 cubHeaders = options.m_bFlat ? k_unSectionAlignment : k_cubHeaders;
	const u32 unFileAlignment = options.m_bFlat ? k_unSectionAlignment : k_unFileAlignment;

	std::vector<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER> rgSections;
	IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER text{};
	std::memcpy( text.Name, options.m_pszTextName, std::strlen( options.m_pszTextName ) );
	text.Misc.VirtualSize = k_cubText;
	text.VirtualAddress = k_unTextRva;
	text.SizeOfRawData = k_cubText;
	text.PointerToRawData = cubHeaders;
	text.Characteristics = IMAGE_SCN_CNT_CODE | IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE | IMAGE_SCN_MEM_READ;
	rgSections.push_back( text );

	u32 ibRaw = cubHeaders + k_cubText;
	u32 unRva = k_unTextRva + k_cubText;
	u32 unRelocationRva = 0;
	if ( options.m_bRelocationSection && !options.m_bRelocationsInOverlay && !relocations.empty() )
	{
		IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER reloc{};
		std::memcpy( reloc.Name, ".reloc", 6 );
		reloc.Misc.VirtualSize = static_cast<u32>( relocations.size() );
		reloc.VirtualAddress = unRva;
		reloc.SizeOfRawData =
		    ( static_cast<u32>( relocations.size() ) + unFileAlignment - 1 ) & ~( unFileAlignment - 1 );
		reloc.PointerToRawData = ibRaw;
		reloc.Characteristics = IMAGE_SCN_CNT_INITIALIZED_DATA | IMAGE_SCN_MEM_READ;
		rgSections.push_back( reloc );
		unRelocationRva = unRva;
		ibRaw += reloc.SizeOfRawData;
		unRva += ( reloc.Misc.VirtualSize + k_unSectionAlignment - 1 ) & ~( k_unSectionAlignment - 1 );
	}

	const u32 cubSectionsEnd = ibRaw;
	u32 cubOverlay = options.m_cubOverlay;
	if ( options.m_bRelocationsInOverlay )
	{
		// The VA pe::AppendOverlaySection gives ".extra": right after the last section, aligned.
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &last = rgSections.back();
		unRelocationRva =
		    ( last.VirtualAddress + last.Misc.VirtualSize + k_unSectionAlignment - 1 ) & ~( k_unSectionAlignment - 1 );
		cubOverlay = static_cast<u32>( relocations.size() );
	}
	if ( options.m_unRelocationVaOverride )
		unRelocationRva = options.m_unRelocationVaOverride;

	Crafted_t crafted;
	crafted.m_unImageBase = options.m_unImageBase;
	std::vector<u8> &file = crafted.m_rgubFile;
	file.assign( cubSectionsEnd + cubOverlay, 0 );

	u32 unSeed = 0x1234567;
	for ( u32 ib = cubHeaders; ib < file.size(); ++ib )
	{
		unSeed = unSeed * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
		file[ib] = static_cast<u8>( unSeed >> 24 );
	}

	auto *pDos = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( file.data() );
	pDos->e_magic = IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE;
	pDos->e_lfanew = k_ibNtHeaders;
	if ( options.m_bValveStub )
	{
		const u32 rgunStub[3] = { 0x564C56, 1, 7 };
		std::memcpy( file.data() + sizeof( IMAGE_DOS_HEADER ), rgunStub, sizeof( rgunStub ) );
	}

	std::memcpy( file.data() + k_ibNtHeaders, "PE\0\0", 4 );
	auto *pFileHeader = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_FILE_HEADER *>( file.data() + k_ibNtHeaders + 4 );
	pFileHeader->Machine = options.m_bPe64 ? IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64 : IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386;
	pFileHeader->NumberOfSections =
	    static_cast<WORD>( options.m_cSectionsOverride != 0xFFFF ? options.m_cSectionsOverride : rgSections.size() );
	pFileHeader->SizeOfOptionalHeader = static_cast<WORD>( cubOptional );

	const auto SetOptional = [&]( auto *pOptional, u16 unMagic )
	{
		pOptional->Magic = options.m_unOptionalMagic ? options.m_unOptionalMagic : unMagic;
		pOptional->ImageBase = options.m_unImageBase;
		pOptional->SectionAlignment = k_unSectionAlignment;
		pOptional->FileAlignment = unFileAlignment;
		pOptional->SizeOfImage = 0x8000;
		pOptional->SizeOfHeaders = cubHeaders;
		pOptional->NumberOfRvaAndSizes = 16;
		pOptional->DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC].VirtualAddress = unRelocationRva;
		pOptional->DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC].Size = static_cast<u32>( relocations.size() );
		pOptional->DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IAT] = options.m_Iat;
		pOptional->DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT] = options.m_Export;
	};
	if ( options.m_bPe64 )
		SetOptional( reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 *>( file.data() + k_ibOptionalHeader ),
		             IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC );
	else
		SetOptional( reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32 *>( file.data() + k_ibOptionalHeader ),
		             IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC );

	std::memcpy( file.data() + k_ibOptionalHeader + cubOptional, rgSections.data(),
	             rgSections.size() * sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) );

	if ( !relocations.empty() )
	{
		const u32 ibTable = options.m_bRelocationsInOverlay ? cubSectionsEnd : cubHeaders + k_cubText;
		if ( options.m_bRelocationSection || options.m_bRelocationsInOverlay )
			std::memcpy( file.data() + ibTable, relocations.data(), relocations.size() );
	}
	return crafted;
}

// What the original should hash for a PE32 whose relocations are all HIGHLOW: every value in .text moved by the delta.
void ExpectedDigest( const Crafted_t &crafted, const std::vector<Reloc_t> &relocs, u8 *pubDigest )
{
	const std::vector<u8> &file = crafted.m_rgubFile;
	const auto *pFileHeader = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_FILE_HEADER *>( file.data() + k_ibNtHeaders + 4 );

	crypto::hash::Md5_t md5;
	md5.Update( file.data(), sizeof( IMAGE_DOS_HEADER ) );
	md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( pFileHeader ), sizeof( IMAGE_FILE_HEADER ) );

	IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32 optional;
	std::memcpy( &optional, file.data() + k_ibOptionalHeader, sizeof( optional ) );
	optional.ImageBase = 0;
	md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &optional ), sizeof( optional ) );

	const auto *pSections =
	    reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *>( file.data() + k_ibOptionalHeader + sizeof( optional ) );
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < pFileHeader->NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		md5.Update( pSections[iSection].Name, 8 );
		md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &pSections[iSection].VirtualAddress ), 4 );
		md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &pSections[iSection].SizeOfRawData ), 4 );
	}

	std::vector<u8> text( file.begin() + k_cubHeaders, file.begin() + k_cubHeaders + k_cubText );
	const u32 unDelta = crafted.m_unImageBase - 0x10000000u;
	for ( const Reloc_t &reloc : relocs )
	{
		u32 unValue;
		std::memcpy( &unValue, text.data() + reloc.m_unRva - k_unTextRva, 4 );
		unValue -= unDelta;
		std::memcpy( text.data() + reloc.m_unRva - k_unTextRva, &unValue, 4 );
	}
	md5.Update( text.data(), text.size() );
	md5.Final( pubDigest );
}

std::string WriteTemporaryFile( const std::vector<u8> &rgubData, const char *pszName )
{
	char szDirectory[MAX_PATH];
	GetTempPathA( MAX_PATH, szDirectory );
	const std::string path = std::string( szDirectory ) + "pmi_regression_" + pszName + ".bin";
	HANDLE hFile =
	    CreateFileA( path.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
	DWORD cubWritten = 0;
	WriteFile( hFile, rgubData.data(), static_cast<DWORD>( rgubData.size() ), &cubWritten, nullptr );
	CloseHandle( hFile );
	return path;
}

bool HashCraftedFile( const Crafted_t &crafted, const char *pszName, u8 *pubDigest )
{
	SystemImports_t imports{};
	imports.ReadFile = ::ReadFile;
	imports.SetFilePointer = ::SetFilePointer;
	imports.GetFileSize = ::GetFileSize;
	imports.CloseHandle = ::CloseHandle;

	const std::string path = WriteTemporaryFile( crafted.m_rgubFile, pszName );
	HANDLE hFile = CreateFileA( path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
	                            FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );

	auto *pReader = new CPeReader( &imports );
	bool bHashed = false;
	if ( pReader->AttachFile( hFile ) && pReader->ParseFile() == EScanStatus::Ok )
		bHashed = pReader->HashImage( pubDigest );
	pReader->Release();
	pReader->CloseSource();
	delete pReader;
	DeleteFileA( path.c_str() );
	return bHashed;
}

void CheckCraftedImages()
{
	u8 rgubActual[16];
	u8 rgubExpected[16];

	// The second value starts 2 bytes before the 4 KB chunk end, the last chunk's tail runs into the next section.
	PeOptions_t crossing;
	crossing.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 }, { 0x1FFE, 3 }, { 0x2FFD, 3 }, { 0x3000, 3 } };
	const Crafted_t crossingPe = BuildPe( crossing );
	Check( HashCraftedFile( crossingPe, "crossing", rgubActual ), "relocations that cross a chunk end hash" );
	ExpectedDigest( crossingPe, crossing.m_Relocs, rgubExpected );
	Check( !std::memcmp( rgubActual, rgubExpected, 16 ), "a value that crosses a chunk end is patched whole" );

	PeOptions_t unknownType;
	unknownType.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 }, { 0x1200, 10 } };
	Check( !HashCraftedFile( BuildPe( unknownType ), "unknown", rgubActual ),
	       "an unknown relocation type fails the hash" );

	PeOptions_t absolute;
	absolute.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 0 }, { 0x1200, 3 } };
	const Crafted_t absolutePe = BuildPe( absolute );
	Check( HashCraftedFile( absolutePe, "absolute", rgubActual ), "IMAGE_REL_BASED_ABSOLUTE is skipped" );
	const std::vector<Reloc_t> absoluteApplied = { { 0x1200, 3 } };
	ExpectedDigest( absolutePe, absoluteApplied, rgubExpected );
	Check( !std::memcmp( rgubActual, rgubExpected, 16 ), "only the HIGHLOW value moves" );

	// Only ".extra" can place this table: the directory RVA is in no section of the file.
	PeOptions_t overlayTable;
	overlayTable.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 }, { 0x1FFE, 3 } };
	overlayTable.m_bRelocationsInOverlay = true;
	const Crafted_t overlayPe = BuildPe( overlayTable );
	Check( HashCraftedFile( overlayPe, "overlay", rgubActual ), "relocations in the overlay hash" );
	ExpectedDigest( overlayPe, overlayTable.m_Relocs, rgubExpected );
	Check( !std::memcmp( rgubActual, rgubExpected, 16 ), "the relocation table is found through .extra" );
}

void CheckEmptyCompression()
{
	auto *pBuilder = new ReportBuilder_t{};
	pBuilder->m_pubRecords = pBuilder->m_rgubRecords;
	pBuilder->m_pubHashes = pBuilder->m_rgubHashes;
	u8 rgubCompressed[16]{};
	rgubCompressed[0] = 0xFF;
	Check( CompressRecords( *pBuilder, rgubCompressed ) == 1 && pBuilder->m_cubPlain == 0 && rgubCompressed[0] == 0,
	       "an empty inventory is one zero LZ4 token" );
	delete pBuilder;
}

int RunPressureTarget( const char *pszDirectory )
{
	std::vector<HANDLE> rgFiles, rgMappings;
	std::vector<void *> rgViews;
	u32 unRandom = 0x12345678;
	for ( unsigned iFile = 0; iFile < 420; ++iFile )
	{
		char szPath[MAX_PATH];
		std::sprintf( szPath, "%s\\mapping-%08x-%08x.bin", pszDirectory, iFile, unRandom );
		HANDLE hFile = CreateFileA( szPath, GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE | GENERIC_EXECUTE, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr,
		                            CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
		if ( hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		{
			std::printf( "file: %lu\n", GetLastError() );
			return 2;
		}
		u8 rgubBytes[4096];
		for ( auto &ub : rgubBytes )
		{
			unRandom = unRandom * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
			ub = static_cast<u8>( unRandom >> 24 );
		}
		DWORD cubWritten = 0;
		if ( !WriteFile( hFile, rgubBytes, sizeof( rgubBytes ), &cubWritten, nullptr ) ||
		     cubWritten != sizeof( rgubBytes ) )
			return 2;
		HANDLE hMapping = CreateFileMappingA( hFile, nullptr, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, 0, sizeof( rgubBytes ), nullptr );
		if ( !hMapping )
		{
			std::printf( "mapping: %lu\n", GetLastError() );
			return 2;
		}
		void *pView =
		    MapViewOfFile( hMapping, FILE_MAP_READ | FILE_MAP_WRITE | FILE_MAP_EXECUTE, 0, 0, sizeof( rgubBytes ) );
		if ( !pView )
		{
			std::printf( "view: %lu\n", GetLastError() );
			return 2;
		}
		rgFiles.push_back( hFile );
		rgMappings.push_back( hMapping );
		rgViews.push_back( pView );
	}
	std::puts( "ready" );
	std::fflush( stdout );
	Sleep( 120000 );
	for ( void *pView : rgViews )
		UnmapViewOfFile( pView );
	for ( HANDLE hMapping : rgMappings )
		CloseHandle( hMapping );
	for ( HANDLE hFile : rgFiles )
		CloseHandle( hFile );
	return 0;
}

// Maps each crafted image executable, so both workers walk onto it and hash it.
int RunCraftedTarget( const char *pszDirectory )
{
	struct Case_t
	{
		const char *m_pszName;
		Crafted_t m_Pe;
		bool m_bExclusive; // Nobody else can open the file, so the hash has to come from memory.
	};
	std::vector<Case_t> rgCases;
	const auto Add = [&]( const char *pszName, const PeOptions_t &options, bool bExclusive = false )
	{ rgCases.push_back( { pszName, BuildPe( options ), bExclusive } ); };

	PeOptions_t crossing;
	crossing.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 }, { 0x1FFE, 3 }, { 0x2FFD, 3 }, { 0x3000, 3 } };
	Add( "crossing", crossing );
	Add( "memory_crossing", crossing, true );

	PeOptions_t flatCrossing = crossing;
	flatCrossing.m_bFlat = true;
	Add( "flat_crossing", flatCrossing );
	Add( "memory_flat_crossing", flatCrossing, true );

	PeOptions_t flatUnknown;
	flatUnknown.m_bFlat = true;
	flatUnknown.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 }, { 0x1200, 10 } };
	Add( "memory_flat_unknown", flatUnknown, true );

	PeOptions_t unknownType;
	unknownType.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 }, { 0x1200, 10 } };
	Add( "unknown_type", unknownType );
	Add( "memory_unknown_type", unknownType, true );

	PeOptions_t dir64Late;
	dir64Late.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 }, { 0x3FF0, 10 } };
	Add( "unknown_type_late", dir64Late );

	PeOptions_t overlayTable;
	overlayTable.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 }, { 0x1FFE, 3 } };
	overlayTable.m_bRelocationsInOverlay = true;
	Add( "relocs_in_overlay", overlayTable );
	Add( "memory_relocs_in_overlay", overlayTable, true );

	PeOptions_t overlayOnly;

	overlayOnly.m_cubOverlay = 0x777;
	Add( "overlay_plain", overlayOnly );

	PeOptions_t relocOutside;
	relocOutside.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 } };
	relocOutside.m_unRelocationVaOverride = 0x20000;
	Add( "relocs_outside_sections", relocOutside );

	PeOptions_t noBaseDifference;
	noBaseDifference.m_unImageBase = 0x10000000;
	noBaseDifference.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 } };
	Add( "at_normal_base", noBaseDifference );

	PeOptions_t pe64;
	pe64.m_bPe64 = true;
	pe64.m_unImageBase = 0x40000000;
	pe64.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 10 } };
	pe64.m_cubOverlay = 0x123;
	Add( "pe64_overlay", pe64 );
	Add( "memory_pe64", pe64, true );

	PeOptions_t textBss;
	textBss.m_pszTextName = ".textbss";
	textBss.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 } };
	Add( "text_prefix_name", textBss );

	PeOptions_t otherName;
	otherName.m_pszTextName = "CODE";
	otherName.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 } };
	Add( "other_exec_name", otherName );

	PeOptions_t stub;
	stub.m_bValveStub = true;
	stub.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 } };
	Add( "valve_stub", stub );

	PeOptions_t directories;
	directories.m_Relocs = { { 0x1100, 3 }, { 0x1FFE, 3 } };
	directories.m_Iat = { 0x1FF0, 0x20 };
	directories.m_Export = { 0x2800, 0x10 };
	Add( "iat_and_export_in_text", directories );

	PeOptions_t badMagic;
	badMagic.m_unOptionalMagic = 0x999;
	Add( "bad_optional_magic", badMagic );

	PeOptions_t zeroSections;
	zeroSections.m_cSectionsOverride = 0;
	Add( "zero_sections_overlay", zeroSections );

	std::vector<void *> rgViews;
	for ( Case_t &testCase : rgCases )
	{
		const std::string path = std::string( pszDirectory ) + "\\" + testCase.m_pszName + ".bin";
		HANDLE hWrite =
		    CreateFileA( path.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
		if ( hWrite == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		{
			std::printf( "write %s: %lu\n", path.c_str(), GetLastError() );
			return 2;
		}
		DWORD cubWritten = 0;
		WriteFile( hWrite, testCase.m_Pe.m_rgubFile.data(), static_cast<DWORD>( testCase.m_Pe.m_rgubFile.size() ),
		           &cubWritten, nullptr );
		CloseHandle( hWrite );

		HANDLE hFile =
		    CreateFileA( path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_EXECUTE, testCase.m_bExclusive ? 0 : FILE_SHARE_READ,
		                 nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
		HANDLE hMapping = CreateFileMappingA( hFile, nullptr, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ, 0, 0, nullptr );
		void *pView = hMapping ? MapViewOfFile( hMapping, FILE_MAP_READ | FILE_MAP_EXECUTE, 0, 0, 0 ) : nullptr;
		if ( !pView )
		{
			std::printf( "map %s: %lu\n", path.c_str(), GetLastError() );
			return 2;
		}
		rgViews.push_back( pView );
		if ( !testCase.m_bExclusive )
			CloseHandle( hFile );
	}

	std::puts( "ready" );
	std::fflush( stdout );
	Sleep( 300000 );
	return 0;
}

} // namespace

int main( int argc, char **argv )
{
	if ( argc == 3 && std::strcmp( argv[1], "--pressure-target" ) == 0 )
		return RunPressureTarget( argv[2] );
	if ( argc == 3 && std::strcmp( argv[1], "--crafted-target" ) == 0 )
		return RunCraftedTarget( argv[2] );

	CheckAllocationWalk();
	CheckLdrCapture();
	CheckCraftedImages();
	CheckEmptyCompression();
	std::printf( "%s: allocation walk, LDR capture, crafted images and empty compression\n",
	             g_cFailures ? "FAIL" : "PASS" );
	return g_cFailures ? 1 : 0;
}
```

```cpp
namespace vac::workers::service_lookup
{

namespace
{

enum class EWorkerResult : int
{
	Completed = 0,
	BootstrapFailed = 1,
	BadArgs = 4,
};

} // namespace

// @orig: 8B 44 24 ? B9
int RunServiceLookup( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	if ( *pcubOutput < sizeof( report ) )
		return static_cast<int>( EWorkerResult::BadArgs );

	*pcubOutput = sizeof( report );
	memset( &report, 0, sizeof( report ) );
	report.m_unReserved = 0;
	report.m_unMagic = k_unReportMagic;

	EWorkerResult eResult = EWorkerResult::BootstrapFailed;
	EScanStatus eStatus;
	if ( bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
	{
		eStatus = ReadServiceInfo( report, input.m_unServiceNameHash );
		eResult = EWorkerResult::Completed;
	}
	else
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
	}

	bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();
	report.m_eStatus = eStatus;
	return static_cast<int>( eResult );
}

} // namespace vac::workers::service_lookup
```

```cpp
// @binary: 87f12249
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "util/encoding.hpp"
#include "util/hashing.hpp"
#include "util/strings.hpp"
#include "util/win32.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::service_lookup
{

namespace
{

constexpr u32 k_cchPath = 160;
constexpr u32 k_cubEnumBuffer = 0x10000;
constexpr u32 k_cubConfigBuffer = 0x1000;

constexpr wchar_t k_wszNtPrefix[] = L"\\??\\";
constexpr wchar_t k_wszSystemDirectory[] = L"\\SystemDirectory";
constexpr wchar_t k_wszWindows[] = L"\\windows";
constexpr wchar_t k_wszSystem32[] = L"system32";
constexpr wchar_t k_wszNative[] = L"native";

wchar_t UpperChar( wchar_t wchChar ) noexcept
{
	return static_cast<wchar_t>(
	    reinterpret_cast<uptr>( CharUpperW( reinterpret_cast<LPWSTR>( static_cast<uptr>( wchChar ) ) ) ) );
}

// @orig: FF 74 24 ? 52
int CompareStringPrefix( const wchar_t *pwszA, const wchar_t *pwszB, int cchCount ) noexcept
{
	return CompareStringW( LOCALE_SYSTEM_DEFAULT, NORM_IGNORECASE, pwszA, cchCount, pwszB, cchCount ) - CSTR_EQUAL;
}

// @orig: 56 57 8B F2 8B F9
wchar_t *CopyPath( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc ) noexcept
{
	// @note / sapdragon: always reads 160 chars from the source, whatever its length
	memcpy( pwszDst, pwszSrc, k_cchPath * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
	const u32 cchSrc = lstrlenW( pwszSrc );
	if ( cchSrc < k_cchPath )
		memset( pwszDst + cchSrc, 0, ( k_cchPath - cchSrc ) * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
	return pwszDst;
}

// @orig: 53 55 56 8B 35 ? ? ? ? 8B E9
wchar_t *AppendPath( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc, u32 cchMax ) noexcept
{
	const u32 cchDst = lstrlenW( pwszDst );
	u32 cchSrc = lstrlenW( pwszSrc );
	if ( cchSrc > cchMax )
		cchSrc = cchMax;
	memcpy( pwszDst + cchDst, pwszSrc, cchSrc * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
	pwszDst[cchSrc + cchDst] = 0;
	return pwszDst;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 8B 35
wchar_t *GetSystem32( wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	wchar_t *pwszChar = pwszPath;
	u32 cchLeft = lstrlenW( pwszPath );
	const u32 cchPattern = lstrlenW( k_wszSystem32 );
	if ( cchLeft < cchPattern )
		return nullptr;

	for ( ;; )
	{
		if ( UpperChar( *pwszChar ) == UpperChar( L's' ) )
		{
			// @note / sapdragon: the text char is compared with 's' a second time, not with the pattern. same result
			const wchar_t *pwszPattern = k_wszSystem32;
			if ( UpperChar( *pwszChar ) == UpperChar( L's' ) )
			{
				for ( ;; )
				{
					++pwszPattern;
					if ( !*pwszPattern )
						return pwszChar;
					if ( UpperChar( pwszChar[pwszPattern - k_wszSystem32] ) != UpperChar( *pwszPattern ) )
						break;
				}
			}
		}

		++pwszChar;
		if ( --cchLeft < cchPattern )
			return nullptr;
	}
}

// @orig: 56 57 8B FA 33 C0
bool FetchSystemDirectories( const wchar_t *pwszPath, wchar_t *pwszOut ) noexcept
{
	*pwszOut = 0;

	int nDiff = 0;
	for ( u32 iChar = 0; iChar < 4; ++iChar )
	{
		const int nChar = pwszPath[iChar];
		if ( !nChar || nChar != k_wszNtPrefix[iChar] )
		{
			nDiff = nChar - k_wszNtPrefix[iChar];
			break;
		}
	}
	if ( !nDiff )
	{
		CopyPath( pwszOut, pwszPath + 4 );
		return true;
	}

	if ( !CompareStringPrefix( pwszPath, L"\\SystemRoot", 11 ) )
	{
		CopyPath( pwszOut, g_pSession->m_wszWindowsDirectory );
		AppendPath( pwszOut, pwszPath + 11, k_cchPath - lstrlenW( pwszOut ) );
		return true;
	}
	if ( !CompareStringPrefix( pwszPath, k_wszSystemDirectory, 16 ) )
	{
		CopyPath( pwszOut, g_pSession->m_wszSystemDirectory );
		AppendPath( pwszOut, pwszPath + 16, k_cchPath - lstrlenW( pwszOut ) );
		return true;
	}
	if ( !CompareStringPrefix( pwszPath, k_wszWindows, 8 ) )
	{
		CopyPath( pwszOut, g_pSession->m_wszWindowsDirectory );
		AppendPath( pwszOut, pwszPath + 8, k_cchPath - lstrlenW( pwszOut ) );
		return true;
	}

	CopyPath( pwszOut, pwszPath );
	return false;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC A1
bool GetFileInfo( const wchar_t *pwszPath, u32 *punVolumeSerial, void *pFileIndex ) noexcept
{
	if ( !g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle )
		return false;

	const HANDLE hFile = g_pImports->CreateFileW( pwszPath, FILE_GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
	                                              FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
	if ( hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return false;

	BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION info;
	const BOOL bResult = g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle( hFile, &info );
	g_pImports->CloseHandle( hFile );
	if ( !bResult )
		return false;

	*punVolumeSerial = info.dwVolumeSerialNumber;
	memcpy( pFileIndex, &info.nFileIndexLow, sizeof( info.nFileIndexLow ) );
	memcpy( static_cast<u8 *>( pFileIndex ) + sizeof( info.nFileIndexLow ), &info.nFileIndexHigh,
	        sizeof( info.nFileIndexHigh ) );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53
EScanStatus ReadServiceInfo( Report_t &report, u32 unServiceNameHash ) noexcept
{
	EScanStatus eStatus = EScanStatus::Ok;
	ENUM_SERVICE_STATUSW *pServices = nullptr;
	QUERY_SERVICE_CONFIGW *pConfig = nullptr;
	SC_HANDLE hService = nullptr;
	DWORD cubNeeded;
	DWORD cServices;
	DWORD unResume = 0;
	char szName[64];
	wchar_t wszPath[k_cchPath];

	const SC_HANDLE hSCManager = g_pImports->OpenSCManagerA( nullptr, nullptr, SC_MANAGER_ENUMERATE_SERVICE );
	if ( !hSCManager )
	{
		eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( util::GetLastError( g_pImports ) );
		goto exit;
	}

	pServices = static_cast<ENUM_SERVICE_STATUSW *>(
	    g_pImports->HeapAlloc( g_pImports->GetProcessHeap(), 0, k_cubEnumBuffer ) );
	if ( !pServices )
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::NotEnoughMemory;
		goto exit;
	}
	memset( pServices, 0, k_cubEnumBuffer );

	{
		// @note / sapdragon: drivers only, and only the running ones
		const BOOL bEnumerated = g_pImports->EnumServicesStatusW( hSCManager, SERVICE_DRIVER, SERVICE_ACTIVE, pServices,
		                                                          k_cubEnumBuffer, &cubNeeded, &cServices, &unResume );
		const DWORD unLastError = util::GetLastError( g_pImports );
		if ( !bEnumerated && unLastError != ERROR_MORE_DATA )
			goto fail;
	}

	pConfig = static_cast<QUERY_SERVICE_CONFIGW *>(
	    g_pImports->HeapAlloc( g_pImports->GetProcessHeap(), 0, k_cubConfigBuffer ) );
	if ( !pConfig )
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::NotEnoughMemory;
		goto exit;
	}

	{
		DWORD iService = 0;
		if ( !cServices )
			goto fail;

		const ENUM_SERVICE_STATUSW *pEntry = pServices;
		for ( ;; )
		{
			util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, pEntry->lpServiceName, szName, sizeof( szName ) );
			u32 cchName = 0;
			while ( szName[cchName] )
				++cchName;
			if ( util::hashing::PathHashBytes( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( szName ), cchName ) == unServiceNameHash )
				break;

			++iService;
			++pEntry;
			if ( iService >= cServices )
				goto fail;
		}

		hService = g_pImports->OpenServiceW( hSCManager, pServices[iService].lpServiceName,
		                                     SERVICE_QUERY_CONFIG | SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS );
		if ( !hService || !g_pImports->QueryServiceConfigW( hService, pConfig, k_cubConfigBuffer, &cubNeeded ) )
			goto fail;
		g_pImports->CloseServiceHandle( hService );
		hService = nullptr;

		util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, pServices[iService].lpServiceName, report.m_szServiceName,
		                                   sizeof( report.m_szServiceName ) );
	}

	util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, pConfig->lpDisplayName, report.m_szDisplayName,
	                                   sizeof( report.m_szDisplayName ) );
	report.m_unServiceType = pConfig->dwServiceType;
	report.m_unStartType = pConfig->dwStartType;
	report.m_unErrorControl = pConfig->dwErrorControl;
	FetchSystemDirectories( pConfig->lpBinaryPathName, wszPath );
	util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, wszPath, report.m_szBinaryPath, sizeof( report.m_szBinaryPath ) );
	util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, pConfig->lpLoadOrderGroup, report.m_szLoadOrderGroup,
	                                   sizeof( report.m_szLoadOrderGroup ) );
	util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, pConfig->lpDependencies, report.m_szDependencies,
	                                   sizeof( report.m_szDependencies ) );
	util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, pConfig->lpServiceStartName, report.m_szServiceStartName,
	                                   sizeof( report.m_szServiceStartName ) );

	{
		wchar_t *pwszSystem32 = GetSystem32( wszPath );
		if ( pwszSystem32 )
		{
			const wchar_t *pwszTail = pwszSystem32 + lstrlenW( k_wszSystem32 );
			const u32 cchTail = lstrlenW( pwszTail );
			// @note / sapdragon: the tail moves one char right without its terminator, only the zero fill of the path saves it
			memmove( pwszSystem32 + 9, pwszTail, cchTail * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
			memcpy( pwszSystem32 + 3, k_wszNative, lstrlenW( k_wszNative ) * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
		}
	}

	GetFileInfo( wszPath, &report.m_unVolumeSerial, &report.m_unFileIndexLow );
	goto exit;

fail:
	eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( util::GetLastError( g_pImports ) );

exit:
	g_pImports->HeapFree( g_pImports->GetProcessHeap(), 0, pConfig );
	g_pImports->HeapFree( g_pImports->GetProcessHeap(), 0, pServices );
	g_pImports->CloseServiceHandle( hService );
	g_pImports->CloseServiceHandle( hSCManager );
	return eStatus;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::service_lookup
```

```cpp
#include "internal/types.hpp"

#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::shared_section
{

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53
int RunSharedSection( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	// @note / sapdragon: incoming capacity is ignored, it always writes the whole report
	memset( &report, 0, k_cubReport );
	*pcubOutput = k_cubReport;
	report.m_unMagic = k_unReportMagic;

	if ( !bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
		report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
	else
		ReadMapping( input, report, g_pImports );

	bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();
	return 0;
}
```
