`modules/shared_section/internal/reader.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 2794a04
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "util/xor_string.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::shared_section
{

namespace
{

constexpr u8 k_unStringKey = 0x13;
constexpr u32 k_cubDirectoryBufferStep = 1024;

// @note / sapdragon: only wdm.h has these two, same names here
constexpr ACCESS_MASK DIRECTORY_QUERY = 0x0001;
constexpr ACCESS_MASK DIRECTORY_TRAVERSE = 0x0002;

using PfnOpenFileMappingW_t = HANDLE( WINAPI * )( DWORD, BOOL, LPCWSTR );
using PfnMapViewOfFile_t = LPVOID( WINAPI * )( HANDLE, DWORD, DWORD, DWORD, SIZE_T );
using PfnUnmapViewOfFile_t = BOOL( WINAPI * )( LPCVOID );

struct ObjectDirectoryEntry_t
{
	UNICODE_STRING m_Name;
	UNICODE_STRING m_TypeName;
};

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 E4 ? 83 EC
HANDLE FindSection( const wchar_t *pwszDirectoryType, const wchar_t *pwszWanted, HANDLE hRoot, UNICODE_STRING *pPath,
                    const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES attributes{};
	attributes.Length = sizeof( attributes );
	attributes.RootDirectory = hRoot;
	attributes.ObjectName = pPath;
	attributes.Attributes = OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE;

	HANDLE hDirectory = nullptr;
	HANDLE hResult = nullptr;
	u8 *pubBuffer = nullptr;

	if ( pImports->NtOpenDirectoryObject( &hDirectory, DIRECTORY_QUERY | DIRECTORY_TRAVERSE, &attributes ) >= 0 )
	{
		u32 cubBuffer = k_cubDirectoryBufferStep;
		pubBuffer = static_cast<u8 *>( pImports->HeapAlloc( pImports->GetProcessHeap(), 0, cubBuffer ) );
		if ( pubBuffer )
		{
			ULONG unContext = 0;
			for ( ;; )
			{
				const NTSTATUS nStatus = pImports->NtQueryDirectoryObject( hDirectory, pubBuffer, cubBuffer, TRUE,
				                                                           FALSE, &unContext, nullptr );
				if ( nStatus < 0 )
				{
					if ( nStatus == STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL )
					{
						pImports->HeapFree( pImports->GetProcessHeap(), 0, pubBuffer );
						cubBuffer += k_cubDirectoryBufferStep;
						pubBuffer =
						    static_cast<u8 *>( pImports->HeapAlloc( pImports->GetProcessHeap(), 0, cubBuffer ) );
						if ( pubBuffer )
							continue;
					}
					break;
				}

				auto *pEntry = reinterpret_cast<ObjectDirectoryEntry_t *>( pubBuffer );
				if ( lstrcmpiW( pEntry->m_TypeName.Buffer, pwszDirectoryType ) == 0 )
				{
					hResult = FindSection( pwszDirectoryType, pwszWanted, hDirectory, &pEntry->m_Name, pImports );
					if ( hResult )
						break;
				}
				else if ( lstrcmpiW( pEntry->m_Name.Buffer, pwszWanted ) == 0 )
				{
					attributes.RootDirectory = hDirectory;
					attributes.ObjectName = &pEntry->m_Name;
					if ( pImports->NtOpenSection( &hResult, SECTION_MAP_READ, &attributes ) < 0 )
						hResult = nullptr;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	if ( hDirectory )
		pImports->CloseHandle( hDirectory );
	if ( pubBuffer )
		pImports->HeapFree( pImports->GetProcessHeap(), 0, pubBuffer );
	return hResult;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: inlined
void FormatMappingName( u32 unIdentifier, wchar_t *pwszName ) noexcept
{
	auto wszFormat = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( L"{%02xDEDF05-86E9-%02x17-9E36-1D94%02x334DFA-A3%02x4421}" );
	wszFormat.Decode();

	const auto *pubIdentifier = reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &unIdentifier );
	wsprintfW( pwszName, wszFormat.Get(), pubIdentifier[0], pubIdentifier[3], pubIdentifier[2], pubIdentifier[1] );
}

// @orig: inlined
void ReadMapping( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	auto szKernel32 = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "kernel32.dll" );
	auto szOpenFileMappingW = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "OpenFileMappingW" );
	auto szMapViewOfFile = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "MapViewOfFile" );
	auto szUnmapViewOfFile = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "UnmapViewOfFile" );
	auto wszDirectory = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( L"Directory" );
	szKernel32.Decode();
	szOpenFileMappingW.Decode();
	szMapViewOfFile.Decode();
	szUnmapViewOfFile.Decode();
	wszDirectory.Decode();

	const HMODULE hKernel32 = pImports->LoadLibraryExA( szKernel32.Get(), nullptr, 0 );
	if ( !hKernel32 )
	{
		report.m_eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
		return;
	}

	const auto pfnOpenFileMappingW =
	    reinterpret_cast<PfnOpenFileMappingW_t>( pImports->GetProcAddress( hKernel32, szOpenFileMappingW.Get() ) );
	PfnMapViewOfFile_t pfnMapViewOfFile = nullptr;
	PfnUnmapViewOfFile_t pfnUnmapViewOfFile = nullptr;
	if ( !pfnOpenFileMappingW )
	{
		report.m_eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
		report.m_eFailureLine = EFailureLine::OpenFileMappingMissing;
	}
	else if ( !( pfnMapViewOfFile = reinterpret_cast<PfnMapViewOfFile_t>(
	                 pImports->GetProcAddress( hKernel32, szMapViewOfFile.Get() ) ) ) )
	{
		report.m_eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
		report.m_eFailureLine = EFailureLine::MapViewMissing;
	}
	else if ( !( pfnUnmapViewOfFile = reinterpret_cast<PfnUnmapViewOfFile_t>(
	                 pImports->GetProcAddress( hKernel32, szUnmapViewOfFile.Get() ) ) ) )
	{
		report.m_eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
		report.m_eFailureLine = EFailureLine::UnmapViewMissing;
	}
	else
	{
		wchar_t wszName[48]{};
		FormatMappingName( input.m_unIdentifier, wszName );

		HANDLE hSection = pfnOpenFileMappingW( FILE_MAP_READ, FALSE, wszName );
		if ( !hSection )
		{
			report.m_eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
			if ( report.m_eStatus != EScanStatus::NoFile )
			{
				report.m_eFailureLine = EFailureLine::OpenFailed;
			}
			else
			{
				wchar_t wszRoot[] = L"\\";
				UNICODE_STRING root{ 2, 4, wszRoot };
				hSection = FindSection( wszDirectory.Get(), wszName, nullptr, &root, pImports );
				if ( !hSection )
					report.m_eFailureLine = EFailureLine::SectionNotFound;
			}
		}

		if ( hSection )
		{
			const auto *pubView = static_cast<const u8 *>( pfnMapViewOfFile( hSection, FILE_MAP_READ, 0, 0, 0 ) );
			if ( pubView )
			{
				memcpy( report.m_rgubMappedPayload, pubView + offsetof( Report_t, m_rgubMappedPayload ),
				        sizeof( report.m_rgubMappedPayload ) );
				report.m_unIdentifierA = input.m_unIdentifier;
				report.m_unIdentifierB = input.m_unIdentifier;
				report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::Ok;
				pfnUnmapViewOfFile( pubView );
			}
			else
			{
				report.m_eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
				report.m_eFailureLine = EFailureLine::MapViewFailed;
			}
			pImports->CloseHandle( hSection );
		}
	}

	pImports->FreeLibrary( hKernel32 );
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "bootstrap/imports.hpp"
#include "core/layout.hpp"
#include "core/packets.hpp"
#include "core/scan_status.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::shared_section
{

inline constexpr u32 k_unModuleId = 0x0E3481C0;
inline constexpr u32 k_unReportMagic = 0x908D62F2;

// @note / sapdragon: these are __LINE__ values from valve's source, not real error codes
enum class EFailureLine : u32
{
	OpenFileMappingMissing = 390,
	MapViewMissing = 400,
	UnmapViewMissing = 410,
	OpenFailed = 440,
	SectionNotFound = 466,
	MapViewFailed = 483,
};

#pragma pack( push, 1 )
struct Input_t
{
	u8 m_rgubBootstrap[96];
	u32 m_unIdentifier;
	u8 m_rgubReserved[60];
};

struct Report_t
{
	u8 m_rgubDispatcher[16];
	u32 m_unMagic;
	EScanStatus m_eStatus;
	union
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: still no idea who writes this mapping or what the format is
		u8 m_rgubMappedPayload[4072];
		struct
		{
			u8 m_rgubUnused0[12];
			u32 m_unIdentifierA;
			u32 m_unIdentifierB;
			u8 m_rgubUnused1[4];
			EFailureLine m_eFailureLine;
		};
	};
};
#pragma pack( pop )
VAC_LAYOUT( Input_t, m_unIdentifier, 0x60 );
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( Input_t, 160 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_unMagic, 0x10 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_eStatus, 0x14 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_rgubMappedPayload, 24 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_unIdentifierA, 0x24 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_unIdentifierB, 0x28 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_eFailureLine, 0x30 );
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( Report_t, k_cubReport );
```

`modules/shared_section/tests/parity.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "../internal/types.hpp"
#include <windows.h>
#include <array>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <fstream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

using namespace vac;
using namespace vac::workers::shared_section;
using Worker = int( __cdecl * )( const u8 *, u8 *, u32 * );
struct Row
{
	UNICODE_STRING name, type;
};
struct Scenario
{
	int resolve = 0;
	bool load = true, open = true, map = true, tree = false, grow = false, section = true, directory = true;
	u32 openError = 2;
};
static Scenario scenario;
static SystemImports_t apis{};
static u8 *original;
static std::array<u8, 4096> contents;
static std::wstring openedName, wantedName;
static u32 error = 77;
static bool grown = false;
static unsigned cases = 0, failures = 0;
static HMODULE WINAPI load( LPCSTR, HANDLE, DWORD )
{
	return scenario.load ? reinterpret_cast<HMODULE>( 0x500 ) : nullptr;
}
static DWORD WINAPI lastError()
{
	return error;
}
static BOOL WINAPI close( HANDLE )
{
	return TRUE;
}
static BOOL WINAPI unload( HMODULE )
{
	return TRUE;
}
static HANDLE WINAPI openMapping( DWORD, BOOL, LPCWSTR name )
{
	openedName = name;
	if ( scenario.open )
		return reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( 0x20 );
	error = scenario.openError;
	return nullptr;
}
static LPVOID WINAPI mapView( HANDLE, DWORD, DWORD, DWORD, SIZE_T )
{
	if ( scenario.map )
		return contents.data();
	error = 88;
	return nullptr;
}
static BOOL WINAPI unmap( LPCVOID )
{
	return TRUE;
}
static FARPROC WINAPI resolve( HMODULE, LPCSTR name )
{
	if ( !std::strcmp( name, "OpenFileMappingW" ) )
		return scenario.resolve == 1 ? nullptr : reinterpret_cast<FARPROC>( openMapping );
	if ( !std::strcmp( name, "MapViewOfFile" ) )
		return scenario.resolve == 2 ? nullptr : reinterpret_cast<FARPROC>( mapView );
	if ( !std::strcmp( name, "UnmapViewOfFile" ) )
		return scenario.resolve == 3 ? nullptr : reinterpret_cast<FARPROC>( unmap );
	return nullptr;
}
static NTSTATUS WINAPI openDirectory( PHANDLE handle, ACCESS_MASK, POBJECT_ATTRIBUTES a )
{
	if ( !scenario.directory )
		return static_cast<NTSTATUS>( 0xC0000022 );
	*handle = a->RootDirectory ? reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( 0x11 ) : reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( 0x10 );
	return 0;
}
static UNICODE_STRING str( const wchar_t *p )
{
	USHORT length = static_cast<USHORT>( std::wcslen( p ) * 2 );
	return { length, static_cast<USHORT>( length + 2 ), const_cast<wchar_t *>( p ) };
}
static NTSTATUS WINAPI queryDirectory( HANDLE h, void *buffer, ULONG size, BOOLEAN, BOOLEAN, PULONG context, PULONG )
{
	if ( !scenario.tree || *context )
		return static_cast<NTSTATUS>( 0x8000001A );
	if ( scenario.grow && !grown && size == 1024 )
	{
		grown = true;
		return static_cast<NTSTATUS>( 0xC0000023 );
	}
	auto *row = static_cast<Row *>( buffer );
	if ( h == reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( 0x10 ) )
	{
		row->name = str( L"Session" );
		row->type = str( L"Directory" );
	}
	else
	{
		row->name = str( wantedName.c_str() );
		row->type = str( L"Section" );
	}
	++*context;
	return 0;
}
static NTSTATUS WINAPI openSection( PHANDLE result, ACCESS_MASK, POBJECT_ATTRIBUTES a )
{
	if ( !scenario.section || std::wcscmp( a->ObjectName->Buffer, wantedName.c_str() ) )
		return static_cast<NTSTATUS>( 0xC0000022 );
	*result = reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( 0x20 );
	return 0;
}
static bool __fastcall boot( void * )
{
	std::memcpy( original + 0x7D00, &apis, sizeof( apis ) );
	*reinterpret_cast<const SystemImports_t **>( original + 0x6004 ) = &apis;
	*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( original + 0x7C78 ) = 0;
	return true;
}
static void patch( void *where, const void *function )
{
	DWORD old;
	VirtualProtect( where, 5, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, &old );
	auto *p = static_cast<u8 *>( where );
	p[0] = 0xE9;
	*reinterpret_cast<i32 *>( p + 1 ) = static_cast<i32>( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( function ) - p - 5 );
	FlushInstructionCache( GetCurrentProcess(), where, 5 );
	VirtualProtect( where, 5, old, &old );
}
static Worker findWorker( HMODULE dll )
{
	auto *base = reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( dll );
	auto *nt = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_NT_HEADERS *>( base + reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( base )->e_lfanew );
	const auto *sections = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION( nt );
	for ( unsigned i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++i )
	{
		if ( sections[i].Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE )
			continue;
		for ( unsigned j = 0; j + 48 <= sections[i].Misc.VirtualSize; j += 4 )
		{
			auto *p = base + sections[i].VirtualAddress + j;
			if ( *reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( p + 4 ) == k_unModuleId && *reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( p + 8 ) == 1 )
			{
				auto fn = *reinterpret_cast<Worker *>( p + 12 );
				if ( reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( fn ) >= base &&
				     reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( fn ) < base + nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage )
					return fn;
			}
		}
	}
	return nullptr;
}
static int live( const char *dllPath, const char *seedPath )
{
	HMODULE dll = LoadLibraryA( dllPath );
	if ( !dll )
		return 4;
	Worker a = reinterpret_cast<Worker>( original + 0x2DE1 ), b = findWorker( dll );
	if ( !b )
		return 5;
	Input_t input{};
	std::ifstream seed( seedPath, std::ios::binary );
	seed.read( reinterpret_cast<char *>( &input ), 160 );
	if ( !seed )
		return 6;
	unsigned failed = 0, n = 0;
	for ( u32 cap : { 0u, 1u, 4095u, 4096u } )
	{
		input.m_unIdentifier = static_cast<u32>( GetCurrentProcessId() ) ^ 0xA5000000u ^ cap;
		wchar_t name[128]{};
		FormatMappingName( input.m_unIdentifier, name );
		HANDLE file = CreateFileMappingW( INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, nullptr, PAGE_READWRITE, 0, 4096, name );
		if ( !file || GetLastError() == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS )
		{
			if ( file )
				CloseHandle( file );
			return 7;
		}
		auto *view = static_cast<u8 *>( MapViewOfFile( file, FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS, 0, 0, 4096 ) );
		if ( !view )
			return 8;
		for ( unsigned i = 0; i < 4096; ++i )
			view[i] = static_cast<u8>( ( i * 73 + cap + 19 ) ^ ( i >> 3 ) );
		std::array<u8, 4096> left{}, right{};
		u32 sa = cap, sb = cap;
		int ra = a( reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( &input ), left.data(), &sa ),
		    rb = b( reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( &input ), right.data(), &sb );
		bool ok = ra == rb && sa == sb && sa == 4096 && left == right &&
		          reinterpret_cast<Report_t *>( left.data() )->m_eStatus == EScanStatus::Ok;
		std::printf( "LIVE cap=%u %s\n", cap, ok ? "OK" : "DIFF" );
		++n;
		if ( !ok )
			++failed;
		UnmapViewOfFile( view );
		CloseHandle( file );
	}
	std::printf( "LIVE RESULT %u cases, %u failures\n", n, failed );
	return failed ? 1 : 0;
}
int main( int argc, char **argv )
{
	if ( argc != 2 && argc != 5 )
		return 2;
	original = reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( LoadLibraryA( argv[1] ) );
	if ( !original )
		return 3;
	if ( argc == 5 && !std::strcmp( argv[2], "--live" ) )
		return live( argv[3], argv[4] );
	patch( original + 0x4BF0, boot );
	apis.LoadLibraryExA = load;
	apis.GetProcAddress = resolve;
	apis.GetLastError = lastError;
	apis.FreeLibrary = unload;
	apis.CloseHandle = close;
	apis.NtOpenDirectoryObject = openDirectory;
	apis.NtQueryDirectoryObject = queryDirectory;
	apis.NtOpenSection = openSection;
	apis.HeapAlloc = HeapAlloc;
	apis.HeapFree = HeapFree;
	apis.GetProcessHeap = GetProcessHeap;
	auto worker = reinterpret_cast<Worker>( original + 0x2DE1 );
	for ( u32 id : { 0u, 1u, 0x01020304u, 0x80FFAA55u, 0xFFFFFFFFu } )
	{
		for ( unsigned kind = 0; kind < 11; ++kind )
		{
			scenario = {};
			if ( kind == 1 )
				scenario.load = false;
			if ( kind >= 2 && kind <= 4 )
				scenario.resolve = kind - 1;
			if ( kind == 5 )
			{
				scenario.open = false;
				scenario.openError = 5;
			}
			if ( kind == 6 )
				scenario.open = false;
			if ( kind == 7 )
				scenario.map = false;
			if ( kind >= 8 )
			{
				scenario.open = false;
				scenario.tree = true;
			}
			if ( kind == 9 )
				scenario.grow = true;
			if ( kind == 10 )
				scenario.section = false;
			Input_t in{};
			in.m_unIdentifier = id;
			wchar_t name[128]{};
			FormatMappingName( id, name );
			wantedName = name;
			for ( unsigned i = 0; i < 4096; ++i )
				contents[i] = static_cast<u8>( i * 31 + kind + ( id >> 24 ) );
			std::array<u8, 4096> expected{}, actual{};
			u32 size = 0;
			error = 77;
			grown = false;
			openedName.clear();
			int ret = worker( reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( &in ), expected.data(), &size );
			std::wstring originalName = openedName;
			error = 77;
			grown = false;
			openedName.clear();
			auto &out = *reinterpret_cast<Report_t *>( actual.data() );
			out.m_unMagic = k_unReportMagic;
			ReadMapping( in, out, &apis );
			bool equal = ret == 0 && size == 4096 && expected == actual && openedName == originalName;
			++cases;
			if ( !equal )
			{
				++failures;
				std::printf( "DIFF %08x case=%u\n", id, kind );
				for ( unsigned i = 0, shown = 0; i < 4096 && shown < 12; ++i )
					if ( expected[i] != actual[i] )
					{
						std::printf( " +%x %02x/%02x\n", i, expected[i], actual[i] );
						++shown;
					}
			}
			else
				std::printf( "OK %08x case=%u\n", id, kind );
		}
	}
	std::printf( "RESULT %u cases, %u failures\n", cases, failures );
	return failures ? 1 : 0;
}
```

`modules/system_handles/entry.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 1da8fb5c
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/blob.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::system_handles
{

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 E4 ? B8
int RunSystemHandles( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	if ( *pcubOutput < k_cubReport )
		return 4;
	*pcubOutput = k_cubReport;

	memset( &report, 0, k_cubReport );
	memset( &report, 0, k_cubReport );

	if ( !bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
	{
		report.m_eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
		return 0;
	}

	report.m_unReportType = 3;
	report.m_unPackedVersion = g_pSession->m_unPackedVersion;

	ScanContext_t context;
	ConstructStringTable( context.m_Directories );
	ConstructStringTable( context.m_BaseNames );
	context.m_unMinPid = input.m_unMinPid;
	context.m_unMaxPid = input.m_unMaxPid;
	context.m_bIncludeExited = HasFlag( input.m_eFlags, EInputFlags::IncludeExited );
	context.m_bFilterByAge = HasFlag( input.m_eFlags, EInputFlags::FilterByAge );
	context.m_bLimitStrings = HasFlag( input.m_eFlags, EInputFlags::LimitStrings );
	context.m_DirectoryHashes = {};
	context.m_BaseNameHashes = {};
	context.m_pReport = &report;
	context.m_cSnapshot = 0;
	context.m_unMaxAgeSeconds = input.m_unMaxAgeSeconds;

	CollectReport( context, report );

	// @note / sapdragon: only on this path, a failed bootstrap returns without it. the frees after it go through the real IAT
	bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();

	if ( context.m_BaseNameHashes.m_punHashes )
		FreeMemory( context.m_BaseNameHashes.m_punHashes );
	if ( context.m_DirectoryHashes.m_punHashes )
		FreeMemory( context.m_DirectoryHashes.m_punHashes );
	DestructStringTable( context.m_BaseNames );
	DestructStringTable( context.m_Directories );
	return 0;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::system_handles
```

```cpp
// @binary: 1da8fb5c

namespace vac::workers::system_handles

constexpr u32 k_unSystemHandleInformation = 16;
constexpr u32 k_unFileTimeTicksPerSecond = 10000000;
constexpr u32 k_cchImagePath = 512;

using PfnNtQuerySystemInformation_t = NTSTATUS( WINAPI * )( u32, void *, ULONG, ULONG * );

#pragma pack( push, 1 )
struct SystemHandleEntry_t
{
	// @note / sapdragon: valve reads the pid as a dword, so the back trace index in the high word comes along
	u32 m_unPidAndBackTrace;
	u8 m_unObjectType;
	u8 m_unFlags;
	u16 m_unHandle;
	u32 m_unObject;
	u32 m_unGrantedAccess;
};

struct SystemHandleInformation_t
{
	int m_cHandles;
	SystemHandleEntry_t m_rgHandles[1];
};
#pragma pack( pop )
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( SystemHandleEntry_t, 16 );

// @note / sapdragon: stands in for __aulldiv, there is no crt here. valve keeps only the low dword anyway
u32 FileTimeToSeconds( u64 ulFileTime ) noexcept
{
	const u32 unHigh = static_cast<u32>( ulFileTime >> 32 ) % k_unFileTimeTicksPerSecond;
	const u64 ulRest = ( static_cast<u64>( unHigh ) << 32 ) | static_cast<u32>( ulFileTime );
	unsigned int unRemainder;
	return _udiv64( ulRest, k_unFileTimeTicksPerSecond, &unRemainder );
}

// @orig: FF 74 24 ? 52
int CompareDevicePrefix( const wchar_t *pwszPath, const wchar_t *pwszDevice, int cchDevice ) noexcept
{
	return CompareStringW( LOCALE_SYSTEM_DEFAULT, NORM_IGNORECASE, pwszPath, cchDevice, pwszDevice, cchDevice ) -
	       CSTR_EQUAL;
}

// @orig: 56 57 8B F2 8B F9
void CopyImagePath( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc ) noexcept
{
	memcpy( pwszDst, pwszSrc, k_cchImagePath * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
	const u32 cchSrc = lstrlenW( pwszSrc );
	if ( cchSrc < k_cchImagePath )
		memset( pwszDst + cchSrc, 0, ( k_cchImagePath - cchSrc ) * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 33 C0
bool DeviceToDosPath( wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	// @note / sapdragon: long paths run from the joined buffer into the device one and the copy reads 1024 bytes
	// from the start, so they stay neighbours like on valve's stack
	struct
	{
		wchar_t m_wszJoined[MAX_PATH];
		wchar_t m_wszDevice[MAX_PATH];
	} buffers;

	wchar_t wszDrives[MAX_PATH];
	wszDrives[0] = 0;
	if ( !g_pImports->GetLogicalDriveStringsW( 250, wszDrives ) )
		return false;

	const wchar_t *pwszDrive = wszDrives;
	wchar_t wszDrive[3] = L"C:";
	wchar_t wchDrive = wszDrives[0];
	for ( ;; )
	{
		wszDrive[0] = wchDrive;
		if ( g_pImports->QueryDosDeviceW( wszDrive, buffers.m_wszDevice, ARRAYSIZE( buffers.m_wszDevice ) ) )
		{
			const u32 cchDevice = lstrlenW( buffers.m_wszDevice );
			if ( cchDevice < ARRAYSIZE( buffers.m_wszDevice ) &&
			     !CompareDevicePrefix( pwszPath, buffers.m_wszDevice, cchDevice ) )
			{
				buffers.m_wszJoined[0] = 0;
				lstrcatW( buffers.m_wszJoined, wszDrive );
				lstrcatW( buffers.m_wszJoined, pwszPath + cchDevice );
				CopyImagePath( pwszPath, buffers.m_wszJoined );
				return true;
			}
		}

		while ( *pwszDrive++ )
			;
		wchDrive = *pwszDrive;
		if ( !wchDrive )
			return false;
	}
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? A1
int EnumerateProcesses( u32 *punPids, u32 *punParentPids ) noexcept
{
	int cProcesses = 0;
	const bool bWalked =
	    process::ForEachSnapshotProcess( g_pImports,
	                                     [&]( const PROCESSENTRY32W &entry )
	                                     {
		                                     if ( cProcesses < k_cMaxPids )
		                                     {
			                                     int iInsert = cProcesses;
			                                     while ( iInsert > 0 && punPids[iInsert - 1] > entry.th32ProcessID )
			                                     {
				                                     punPids[iInsert] = punPids[iInsert - 1];
				                                     punParentPids[iInsert] = punParentPids[iInsert - 1];
				                                     --iInsert;
			                                     }
			                                     ++cProcesses;
			                                     punPids[iInsert] = entry.th32ProcessID;
			                                     punParentPids[iInsert] = entry.th32ParentProcessID;
		                                     }
		                                     return true;
	                                     } );

	// @note / sapdragon: a failed snapshot reports 60 processes, the callers use it as a real count. valve bug, keep it
	return bWalked ? cProcesses : 60;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 83 24 24
EScanStatus GetSystemHandles( u32 *punPids, int cPids, int *pcExtraPids, u32 *pcHandles, HandleMask_t *pMasks ) noexcept
{
	auto szQuery = util::MakeXorString<0x5E>( "NtQuerySystemInformation" );
	szQuery.Decode();

	const auto pfnQuery = reinterpret_cast<PfnNtQuerySystemInformation_t>(
	    g_pImports->GetProcAddress( g_pSession->m_hNtdll, szQuery.Get() ) );
	if ( !pfnQuery )
		return static_cast<EScanStatus>( g_pImports->GetLastError() );

	SystemHandleInformation_t *pInformation = nullptr;
	u32 cubBuffer = 0;
	EScanStatus eStatus;
	for ( ;; )
	{
		cubBuffer += 0x100000;
		if ( pInformation )
			g_pImports->VirtualFree( pInformation, 0, MEM_RELEASE );

		pInformation = static_cast<SystemHandleInformation_t *>(
		    g_pImports->VirtualAlloc( nullptr, cubBuffer, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE ) );
		if ( !pInformation )
			return static_cast<EScanStatus>( g_pImports->GetLastError() );

		eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pfnQuery( k_unSystemHandleInformation, pInformation, cubBuffer, nullptr ) );
		if ( static_cast<NTSTATUS>( eStatus ) != STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH )
			break;
	}

	if ( eStatus == EScanStatus::Ok )
	{
		*pcHandles = pInformation->m_cHandles;
		*pcExtraPids = 0;

		int iPid = 0;
		for ( int iHandle = 0; iHandle < pInformation->m_cHandles; ++iHandle )
		{
			const SystemHandleEntry_t &entry = pInformation->m_rgHandles[iHandle];
			const u32 unPid = entry.m_unPidAndBackTrace;

			// @note / sapdragon: the search starts where the last one ended, handles of one process come in a row
			bool bFound = false;
			for ( int iTry = 0; iTry < cPids; ++iTry )
			{
				if ( punPids[iPid] == unPid )
				{
					bFound = true;
					break;
				}
				if ( ++iPid >= cPids )
					iPid %= cPids;
			}

			if ( !bFound )
			{
				++*pcExtraPids;
				if ( cPids < k_cMaxPids )
				{
					punPids[cPids] = unPid;
					iPid = cPids++;
				}
			}

			if ( punPids[iPid] == unPid )
			{
				u32 unLow = 0;
				u32 unHigh = 0;
				if ( entry.m_unObjectType < 55 )
				{
					if ( entry.m_unObjectType < 32 )
						unLow = 1u << entry.m_unObjectType;
					else
						unHigh = 1u << ( entry.m_unObjectType - 32 );
				}

				HandleMask_t &mask = pMasks[iPid];
				u32 unMaskHigh = mask.m_unHigh;
				if ( unMaskHigh < 0xFF000000 )
					unMaskHigh += 0x01000000;
				mask.m_unLow |= unLow;
				mask.m_unHigh = unMaskHigh | unHigh;
			}
		}
	}

	g_pImports->VirtualFree( pInformation, 0, MEM_RELEASE );
	return eStatus;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56
bool CollectProcess( ScanContext_t &context, u32 unPid, u32 unParentPidAndFlags, u32 unMaskLow,
                     u32 unMaskHigh ) noexcept
{
	Report_t &report = *context.m_pReport;
	ProcessRecord_t &record = report.m_rgRecords[report.m_cRecords];

	HANDLE hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );
	if ( ( g_pSession->m_OsVersion.dwPlatformId != VER_PLATFORM_WIN32_NT ||
	       g_pSession->m_OsVersion.dwMajorVersion < 6 ) &&
	     ( !hProcess || hProcess == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ) )
	{
		hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );
	}

	u32 unDirectoryHash = 0;
	u32 unBaseNameHash = 0;
	u64 ulCreateTime = 0;
	u32 unCreateSeconds = 0;
	u32 unError = 0;
	u32 unFlags;

	if ( !hProcess || hProcess == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
	{
		unError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
		// @note / sapdragon: the brute forced pids that do not exist end here
		if ( unError == ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER &&
		     unParentPidAndFlags == static_cast<u32>( ERecordFlags::NotInSnapshot ) )
			return true;
		unFlags = unParentPidAndFlags | static_cast<u32>( ERecordFlags::OpenFailed );
	}
	else
	{
		++report.m_cOpened;

		// @note / sapdragon: not cleared, a failed name query leaves stack garbage that still goes through the conversion
		wchar_t wszImage[k_cchImagePath];
		const u32 cchImage = g_pImports->GetProcessImageFileNameW( hProcess, wszImage, k_cchImagePath );
		DeviceToDosPath( wszImage );

		FILETIME createTime;
		FILETIME exitTime;
		FILETIME kernelTime;
		FILETIME userTime;
		const BOOL bHaveTimes = g_pImports->GetProcessTimes( hProcess, &createTime, &exitTime, &kernelTime, &userTime );
		g_pImports->CloseHandle( hProcess );

		unFlags = unParentPidAndFlags;
		if ( bHaveTimes )
		{
			memcpy( &ulCreateTime, &createTime, sizeof( ulCreateTime ) );
			if ( exitTime.dwHighDateTime || exitTime.dwLowDateTime )
			{
				if ( !context.m_bIncludeExited )
					return true;
				unFlags |= static_cast<u32>( ERecordFlags::Exited );
			}

			unCreateSeconds = FileTimeToSeconds( ulCreateTime );
			// @note / sapdragon: the clock is only set in ScanPidRange, handle-only pids compare against stack garbage. valve bug, keep it
			if ( context.m_bFilterByAge && context.m_unNowSeconds > unCreateSeconds &&
			     context.m_unNowSeconds - unCreateSeconds > context.m_unMaxAgeSeconds )
			{
				return true;
			}
		}

		char szBaseName[264];
		int cchBaseName = 0;
		if ( cchImage - 1 <= k_cchImagePath - 2 )
		{
			wchar_t *pwszBaseName = const_cast<wchar_t *>( util::wstr::BaseName( wszImage ) );
			// @note / sapdragon: cuts the name off the path, so the "path" hash and string below are the directory only
			if ( pwszBaseName > wszImage )
				pwszBaseName[-1] = 0;
			util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, pwszBaseName, szBaseName, MAX_PATH );
			while ( szBaseName[cchBaseName] )
				++cchBaseName;
		}

		char szDirectory[264];
		util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, wszImage, szDirectory, MAX_PATH );
		int cchDirectory = 0;
		while ( szDirectory[cchDirectory] )
			++cchDirectory;

		if ( context.m_bLimitStrings &&
		     cchBaseName + cchDirectory + context.m_Directories.m_cubUsed + context.m_BaseNames.m_cubUsed + 2 >
		         static_cast<int>( sizeof( ProcessRecord_t ) *
		                           ( ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgRecords ) - 1 - report.m_cRecords ) ) )
		{
			return false;
		}

		if ( cchBaseName )
		{
			unDirectoryHash = util::hashing::PathHashBytes( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( szDirectory ), cchDirectory );
			AddString( context.m_Directories, unDirectoryHash, szDirectory, cchDirectory );
			AppendHash( context.m_DirectoryHashes, unDirectoryHash );

			unBaseNameHash = util::hashing::PathHashBytes( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( szBaseName ), cchBaseName );
			AddString( context.m_BaseNames, unBaseNameHash, szBaseName, cchBaseName );
			AppendHash( context.m_BaseNameHashes, unBaseNameHash );
		}
	}

	record.m_unDirectoryHash = unDirectoryHash;
	record.m_unPid = unPid;
	record.m_unBaseNameHash = unBaseNameHash;
	record.m_unParentPidAndFlags = unFlags;
	record.m_unCreateSecondsOrError = ulCreateTime ? unCreateSeconds : unError;
	record.m_unHandleMaskLow = unMaskLow;
	record.m_unHandleMaskHigh = unMaskHigh;
	++report.m_cRecords;
	return true;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 57 8D 44 24
void ScanPidRange( ScanContext_t &context ) noexcept
{
	FILETIME now;
	g_pImports->GetSystemTimeAsFileTime( &now );
	u64 ulNow;
	memcpy( &ulNow, &now, sizeof( ulNow ) );

	const u32 unNowSeconds = FileTimeToSeconds( ulNow );
	context.m_pReport->m_unScanTimeSeconds = unNowSeconds;
	context.m_unNowSeconds = unNowSeconds;

	if ( !context.m_cSnapshot )
		return;

	// @note / sapdragon: walks every pid below the highest one in steps of 4, this is how it finds what the snapshot does not list
	u32 unPid = context.m_rgunPids[context.m_cSnapshot - 1];
	int iSnapshot = context.m_cSnapshot - 1;
	while ( iSnapshot >= 0 )
	{
		if ( !unPid || context.m_pReport->m_cRecords >= ARRAYSIZE( context.m_pReport->m_rgRecords ) )
			return;

		u32 unMaskLow = 0;
		u32 unMaskHigh = 0;
		u32 unParentPidAndFlags = static_cast<u32>( ERecordFlags::NotInSnapshot );
		if ( context.m_rgunPids[iSnapshot] == unPid )
		{
			unParentPidAndFlags = context.m_rgunParentPids[iSnapshot];
			unMaskLow = context.m_rgMasks[iSnapshot].m_unLow;
			unMaskHigh = context.m_rgMasks[iSnapshot].m_unHigh;
			--iSnapshot;
		}

		if ( unPid >= context.m_unMinPid && ( unPid <= context.m_unMaxPid || !context.m_unMaxPid ) )
		{
			if ( !CollectProcess( context, unPid, unParentPidAndFlags, unMaskLow, unMaskHigh ) )
				return;
		}
		unPid -= 4;
	}
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 57 8B E9
void CollectReport( ScanContext_t &context, Report_t &report ) noexcept
{
	int cubPids;
	g_pImports->EnumProcesses( reinterpret_cast<DWORD *>( context.m_rgunPids ), sizeof( context.m_rgunPids ),
	                           reinterpret_cast<DWORD *>( &cubPids ) );
	const int cEnumerated = cubPids / static_cast<int>( sizeof( u32 ) );

	memset( context.m_rgunParentPids, 0, sizeof( context.m_rgunParentPids ) );
	context.m_cSnapshot = EnumerateProcesses( context.m_rgunPids, context.m_rgunParentPids );
	report.m_cEnumerated = cEnumerated;

	int cExtraPids = 0;
	u32 cHandles = 0;
	memset( context.m_rgMasks, 0, sizeof( context.m_rgMasks ) );
	report.m_eHandleQueryStatus =
	    GetSystemHandles( context.m_rgunPids, context.m_cSnapshot, &cExtraPids, &cHandles, context.m_rgMasks );

	// @note / sapdragon: from slot 500 on this reads pids out of the parent list and masks from above the context on the
	// stack, so the report can hold return addresses. only needs a big process list. valve bug, keep it
	for ( int iExtra = 0; iExtra < cExtraPids; ++iExtra )
	{
		const int iPid = context.m_cSnapshot + iExtra;
		CollectProcess( context, context.m_rgunPids[iPid], 0, context.m_rgMasks[iPid].m_unLow,
		                context.m_rgMasks[iPid].m_unHigh );
		if ( report.m_cRecords == ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgRecords ) )
			break;
	}
	report.m_cExtraPids = cExtraPids;
	report.m_cSystemHandles = cHandles;

	ScanPidRange( context );

	EmitStrings( context.m_BaseNames, context.m_Directories, context.m_DirectoryHashes, context.m_BaseNameHashes,
	             sizeof( ProcessRecord_t ) * ( ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgRecords ) - report.m_cRecords ),
	             reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( &report.m_rgRecords[report.m_cRecords] ) );

	// @note / sapdragon: the hash vectors only have entries for records with a base name, hence the separate index
	int iHash = 0;
	for ( u32 iRecord = 0; iRecord < report.m_cRecords; ++iRecord )
	{
		ProcessRecord_t &record = report.m_rgRecords[iRecord];
		if ( record.m_unBaseNameHash && !context.m_BaseNameHashes.m_punHashes[iHash] )
			record.m_unParentPidAndFlags |= static_cast<u32>( ERecordFlags::BaseNameEmitted );
		if ( record.m_unDirectoryHash && !context.m_DirectoryHashes.m_punHashes[iHash] )
			record.m_unParentPidAndFlags |= static_cast<u32>( ERecordFlags::DirectoryEmitted );
		if ( record.m_unBaseNameHash )
			++iHash;
	}
}
```

```cpp
// @orig: 1da8fb5c:0x1000562F (no unique signature)
void *AllocateMemory( SIZE_T cubMemory ) noexcept
{
	return HeapAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), 0, cubMemory );
}

// @orig: 52 85 C9 74
void *ReallocateMemory( void *pMemory, SIZE_T cubMemory ) noexcept
{
	if ( pMemory )
		return HeapReAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), 0, pMemory, cubMemory );
	return HeapAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), 0, cubMemory );
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 56
void GrowHashVector( HashVector_t &vector ) noexcept
{
	if ( vector.m_cHashes == vector.m_cCapacity )
	{
		vector.m_cCapacity += 128;
		vector.m_punHashes =
		    static_cast<u32 *>( ReallocateMemory( vector.m_punHashes, sizeof( u32 ) * vector.m_cCapacity ) );
	}
}

// @orig: 8B 11 33 C0 56
int FindString( const StringTable_t &table, u32 unHash ) noexcept
{
	for ( int iEntry = 0; iEntry < table.m_cEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		if ( table.m_pEntries[iEntry].m_unHash == unHash )
			return iEntry;
	}
	return -1;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 55 8B E9
void SortByRefs( StringTable_t &table ) noexcept
{
	for ( int iLeft = 0; iLeft < table.m_cEntries; ++iLeft )
	{
		for ( int iRight = iLeft + 1; iRight < table.m_cEntries; ++iRight )
		{
			if ( table.m_pEntries[iLeft].m_cRefs < table.m_pEntries[iRight].m_cRefs )
			{
				const StringEntry_t temp = table.m_pEntries[iLeft];
				table.m_pEntries[iLeft] = table.m_pEntries[iRight];
				table.m_pEntries[iRight] = temp;
			}
		}
	}
}

// @orig: 53 8B D9 33 D2
bool CopyString( const StringTable_t &table, u32 unHash, u8 **ppubCursor, int *pcubLeft ) noexcept
{
	for ( int iEntry = 0; iEntry < table.m_cEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		const StringEntry_t &entry = table.m_pEntries[iEntry];
		if ( entry.m_unHash == unHash && entry.m_cchText < *pcubLeft )
		{
			u8 *pubCursor = *ppubCursor;
			*pcubLeft = *pcubLeft - entry.m_cchText - 1;
			// @note / sapdragon: text stays null when the pool was full, this faults. valve bug, keep it
			memcpy( pubCursor, entry.m_pszText, entry.m_cchText + 1 );
			*ppubCursor = pubCursor + entry.m_cchText + 1;
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

	HeapFree( GetProcessHeap(), 0, pMemory );
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 B9
void ConstructStringTable( StringTable_t &table ) noexcept
{
	table.m_pubPool = static_cast<char *>( AllocateMemory( k_cubStringPool ) );
	table.m_pubCursor = table.m_pubPool;
	table.m_pEntries = static_cast<StringEntry_t *>( AllocateMemory( k_cMaxStrings * sizeof( StringEntry_t ) ) );
	table.m_cubUsed = 0;
	table.m_cEntries = 0;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 4E
void DestructStringTable( StringTable_t &table ) noexcept
{
	FreeMemory( table.m_pubPool );
	FreeMemory( table.m_pEntries );
}

// @orig: 53 8B 5C 24 ? 33 C0
void AddString( StringTable_t &table, u32 unHash, const char *pszText, int cchText ) noexcept
{
	for ( int iEntry = 0; iEntry < table.m_cEntries; ++iEntry )
	{
		if ( table.m_pEntries[iEntry].m_unHash == unHash )
		{
			++table.m_pEntries[iEntry].m_cRefs;
			return;
		}
	}

	if ( table.m_cEntries >= k_cMaxStrings )
		return;

	StringEntry_t &entry = table.m_pEntries[table.m_cEntries];
	entry.m_unHash = unHash;
	entry.m_cRefs = 1;
	entry.m_pszText = nullptr;
	entry.m_cchText = cchText;
	entry.m_bSelected = false;
	if ( pszText && static_cast<u32>( cchText + table.m_cubUsed + 1 ) < k_cubStringPool )
	{
		memcpy( table.m_pubCursor, pszText, cchText );
		table.m_pubCursor[cchText] = 0;
		entry.m_pszText = table.m_pubCursor;
		table.m_pubCursor += cchText + 1;
		table.m_cubUsed += cchText + 1;
	}
	++table.m_cEntries;
}

// @orig: 56 57 8B F9 E8
void AppendHash( HashVector_t &vector, u32 unHash ) noexcept
{
	GrowHashVector( vector );
	vector.m_punHashes[vector.m_cHashes++] = unHash;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 55 57
void EmitStrings( StringTable_t &baseNames, StringTable_t &directories, HashVector_t &directoryHashes,
                  HashVector_t &baseNameHashes, int cubBudget, u8 *pubCursor ) noexcept
{
	if ( !directories.m_cEntries )
		return;

	int cubMarked = cubBudget;
	SortByRefs( directories );

	// @note / sapdragon: starts at the least referenced directory and walks up. a percentile with 100 hardcoded
	int iDirectory = ( 100 * directories.m_cEntries - 100 ) / 100;
	const int iLast = ( iDirectory + 1 ) % directories.m_cEntries;
	if ( directories.m_cEntries > 0 )
	{
		int cVisited = 0;
		do
		{
			for ( int iHash = 0; iHash < directoryHashes.m_cHashes; ++iHash )
			{
				if ( FindString( directories, directoryHashes.m_punHashes[iHash] ) != iDirectory )
					continue;

				const int iBaseName = FindString( baseNames, baseNameHashes.m_punHashes[iHash] );
				if ( !baseNames.m_pEntries[iBaseName].m_bSelected )
				{
					cubMarked += -1 - baseNames.m_pEntries[iBaseName].m_cchText;
					if ( cubMarked < 0 )
						break;
					if ( iBaseName >= 0 && iBaseName < baseNames.m_cEntries )
						baseNames.m_pEntries[iBaseName].m_bSelected = true;
				}
			}

			cubMarked += -1 - directories.m_pEntries[iDirectory].m_cchText;
			if ( cubMarked < 0 )
				break;
			if ( iDirectory >= 0 && iDirectory < directories.m_cEntries )
				directories.m_pEntries[iDirectory].m_bSelected = true;
			if ( iDirectory == iLast )
				break;

			++cVisited;
			iDirectory = ( iDirectory - 1 >= 0 ? iDirectory : directories.m_cEntries ) - 1;
		} while ( cVisited < directories.m_cEntries );
	}

	int cubLeft = cubBudget;
	for ( int iHash = 0; iHash < directoryHashes.m_cHashes; ++iHash )
	{
		const int iBaseName = FindString( baseNames, baseNameHashes.m_punHashes[iHash] );
		if ( iBaseName >= 0 && baseNames.m_pEntries[iBaseName].m_bSelected )
		{
			if ( iBaseName < baseNames.m_cEntries )
				baseNames.m_pEntries[iBaseName].m_bSelected = false;
			if ( CopyString( baseNames, baseNameHashes.m_punHashes[iHash], &pubCursor, &cubLeft ) )
				baseNameHashes.m_punHashes[iHash] = 0;
		}

		const int iSelected = FindString( directories, directoryHashes.m_punHashes[iHash] );
		if ( iSelected >= 0 && directories.m_pEntries[iSelected].m_bSelected )
		{
			if ( iSelected < directories.m_cEntries )
				directories.m_pEntries[iSelected].m_bSelected = false;

			// @note / sapdragon: a directory hash found among the base names counts as sent without being copied. valve's quirk
			const u32 unHash = directoryHashes.m_punHashes[iHash];
			if ( FindString( baseNames, unHash ) >= 0 || CopyString( directories, unHash, &pubCursor, &cubLeft ) )
				directoryHashes.m_punHashes[iHash] = 0;
		}
	}
}

} // namespace vac::workers::system_handles
```

`modules/system_handles/tests/parity.cpp`:

```cpp
// Controlled comparison of system_handles against the original worker.
//
//     system_handles_parity.exe <original module.dll> [--no-frozen] [--fuzz <cases>] [--only <scenario>]
//
// A live run cannot settle this module: processes, handle counts and the clock move between two calls.
// Here both sides run on the same frozen world: the original's bootstrap and teardown are patched to install
// fake imports, the rebuild links against the fake BootstrapMain below. Compared for every case: all report
// bytes plus a sentinel behind them, return value, output size, whether it faulted, and the ordered list of import calls.
//
// Scenario groups: scripted edge cases, seeded random worlds, and "frozen": one real snapshot of this machine taken
// once at start and replayed to both sides, so real paths, handle tables and over 144 record lists are covered too.

#include "../internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cwchar>
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <random>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace vac
{

namespace
{

constinit SystemImports_t s_Imports{};
constinit ModuleSession_t s_Session{};

} // namespace

constinit SystemImports_t *const g_pImports = &s_Imports;
constinit ModuleSession_t *const g_pSession = &s_Session;
constinit u32 g_unIntegrityHash = 0;
constinit Module_t *g_pModuleListHead = nullptr;

} // namespace vac

using namespace vac;
using namespace vac::workers::system_handles;

namespace vac::workers::system_handles
{
int RunSystemHandles( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept;
}

namespace
{

// Addresses in 1da8fb5c. 9f73e639 has the same code at the same addresses.
constexpr u32 k_rvaWorker = 0x313D;
constexpr u32 k_rvaBootstrapMain = 0x51A3;
constexpr u32 k_rvaBootstrapTeardown = 0x5262;
constexpr u32 k_rvaSessionPointer = 0x6000;
constexpr u32 k_rvaImportsPointer = 0x6004;

const HMODULE k_hFakeNtdll = reinterpret_cast<HMODULE>( 0x7777 );
const HANDLE k_hFakeSnapshot = reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( 0x5150 );
constexpr u64 k_ulBaseTime = 133000000000000000ull;
constexpr u64 k_ulTicksPerSecond = 10000000ull;
constexpr u32 k_cubSentinel = 64;

using PfnWorker_t = int( __cdecl * )( const void *, void *, u32 * );

struct FakeProcess_t
{
	u32 m_unOpenError = 0;
	bool m_bOpenGivesMinusOne = false;
	bool m_bLimitedDenied = false;
	std::wstring m_wszImage;
	bool m_bNameOverride = false;
	u32 m_unNameResult = 0;
	bool m_bNameWrites = true;
	u32 m_unNameError = 31;
	bool m_bTimesFail = false;
	u32 m_unTimesError = 6;
	u64 m_ulCreate = k_ulBaseTime;
	u64 m_ulExit = 0;
};

struct FakeHandle_t
{
	u32 m_unPidAndBackTrace;
	u8 m_unType;
};

struct SnapshotRow_t
{
	u32 m_unPid;
	u32 m_unParent;
};

struct World_t
{
	std::vector<u32> m_rgunEnum;
	std::vector<SnapshotRow_t> m_rgSnapshot;
	bool m_bSnapshotFails = false;
	std::map<u32, FakeProcess_t> m_Processes;
	std::vector<FakeHandle_t> m_rgHandles;
	u32 m_cMismatches = 0;
	u32 m_unHandleStatus = 0;
	bool m_bNoNtQuery = false;
	int m_iFailAlloc = -1;
	bool m_bDrivesFail = false;
	std::vector<std::pair<wchar_t, std::wstring>> m_rgDrives;
	u32 m_unDefaultOpenError = ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER;
	u64 m_ulNow = k_ulBaseTime + 5000 * k_ulTicksPerSecond;
	u32 m_unPlatform = VER_PLATFORM_WIN32_NT;
	u32 m_unMajor = 10;
	u32 m_unMinor = 0;
	bool m_bBootFails = false;

void Trace( const char *pszFormat, ... )
{
	char szLine[160];
	va_list args;
	va_start( args, pszFormat );
	vsnprintf( szLine, sizeof( szLine ), pszFormat, args );
	va_end( args );
	s_szTrace += szLine;
	s_szTrace += '\n';
}

DWORD WINAPI FakeGetLastError()
{
	Trace( "GetLastError -> %u", s_unLastError );
	return s_unLastError;
}

NTSTATUS WINAPI FakeNtQuery( u32 unClass, void *pBuffer, ULONG cubBuffer, ULONG *pcubReturned )
{
	Trace( "NtQuerySystemInformation %u %u %d", unClass, cubBuffer, pcubReturned != nullptr );
	if ( s_cHandleQueries++ < s_pWorld->m_cMismatches )
		return static_cast<NTSTATUS>( 0xC0000004 );
	if ( s_pWorld->m_unHandleStatus )
		return static_cast<NTSTATUS>( s_pWorld->m_unHandleStatus );

	const size_t cHandles = s_pWorld->m_rgHandles.size();
	if ( 4 + cHandles * 16 > cubBuffer )
		return static_cast<NTSTATUS>( 0xC0000004 );

	auto *pubBuffer = static_cast<u8 *>( pBuffer );
	*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubBuffer ) = static_cast<u32>( cHandles );
	for ( size_t iHandle = 0; iHandle < cHandles; ++iHandle )
	{
		u8 *pubEntry = pubBuffer + 4 + iHandle * 16;
		*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubEntry ) = s_pWorld->m_rgHandles[iHandle].m_unPidAndBackTrace;
		pubEntry[4] = s_pWorld->m_rgHandles[iHandle].m_unType;
		pubEntry[5] = 0x5A;
		*reinterpret_cast<u16 *>( pubEntry + 6 ) = static_cast<u16>( iHandle );
		*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubEntry + 8 ) = 0x81000000u + static_cast<u32>( iHandle );
		*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubEntry + 12 ) = 0x1FFFFF;
	}
	return 0;
}

FARPROC WINAPI FakeGetProcAddress( HMODULE hModule, LPCSTR pszName )
{
	Trace( "GetProcAddress %p %s", hModule, pszName );
	if ( s_pWorld->m_bNoNtQuery || std::strcmp( pszName, "NtQuerySystemInformation" ) )
	{
		s_unLastError = ERROR_PROC_NOT_FOUND;
		return nullptr;
	}
	return reinterpret_cast<FARPROC>( FakeNtQuery );
}

BOOL WINAPI FakeEnumProcesses( DWORD *punPids, DWORD cubPids, LPDWORD pcubNeeded )
{
	const DWORD cWrite = min( static_cast<DWORD>( s_pWorld->m_rgunEnum.size() ), cubPids / 4 );
	Trace( "EnumProcesses %u", cubPids );
	if ( cWrite )
		std::memcpy( punPids, s_pWorld->m_rgunEnum.data(), cWrite * 4 );
	*pcubNeeded = cWrite * 4;
	return TRUE;
}

HANDLE WINAPI FakeCreateSnapshot( DWORD unFlags, DWORD unPid )
{
	Trace( "CreateToolhelp32Snapshot %u %u", unFlags, unPid );
	s_iSnapshot = 0;
	if ( s_pWorld->m_bSnapshotFails )
	{
		s_unLastError = ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED;
		return INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
	}
	return k_hFakeSnapshot;
}

BOOL FillSnapshotRow( PROCESSENTRY32W *pEntry )
{
	if ( s_iSnapshot >= s_pWorld->m_rgSnapshot.size() )
	{
		s_unLastError = ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES;
		return FALSE;
	}
	pEntry->th32ProcessID = s_pWorld->m_rgSnapshot[s_iSnapshot].m_unPid;
	pEntry->th32ParentProcessID = s_pWorld->m_rgSnapshot[s_iSnapshot].m_unParent;
	++s_iSnapshot;
	return TRUE;
}

BOOL WINAPI FakeProcessFirst( HANDLE hSnapshot, LPPROCESSENTRY32W pEntry )
{
	Trace( "Process32FirstW %p %u", hSnapshot, pEntry->dwSize );
	return FillSnapshotRow( pEntry );
}

BOOL WINAPI FakeProcessNext( HANDLE hSnapshot, LPPROCESSENTRY32W pEntry )
{
	Trace( "Process32NextW %p %u", hSnapshot, pEntry->dwSize );
	return FillSnapshotRow( pEntry );
}

BOOL WINAPI FakeCloseHandle( HANDLE hObject )
{
	Trace( "CloseHandle %p", hObject );
	return TRUE;
}

LPVOID WINAPI FakeVirtualAlloc( LPVOID pAddress, SIZE_T cub, DWORD unType, DWORD unProtect )
{
	Trace( "VirtualAlloc %p %u %x %x", pAddress, static_cast<u32>( cub ), unType, unProtect );
	if ( s_cAllocs++ == s_pWorld->m_iFailAlloc )
	{
		s_unLastError = ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY;
		return nullptr;
	}
	return VirtualAlloc( pAddress, cub, unType, unProtect );
}

BOOL WINAPI FakeVirtualFree( LPVOID pAddress, SIZE_T cub, DWORD unType )
{
	Trace( "VirtualFree %u %x", static_cast<u32>( cub ), unType );
	return VirtualFree( pAddress, cub, unType );
}

HANDLE WINAPI FakeOpenProcess( DWORD unAccess, BOOL bInherit, DWORD unPid )
{
	Trace( "OpenProcess %x %d %u", unAccess, bInherit, unPid );
	const auto iter = s_pWorld->m_Processes.find( unPid );
	if ( iter == s_pWorld->m_Processes.end() )
	{
		s_unLastError = s_pWorld->m_unDefaultOpenError;
		return nullptr;
	}
	const FakeProcess_t &process = iter->second;
	if ( process.m_unOpenError )
	{
		s_unLastError = process.m_unOpenError;
		return process.m_bOpenGivesMinusOne ? INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE : nullptr;
	}
	if ( process.m_bLimitedDenied && unAccess == 0x1000 )
	{
		s_unLastError = ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED;
		return nullptr;
	}
	const HANDLE hProcess = reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( static_cast<uptr>( 0x40000000u + 4 * ++s_cHandlesOpened ) );
	s_HandlePids[hProcess] = unPid;
	return hProcess;
}

const FakeProcess_t &ProcessOf( HANDLE hProcess )
{
	return s_pWorld->m_Processes.at( s_HandlePids.at( hProcess ) );
}

DWORD WINAPI FakeImageName( HANDLE hProcess, LPWSTR pwszName, DWORD cchName )
{
	const FakeProcess_t &process = ProcessOf( hProcess );
	Trace( "GetProcessImageFileNameW %p %u", hProcess, cchName );
	if ( process.m_bNameWrites )
	{
		const size_t cchCopy = min( process.m_wszImage.size(), static_cast<size_t>( cchName - 1 ) );
		std::wmemcpy( pwszName, process.m_wszImage.data(), cchCopy );
		pwszName[cchCopy] = 0;
	}
	if ( process.m_bNameOverride )
	{
		s_unLastError = process.m_unNameError;
		return process.m_unNameResult;
	}
	return static_cast<DWORD>( min( process.m_wszImage.size(), static_cast<size_t>( cchName - 1 ) ) );
}

BOOL WINAPI FakeProcessTimes( HANDLE hProcess, LPFILETIME pCreate, LPFILETIME pExit, LPFILETIME pKernel,
                              LPFILETIME pUser )
{
	const FakeProcess_t &process = ProcessOf( hProcess );
	Trace( "GetProcessTimes %p", hProcess );
	if ( process.m_bTimesFail )
	{
		s_unLastError = process.m_unTimesError;
		return FALSE;
	}
	std::memcpy( pCreate, &process.m_ulCreate, 8 );
	std::memcpy( pExit, &process.m_ulExit, 8 );
	std::memset( pKernel, 0x11, 8 );
	std::memset( pUser, 0x22, 8 );
	return TRUE;
}

DWORD WINAPI FakeLogicalDrives( DWORD cchBuffer, LPWSTR pwszBuffer )
{
	Trace( "GetLogicalDriveStringsW %u", cchBuffer );
	if ( s_pWorld->m_bDrivesFail )
		return 0;
	wchar_t *pwszWrite = pwszBuffer;
	for ( const auto &drive : s_pWorld->m_rgDrives )
	{
		*pwszWrite++ = drive.first;
		*pwszWrite++ = L':';
		*pwszWrite++ = L'\\';
		*pwszWrite++ = 0;
	}
	*pwszWrite = 0;
	return static_cast<DWORD>( pwszWrite - pwszBuffer );
}

DWORD WINAPI FakeQueryDosDevice( LPCWSTR pwszDrive, LPWSTR pwszDevice, DWORD cchDevice )
{
	Trace( "QueryDosDeviceW %04x %04x %04x %u", pwszDrive[0], pwszDrive[1], pwszDrive[2], cchDevice );
	for ( const auto &drive : s_pWorld->m_rgDrives )
	{
		if ( drive.first == pwszDrive[0] && !drive.second.empty() && drive.second != L"?" )
		{
			std::wcscpy( pwszDevice, drive.second.c_str() );
			return static_cast<DWORD>( drive.second.size() + 2 );
		}
		if ( drive.first == pwszDrive[0] && drive.second.empty() )
		{
			pwszDevice[0] = 0;
			return 1;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

// Strings stay out of the trace, a failed name query leaves different stack garbage per side.
int WINAPI FakeWideToMulti( UINT unCodePage, DWORD unFlags, LPCWCH pwszIn, int cchIn, LPSTR pszOut, int cubOut,
                            LPCCH pszDefault, LPBOOL pbUsedDefault )
{
	const int nResult =
	    WideCharToMultiByte( unCodePage, unFlags, pwszIn, cchIn, pszOut, cubOut, pszDefault, pbUsedDefault );
	Trace( "WideCharToMultiByte %u %x %d %d %p %p", unCodePage, unFlags, cchIn, cubOut, pszDefault, pbUsedDefault );
	return nResult;
}

void WINAPI FakeSystemTime( LPFILETIME pTime )
{
	Trace( "GetSystemTimeAsFileTime" );
	std::memcpy( pTime, &s_pWorld->m_ulNow, 8 );
}

void FillSession( ModuleSession_t &session )
{
	session.m_OsVersion.dwPlatformId = s_pWorld->m_unPlatform;
	session.m_OsVersion.dwMajorVersion = s_pWorld->m_unMajor;
	session.m_OsVersion.dwMinorVersion = s_pWorld->m_unMinor;
	session.m_unPackedVersion =
	    s_pWorld->m_unPlatform | ( ( s_pWorld->m_unMajor | ( s_pWorld->m_unMinor << 8 ) ) << 8 );
	session.m_hNtdll = k_hFakeNtdll;
}

bool __fastcall FakeOriginalBootstrap( const void * )
{
	Trace( "BootstrapMain" );
	if ( s_pWorld->m_bBootFails )
		return false;
	*s_pOriginalImports = s_FakeImports;
	FillSession( *s_pOriginalSession );
	return true;
}

void __cdecl FakeOriginalTeardown()
{
	Trace( "BootstrapTeardown" );
	std::memset( s_pOriginalImports, 0, sizeof( *s_pOriginalImports ) );
}

void Patch( void *pWhere, const void *pfnTarget )
{
	DWORD unOld;
	VirtualProtect( pWhere, 5, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, &unOld );
	auto *pubCode = static_cast<u8 *>( pWhere );
	pubCode[0] = 0xE9;
	*reinterpret_cast<i32 *>( pubCode + 1 ) = static_cast<i32>( static_cast<const u8 *>( pfnTarget ) - pubCode - 5 );
	FlushInstructionCache( GetCurrentProcess(), pWhere, 5 );
	VirtualProtect( pWhere, 5, unOld, &unOld );
}

struct Outcome_t
{
	int m_nResult = 0;
	u32 m_cubOutput = 0;
	DWORD m_unFault = 0;
	std::array<u8, k_cubReport + k_cubSentinel> m_rgubReport{};
	std::string m_szTrace;
};

int RunOriginalGuarded( const Input_t *pInput, u8 *pubReport, u32 *pcubOutput, DWORD *punFault )
{
	__try
	{
		return reinterpret_cast<PfnWorker_t>( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaWorker )( pInput, pubReport, pcubOutput );
	}
	__except ( *punFault = GetExceptionCode(), EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER )
	{
		return -1;
	}
}

int RunRebuildGuarded( const Input_t *pInput, u8 *pubReport, u32 *pcubOutput, DWORD *punFault )
{
	__try
	{
		return RunSystemHandles( *pInput, *reinterpret_cast<Report_t *>( pubReport ), pcubOutput );
	}
	__except ( *punFault = GetExceptionCode(), EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER )
	{
		return -1;
	}
}

// The scan context is not cleared and the first pass reads its clock before it is set, so that field is whatever the
// stack held. Painting gives both sides the same garbage, and running with two values covers both branches it can take.
__declspec( noinline ) void PaintStack( u32 unValue )
{
	volatile u32 rgunStack[0x10000 / sizeof( u32 )];
	for ( u32 iValue = 0; iValue < sizeof( rgunStack ) / sizeof( rgunStack[0] ); ++iValue )
		rgunStack[iValue] = unValue;
}

void RunSide( bool bOriginal, const World_t &world, const Input_t &input, u32 cubCapacity, u32 unPaint,
              Outcome_t &outcome )
{
	s_pWorld = &world;
	s_szTrace.clear();
	s_unLastError = 77;
	s_iSnapshot = 0;
	s_cHandlesOpened = 0;
	s_HandlePids.clear();
	s_cAllocs = 0;
	s_cHandleQueries = 0;

	outcome.m_rgubReport.fill( 0xCD );
	outcome.m_cubOutput = cubCapacity;
	outcome.m_unFault = 0;
	PaintStack( unPaint );
	outcome.m_nResult =
	    bOriginal ? RunOriginalGuarded( &input, outcome.m_rgubReport.data(), &outcome.m_cubOutput, &outcome.m_unFault )
	              : RunRebuildGuarded( &input, outcome.m_rgubReport.data(), &outcome.m_cubOutput, &outcome.m_unFault );
	outcome.m_szTrace = s_szTrace;
}

u32 s_cCases;
u32 s_cFailures;
u32 s_cFaulted;

void PrintTraceDifference( const std::string &szA, const std::string &szB )
{
	size_t ib = 0;
	while ( ib < szA.size() && ib < szB.size() && szA[ib] == szB[ib] )
		++ib;
	const size_t ibLine = szA.rfind( '\n', ib ) == std::string::npos ? 0 : szA.rfind( '\n', ib ) + 1;
	std::printf( "  trace differs at byte %u:\n  original: %.200s\n  rebuild:  %.200s\n", static_cast<u32>( ib ),
	             szA.substr( ibLine, 120 ).c_str(), szB.size() > ibLine ? szB.substr( ibLine, 120 ).c_str() : "" );
}

bool CompareCase( const char *pszName, const World_t &world, const Input_t &input, u32 cubCapacity, u32 unPaint )
{
	static Outcome_t expected;
	static Outcome_t actual;
	RunSide( true, world, input, cubCapacity, unPaint, expected );
	RunSide( false, world, input, cubCapacity, unPaint, actual );

	++s_cCases;
	s_cFaulted += expected.m_unFault != 0;
	const bool bEqual = expected.m_nResult == actual.m_nResult && expected.m_cubOutput == actual.m_cubOutput &&
	                    expected.m_unFault == actual.m_unFault && expected.m_rgubReport == actual.m_rgubReport &&
	                    expected.m_szTrace == actual.m_szTrace;
	if ( bEqual )
		return true;

	++s_cFailures;
	if ( s_cFailures <= 12 )
	{
		std::printf( "DIFF %s paint=%x min=%u max=%u age=%u flags=%x cap=%u ret=%d/%d size=%u/%u fault=%lx/%lx\n",
		             pszName, unPaint, input.m_unMinPid, input.m_unMaxPid, input.m_unMaxAgeSeconds,
		             static_cast<u32>( input.m_eFlags ), cubCapacity, expected.m_nResult, actual.m_nResult,
		             expected.m_cubOutput, actual.m_cubOutput, expected.m_unFault, actual.m_unFault );
		u32 cShown = 0;
		for ( u32 ib = 0; ib < expected.m_rgubReport.size() && cShown < 12; ++ib )
		{
			if ( expected.m_rgubReport[ib] != actual.m_rgubReport[ib] )
			{
				std::printf( "  +0x%03x %02x/%02x\n", ib, expected.m_rgubReport[ib], actual.m_rgubReport[ib] );
				++cShown;
			}
		}
		if ( expected.m_szTrace != actual.m_szTrace )
			PrintTraceDifference( expected.m_szTrace, actual.m_szTrace );
	}
	return false;
}

Input_t MakeInput( u32 unMinPid, u32 unMaxPid, u32 unMaxAge, u32 unFlags )
{
	Input_t input{};
	for ( u32 ib = 0; ib < sizeof( input.m_rgubBootstrap ); ++ib )
		input.m_rgubBootstrap[ib] = static_cast<u8>( 0x31 * ib + 7 );
	for ( u32 ib = 0; ib < sizeof( input.m_rgubReserved ); ++ib )
		input.m_rgubReserved[ib] = static_cast<u8>( 0x17 * ib + 3 );
	input.m_unMinPid = unMinPid;
	input.m_unMaxPid = unMaxPid;
	input.m_unMaxAgeSeconds = unMaxAge;
	// Only the low 3 bits are flags, the rest is filler in captured packets.
	input.m_eFlags = static_cast<EInputFlags>( 0x9104E640u | unFlags );
	return input;
}

void ComparePainted( const char *pszName, const World_t &world, const Input_t &input, u32 cubCapacity )
{
	CompareCase( pszName, world, input, cubCapacity, 0 );
	CompareCase( pszName, world, input, cubCapacity, 0xCCCCCCCC );
}

void CompareAllInputs( const char *pszName, const World_t &world )
{
	struct Range_t
	{
		u32 m_unMin;
		u32 m_unMax;
	};
	static constexpr Range_t k_rgRanges[] = { { 0, 0 }, { 8, 0 }, { 0, 400 }, { 200, 600 }, { 0xFFFFFFF0, 0 } };
	static constexpr u32 k_rgunAges[] = { 0, 1200, 0xFFFFFFFF };
	for ( u32 unFlags = 0; unFlags < 8; ++unFlags )
	{
		for ( const Range_t &range : k_rgRanges )
		{
			for ( const u32 unAge : k_rgunAges )
				ComparePainted( pszName, world, MakeInput( range.m_unMin, range.m_unMax, unAge, unFlags ),
				                k_cubReport );
		}
	}
}

void AddProcess( World_t &world, u32 unPid, u32 unParent, const std::wstring &wszImage, u64 ulCreate = k_ulBaseTime,
                 u64 ulExit = 0 )
{
	world.m_rgunEnum.push_back( unPid );
	world.m_rgSnapshot.push_back( { unPid, unParent } );
	FakeProcess_t process;
	process.m_wszImage = wszImage;
	process.m_ulCreate = ulCreate;
	process.m_ulExit = ulExit;
	world.m_Processes[unPid] = process;
}

World_t BaseWorld()
{
	World_t world;
	world.m_rgDrives = { { L'A', L"" },
	                     { L'B', L"?" },
	                     { L'C', L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3" },
	                     { L'D', L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume10" } };
	AddProcess( world, 0, 0, L"" );
	world.m_Processes.erase( 0 );
	AddProcess( world, 4, 0, L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3\\Windows\\System32\\ntoskrnl.exe" );
	AddProcess( world, 100, 4, L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3\\Windows\\System32\\smss.exe" );
	AddProcess( world, 204, 100, L"\\device\\harddiskvolume3\\WINDOWS\\system32\\CSRSS.exe" );
	AddProcess( world, 308, 100, L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume10\\Games\\game.exe" );
	AddProcess( world, 412, 308, L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume7\\Tools\\tool.exe" );
	AddProcess( world, 516, 308, L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe" );
	AddProcess( world, 620, 308, L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe" );
	for ( const u32 unPid : { 4u, 100u, 204u, 308u, 412u, 516u, 620u } )
	{
		for ( const u8 unType : { 0, 7, 31, 32, 37, 54, 55, 63, 64, 200, 255 } )
			world.m_rgHandles.push_back( { unPid, static_cast<u8>( unType ) } );
	}
	return world;
}

		      world.m_Processes[620].m_wszImage = L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3\\" + std::wstring( 487, L'r' );
	      } },
	    { "drive_lookup_edges", []( World_t &world ) { world.m_bDrivesFail = true; } },
	    { "no_drives", []( World_t &world ) { world.m_rgDrives.clear(); } },
	    { "empty_device_matches_everything", []( World_t &world ) { world.m_rgDrives = { { L'Q', L"" } }; } },
	    { "device_259_chars", []( World_t &world )
	      { world.m_rgDrives = { { L'L', std::wstring( 259, L'z' ) }, { L'C', L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3" } }; } },
	    { "handle_query_error", []( World_t &world ) { world.m_unHandleStatus = 0xC0000022; } },
	    { "handle_query_grows", []( World_t &world ) { world.m_cMismatches = 3; } },
	    { "handle_query_too_big_for_first_buffer",
	      []( World_t &world ) { world.m_rgHandles.resize( 70000, FakeHandle_t{ 308, 5 } ); } },
	    { "no_ntquery_export", []( World_t &world ) { world.m_bNoNtQuery = true; } },
	    { "first_alloc_fails", []( World_t &world ) { world.m_iFailAlloc = 0; } },
	    { "alloc_fails_after_growth",
	      []( World_t &world )
	      {
		      world.m_cMismatches = 2;
		      world.m_iFailAlloc = 2;
	      } },
	    { "string_limit_trips",
	      []( World_t &world )
	      {
		      for ( u32 iPid = 0; iPid < 60; ++iPid )
			      AddProcess( world, 1000 + iPid * 4, 4,
			                  L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3\\" + std::wstring( 120, wchar_t( L'a' + iPid % 26 ) ) +
			                      std::to_wstring( iPid ) + L"\\" + std::wstring( 100, wchar_t( L'b' + iPid % 25 ) ) +
			                      std::to_wstring( iPid ) + L".exe" );
	      } },
	    { "budget_runs_out",
	      []( World_t &world )
	      {
		      for ( u32 iPid = 0; iPid < 138; ++iPid )
			      AddProcess( world, 1000 + iPid * 4, 4,
			                  L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3\\Dir" + std::to_wstring( iPid % 40 ) + L"\\" +
			                      std::wstring( 20 + iPid % 30, L'n' ) + L".exe" );
	      } },
	    { "refs_decide_who_gets_strings",
	      []( World_t &world )
	      {
		      for ( u32 iPid = 0; iPid < 120; ++iPid )
		      {
			      const u32 iDir = iPid < 60 ? 1 : ( iPid < 90 ? 2 : iPid );
			      AddProcess( world, 1000 + iPid * 4, 4,
			                  L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3\\Dir" + std::to_wstring( iDir ) + L"\\" +
			                      ( iPid % 3 ? L"common.exe" : L"app" + std::to_wstring( iPid ) + L".exe" ) );
		      }
	      } },
	    { "string_pool_full_faults_in_both",
	      []( World_t &world )
	      {
		      for ( u32 iPid = 0; iPid < 90; ++iPid )
			      AddProcess( world, 1000 + iPid * 4, 4,
			                  L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3\\" + std::wstring( 220, wchar_t( L'a' + iPid % 26 ) ) +
			                      std::to_wstring( iPid ) + L"\\" + std::to_wstring( iPid ) + L".exe" );
	      } },
	};

	for ( const auto &scenario : rgScenarios )
	{
		if ( pszOnly && std::strcmp( pszOnly, scenario.first ) )
			continue;
		World_t world = BaseWorld();
		scenario.second( world );
		const u32 cFailuresBefore = s_cFailures;
		const u32 cCasesBefore = s_cCases;
		CompareAllInputs( scenario.first, world );
		std::printf( "%-4s %-40s %u cases\n", s_cFailures == cFailuresBefore ? "OK" : "FAIL", scenario.first,
		             s_cCases - cCasesBefore );
	}
	if ( pszOnly )
		return;

	// Name query fails and writes nothing: the stack garbage must not reach the report. Drive lookup and the string limit
	// would both look at that garbage, in both DLLs, so those stay off.
	{
		World_t world = BaseWorld();
		world.m_bDrivesFail = true;
		world.m_Processes[308].m_bNameOverride = true;
		world.m_Processes[308].m_unNameResult = 0;
		world.m_Processes[308].m_bNameWrites = false;
		const u32 cFailuresBefore = s_cFailures;
		ComparePainted( "name_query_writes_nothing", world, MakeInput( 0, 0, 1200, 0 ), k_cubReport );
		ComparePainted( "name_query_writes_nothing", world, MakeInput( 0, 0, 1200, 3 ), k_cubReport );
		std::printf( "%-4s %-40s 4 cases\n", s_cFailures == cFailuresBefore ? "OK" : "FAIL",
		             "name_query_writes_nothing" );
	}

	{
		World_t world = BaseWorld();
		world.m_bBootFails = true;
		const u32 cFailuresBefore = s_cFailures;
		for ( const u32 cubCapacity : { 0u, 1u, 0xFFFu, 0x1000u, 0x1001u, 0x2000u } )
			CompareCase( "bootstrap_fails", world, MakeInput( 0, 0, 1200, 0 ), cubCapacity, 0 );
		std::printf( "%-4s %-40s 6 cases\n", s_cFailures == cFailuresBefore ? "OK" : "FAIL", "bootstrap_fails" );
	}

	{
		World_t world = BaseWorld();
		const u32 cFailuresBefore = s_cFailures;
		for ( const u32 cubCapacity : { 0u, 1u, 0xFFFu, 0x1000u, 0x1001u, 0x2000u } )
			CompareCase( "capacity", world, MakeInput( 0, 0, 1200, 0 ), cubCapacity, 0 );
		std::printf( "%-4s %-40s 6 cases\n", s_cFailures == cFailuresBefore ? "OK" : "FAIL", "capacity" );
	}
}

World_t RandomWorld( std::mt19937 &random )
{
	const auto Pick = [&]( u32 cValues ) { return static_cast<u32>( random() % cValues ); };

	static const wchar_t *const k_rgpwszRoots[] = { L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3\\",
	                                                L"\\device\\HARDDISKVOLUME3\\",
	                                                L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume10\\",
	                                                L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume7\\",
	                                                L"",
	                                                L"\\" };
	static const wchar_t *const k_rgpwszDirs[] = { L"Windows\\System32\\",
	                                               L"Windows\\SysWOW64\\",
	                                               L"Program Files\\Steam\\",
	                                               L"Games\\",
	                                               L"",
	                                               L"Users\\\x0418\x0432\x0430\x043D\\AppData\\" };
	static const wchar_t *const k_rgpwszNames[] = {
	    L"svchost.exe", L"SVCHOST.EXE", L"csrss.exe", L"game.exe", L"steam.exe", L"\x0438\x0433\x0440\x0430.exe", L"",
	    L"a.exe" };

	World_t world;
	world.m_rgDrives = { { L'C', L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3" }, { L'D', L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume10" } };
	if ( !Pick( 20 ) )
		world.m_rgDrives.clear();
	if ( !Pick( 30 ) )
		world.m_bDrivesFail = true;

	if ( !Pick( 10 ) )
		world.m_unMajor = 5;
	if ( !Pick( 20 ) )
		world.m_unPlatform = VER_PLATFORM_WIN32_WINDOWS;
	world.m_unDefaultOpenError = Pick( 3 ) ? ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER : ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED;
	world.m_ulNow = k_ulBaseTime + Pick( 100000 ) * k_ulTicksPerSecond + Pick( 10000000 );

	const u32 cSnapshot = Pick( 4 ) ? Pick( 40 ) : Pick( 260 );
	std::vector<u32> rgunPids;
	for ( u32 iProcess = 0; iProcess < cSnapshot; ++iProcess )
	{
		const u32 unPid = Pick( 30 ) ? ( Pick( 600 ) + 1 ) * 4 : Pick( 2000 ) + 1;
		std::wstring wszImage = k_rgpwszRoots[Pick( 6 )];
		wszImage += k_rgpwszDirs[Pick( 6 )];
		if ( !Pick( 6 ) )
			wszImage += std::wstring( Pick( 200 ), wchar_t( L'd' + Pick( 3 ) ) ) + L"\\";
		wszImage += k_rgpwszNames[Pick( 8 )];
		if ( !Pick( 6 ) )
			wszImage += std::wstring( Pick( 60 ), wchar_t( L'n' + Pick( 3 ) ) );
		u64 ulCreate = world.m_ulNow - Pick( 4000 ) * k_ulTicksPerSecond;
		u64 ulExit = Pick( 8 ) ? 0 : world.m_ulNow - Pick( 100 );
		AddProcess( world, unPid, ( Pick( 100 ) + 1 ) * 4, wszImage, ulCreate, ulExit );

		FakeProcess_t &process = world.m_Processes[unPid];
		switch ( Pick( 24 ) )
		{
		case 0:
			process.m_unOpenError = ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED;
			break;
		case 1:
			process.m_unOpenError = ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER;
			break;
		case 2:
			process.m_bLimitedDenied = true;
			break;
		case 3:
			process.m_bTimesFail = true;
			break;
		case 4:
			process.m_bNameOverride = true;
			process.m_unNameResult = Pick( 2 ) ? 0 : 0x200;
			break;
		case 5:
			process.m_ulCreate = 0;
			break;
		default:
			break;
		}
		rgunPids.push_back( unPid );
	}

	// An unaligned highest pid never reaches 0 in the walk, both DLLs would call OpenProcess a billion times.
	if ( cSnapshot )
		AddProcess( world, 2404, 4, L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3\\Top\\top.exe" );

	const u32 cBruteForceAlive = Pick( 12 );
	for ( u32 iProcess = 0; iProcess < cBruteForceAlive; ++iProcess )
	{
		FakeProcess_t process;
		process.m_wszImage = L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume3\\Hidden\\h" + std::to_wstring( Pick( 3 ) ) + L".exe";
		process.m_unOpenError = Pick( 4 ) ? 0 : ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED;
		world.m_Processes.emplace( ( Pick( 600 ) + 1 ) * 4, process );
	}

	const u32 cHandles = Pick( 500 );
	for ( u32 iHandle = 0; iHandle < cHandles; ++iHandle )
	{
		u32 unPid = rgunPids.empty() || !Pick( 8 ) ? ( Pick( 900 ) + 1 ) * 4
		                                           : rgunPids[Pick( static_cast<u32>( rgunPids.size() ) )];
		if ( !Pick( 64 ) )
			unPid |= ( Pick( 7 ) + 1 ) << 16;
		world.m_rgHandles.push_back( { unPid, static_cast<u8>( Pick( 3 ) ? Pick( 60 ) : Pick( 256 ) ) } );
	}

	if ( !Pick( 16 ) )
		world.m_cMismatches = Pick( 4 );
	if ( !Pick( 32 ) )
		world.m_unHandleStatus = 0xC0000022;
	if ( !Pick( 64 ) )
		world.m_bNoNtQuery = true;
	if ( !Pick( 64 ) )
		world.m_iFailAlloc = Pick( 2 );
	// A failed snapshot reports 60 entries, fewer than that in EnumProcesses would make both sides read their own stack.
	if ( !Pick( 32 ) && world.m_rgunEnum.size() >= 60 && !( world.m_rgunEnum[59] & 3 ) )
		world.m_bSnapshotFails = true;
	return world;
}

void RunFuzz( u32 cCases )
{
	const u32 cFailuresBefore = s_cFailures;
	const u32 cFaultedBefore = s_cFaulted;
	const auto Pick = []( std::mt19937 &random, u32 cValues ) { return static_cast<u32>( random() % cValues ); };
	for ( u32 iCase = 0; iCase < cCases; ++iCase )
	{
		std::mt19937 random( 0x1DA8FB5Cu + iCase );
		const World_t world = RandomWorld( random );
		const u32 unMin = Pick( random, 4 ) ? 0 : Pick( random, 1200 );
		const u32 unMax = Pick( random, 4 ) ? 0 : unMin + Pick( random, 1200 );
		char szName[32];
		std::snprintf( szName, sizeof( szName ), "fuzz#%u", iCase );
		ComparePainted( szName, world, MakeInput( unMin, unMax, Pick( random, 5000 ), Pick( random, 8 ) ),
		                k_cubReport );
	}
	std::printf( "%-4s %-40s %u cases, %u faulted in both\n", s_cFailures == cFailuresBefore ? "OK" : "FAIL", "fuzz",
	             cCases, s_cFaulted - cFaultedBefore );
}

World_t CaptureRealWorld()
{
	World_t world;
	world.m_unDefaultOpenError = ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER;

	GetSystemTimeAsFileTime( reinterpret_cast<FILETIME *>( &world.m_ulNow ) );
	OSVERSIONINFOEXA os{};
	os.dwOSVersionInfoSize = sizeof( os );
#pragma warning( suppress : 4996 )
	GetVersionExA( reinterpret_cast<OSVERSIONINFOA *>( &os ) );
	world.m_unPlatform = os.dwPlatformId;
	world.m_unMajor = os.dwMajorVersion;
	world.m_unMinor = os.dwMinorVersion;

	wchar_t wszDrives[260]{};
	GetLogicalDriveStringsW( 250, wszDrives );
	for ( const wchar_t *pwszDrive = wszDrives; *pwszDrive; pwszDrive += wcslen( pwszDrive ) + 1 )
	{
		const wchar_t wszName[3] = { pwszDrive[0], L':', 0 };
		wchar_t wszDevice[260]{};
		if ( QueryDosDeviceW( wszName, wszDevice, 260 ) )
			world.m_rgDrives.push_back( { pwszDrive[0], wszDevice } );
	}

	std::vector<u32> rgunEnum( 500 );
	DWORD cubEnum = 0;
	using PfnEnumProcesses_t = BOOL( WINAPI * )( DWORD *, DWORD, LPDWORD );
	const auto pfnEnum =
	    reinterpret_cast<PfnEnumProcesses_t>( GetProcAddress( LoadLibraryA( "psapi.dll" ), "EnumProcesses" ) );
	pfnEnum( reinterpret_cast<DWORD *>( rgunEnum.data() ), 2000, &cubEnum );
	rgunEnum.resize( cubEnum / 4 );
	world.m_rgunEnum = rgunEnum;

	u32 unHighestPid = 0;
	const HANDLE hSnapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot( TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0 );
	PROCESSENTRY32W entry{};
	entry.dwSize = sizeof( entry );
	if ( Process32FirstW( hSnapshot, &entry ) )
	{
		do
		{
			world.m_rgSnapshot.push_back( { entry.th32ProcessID, entry.th32ParentProcessID } );
			unHighestPid = max( unHighestPid, static_cast<u32>( entry.th32ProcessID ) );
		} while ( Process32NextW( hSnapshot, &entry ) );
	}
	CloseHandle( hSnapshot );

	using PfnNtQuery_t = NTSTATUS( WINAPI * )( u32, void *, ULONG, ULONG * );
	const auto pfnQuery =
	    reinterpret_cast<PfnNtQuery_t>( GetProcAddress( GetModuleHandleA( "ntdll.dll" ), "NtQuerySystemInformation" ) );
	std::vector<u8> rgubHandles;
	NTSTATUS nStatus;
	u32 cubHandles = 0x100000;
	do
	{
		cubHandles *= 2;
		rgubHandles.resize( cubHandles );
		nStatus = pfnQuery( 16, rgubHandles.data(), cubHandles, nullptr );
	} while ( static_cast<u32>( nStatus ) == 0xC0000004 );
	if ( nStatus >= 0 )
	{
		const u32 cHandles = *reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( rgubHandles.data() );
		for ( u32 iHandle = 0; iHandle < cHandles; ++iHandle )
		{
			const u8 *pubEntry = rgubHandles.data() + 4 + iHandle * 16;
			world.m_rgHandles.push_back( { *reinterpret_cast<const u32 *>( pubEntry ), pubEntry[4] } );
		}
	}
	else
		world.m_unHandleStatus = static_cast<u32>( nStatus );

	const auto Capture = [&]( u32 unPid )
	{
		if ( world.m_Processes.count( unPid ) )
			return;
		const HANDLE hProcess = OpenProcess( 0x1000, FALSE, unPid );
		if ( !hProcess )
		{
			FakeProcess_t process;
			process.m_unOpenError = GetLastError();
			world.m_Processes[unPid] = process;
			return;
		}
		using PfnImageName_t = DWORD( WINAPI * )( HANDLE, LPWSTR, DWORD );
		static const auto pfnImageName = reinterpret_cast<PfnImageName_t>(
		    GetProcAddress( LoadLibraryA( "psapi.dll" ), "GetProcessImageFileNameW" ) );
		FakeProcess_t process;
		wchar_t wszImage[512]{};
		const DWORD cchImage = pfnImageName( hProcess, wszImage, 512 );
		process.m_wszImage = wszImage;
		if ( !cchImage )
		{
			process.m_bNameOverride = true;
			process.m_unNameError = GetLastError();
			process.m_unNameResult = 0;
		}
		FILETIME create, exit, kernel, user;
		if ( GetProcessTimes( hProcess, &create, &exit, &kernel, &user ) )
		{
			std::memcpy( &process.m_ulCreate, &create, 8 );
			std::memcpy( &process.m_ulExit, &exit, 8 );
		}
		else
		{
			process.m_bTimesFail = true;
			process.m_unTimesError = GetLastError();
		}
		CloseHandle( hProcess );
		world.m_Processes[unPid] = process;
	};

	for ( const SnapshotRow_t &row : world.m_rgSnapshot )
		Capture( row.m_unPid );
	for ( const u32 unPid : world.m_rgunEnum )
		Capture( unPid );
	for ( const FakeHandle_t &handle : world.m_rgHandles )
		Capture( handle.m_unPidAndBackTrace );
	for ( u32 unPid = unHighestPid; unPid >= 4 && unPid <= unHighestPid; unPid -= 4 )
		Capture( unPid );
	return world;
}

void CompareFrozen( const char *pszName, const World_t &world )
{
	const u32 cFailuresBefore = s_cFailures;
	const u32 cCasesBefore = s_cCases;
	CompareAllInputs( pszName, world );
	ComparePainted( pszName, world, MakeInput( 0, 0, 0x4B0, 0 ), k_cubReport );
	std::printf( "%-4s %-40s %u cases, snapshot=%u handles=%u pids_seen=%u\n",
	             s_cFailures == cFailuresBefore ? "OK" : "FAIL", pszName, s_cCases - cCasesBefore,
	             static_cast<u32>( world.m_rgSnapshot.size() ), static_cast<u32>( world.m_rgHandles.size() ),
	             static_cast<u32>( world.m_Processes.size() ) );
}

// The worker visits at most 144 handle-only pids starting at the snapshot count. Past pid slot 500 it reads their masks from
// beyond its context, so the report gets whatever sits on the stack above the frame: return addresses, different per DLL and
// per run. That is the one thing no comparison can match, so each world below stays clear of it in its own way.
void RunFrozen()
{
	const World_t world = CaptureRealWorld();

	World_t trimmed = world;
	if ( trimmed.m_rgSnapshot.size() > 350 )
		trimmed.m_rgSnapshot.resize( 350 );
	CompareFrozen( "frozen_machine_up_to_350_processes", trimmed );

	World_t onlyListed = world;
	std::vector<u32> rgunListed;
	for ( size_t iRow = 0; iRow < world.m_rgSnapshot.size() && iRow < k_cMaxPids; ++iRow )
		rgunListed.push_back( world.m_rgSnapshot[iRow].m_unPid );
	std::sort( rgunListed.begin(), rgunListed.end() );
	onlyListed.m_rgHandles.erase(
	    std::remove_if(
	        onlyListed.m_rgHandles.begin(), onlyListed.m_rgHandles.end(), [&]( const FakeHandle_t &handle )
	        { return !std::binary_search( rgunListed.begin(), rgunListed.end(), handle.m_unPidAndBackTrace ); } ),
	    onlyListed.m_rgHandles.end() );
	CompareFrozen( "frozen_machine_no_handle_only_pids", onlyListed );
}

void FillFakeImports()
{
	s_FakeImports.GetProcAddress = FakeGetProcAddress;
	s_FakeImports.GetLastError = FakeGetLastError;
	s_FakeImports.EnumProcesses = FakeEnumProcesses;
	s_FakeImports.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot = FakeCreateSnapshot;
	s_FakeImports.Process32FirstW = FakeProcessFirst;
	s_FakeImports.Process32NextW = FakeProcessNext;
	s_FakeImports.CloseHandle = FakeCloseHandle;
	s_FakeImports.VirtualAlloc = FakeVirtualAlloc;
	s_FakeImports.VirtualFree = FakeVirtualFree;
	s_FakeImports.OpenProcess = FakeOpenProcess;
	s_FakeImports.GetProcessImageFileNameW = FakeImageName;
	s_FakeImports.GetProcessTimes = FakeProcessTimes;
	s_FakeImports.GetLogicalDriveStringsW = FakeLogicalDrives;
	s_FakeImports.QueryDosDeviceW = FakeQueryDosDevice;
	s_FakeImports.WideCharToMultiByte = FakeWideToMulti;
	s_FakeImports.GetSystemTimeAsFileTime = FakeSystemTime;
}

} // namespace

namespace vac::bootstrap
{

bool BootstrapMain( const void * ) noexcept
{
	Trace( "BootstrapMain" );
	if ( s_pWorld->m_bBootFails )
		return false;
	*g_pImports = s_FakeImports;
	FillSession( *g_pSession );
	return true;
}

void BootstrapTeardown() noexcept
{
	Trace( "BootstrapTeardown" );
	std::memset( g_pImports, 0, sizeof( *g_pImports ) );
}

} // namespace vac::bootstrap

int main( int argc, char **argv )
{
	setvbuf( stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0 );
	if ( argc < 2 )
		return 2;

	bool bFrozen = true;
	u32 cFuzz = 2000;
	const char *pszOnly = nullptr;
	for ( int iArg = 2; iArg < argc; ++iArg )
	{
		if ( !std::strcmp( argv[iArg], "--no-frozen" ) )
			bFrozen = false;
		else if ( !std::strcmp( argv[iArg], "--fuzz" ) && iArg + 1 < argc )
			cFuzz = static_cast<u32>( std::atoi( argv[++iArg] ) );
		else if ( !std::strcmp( argv[iArg], "--only" ) && iArg + 1 < argc )
			pszOnly = argv[++iArg];
		else
			return 2;
	}

	s_pubOriginal = reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( LoadLibraryA( argv[1] ) );
	if ( !s_pubOriginal )
		return 3;

	s_pOriginalImports = *reinterpret_cast<SystemImports_t **>( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaImportsPointer );
	s_pOriginalSession = *reinterpret_cast<ModuleSession_t **>( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaSessionPointer );
	if ( reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( s_pOriginalImports ) != s_pubOriginal + 0x7CF8 ||
	     reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( s_pOriginalSession ) != s_pubOriginal + 0x7788 )
	{
		std::printf( "not the expected build of the module\n" );
		return 4;
	}

	Patch( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaBootstrapMain, FakeOriginalBootstrap );
	Patch( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaBootstrapTeardown, FakeOriginalTeardown );
	FillFakeImports();

	RunScripted( pszOnly );
	RunFuzz( pszOnly ? 0 : cFuzz );
	if ( bFrozen && !pszOnly )
		RunFrozen();

	std::printf( "RESULT %u cases, %u failures, %u faulted in both\n", s_cCases, s_cFailures, s_cFaulted );
	return s_cFailures ? 1 : 0;
}
```

```cpp
enum class ESystemInformationClass : u32
{
	TimeOfDay = SystemTimeOfDayInformation,
	Device = 7,
	KernelDebugger = 35,
	RangeStart = 50,
	BootEnvironment = 90,
	CodeIntegrity = SystemCodeIntegrityInformation,
};

enum class EStubMark : u32
{
	MovEdxSharedUserData = 0xFE0300BA,
	CallNext = 1000,
	MovR10Rcx = 0xB8D18B4C,
};

struct SystemTimeOfDay_t

	u64 m_ulBootTime;
	u64 m_ulCurrentTime;

using PfnGetNativeSystemInfo_t = void( WINAPI * )( LPSYSTEM_INFO );
```
