```cpp
// @orig: inlined
u64 ReadSystemTime() noexcept
{
	const volatile nt::KUserSharedData_t &sharedData = nt::GetKUserSharedData();
	u32 unLow;
	i32 nHigh;
	i32 nHigh2;
	do
	{
		nHigh = sharedData.m_SystemTime.m_nHigh1Time;
		unLow = sharedData.m_SystemTime.m_unLowPart;
		nHigh2 = sharedData.m_SystemTime.m_nHigh2Time;
	} while ( nHigh != nHigh2 );
	return ( static_cast<u64>( static_cast<u32>( nHigh ) ) << 32 ) | unLow;
}

// @orig: inlined
u32 ReadTickCountMs() noexcept
{
	const volatile nt::KUserSharedData_t &sharedData = nt::GetKUserSharedData();
	u32 unLow;
	i32 nHigh;
	i32 nHigh2;
	do
	{
		nHigh = sharedData.m_TickCount.m_nHigh1Time;
		unLow = sharedData.m_TickCount.m_unLowPart;
		nHigh2 = sharedData.m_TickCount.m_nHigh2Time;
	} while ( nHigh != nHigh2 );

	if ( static_cast<u32>( nHigh2 ) | unLow )
	{
		const u32 unMultiplier = sharedData.m_unTickCountMultiplier;
		return static_cast<u32>( ( static_cast<u64>( unLow ) * unMultiplier ) >> 24 ) +
		       sharedData.m_unTickCountMultiplier * ( static_cast<u32>( nHigh ) << 8 );
	}
	const u32 unTicks = sharedData.m_unTickCountLowDeprecated;
	return static_cast<u32>( ( static_cast<u64>( unTicks ) * sharedData.m_unTickCountMultiplier ) >> 24 );
}

// @orig: inlined
// @note / sapdragon: the sdk keeps the loaded library list private, so this walks the same imports.inl order. a
// library that failed to load is skipped by both
void CopyBootstrapState( Report_t &report, const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	const char *rgpszSeen[ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rghLoadedLibraries )];
	u32 cSeen = 0;
	for ( const bootstrap::detail::ImportName_t &importName : bootstrap::detail::k_rgImportNames )
	{
		u32 iSeen = 0;
		while ( iSeen < cSeen && !util::EqualA( rgpszSeen[iSeen], importName.m_szLibrary ) )
			++iSeen;
		if ( iSeen < cSeen )
			continue;

		const HMODULE hLibrary = pImports->GetModuleHandleA( importName.m_szLibrary );
		if ( !hLibrary )
			continue;

		rgpszSeen[cSeen] = importName.m_szLibrary;
		report.m_rghLoadedLibraries[cSeen] = static_cast<u32>( reinterpret_cast<uptr>( hLibrary ) );
		++cSeen;
	}
	report.m_cLoadedLibraries = cSeen;
	report.m_cResolvedImports = ARRAYSIZE( bootstrap::detail::k_rgImportNames );
	memcpy( report.m_rgubImports, pImports, sizeof( report.m_rgubImports ) );
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC B8
int RunSystemInfo( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	auto wszNtdll = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( L"NtDll.dll" );
	auto szNtdll = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "NtDll.dll" );
	auto szKernel32 = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "Kernel32.dll" );
	auto szNtQuerySystemInformation = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "NtQuerySystemInformation" );
	auto szGetVersion = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "GetVersion" );
	auto szGetNativeSystemInfo = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "GetNativeSystemInfo" );
	auto szWow64EnableFsRedirection = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "Wow64EnableWow64FsRedirection" );
	auto szNtReadVirtualMemory = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "NtReadVirtualMemory" );
	auto szNtQueryVirtualMemory = util::MakeXorString<k_unStringKey>( "NtQueryVirtualMemory" );

	report.m_unMagic = k_unReportMagic;

	if ( !bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )

	}
	else

		report.m_ulSystemTimeStart = ReadSystemTime();
		report.m_unTickMsStart = ReadTickCountMs();

		PfnGetVersion_t pfnGetVersion = nullptr;

			if ( pfnNtQuerySystemInformation )

			if ( pfnGetVersion )

				    pImports->GetProcAddress( hKernel32, szGetNativeSystemInfo.Get() ) );
		}

		if ( !pfnGetNativeSystemInfo )
		{
			eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( pImports->GetLastError() );
		}
		else

			const auto pfnWow64EnableFsRedirection = reinterpret_cast<PfnWow64EnableFsRedirection_t>(
			    pImports->GetProcAddress( hKernel32, szWow64EnableFsRedirection.Get() ) );

			report.m_unVersion = pfnGetVersion();

			SYSTEM_INFO systemInfo;
			pfnGetNativeSystemInfo( &systemInfo );
			report.m_unProcessorArchitecture = systemInfo.wProcessorArchitecture;
			report.m_unProcessorType = systemInfo.dwProcessorType;

			// whatever was on valve's stack, keep it

			                                                         sizeof( timeOfDay ), nullptr );
			report.m_ulCurrentTime = timeOfDay.m_ulCurrentTime;
			report.m_ulBootTime = timeOfDay.m_ulBootTime;

			report.m_nCodeIntegrityStatus = pfnNtQuerySystemInformation(
			    ESystemInformationClass::CodeIntegrity, &codeIntegrity, sizeof( codeIntegrity ), nullptr );
			report.m_unCodeIntegrityOptions = codeIntegrity.m_unOptions;

			SystemDevice_t device;
			report.m_nDeviceStatus =
			    pfnNtQuerySystemInformation( ESystemInformationClass::Device, &device, sizeof( device ), nullptr );
			report.m_cDisks = device.m_cDisks;

			report.m_nKernelDebuggerStatus =
			    pfnNtQuerySystemInformation( ESystemInformationClass::KernelDebugger, &unKernelDebugger, 2, nullptr );
			report.m_unKernelDebugger = static_cast<u16>( unKernelDebugger );

			u8 rgubBootEnvironment[32];
			memset( rgubBootEnvironment, 0, sizeof( rgubBootEnvironment ) );
			report.m_nBootEnvironmentStatus = pfnNtQuerySystemInformation(
			    ESystemInformationClass::BootEnvironment, rgubBootEnvironment, sizeof( rgubBootEnvironment ), nullptr );

			                                                          sizeof( nRangeStart ), nullptr );

			report.m_unPid = pImports->GetCurrentProcessId();
			report.m_unTid = pImports->GetCurrentThreadId();

			if ( cchImageName )

				report.m_eImageNameStatus = EScanStatus::Ok;

				memcpy( report.m_rgchImageNameTail, &szImageName[ibTail >= 0 ? ibTail : 0],
				        sizeof( report.m_rgchImageNameTail ) );
			}
			else

			const u32 cchSystemDirectory = pImports->GetSystemDirectoryW( wszDirectory, k_cDirectoryChars );

				report.m_eNtdllStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( unError );
				report.m_SystemDirectory.m_unError = unError;
			}
			else

				                                   sizeof( report.m_szSystemDirectory ) );

				u32 unSerial = 0;
				u64 ulFileId = 0;
				if ( QueryFileIdentity( wszDirectory, &unSerial, &ulFileId, pImports ) )
				{
					report.m_SystemDirectory.m_ulFileId = ulFileId;
					report.m_SystemDirectory.m_unVolumeSerial = unSerial;
				}
				else
				{
					report.m_SystemDirectory.m_unError = pImports->GetLastError();
				}

				wszDirectory[cchSystemDirectory] = L'\\';
				memcpy( &wszDirectory[cchSystemDirectory + 1], wszNtdll.Get(), sizeof( wszNtdll ) );

				if ( pfnWow64EnableFsRedirection )
					bRedirectionWasOn = pfnWow64EnableFsRedirection( FALSE );

				                                    OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
				const u32 unOpenError = pImports->GetLastError();
				if ( bRedirectionWasOn )
					pfnWow64EnableFsRedirection( TRUE );

				if ( hNtdllFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
				{
					report.m_eNtdllStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( unOpenError );
				}
				else
				{
					EScanStatus eReaderStatus = ntdll.Open( hNtdllFile );
					hNtdllFile = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
					if ( eReaderStatus == EScanStatus::Ok )
					{
						report.m_unNtdllTimeDateStamp = ntdll.m_RawFileHeader.TimeDateStamp;
						eReaderStatus = ntdll.ParseExports();
					}

					if ( eReaderStatus != EScanStatus::Ok )
					{
						report.m_eNtdllStatus = eReaderStatus;
					}
					else

						szNtReadVirtualMemory.Decode();
						szNtQueryVirtualMemory.Decode();
						szNtOpenProcess.Decode();

						for ( u32 iName = 0; iName < static_cast<u32>( ntdll.m_cExportNames ); ++iName )
						{
							const char *pszName = ntdll.m_ppszExportNames[iName];
							u32 *punSsn;
							if ( !CompareBounded( pszName, szNtReadVirtualMemory.Get() ) )
								punSsn = &report.m_unSsnNtReadVirtualMemory;
							else if ( !CompareBounded( pszName, szNtQueryVirtualMemory.Get() ) )
								punSsn = &report.m_unSsnNtQueryVirtualMemory;
							else if ( !CompareBounded( pszName, szNtOpenProcess.Get() ) )
								punSsn = &report.m_unSsnNtOpenProcess;
							else if ( !CompareBounded( pszName, szNtQuerySystemInformation.Get() ) )
								punSsn = &report.m_unSsnNtQuerySystemInformation;
							else
								continue;

							const u32 unFunctionRva = ntdll.m_punExportFunctions[iName];
							const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection = pe::FindSectionByRva(
							    ntdll.m_pSections, ntdll.m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections, unFunctionRva );
							if ( !pSection )

								continue;
							}

							{
								report.m_eNtdllStatus = EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
								continue;
							}

							if ( ntdll.m_bPe64 )
							{
								if ( static_cast<EStubMark>( rgunStub[0] ) == EStubMark::MovR10Rcx )
									*punSsn = rgunStub[1];
								else
									report.m_eNtdllStatus = EScanStatus::UnknownStub;
							}
							else if ( static_cast<EStubMark>( rgunStub[1] ) == EStubMark::MovEdxSharedUserData ||
							          static_cast<EStubMark>( rgunStub[1] ) == EStubMark::CallNext )
							{
								*punSsn = rgunStub[0];
							}
							else
							{
								report.m_eNtdllStatus = EScanStatus::UnknownStub;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

			if ( !pImports->GetWindowsDirectoryW( wszDirectory, k_cDirectoryChars ) )
			{
				const u32 unError = pImports->GetLastError();
				report.m_eNtdllStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( unError );
				report.m_WindowsDirectory.m_unError = unError;
			}
			else
			{
				util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( pImports, wszDirectory, report.m_szWindowsDirectory,
				                                   sizeof( report.m_szWindowsDirectory ) );

				u32 unSerial = 0;
				u64 ulFileId = 0;
				if ( QueryFileIdentity( wszDirectory, &unSerial, &ulFileId, pImports ) )
				{
					report.m_WindowsDirectory.m_ulFileId = ulFileId;
					report.m_WindowsDirectory.m_unVolumeSerial = unSerial;
				}
				else
				{
					report.m_WindowsDirectory.m_unError = pImports->GetLastError();
				}
			}

			CopyBootstrapState( report, pImports );

			const uptr ulCallerBase = reinterpret_cast<uptr>( _ReturnAddress() ) & 0xFFFF0000u;
			report.m_unCallerBase = static_cast<u32>( ulCallerBase );
			report.m_unCallerDword0 = *reinterpret_cast<const u32 *>( ulCallerBase );
			report.m_unCallerDword114 = *reinterpret_cast<const u32 *>( ulCallerBase + 0x114 );
			report.m_unCallerDword400 = *reinterpret_cast<const u32 *>( ulCallerBase + 0x400 );

			report.m_cVolumes = CollectVolumes( report.m_rgVolumes, pImports );

			report.m_unTargetPid = input.m_unTargetPid;
			if ( report.m_unTargetPid )
			{
				const HANDLE hTarget = pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, report.m_unTargetPid );
				if ( !hTarget || hTarget == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
				{
					report.m_hTargetProcess = 0;
					report.m_unTargetOpenError = pImports->GetLastError();
				}
				else
				{
					report.m_hTargetProcess = static_cast<u32>( reinterpret_cast<uptr>( hTarget ) );
					report.m_unTargetOpenError = 0;
					report.m_unTargetProcessId = pImports->GetProcessId( hTarget );
					pImports->CloseHandle( hTarget );
				}

				CProcessReader target;
				memset( &target, 0, sizeof( target ) );
				target.m_hProcess = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
				if ( target.ReadProcess( report.m_unTargetPid, EReadFlags::Parameters ) == EScanStatus::Ok )
					util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( pImports, target.m_wszCommandLine, report.m_szTargetCommandLine,
					                                   sizeof( report.m_szTargetCommandLine ) );
				target.Release();
			}

			report.m_ulSystemTimeEnd = ReadSystemTime();
			report.m_unTickMsEnd = ReadTickCountMs();
			eStatus = EScanStatus::Ok;

			if ( hNtdllFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
				pImports->CloseHandle( hNtdllFile );
		}
	}

	ntdll.Release();
	bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();

	report.m_eStatus = eStatus;
	u32 *punReport = reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( &report );
	const u32 unKey = input.m_unReportXorKey;
	for ( u32 iWord = 0; iWord < sizeof( report ) / sizeof( u32 ); ++iWord )
		punReport[iWord] ^= unKey;

	ntdll.Release();
	ntdll.Close();
	return 0;
}
```

```hpp
// @binary: a07ed54b
#pragma once

#include "bootstrap/imports.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

// @note / sapdragon: these use the linked kernel32 on purpose, the workers free memory after the import table
// is gone

namespace vac::workers::system_info
{

// @orig: a07ed54b:0x100064C6 (no unique signature)
inline void *HeapAllocate( SIZE_T cubSize ) noexcept
{
	return HeapAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), 0, cubSize );
}

// @orig: a07ed54b:0x100064D7 (no unique signature)
inline void HeapRelease( void *pMemory ) noexcept
{
	HeapFree( GetProcessHeap(), 0, pMemory );
}

// @orig: 52 85 C9 74
inline void *HeapResize( void *pMemory, SIZE_T cubSize ) noexcept
{
	if ( pMemory )
		return HeapReAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), 0, pMemory, cubSize );
	return HeapAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), 0, cubSize );
}

// @orig: 56 57 8B FA 33 F6
inline i32 CompareBounded( const char *pszA, const char *pszB ) noexcept
{
	u32 iChar = 0;
	for ( ;; )
	{
		const u8 unChar = static_cast<u8>( pszA[iChar] );
		if ( !unChar || unChar != static_cast<u8>( pszB[iChar] ) )
			return unChar - static_cast<u8>( pszB[iChar] );
		if ( ++iChar >= 0xFFFF )
			return 0;
	}
}

// @orig: 53 55 56 57 8B EA
inline i32 CompareBoundedNoCase( const char *pszA, const char *pszB ) noexcept
{
	u32 cCompared = 0;
	for ( ;; )
	{
		const char chA = *pszA++;
		const char chB = *pszB++;
		if ( chA == chB )
		{
			if ( !chA )
				return 0;
		}
		else
		{
			const char chLowerB = static_cast<u8>( chB - 'A' ) > 0x19 ? chB : static_cast<char>( chB | 0x20 );
			const char chLowerA = static_cast<u8>( chA - 'A' ) > 0x19 ? chA : static_cast<char>( chA | 0x20 );
			if ( chLowerA != chLowerB )
				return 1;
		}
		if ( ++cCompared >= 0xFFFF )
			return 0;
	}
}

// @orig: 53 56 57 8B 7C 24 ? 8B F2
inline wchar_t *CopyWideClearRest( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc, u32 cChars ) noexcept
{
	// @note / sapdragon: copies cChars no matter how long the source is, then clears past its end
	memcpy( pwszDst, pwszSrc, 2 * cChars );
	const u32 cSource = static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( pwszSrc ) );
	if ( cChars > cSource )
		memset( pwszDst + cSource, 0, 2 * ( cChars - cSource ) );
	return pwszDst;
}
```

```cpp
// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 86
void CPeFileReader::Close() noexcept
{
	if ( IsOpen() )
	{
		g_pImports->CloseHandle( m_hFile );
		m_hFile = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
	}
	m_cubWindow = 0;
	m_ulWindowBase = 0;
	m_ibCursor = 0;
	m_ulRangeStart = 0;
	m_ulRangeEnd = 0;
	m_hProcess = nullptr;
}

		m_ulRangeEnd = ulRangeEnd;

// @orig: 51 51 53 55 8B 6C 24
const u8 *CPeFileReader::Read( u32 cubRead ) noexcept
{
	if ( cubRead > k_cubReaderPage )
		return nullptr;

	u32 ibCursor = m_ibCursor;
	const u32 cubWindow = m_cubWindow;
	if ( ibCursor + cubRead >= cubWindow )
	{
		u32 ibFill = 0;
		u32 cubFill;
		bool bFill = true;
		if ( ibCursor + cubRead == cubWindow )
		{
			if ( cubWindow == sizeof( m_rgubWindow ) )
			{
				memcpy( m_rgubWindow, m_rgubWindow + k_cubReaderPage, k_cubReaderPage );
				m_ulWindowBase += k_cubReaderPage;
				ibFill = k_cubReaderPage;
				m_ibCursor -= k_cubReaderPage;
				ibCursor = m_ibCursor;
			}
			cubFill = ibFill;
			bFill = ibFill != 0;
		}
		else if ( cubWindow )
		{
			if ( cubWindow < sizeof( m_rgubWindow ) )
				return nullptr;
			memcpy( m_rgubWindow, m_rgubWindow + k_cubReaderPage, k_cubReaderPage );
			m_ulWindowBase += k_cubReaderPage;
			ibFill = k_cubReaderPage;
			cubFill = k_cubReaderPage;
			m_ibCursor -= k_cubReaderPage;
		}
		else
		{
			cubFill = sizeof( m_rgubWindow );
		}

		if ( bFill )
		{
			u32 cubFilled;
			u64 ulRead = 0;
			if ( m_hFile != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
			{
				g_pImports->ReadFile( m_hFile, m_rgubWindow + ibFill, cubFill, reinterpret_cast<DWORD *>( &ulRead ),
				                      nullptr );
				cubFilled = static_cast<u32>( ulRead );
			}
			else if ( !m_hProcess || m_hProcess == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
			{
				const u32 ulFill = static_cast<u32>( m_ulWindowBase ) + ibFill;
				if ( m_ulRangeEnd || m_ulRangeStart )
				{
					if ( ulFill >= m_ulRangeStart )
					{
						if ( static_cast<u64>( ulFill + cubFill ) > m_ulRangeEnd )
							cubFill = static_cast<u32>( m_ulRangeEnd ) - ulFill;
					}
					else
					{
						cubFill = 0;
					}
				}
				memcpy( m_rgubWindow + ibFill,
				        reinterpret_cast<const void *>(
				            static_cast<uptr>( static_cast<u32>( m_ulWindowBase + m_ulMemoryBase ) + ibFill ) ),
				        cubFill );
				cubFilled = cubFill;
			}
			else
			{
				const u64 ulAddress = m_ulWindowBase + m_ulMemoryBase + ibFill;
				ReadVirtualMemoryAuto( m_hProcess, ulAddress, m_rgubWindow + ibFill, cubFill, &ulRead );
				cubFilled = static_cast<u32>( ulRead );
				if ( !ulRead && cubFill > k_cubReaderPage )
				{
					ReadVirtualMemoryAuto( m_hProcess, ulAddress, m_rgubWindow + ibFill, k_cubReaderPage, &ulRead );
					cubFilled = static_cast<u32>( ulRead );
					if ( !ulRead )
						return nullptr;
				}
			}
			ibCursor = m_ibCursor;
			m_cubWindow = cubFilled + ibFill;
		}

		if ( ibCursor + cubRead > m_cubWindow )
			return nullptr;
	}

	m_ibCursor = ibCursor + cubRead;
	return m_rgubWindow + ibCursor;
}

// @orig: 51 51 55 56 33 F6
bool CPeFileReader::ReadBytes( void *pDst, u32 cubRead ) noexcept
{
	u32 ibDone = 0;
	if ( !cubRead )
		return true;

	for ( ;; )
	{
		u32 cubChunk = cubRead - ibDone;
		if ( cubChunk > k_cubReaderPage )
			cubChunk = k_cubReaderPage;
		const u8 *pubChunk = Read( cubChunk );
		if ( !pubChunk )
			return false;
		memcpy( static_cast<u8 *>( pDst ) + ibDone, pubChunk, cubChunk );
		ibDone += cubChunk;
		if ( ibDone == cubRead )
			return true;
	}
}

// @orig: 51 53 55 56 57 6A
i32 CPeFileReader::ReadString( char *pszDst, u32 cchDst ) noexcept
{
	u32 iChar = 0;
	for ( const u8 *pubChar = Read( 1 ); pubChar; pubChar = Read( 1 ) )
	{
		if ( !*pubChar )
			break;
		pszDst[iChar] = static_cast<char>( *pubChar );
		if ( ++iChar == cchDst )
		{
			pszDst[cchDst - 1] = 0;
			return -1;
		}
	}
	pszDst[iChar] = 0;
	return static_cast<i32>( iChar );
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 56
bool CPeFileReader::Seek( u32 ibOffset, bool bForce ) noexcept
{
	if ( !bForce )
	{
		if ( m_ulWindowBase + m_ibCursor == ibOffset )
			return true;
		if ( ibOffset >= m_ulWindowBase && ibOffset < m_ulWindowBase + m_cubWindow )
		{
			m_ibCursor = ibOffset - static_cast<u32>( m_ulWindowBase );
			return true;
		}
	}

	m_ibCursor = ibOffset % k_cubReaderPage;
	m_ulWindowBase = ibOffset - m_ibCursor;
	m_cubWindow = 0;
	if ( IsOpen() &&
	     ( static_cast<u32>( m_ulWindowBase ) !=
	           g_pImports->SetFilePointer( m_hFile, static_cast<LONG>( m_ulWindowBase ), nullptr, FILE_BEGIN ) ||
	       m_ulWindowBase >> 32 ) )
	{
		Close();
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57
EScanStatus CPeFileReader::ParseExports() noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory = m_bPe64 ? m_OptionalHeader64.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT]
	                                                : m_OptionalHeader32.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT];

	u32 unRvaDelta = 0;
	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection =
	    pe::FindSectionByRva( m_pSections, m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections, directory.VirtualAddress );
	if ( pSection && IsOpen() )
		unRvaDelta = pSection->VirtualAddress - pSection->PointerToRawData;

	if ( !Seek( directory.VirtualAddress - unRvaDelta, false ) )
		return EScanStatus::SeekFailed;

	const u32 unDirectoryStart = directory.VirtualAddress;
	const u32 unDirectoryEnd = directory.VirtualAddress + directory.Size;

	IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY exportDirectory;
	if ( !ReadBytes( &exportDirectory, sizeof( exportDirectory ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;

	if ( Seek( exportDirectory.Name - unRvaDelta, false ) )
		(void)ReadString( m_szExportName, sizeof( m_szExportName ) );

	const i32 cFunctions = static_cast<i32>( exportDirectory.NumberOfFunctions );
	if ( !cFunctions )
		return EScanStatus::Ok;

	m_cExportNames = static_cast<i32>( exportDirectory.NumberOfNames );
	if ( m_cExportNames > cFunctions )
		return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;

	u16 *punOrdinals = static_cast<u16 *>( HeapAllocate( 2 * m_cExportNames ) );
	if ( !punOrdinals )
		return EScanStatus::AllocFailed;

	EScanStatus eStatus = EScanStatus::Ok;
	u32 *punNameRvas = nullptr;
	char szName[260];
	u32 *punFunctions = static_cast<u32 *>( HeapAllocate( 4 * cFunctions ) );
	if ( !punFunctions )
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::AllocFailed;
	}
	else if ( !Seek( exportDirectory.AddressOfFunctions - unRvaDelta, false ) )
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::SeekFailed;
	}
	else if ( !ReadBytes( punFunctions, 4 * cFunctions ) )
	{
		eStatus = EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	}
	else
	{
		const u32 cubNameTable = 4 * m_cExportNames;
		m_ppszExportNames = static_cast<char **>( HeapAllocate( cubNameTable ) );
		memset( m_ppszExportNames, 0, cubNameTable );
		punNameRvas = static_cast<u32 *>( HeapAllocate( cubNameTable ) );
		if ( !punNameRvas )
		{
			eStatus = EScanStatus::AllocFailed;
		}
		else if ( !Seek( exportDirectory.AddressOfNames - unRvaDelta, false ) )
		{
			eStatus = EScanStatus::SeekFailed;
		}
		else if ( !ReadBytes( punNameRvas, cubNameTable ) )
		{
			eStatus = EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
		}
		else
		{
			m_punExportFunctions = static_cast<u32 *>( HeapAllocate( cubNameTable ) );
			memset( m_punExportFunctions, 0, cubNameTable );
			if ( !Seek( exportDirectory.AddressOfNameOrdinals - unRvaDelta, false ) )
				eStatus = EScanStatus::SeekFailed;
			else if ( !ReadBytes( punOrdinals, 2 * m_cExportNames ) )
				eStatus = EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
		}
	}

	if ( eStatus == EScanStatus::Ok )
	{
		for ( i32 iName = 0; iName < m_cExportNames; ++iName )
		{
			if ( !Seek( punNameRvas[iName] - unRvaDelta, false ) )
			{
				eStatus = EScanStatus::SeekFailed;
				break;
			}

			const i32 cchName = ReadString( szName, k_cchNameBuffer );
			if ( cchName < 0 )
			{
				eStatus = EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
				break;
			}

			m_ppszExportNames[iName] = static_cast<char *>( HeapAllocate( cchName + 1 ) );
			memcpy( m_ppszExportNames[iName], szName, cchName + 1 );

			m_punExportFunctions[iName] = punFunctions[punOrdinals[iName]];
			const u32 unFunctionRva = m_punExportFunctions[iName];
			if ( unFunctionRva >= unDirectoryStart && unFunctionRva < unDirectoryEnd )
				m_punExportFunctions[iName] = 0;
		}
	}

	if ( eStatus == EScanStatus::Ok )
	{
		i32 iFunction = 0;
		u16 unFunction = 0;
		while ( iFunction < cFunctions )
		{
			const u32 unFunctionRva = punFunctions[iFunction];
			if ( unFunctionRva >= unDirectoryStart && unFunctionRva < unDirectoryEnd )
			{
				if ( !Seek( unFunctionRva - unRvaDelta, false ) )
				{
					eStatus = EScanStatus::SeekFailed;
					break;
				}

				i32 iDot = ReadString( szName, k_cchNameBuffer );
				for ( ; iDot > 0; --iDot )
				{
					if ( szName[iDot] == '.' )
					{
						szName[iDot] = 0;
						break;
					}
				}
				if ( !iDot )
				{
					eStatus = EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
					break;
				}

				memcpy( &szName[iDot], ".dll", 5 );

				bool bKnown = false;
				for ( i32 iLibrary = 0; iLibrary < m_cForwarderLibraries; ++iLibrary )
				{
					if ( !CompareBoundedNoCase( m_rgpszForwarderLibraries[iLibrary], szName ) )
					{
						bKnown = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if ( !bKnown )
				{
					// @note / sapdragon: no bound on the table. valve bug, keep it
					const u32 cubCopy = iDot + 5;
					m_rgpszForwarderLibraries[m_cForwarderLibraries] = static_cast<char *>( HeapAllocate( cubCopy ) );
					memcpy( m_rgpszForwarderLibraries[m_cForwarderLibraries], szName, cubCopy );
					++m_cForwarderLibraries;
				}
			}

			// @note / sapdragon: the counter is 16 bits, so a table over 65535 entries never ends
			iFunction = ++unFunction;
		}
	}

	HeapRelease( punOrdinals );
	if ( punFunctions )
		HeapRelease( punFunctions );
	if ( punNameRvas )
		HeapRelease( punNameRvas );
	return eStatus;
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 57 BD
EScanStatus CPeFileReader::ParseHeaders() noexcept
{
	SetMemoryRangeEnd( k_cubReaderPage );

	if ( !ReadBytes( &m_DosHeader, sizeof( m_DosHeader ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	if ( m_DosHeader.e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;
	if ( !ReadBytes( m_rgubDosStub, sizeof( m_rgubDosStub ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	if ( !Seek( m_DosHeader.e_lfanew, false ) )
		return EScanStatus::SeekFailed;

	u32 unSignature;
	if ( !ReadBytes( &unSignature, sizeof( unSignature ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	if ( unSignature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE )
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;

	if ( !ReadBytes( &m_RawFileHeader, sizeof( m_RawFileHeader ) ) )
		return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	memcpy( &m_FileHeader, &m_RawFileHeader, sizeof( m_FileHeader ) );

	if ( ( m_FileHeader.Machine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386 && m_FileHeader.Machine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64 ) ||
	     m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections > 0x40 )
	{
		return EScanStatus::BadImage;
	}

	if ( m_FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader == sizeof( m_OptionalHeader64 ) )
	{
		if ( !ReadBytes( &m_OptionalHeader64, sizeof( m_OptionalHeader64 ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
		if ( m_OptionalHeader64.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC )
			return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
		m_bPe64 = 1;
	}
	else if ( m_FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader == sizeof( m_OptionalHeader32 ) )
	{
		if ( !ReadBytes( &m_OptionalHeader32, sizeof( m_OptionalHeader32 ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
		if ( m_OptionalHeader32.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC )
			return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
	}
	else
	{
		return EScanStatus::BadOptionalHeader;
	}

	const u32 cSections = m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
	m_pSections = static_cast<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *>( HeapAllocate( sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) * cSections ) );
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		if ( !ReadBytes( &m_pSections[iSection], sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) ) )
			return EScanStatus::ReadFailed;
	}

	m_ulImageBase = m_bPe64 ? m_OptionalHeader64.ImageBase : m_OptionalHeader32.ImageBase;
	SetMemoryRangeEnd( 0 );
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 51 56 8B F1 E8
EScanStatus CPeFileReader::Open( HANDLE hFile ) noexcept
{
	Release();
	if ( AttachFile( hFile ) )
		return Load();
	return EScanStatus::OpenFailed;
}

// @orig: 51 53 55 56 8B F1
EScanStatus CPeFileReader::Load() noexcept
{
	if ( !IsOpen() )
		return EScanStatus::NoFile;

	const EScanStatus eStatus = ParseHeaders();
	if ( eStatus != EScanStatus::Ok )
	{
		Release();
		return eStatus;
	}

	u32 ibSectionsEnd = 0;
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const u32 ibEnd = m_pSections[iSection].PointerToRawData + m_pSections[iSection].SizeOfRawData;
		if ( ibEnd > ibSectionsEnd )
			ibSectionsEnd = ibEnd;
	}

	const u32 cubFile = file::GetFileSizeOrZero( g_pImports, m_hFile );
	const u32 cubAlignment = m_bPe64 ? m_OptionalHeader64.SectionAlignment : m_OptionalHeader32.SectionAlignment;
	if ( ibSectionsEnd < cubFile )
	{
		++m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
		const u32 cubExtra = cubFile - ibSectionsEnd;
		m_pSections = static_cast<IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *>(
		    HeapResize( m_pSections, sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) * m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections ) );

		IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pExtra = &m_pSections[m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections - 1];
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pLast = &m_pSections[m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections - 2];

		const u32 cubLastRaw = pLast->SizeOfRawData;
		u32 cubLastVirtual = pLast->Misc.VirtualSize;
		if ( cubLastVirtual < cubLastRaw )
			cubLastVirtual = cubAlignment + cubLastRaw - 1 - ( cubAlignment + cubLastRaw - 1 ) % cubAlignment;
		const u32 unNextRva = cubAlignment + cubLastVirtual + pLast->VirtualAddress - 1;

		memset( pExtra, 0, sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER ) );
		pExtra->PointerToRawData = ibSectionsEnd;
		pExtra->Characteristics = IMAGE_SCN_MEM_DISCARDABLE;
		pExtra->SizeOfRawData = cubExtra;
		pExtra->VirtualAddress = unNextRva - unNextRva % cubAlignment;
		pExtra->Misc.VirtualSize = cubAlignment + cubExtra - 1 - ( cubAlignment + cubExtra - 1 ) % cubAlignment;
		memcpy( pExtra->Name, ".extra", 7 );
	}
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 53 56 57 8B F1
void CPeFileReader::Release() noexcept
{
	Close();

	if ( m_pSections )
		HeapRelease( m_pSections );

	if ( m_cExportNames > 0 )
	{
		if ( m_ppszExportNames )
		{
			for ( i32 iName = 0; iName < m_cExportNames; ++iName )
			{
				if ( m_ppszExportNames[iName] )
					HeapRelease( m_ppszExportNames[iName] );
			}
			HeapRelease( m_ppszExportNames );
		}
		if ( m_punExportFunctions )
			HeapRelease( m_punExportFunctions );
	}

	for ( i32 iLibrary = 0; iLibrary < m_cForwarderLibraries; ++iLibrary )
		HeapRelease( m_rgpszForwarderLibraries[iLibrary] );

	if ( m_pUnused2690 )
		HeapRelease( m_pUnused2690 );

	if ( m_ppSectionData )
	{
		for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < m_FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
		{
			if ( m_ppSectionData[iSection] )
				HeapRelease( m_ppSectionData[iSection] );
		}
		HeapRelease( m_ppSectionData );
	}

	m_ulImageBase = 0;
	m_rgunUnused2140[2] = 0;
	m_pSections = nullptr;
	m_ppSectionData = nullptr;
	m_cExportNames = 0;
	m_ppszExportNames = nullptr;
	m_punExportFunctions = nullptr;
	m_cForwarderLibraries = 0;
	m_pUnused2690 = nullptr;
	m_unUnused2694 = 0;
	m_szExportName[0] = 0;
	m_unUnused2578 = 0;
	m_rgunUnused2140[0] = 0;
	m_rgunUnused2140[1] = 0;
	m_unUnused214C = 0;
	m_bPe64 = 0;
	memset( m_rgpszForwarderLibraries, 0, sizeof( m_rgpszForwarderLibraries ) );
	m_unUnused257C = 0;
}
```

```cpp
// @binary: a07ed54b
#include "internal/process_reader.hpp"
#include "internal/helpers.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/enum.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "process/capture_flags.hpp"
#include "process/process.hpp"
#include "util/wstr.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::system_info
{

VAC_FLAGS( EReadFlags )

namespace
{

constexpr u32 k_cubMaxPathString = ( MAX_PATH - 1 ) * sizeof( wchar_t );
constexpr u32 k_cMaxModules = 1000;

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 56
BOOL __stdcall IsNative64Process( HANDLE hProcess, BOOL *pbNative64 ) noexcept
{
	*pbNative64 = FALSE;
	if ( g_pImports->IsWow64Process )
	{
		BOOL bSelfWow64 = FALSE;
		BOOL bTargetWow64 = FALSE;
		g_pImports->IsWow64Process( g_pImports->GetCurrentProcess(), &bSelfWow64 );
		if ( bSelfWow64 )
		{
			if ( hProcess == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
			{
				*pbNative64 = TRUE;
			}
			else
			{
				g_pImports->IsWow64Process( hProcess, &bTargetWow64 );
				if ( !bTargetWow64 )
					*pbNative64 = TRUE;
			}
		}
	}
	return TRUE;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 51
NTSTATUS __stdcall ReadVirtualMemoryAuto( HANDLE hProcess, u64 ulAddress, void *pBuffer, u64 cubRead,
                                          u64 *pcubRead ) noexcept
{
	BOOL bNative64 = FALSE;
	if ( IsNative64Process( hProcess, &bNative64 ) && bNative64 )
	{
		if ( g_pImports->NtWow64ReadVirtualMemory64 )
			return g_pImports->NtWow64ReadVirtualMemory64( hProcess, reinterpret_cast<PVOID64>( ulAddress ), pBuffer,
			                                               cubRead, pcubRead );
		return 0;
	}

	if ( g_pImports->NtReadVirtualMemory )
	{
		ULONG cubDone = 0;
		const NTSTATUS nStatus =
		    g_pImports->NtReadVirtualMemory( hProcess, reinterpret_cast<void *>( static_cast<uptr>( ulAddress ) ),
		                                     pBuffer, static_cast<ULONG>( cubRead ), &cubDone );
		*pcubRead = cubDone;
		return nStatus;
	}
	return 0;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 8E
void CProcessReader::Release() noexcept
{
	if ( m_pModules )
		HeapRelease( m_pModules );
	m_pModules = nullptr;
	m_cModules = 0;
	if ( m_pUnused254 )
		HeapRelease( m_pUnused254 );
	if ( m_pUnused27C )
		HeapRelease( m_pUnused27C );
	if ( m_pUnused25C )
		HeapRelease( m_pUnused25C );
	if ( m_pUnused264 )
		HeapRelease( m_pUnused264 );
	if ( m_hProcess != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && m_hProcess )
		g_pImports->CloseHandle( m_hProcess );
	memset( this, 0, sizeof( *this ) );
	m_hProcess = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 8A 84 24 ? ? ? ? 53 55 8B D9
EScanStatus CProcessReader::ReadProcess64( u32 unPid, EReadFlags eReadFlags ) noexcept
{
	m_unPid = unPid;
	m_cModules = 0;
	m_unUnused250 = 0;
	m_CreationTime.dwLowDateTime = 0;
	m_CreationTime.dwHighDateTime = 0;

	FILETIME rgTimes[4];
	if ( g_pImports->GetProcessTimes( m_hProcess, &rgTimes[0], &rgTimes[1], &rgTimes[2], &rgTimes[3] ) )
	{
		m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Times64;
		m_CreationTime = rgTimes[0];
	}

	const HANDLE hProcess = m_hProcess;
	m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Entered64;

	nt::ProcessBasicInformation64_t basicInfo;
	ULONG cubBasicInfo = 0;
	BOOL bNative64 = FALSE;
	if ( IsNative64Process( hProcess, &bNative64 ) && bNative64 )
	{
		if ( g_pImports->NtWow64QueryInformationProcess64 )
			g_pImports->NtWow64QueryInformationProcess64( hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation, &basicInfo,
			                                              sizeof( basicInfo ), &cubBasicInfo );
	}
	else if ( g_pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess )
	{
		ULONG cubReturned = 0;
		g_pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess( hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation, &basicInfo, sizeof( basicInfo ),
		                                       &cubReturned );
		cubBasicInfo = cubReturned;
	}

	if ( cubBasicInfo != sizeof( basicInfo ) )
	{
		GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::BasicInfoFailed;
	}

	m_unParentPid = static_cast<u32>( basicInfo.m_ulInheritedFromUniqueProcessId );
	m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::BasicInfo64;
	if ( !basicInfo.m_ulPebBaseAddress )
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;

	u64 cubRead = 0;
	m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebAddress64;
	nt::Peb64_t peb;
	ReadVirtualMemoryAuto( m_hProcess, basicInfo.m_ulPebBaseAddress, &peb, sizeof( peb ), &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != sizeof( peb ) )
		return EScanStatus::PebReadFailed;
	m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebRead64;

	// @note / sapdragon: valve reads 1024 chars out of a 520 byte stack buffer and clears it right after,
	// so only the neighbours in its frame get read. this one is just big enough for that copy
	alignas( 8 ) u8 rgubBuffer[2048];
	wchar_t *pwszBuffer = reinterpret_cast<wchar_t *>( rgubBuffer );

	if ( HasFlag( eReadFlags, EReadFlags::Parameters ) )
	{
		alignas( 8 ) u8 rgubParameters[nt::Arch64_t::k_cubProcessParametersSnapshot];
		const auto &parameters = *reinterpret_cast<const nt::ProcessParameters_t<nt::Arch64_t> *>( rgubParameters );
		ReadVirtualMemoryAuto( m_hProcess, peb.m_ulProcessParameters, rgubParameters, sizeof( rgubParameters ),
		                       &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != nt::Arch64_t::k_cubProcessParametersSnapshot )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;

		pwszBuffer[MAX_PATH - 1] = 0;

		u32 cubString = k_cubMaxPathString;
		if ( parameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath.m_cubLength < k_cubMaxPathString )
			cubString = parameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath.m_cubLength;
		memset( rgubBuffer, 0, MAX_PATH * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
		ReadVirtualMemoryAuto( m_hProcess, parameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath.m_ulBuffer, rgubBuffer, cubString,
		                       &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != cubString )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		pwszBuffer[parameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath.m_cubLength > cubString
		               ? MAX_PATH - 1
		               : parameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath.m_cubLength >> 1] = 0;
		CopyWideClearRest( m_wszCurrentDirectory, pwszBuffer, ARRAYSIZE( m_wszCurrentDirectory ) );

		cubString = k_cubMaxPathString;
		if ( parameters.m_ImagePathName.m_cubLength < k_cubMaxPathString )
			cubString = parameters.m_ImagePathName.m_cubLength;
		memset( rgubBuffer, 0, MAX_PATH * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
		ReadVirtualMemoryAuto( m_hProcess, parameters.m_ImagePathName.m_ulBuffer, rgubBuffer, cubString, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != cubString )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		pwszBuffer[parameters.m_ImagePathName.m_cubLength > cubString ? MAX_PATH - 1
		                                                              : parameters.m_ImagePathName.m_cubLength >> 1] =
		    0;
		CopyWideClearRest( m_wszImagePath, pwszBuffer, ARRAYSIZE( m_wszImagePath ) );

		cubString = k_cubMaxPathString;
		if ( parameters.m_CommandLine.m_cubLength < k_cubMaxPathString )
			cubString = parameters.m_CommandLine.m_cubLength;
		memset( rgubBuffer, 0, MAX_PATH * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
		ReadVirtualMemoryAuto( m_hProcess, parameters.m_CommandLine.m_ulBuffer, rgubBuffer, cubString, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != cubString )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		pwszBuffer[parameters.m_CommandLine.m_cubLength > cubString ? MAX_PATH - 1
		                                                            : parameters.m_CommandLine.m_cubLength >> 1] = 0;
		CopyWideClearRest( m_wszCommandLine, pwszBuffer, ARRAYSIZE( m_wszCommandLine ) );
	}

	if ( HasFlag( eReadFlags, EReadFlags::Modules ) )
	{
		nt::PebLdrData64_t loaderData;
		ReadVirtualMemoryAuto( m_hProcess, peb.m_ulLdr, &loaderData, nt::Arch64_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != nt::Arch64_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot )
		{
			m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrReadFailed;
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		}

		m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrRead64;
		const u64 ulFirstEntry = loaderData.m_InLoadOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
		if ( !ulFirstEntry )
		{
			m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrEmpty64;
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		}

		auto *pEntry = reinterpret_cast<nt::LdrDataTableEntry64_t *>( rgubBuffer );
		ReadVirtualMemoryAuto( m_hProcess, ulFirstEntry, pEntry, nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot )
		{
			m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntryFailed64;
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		}

		m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntry64;
		u32 iModule = 0;
		u32 iLoadIndex = 1;
		do
		{
			ProcessModuleEntry_t moduleEntry;
			memset( &moduleEntry, 0, sizeof( moduleEntry ) );
			moduleEntry.m_iLoadIndex = iLoadIndex;
			const u32 iNextLoadIndex = iLoadIndex + 1;
			const u32 cubName = pEntry->m_FullDllName.m_cubLength;
			moduleEntry.m_ulDllBase = pEntry->m_ulDllBase;
			moduleEntry.m_cubSizeOfImage = pEntry->m_cubSizeOfImage;

			wchar_t wszName[262];
			if ( cubName >= k_cubMaxPathString )
			{
				m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameTooLong;
			}
			else
			{
				cubRead = 0;
				ReadVirtualMemoryAuto( m_hProcess, pEntry->m_FullDllName.m_ulBuffer, wszName, cubName, &cubRead );
				if ( cubRead != cubName )
				{
					m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameReadFailed;
				}
				else
				{
					wszName[cubName >> 1] = 0;
					CopyWideClearRest( moduleEntry.m_wszPath, wszName, ARRAYSIZE( moduleEntry.m_wszPath ) );
					const wchar_t *pwszBase = util::wstr::BaseName( moduleEntry.m_wszPath );
					if ( pwszBase )
						CopyWideClearRest( moduleEntry.m_wszName, pwszBase, ARRAYSIZE( moduleEntry.m_wszName ) );
				}
			}

			m_pModules = static_cast<ProcessModuleEntry_t *>(
			    HeapResize( m_pModules, sizeof( ProcessModuleEntry_t ) * ( m_cModules + 1 ) ) );
			memcpy( &m_pModules[m_cModules], &moduleEntry, sizeof( moduleEntry ) );
			++m_cModules;

			const u64 ulNext = pEntry->m_InLoadOrderLinks.m_ulFlink;
			if ( !ulNext || ulNext == ulFirstEntry )
				break;
			ReadVirtualMemoryAuto( m_hProcess, ulNext, pEntry, nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot, &cubRead );
			if ( cubRead != nt::Arch64_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot || !pEntry->m_ulDllBase )
				break;

			iLoadIndex = iNextLoadIndex;
			++iModule;
		} while ( iModule < k_cMaxModules );
	}
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 8A 45
bool CProcessReader::NextLoaderEntry( u32 ulStop, nt::LdrDataTableEntry32_t *pEntry, EReadFlags eReadFlags ) noexcept
{
	bool bInitOrder = ( static_cast<u8>( eReadFlags ) >> 7 ) != 0;
	u32 ulNext;
	if ( HasFlag( eReadFlags, EReadFlags::WalkLoadOrder ) )
	{
		ulNext = pEntry->m_InLoadOrderLinks.m_ulFlink;
	}
	else if ( !HasFlag( eReadFlags, EReadFlags::WalkInitOrder ) )
	{
		bInitOrder = false;
		ulNext = pEntry->m_InMemoryOrderLinks.m_ulFlink;
	}
	else
	{
		ulNext = pEntry->m_InInitializationOrderLinks.m_ulFlink;
	}

	if ( !ulNext || ulNext == ulStop )
		return false;

	if ( !HasFlag( eReadFlags, EReadFlags::WalkLoadOrder ) )
		ulNext -= bInitOrder ? 16 : 8;

	SIZE_T cubRead = 0;
	g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( m_hProcess, reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>( static_cast<uptr>( ulNext ) ), pEntry,
	                               nt::Arch32_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot, &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != nt::Arch32_t::k_cubLdrEntrySnapshot )
	{
		m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::EntryReadFailed;
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 8A 84 24 ? ? ? ? 53 55 56
EScanStatus CProcessReader::ReadProcess( u32 unPid, EReadFlags eReadFlags ) noexcept
{
	m_eFlags = process::ECaptureFlags::None;
	m_CreationTime.dwLowDateTime = 0;
	m_CreationTime.dwHighDateTime = 0;

	m_hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );
	if ( ( g_pSession->m_OsVersion.dwPlatformId != VER_PLATFORM_WIN32_NT ||
	       g_pSession->m_OsVersion.dwMajorVersion < 6 ) &&
	     ( !m_hProcess || m_hProcess == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ) )
	{
		m_hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );
	}

	if ( !m_hProcess )
	{
		m_unLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::ProcessOpenFailed;
	}

	m_unPid = unPid;
	m_cModules = 0;
	m_unUnused250 = 0;
	m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Opened;
	ULONG cubImageName = 1;

	FILETIME rgTimes[4];
	if ( g_pImports->GetProcessTimes( m_hProcess, &rgTimes[0], &rgTimes[1], &rgTimes[2], &rgTimes[3] ) )
	{
		m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Times;
		m_CreationTime = rgTimes[0];
	}

	BOOL bNative64 = FALSE;
	IsNative64Process( GetCurrentProcess(), &bNative64 );
	m_bSelfIsWow64 = bNative64 != FALSE;
	bNative64 = FALSE;
	IsNative64Process( m_hProcess, &bNative64 );
	m_bTargetIsNative64 = bNative64 != FALSE;
	g_pImports->CloseHandle( m_hProcess );

	m_hProcess = g_pImports->OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ, FALSE, unPid );
	if ( !m_hProcess )
	{
		m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::ReopenFailed;
		m_unLastError = g_pImports->GetLastError();
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReopenFailed;
	}

	m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Reopened;
	if ( m_bTargetIsNative64 )
	{
		m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::Cross64;
		return ReadProcess64( unPid, eReadFlags );
	}

	nt::ProcessBasicInformation32_t basicInfo;
	ULONG cubBasicInfo = 0;
	g_pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess( m_hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation, &basicInfo, sizeof( basicInfo ),
	                                       &cubBasicInfo );
	if ( cubBasicInfo != sizeof( basicInfo ) )
		return EScanStatus::BasicInfoFailed;

	m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::BasicInfo;
	m_unParentPid = basicInfo.m_ulInheritedFromUniqueProcessId;

	if ( !basicInfo.m_ulPebBaseAddress )
	{
		alignas( 8 ) u8 rgubImageName[MAX_PATH * sizeof( wchar_t )];
		reinterpret_cast<wchar_t *>( rgubImageName )[MAX_PATH - 1] = 0;
		g_pImports->NtQueryInformationProcess( m_hProcess, ProcessImageFileName, rgubImageName, sizeof( rgubImageName ),
		                                       &cubImageName );
		if ( cubImageName )
			CopyWideClearRest( m_wszImagePath, reinterpret_cast<const wchar_t *>( rgubImageName + 8 ),
			                   ARRAYSIZE( m_wszImagePath ) );
		return EScanStatus::NoPeb;
	}

	SIZE_T cubRead = 0;
	m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebAddress;
	g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( m_hProcess,
	                               reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>( static_cast<uptr>( basicInfo.m_ulPebBaseAddress ) ),
	                               &m_Peb, sizeof( nt::Peb32_t ), &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != sizeof( nt::Peb32_t ) )
		return EScanStatus::PebReadFailed;

	m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::PebRead;

	wchar_t wszBuffer[1024];
	if ( HasFlag( eReadFlags, EReadFlags::Parameters ) )
	{
		g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( m_hProcess,
		                               reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>( static_cast<uptr>( m_Peb.m_ulProcessParameters ) ),
		                               &m_Parameters, nt::Arch32_t::k_cubProcessParametersSnapshot, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != nt::Arch32_t::k_cubProcessParametersSnapshot )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;

		u32 cubString = m_Parameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath.m_cubLength;
		if ( cubString >= sizeof( wszBuffer ) - sizeof( wchar_t ) )
			cubString = sizeof( wszBuffer ) - sizeof( wchar_t );
		memset( wszBuffer, 0, sizeof( wszBuffer ) );
		g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory(
		    m_hProcess,
		    reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>( static_cast<uptr>( m_Parameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath.m_ulBuffer ) ), wszBuffer,
		    cubString, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != cubString )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		wszBuffer[m_Parameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath.m_cubLength > cubString
		              ? ARRAYSIZE( wszBuffer ) - 1
		              : m_Parameters.m_CurrentDirectoryPath.m_cubLength >> 1] = 0;
		CopyWideClearRest( m_wszCurrentDirectory, wszBuffer, ARRAYSIZE( m_wszCurrentDirectory ) );

		cubString = m_Parameters.m_ImagePathName.m_cubLength;
		if ( cubString >= sizeof( wszBuffer ) - sizeof( wchar_t ) )
			cubString = sizeof( wszBuffer ) - sizeof( wchar_t );
		memset( wszBuffer, 0, sizeof( wszBuffer ) );
		g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory(
		    m_hProcess, reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>( static_cast<uptr>( m_Parameters.m_ImagePathName.m_ulBuffer ) ),
		    wszBuffer, cubString, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != cubString )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		wszBuffer[m_Parameters.m_ImagePathName.m_cubLength > cubString
		              ? ARRAYSIZE( wszBuffer ) - 1
		              : m_Parameters.m_ImagePathName.m_cubLength >> 1] = 0;
		CopyWideClearRest( m_wszImagePath, wszBuffer, ARRAYSIZE( m_wszImagePath ) );

		cubString = sizeof( wszBuffer ) - sizeof( wchar_t );
		if ( m_Parameters.m_CommandLine.m_cubLength < sizeof( wszBuffer ) - sizeof( wchar_t ) )
			cubString = m_Parameters.m_CommandLine.m_cubLength;
		memset( wszBuffer, 0, sizeof( wszBuffer ) );
		g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory(
		    m_hProcess, reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>( static_cast<uptr>( m_Parameters.m_CommandLine.m_ulBuffer ) ),
		    wszBuffer, cubString, &cubRead );
		if ( cubRead != cubString )
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		wszBuffer[m_Parameters.m_CommandLine.m_cubLength > cubString ? ARRAYSIZE( wszBuffer ) - 1
		                                                             : m_Parameters.m_CommandLine.m_cubLength >> 1] = 0;
		CopyWideClearRest( m_wszCommandLine, wszBuffer, ARRAYSIZE( m_wszCommandLine ) );
	}

	nt::PebLdrData32_t loaderData;
	g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory( m_hProcess, reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>( static_cast<uptr>( m_Peb.m_ulLdr ) ),
	                               &loaderData, nt::Arch32_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot, &cubRead );
	if ( cubRead != nt::Arch32_t::k_cubPebLdrSnapshot )
	{
		m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrReadFailed;
		return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
	}

	m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::LdrRead;
	if ( HasFlag( eReadFlags, EReadFlags::Modules ) )
	{
		u32 ulStop = loaderData.m_InLoadOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
		nt::LdrDataTableEntry32_t entry;
		entry.m_InLoadOrderLinks.m_ulFlink = loaderData.m_InLoadOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
		entry.m_InInitializationOrderLinks.m_ulFlink = loaderData.m_InInitializationOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
		entry.m_InMemoryOrderLinks.m_ulFlink = loaderData.m_InMemoryOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
		if ( !HasFlag( eReadFlags, EReadFlags::WalkLoadOrder ) )
		{
			ulStop = HasFlag( eReadFlags, EReadFlags::WalkInitOrder )
			             ? loaderData.m_InInitializationOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink
			             : loaderData.m_InMemoryOrderModuleList.m_ulFlink;
		}

		if ( !NextLoaderEntry( 0, &entry, eReadFlags ) )
		{
			m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntryFailed;
			return EScanStatus::ProcessReadFailed;
		}

		i32 cRemaining = k_cMaxModules;
		m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::FirstEntry;
		wchar_t wszName[MAX_PATH];
		for ( ;; )
		{
			--cRemaining;
			ProcessModuleEntry_t moduleEntry;
			memset( &moduleEntry, 0, sizeof( moduleEntry ) );
			const u32 cubName = entry.m_FullDllName.m_cubLength;
			moduleEntry.m_ulDllBase = static_cast<u64>( static_cast<i64>( static_cast<i32>( entry.m_ulDllBase ) ) );
			moduleEntry.m_iLoadIndex = cubImageName;
			moduleEntry.m_cubSizeOfImage = 4096;
			++cubImageName;

			if ( cubName >= k_cubMaxPathString )
			{
				m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameTooLong;
			}
			else
			{
				cubRead = 0;
				g_pImports->ReadProcessMemory(
				    m_hProcess, reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>( static_cast<uptr>( entry.m_FullDllName.m_ulBuffer ) ),
				    wszName, cubName, &cubRead );
				if ( cubRead == cubName )
				{
					wszName[cubName >> 1] = 0;
					CopyWideClearRest( moduleEntry.m_wszPath, wszName, ARRAYSIZE( moduleEntry.m_wszPath ) );
					const wchar_t *pwszBase = util::wstr::BaseName( moduleEntry.m_wszPath );
					if ( pwszBase )
						CopyWideClearRest( moduleEntry.m_wszName, pwszBase, ARRAYSIZE( moduleEntry.m_wszName ) );
				}
				else
				{
					m_eFlags |= process::ECaptureFlags::NameReadFailed;
				}
			}

			m_pModules = static_cast<ProcessModuleEntry_t *>(
			    HeapResize( m_pModules, sizeof( ProcessModuleEntry_t ) * ( m_cModules + 1 ) ) );
			memcpy( &m_pModules[m_cModules], &moduleEntry, sizeof( moduleEntry ) );
			++m_cModules;

			if ( !NextLoaderEntry( ulStop, &entry, eReadFlags ) || !entry.m_ulDllBase )
				break;
			if ( cRemaining <= 0 )
			{
				--cRemaining;
				break;
			}
		}
		if ( !cRemaining )
			return EScanStatus::TooManyModules;
	}
	return EScanStatus::Ok;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::system_info
```

```cpp
// @binary: a07ed54b
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "file/file.hpp"
#include "util/hashing.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::system_info
{

namespace
{

constexpr u32 k_cVolumeFieldChars = 50;

u32 HashWide( const wchar_t *pwszText ) noexcept
{
	// @note / sapdragon: the length is in chars but the hash walks bytes, so only half the string counts
	return util::hashing::PathHashBytes( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( pwszText ),
	                                     static_cast<u32>( lstrlenW( pwszText ) ) );
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 55 8D 6C 24
bool QueryFileIdentity( const wchar_t *pwszPath, u32 *punVolumeSerial, u64 *pulFileId,
                        const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle )
		return false;

	const HANDLE hFile = pImports->CreateFileW( pwszPath, FILE_GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
	                                            FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, nullptr );
	if ( hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE || !pImports->GetFileInformationByHandleEx )
		return false;

	u8 rgubInfo[132];
	memset( rgubInfo, 0, sizeof( rgubInfo ) );
	const BOOL bOk =
	    pImports->GetFileInformationByHandleEx( hFile, FileIdBothDirectoryInfo, rgubInfo, sizeof( rgubInfo ) );

	*punVolumeSerial = 0;
	if ( bOk && pImports->GetVolumeInformationByHandleW )
		pImports->GetVolumeInformationByHandleW( hFile, nullptr, 0, reinterpret_cast<LPDWORD>( punVolumeSerial ),
		                                         nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, 0 );

	pImports->CloseHandle( hFile );
	if ( !bOk )
	{
		pImports->GetLastError();
		return false;
	}

	memcpy( pulFileId, &rgubInfo[offsetof( FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFO, FileId.LowPart )], sizeof( u32 ) );
	memcpy( reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( pulFileId ) + sizeof( u32 ),
	        &rgubInfo[offsetof( FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFO, FileId.HighPart )], sizeof( u32 ) );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 33 F6
u32 CollectVolumes( VolumeEntry_t *pEntries, const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pImports->FindFirstVolumeW )
		return 0;

	wchar_t wszVolume[MAX_PATH + 2];
	memset( wszVolume, 0, MAX_PATH * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
	const HANDLE hFind = pImports->FindFirstVolumeW( wszVolume, MAX_PATH );
	if ( hFind == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
	{
		pImports->GetLastError();
		return 0;
	}

	if ( !pImports->GetVolumeInformationW || !pImports->GetDriveTypeW || !pImports->GetVolumePathNamesForVolumeNameW )
		return 0;

	u32 cVolumes = 0;
	do
	{
		VolumeEntry_t entry;
		memset( &entry, 0, sizeof( entry ) );
		entry.m_unNameHash = HashWide( wszVolume );

		DWORD unSerial = 0;
		DWORD unFlags = 0;
		wchar_t wszLabel[k_cVolumeFieldChars + 2];
		wchar_t wszFileSystem[k_cVolumeFieldChars + 2];
		if ( pImports->GetVolumeInformationW( wszVolume, wszLabel, k_cVolumeFieldChars, &unSerial, nullptr, &unFlags,
		                                      wszFileSystem, k_cVolumeFieldChars ) )
		{
			entry.m_unFileSystemFlags = unFlags;
			entry.m_unSerial = unSerial;
			entry.m_unLabelHash = HashWide( wszLabel );
			entry.m_unFileSystemHash = HashWide( wszFileSystem );
		}
		else
		{
			entry.m_unInfoError = pImports->GetLastError();
		}

		entry.m_unDriveType = static_cast<u16>( pImports->GetDriveTypeW( wszVolume ) );

		wchar_t wszMountPoints[k_cVolumeFieldChars + 2];
		DWORD cchMountPoints;
		if ( pImports->GetVolumePathNamesForVolumeNameW( wszVolume, wszMountPoints, k_cVolumeFieldChars,
		                                                 &cchMountPoints ) )
		{
			entry.m_cchMountPoints = static_cast<u16>( cchMountPoints );
			entry.m_unMountPointHashOrError = HashWide( wszMountPoints );
		}
		else
		{
			entry.m_cchMountPoints = 0;
			entry.m_unMountPointHashOrError = pImports->GetLastError();
		}

		if ( cVolumes < ARRAYSIZE( Report_t::m_rgVolumes ) )
			pEntries[cVolumes] = entry;
		++cVolumes;
	} while ( pImports->FindNextVolumeW( hFind, wszVolume, MAX_PATH ) );

	pImports->FindVolumeClose( hFind );
	return cVolumes;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::system_info
```

`modules/system_info/tests/parity.cpp`:

```cpp
// Fault injection parity for system_info, the paths a healthy machine never takes.
//
//     system_info_parity.exe <original.dll> <rebuild.dll> <decrypted_input.bin>
//
// Each scenario runs the original, the rebuild and the original again in this process, with the same API
// faults. Bytes that differ between the two original runs are noise. Time fields must land between the two
// original runs, so their high bytes get checked as well, and the handle must be open in both or in neither.
#include <windows.h>

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace
{

using Worker_t = int( __cdecl * )( const unsigned char *, unsigned char *, unsigned * );

constexpr unsigned k_cubWritten = 3072;
constexpr unsigned k_cubAllocated = 4096;
constexpr unsigned k_ibTargetPid = 0x60;
constexpr unsigned k_ibXorKey = 0x64;
constexpr unsigned k_ibStatus = 0x14;
constexpr unsigned k_ibSystemTimeStart = 0x20;
constexpr unsigned k_ibSystemTimeEnd = 0x28;
constexpr unsigned k_ibTickStart = 0x30;
constexpr unsigned k_ibTickEnd = 0x34;
constexpr unsigned k_ibCurrentTime = 0x38;
constexpr unsigned k_ibTimesEnd = 0x40;
constexpr unsigned k_ibNtdllStatus = 0xB8;
constexpr unsigned k_ibTargetHandle = 0x6F4;
constexpr unsigned k_ibCommandLine = 0x800;
constexpr unsigned k_unInjectedError = 77;

enum class EFault
{
	None,
	FailSystemDirectory,
	FailWindowsDirectory,
	FailDirectoryOpen,
	FailNtdllOpen,
	RedirectNtdll,
	FailReadFileNth,
	ShortReadFileNth,
	FailSeekNth,
	WrongFileSize,
	FailFileInfo,
	FailFirstVolume,
	FailVolumeInfo,
	FailMountPoints,
	FailOpenProcessNth,
	FailImageName,
	ShortRemoteReadNth,
	ShortWow64ReadNth,
};

EFault s_eFault = EFault::None;
unsigned s_nFaultAt = 0;
unsigned s_cCalls = 0;
DWORD s_cubFakeFileSize = 0;
std::wstring s_wstrRedirect;

bool HitFault( EFault eFault )
{
	return s_eFault == eFault && ++s_cCalls == s_nFaultAt;
}

struct Hook_t
{
	const char *m_pszLibrary;
	const char *m_pszName;
	void *m_pfnHook;
	unsigned char *m_pubTarget;
	unsigned char m_rgubSaved[5];
};

void Install( Hook_t &hook )
{
	unsigned char rgubJump[5] = { 0xE9 };
	const int nDelta = static_cast<int>( static_cast<unsigned char *>( hook.m_pfnHook ) - hook.m_pubTarget - 5 );
	std::memcpy( rgubJump + 1, &nDelta, 4 );
	DWORD unOld;
	VirtualProtect( hook.m_pubTarget, 5, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, &unOld );
	std::memcpy( hook.m_pubTarget, rgubJump, 5 );
	VirtualProtect( hook.m_pubTarget, 5, unOld, &unOld );
}

void Remove( Hook_t &hook )
{
	DWORD unOld;
	VirtualProtect( hook.m_pubTarget, 5, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, &unOld );
	std::memcpy( hook.m_pubTarget, hook.m_rgubSaved, 5 );
	VirtualProtect( hook.m_pubTarget, 5, unOld, &unOld );
}

template <typename Function_t, typename... Args_t>
auto CallReal( Hook_t &hook, Args_t... args )
{
	Remove( hook );
	const auto result = reinterpret_cast<Function_t>( hook.m_pubTarget )( args... );
	const DWORD unError = GetLastError();
	Install( hook );
	SetLastError( unError );
	return result;
}

extern Hook_t s_rgHooks[];
enum EHook
{
	k_iCreateFileW,
	k_iReadFile,
	k_iSetFilePointer,
	k_iGetFileSize,
	k_iGetSystemDirectoryW,
	k_iGetWindowsDirectoryW,
	k_iGetFileInformationByHandleEx,
	k_iFindFirstVolumeW,
	k_iGetVolumeInformationW,
	k_iGetVolumePathNames,
	k_iOpenProcess,
	k_iGetProcessImageFileNameA,
	k_iReadProcessMemory,
	k_iNtWow64ReadVirtualMemory64,
	k_cHooks,
};

HANDLE WINAPI HookCreateFileW( LPCWSTR pwszPath, DWORD unAccess, DWORD unShare, LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES pSecurity,
                               DWORD unDisposition, DWORD unFlags, HANDLE hTemplate )
{
	const bool bNtdll = std::wcsstr( pwszPath, L"NtDll.dll" ) != nullptr;
	if ( ( s_eFault == EFault::FailNtdllOpen && bNtdll ) || ( s_eFault == EFault::FailDirectoryOpen && !bNtdll ) )
	{
		SetLastError( k_unInjectedError );
		return INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
	}
	if ( s_eFault == EFault::RedirectNtdll && bNtdll )
		pwszPath = s_wstrRedirect.c_str();
	return CallReal<decltype( &CreateFileW )>( s_rgHooks[k_iCreateFileW], pwszPath, unAccess, unShare, pSecurity,
	                                           unDisposition, unFlags, hTemplate );
}

BOOL WINAPI HookReadFile( HANDLE hFile, LPVOID pBuffer, DWORD cubRead, LPDWORD pcubRead, LPOVERLAPPED pOverlapped )
{
	if ( HitFault( EFault::FailReadFileNth ) )
	{
		*pcubRead = 0;
		SetLastError( k_unInjectedError );
		return FALSE;
	}
	if ( HitFault( EFault::ShortReadFileNth ) )
		cubRead /= 2;
	return CallReal<decltype( &ReadFile )>( s_rgHooks[k_iReadFile], hFile, pBuffer, cubRead, pcubRead, pOverlapped );
}

DWORD WINAPI HookSetFilePointer( HANDLE hFile, LONG nDistance, PLONG pnHigh, DWORD unMethod )
{
	if ( HitFault( EFault::FailSeekNth ) )
	{
		SetLastError( k_unInjectedError );
		return INVALID_SET_FILE_POINTER;
	}
	return CallReal<decltype( &SetFilePointer )>( s_rgHooks[k_iSetFilePointer], hFile, nDistance, pnHigh, unMethod );
}

DWORD WINAPI HookGetFileSize( HANDLE hFile, LPDWORD punHigh )
{
	if ( s_eFault == EFault::WrongFileSize )
		return s_cubFakeFileSize;
	return CallReal<decltype( &GetFileSize )>( s_rgHooks[k_iGetFileSize], hFile, punHigh );
}

UINT WINAPI HookGetSystemDirectoryW( LPWSTR pwszBuffer, UINT cchBuffer )
{
	if ( HitFault( EFault::FailSystemDirectory ) )
	{
		SetLastError( k_unInjectedError );
		return 0;
	}
	return CallReal<decltype( &GetSystemDirectoryW )>( s_rgHooks[k_iGetSystemDirectoryW], pwszBuffer, cchBuffer );
}

UINT WINAPI HookGetWindowsDirectoryW( LPWSTR pwszBuffer, UINT cchBuffer )
{
	if ( HitFault( EFault::FailWindowsDirectory ) )
	{
		SetLastError( k_unInjectedError );
		return 0;
	}
	return CallReal<decltype( &GetWindowsDirectoryW )>( s_rgHooks[k_iGetWindowsDirectoryW], pwszBuffer, cchBuffer );
}

BOOL WINAPI HookGetFileInformationByHandleEx( HANDLE hFile, FILE_INFO_BY_HANDLE_CLASS eClass, LPVOID pBuffer,
                                              DWORD cubBuffer )
{
	if ( s_eFault == EFault::FailFileInfo )
	{

	{

		return INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;

BOOL WINAPI HookGetVolumeInformationW( LPCWSTR pwszRoot, LPWSTR pwszLabel, DWORD cchLabel, LPDWORD punSerial,
                                       LPDWORD pcchComponent, LPDWORD punFlags, LPWSTR pwszFileSystem,

	                                                     cchFileSystem );

BOOL WINAPI HookGetVolumePathNames( LPCWSTR pwszVolume, LPWCH pwszPaths, DWORD cchPaths, PDWORD pcchReturned )
{
	if ( s_eFault == EFault::FailMountPoints )
	{
		SetLastError( k_unInjectedError );
		return FALSE;

	                                                                pwszPaths, cchPaths, pcchReturned );

HANDLE WINAPI HookOpenProcess( DWORD unAccess, BOOL bInherit, DWORD unPid )
{
	if ( HitFault( EFault::FailOpenProcessNth ) )
	{
		SetLastError( k_unInjectedError );
		return nullptr;
	}
	return CallReal<decltype( &OpenProcess )>( s_rgHooks[k_iOpenProcess], unAccess, bInherit, unPid );

DWORD WINAPI HookGetProcessImageFileNameA( HANDLE hProcess, LPSTR pszName, DWORD cchName )
{
	if ( s_eFault == EFault::FailImageName )
	{
		SetLastError( k_unInjectedError );
		return 0;
	}
	using Pfn_t = DWORD( WINAPI * )( HANDLE, LPSTR, DWORD );

BOOL WINAPI HookReadProcessMemory( HANDLE hProcess, LPCVOID pAddress, LPVOID pBuffer, SIZE_T cubRead, SIZE_T *pcubRead )

	if ( HitFault( EFault::ShortRemoteReadNth ) )
	{

		SetLastError( k_unInjectedError );
		return FALSE;

	return CallReal<decltype( &ReadProcessMemory )>( s_rgHooks[k_iReadProcessMemory], hProcess, pAddress, pBuffer,
	                                                 cubRead, pcubRead );

LONG WINAPI HookNtWow64ReadVirtualMemory64( HANDLE hProcess, unsigned long long ulAddress, void *pBuffer,
                                            unsigned long long cubRead, unsigned long long *pcubRead )
{
	if ( HitFault( EFault::ShortWow64ReadNth ) )
	{
		*pcubRead = 0;
		return 0;
	}
	using Pfn_t = LONG( WINAPI * )( HANDLE, unsigned long long, void *, unsigned long long, unsigned long long * );
	return CallReal<Pfn_t>( s_rgHooks[k_iNtWow64ReadVirtualMemory64], hProcess, ulAddress, pBuffer, cubRead, pcubRead );
}

Hook_t s_rgHooks[k_cHooks] = {
    { "kernel32.dll", "CreateFileW", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookCreateFileW ) },
    { "kernel32.dll", "ReadFile", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookReadFile ) },
    { "kernel32.dll", "SetFilePointer", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookSetFilePointer ) },
    { "kernel32.dll", "GetFileSize", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookGetFileSize ) },
    { "kernel32.dll", "GetSystemDirectoryW", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookGetSystemDirectoryW ) },
    { "kernel32.dll", "GetWindowsDirectoryW", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookGetWindowsDirectoryW ) },
    { "kernel32.dll", "GetFileInformationByHandleEx", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookGetFileInformationByHandleEx ) },
    { "kernel32.dll", "FindFirstVolumeW", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookFindFirstVolumeW ) },
    { "kernel32.dll", "GetVolumeInformationW", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookGetVolumeInformationW ) },
    { "kernel32.dll", "GetVolumePathNamesForVolumeNameW", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookGetVolumePathNames ) },
    { "kernel32.dll", "OpenProcess", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookOpenProcess ) },
    { "psapi.dll", "GetProcessImageFileNameA", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookGetProcessImageFileNameA ) },
    { "kernel32.dll", "ReadProcessMemory", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookReadProcessMemory ) },
    { "ntdll.dll", "NtWow64ReadVirtualMemory64", reinterpret_cast<void *>( HookNtWow64ReadVirtualMemory64 ) },
};

Worker_t FindWorker( HMODULE hModule, unsigned unId )
{
	auto *pubBase = reinterpret_cast<unsigned char *>( hModule );
	const auto *pNt = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS32 *>(
	    pubBase + reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( pubBase )->e_lfanew );
	const unsigned cubImage = pNt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage;
	DWORD unOld;
	VirtualProtect( pubBase, cubImage, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, &unOld );
	for ( unsigned ib = 0; ib + 12 <= cubImage; ib += 4 )
	{
		const auto *punNode = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned *>( pubBase + ib );
		const unsigned unWorker = punNode[2] - static_cast<unsigned>( reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>( pubBase ) );
		if ( punNode[0] == unId && punNode[1] == 1 && unWorker < cubImage )
			return reinterpret_cast<Worker_t>( pubBase + unWorker );
	}
	return nullptr;
}

DWORD CallGuarded( Worker_t pfnWorker, const unsigned char *pubInput, unsigned char *pubOutput, unsigned *pcubOutput )
{
	__try
	{
		pfnWorker( pubInput, pubOutput, pcubOutput );
	}
	__except ( EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER )
	{
		return GetExceptionCode();
	}
	return 0;
}

struct RunResult_t
{
	std::vector<unsigned char> m_rgubOutput;
	DWORD m_unException;
};

RunResult_t RunWorker( Worker_t pfnWorker, std::vector<unsigned char> input )
{
	RunResult_t result{ std::vector<unsigned char>( k_cubAllocated, 0xCC ), 0 };
	unsigned cubOutput = k_cubAllocated;
	s_cCalls = 0;
	for ( Hook_t &hook : s_rgHooks )
		Install( hook );
	result.m_unException = CallGuarded( pfnWorker, input.data(), result.m_rgubOutput.data(), &cubOutput );
	for ( Hook_t &hook : s_rgHooks )
		Remove( hook );
	result.m_rgubOutput.resize( cubOutput );
	return result;
}

unsigned ReadU32( const std::vector<unsigned char> &bytes, unsigned ib, unsigned unKey )
{
	unsigned unValue;
	std::memcpy( &unValue, bytes.data() + ib, 4 );
	return unValue ^ unKey;
}

unsigned long long ReadU64( const std::vector<unsigned char> &bytes, unsigned ib, unsigned unKey )
{
	return ( static_cast<unsigned long long>( ReadU32( bytes, ib + 4, unKey ) ) << 32 ) | ReadU32( bytes, ib, unKey );
}

void WriteFileBytes( const std::wstring &wstrPath, const std::vector<unsigned char> &bytes )
{
	std::ofstream file( wstrPath, std::ios::binary );
	file.write( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( bytes.data() ), static_cast<std::streamsize>( bytes.size() ) );
}

std::vector<unsigned char> ReadFileBytes( const std::wstring &wstrPath )
{
	std::ifstream file( wstrPath, std::ios::binary );
	return { std::istreambuf_iterator<char>( file ), {} };
}

unsigned RvaToOffset( const std::vector<unsigned char> &image, unsigned unRva )
{
	const auto *pNt = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS *>(
	    image.data() + reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( image.data() )->e_lfanew );
	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION( pNt );
	for ( unsigned i = 0; i < pNt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++i )
	{
		if ( unRva >= pSection[i].VirtualAddress && unRva < pSection[i].VirtualAddress + pSection[i].SizeOfRawData )
			return unRva - pSection[i].VirtualAddress + pSection[i].PointerToRawData;
	}
	return 0;
}

// The export directory of a 64 bit image, the one the worker reads.
IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY *ExportsOf( std::vector<unsigned char> &image )
{
	const auto *pNt = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 *>(
	    image.data() + reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( image.data() )->e_lfanew );
	const unsigned ib =
	    RvaToOffset( image, pNt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT].VirtualAddress );
	return reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY *>( image.data() + ib );
}

HANDLE SpawnSleeper( const wchar_t *pwszCmd, DWORD *punPid )
{
	std::wstring wstrLine = std::wstring( pwszCmd ) + L" /c ping -n 300 127.0.0.1 >nul";
	STARTUPINFOW startup{};
	startup.cb = sizeof( startup );
	PROCESS_INFORMATION info{};
	PVOID pOld = nullptr;
	Wow64DisableWow64FsRedirection( &pOld );
	const BOOL bOk = CreateProcessW( pwszCmd, wstrLine.data(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, nullptr,
	                                 nullptr, &startup, &info );
	Wow64RevertWow64FsRedirection( pOld );
	if ( !bOk )
		return nullptr;
	CloseHandle( info.hThread );
	*punPid = info.dwProcessId;
	Sleep( 500 );
	return info.hProcess;
}

struct Scenario_t
{
	std::wstring m_wstrName;
	EFault m_eFault;
	unsigned m_nFaultAt;
	unsigned m_unPid;
	std::wstring m_wstrRedirect;
	DWORD m_cubFakeFileSize;
};

std::string Narrow( const std::wstring &wstr )
{
	std::string str;
	for ( const wchar_t wch : wstr )
		str.push_back( static_cast<char>( wch ) );
	return str;
}

} // namespace

int wmain( int argc, wchar_t **argv )
{
	if ( argc != 4 )
		return 2;

	std::vector<unsigned char> input = ReadFileBytes( argv[3] );
	if ( input.size() < 0xA0 )
		return 3;

	HMODULE hOriginal = LoadLibraryW( argv[1] );
	HMODULE hRebuild = LoadLibraryW( argv[2] );
	if ( !hOriginal || !hRebuild )
		return 4;

	const Worker_t pfnOriginal = FindWorker( hOriginal, 0x0F8083A0 );
	const Worker_t pfnRebuild = FindWorker( hRebuild, 0x0F8083A0 );
	if ( !pfnOriginal || !pfnRebuild || FindWorker( hRebuild, 0x0C2232C2 ) != pfnRebuild )
		return 5;

	for ( Hook_t &hook : s_rgHooks )
	{
		hook.m_pubTarget =
		    reinterpret_cast<unsigned char *>( GetProcAddress( LoadLibraryA( hook.m_pszLibrary ), hook.m_pszName ) );
		if ( !hook.m_pubTarget )
			return 6;
		std::memcpy( hook.m_rgubSaved, hook.m_pubTarget, 5 );
	}

	wchar_t wszTemp[MAX_PATH];
	GetTempPathW( MAX_PATH, wszTemp );
	const std::wstring wstrTemp =
	    std::wstring( wszTemp ) + L"si_parity_" + std::to_wstring( GetCurrentProcessId() ) + L"_";

	PVOID pOldRedirection = nullptr;
	Wow64DisableWow64FsRedirection( &pOldRedirection );
	const std::vector<unsigned char> ntdll64 = ReadFileBytes( L"C:\\Windows\\System32\\ntdll.dll" );
	Wow64RevertWow64FsRedirection( pOldRedirection );
	if ( ntdll64.size() < 0x10000 )
		return 7;

	const std::wstring wstrText = wstrTemp + L"text.bin";
	WriteFileBytes( wstrText, { 'h', 'e', 'l', 'l', 'o' } );

	const std::wstring wstrEmpty = wstrTemp + L"empty.bin";
	WriteFileBytes( wstrEmpty, {} );

	std::vector<unsigned char> badPe( ntdll64.begin(), ntdll64.begin() + 0x1000 );
	badPe[reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( badPe.data() )->e_lfanew] ^= 0xFF;
	const std::wstring wstrBadPe = wstrTemp + L"badpe.bin";
	WriteFileBytes( wstrBadPe, badPe );

	std::vector<unsigned char> truncated( ntdll64.begin(), ntdll64.begin() + 0x400 );
	const std::wstring wstrTruncatedHeaders = wstrTemp + L"trunc_headers.bin";
	WriteFileBytes( wstrTruncatedHeaders, truncated );

	std::vector<unsigned char> truncatedBody( ntdll64.begin(), ntdll64.begin() + ntdll64.size() / 2 );
	const std::wstring wstrTruncatedBody = wstrTemp + L"trunc_body.bin";
	WriteFileBytes( wstrTruncatedBody, truncatedBody );

	std::vector<unsigned char> overlay = ntdll64;
	overlay.resize( overlay.size() + 0x1234, 0x5A );
	const std::wstring wstrOverlay = wstrTemp + L"overlay.bin";
	WriteFileBytes( wstrOverlay, overlay );

	std::vector<unsigned char> moreNames = ntdll64;
	ExportsOf( moreNames )->NumberOfNames = ExportsOf( moreNames )->NumberOfFunctions + 1;
	const std::wstring wstrMoreNames = wstrTemp + L"more_names.bin";
	WriteFileBytes( wstrMoreNames, moreNames );

	std::vector<unsigned char> noFunctions = ntdll64;
	ExportsOf( noFunctions )->NumberOfFunctions = 0;
	const std::wstring wstrNoFunctions = wstrTemp + L"no_functions.bin";
	WriteFileBytes( wstrNoFunctions, noFunctions );

	std::vector<unsigned char> badMachine = ntdll64;
	reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 *>( badMachine.data() +
	                                        reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( badMachine.data() )->e_lfanew )
	    ->FileHeader.Machine = 0x1234;
	const std::wstring wstrBadMachine = wstrTemp + L"bad_machine.bin";
	WriteFileBytes( wstrBadMachine, badMachine );

	std::vector<unsigned char> badOptional = ntdll64;
	reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 *>( badOptional.data() +
	                                        reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( badOptional.data() )->e_lfanew )
	    ->FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader = 100;
	const std::wstring wstrBadOptional = wstrTemp + L"bad_optional.bin";
	WriteFileBytes( wstrBadOptional, badOptional );

	std::vector<unsigned char> badStubs = ntdll64;
	{
		IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY *pExports = ExportsOf( badStubs );
		const unsigned *punFunctions = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned *>(
		    badStubs.data() + RvaToOffset( badStubs, pExports->AddressOfFunctions ) );
		for ( unsigned i = 0; i < pExports->NumberOfFunctions; ++i )
		{
			const unsigned ibStub = RvaToOffset( badStubs, punFunctions[i] );
			if ( ibStub )
				std::memset( badStubs.data() + ibStub, 0xCC, 8 );
		}
	}
	const std::wstring wstrBadStubs = wstrTemp + L"bad_stubs.bin";
	WriteFileBytes( wstrBadStubs, badStubs );

	DWORD unPidWow64 = 0;
	DWORD unPidNative = 0;
	const HANDLE hWow64 = SpawnSleeper( L"C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\cmd.exe", &unPidWow64 );
	const HANDLE hNative = SpawnSleeper( L"C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe", &unPidNative );
	if ( !hWow64 || !hNative )
		return 8;

	std::vector<Scenario_t> rgScenarios = {
	    { L"bootstrap_directory", EFault::FailSystemDirectory, 1, 0 },
	    { L"healthy", EFault::None, 0, 0 },
	    { L"healthy_wow64", EFault::None, 0, unPidWow64 },
	    { L"healthy_native64", EFault::None, 0, unPidNative },
	    { L"pid4", EFault::None, 0, 4 },
	    { L"pid_bad", EFault::None, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF },
	    { L"system_directory", EFault::FailSystemDirectory, 2, 0 },
	    { L"windows_directory", EFault::FailWindowsDirectory, 2, 0 },
	    { L"directory_open", EFault::FailDirectoryOpen, 0, 0 },
	    { L"ntdll_open", EFault::FailNtdllOpen, 0, 0 },
	    { L"file_info", EFault::FailFileInfo, 0, 0 },
	    { L"first_volume", EFault::FailFirstVolume, 0, 0 },
	    { L"volume_info", EFault::FailVolumeInfo, 0, 0 },
	    { L"mount_points", EFault::FailMountPoints, 0, 0 },
	    { L"image_name", EFault::FailImageName, 0, 0 },
	    { L"size_zero", EFault::WrongFileSize, 0, 0, L"", 0 },
	    { L"size_error", EFault::WrongFileSize, 0, 0, L"", INVALID_FILE_SIZE },
	    { L"size_huge", EFault::WrongFileSize, 0, 0, L"", 0x7FFFFFFF },
	    { L"ntdll32", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, L"C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\ntdll.dll" },
	    { L"file_text", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, wstrText },
	    { L"file_empty", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, wstrEmpty },
	    { L"file_bad_pe", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, wstrBadPe },
	    { L"file_trunc_headers", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, wstrTruncatedHeaders },
	    { L"file_trunc_body", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, wstrTruncatedBody },
	    { L"file_overlay", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, wstrOverlay },
	    { L"file_more_names", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, wstrMoreNames },
	    { L"file_no_functions", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, wstrNoFunctions },
	    { L"file_bad_machine", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, wstrBadMachine },
	    { L"file_bad_optional", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, wstrBadOptional },
	    { L"file_bad_stubs", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, wstrBadStubs },
	    { L"file_no_exports", EFault::RedirectNtdll, 0, 0, argv[0] },
	};
	for ( const unsigned nAt :
	      { 1u, 2u, 3u, 4u, 5u, 6u, 7u, 8u, 10u, 15u, 25u, 50u, 100u, 200u, 400u, 800u, 1600u, 3200u } )
	{
		rgScenarios.push_back( { L"readfile_fail_" + std::to_wstring( nAt ), EFault::FailReadFileNth, nAt, 0 } );
		rgScenarios.push_back( { L"readfile_short_" + std::to_wstring( nAt ), EFault::ShortReadFileNth, nAt, 0 } );
		rgScenarios.push_back( { L"seek_fail_" + std::to_wstring( nAt ), EFault::FailSeekNth, nAt, 0 } );
	}
	for ( unsigned nAt = 1; nAt <= 4; ++nAt )
		rgScenarios.push_back(
		    { L"open_wow64_" + std::to_wstring( nAt ), EFault::FailOpenProcessNth, nAt, unPidWow64 } );
	for ( unsigned nAt = 1; nAt <= 8; ++nAt )
		rgScenarios.push_back(
		    { L"remote_read_" + std::to_wstring( nAt ), EFault::ShortRemoteReadNth, nAt, unPidWow64 } );
	for ( unsigned nAt = 1; nAt <= 8; ++nAt )
		rgScenarios.push_back(
		    { L"wow64_read_" + std::to_wstring( nAt ), EFault::ShortWow64ReadNth, nAt, unPidNative } );

	const unsigned unKey = *reinterpret_cast<const unsigned *>( input.data() + k_ibXorKey );
	int cFailures = 0;
	for ( const Scenario_t &scenario : rgScenarios )
	{
		s_eFault = scenario.m_eFault;
		s_nFaultAt = scenario.m_nFaultAt;
		s_wstrRedirect = scenario.m_wstrRedirect;
		s_cubFakeFileSize = scenario.m_cubFakeFileSize;

		std::vector<unsigned char> caseInput = input;
		std::memcpy( caseInput.data() + k_ibTargetPid, &scenario.m_unPid, 4 );

		const RunResult_t resultBefore = RunWorker( pfnOriginal, caseInput );
		const RunResult_t resultRebuilt = RunWorker( pfnRebuild, caseInput );
		const RunResult_t resultAfter = RunWorker( pfnOriginal, caseInput );
		const std::vector<unsigned char> &before = resultBefore.m_rgubOutput;
		const std::vector<unsigned char> &rebuilt = resultRebuilt.m_rgubOutput;
		const std::vector<unsigned char> &after = resultAfter.m_rgubOutput;

		const bool bCrashed = resultBefore.m_unException || resultRebuilt.m_unException || resultAfter.m_unException;
		bool bOk = before.size() == k_cubWritten && rebuilt.size() == k_cubWritten && after.size() == k_cubWritten &&
		           resultBefore.m_unException == resultRebuilt.m_unException &&
		           resultBefore.m_unException == resultAfter.m_unException;
		unsigned cReal = 0;
		unsigned ibFirst = 0;
		if ( bOk && !bCrashed )
		{
			for ( unsigned ib = 0; ib < k_cubWritten; ++ib )
			{
				if ( before[ib] != rebuilt[ib] && before[ib] == after[ib] )
				{
					const bool bTimes = ib >= k_ibSystemTimeStart && ib < k_ibTimesEnd;
					const bool bHandle = ib >= k_ibTargetHandle && ib < k_ibTargetHandle + 4;
					if ( bTimes || bHandle )
						continue;
					if ( !cReal )
						ibFirst = ib;
					++cReal;
				}
			}

			const auto bTimeBetween = [&]( unsigned ib )
			{
				const unsigned long long ulLow = ReadU64( before, ib, unKey );
				const unsigned long long ulHigh = ReadU64( after, ib, unKey );
				const unsigned long long ulValue = ReadU64( rebuilt, ib, unKey );
				return !ulLow || ( ulLow <= ulValue && ulValue <= ulHigh );
			};
			const auto bTickBetween = [&]( unsigned ib )
			{
				const unsigned unLow = ReadU32( before, ib, unKey );
				const unsigned unHigh = ReadU32( after, ib, unKey );
				const unsigned unValue = ReadU32( rebuilt, ib, unKey );
				return !unLow || ( unLow <= unValue && unValue <= unHigh );
			};
			const bool bTimesOk = bTimeBetween( k_ibSystemTimeStart ) && bTimeBetween( k_ibSystemTimeEnd ) &&
			                      bTimeBetween( k_ibCurrentTime ) && bTickBetween( k_ibTickStart ) &&
			                      bTickBetween( k_ibTickEnd );
			const unsigned hBefore = ReadU32( before, k_ibTargetHandle, unKey );
			const unsigned hRebuilt = ReadU32( rebuilt, k_ibTargetHandle, unKey );
			const bool bHandleOk = ( hBefore != 0 ) == ( hRebuilt != 0 ) && hRebuilt < 0x10000;
			bOk = !cReal && bTimesOk && bHandleOk;
			if ( !bTimesOk || !bHandleOk )
				std::printf( "     times=%d handle=%d\n", bTimesOk, bHandleOk );
		}

		cFailures += !bOk;
		if ( bCrashed )
		{
			std::printf( "%-4s %-22s exception original=0x%08x rebuild=0x%08x\n", bOk ? "ok" : "FAIL",
			             Narrow( scenario.m_wstrName ).c_str(), static_cast<unsigned>( resultBefore.m_unException ),
			             static_cast<unsigned>( resultRebuilt.m_unException ) );
		}
		else
		{
			std::printf( "%-4s %-22s status=%u ntdll=%u cmd=%c real=%u first=0x%x\n", bOk ? "ok" : "FAIL",
			             Narrow( scenario.m_wstrName ).c_str(), ReadU32( rebuilt, k_ibStatus, unKey ),
			             ReadU32( rebuilt, k_ibNtdllStatus, unKey ),
			             ( rebuilt[k_ibCommandLine] ^ static_cast<unsigned char>( unKey ) ) ? 'y' : 'n', cReal,
			             ibFirst );
		}
		std::fflush( stdout );
	}

	TerminateProcess( hWow64, 0 );
	TerminateProcess( hNative, 0 );
	CloseHandle( hWow64 );
	CloseHandle( hNative );
	for ( const std::wstring *pwstrPath :
	      { &wstrText, &wstrEmpty, &wstrBadPe, &wstrTruncatedHeaders, &wstrTruncatedBody, &wstrOverlay, &wstrMoreNames,
	        &wstrNoFunctions, &wstrBadMachine, &wstrBadOptional, &wstrBadStubs } )
		DeleteFileW( pwstrPath->c_str() );

	std::printf( "scenarios=%u failures=%d\n", static_cast<unsigned>( rgScenarios.size() ), cFailures );
	return cFailures ? 1 : 0;
}
```

```cpp
// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 E4 ? 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53
int RunTargetHandles( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	HANDLE hProcess = nullptr;
	u8 *pubHandles = nullptr;

	// @note / sapdragon: incoming capacity is ignored, it always writes the whole report
	memset( &report, 0, k_cubReport );
	*pcubOutput = k_cubReport;
	report.m_unMagic = k_unReportMagic;

	EScanStatus eStatus = EScanStatus::BootstrapFailed;
	if ( bootstrap::BootstrapMain( &input ) )
		eStatus = WatchTargetHandles( input, report, &hProcess, &pubHandles );

	if ( hProcess )
		g_pImports->CloseHandle( hProcess );
	if ( pubHandles )
		g_pImports->VirtualFree( pubHandles, 0, MEM_RELEASE );

	bootstrap::BootstrapTeardown();

	report.m_eStatus = eStatus;
	return 0;
}
```
