```cpp
// @binary: 762110ce
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "process/process.hpp"
#include "util/encoding.hpp"
#include "util/strings.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::target_handles
{

namespace
{

constexpr u32 k_unSystemHandleInformation = 16;
constexpr u32 k_cchImagePath = MAX_PATH + 1;

#pragma pack( push, 1 )
struct HandleEntry32_t
{
	u32 m_unPidAndBackTrace;
	u8 m_unType;
	u8 m_unAttributes;
	u16 m_unHandle;
	i32 m_nObject;
	u32 m_unGrantedAccess;
};
#pragma pack( pop )
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( HandleEntry32_t, 16 );

constinit HandleEntry_t s_ConvertedEntry{};

// @orig: 80 3D ? ? ? ? ? 56
const HandleEntry_t *GetHandleEntry( const u8 *pubHandles, u32 iHandle ) noexcept
{
	if ( g_bUseX64Gate )
		return reinterpret_cast<const HandleEntry_t *>( pubHandles + sizeof( u64 ) +
		                                                iHandle * sizeof( HandleEntry_t ) );

	const auto &entry = reinterpret_cast<const HandleEntry32_t *>( pubHandles + sizeof( u32 ) )[iHandle];
	s_ConvertedEntry.m_unPidAndBackTrace = entry.m_unPidAndBackTrace;
	s_ConvertedEntry.m_unType = entry.m_unType;
	s_ConvertedEntry.m_unAttributes = entry.m_unAttributes;
	s_ConvertedEntry.m_unHandle = entry.m_unHandle;
	s_ConvertedEntry.m_ulObject = static_cast<u64>( static_cast<i64>( entry.m_nObject ) );
	s_ConvertedEntry.m_unGrantedAccess = entry.m_unGrantedAccess;
	return &s_ConvertedEntry;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: inlined
EScanStatus WatchTargetHandles( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, HANDLE *phProcess, u8 **ppubHandles ) noexcept
{
	g_unQuerySsn = input.m_unQuerySsn;
	g_bUseX64Gate = input.m_unUseX64Gate != 0;
	g_unOpenSsn = input.m_unOpenSsn;

	bool bLowAccess = false;
	EScanStatus eStatus = OpenProcessBySyscall( phProcess, PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, input.m_unTargetPid );
	if ( eStatus != EScanStatus::Ok )
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: compares a win32 code against an ntstatus, real access denied is 0xC0000022 and never takes this fallback
		if ( eStatus != static_cast<EScanStatus>( ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED ) )
			return eStatus;
		eStatus = OpenProcessBySyscall( phProcess, PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, input.m_unTargetPid );
		if ( eStatus != EScanStatus::Ok )
			return eStatus;
		bLowAccess = true;
	}

	if ( reinterpret_cast<uptr>( *phProcess ) > 0xFFFF )
		return EScanStatus::BadHandleValue;

	u32 cubHandles = 0x800000;
	*ppubHandles =
	    static_cast<u8 *>( g_pImports->VirtualAlloc( nullptr, cubHandles, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE ) );
	if ( !*ppubHandles )
		return static_cast<EScanStatus>( g_pImports->GetLastError() );

	u64 ulTargetObject = 0;
	u8 unTargetType = 0;
	u32 cHandles = 0;
	EScanStatus ePending = EScanStatus::Ok;
	u32 unQuery = 0;
	bool bFirstPass = true;
	const DWORD unStartTick = g_pImports->GetTickCount();

	for ( u32 iPass = 0; iPass < 10; ++iPass )
	{
		if ( g_pImports->GetTickCount() - unStartTick >= 6000 )
		{
			ePending = EScanStatus::Timeout;
			break;
		}

		do
		{
			if ( static_cast<NTSTATUS>( unQuery ) == STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH )
			{
				if ( *ppubHandles )
					g_pImports->VirtualFree( *ppubHandles, 0, MEM_RELEASE );

				// @note / sapdragon: the pointer stays set here, so the cleanup frees it a second time. valve bug, keep it
				if ( cubHandles > 0x3200000 )
					return EScanStatus::HandleBufferLimit;

				cubHandles *= 2;
				*ppubHandles = static_cast<u8 *>(
				    g_pImports->VirtualAlloc( nullptr, cubHandles, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE ) );
				if ( !*ppubHandles )
					return static_cast<EScanStatus>( g_pImports->GetLastError() );
			}

			if ( !g_unQuerySsn )
				return EScanStatus::NoSyscallNumber;

			if ( g_bUseX64Gate )
			{
				unQuery = NtQuerySystemInformationX64( k_unSystemHandleInformation, PointerToX64( *ppubHandles ),
				                                       cubHandles, 0 );
			}
			else
			{
				unQuery =
				    NtQuerySystemInformationSysenter( k_unSystemHandleInformation, *ppubHandles, cubHandles, nullptr );
			}
		} while ( static_cast<NTSTATUS>( unQuery ) == STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH );

		if ( unQuery )
			return static_cast<EScanStatus>( unQuery );

		cHandles = *reinterpret_cast<const u32 *>( *ppubHandles );

		if ( bFirstPass )
		{
			report.m_cInitialHandles = cHandles;
			// @note / sapdragon: same code for an empty snapshot and for our handle not being in it
			if ( !cHandles )
				return EScanStatus::NoTargetHandle;

			bool bFound = false;
			for ( u32 iHandle = 0; iHandle < cHandles; ++iHandle )
			{
				const HandleEntry_t *pEntry = GetHandleEntry( *ppubHandles, iHandle );
				if ( pEntry->m_unHandle == static_cast<u16>( reinterpret_cast<uptr>( *phProcess ) ) &&
				     pEntry->m_unPidAndBackTrace == g_pImports->GetCurrentProcessId() )
				{
					if ( bFound )
						return EScanStatus::DuplicateHandle;
					bFound = true;
					ulTargetObject = pEntry->m_ulObject;
					unTargetType = pEntry->m_unType;
				}
			}
			if ( !bFound )
				return EScanStatus::NoTargetHandle;
		}

		for ( u32 iHandle = 0; iHandle < cHandles; ++iHandle )
		{
			const HandleEntry_t *pEntry = GetHandleEntry( *ppubHandles, iHandle );
			if ( pEntry->m_ulObject != ulTargetObject || pEntry->m_unType != unTargetType )
				continue;

			const u32 unPid = pEntry->m_unPidAndBackTrace;
			if ( unPid == g_pImports->GetCurrentProcessId() )
				continue;

			u32 iRow = 0;
			while ( iRow < report.m_cRows && ( report.m_rgRows[iRow].m_unPid != unPid ||
			                                   report.m_rgRows[iRow].m_unGrantedAccess != pEntry->m_unGrantedAccess ) )
			{
				++iRow;
			}

			if ( iRow == report.m_cRows )
			{
				if ( report.m_cRows < ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgRows ) )
				{
					report.m_rgRows[report.m_cRows].m_unPid = unPid;
					report.m_rgRows[report.m_cRows].m_unGrantedAccess = pEntry->m_unGrantedAccess;
					++report.m_cRows;
				}
				else
				{
					ePending = EScanStatus::TooManyRows;
				}
			}
		}

		// @note / sapdragon: leaves an empty row after the first pass, later owners go after it
		if ( bFirstPass && report.m_cRows < ARRAYSIZE( report.m_rgRows ) )
			++report.m_cRows;

		++report.m_cPasses;
		bFirstPass = false;
		g_pImports->SwitchToThread();
	}

	for ( u32 iRow = 0; iRow < report.m_cRows; ++iRow )
	{
		OwnerRow_t &row = report.m_rgRows[iRow];
		if ( !row.m_unPid )
			continue;

		if ( *phProcess )
			g_pImports->CloseHandle( *phProcess );

		const EScanStatus eOpen = OpenProcessBySyscall(
		    phProcess, bLowAccess ? PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ : PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION,
		    row.m_unPid );
		if ( eOpen != EScanStatus::Ok )
		{
			row.m_eStatus = eOpen;
		}
		else
		{
			wchar_t wszImage[264];
			char szImage[264];
			memset( wszImage, 0, k_cchImagePath * sizeof( wchar_t ) );
			memset( szImage, 0, k_cchImagePath );

			const DWORD cchImage =
			    bLowAccess ? g_pImports->GetModuleFileNameExW( *phProcess, nullptr, wszImage, k_cchImagePath )
			               : g_pImports->GetProcessImageFileNameW( *phProcess, wszImage, k_cchImagePath );
			util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( g_pImports, wszImage, szImage, k_cchImagePath );

			HANDLE hFile = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
			if ( cchImage )
			{
				const u32 cubImage = util::StrLenA( szImage );
				memcpy( row.m_rgchNameTail,
				        cubImage > sizeof( row.m_rgchNameTail ) ? szImage + cubImage - sizeof( row.m_rgchNameTail )
				                                                : szImage,
				        sizeof( row.m_rgchNameTail ) );

				// @note / sapdragon: turns "\Device\" into "\\.\", so byte 4 on is a path CreateFile takes. only for NT paths
				if ( !bLowAccess )
				{
					szImage[4] = '\\';
					szImage[5] = '\\';
					szImage[6] = '.';
				}

				hFile = g_pImports->CreateFileA( bLowAccess ? szImage : szImage + 4, 0,
				                                 FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nullptr,
				                                 OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr );
			}

			if ( hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
			{
				row.m_eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( g_pImports->GetLastError() );
			}
			else
			{
				BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION information;
				if ( g_pImports->GetFileInformationByHandle( hFile, &information ) )
				{
					row.m_unVolumeSerial = information.dwVolumeSerialNumber;
					row.m_unFileIndexLow = information.nFileIndexLow;
					row.m_unFileIndexHigh = information.nFileIndexHigh;
				}
				else
				{
					row.m_eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( g_pImports->GetLastError() );
				}
				g_pImports->CloseHandle( hFile );
			}
		}

		for ( HandleTotal_t &total : report.m_rgTotals )
		{
			if ( row.m_unPid == total.m_unPid )
				break;
			if ( !total.m_unPid )
			{
				total.m_unPid = row.m_unPid;
				// @note / sapdragon: counts every handle of the type in the last snapshot, not only the ones to our target
				for ( u32 iHandle = 0; iHandle < cHandles; ++iHandle )
				{
					const HandleEntry_t *pEntry = GetHandleEntry( *ppubHandles, iHandle );
					if ( pEntry->m_unPidAndBackTrace == total.m_unPid && pEntry->m_unType == unTargetType )
						++total.m_cHandles;
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	return ePending;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::target_handles
```

```cpp
// @binary: 762110ce
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::target_handles
{

constinit u32 g_unOpenSsn = 0;
constinit u32 g_unQuerySsn = 0;
constinit bool g_bUseX64Gate = false;

namespace
{

#pragma pack( push, 1 )
struct ObjectAttributes64_t
{
	u32 m_cubLength;
	u32 m_unPadding0;
	u64 m_ulRootDirectory;
	u64 m_ulObjectName;
	u32 m_unAttributes;
	u32 m_unPadding1;
	u64 m_ulSecurityDescriptor;
	u64 m_ulSecurityQualityOfService;
};
#pragma pack( pop )
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( ObjectAttributes64_t, 48 );

constinit u32 s_unSavedEbx = 0;
constinit u32 s_unSavedEsi = 0;
constinit u32 s_unSavedEdi = 0;
constinit u32 s_unSavedEbp = 0;
constinit u32 s_unSavedEsp = 0;
constinit u64 s_ulSavedR10 = 0;
constinit u32 s_rgunFarEnter[2] = {};
constinit u32 s_rgunFarLeave[2] = {};

} // namespace

// @note / sapdragon: REX prefixed bytes run after the far jump to selector 0x33, the assembler can't write them in 32-bit mode.
// the x64 args are 4 qwords on the caller's stack, r10 is kept in s_ulSavedR10
#define VAC_X64_SYSCALL_BODY()                                                                                         \
	__asm _emit 0x5F                                                                         /* pop rdi */             \
	    __asm _emit 0x4C __asm _emit 0x89 __asm _emit 0x17                                   /* mov [rdi], r10 */      \
	    __asm _emit 0x48 __asm _emit 0x8B __asm _emit 0x4C __asm _emit 0x24 __asm _emit 0x08 /* mov rcx, [rsp+8] */    \
	    __asm _emit 0x48 __asm _emit 0x8B __asm _emit 0x54 __asm _emit 0x24 __asm _emit 0x10 /* mov rdx, [rsp+10h] */  \
	    __asm _emit 0x4C __asm _emit 0x8B __asm _emit 0x44 __asm _emit 0x24 __asm _emit 0x18 /* mov r8, [rsp+18h] */   \
	    __asm _emit 0x4C __asm _emit 0x8B __asm _emit 0x4C __asm _emit 0x24 __asm _emit 0x20 /* mov r9, [rsp+20h] */   \
	    __asm _emit 0x4C __asm _emit 0x8B __asm _emit 0xD1                                   /* mov r10, rcx */        \
	    __asm _emit 0x0F __asm _emit 0x05                                                    /* syscall */             \
	    __asm _emit 0x4C __asm _emit 0x8B __asm _emit 0x17                                   /* mov r10, [rdi] */      \
	    __asm _emit 0x48 __asm _emit 0x33 __asm _emit 0xC9                                   /* xor rcx, rcx */        \
	    __asm _emit 0x8B __asm _emit 0x0C __asm _emit 0x24                                   /* mov ecx, [rsp] */      \
	    __asm _emit 0xFF __asm _emit 0x29                                                    /* jmp far [rcx] */

// @orig: 762110ce:0x100032E8 (no unique signature)
__declspec( naked ) u32 __cdecl NtQuerySystemInformationX64( u64, u64, u64, u64 )
{
	__asm
	    {
		mov s_unSavedEbx, ebx
		mov s_unSavedEsi, esi
		mov s_unSavedEdi, edi
		mov s_unSavedEbp, ebp
		mov s_unSavedEsp, esp
		lea ecx, s_rgunFarLeave
		mov eax, offset leave_x64
		mov [ecx], eax
		mov dword ptr [ecx + 4], 23h
		push ecx
		lea ecx, s_ulSavedR10
		push 0
		push ecx
		lea ecx, s_rgunFarEnter
		mov eax, offset enter_x64
		mov [ecx], eax
		mov word ptr [ecx + 4], 33h
		mov eax, g_unQuerySsn
		jmp fword ptr [ecx]
	enter_x64:
	    }
	VAC_X64_SYSCALL_BODY()
	__asm
	{
	leave_x64:
		mov ebx, s_unSavedEbx
		mov esi, s_unSavedEsi
		mov edi, s_unSavedEdi
		mov ebp, s_unSavedEbp
		mov esp, s_unSavedEsp
		ret
	}
}

// @orig: 762110ce:0x10003392 (no unique signature)
__declspec( naked ) static void QuerySysenterGate()
{
	__asm
	{
		mov edx, esp
		_emit 0Fh
		_emit 34h
		ret
	}
}

// @orig: 762110ce:0x10003385 (no unique signature)
__declspec( naked ) u32 __cdecl NtQuerySystemInformationSysenter( u32, void *, u32, void * )
{
	__asm
	{
		mov eax, g_unQuerySsn
		mov edx, offset QuerySysenterGate
		call edx
		ret
	}
}

// @orig: 762110ce:0x10003397 (no unique signature)
__declspec( naked ) u32 __cdecl NtOpenProcessX64( u64, u64, u64, u64 )
{
	__asm
	    {
		mov s_unSavedEbx, ebx
		mov s_unSavedEsi, esi
		mov s_unSavedEdi, edi
		mov s_unSavedEbp, ebp
		mov s_unSavedEsp, esp
		lea ecx, s_rgunFarLeave
		mov eax, offset leave_x64
		mov [ecx], eax
		mov dword ptr [ecx + 4], 23h
		push ecx
		lea ecx, s_ulSavedR10
		push 0
		push ecx
		lea ecx, s_rgunFarEnter
		mov eax, offset enter_x64
		mov [ecx], eax
		mov word ptr [ecx + 4], 33h
		mov eax, g_unOpenSsn
		jmp fword ptr [ecx]
	enter_x64:
	    }
	VAC_X64_SYSCALL_BODY()
	__asm
	{
	leave_x64:
		mov ebx, s_unSavedEbx
		mov esi, s_unSavedEsi
		mov edi, s_unSavedEdi
		mov ebp, s_unSavedEbp
		mov esp, s_unSavedEsp
		ret
	}
}

// @orig: 762110ce:0x10003441 (no unique signature)
__declspec( naked ) static void OpenSysenterGate()
{
	__asm
	{
		mov edx, esp
		_emit 0Fh
		_emit 34h
		ret
	}
}

// @orig: 762110ce:0x10003434 (no unique signature)
__declspec( naked ) u32 __cdecl NtOpenProcessSysenter( HANDLE *, u32, void *, void * )
{
	__asm
	{
		mov eax, g_unOpenSsn
		mov edx, offset OpenSysenterGate
		call edx
		ret
	}
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 83 3D
EScanStatus OpenProcessBySyscall( HANDLE *phProcess, u32 unAccess, u32 unPid ) noexcept
{
	if ( !g_unOpenSsn )
		return EScanStatus::NoSyscallNumber;

	if ( g_bUseX64Gate )
	{
		ObjectAttributes64_t attributes;
		memset( &attributes, 0, sizeof( attributes ) );
		attributes.m_cubLength = sizeof( attributes );

		u32 rgunClientId[4];
		memset( rgunClientId, 0, sizeof( rgunClientId ) );
		rgunClientId[0] = unPid;

		// @note / sapdragon: not cleared and written back on failure too, so a failed open leaves stack garbage in the handle
		// and the callers close it. valve bug, keep it
		u64 ulHandle;
		const EScanStatus eStatus = static_cast<EScanStatus>( NtOpenProcessX64(
		    PointerToX64( &ulHandle ), unAccess, PointerToX64( &attributes ), PointerToX64( rgunClientId ) ) );
		*phProcess = reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( static_cast<uptr>( ulHandle ) );
		return eStatus;
	}

	OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES attributes;
	memset( &attributes, 0, sizeof( attributes ) );
	attributes.Length = sizeof( attributes );

	u32 rgunClientId[2];
	memset( rgunClientId, 0, sizeof( rgunClientId ) );
	rgunClientId[0] = unPid;
	return static_cast<EScanStatus>( NtOpenProcessSysenter( phProcess, unAccess, &attributes, rgunClientId ) );
}
```

`modules/target_handles/tests/parity.cpp`:

```cpp
// Compares target_handles with the original worker.
//
//     target_handles_parity.exe <original module.dll>
//     target_handles_parity.exe <original module.dll> --live
//     target_handles_parity.exe <original module.dll> --no-syscall-dll <rebuild.dll> <input_plain.bin>
//
// Default: both sides run on fake imports with their NT calls patched out. Compared per case: all report bytes, return
// value, output size and the ordered list of import calls.
//
// --live calls only the transports, in both DLLs, on syscall numbers read from this machine's ntdll.
//
// --no-syscall-dll runs both final DLLs with their real bootstrap. Only the key bytes of the input are used. Every syscall
// number is forced to zero first, and the worker returns 44 for a zero number before it reaches a syscall.

#include "../internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"

#include <windows.h>

#include <array>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace vac
{

namespace
{

constinit SystemImports_t s_Imports{};
constinit ModuleSession_t s_Session{};

} // namespace

constinit SystemImports_t *const g_pImports = &s_Imports;
constinit ModuleSession_t *const g_pSession = &s_Session;
constinit u32 g_unIntegrityHash = 0;
constinit Module_t *g_pModuleListHead = nullptr;

} // namespace vac

static_assert( offsetof( SystemImports_t, GetCurrentProcessId ) == 432, "original import layout" );
static_assert( offsetof( SystemImports_t, CreateFileA ) == 672, "original import layout" );

namespace
{

constexpr u32 k_rvaWorker = 0x2C31;
constexpr u32 k_rvaBootstrap = 0x4CEC;
constexpr u32 k_rvaOpen = 0x3446;
constexpr u32 k_rvaQueryX64 = 0x32E8;
constexpr u32 k_rvaQuerySysenter = 0x3385;
constexpr u32 k_rvaImportTable = 0x7D38;
constexpr u32 k_rvaImportsPointer = 0x6008;
constexpr u32 k_rvaLoadedLibraries = 0x7CB0;
constexpr u32 k_rvaOpenSsn = 0x7788;
constexpr u32 k_rvaQuerySsn = 0x778C;
constexpr u32 k_rvaUseX64Gate = 0x7790;

constexpr u32 k_unSelfPid = 0x12345678;
constexpr u64 k_ulObject = 0xFFFFFFFF89ABCDEF;

using PfnWorker_t = int( __cdecl * )( const void *, void *, u32 * );

struct Scenario_t
{
	std::vector<std::vector<HandleEntry_t>> m_rgSnapshots;
	std::vector<u32> m_rgunQueryStatuses;
	u32 m_unInitialStatus = 0;
	u32 m_unSecondStatus = 0;
	u32 m_unDetailStatus = 0;
	u32 m_unHandle = 0x44;
	u32 m_unTickStep = 0;
	u32 m_iFailAllocation = 0;
	bool m_bBootFails = false;
	bool m_bNoPath = false;
	bool m_bNoFile = false;
	bool m_bNoFileInfo = false;
	std::wstring m_wszPath = L"\\Device\\HarddiskVolume7\\fixture.exe";
};

Scenario_t s_Scenario;
Input_t s_Input{};
u32 s_cQueries;
u32 s_cOpens;
u32 s_cTicks;
u32 s_cAllocations;
SystemImports_t s_Apis{};
u8 *s_pubOriginal;
u32 s_cCases;
u32 s_cFailures;
std::string s_szTrace;

void Trace( const char *pszFormat, ... )
{
	char szLine[300];
	va_list args;
	va_start( args, pszFormat );
	vsnprintf( szLine, sizeof( szLine ), pszFormat, args );
	va_end( args );
	s_szTrace += szLine;
	s_szTrace += '\n';
}

LONG CALLBACK LogException( PEXCEPTION_POINTERS pException )
{
	std::printf( "exception %08lx at %p (original+%x) bad address %p queries=%u\n",
	             pException->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode, pException->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionAddress,
	             static_cast<u32>( static_cast<u8 *>( pException->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionAddress ) - s_pubOriginal ),
	             reinterpret_cast<void *>( pException->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionInformation[1] ), s_cQueries );
	std::fflush( stdout );
	return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

void ResetCounters()
{
	s_cQueries = s_cOpens = s_cTicks = s_cAllocations = 0;
	s_szTrace.clear();
}

HandleEntry_t MakeHandle( u32 unPid, u16 unHandle = 0x70, u32 unAccess = 0x1000, u64 ulObject = k_ulObject,
                          u8 unType = 7 )
{
	return { unPid, unType, 0, unHandle, ulObject, unAccess, 0 };
}

DWORD WINAPI FakeCurrentPid()
{
	Trace( "GetCurrentProcessId" );
	return k_unSelfPid;
}

DWORD WINAPI FakeLastError()
{
	Trace( "GetLastError" );
	return 77;
}

DWORD WINAPI FakeTick()
{
	Trace( "GetTickCount" );
	return s_cTicks++ * s_Scenario.m_unTickStep;
}

BOOL WINAPI FakeYield()
{
	Trace( "SwitchToThread" );
	return TRUE;
}

BOOL WINAPI FakeClose( HANDLE hObject )
{
	Trace( "CloseHandle %p", hObject );
	return TRUE;
}

LPVOID WINAPI FakeAllocate( LPVOID pAddress, SIZE_T cub, DWORD unType, DWORD unProtect )
{
	Trace( "VirtualAlloc %p %x %x %x", pAddress, static_cast<u32>( cub ), unType, unProtect );
	++s_cAllocations;
	if ( s_Scenario.m_iFailAllocation && s_cAllocations == s_Scenario.m_iFailAllocation )
		return nullptr;
	return VirtualAlloc( nullptr, 65536, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE );
}

BOOL WINAPI FakeRelease( LPVOID pAddress, SIZE_T cub, DWORD unType )
{
	Trace( "VirtualFree %x %x", static_cast<u32>( cub ), unType );
	return VirtualFree( pAddress, 0, MEM_RELEASE );
}

u32 __cdecl FakeOpen( HANDLE *phProcess, u32 unAccess, u32 unPid )
{
	Trace( "NtOpenProcess %x %u", unAccess, unPid );
	++s_cOpens;
	u32 unStatus;
	if ( s_cOpens == 1 )
		unStatus = s_Scenario.m_unInitialStatus;
	else if ( s_cOpens == 2 && s_Scenario.m_unInitialStatus == 5 && unAccess == 0x400 )
		unStatus = s_Scenario.m_unSecondStatus;
	else
		unStatus = s_Scenario.m_unDetailStatus;
	if ( !unStatus )
		*phProcess = reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( static_cast<uptr>( s_Scenario.m_unHandle ) );
	return unStatus;
}

u32 FakeQuery( void *pBuffer, u32 cubBuffer )
{
	Trace( "NtQuerySystemInformation %x", cubBuffer );
	const u32 iQuery = s_cQueries++;
	const u32 unStatus = iQuery < s_Scenario.m_rgunQueryStatuses.size() ? s_Scenario.m_rgunQueryStatuses[iQuery] : 0;
	if ( unStatus )
		return unStatus;

	const auto &rgRows =
	    s_Scenario
	        .m_rgSnapshots[iQuery < s_Scenario.m_rgSnapshots.size() ? iQuery : s_Scenario.m_rgSnapshots.size() - 1];
	auto *pubBuffer = static_cast<u8 *>( pBuffer );
	std::memset( pubBuffer, 0, 65536 );
	*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubBuffer ) = static_cast<u32>( rgRows.size() );
	for ( u32 iRow = 0; iRow < rgRows.size(); ++iRow )
	{
		const HandleEntry_t &row = rgRows[iRow];
		if ( s_Input.m_unUseX64Gate )
		{
			std::memcpy( pubBuffer + 8 + iRow * 24, &row, 24 );
		}
		else
		{
			u8 *pubEntry = pubBuffer + 4 + iRow * 16;
			std::memcpy( pubEntry, &row, 8 );
			*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubEntry + 8 ) = static_cast<u32>( row.m_ulObject );
			*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubEntry + 12 ) = row.m_unGrantedAccess;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

DWORD WINAPI FakeImageName( HANDLE hProcess, LPWSTR pwszOut, DWORD cchOut )
{
	Trace( "GetProcessImageFileNameW %p %u", hProcess, cchOut );
	if ( s_Scenario.m_bNoPath )
		return 0;
	std::wcsncpy( pwszOut, s_Scenario.m_wszPath.c_str(), cchOut - 1 );
	pwszOut[cchOut - 1] = 0;
	return static_cast<DWORD>( std::wcslen( pwszOut ) );
}

DWORD WINAPI FakeModuleName( HANDLE hProcess, HMODULE hModule, LPWSTR pwszOut, DWORD cchOut )
{
	Trace( "GetModuleFileNameExW %p %p %u", hProcess, hModule, cchOut );
	if ( s_Scenario.m_bNoPath )
		return 0;
	std::wcsncpy( pwszOut, s_Scenario.m_wszPath.c_str(), cchOut - 1 );
	pwszOut[cchOut - 1] = 0;
	return static_cast<DWORD>( std::wcslen( pwszOut ) );
}

HANDLE WINAPI FakeCreateFile( LPCSTR pszPath, DWORD unAccess, DWORD unShare, LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES pSecurity,
                              DWORD unCreation, DWORD unAttributes, HANDLE hTemplate )
{
	Trace( "CreateFileA '%s' %x %x %p %x %x %p", pszPath, unAccess, unShare, pSecurity, unCreation, unAttributes,
	       hTemplate );
	return s_Scenario.m_bNoFile ? INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE : reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>( 0x99 );
}

BOOL WINAPI FakeFileInfo( HANDLE hFile, LPBY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION pInformation )
{
	Trace( "GetFileInformationByHandle %p", hFile );
	if ( s_Scenario.m_bNoFileInfo )
		return FALSE;
	std::memset( pInformation, 0, sizeof( *pInformation ) );
	pInformation->dwVolumeSerialNumber = 0x13572468;
	pInformation->nFileIndexLow = 0x24681357;
	pInformation->nFileIndexHigh = 0x89ABCDEF;
	return TRUE;
}

// The original passes ECX and EDX plus one caller cleaned stack argument. MSVC's __fastcall would pop it in the callee.
__declspec( naked ) u32 OriginalOpenThunk()
{
	__asm
	{
		push dword ptr [esp+4]
		push edx
		push ecx
		call FakeOpen
		add esp, 12
		ret
	}
}

u32 __cdecl FakeQueryX64( u64, u64 ulBuffer, u64 ulCubBuffer, u64 )
{
	return FakeQuery( reinterpret_cast<void *>( static_cast<uptr>( ulBuffer ) ), static_cast<u32>( ulCubBuffer ) );
}

u32 __cdecl FakeQuerySysenter( u32, void *pBuffer, u32 cubBuffer, void * )
{
	return FakeQuery( pBuffer, cubBuffer );
}

bool __fastcall FakeOriginalBootstrap( void * )
{
	Trace( "BootstrapMain" );
	if ( s_Scenario.m_bBootFails )
		return false;
	std::memcpy( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaImportTable, &s_Apis, sizeof( s_Apis ) );
	*reinterpret_cast<const SystemImports_t **>( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaImportsPointer ) = &s_Apis;
	*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaLoadedLibraries ) = 0;
	return true;
}

void Patch( void *pWhere, const void *pfnTarget )
{
	DWORD unOld;
	VirtualProtect( pWhere, 5, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, &unOld );
	auto *pubCode = static_cast<u8 *>( pWhere );
	pubCode[0] = 0xE9;
	*reinterpret_cast<i32 *>( pubCode + 1 ) = static_cast<i32>( static_cast<const u8 *>( pfnTarget ) - pubCode - 5 );
	FlushInstructionCache( GetCurrentProcess(), pWhere, 5 );
	VirtualProtect( pWhere, 5, unOld, &unOld );
}

u32 CallOriginalOpen( HANDLE *phProcess, u32 unAccess, u32 unPid )
{
	void *pfnOpen = s_pubOriginal + k_rvaOpen;
	u32 unResult;
	__asm
	{
		mov ecx, phProcess
		mov edx, unAccess
		push unPid
		call pfnOpen
		add esp, 4
		mov unResult, eax
	}
	return unResult;
}

u32 SyscallNumber( const std::vector<u8> &rgubNtdll, const char *pszFunction )
{
	const auto *pDos = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( rgubNtdll.data() );
	const auto *pNt = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 *>( rgubNtdll.data() + pDos->e_lfanew );
	const auto *pSections = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION( pNt );
	const auto RvaToOffset = [&]( u32 unRva ) -> u32
	{
		for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < pNt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
		{
			if ( unRva >= pSections[iSection].VirtualAddress &&
			     unRva - pSections[iSection].VirtualAddress < pSections[iSection].SizeOfRawData )
				return pSections[iSection].PointerToRawData + unRva - pSections[iSection].VirtualAddress;
		}
		return unRva;
	};

	const auto &exportDir = pNt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT];
	const auto *pExports =
	    reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY *>( rgubNtdll.data() + RvaToOffset( exportDir.VirtualAddress ) );
	const auto *punNames = reinterpret_cast<const u32 *>( rgubNtdll.data() + RvaToOffset( pExports->AddressOfNames ) );
	const auto *punOrdinals =
	    reinterpret_cast<const u16 *>( rgubNtdll.data() + RvaToOffset( pExports->AddressOfNameOrdinals ) );
	const auto *punFunctions =
	    reinterpret_cast<const u32 *>( rgubNtdll.data() + RvaToOffset( pExports->AddressOfFunctions ) );
	for ( u32 iName = 0; iName < pExports->NumberOfNames; ++iName )
	{
		if ( !std::strcmp( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( rgubNtdll.data() + RvaToOffset( punNames[iName] ) ),
		                   pszFunction ) )
		{
			const u8 *pubStub = rgubNtdll.data() + RvaToOffset( punFunctions[punOrdinals[iName]] );
			if ( pubStub[0] == 0x4C && pubStub[1] == 0x8B && pubStub[2] == 0xD1 && pubStub[3] == 0xB8 )
				return *reinterpret_cast<const u32 *>( pubStub + 4 );
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

int RunLive()
{
	std::ifstream file( "C:\\Windows\\Sysnative\\ntdll.dll", std::ios::binary );
	const std::vector<u8> rgubNtdll( ( std::istreambuf_iterator<char>( file ) ), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>() );
	if ( rgubNtdll.empty() )
		return 7;

	const u32 unOpenSsn = SyscallNumber( rgubNtdll, "NtOpenProcess" );
	const u32 unQuerySsn = SyscallNumber( rgubNtdll, "NtQuerySystemInformation" );
	if ( !unOpenSsn || !unQuerySsn )
		return 8;
	std::printf( "LIVE SSNs open=%u query=%u\n", unOpenSsn, unQuerySsn );
	std::fflush( stdout );

	*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaOpenSsn ) = unOpenSsn;
	*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaQuerySsn ) = unQuerySsn;
	*reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaUseX64Gate ) = 1;
	g_unOpenSsn = unOpenSsn;
	g_unQuerySsn = unQuerySsn;
	g_bUseX64Gate = true;

	u32 cFailed = 0;
	u32 cChecks = 0;
	for ( const u32 unPid : { 0u, 0xFFFFFFFCu, static_cast<u32>( GetCurrentProcessId() ) } )
	{
		HANDLE hOriginal = nullptr;
		HANDLE hRebuild = nullptr;
		const u32 unOriginal = CallOriginalOpen( &hOriginal, 0x1000, unPid );
		const u32 unRebuild = static_cast<u32>( OpenProcessBySyscall( &hRebuild, 0x1000, unPid ) );
		const bool bEqual = unOriginal == unRebuild && ( unOriginal != 0 || ( hOriginal && hRebuild ) );
		std::printf( "LIVE open pid=%u status=%08x/%08x %s\n", unPid, unOriginal, unRebuild, bEqual ? "OK" : "DIFF" );
		std::fflush( stdout );
		++cChecks;
		cFailed += !bEqual;
		if ( !unOriginal && hOriginal )
			CloseHandle( hOriginal );
		if ( !unRebuild && hRebuild )
			CloseHandle( hRebuild );
	}

	using PfnQueryX64_t = u32( __cdecl * )( u64, u64, u64, u64 );
	const auto pfnOriginalQuery = reinterpret_cast<PfnQueryX64_t>( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaQueryX64 );
	for ( const u32 cubBuffer : { 16u, 0x800000u } )
	{
		auto *pubOriginal =
		    static_cast<u8 *>( VirtualAlloc( nullptr, cubBuffer, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE ) );
		auto *pubRebuild =
		    static_cast<u8 *>( VirtualAlloc( nullptr, cubBuffer, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE ) );
		const u32 unOriginal = pfnOriginalQuery( 16, reinterpret_cast<uptr>( pubOriginal ), cubBuffer, 0 );
		const u32 unRebuild = NtQuerySystemInformationX64( 16, PointerToX64( pubRebuild ), cubBuffer, 0 );
		const bool bEqual = unOriginal == unRebuild && ( unOriginal || ( *reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubOriginal ) > 0 &&
		                                                                 *reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubRebuild ) > 0 ) );
		std::printf( "LIVE query size=%u status=%08x/%08x %s\n", cubBuffer, unOriginal, unRebuild,
		             bEqual ? "OK" : "DIFF" );
		std::fflush( stdout );
		++cChecks;
		cFailed += !bEqual;
		VirtualFree( pubOriginal, 0, MEM_RELEASE );
		VirtualFree( pubRebuild, 0, MEM_RELEASE );
	}

	std::printf( "LIVE RESULT %u checks, %u failures\n", cChecks, cFailed );
	return cFailed ? 1 : 0;
}

PfnWorker_t FindWorker( HMODULE hModule )
{
	auto *pubBase = reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( hModule );
	const auto *pNt =
	    reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_NT_HEADERS *>( pubBase + reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( pubBase )->e_lfanew );
	const auto *pSections = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION( pNt );
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < pNt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		if ( pSections[iSection].Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE )
			continue;
		for ( u32 ib = 0; ib + 48 <= pSections[iSection].Misc.VirtualSize; ib += 4 )
		{
			u8 *pubNode = pubBase + pSections[iSection].VirtualAddress + ib;
			if ( *reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubNode + 4 ) == k_unModuleId &&
			     *reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pubNode + 8 ) == 1 )
			{
				const auto pfnWorker = *reinterpret_cast<PfnWorker_t *>( pubNode + 12 );
				const auto *pubWorker = reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( pfnWorker );
				if ( pubWorker >= pubBase && pubWorker < pubBase + pNt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage )
					return pfnWorker;
			}
		}
	}
	return nullptr;
}

// Both final DLLs with the real bootstrap. All syscall numbers are zero, so the first open returns 44 without any syscall.
int RunNoSyscallDll( const char *pszRebuild, const char *pszSeed )
{
	const HMODULE hRebuild = LoadLibraryA( pszRebuild );
	if ( !hRebuild )
		return 4;
	const PfnWorker_t pfnRebuild = FindWorker( hRebuild );
	if ( !pfnRebuild )
		return 5;
	const auto pfnOriginal = reinterpret_cast<PfnWorker_t>( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaWorker );

	Input_t input{};
	std::ifstream seed( pszSeed, std::ios::binary );
	seed.read( reinterpret_cast<char *>( &input ), sizeof( input ) );
	if ( !seed )
		return 6;
	input.m_unTargetPid = 0;
	input.m_unQuerySsn = 0;
	input.m_unOpenSsn = 0;

	u32 cFailed = 0;
	u32 cChecks = 0;
	for ( const u32 unUseGate : { 0u, 1u, 0u, 1u } )
	{
		input.m_unUseX64Gate = unUseGate;
		for ( const u32 cubCapacity : { 0u, 4096u } )
		{
			std::array<u8, 4096> rgubOriginal;
			std::array<u8, 4096> rgubRebuild;
			rgubOriginal.fill( 0xCD );
			rgubRebuild.fill( 0xCD );
			u32 cubOriginal = cubCapacity;
			u32 cubRebuild = cubCapacity;
			const int nOriginal = pfnOriginal( &input, rgubOriginal.data(), &cubOriginal );
			const int nRebuild = pfnRebuild( &input, rgubRebuild.data(), &cubRebuild );
			const EScanStatus eStatus = reinterpret_cast<const Report_t *>( rgubOriginal.data() )->m_eStatus;
			const bool bEqual = nOriginal == nRebuild && cubOriginal == cubRebuild && rgubOriginal == rgubRebuild &&
			                    eStatus == EScanStatus::NoSyscallNumber;
			std::printf( "DLL gate=%u cap=%u ret=%d/%d size=%u/%u status=%u %s\n", unUseGate, cubCapacity, nOriginal,
			             nRebuild, cubOriginal, cubRebuild, static_cast<u32>( eStatus ), bEqual ? "OK" : "DIFF" );
			++cChecks;
			cFailed += !bEqual;
		}
	}
	std::printf( "DLL RESULT %u checks, %u failures\n", cChecks, cFailed );
	return cFailed ? 1 : 0;
}

void Run( const std::string &szName, bool bWide, Scenario_t scenario, u32 unTargetPid = 4321 )
{
	s_Scenario = std::move( scenario );
	s_Input = {};
	s_Input.m_unTargetPid = unTargetPid;
	s_Input.m_unUseX64Gate = bWide;
	s_Input.m_unQuerySsn = 54;
	s_Input.m_unOpenSsn = 38;
	if ( szName.find( "missing_query" ) != std::string::npos )
		s_Input.m_unQuerySsn = 0;
	if ( s_Scenario.m_rgSnapshots.empty() )
		s_Scenario.m_rgSnapshots = { { MakeHandle( k_unSelfPid, 0x44 ) } };

	static std::array<u8, 4096> s_rgubExpected;
	static std::array<u8, 4096> s_rgubActual;
	s_rgubExpected.fill( 0xCD );
	s_rgubActual.fill( 0xCD );

	u32 cubExpected = 0;
	ResetCounters();
	const int nExpected =
	    reinterpret_cast<PfnWorker_t>( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaWorker )( &s_Input, s_rgubExpected.data(), &cubExpected );
	const std::string szExpectedTrace = s_szTrace;

	u32 cubActual = 0;
	ResetCounters();
	const int nActual = RunTargetHandles( s_Input, *reinterpret_cast<Report_t *>( s_rgubActual.data() ), &cubActual );

	const bool bEqual = nExpected == nActual && cubExpected == cubActual && cubExpected == 4096 &&
	                    s_rgubExpected == s_rgubActual && szExpectedTrace == s_szTrace;
	++s_cCases;
	if ( bEqual )
	{
		std::printf( "OK %s_%d\n", szName.c_str(), bWide );
	}
	else
	{
		++s_cFailures;
		std::printf( "DIFF %s_%d ret=%d/%d size=%u/%u\n", szName.c_str(), bWide, nExpected, nActual, cubExpected,
		             cubActual );
		u32 cShown = 0;
		for ( u32 ib = 0; ib < 4096 && cShown < 12; ++ib )
		{
			if ( s_rgubExpected[ib] != s_rgubActual[ib] )
			{
				std::printf( " +%x %02x/%02x\n", ib, s_rgubExpected[ib], s_rgubActual[ib] );
				++cShown;
			}
		}
		if ( szExpectedTrace != s_szTrace )
		{
			size_t ib = 0;
			while ( ib < szExpectedTrace.size() && ib < s_szTrace.size() && szExpectedTrace[ib] == s_szTrace[ib] )
				++ib;
			const size_t ibStart = ib > 60 ? ib - 60 : 0;
			std::printf( " trace at %u\n  original: %.160s\n  rebuild:  %.160s\n", static_cast<u32>( ib ),
			             szExpectedTrace.c_str() + ibStart, s_szTrace.c_str() + ibStart );
		}
	}
	std::fflush( stdout );
}

void RunScenarios()
{
	for ( const bool bWide : { false, true } )
	{
		Run( "no_owners", bWide, {} );

		Scenario_t base;
		base.m_rgSnapshots = { { MakeHandle( k_unSelfPid, 0x44 ), MakeHandle( 100 ), MakeHandle( 100, 0x74, 0x410 ),
		                         MakeHandle( 200 ), MakeHandle( 200 ), MakeHandle( 300, 1, 1, k_ulObject, 8 ),
		                         MakeHandle( 400, 1, 1, k_ulObject + 1 ) } };
		Run( "dedup_rights_type_object", bWide, base );

		Scenario_t scenario = base;
		scenario.m_bBootFails = true;
		Run( "bootstrap_fails", bWide, scenario );

		scenario = base;
		scenario.m_unInitialStatus = 0xC0000022;
		Run( "open_denied", bWide, scenario );

		scenario = base;
		scenario.m_unInitialStatus = 5;
		Run( "fallback_access", bWide, scenario );

		scenario.m_bNoPath = true;
		Run( "fallback_access_no_path", bWide, scenario );

		scenario = base;
		scenario.m_unInitialStatus = 5;
		scenario.m_bNoFile = true;
		Run( "fallback_access_no_file", bWide, scenario );

		scenario = base;
		scenario.m_unInitialStatus = 5;
		scenario.m_unSecondStatus = 0xC000000B;
		Run( "fallback_failed", bWide, scenario );

		scenario = base;
		scenario.m_unHandle = 0x10000;
		Run( "handle_too_large", bWide, scenario );

namespace vac::bootstrap
{

bool BootstrapMain( const void * ) noexcept
{
	Trace( "BootstrapMain" );
	if ( s_Scenario.m_bBootFails )
		return false;
	*g_pImports = s_Apis;
	return true;
}

void BootstrapTeardown() noexcept
{
	std::memset( g_pImports, 0, sizeof( *g_pImports ) );
}

} // namespace vac::bootstrap

int main( int argc, char **argv )
{
	setvbuf( stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0 );
	AddVectoredExceptionHandler( 1, LogException );
	if ( argc < 2 )
		return 2;

	s_pubOriginal = reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( LoadLibraryA( argv[1] ) );
	if ( !s_pubOriginal )
		return 3;

	if ( argc == 3 && !std::strcmp( argv[2], "--live" ) )
		return RunLive();
	if ( argc == 5 && !std::strcmp( argv[2], "--no-syscall-dll" ) )
		return RunNoSyscallDll( argv[3], argv[4] );
	if ( argc != 2 )
		return 2;

	Patch( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaBootstrap, FakeOriginalBootstrap );
	Patch( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaOpen, OriginalOpenThunk );
	Patch( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaQueryX64, FakeQueryX64 );
	Patch( s_pubOriginal + k_rvaQuerySysenter, FakeQuerySysenter );

	// The rebuild has plain cdecl for these, so the same fakes go straight in. No real syscall can run in this mode.
	Patch( reinterpret_cast<void *>( &OpenProcessBySyscall ), FakeOpen );
	Patch( reinterpret_cast<void *>( &NtQuerySystemInformationX64 ), FakeQueryX64 );
	Patch( reinterpret_cast<void *>( &NtQuerySystemInformationSysenter ), FakeQuerySysenter );

	s_Apis.GetCurrentProcessId = FakeCurrentPid;
	s_Apis.GetLastError = FakeLastError;
	s_Apis.GetTickCount = FakeTick;
	s_Apis.SwitchToThread = FakeYield;
	s_Apis.CloseHandle = FakeClose;
	s_Apis.VirtualAlloc = FakeAllocate;
	s_Apis.VirtualFree = FakeRelease;
	s_Apis.GetProcessImageFileNameW = FakeImageName;
	s_Apis.GetModuleFileNameExW = FakeModuleName;
	s_Apis.WideCharToMultiByte = WideCharToMultiByte;
	s_Apis.CreateFileA = FakeCreateFile;
	s_Apis.GetFileInformationByHandle = FakeFileInfo;

	RunScenarios();

	std::printf( "RESULT %u cases, %u failures\n", s_cCases, s_cFailures );
	return s_cFailures ? 1 : 0;
}
```

```cpp
// @binary: de9615cb
#include "internal/types.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/blob.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "nt/nt.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::timing_check
{

namespace
{

// @note / sapdragon: Valve patches this in place and calls it, so .data has to be executable (see the vcxproj)
constinit Stub_t s_Stub = { 0xB8, 0x99999999, 0xC3 };

using PfnStub_t = u32( __cdecl * )();

// @orig: inlined
u32 SampleTickCount() noexcept
{
	const volatile nt::KUserSharedData_t &shared = nt::GetKUserSharedData();

	u32 unLow;
	i32 nHigh1;
	i32 nHigh2;
	do
	{
		nHigh1 = shared.m_TickCount.m_nHigh1Time;
		unLow = shared.m_TickCount.m_unLowPart;
		nHigh2 = shared.m_TickCount.m_nHigh2Time;
	} while ( nHigh1 != nHigh2 );

	u32 unTicks;
	if ( ( unLow | static_cast<u32>( nHigh2 ) ) != 0 )
		unTicks = shared.m_unTickCountMultiplier * ( static_cast<u32>( nHigh1 ) << 8 ) +
		          static_cast<u32>( ( static_cast<u64>( unLow ) * shared.m_unTickCountMultiplier ) >> 24 );
	else
		unTicks = static_cast<u32>(
		    ( static_cast<u64>( shared.m_unTickCountLowDeprecated ) * shared.m_unTickCountMultiplier ) >> 24 );

	return ( ( unTicks >> 7 ) + 0xFF ) & 0x03FFFF00;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 53
int RunTimingCheck( const Input_t &input, Report_t &report, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	memset( &report, 0, sizeof( Report_t ) );
	*pcubOutput = sizeof( Report_t );
	report.m_unMagic = k_unReportMagic;

	report.m_unTimingCheck ^= SampleTickCount();
	report.m_unBeingDebugged = NtCurrentTeb()->ProcessEnvironmentBlock->BeingDebugged;

	s_Stub.m_unImmediate = input.m_unStubValue;
	report.m_unTimingCheck ^= reinterpret_cast<PfnStub_t>( &s_Stub )();
	report.m_unTimingCheck ^= SampleTickCount();
	return 0;
}

} // namespace vac::workers::timing_check

#include "internal/module_data.inl"

VAC_WORKER( vac::workers::timing_check::RunTimingCheck, vac::workers::timing_check::k_unModuleId, 1, 0x32, 0xAA, 0x46,
            0x8A, 0x3F, 0xDF, 0xEF, 0xE6, 0x75, 0x22, 0xA4, 0x14, 0x6F, 0x9A, 0xF4, 0x61, 0x11, 0x25, 0x98, 0xD9, 0x33,
            0x71, 0x28, 0xC7, 0xEB, 0xAA, 0x63, 0x06, 0x9B, 0x4D, 0x87, 0xD0 );
```

`modules/timing_check/internal/types.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "bootstrap/imports.hpp"
#include "core/layout.hpp"
#include "core/packets.hpp"

namespace vac::workers::timing_check
{

inline constexpr u32 k_unModuleId = 0x0D8C40E1;
inline constexpr u32 k_unReportMagic = 0x34E663C0;

#pragma pack( push, 1 )
struct Input_t
{
	u8 m_rgubUnused0[0x64];
	u32 m_unStubValue;
	u8 m_rgubUnused1[0x38];
};

struct Report_t
{
	u8 m_rgubDispatcher[16];
	u32 m_unMagic;
	u32 m_unTimingCheck;
	u32 m_unBeingDebugged;
	u32 m_unReserved1C;
};

// mov eax, imm32; ret
struct Stub_t
{
	u8 m_ubMovEax;
	u32 m_unImmediate;
	u8 m_ubRet;
};
#pragma pack( pop )
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( Input_t, k_cubEncryptedConfig );
VAC_LAYOUT( Input_t, m_unStubValue, 0x64 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_unMagic, 0x10 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_unTimingCheck, 0x14 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Report_t, m_unBeingDebugged, 0x18 );
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( Report_t, 0x20 );
VAC_LAYOUT( Stub_t, m_unImmediate, 1 );
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( Stub_t, 6 );

} // namespace vac::workers::timing_check
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "bootstrap/imports.hpp"
#include "core/types.hpp"
#include "crypto/ice/ice.hpp"

// @note / sapdragon: valve encrypts this with the first 8 input bytes, so the key differs per build. same text

namespace vac::bootstrap
{

struct ImportEntry_t
{
	u32 m_ibLibrary;
	u32 m_ibFunction;

{
	u8 m_rgub[0xFC0];

namespace detail
{

struct ImportName_t
{
	const char *m_szLibrary;
	const char *m_szFunction;
};

inline constexpr ImportName_t k_rgImportNames[] = {
#define VAC_IMPORT( szLibrary, ReturnType, Name, Args ) { szLibrary, #Name },
#include "bootstrap/imports.inl"
#undef VAC_IMPORT
};
static_assert( ARRAYSIZE( k_rgImportNames ) == 172 );

} // namespace detail

struct BlobImage_t
{
	BootstrapBlob_t m_Blob;
	ImportEntry_t m_rgEntries[ARRAYSIZE( detail::k_rgImportNames ) + 1];
};

namespace detail
{

consteval bool StringsEqual( const char *pszA, const char *pszB )
{
	while ( *pszA && *pszA == *pszB )
	{
		++pszA;
		++pszB;
	}
	return *pszA == *pszB;
}

consteval u32 AppendString( BootstrapBlob_t &blob, u32 &ibWrite, const char *pszText )
{
	const u32 ibString = ibWrite;
	while ( *pszText )
		blob.m_rgub[ibWrite++] = static_cast<u8>( *pszText++ );
	blob.m_rgub[ibWrite++] = 0;
	return ibString;
}

} // namespace detail

consteval BlobImage_t BuildBlobImage()
{
	constexpr u8 k_rgubHeader[] = { 0xC9, 0xB8, 0x7C, 0xAD, 0xC0, 0x0F, 0x00, 0x00,
	                                0x39, 0xCE, 0xC0, 0x8C, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00 };

	BlobImage_t image{};
	for ( u32 ib = 0; ib < ARRAYSIZE( k_rgubHeader ); ++ib )
		image.m_Blob.m_rgub[ib] = k_rgubHeader[ib];

	u32 ibWrite = ARRAYSIZE( k_rgubHeader );
	for ( u32 iImport = 0; iImport < ARRAYSIZE( detail::k_rgImportNames ); ++iImport )
	{
		const detail::ImportName_t &name = detail::k_rgImportNames[iImport];

		// @note / sapdragon: offset 0 stays free, a zero library offset ends the list
		u32 ibLibrary = 0;
		for ( u32 iPrevious = 0; iPrevious < iImport && !ibLibrary; ++iPrevious )
		{
			if ( detail::StringsEqual( detail::k_rgImportNames[iPrevious].m_szLibrary, name.m_szLibrary ) )
				ibLibrary = image.m_rgEntries[iPrevious].m_ibLibrary;
		}
		if ( !ibLibrary )
			ibLibrary = detail::AppendString( image.m_Blob, ibWrite, name.m_szLibrary );

		image.m_rgEntries[iImport].m_ibLibrary = ibLibrary;
		image.m_rgEntries[iImport].m_ibFunction = detail::AppendString( image.m_Blob, ibWrite, name.m_szFunction );
	}
	return image;
}

inline constexpr BlobImage_t k_BlobImage = BuildBlobImage();

extern const BootstrapBlob_t g_EncryptedBlob;

} // namespace vac::bootstrap
```

```cpp
// @binary: 9b85c913
#include "bootstrap/bootstrap.hpp"
#include "bootstrap/blob.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "crypto/hash/hash488781ed.hpp"
#include "crypto/ice/ice.hpp"

namespace vac
{

namespace
{

constinit SystemImports_t s_Imports{};
constinit ModuleSession_t s_Session{};

} // namespace

constinit SystemImports_t *const g_pImports = &s_Imports;
constinit ModuleSession_t *const g_pSession = &s_Session;
constinit u32 g_unIntegrityHash = 0;

} // namespace vac

namespace vac::bootstrap
{

namespace
{

constinit u32 s_cResolvedImports = 0;
constinit u32 s_cLoadedLibraries = 0;
constinit u32 s_rgibLoadedLibraryNames[16]{};
constinit HMODULE s_rghLoadedLibraries[16]{};
constinit BootstrapBlob_t s_Blob{};

const char *BlobString( u32 ibString ) noexcept
{
	return reinterpret_cast<const char *>( s_Blob.m_rgub + ibString );
}

// @orig: 83 3D ? ? ? ? ? 53
bool ResolveAllImports() noexcept
{
	const ImportEntry_t *pEntry = k_BlobImage.m_rgEntries;
	void **ppfnImport = reinterpret_cast<void **>( &s_Imports );

	if ( !pEntry->m_ibLibrary )
		return false;

	while ( s_cResolvedImports < sizeof( s_Imports ) / sizeof( void * ) )
	{
		u32 iLibrary = 0;
		while ( iLibrary < s_cLoadedLibraries && s_rgibLoadedLibraryNames[iLibrary] != pEntry->m_ibLibrary )
			++iLibrary;

		HMODULE hLibrary;
		if ( iLibrary < s_cLoadedLibraries )
		{
			hLibrary = s_rghLoadedLibraries[iLibrary];
		}
		else
		{
			if ( s_cLoadedLibraries >= ARRAYSIZE( s_rghLoadedLibraries ) )
				return false;

			hLibrary = g_pImports->LoadLibraryExA( BlobString( pEntry->m_ibLibrary ), nullptr, 0 );
			s_rghLoadedLibraries[s_cLoadedLibraries] = hLibrary;
			if ( hLibrary )
			{
				s_rgibLoadedLibraryNames[s_cLoadedLibraries] = pEntry->m_ibLibrary;
				++s_cLoadedLibraries;
			}
		}

		if ( hLibrary && pEntry->m_ibFunction )
		{
			*ppfnImport =
			    reinterpret_cast<void *>( g_pImports->GetProcAddress( hLibrary, BlobString( pEntry->m_ibFunction ) ) );
		}

		++pEntry;
		++ppfnImport;
		++s_cResolvedImports;
		if ( !pEntry->m_ibLibrary )
			return true;
	}
	return false;
}

// @orig: 9b85c913:0x10004ADD (no unique signature)
bool VerifyCriticalApis() noexcept
{
	return s_Imports.CreateFileA && s_Imports.OpenProcess && s_Imports.CloseHandle && s_Imports.ReadProcessMemory &&
	       s_Imports.VirtualQuery && s_Imports.VirtualQueryEx && s_Imports.EnumProcesses && s_Imports.LoadLibraryA &&
	       s_Imports.LoadLibraryExA && s_Imports.VirtualAlloc && s_Imports.GetModuleHandleA &&
	       s_Imports.GetModuleFileNameA && s_Imports.GetCurrentProcess && s_Imports.GetCurrentProcessId &&
	       s_Imports.GetLastError && s_Imports.GetSystemInfo && s_Imports.GetSystemDirectoryA &&
	       s_Imports.GetWindowsDirectoryA && s_Imports.GetVersionExA && s_Imports.ReadFile && s_Imports.FreeLibrary &&
	       s_Imports.GetProcAddress && s_Imports.NtQueryInformationProcess && s_Imports.NtQuerySystemInformation &&
	       s_Imports.GetProcessTimes;
}

// @orig: 51 A1
bool CollectSystemInfo() noexcept
{
	ModuleSession_t *pSession = g_pSession;

	pSession->m_unPid = g_pImports->GetCurrentProcessId();
	pSession->m_unTid = g_pImports->GetCurrentThreadId();
	if ( !pSession->m_unPid || !pSession->m_unTid )
		return false;

	g_pImports->GetSystemInfo( &pSession->m_SystemInfo );
	if ( pSession->m_SystemInfo.dwPageSize != 4096 )
		return false;

	pSession->m_OsVersion.dwOSVersionInfoSize = sizeof( pSession->m_OsVersion );
	if ( !g_pImports->GetVersionExA( &pSession->m_OsVersion ) )
		return false;

	pSession->m_unPackedVersion =
	    pSession->m_OsVersion.dwPlatformId |
	    ( ( pSession->m_OsVersion.dwMajorVersion | ( pSession->m_OsVersion.dwMinorVersion << 8 ) ) << 8 );

	// @note / sapdragon: 520 chars into 260 char buffers. valve passed the byte size, keep it
	return g_pImports->GetSystemDirectoryW( pSession->m_wszSystemDirectory, 520 ) &&
	       g_pImports->GetWindowsDirectoryW( pSession->m_wszWindowsDirectory, 520 );
}

// @orig: 68 ? ? ? ? BA
void UpdateIntegrityHash() noexcept
{
	// @note / sapdragon: seed is the address of the hash, not its value. valve bug, keep it
	const u32 unSeed = static_cast<u32>( reinterpret_cast<uptr>( &g_unIntegrityHash ) );
	g_unIntegrityHash =
	    crypto::hash::Hash488781ED_t::Of( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &s_Imports ), sizeof( s_Imports ), unSeed );
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 83 3D ? ? ? ? ? 74 ? 51
bool BootstrapMain( const void *pubInput ) noexcept
{
	// @note / sapdragon: the blob lives in .rdata here, so the first call decrypts into a writable copy
	if ( !s_Blob.m_rgub[0] )
		crypto::ice::DecryptBuffer( static_cast<const u8 *>( pubInput ), g_EncryptedBlob.m_rgub,
		                            sizeof( g_EncryptedBlob.m_rgub ), s_Blob.m_rgub );

	s_cResolvedImports = 0;
	s_cLoadedLibraries = 0;
	memset( &s_Imports, 0, sizeof( s_Imports ) );

	const ImportEntry_t *pEntries = k_BlobImage.m_rgEntries;
	const HMODULE hKernel32 = GetModuleHandleA( BlobString( pEntries[0].m_ibLibrary ) );
	g_pImports->LoadLibraryExA = reinterpret_cast<decltype( SystemImports_t::LoadLibraryExA )>(
	    GetProcAddress( hKernel32, BlobString( pEntries[0].m_ibFunction ) ) );
	g_pImports->GetProcAddress = reinterpret_cast<decltype( SystemImports_t::GetProcAddress )>(
	    GetProcAddress( hKernel32, BlobString( pEntries[1].m_ibFunction ) ) );
	g_pSession->m_hNtdll = GetModuleHandleA( BlobString( pEntries[2].m_ibLibrary ) );

	if ( !ResolveAllImports() )
		return false;
	if ( !VerifyCriticalApis() )
		return false;

	g_pSession->m_unLastError = 0;
	if ( !CollectSystemInfo() )
		return false;

	UpdateIntegrityHash();
	return true;
}

// @note / sapdragon: inlined at the end of the workers that tear down, some builds never call it
void BootstrapTeardown() noexcept
{
	for ( u32 iLibrary = 0; iLibrary < s_cLoadedLibraries; ++iLibrary )
	{
		s_Imports.FreeLibrary( s_rghLoadedLibraries[iLibrary] );
		s_rghLoadedLibraries[iLibrary] = nullptr;
	}
	s_cLoadedLibraries = 0;
	memset( &s_Imports, 0, sizeof( s_Imports ) );
	s_cResolvedImports = 0;
}

} // namespace vac::bootstrap
```

```hpp
// @binary: 78a6ef0f
#pragma once

#include "core/types.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "util/strings.hpp"

namespace vac::compress::lz4
{

inline constexpr u32 k_cHashLogBits = 13u;
inline constexpr u32 k_cubMinMatch = 4u;
inline constexpr u32 k_cubMaxInput = 0x7E000000u;

constexpr u32 CompressBound( u32 cubInput ) noexcept
{
	return cubInput <= k_cubMaxInput ? cubInput + cubInput / 255u + 16u : 0;
}

constexpr u32 Hash( u32 unSequence ) noexcept
{
	return ( unSequence * 2654435761u ) >> ( ( k_cubMinMatch * 8u ) - k_cHashLogBits );
}

constexpr u32 CommonBytes( u32 unDifference ) noexcept
{
	if ( !unDifference )
		return 4;
	u32 cBytes = 0;
	while ( ( unDifference & 0xFFu ) == 0 )
	{
		++cBytes;
		unDifference >>= 8;
	}
	return cBytes;
}

// @note / sapdragon: 16-bit positions only, like valve's small-input path. their 64 KB path is not rebuilt, the
// report never gets that big
// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 8B FA
inline int Compress( const u8 *pubInput, u8 *pubOutput, u32 cubInput, u32 cubOutput ) noexcept
{
	if ( !cubInput )
		return 0;
	if ( CompressBound( cubInput ) > cubOutput )
		return 0;

	u16 rgunTable[1u << k_cHashLogBits];
	memset( rgunTable, 0, sizeof( rgunTable ) );

	const u8 *const pubBase = pubInput;
	const u8 *const pubInputEnd = pubInput + cubInput;
	const u8 *const pubMatchFindLimit = pubInputEnd - 11;
	const u8 *pubAnchor = pubInput;
	const u8 *pubCursor = pubInput + 1;
	u32 unForwardHash = 0;
	u8 *pubWrite = pubOutput;

	if ( cubInput < 13u )
		goto last_literals;

	rgunTable[Hash( util::Read32( pubInput ) )] = 0;
	unForwardHash = Hash( util::Read32( pubCursor ) );

	for ( ;; )
	{
		const u8 *pubMatch;
		const u8 *pubForward = pubCursor;
		u32 cubStep = 1;
		u32 cSearches = 64;

		do
		{
			pubCursor = pubForward;
			pubForward += cubStep;
			cubStep = cSearches++ >> 6;
			if ( pubForward > pubMatchFindLimit )
				goto last_literals;

			const u32 unHash = unForwardHash;
			const u16 unPosition = rgunTable[unHash];
			pubMatch = pubBase + unPosition;
			unForwardHash = Hash( util::Read32( pubForward ) );
			rgunTable[unHash] = static_cast<u16>( pubCursor - pubBase );
		} while ( ( pubCursor - pubMatch > 0xFFFF ) || util::Read32( pubMatch ) != util::Read32( pubCursor ) );

		while ( pubCursor > pubAnchor && pubMatch > pubBase && pubCursor[-1] == pubMatch[-1] )
		{
			--pubCursor;
			--pubMatch;
		}

		{
			const u32 cubLiterals = static_cast<u32>( pubCursor - pubAnchor );
			u8 *pubToken = pubWrite++;
			if ( cubLiterals >= 15u )
			{
				*pubToken = 15u << 4;
				const u32 cubRemaining = cubLiterals - 15u;
				if ( cubRemaining < 255u )
				{
					*pubWrite++ = static_cast<u8>( cubRemaining );
				}
				else
				{
					const u32 cBlocks = cubRemaining / 255u;
					memset( pubWrite, 255, cBlocks );
					pubWrite += cBlocks;
					*pubWrite++ = static_cast<u8>( cubRemaining % 255u );
				}
			}
			else
			{
				*pubToken = static_cast<u8>( cubLiterals << 4 );
			}

			memcpy( pubWrite, pubAnchor, cubLiterals );
			pubWrite += cubLiterals;

			for ( ;; )
			{
				util::Write16( pubWrite, static_cast<u16>( pubCursor - pubMatch ) );
				pubWrite += 2;

				pubCursor += k_cubMinMatch;
				pubMatch += k_cubMinMatch;

				const u8 *pubMatchStart = pubCursor;
				while ( pubCursor < pubInputEnd - 8 )
				{
					const u32 unDifference = util::Read32( pubMatch ) ^ util::Read32( pubCursor );
					if ( unDifference )
					{
						pubCursor += CommonBytes( unDifference );
						goto match_done;
					}
					pubCursor += 4;
					pubMatch += 4;
				}
				if ( pubCursor < pubInputEnd - 6 &&
				     *reinterpret_cast<const u16 *>( pubMatch ) == *reinterpret_cast<const u16 *>( pubCursor ) )
				{
					pubCursor += 2;
					pubMatch += 2;
				}
				if ( pubCursor < pubInputEnd - 5 && *pubMatch == *pubCursor )
					++pubCursor;

			match_done:
			{
				u32 cubMatch = static_cast<u32>( pubCursor - pubMatchStart );
				if ( cubMatch >= 15u )
				{
					*pubToken += 15u;
					cubMatch -= 15u;
					u32 unFill = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
					memcpy( pubWrite, &unFill, 4 );
					if ( cubMatch >= 1020u )
					{
						u32 cBlocks = cubMatch / 1020u;
						do
						{
							pubWrite += 4;
							memcpy( pubWrite, &unFill, 4 );
							--cBlocks;
						} while ( cBlocks );
						cubMatch %= 1020u;
					}
					pubWrite += cubMatch / 255u;
					*pubWrite++ = static_cast<u8>( cubMatch % 255u );
				}
				else
				{
					*pubToken = static_cast<u8>( *pubToken + cubMatch );
				}
			}

				pubAnchor = pubCursor;
				if ( pubCursor >= pubMatchFindLimit )
					goto last_literals;

				rgunTable[Hash( util::Read32( pubCursor - 2 ) )] = static_cast<u16>( ( pubCursor - 2 ) - pubBase );
				const u32 unHash = Hash( util::Read32( pubCursor ) );
				pubMatch = pubBase + rgunTable[unHash];
				rgunTable[unHash] = static_cast<u16>( pubCursor - pubBase );
				if ( pubCursor - pubMatch > 0xFFFF || util::Read32( pubMatch ) != util::Read32( pubCursor ) )
				{
					unForwardHash = Hash( util::Read32( ++pubCursor ) );
					break;
				}
				pubToken = pubWrite++;
				*pubToken = 0;
			}
		}
	}

last_literals:
{
	const u32 cubLiterals = static_cast<u32>( pubInputEnd - pubAnchor );
	if ( !cubLiterals )
		return static_cast<int>( pubWrite - pubOutput );

	u8 *pubToken = pubWrite++;
	if ( cubLiterals >= 15u )
	{
		*pubToken = 15u << 4;
		const u32 cubRemaining = cubLiterals - 15u;
		if ( cubRemaining < 255u )
		{
			*pubWrite++ = static_cast<u8>( cubRemaining );
		}
		else
		{
			const u32 cBlocks = cubRemaining / 255u;
			memset( pubWrite, 255, cBlocks );
			pubWrite += cBlocks;
			*pubWrite++ = static_cast<u8>( cubRemaining % 255u );
		}
	}
	else
	{
		*pubToken = static_cast<u8>( cubLiterals << 4 );
	}
	memcpy( pubWrite, pubAnchor, cubLiterals );
	pubWrite += cubLiterals;
}

	return static_cast<int>( pubWrite - pubOutput );
}

} // namespace vac::compress::lz4
```

```cpp
// @binary: 9b85c913
#include "core/dispatcher.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "crypto/hash/crc32.hpp"
#include "crypto/ice/ice.hpp"
#include "crypto/random/park_miller.hpp"
#include "crypto/rsa/rsa.hpp"
#include "util/util.hpp"

#include <Windows.h>
#include <intrin.h>

namespace vac
{

constinit Module_t *g_pModuleListHead = nullptr;

namespace
{

struct SessionKey_t
{
	u32 m_unHeader;
	u32 m_cubReport;
	u32 m_rgunIceKey[2];
	u32 m_unTerminator;
	u32 m_rgunPadding[2];
	u32 m_rgunUnsent[25];
};
VAC_LAYOUT( SessionKey_t, m_rgunUnsent, 28 );
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( SessionKey_t, 128 );

constinit u32 s_cubPage = 0;

// @orig: inlined
const Module_t *FindWorkerNode( const VacInputPacket_t *pInput ) noexcept
{
	for ( const Module_t *pNode = g_pModuleListHead; pNode; pNode = pNode->m_pNext )
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: a node without a worker also stops the walk and gets called. same in the original
		if ( !pNode->m_pfnWorker ||
		     ( pNode->m_unId == pInput->m_unModuleId && pNode->m_unVersion == pInput->m_unVersion ) )
		{
			return pNode;
		}
	}
	return nullptr;
}

// @orig: inlined
void SealResponse( const u8 *pubReport, VacOutputPacket_t *pOutput, u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	u8 rgubRsaPublicKey[200];
	memcpy( rgubRsaPublicKey, k_rgubRsaPublicKey, k_cubRsaPublicKey );

	const i32 nTicks = static_cast<i32>( __rdtsc() );
	crypto::random::ParkMiller_t prng( static_cast<u32>( nTicks < 0 ? nTicks : -nTicks ) );

	SessionKey_t sessionKey;
	u32 *punSessionKey = reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( &sessionKey );
	for ( u32 iWord = 0; iWord < sizeof( SessionKey_t ) / sizeof( u32 ); ++iWord )
		punSessionKey[iWord] = prng.Next();

	sessionKey.m_unTerminator = 0;
	sessionKey.m_cubReport = *pcubOutput;
	sessionKey.m_unHeader = ( sessionKey.m_unHeader & 0xFFFFFF7Fu ) | 0x40u;

	u32 *punResponse = reinterpret_cast<u32 *>( pOutput );
	for ( u32 iWord = *pcubOutput >> 2; iWord < sizeof( VacOutputPacket_t ) / sizeof( u32 ); ++iWord )
		punResponse[iWord] = prng.Next();

	u32 cubRsaOutput = 0x40;
	crypto::rsa::ERsaError eRsaError = crypto::rsa::ERsaError::Ok;
	const bool bRsaOk = crypto::rsa::EncryptSessionKey(
	    reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &sessionKey ), offsetof( SessionKey_t, m_rgunUnsent ), rgubRsaPublicKey,
	    k_cubRsaPublicKey, pOutput->m_rgubRsaSessionKey, &cubRsaOutput, &eRsaError );
	pOutput->m_cubRsaPayload = cubRsaOutput;
	pOutput->m_unRsaStatus = static_cast<u32>( eRsaError ) | ( bRsaOk ? 0 : 0x10000 );

	crypto::ice::EncryptBuffer( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( sessionKey.m_rgunIceKey ), pubReport, k_cubReport,
	                            pOutput->m_rgubEncryptedReport );

	for ( u32 iWord = 0; iWord < sizeof( SessionKey_t ) / sizeof( u32 ); ++iWord )
		(void)prng.Next();

	*pcubOutput = sizeof( VacOutputPacket_t );
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 E4 ? 81 EC
EDispatchResult __fastcall RunDispatcher( const VacInputPacket_t *pInput, u32 cubInput, VacOutputPacket_t *pOutput,
                                          u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	const u32 cubCapacity = *pcubOutput;
	if ( cubInput < sizeof( VacInputPacket_t ) || cubCapacity < sizeof( VacDispatchStatus_t ) )
		return EDispatchResult::BadArguments;

	*pcubOutput = sizeof( VacDispatchStatus_t );
	memset( pOutput, 0, sizeof( VacDispatchStatus_t ) );

	auto *pStatus = reinterpret_cast<VacDispatchStatus_t *>( pOutput );
	pStatus->m_unError = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
	pStatus->m_unSessionId = pInput->m_unSessionId;
	pStatus->m_eStatus = EDispatchStatus::Ok;

	const Module_t *pNode = FindWorkerNode( pInput );
	if ( !pNode )
	{
		pStatus->m_eStatus = EDispatchStatus::ModuleNotFound;
		return EDispatchResult::Success;
	}

	u8 rgubConfig[k_cubEncryptedConfig];
	crypto::ice::DecryptBuffer( pNode->m_rgubIceKey, pInput->m_rgubEncryptedConfig, k_cubEncryptedConfig, rgubConfig );
	if ( crypto::hash::Crc32_t::Of( rgubConfig, k_cubEncryptedConfig ) != pInput->m_unConfigCrc32 )
	{
		pStatus->m_eStatus = EDispatchStatus::IntegrityFailed;
		return EDispatchResult::Success;
	}

	if ( cubCapacity < k_cubReport )
		return EDispatchResult::BadArguments;

	if ( !s_cubPage )
	{
		SYSTEM_INFO systemInfo;
		GetSystemInfo( &systemInfo );
		s_cubPage = systemInfo.dwPageSize;
	}

	const u32 cubSandbox = s_cubPage * ( ( s_cubPage + sizeof( VacOutputPacket_t ) - 1 ) / s_cubPage + 2 );
	u8 *pubSandbox = static_cast<u8 *>( VirtualAlloc( nullptr, cubSandbox, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE,
	                                                  util::MapProtectionFlags( util::EProtectMode::NoAccess ) ) );
	if ( !pubSandbox )
		return EDispatchResult::BadArguments;

	EDispatchResult eResult = EDispatchResult::Success;
	u8 *pubReport = pubSandbox + s_cubPage;
	DWORD unOldProtect;
	if ( VirtualProtect( pubReport, cubSandbox - 2 * s_cubPage,
	                     util::MapProtectionFlags( util::EProtectMode::ReadWrite ), &unOldProtect ) )
	{
		*pcubOutput = k_cubReport;
		const int nWorkerResult = pNode->m_pfnWorker( rgubConfig, pubReport, pcubOutput );

		auto *pHeader = reinterpret_cast<VacReportHeader_t *>( pubReport );
		pHeader->m_unReserved = 0;
		pHeader->m_unWorkerResult = static_cast<u32>( nWorkerResult );
		pHeader->m_unSessionId = pInput->m_unSessionId;

		SealResponse( pubReport, pOutput, pcubOutput );
	}
	else
	{
		eResult = EDispatchResult::BadArguments;
	}

	VirtualFree( pubSandbox, 0, MEM_RELEASE );
	return eResult;
}

} // namespace vac
```

```cpp
// @binary: 9b85c913
#include "core/dispatcher.hpp"
#include "core/module.hpp"

#include <Windows.h>

#pragma comment( linker, "/merge:.vacini=.rdata" )

namespace vac
{

namespace
{

struct StdHandle_t
{
	u32 m_bInitialized;
	HANDLE m_hHandle;
};

constinit u32 s_cubHeapGranularity = 0;
constinit void *s_pubHeapScratch = nullptr;
constinit StdHandle_t s_rgStdHandles[3]{};

// @note / sapdragon: non-zero from the start, so the initializers always run again after dispatch
constinit u32 s_bRunInitializersAgain = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

// @orig: 6A ? B8
void __cdecl ClearStdHandleFlags()
{
	for ( StdHandle_t &stdHandle : s_rgStdHandles )
		stdHandle.m_bInitialized = 0;
}

__declspec( allocate( ".vacini$a" ) ) extern const PfnInitializer_t k_pfnInitializersBegin = nullptr;
__declspec( allocate( ".vacini$m" ) ) extern const PfnInitializer_t k_pfnClearStdHandleFlags = ClearStdHandleFlags;
__declspec( allocate( ".vacini$z" ) ) extern const PfnInitializer_t k_pfnInitializersEnd = nullptr;

// @orig: 51 53 56 57 BF
void CallInitializers() noexcept
{
	for ( const PfnInitializer_t *ppfnInit = &k_pfnInitializersBegin; ppfnInit < &k_pfnInitializersEnd; ++ppfnInit )
	{
		if ( *ppfnInit )
			( *ppfnInit )();
	}
}

} // namespace

} // namespace vac

// @orig: 55 8B EC 56 57
extern "C"
    __declspec( dllexport ) int __stdcall runfunc( int nMode, const vac::VacInputPacket_t *pInput, vac::u32 cubInput,
                                                   vac::VacOutputPacket_t *pOutput, vac::u32 *pcubOutput ) noexcept
{
	using namespace vac;

	s_cubHeapGranularity = 128;
	s_pubHeapScratch = HeapAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), HEAP_ZERO_MEMORY, 0x200 );

	s_rgStdHandles[0].m_hHandle = GetStdHandle( STD_INPUT_HANDLE );
	s_rgStdHandles[0].m_bInitialized = 1;
	s_rgStdHandles[1].m_hHandle = GetStdHandle( STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE );
	s_rgStdHandles[1].m_bInitialized = 1;
	s_rgStdHandles[2].m_hHandle = GetStdHandle( STD_ERROR_HANDLE );
	s_rgStdHandles[2].m_bInitialized = 1;

	CallInitializers();

	EDispatchResult eResult = EDispatchResult::NoDispatch;
	if ( nMode == 4 )
		eResult = RunDispatcher( pInput, cubInput, pOutput, pcubOutput );

	if ( s_bRunInitializersAgain )
		CallInitializers();

	return static_cast<int>( eResult );
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <type_traits>

#define VAC_FLAGS( EFlags )                                                                                            \
	constexpr EFlags operator|( EFlags eLeft, EFlags eRight ) noexcept                                                 \
	{                                                                                                                  \
		using Underlying_t = std::underlying_type_t<EFlags>;                                                           \
		return static_cast<EFlags>( static_cast<Underlying_t>( eLeft ) | static_cast<Underlying_t>( eRight ) );        \
	}                                                                                                                  \
	constexpr EFlags operator&( EFlags eLeft, EFlags eRight ) noexcept                                                 \
	{                                                                                                                  \
		using Underlying_t = std::underlying_type_t<EFlags>;                                                           \
		return static_cast<EFlags>( static_cast<Underlying_t>( eLeft ) & static_cast<Underlying_t>( eRight ) );        \
	}                                                                                                                  \
	constexpr EFlags &operator|=( EFlags &eLeft, EFlags eRight ) noexcept                                              \
	{                                                                                                                  \
		return eLeft = eLeft | eRight;                                                                                 \
	}                                                                                                                  \
	constexpr bool HasFlag( EFlags eValue, EFlags eFlag ) noexcept                                                     \
	{                                                                                                                  \
		return static_cast<std::underlying_type_t<EFlags>>( eValue & eFlag ) != 0;                                     \
	}
```

```hpp
namespace vac

using PfnInitializer_t = void( __cdecl * )();

struct Module_t
{
	Module_t *m_pNext;
	u32 m_unId;
	u32 m_unVersion;
	PfnWorker_t m_pfnWorker;
	u8 m_rgubIceKey[36];
};

VAC_LAYOUT( Module_t, m_rgubIceKey, 0x10 );
VAC_LAYOUT_SIZE( Module_t, 0x34 );

extern Module_t *g_pModuleListHead;

namespace detail
{

template <auto pfnWorker>
struct WorkerThunk_t;

template <typename Input_t, typename Output_t, int ( *pfnWorker )( Input_t &, Output_t &, u32 * ) noexcept>
struct WorkerThunk_t<pfnWorker>
{
	static int __cdecl Call( const u8 *pubInput, u8 *pubOutput, u32 *pcubOutput )
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: some workers write back into their input, so constness follows the worker's signature
		auto *pInput = reinterpret_cast<Input_t *>( const_cast<u8 *>( pubInput ) );
		return pfnWorker( *pInput, *reinterpret_cast<Output_t *>( pubOutput ), pcubOutput );
	}
};

template <int ( *pfnWorker )( const u8 *, u8 *, u32 * ) noexcept>
struct WorkerThunk_t<pfnWorker>
{
	static int __cdecl Call( const u8 *pubInput, u8 *pubOutput, u32 *pcubOutput )
	{
		return pfnWorker( pubInput, pubOutput, pcubOutput );
	}
};

} // namespace detail

} // namespace vac

#pragma section( ".vacini$a", read )
#pragma section( ".vacini$m", read )
#pragma section( ".vacini$z", read )

	static ::vac::Module_t s_WorkerNode##nUnique{                                                                      \
	    nullptr, ( unId ), ( unVersion ), &::vac::detail::WorkerThunk_t<&pfnWorker>::Call, { __VA_ARGS__ } };          \
	static void __cdecl RegisterWorkerNode##nUnique()                                                                  \
	{                                                                                                                  \
		s_WorkerNode##nUnique.m_pNext = ::vac::g_pModuleListHead;                                                      \
		::vac::g_pModuleListHead = &s_WorkerNode##nUnique;                                                             \
	}                                                                                                                  \
	extern "C" __declspec( allocate( ".vacini$m" ) ) const ::vac::PfnInitializer_t g_pfnRegisterWorkerNode##nUnique;   \
	__declspec( allocate( ".vacini$m" ) ) const ::vac::PfnInitializer_t g_pfnRegisterWorkerNode##nUnique =             \
	    RegisterWorkerNode##nUnique

#define VAC_DETAIL_WORKER_EXPAND( pfnWorker, unId, unVersion, nUnique, ... )                                           \
	VAC_DETAIL_WORKER( pfnWorker, unId, unVersion, nUnique, __VA_ARGS__ )

#define VAC_WORKER( pfnWorker, unId, unVersion, ... )                                                                  \
```

`sdk/src/crt/intrinsics.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 42878040
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

// @note / sapdragon: stops the compiler from turning these bodies into calls to themselves
#pragma function( memset, memcpy, memmove, memcmp )

extern "C"
{
	// @orig: 8B 4C 24 ? 85 C9
	void *memset( void *pDst, int nValue, std::size_t cub )
	{
		auto *pubDst = static_cast<unsigned char *>( pDst );
		const auto unValue = static_cast<unsigned char>( nValue );
		while ( cub-- )
			*pubDst++ = unValue;
		return pDst;
	}

	// @orig: 8B 54 24 ? 8B 44 24
	void *memcpy( void *pDst, const void *pSrc, std::size_t cub )
	{
		auto *pubDst = static_cast<unsigned char *>( pDst );
		const auto *pubSrc = static_cast<const unsigned char *>( pSrc );
		while ( cub-- )
			*pubDst++ = *pubSrc++;
		return pDst;
	}

	void *memmove( void *pDst, const void *pSrc, std::size_t cub )
	{
		auto *pubDst = static_cast<unsigned char *>( pDst );
		const auto *pubSrc = static_cast<const unsigned char *>( pSrc );
		if ( pubDst == pubSrc || cub == 0 )
			return pDst;
		if ( pubDst < pubSrc )
		{
			while ( cub-- )
				*pubDst++ = *pubSrc++;
		}
		else
		{
			pubDst += cub;
			pubSrc += cub;
			while ( cub-- )
				*--pubDst = *--pubSrc;
		}
		return pDst;
	}

	// @orig: 8B 44 24 ? 53
	int memcmp( const void *pA, const void *pB, std::size_t cub )
	{
		const auto *pubA = static_cast<const unsigned char *>( pA );
		const auto *pubB = static_cast<const unsigned char *>( pB );
		while ( cub-- )
		{
			// @note / sapdragon: returns the byte difference, not -1 or 1. same in the original
			if ( *pubA != *pubB )
				return *pubA - *pubB;
			++pubA;
			++pubB;
		}
		return 0;
	}

	int _fltused = 0;

#if defined( _M_IX86 )

	// clang-format off
	// @orig: 51 8D 4C 24 ? 2B C8
	__declspec( naked ) void _chkstk()
	{
		__asm
		{
			push ecx
			push edx

			// @note / sapdragon: esp after the ret has to be esp before the call minus eax
			lea  edx, [esp + 8]
			mov  ecx, edx
			sub  ecx, eax

		probe_pages:
			sub  edx, 1000h
			cmp  edx, ecx
			jb   probe_tail
			test dword ptr [edx], eax
			jmp  probe_pages

		probe_tail:
			test dword ptr [ecx], eax

			mov  eax, ecx
			mov  ecx, [esp + 8]
			mov  [eax], ecx
			mov  edx, [esp + 0]
			mov  ecx, [esp + 4]
			mov  esp, eax
			ret
		}
	}

	__declspec( naked ) void __chkstk() { __asm { jmp _chkstk } }
	__declspec( naked ) void _alloca_probe() { __asm { jmp _chkstk } }
	__declspec( naked ) void _alloca_probe_16() { __asm { jmp _chkstk } }
	__declspec( naked ) void _alloca_probe_8() { __asm { jmp _chkstk } }
	__declspec( naked ) void __alloca_probe() { __asm { jmp _chkstk } }
	__declspec( naked ) void __alloca_probe_16() { __asm { jmp _chkstk } }
	__declspec( naked ) void __alloca_probe_8() { __asm { jmp _chkstk } }
	// clang-format on

#endif
}
```

`sdk/src/crypto/bigint/bigint.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 9b85c913
#include "crypto/bigint/bigint.hpp"
#include "core/vac_util.hpp"

// @note / sapdragon: a plain u64 product pulls the crt's _allmul on x86, this intrinsic stays a single mul
extern "C" unsigned __int64 __emulu( unsigned int unA, unsigned int unB );
#pragma intrinsic( __emulu )

namespace vac::crypto::bigint
{

void Bignum_t::Destroy() noexcept
{
	if ( m_punData )
		util::HeapFree( m_punData );
	m_punData = nullptr;
	m_cAllocated = 0;
	m_cUsed = 0;
	m_cBits = 0;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 57 8B 7C 24
void Bignum_t::EnsureAlloc( u32 cWords ) noexcept
{
	if ( m_cAllocated >= cWords )
		return;

	u32 *const punOld = m_punData;
	const usize cubNew = ( u64( cWords ) >> 30 ) ? usize( -1 ) : usize( cWords ) * 4;
	auto *const punNew = static_cast<u32 *>( util::HeapAlloc( cubNew ) );
	for ( u32 iWord = 0; iWord < m_cUsed; ++iWord )
		punNew[iWord] = punOld[iWord];

	m_punData = punNew;
	m_cAllocated = cWords;
	if ( punOld )
		util::HeapFree( punOld );
}

// @orig: 56 FF 74 24 ? 8B F1
void Bignum_t::ZeroExtend( u32 cWords ) noexcept
{
	EnsureAlloc( cWords );
	while ( m_cUsed < cWords )
		m_punData[m_cUsed++] = 0;
	m_cBits = 32 * m_cUsed;
}

// @orig: 8B 51 ? 56 33 F6
void Bignum_t::RecalcBits() noexcept
{
	while ( m_cUsed > 0 && m_punData[m_cUsed - 1] == 0 )
		--m_cUsed;
	if ( m_cUsed == 0 )
	{
		m_cBits = 0;
		return;
	}

	const u32 unTop = m_punData[m_cUsed - 1];
	u32 iHighestBit = 0;
	for ( u32 iBit = 31;; --iBit )
	{
		if ( unTop & ( 1u << iBit ) )
		{
			iHighestBit = iBit;
			break;
		}
		if ( iBit == 0 )
			break;
	}
	m_cBits = 32 * ( m_cUsed - 1 ) + iHighestBit + 1;
}

// @orig: 8B 54 24 ? 53 55 8B E9 8B 02
void Bignum_t::Swap( Bignum_t &other ) noexcept
{
	Bignum_t temp = *this;
	*this = other;
	other = temp;
}

// @orig: 56 6A ? 8B F1
void Bignum_t::SetInt( u32 unValue ) noexcept
{
	EnsureAlloc( 1 );
	m_punData[0] = unValue;
	m_cUsed = 1;
	m_cBits = 32;
	RecalcBits();
}

// @orig: 53 56 8B 74 24
void Bignum_t::SetBytes( const u8 *pubData, usize cubData ) noexcept
{
	m_cBits = 0;
	m_cUsed = 0;
	ZeroExtend( static_cast<u32>( ( cubData + 3 ) >> 2 ) );
	auto *const pubWords = reinterpret_cast<u8 *>( m_punData );
	for ( usize ib = 0; ib < cubData; ++ib )
		pubWords[ib] = pubData[cubData - 1 - ib];
	RecalcBits();
}

// @orig: 53 8B 5C 24 ? 56
void Bignum_t::CopyFrom( const Bignum_t &source ) noexcept
{
	m_punData = nullptr;
	m_cAllocated = 0;
	m_cUsed = 0;
	m_cBits = 0;
	EnsureAlloc( source.m_cUsed );
	m_cUsed = source.m_cUsed;
	m_cBits = source.m_cBits;
	for ( u32 iWord = 0; iWord < m_cUsed; ++iWord )
		m_punData[iWord] = source.m_punData[iWord];
}

// @orig: 51 53 55 56 8B 74 24
void Bignum_t::Add( const Bignum_t &other, u32 iWordOffset ) noexcept
{
	u32 cNeeded = iWordOffset + other.m_cUsed;
	if ( m_cUsed > cNeeded )
		cNeeded = m_cUsed;
	ZeroExtend( cNeeded + 1 );

	u64 ulCarry = 0;
	for ( u32 iWord = 0; iWord < other.m_cUsed; ++iWord )
	{
		const u64 ulSum = u64( m_punData[iWordOffset + iWord] ) + u64( other.m_punData[iWord] ) + ulCarry;
		m_punData[iWordOffset + iWord] = u32( ulSum );
		ulCarry = ulSum >> 32;
	}
	u32 iWord = iWordOffset + other.m_cUsed;
	while ( ulCarry )
	{
		const u64 ulSum = u64( m_punData[iWord] ) + ulCarry;
		m_punData[iWord] = u32( ulSum );
		ulCarry = ulSum >> 32;
		++iWord;
	}

	if ( m_cUsed > 0 && m_punData[m_cUsed - 1] == 0 )
	{
		m_cBits -= 32;
		--m_cUsed;
	}
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 8B 5C 24
void Bignum_t::Multiply( const Bignum_t &other ) noexcept
{
	Bignum_t result;
	Bignum_t row;
	result.ZeroExtend( m_cUsed + other.m_cUsed + 2 );
	row.ZeroExtend( other.m_cUsed + 1 );

	for ( u32 iWord = 0; iWord < m_cUsed; ++iWord )
	{
		const u32 unMultiplier = m_punData[iWord];
		u64 ulCarry = 0;
		for ( u32 iOther = 0; iOther < other.m_cUsed; ++iOther )
		{
			const u64 ulProduct = __emulu( other.m_punData[iOther], unMultiplier ) + ulCarry;
			row.m_punData[iOther] = u32( ulProduct );
			ulCarry = ulProduct >> 32;
		}
		row.m_punData[other.m_cUsed] = u32( ulCarry );
		result.Add( row, iWord );
	}
	result.RecalcBits();
	Swap( result );

	row.Destroy();
	result.Destroy();
}

// @orig: 51 56 8B F1 89 74 24
void Bignum_t::ShiftRight( u32 cBits, u32 iStartWord ) noexcept
{
	if ( m_cBits == 0 || cBits == 0 )
		return;
	if ( cBits >= m_cBits )
	{
		m_cBits = 0;
		m_cUsed = 0;
		return;
	}

	const u32 cWordShift = cBits >> 5;
	const u32 cBitShift = cBits & 0x1F;

	if ( cWordShift )
	{
		u32 iSource = cWordShift + iStartWord;
		u32 iTarget = iStartWord;
		while ( iSource < m_cUsed )
			m_punData[iTarget++] = m_punData[iSource++];
		m_cUsed -= cWordShift;
		m_cBits -= 32 * cWordShift;
	}

	if ( cBitShift )
	{
		const u32 iLast = m_cUsed - 1;
		for ( u32 iWord = iStartWord; iWord < iLast; ++iWord )
			m_punData[iWord] = ( m_punData[iWord] >> cBitShift ) | ( m_punData[iWord + 1] << ( 32 - cBitShift ) );
		m_punData[iLast] >>= cBitShift;
		m_cBits -= cBitShift;
		m_cUsed = ( m_cBits + 31 ) >> 5;
	}
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 33 C0
void Bignum_t::PowerOfTwo( u32 unExponent ) noexcept
{
	Bignum_t shifted;
	Bignum_t one;
	one.SetInt( 1u << ( unExponent & 0x1F ) );
	shifted.Add( one, unExponent >> 5 );
	one.Destroy();
	Multiply( shifted );
	shifted.Destroy();
}

// @orig: 51 53 8B 5C 24
bool Bignum_t::CompareSub( const Bignum_t &other, u32 iShift ) noexcept
{
	if ( iShift >= other.m_cUsed )
		return false;
	if ( m_cBits < other.m_cBits )
		return false;

	if ( m_cBits == other.m_cBits )
	{
		for ( u32 iWord = other.m_cUsed; iWord > iShift; )
		{
			--iWord;
			if ( m_punData[iWord] < other.m_punData[iWord] )
				return false;
			if ( m_punData[iWord] > other.m_punData[iWord] )
				break;
		}
	}

	u64 ulBorrow = 0;
	u32 iWord = 0;
	for ( ; iWord < other.m_cUsed - iShift; ++iWord )
	{
		const u64 ulDifference = u64( m_punData[iShift + iWord] ) - u64( other.m_punData[iShift + iWord] ) - ulBorrow;
		m_punData[iShift + iWord] = u32( ulDifference );
		ulBorrow = ( ulDifference >> 32 ) & 1;
	}
	while ( ulBorrow )
	{
		const u64 ulDifference = u64( m_punData[iShift + iWord] ) - ulBorrow;
		m_punData[iShift + iWord] = u32( ulDifference );
		ulBorrow = ( ulDifference >> 32 ) & 1;
		++iWord;
	}

	RecalcBits();
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 53 56 8B 75
void Bignum_t::DivMod( const Bignum_t &divisor, Bignum_t &remainder ) noexcept
{
	if ( divisor.m_cBits == 0 )
		return;

	Bignum_t shifted;
	shifted.CopyFrom( divisor );
	u32 cShift = ( divisor.m_cBits < m_cBits ) ? m_cBits - divisor.m_cBits : 0;
	shifted.PowerOfTwo( cShift );

	Swap( remainder );
	m_cBits = 0;
	m_cUsed = 0;
	u32 iWord = cShift >> 5;
	ZeroExtend( iWord + 1 );

	for ( ;; )
	{
		if ( remainder.CompareSub( shifted, iWord ) )
			m_punData[iWord] |= ( 1u << ( cShift & 0x1F ) );
		if ( cShift == 0 )
			break;
		--cShift;
		iWord = cShift >> 5;
		shifted.ShiftRight( 1, iWord );
	}

	RecalcBits();
	shifted.Destroy();
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 53 56 57 8B 7D
void Bignum_t::Modulo( const Bignum_t &modulus, const Bignum_t &barrett ) noexcept
{
	if ( m_cBits > modulus.m_cBits )
	{
		Bignum_t scratch;
		scratch.CopyFrom( *this );
		scratch.ShiftRight( 32 * modulus.m_cUsed - 32, 0 );
		scratch.Multiply( barrett );
		scratch.ShiftRight( 32 * ( modulus.m_cUsed + 1 ), 0 );
		scratch.Multiply( modulus );

		if ( scratch.m_cUsed > modulus.m_cUsed + 1 )
		{
			scratch.m_cUsed = modulus.m_cUsed + 1;
			scratch.m_cBits = 32 * ( modulus.m_cUsed + 1 );
			scratch.RecalcBits();
		}
		if ( m_cUsed > modulus.m_cUsed + 1 )
		{
			m_cUsed = modulus.m_cUsed + 1;
			m_cBits = 32 * ( modulus.m_cUsed + 1 );
			RecalcBits();
		}
		if ( !CompareSub( scratch, 0 ) )
		{
			ZeroExtend( modulus.m_cUsed + 2 );
			m_punData[modulus.m_cUsed + 1] = 1;
			RecalcBits();
			CompareSub( scratch, 0 );
		}
		scratch.Destroy();
	}
	while ( CompareSub( modulus, 0 ) )
	{
	}
}

// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 8B F1
void Bignum_t::ModExp( const Bignum_t &exponent, const Bignum_t &modulus ) noexcept
{
	if ( m_cBits == 0 || modulus.m_cBits == 0 )
		return;

	if ( &exponent == this || &modulus == this )
	{
		Bignum_t exponentCopy;
		Bignum_t modulusCopy;
		exponentCopy.CopyFrom( exponent );
		modulusCopy.CopyFrom( modulus );
		ModExp( exponentCopy, modulusCopy );
		exponentCopy.Destroy();
		modulusCopy.Destroy();
		return;
	}

	Bignum_t barrett;
	barrett.SetInt( 1 );
	barrett.PowerOfTwo( modulus.m_cUsed << 6 );

	Bignum_t remainder;
	barrett.DivMod( modulus, remainder );

	Bignum_t base;
	base.CopyFrom( *this );
	if ( m_cBits > 2 * modulus.m_cBits )
		DivMod( modulus, base );
	else
		base.Modulo( modulus, barrett );

	EnsureAlloc( 2 * modulus.m_cUsed + 3 );
	m_punData[0] = 1;
	m_cUsed = 1;
	m_cBits = 32;
	RecalcBits();

	u32 cBitsLeft = exponent.m_cBits;
	while ( cBitsLeft )
	{
		--cBitsLeft;
		Multiply( *this );
		Modulo( modulus, barrett );
		const bool bBitSet = ( exponent.m_punData[cBitsLeft >> 5] >> ( cBitsLeft & 0x1F ) ) & 1u;
		if ( bBitSet )
		{
			Multiply( base );
			Modulo( modulus, barrett );
		}
	}

	base.Destroy();
	remainder.Destroy();
	barrett.Destroy();
}

} // namespace vac::crypto::bigint
```

```hpp
namespace vac::crypto::hash
```
