```hpp
namespace detail
{

struct Crc32Table_t
{
	u32 m_rgunEntries[256];
};

constexpr Crc32Table_t MakeCrc32Table() noexcept
{
	Crc32Table_t table{};
	for ( u32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < 256; ++iEntry )
	{
		u32 unValue = iEntry;
		for ( u32 iBit = 0; iBit < 8; ++iBit )
			unValue = ( unValue & 1 ) ? ( ( unValue >> 1 ) ^ 0xEDB88320u ) : ( unValue >> 1 );
		table.m_rgunEntries[iEntry] = unValue;
	}
	return table;
}

inline constexpr Crc32Table_t k_Crc32Table = MakeCrc32Table();

} // namespace detail

struct Crc32_t
{
	u32 m_unState = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

	constexpr Crc32_t() = default;
	constexpr explicit Crc32_t( u32 unInitial ) noexcept : m_unState{ unInitial } {}

	constexpr Crc32_t &Update( const u8 *pubData, usize cubData ) noexcept
	{
		for ( usize ib = 0; ib < cubData; ++ib )
			m_unState = detail::k_Crc32Table.m_rgunEntries[( m_unState ^ pubData[ib] ) & 0xFFu] ^ ( m_unState >> 8 );
		return *this;
	}

	[[nodiscard]] constexpr u32 Value() const noexcept { return ~m_unState; }

	// @orig: 53 55 8B E9 56
	[[nodiscard]] static constexpr u32 Of( const u8 *pubData, usize cubData ) noexcept
	{
		return Crc32_t{}.Update( pubData, cubData ).Value();
	}
};

} // namespace vac::crypto::hash
```

```cpp
inline u32 RotateLeft( u32 unValue, u32 cBits ) noexcept
{
	return ( unValue << cBits ) | ( unValue >> ( 32 - cBits ) );
}

inline void RoundF( u32 &unA, u32 unB, u32 unC, u32 unD, u32 unWord, u32 cBits, u32 unConstant ) noexcept
{
	unA = unB + RotateLeft( unA + ( ( unB & unC ) | ( ~unB & unD ) ) + unWord + unConstant, cBits );
}

inline void RoundG( u32 &unA, u32 unB, u32 unC, u32 unD, u32 unWord, u32 cBits, u32 unConstant ) noexcept
{
	unA = unB + RotateLeft( unA + ( ( unB & unD ) | ( unC & ~unD ) ) + unWord + unConstant, cBits );
}

inline void RoundH( u32 &unA, u32 unB, u32 unC, u32 unD, u32 unWord, u32 cBits, u32 unConstant ) noexcept
{
	unA = unB + RotateLeft( unA + ( unB ^ unC ^ unD ) + unWord + unConstant, cBits );
}

inline void RoundI( u32 &unA, u32 unB, u32 unC, u32 unD, u32 unWord, u32 cBits, u32 unConstant ) noexcept
{
	unA = unB + RotateLeft( unA + ( unC ^ ( unB | ~unD ) ) + unWord + unConstant, cBits );
}

// @orig: 53 8B D9 55 56
void Md5_t::Update( const u8 *pubData, usize cubData ) noexcept
{
	u32 ibBuffer = static_cast<u32>( ( m_ulBitCount >> 3 ) & 0x3F );
	m_ulBitCount += static_cast<u64>( cubData ) << 3;

	const u32 cubPart = 64 - ibBuffer;
	usize ibData = 0;
	if ( cubData >= cubPart )
	{
		memcpy( &m_rgubBuffer[ibBuffer], pubData, cubPart );
		Transform( m_rgubBuffer );
		for ( ibData = cubPart; ibData + 63 < cubData; ibData += 64 )
			Transform( &pubData[ibData] );
		ibBuffer = 0;
	}
	if ( ibData < cubData )
		memcpy( &m_rgubBuffer[ibBuffer], &pubData[ibData], cubData - ibData );
}

// @orig: 53 55 56 8B F2
void Md5_t::Final( u8 *pubDigest ) noexcept
{
	u8 rgubLength[8];
	memcpy( rgubLength, &m_ulBitCount, sizeof( rgubLength ) );

	static const u8 k_rgubPadding[64] = { 0x80 };
	const u32 ibBuffer = static_cast<u32>( ( m_ulBitCount >> 3 ) & 0x3F );
	const u32 cubPadding = ( ibBuffer < 56 ) ? ( 56 - ibBuffer ) : ( 120 - ibBuffer );
	Update( k_rgubPadding, cubPadding );
	Update( rgubLength, 8 );

	for ( u32 iWord = 0; iWord < 4; ++iWord )
	{
		pubDigest[iWord * 4] = static_cast<u8>( m_rgunState[iWord] );
		pubDigest[iWord * 4 + 1] = static_cast<u8>( m_rgunState[iWord] >> 8 );
		pubDigest[iWord * 4 + 2] = static_cast<u8>( m_rgunState[iWord] >> 16 );
		pubDigest[iWord * 4 + 3] = static_cast<u8>( m_rgunState[iWord] >> 24 );
	}

	memset( this, 0, sizeof( *this ) );
}
```

```cpp
		DecryptBlock( key, pubIn + iBlock * k_cubBlock, pubOut + iBlock * k_cubBlock );
```

```hpp
// @binary: 9b85c913
#pragma once

#include "core/types.hpp"
#include "crypto/ice/internal/round.hpp"

namespace vac::crypto::ice
{

inline constexpr usize k_cubBlock = 8;
inline constexpr usize k_cubKey = 8;
inline constexpr usize k_cRounds = 16;

struct IceKey_t
{
	i32 m_nSize;
	i32 m_cRounds;
	u32 m_rgrgunSchedule[k_cRounds][3];

	// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 57
	constexpr explicit IceKey_t( const u8 ( &rgubKey )[k_cubKey] ) noexcept
	    : m_nSize{ 1 }, m_cRounds{ static_cast<i32>( k_cRounds ) }, m_rgrgunSchedule{}
	{
		u16 rgunWords[4]{};
		for ( usize iWord = 0; iWord < 4; ++iWord )
		{
			rgunWords[3 - iWord] = static_cast<u16>( ( static_cast<u16>( rgubKey[iWord * 2] ) << 8 ) |
			                                         static_cast<u16>( rgubKey[iWord * 2 + 1] ) );
		}
		BuildSchedule( 0, &detail::k_rgunKeyRot[0], rgunWords );
		BuildSchedule( 8, &detail::k_rgunKeyRot[8], rgunWords );
	}

private:
	// @orig: 83 EC ? 53 55 56 33 F6
	constexpr void BuildSchedule( usize iRound, const u32 *punKeyRot, u16 ( &rgunWords )[4] ) noexcept
	{
		for ( usize iStep = 0; iStep < 8; ++iStep )
		{
			const u32 unRotation = punKeyRot[iStep];
			u32( &rgunSubkey )[3] = m_rgrgunSchedule[iRound + iStep];
			rgunSubkey[0] = rgunSubkey[1] = rgunSubkey[2] = 0;

			for ( usize iBit = 0; iBit < 15; ++iBit )
			{
				u32 &unTarget = rgunSubkey[iBit % 3];
				for ( usize iWord = 0; iWord < 4; ++iWord )
				{
					u16 &unWord = rgunWords[( unRotation + iWord ) & 3];
					const u32 unBit = static_cast<u32>( unWord ) & 1;
					unTarget = ( unTarget << 1 ) | unBit;
					unWord = static_cast<u16>( ( unWord >> 1 ) | ( ( unBit ^ 1 ) << 15 ) );
				}
			}
		}
	}
};
static_assert( sizeof( IceKey_t ) == 200, "IceKey_t is two ints and sixteen subkeys" );

namespace detail
{

constexpr void ReadBlockBe( const u8 *pubIn, u32 &unLeft, u32 &unRight ) noexcept
{
	unLeft = ( u32( pubIn[0] ) << 24 ) | ( u32( pubIn[1] ) << 16 ) | ( u32( pubIn[2] ) << 8 ) | u32( pubIn[3] );
	unRight = ( u32( pubIn[4] ) << 24 ) | ( u32( pubIn[5] ) << 16 ) | ( u32( pubIn[6] ) << 8 ) | u32( pubIn[7] );
}

constexpr void WriteBlockBe( u8 *pubOut, u32 unRight, u32 unLeft ) noexcept
{
	for ( usize ib = 0; ib < 4; ++ib )
	{
		pubOut[3 - ib] = static_cast<u8>( unRight );
		unRight >>= 8;
		pubOut[7 - ib] = static_cast<u8>( unLeft );
		unLeft >>= 8;
	}
}

} // namespace detail

// @orig: 8B 54 24 ? 53 55 8B E9 0F B6 1A
constexpr void EncryptBlock( const IceKey_t &key, const u8 *pubIn, u8 *pubOut ) noexcept
{
	u32 unLeft = 0;
	u32 unRight = 0;
	detail::ReadBlockBe( pubIn, unLeft, unRight );
	for ( usize iRound = 0; iRound < k_cRounds; iRound += 2 )
	{
		unLeft ^= detail::FRound( unRight, key.m_rgrgunSchedule[iRound] );
		unRight ^= detail::FRound( unLeft, key.m_rgrgunSchedule[iRound + 1] );
	}
	detail::WriteBlockBe( pubOut, unRight, unLeft );
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 8B 55
constexpr void DecryptBlock( const IceKey_t &key, const u8 *pubIn, u8 *pubOut ) noexcept
{
	u32 unLeft = 0;
	u32 unRight = 0;
	detail::ReadBlockBe( pubIn, unLeft, unRight );
	for ( usize iRound = k_cRounds; iRound > 0; iRound -= 2 )
	{
		unLeft ^= detail::FRound( unRight, key.m_rgrgunSchedule[iRound - 1] );
		unRight ^= detail::FRound( unLeft, key.m_rgrgunSchedule[iRound - 2] );
	}
	detail::WriteBlockBe( pubOut, unRight, unLeft );
}

inline void EncryptBlock( const u8 ( &rgubKey )[k_cubKey], const u8 *pubIn, u8 *pubOut ) noexcept
{
	EncryptBlock( IceKey_t{ rgubKey }, pubIn, pubOut );
}

inline void DecryptBlock( const u8 ( &rgubKey )[k_cubKey], const u8 *pubIn, u8 *pubOut ) noexcept
{
	DecryptBlock( IceKey_t{ rgubKey }, pubIn, pubOut );
}

inline void EncryptBlock( const u8 *pubKey, const u8 *pubIn, u8 *pubOut ) noexcept
{
	u8 rgubKey[k_cubKey]{};
	for ( usize ib = 0; ib < k_cubKey; ++ib )
		rgubKey[ib] = pubKey[ib];
	EncryptBlock( IceKey_t{ rgubKey }, pubIn, pubOut );
}

inline void DecryptBlock( const u8 *pubKey, const u8 *pubIn, u8 *pubOut ) noexcept
{
	u8 rgubKey[k_cubKey]{};
	for ( usize ib = 0; ib < k_cubKey; ++ib )
		rgubKey[ib] = pubKey[ib];
	DecryptBlock( IceKey_t{ rgubKey }, pubIn, pubOut );
}

void EncryptBuffer( const IceKey_t &key, const u8 *pubIn, usize cubData, u8 *pubOut ) noexcept;
void DecryptBuffer( const IceKey_t &key, const u8 *pubIn, usize cubData, u8 *pubOut ) noexcept;
void EncryptBuffer( const u8 ( &rgubKey )[k_cubKey], const u8 *pubIn, usize cubData, u8 *pubOut ) noexcept;
void DecryptBuffer( const u8 ( &rgubKey )[k_cubKey], const u8 *pubIn, usize cubData, u8 *pubOut ) noexcept;
void EncryptBuffer( const u8 *pubKey, const u8 *pubIn, usize cubData, u8 *pubOut ) noexcept;
void DecryptBuffer( const u8 *pubKey, const u8 *pubIn, usize cubData, u8 *pubOut ) noexcept;
```

```hpp
// @binary: 9b85c913
#pragma once

#include "core/types.hpp"
#include "crypto/ice/internal/sbox.hpp"

namespace vac::crypto::ice::detail
{

constexpr u32 RotateRight( u32 unValue, u32 cBits ) noexcept
{
	return ( unValue >> cBits ) | ( unValue << ( 32 - cBits ) );
}

// @orig: 53 55 56 8B F1 BD
constexpr u32 FRound( u32 unHalf, const u32 ( &rgunSubkey )[3] ) noexcept
{
	const u32 unLeft = ( ( unHalf >> 16 ) & 0x3FF ) | ( RotateRight( unHalf, 14 ) & 0xFFC00 );
	const u32 unRight = ( unHalf & 0x3FF ) | ( ( unHalf & 0x3FF00 ) << 2 );

	const u32 unMask = rgunSubkey[2] & ( unLeft ^ unRight );
	const u32 unMixedLeft = unLeft ^ unMask ^ rgunSubkey[0];
	const u32 unMixedRight = unRight ^ unMask ^ rgunSubkey[1];

	return k_Sbox0.m_rgunEntries[unMixedLeft >> 10] ^ k_Sbox1.m_rgunEntries[unMixedLeft & 0x3FF] ^
	       k_Sbox2.m_rgunEntries[unMixedRight >> 10] ^ k_Sbox3.m_rgunEntries[unMixedRight & 0x3FF];
}

} // namespace vac::crypto::ice::detail
```

`sdk/src/crypto/ice/internal/sbox.hpp`:

```hpp
// @binary: 9b85c913
#pragma once

#include "core/types.hpp"
#include "crypto/ice/internal/constants.hpp"

// @note / sapdragon: the original builds its s-boxes on first use, here they are compile-time data

namespace vac::crypto::ice::detail
{

// @orig: 53 56 57 8B FA
constexpr u32 GfMult( u32 unA, u32 unB, u32 unModulus ) noexcept
{
	u32 unResult = 0;
	while ( unB )
	{
		if ( unB & 1 )
			unResult ^= unA;
		unB >>= 1;
		unA <<= 1;
		if ( unA >= 0x100 )
			unA ^= unModulus;
	}
	return unResult;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 57 8B FA
constexpr u32 GfExp7( u32 unBase, u32 unModulus ) noexcept
{
	if ( !unBase )
		return 0;
	u32 unValue = GfMult( unBase, unBase, unModulus );
	unValue = GfMult( unBase, unValue, unModulus );
	unValue = GfMult( unValue, unValue, unModulus );
	return GfMult( unBase, unValue, unModulus );
}

// @orig: 33 C0 BA
constexpr u32 Permute32( u32 unValue ) noexcept
{
	u32 unResult = 0;
	for ( u32 iBit = 0; iBit < 32; ++iBit )
	{
		if ( unValue & 1 )
			unResult |= k_rgunPbox[iBit];
		unValue >>= 1;
		if ( !unValue )
			break;
	}
	return unResult;
}

struct Sbox_t
{
	u32 m_rgunEntries[1024];
};

// @orig: 53 56 57 33 DB
template <usize iBox>
constexpr Sbox_t MakeSbox() noexcept
{
	Sbox_t box{};
	for ( usize iEntry = 0; iEntry < 1024; ++iEntry )
	{
		const u32 iColumn = static_cast<u32>( ( iEntry >> 1 ) & 0xFF );
		const u32 iRow = static_cast<u32>( ( iEntry & 1 ) | ( ( iEntry >> 8 ) & 2 ) );
		const u32 unInput = iColumn ^ k_rgrgunSxor[iBox][iRow];
		const u32 unExponent = GfExp7( unInput, k_rgrgunSmod[iBox][iRow] );
		const u32 cShift = static_cast<u32>( ( 3 - iBox ) * 8 );
		box.m_rgunEntries[iEntry] = Permute32( unExponent << cShift );
	}
	return box;
}

inline constexpr Sbox_t k_Sbox0 = MakeSbox<0>();
inline constexpr Sbox_t k_Sbox1 = MakeSbox<1>();
inline constexpr Sbox_t k_Sbox2 = MakeSbox<2>();
inline constexpr Sbox_t k_Sbox3 = MakeSbox<3>();

} // namespace vac::crypto::ice::detail
```

`sdk/src/crypto/random/park_miller.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 9b85c913
#include "crypto/random/park_miller.hpp"

namespace vac::crypto::random
{

namespace
{

constexpr i32 k_nMultiplier = 16807;
constexpr i32 k_nModulus = 0x7FFFFFFF;
constexpr i32 k_nQuotient = 127773;
constexpr i32 k_cWarmupRounds = 40;
constexpr i32 k_cShuffle = 32;

// @note / sapdragon: relies on signed wrap, both products overflow the same way
constexpr i32 Step( i32 nSeed ) noexcept
{
	const i32 nResult = static_cast<i32>( static_cast<u32>( k_nMultiplier ) * static_cast<u32>( nSeed ) -
	                                      static_cast<u32>( k_nModulus ) * static_cast<u32>( nSeed / k_nQuotient ) );
	return nResult < 0 ? nResult + k_nModulus : nResult;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: inlined
ParkMiller_t::ParkMiller_t( u32 unSeed ) noexcept : m_rgnShuffle{}
{
	// @note / sapdragon: the seed gets negated, so any positive seed collapses to 1. same in the original
	i32 nSeed = static_cast<i32>( 0u - unSeed );
	if ( nSeed < 1 )
		nSeed = 1;

	for ( i32 iRound = k_cWarmupRounds - 1; iRound >= 0; --iRound )
	{
		nSeed = Step( nSeed );
		if ( iRound < k_cShuffle )
			m_rgnShuffle[iRound] = nSeed;
	}
	m_nSeed = nSeed;
	m_nOutput = m_rgnShuffle[0];
}

// @orig: 51 53 56 57 8B F9
u32 ParkMiller_t::Next() noexcept
{
	const i32 nSeed = Step( m_nSeed );

	const u32 iBucket = static_cast<u32>( m_nOutput ) >> 26;
	m_nOutput = m_rgnShuffle[iBucket];
	m_rgnShuffle[iBucket] = nSeed;
	m_nSeed = nSeed;
	return static_cast<u32>( m_nOutput );
}

} // namespace vac::crypto::random
```

```cpp
// @binary: 9b85c913
#include "crypto/rsa/rsa.hpp"
#include "util/asn1.hpp"

namespace vac::crypto::rsa
{

namespace
{

constexpr u8 k_rgubRsaEncryptionId[] = {
    0x30, 0x0D, 0x06, 0x09, 0x2A, 0x86, 0x48, 0x86, 0xF7, 0x0D, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x05, 0x00,
};

constexpr bool BytesEqual( const u8 *pubA, const u8 *pubB, usize cub ) noexcept
{
	for ( usize ib = 0; ib < cub; ++ib )
	{
		if ( pubA[ib] != pubB[ib] )
			return false;
	}
	return true;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 51 51 53 55 56
bool ParsePublicKey( const u8 *pubKey, u32 cubKey, bigint::Bignum_t &exponent, bigint::Bignum_t &modulus ) noexcept
{
	const u8 *pubOuter;
	u32 cubOuter;
	if ( !util::ParseTlv( util::EAsn1Tag::Sequence, pubKey, cubKey, pubOuter, cubOuter ) )
		return false;
	if ( cubOuter <= sizeof( k_rgubRsaEncryptionId ) )
		return false;

	if ( !BytesEqual( pubOuter, k_rgubRsaEncryptionId, sizeof( k_rgubRsaEncryptionId ) ) )
		return false;
	const u8 *pubAfterId = pubOuter + sizeof( k_rgubRsaEncryptionId );
	const u32 cubAfterId = cubOuter - sizeof( k_rgubRsaEncryptionId );

	const u8 *pubBitString;
	u32 cubBitString;
	if ( !util::ParseTlv( util::EAsn1Tag::BitString, pubAfterId, cubAfterId, pubBitString, cubBitString ) )
		return false;
	if ( cubBitString == 0 )
		return false;

	const u8 *pubSpki = pubBitString + 1;
	const u32 cubSpki = cubBitString - 1;

	const u8 *pubInner;
	u32 cubInner;
	if ( !util::ParseTlv( util::EAsn1Tag::Sequence, pubSpki, cubSpki, pubInner, cubInner ) )
		return false;

	const u8 *pubModulus;
	u32 cubModulus;
	if ( !util::ParseTlv( util::EAsn1Tag::Integer, pubInner, cubInner, pubModulus, cubModulus ) )
		return false;

	const u32 ibExponent = u32( ( pubModulus - pubInner ) + cubModulus );
	if ( ibExponent > cubInner )
		return false;
	const u8 *pubExponent;
	u32 cubExponent;
	if ( !util::ParseTlv( util::EAsn1Tag::Integer, pubInner + ibExponent, cubInner - ibExponent, pubExponent,
	                      cubExponent ) )
		return false;

	if ( cubModulus > 0 && pubModulus[0] == 0 )
	{
		++pubModulus;
		--cubModulus;
	}
	if ( cubExponent > 0 && pubExponent[0] == 0 )
	{
		++pubExponent;
		--cubExponent;
	}

	modulus.SetBytes( pubModulus, cubModulus );
	exponent.SetBytes( pubExponent, cubExponent );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 8B 94 24
bool EncryptSessionKey( const u8 *pubSessionKey, u32 cubSessionKey, const u8 *pubKey, u32 cubKey, u8 *pubOutput,
                        u32 *pcubOutput, ERsaError *peError ) noexcept
{
	*peError = ERsaError::Ok;

	bigint::Bignum_t exponent;
	bigint::Bignum_t modulus;
	if ( !ParsePublicKey( pubKey, cubKey, exponent, modulus ) )
	{
		*peError = ERsaError::ParseFailed;
		exponent.Destroy();
		modulus.Destroy();
		return false;
	}

	if ( modulus.m_cBits > 8192 )
	{
		*peError = ERsaError::BadKeySize;
		exponent.Destroy();
		modulus.Destroy();
		return false;
	}

	bigint::Bignum_t message;
	message.SetBytes( pubSessionKey, cubSessionKey );

	message.ModExp( exponent, modulus );

	const u32 cubResult = ( message.m_cBits + 7 ) >> 3;
	if ( cubResult > 1024 )
	{
		*peError = ERsaError::BadKeySize;
		message.Destroy();
		exponent.Destroy();
		modulus.Destroy();
		return false;
	}

	if ( cubResult > *pcubOutput )
	{
		*peError = ERsaError::BufferTooSmall;
		*pcubOutput = cubResult;
		message.Destroy();
		exponent.Destroy();
		modulus.Destroy();
		return false;
	}

	const u32 cubPadding = *pcubOutput - cubResult;
	for ( u32 ib = 0; ib < cubPadding; ++ib )
		pubOutput[ib] = 0;
	const auto *pubMessage = reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( message.m_punData );
	for ( u32 ib = 0; ib < cubResult; ++ib )
		pubOutput[cubPadding + ib] = pubMessage[cubResult - 1 - ib];

	message.Destroy();
	exponent.Destroy();
	modulus.Destroy();
	return true;
}

} // namespace vac::crypto::rsa
```

```cpp
// @binary: 42878040
#include "file/file.hpp"

namespace vac::file
{

// @orig: 8B 81 ? ? ? ? 83 F8
u32 GetFileSizeOrZero( const SystemImports_t *pImports, HANDLE hFile ) noexcept
{
	if ( hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return 0;
	const DWORD cubSize = pImports->GetFileSize( hFile, nullptr );
	return cubSize == INVALID_FILE_SIZE ? 0 : cubSize;
}

bool GetFileSize32( const SystemImports_t *pImports, HANDLE hFile, u32 *pcubSize ) noexcept
{
	*pcubSize = 0;
	if ( !pImports )
		return false;

	if ( pImports->GetFileSizeEx )
	{
		LARGE_INTEGER liSize;
		liSize.QuadPart = 0;
		if ( !pImports->GetFileSizeEx( hFile, &liSize ) || liSize.QuadPart < 0 || liSize.HighPart != 0 )
			return false;
		*pcubSize = liSize.LowPart;
		return true;
	}

	if ( pImports->GetFileSize )
	{
		DWORD unHigh = 0;
		const DWORD unLow = pImports->GetFileSize( hFile, &unHigh );
		if ( unLow == INVALID_FILE_SIZE && pImports->GetLastError && pImports->GetLastError() != NO_ERROR )
			return false;
		if ( unHigh )
			return false;
		*pcubSize = unLow;
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

bool ReadWholeFile( const SystemImports_t *pImports, HANDLE hFile, u8 **ppubData, u32 *pcubData,
                    bool bAllowLinkedHeap ) noexcept
{
	*ppubData = nullptr;
	*pcubData = 0;
	if ( !pImports || !pImports->ReadFile )
		return false;
	if ( !bAllowLinkedHeap && ( !pImports->HeapAlloc || !pImports->HeapFree || !pImports->GetProcessHeap ) )
		return false;

	u32 cubFile = 0;
	if ( !GetFileSize32( pImports, hFile, &cubFile ) || !cubFile )
		return false;

	HANDLE hHeap = pImports->GetProcessHeap ? pImports->GetProcessHeap() : GetProcessHeap();
	auto *pubBuffer = static_cast<u8 *>( pImports->HeapAlloc ? pImports->HeapAlloc( hHeap, 0, cubFile )
	                                                         : ::HeapAlloc( hHeap, 0, cubFile ) );
	if ( !pubBuffer )
		return false;

	u32 cubTotal = 0;
	while ( cubTotal < cubFile )
	{
		DWORD cubRead = 0;
		const u32 cubWanted = ( cubFile - cubTotal ) > 0x10000u ? 0x10000u : ( cubFile - cubTotal );
		if ( !pImports->ReadFile( hFile, pubBuffer + cubTotal, cubWanted, &cubRead, nullptr ) || !cubRead )
		{
			FreeWholeFile( pImports, pubBuffer, bAllowLinkedHeap );
			return false;
		}
		cubTotal += cubRead;
	}

	*ppubData = pubBuffer;
	*pcubData = cubFile;
	return true;
}

void FreeWholeFile( const SystemImports_t *pImports, u8 *pubData, bool bAllowLinkedHeap ) noexcept
{
	if ( !bAllowLinkedHeap )
	{
		pImports->HeapFree( pImports->GetProcessHeap(), 0, pubData );
		return;
	}

	HANDLE hHeap = pImports && pImports->GetProcessHeap ? pImports->GetProcessHeap() : GetProcessHeap();
	if ( pImports && pImports->HeapFree )
		pImports->HeapFree( hHeap, 0, pubData );
	else
		::HeapFree( hHeap, 0, pubData );
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 83 3D
EOpenByIdStatus OpenByVolumeAndId( const SystemImports_t *pImports, u32 unVolumeSerial, u64 ulFileId,
                                   DWORD unDesiredAccess, HANDLE *phFile, u32 *punLastError ) noexcept
{
	*phFile = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
	*punLastError = 0;

	if ( !pImports || !pImports->FindFirstVolumeW || !pImports->FindNextVolumeW || !pImports->FindVolumeClose ||
	     !pImports->GetVolumeInformationW || !pImports->CreateFileW || !pImports->CloseHandle ||
	     !pImports->OpenFileById )
		return EOpenByIdStatus::ImportsMissing;

	wchar_t wszVolume[MAX_PATH];
	memset( wszVolume, 0, sizeof( wszVolume ) );
	HANDLE hFind = pImports->FindFirstVolumeW( wszVolume, MAX_PATH );
	if ( hFind == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
	{
		*punLastError = pImports->GetLastError();
		return EOpenByIdStatus::FindFirstFailed;
	}

	for ( ;; )
	{
		DWORD unSerial = 0;
		if ( pImports->GetVolumeInformationW( wszVolume, nullptr, 0, &unSerial, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, 0 ) &&
		     unSerial == unVolumeSerial )
		{
			// @note / sapdragon: without the trailing slash the volume name opens the volume itself
			const u32 cChars = util::wstr::Length( wszVolume );
			if ( cChars > 1 )
				wszVolume[cChars - 1] = 0;

			HANDLE hRoot = pImports->CreateFileW( wszVolume, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, nullptr,
			                                      OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr );
			if ( hRoot != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
			{
				FILE_ID_DESCRIPTOR descriptor{};
				descriptor.dwSize = sizeof( descriptor );
				descriptor.Type = FileIdType;
				descriptor.FileId.QuadPart = static_cast<LONGLONG>( ulFileId );

				HANDLE hFile = pImports->OpenFileById( hRoot, &descriptor, unDesiredAccess,
				                                       FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nullptr,
				                                       FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS );
				*punLastError = pImports->GetLastError();
				pImports->CloseHandle( hRoot );
				pImports->FindVolumeClose( hFind );

				if ( hFile == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
					return EOpenByIdStatus::OpenFailed;
				*phFile = hFile;
				return EOpenByIdStatus::Ok;
			}
			*punLastError = pImports->GetLastError();
		}

		if ( !pImports->FindNextVolumeW( hFind, wszVolume, MAX_PATH ) )
		{
			pImports->FindVolumeClose( hFind );
			return EOpenByIdStatus::NoVolumeMatched;
		}
	}
}
```

```hpp
#include "bootstrap/imports.hpp"
#include "core/types.hpp"

namespace vac::file
{

enum class EOpenByIdStatus : u32
{
	Ok = 0,
	ImportsMissing = 78,
	FindFirstFailed = 91,
	OpenFailed = 92,
	NoVolumeMatched = 93,
};
```

```cpp
// @binary: 42878040
#include "pe/pe.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "util/strings.hpp"

namespace vac::pe
{

namespace
{

constexpr char k_szTextSection[] = ".text";
constexpr char k_szOverlaySection[] = ".extra";

} // namespace

const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY *GetDataDirectory( const void *pOptionalHeader, bool bPe64, u32 iDirectory ) noexcept
{
	if ( bPe64 )
		return &static_cast<const IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 *>( pOptionalHeader )->DataDirectory[iDirectory];
	return &static_cast<const IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32 *>( pOptionalHeader )->DataDirectory[iDirectory];
}

// @orig: 56 0F B7 B1
const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *FindSectionByRva( const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSections, u32 cSections, u32 unRva ) noexcept
{
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = pSections[iSection];
		u32 cubExtent = section.SizeOfRawData;
		if ( cubExtent )
		{
			if ( section.Misc.VirtualSize )
				cubExtent = section.Misc.VirtualSize;
			if ( unRva >= section.VirtualAddress && unRva < section.VirtualAddress + cubExtent )
				return &section;
		}
	}
	return nullptr;
}

// @orig: 53 0F B7 99 ? ? ? ? 83 CA
u32 RvaToFileOffset( const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSections, u32 cSections, u32 unRva ) noexcept
{
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = pSections[iSection];
		if ( unRva >= section.VirtualAddress && unRva < section.VirtualAddress + section.SizeOfRawData )
			return unRva + section.PointerToRawData - section.VirtualAddress;
	}
	return k_unInvalidOffset;
}

bool RvaToFileOffsetLargestSpan( const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSections, u32 cSections, u32 unRva,
                                 u32 *pibFileOffset ) noexcept
{
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = pSections[iSection];
		u32 cubSpan = section.Misc.VirtualSize;
		if ( cubSpan < section.SizeOfRawData )
			cubSpan = section.SizeOfRawData;
		if ( unRva >= section.VirtualAddress && unRva < section.VirtualAddress + cubSpan )
		{
			*pibFileOffset = section.PointerToRawData + unRva - section.VirtualAddress;
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
}

// @orig: 51 80 B9
void SplitAroundDirectory( u32 unDirectoryVa, u32 cubDirectory, u32 unStart, u32 unEnd, RangePair_t &ranges ) noexcept
{
	ranges.m_rgunStart[0] = ranges.m_rgunEnd[0] = ranges.m_rgunStart[1] = ranges.m_rgunEnd[1] = 0;

	u32 unCutStart = unDirectoryVa;
	if ( unCutStart < unStart )
		unCutStart = unStart;

	// @note / sapdragon: the sum can wrap on a corrupt directory. no clamp, valve's check does not have one either
	u32 unCutEnd = unEnd;
	if ( unDirectoryVa + cubDirectory + 4 < unEnd )
		unCutEnd = unDirectoryVa + cubDirectory + 4;

	if ( unCutStart >= unCutEnd )
	{
		ranges.m_rgunStart[0] = unStart;
		ranges.m_rgunEnd[0] = unEnd;
		return;
	}

	if ( unCutEnd < unEnd )
	{
		ranges.m_rgunStart[1] = unCutEnd;
		ranges.m_rgunEnd[1] = unEnd;
	}
	if ( unCutStart <= unStart )
	{
		ranges.m_rgunStart[0] = ranges.m_rgunStart[1];
		ranges.m_rgunEnd[0] = ranges.m_rgunEnd[1];
		ranges.m_rgunStart[1] = 0;
		ranges.m_rgunEnd[1] = 0;
	}
	else
	{
		ranges.m_rgunStart[0] = unStart;
		ranges.m_rgunEnd[0] = unCutStart;
	}
}

// @note / sapdragon: rebuilt modules' behaviour, not valve's loop. the original fails on unknown entry types and
// patches a value that crosses the chunk end, this skips both
// @orig: 51 51 8B 44 24
bool ApplyRelocationsForHash( const u8 *pubFile, u32 cubFile, const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSections, u32 cSections,
                              const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &relocations, u32 unImageBase, u32 unChunkRva, u8 *pubChunk,
                              u32 cubChunk ) noexcept
{
	if ( !relocations.VirtualAddress || relocations.Size < sizeof( IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION ) || !unImageBase )
		return true;

	u32 ibRelocations = 0;
	if ( !RvaToFileOffsetLargestSpan( pSections, cSections, relocations.VirtualAddress, &ibRelocations ) ||
	     ibRelocations >= cubFile )
		return true;

	const u32 unDelta = unImageBase - k_unRelocationBase;
	const u32 cubAvailable = cubFile - ibRelocations;
	const u32 cubRelocations = relocations.Size < cubAvailable ? relocations.Size : cubAvailable;
	const u32 unChunkEnd = unChunkRva + cubChunk;

	u32 ibBlock = 0;
	u32 cBlocks = 0;
	while ( ibBlock + sizeof( IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION ) <= cubRelocations && cBlocks++ < 0x10000 )
	{
		const u8 *pubBlock = pubFile + ibRelocations + ibBlock;
		const u32 unPageRva = util::Read32( pubBlock );
		const u32 cubBlock = util::Read32( pubBlock + 4 );
		if ( cubBlock < sizeof( IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION ) || ibBlock + cubBlock > cubRelocations )
			return false;

		if ( unPageRva + 0x1000 > unChunkRva && unPageRva < unChunkEnd )
		{
			const u32 cEntries = ( cubBlock - sizeof( IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION ) ) >> 1;
			for ( u32 iEntry = 0; iEntry < cEntries; ++iEntry )
			{
				const u8 *pubEntry = pubBlock + sizeof( IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION ) + iEntry * 2u;
				const u16 unEntry = static_cast<u16>( pubEntry[0] | ( static_cast<u16>( pubEntry[1] ) << 8 ) );
				if ( ( unEntry >> 12 ) != IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGHLOW )
					continue;

				const u32 unPatchRva = unPageRva + ( unEntry & 0x0FFFu );
				if ( unPatchRva < unChunkRva || unPatchRva + 4u > unChunkEnd )
					continue;

				u8 *pubValue = pubChunk + unPatchRva - unChunkRva;
				const u32 unValue = util::Read32( pubValue ) - unDelta;
				memcpy( pubValue, &unValue, sizeof( unValue ) );
			}
		}

		ibBlock += cubBlock;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 8B 45
bool HashSection( const u8 *pubFile, u32 cubFile, const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section,
                  const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSections, u32 cSections, const void *pOptionalHeader, bool bPe64,
                  u32 unImageBase32, crypto::hash::Md5_t &md5 ) noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY *pIat = GetDataDirectory( pOptionalHeader, bPe64, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IAT );
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY *pExport = GetDataDirectory( pOptionalHeader, bPe64, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT );
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY *pRelocations =
	    GetDataDirectory( pOptionalHeader, bPe64, IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC );

	RangePair_t iatSplit;
	SplitAroundDirectory( pIat->VirtualAddress, pIat->Size, section.VirtualAddress,
	                      section.VirtualAddress + section.SizeOfRawData, iatSplit );

	RangePair_t first;
	RangePair_t second;
	SplitAroundDirectory( pExport->VirtualAddress, pExport->Size, iatSplit.m_rgunStart[0], iatSplit.m_rgunEnd[0],
	                      first );
	SplitAroundDirectory( pExport->VirtualAddress, pExport->Size, iatSplit.m_rgunStart[1], iatSplit.m_rgunEnd[1],
	                      second );

	const u32 rgunStarts[] = { first.m_rgunStart[0], first.m_rgunStart[1], second.m_rgunStart[0],
	                           second.m_rgunStart[1] };
	const u32 rgunEnds[] = { first.m_rgunEnd[0], first.m_rgunEnd[1], second.m_rgunEnd[0], second.m_rgunEnd[1] };

	u8 rgubChunk[4096];
	for ( u32 iRange = 0; iRange < ARRAYSIZE( rgunStarts ); ++iRange )
	{
		if ( rgunEnds[iRange] <= rgunStarts[iRange] )
			continue;

		u32 unRva = rgunStarts[iRange];
		u32 cubLeft = rgunEnds[iRange] - rgunStarts[iRange];
		while ( cubLeft )
		{
			const u32 cubChunk = cubLeft > sizeof( rgubChunk ) ? sizeof( rgubChunk ) : cubLeft;
			const u32 ibFile = section.PointerToRawData + unRva - section.VirtualAddress;
			if ( ibFile > cubFile || cubChunk > cubFile - ibFile )
				return false;

			memcpy( rgubChunk, pubFile + ibFile, cubChunk );
			if ( !bPe64 && !ApplyRelocationsForHash( pubFile, cubFile, pSections, cSections, *pRelocations,
			                                         unImageBase32, unRva, rgubChunk, cubChunk ) )
				return false;

			md5.Update( rgubChunk, cubChunk );
			unRva += cubChunk;
			cubLeft -= cubChunk;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: inlined
const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *SelectHashSection( const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSections, u32 cSections ) noexcept
{
	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSelected = nullptr;
	u32 cubLargest = 0;
	bool bFoundText = false;
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = pSections[iSection];
		const bool bExecutable = ( section.Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE ) != 0;

		bool bText = true;
		for ( u32 iChar = 0; iChar < sizeof( k_szTextSection ) - 1; ++iChar )
		{
			if ( section.Name[iChar] != static_cast<unsigned char>( k_szTextSection[iChar] ) )
			{
				bText = false;
				break;
			}
		}

		if ( bText && bExecutable )
		{
			pSelected = &section;
			bFoundText = true;
		}
		if ( !bFoundText && bExecutable && section.SizeOfRawData > cubLargest )
		{
			pSelected = &section;
			cubLargest = section.SizeOfRawData;
		}
	}
	return pSelected;
}

// @orig: 51 53 55 56 8B F1 57 83 BE
bool AppendOverlaySection( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSections, u32 *pcSections, u32 cubFile,
                           u32 unSectionAlignment ) noexcept
{
	const u32 cSections = *pcSections;
	u32 ibRawEnd = 0;

	// @note / sapdragon: a vectorized loop would reference the crt's __isa_available
#pragma loop( no_vector )
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < cSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const u32 ibSectionEnd = pSections[iSection].PointerToRawData + pSections[iSection].SizeOfRawData;
		if ( ibSectionEnd > ibRawEnd )
			ibRawEnd = ibSectionEnd;
	}

	if ( !cSections || ibRawEnd >= cubFile )
		return true;
	if ( !unSectionAlignment )
		return false;

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &last = pSections[cSections - 1];
	u32 cubSpan = last.Misc.VirtualSize;
	if ( cubSpan < last.SizeOfRawData )
		cubSpan = last.SizeOfRawData + unSectionAlignment - 1 -
		          ( last.SizeOfRawData + unSectionAlignment - 1 ) % unSectionAlignment;

	IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &overlay = pSections[cSections];
	memset( &overlay, 0, sizeof( overlay ) );
	memcpy( overlay.Name, k_szOverlaySection, sizeof( k_szOverlaySection ) );
	overlay.PointerToRawData = ibRawEnd;
	overlay.SizeOfRawData = cubFile - ibRawEnd;
	overlay.VirtualAddress = last.VirtualAddress + cubSpan + unSectionAlignment - 1;
	overlay.VirtualAddress -= overlay.VirtualAddress % unSectionAlignment;
	overlay.Misc.VirtualSize = overlay.SizeOfRawData + unSectionAlignment - 1;
	overlay.Misc.VirtualSize -= overlay.Misc.VirtualSize % unSectionAlignment;
	overlay.Characteristics = IMAGE_SCN_MEM_DISCARDABLE;

	*pcSections = cSections + 1;
	return true;
}

// @orig: 81 EC ? ? ? ? 53 55 56 57 8B BC 24
bool HashNormalizedPeImage( const u8 *pubFile, u32 cubFile, u8 *pubDigest,
                            const NormalizedHashParams_t &params ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pubFile || cubFile < sizeof( IMAGE_DOS_HEADER ) )
		return false;

	IMAGE_DOS_HEADER dos;
	memcpy( &dos, pubFile, sizeof( dos ) );
	if ( dos.e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE )
		return false;

	const u32 ibNtHeaders = dos.e_lfanew;
	if ( ibNtHeaders > cubFile || 4u + sizeof( IMAGE_FILE_HEADER ) > cubFile - ibNtHeaders )
		return false;
	if ( util::Read32( pubFile + ibNtHeaders ) != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE )
		return false;

	const auto *pFileHeader = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_FILE_HEADER *>( pubFile + ibNtHeaders + 4 );
	if ( ( pFileHeader->Machine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386 && pFileHeader->Machine != IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64 ) ||
	     pFileHeader->NumberOfSections > k_cMaxSections || !pFileHeader->SizeOfOptionalHeader )
		return false;

	const u32 ibOptionalHeader = ibNtHeaders + 4u + sizeof( IMAGE_FILE_HEADER );
	if ( ibOptionalHeader > cubFile || pFileHeader->SizeOfOptionalHeader > cubFile - ibOptionalHeader )
		return false;

	u8 rgubOptionalHeader[sizeof( IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 )];
	memset( rgubOptionalHeader, 0, sizeof( rgubOptionalHeader ) );
	bool bPe64 = false;
	u32 unImageBase32 = 0;
	u32 unSectionAlignment = 0;
	if ( pFileHeader->SizeOfOptionalHeader == sizeof( IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 ) )
	{
		memcpy( rgubOptionalHeader, pubFile + ibOptionalHeader, sizeof( IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 ) );
		const auto *pOptional = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 *>( rgubOptionalHeader );
		if ( pOptional->Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC )
			return false;
		bPe64 = true;
		unSectionAlignment = pOptional->SectionAlignment;
		memset( rgubOptionalHeader + offsetof( IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64, ImageBase ), 0, sizeof( u32 ) );
		memset( rgubOptionalHeader + offsetof( IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64, ImageBase ) + sizeof( u32 ), 0, sizeof( u32 ) );
	}
	else if ( pFileHeader->SizeOfOptionalHeader == sizeof( IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32 ) )
	{
		memcpy( rgubOptionalHeader, pubFile + ibOptionalHeader, sizeof( IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32 ) );
		const auto *pOptional = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32 *>( rgubOptionalHeader );
		if ( pOptional->Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC )
			return false;
		unImageBase32 = params.m_unLoadedBase32 ? params.m_unLoadedBase32 : pOptional->ImageBase;
		unSectionAlignment = pOptional->SectionAlignment;
		memset( rgubOptionalHeader + offsetof( IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER32, ImageBase ), 0, sizeof( u32 ) );
	}
	else
	{
		return false;
	}

	const u32 ibSections = ibOptionalHeader + pFileHeader->SizeOfOptionalHeader;
	const u32 cubSections = pFileHeader->NumberOfSections * sizeof( IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER );
	if ( ibSections > cubFile || cubSections > cubFile - ibSections )
		return false;

	IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER rgSections[k_cMaxSections + 1];
	memcpy( rgSections, pubFile + ibSections, cubSections );

	u32 cSections = pFileHeader->NumberOfSections;
	if ( params.m_bAppendOverlaySection &&
	     !AppendOverlaySection( rgSections, &cSections, cubFile, unSectionAlignment ) )
		return false;

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSelected = SelectHashSection( rgSections, cSections );
	if ( !pSelected || !pSelected->PointerToRawData || !pSelected->SizeOfRawData )
		return false;

	crypto::hash::Md5_t md5;
	md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &dos ), sizeof( dos ) );
	md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( pFileHeader ), sizeof( IMAGE_FILE_HEADER ) );
	md5.Update( rgubOptionalHeader, pFileHeader->SizeOfOptionalHeader );

	// @note / sapdragon: the overlay section only takes part in the selection, its metadata is not on disk
	for ( u32 iSection = 0; iSection < pFileHeader->NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		md5.Update( rgSections[iSection].Name, 8 );
		md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &rgSections[iSection].VirtualAddress ), 4 );
		md5.Update( reinterpret_cast<const u8 *>( &rgSections[iSection].SizeOfRawData ), 4 );
	}

	if ( !HashSection( pubFile, cubFile, *pSelected, rgSections, cSections, rgubOptionalHeader, bPe64, unImageBase32,
	                   md5 ) )
		return false;

	md5.Final( pubDigest );
	return true;
}

} // namespace vac::pe
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "bootstrap/imports.hpp"
#include "core/types.hpp"

namespace vac::process
{

void EnableSeDebugPrivilege( const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept;

// @orig: inlined in CollectSystemInfo
constexpr u32 PackOsVersion( u32 unPlatformId, u32 unMajorVersion, u32 unMinorVersion ) noexcept
{
	return unPlatformId | ( unMajorVersion << 8 ) | ( unMinorVersion << 16 );
}

// @note / sapdragon: no original calls GetVersionExA after bootstrap, they read g_pSession->m_unPackedVersion.
// this is for system_handles's rebuild until it migrates
[[nodiscard]] u32 QueryPackedOsVersion( const SystemImports_t *pImports ) noexcept;

template <typename Visitor_t>
bool ForEachSnapshotProcess( const SystemImports_t *pImports, Visitor_t &&visitor ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pImports->CreateToolhelp32Snapshot || !pImports->Process32FirstW || !pImports->Process32NextW ||
	     !pImports->CloseHandle )
		return false;

	HANDLE hSnapshot = pImports->CreateToolhelp32Snapshot( TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0 );
	if ( hSnapshot == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE )
		return false;

	PROCESSENTRY32W entry{};
	entry.dwSize = sizeof( entry );
	if ( pImports->Process32FirstW( hSnapshot, &entry ) )
	{
		do
		{
			if ( !visitor( static_cast<const PROCESSENTRY32W &>( entry ) ) )
				break;
		} while ( pImports->Process32NextW( hSnapshot, &entry ) );
	}

	pImports->CloseHandle( hSnapshot );
	return true;
}

} // namespace vac::process
```

`sdk/src/util/asn1.hpp`:

```hpp
// @binary: 9b85c913
#pragma once

#include "core/types.hpp"

namespace vac::util
{

enum class EAsn1Tag : u8
{
	Integer = 0x02,
	BitString = 0x03,
	OctetString = 0x04,
	Sequence = 0x30,
};

// @orig: 53 8B 5C 24 ? 55 8B 6C 24 ? 56 33 F6
constexpr bool ParseTlv( EAsn1Tag eExpectedTag, const u8 *pubData, u32 cubData, const u8 *&pubValue,
                         u32 &cubValue ) noexcept
{
	pubValue = nullptr;
	cubValue = 0;
	if ( cubData < 2 || pubData[0] != static_cast<u8>( eExpectedTag ) )
		return false;

	const u8 unLengthByte = pubData[1];
	u32 ibValue;
	u32 cubBody;

	if ( ( unLengthByte & 0x80 ) == 0 )
	{
		cubBody = unLengthByte & 0x7F;
		ibValue = 2;
	}
	else
	{
		const u32 cLengthBytes = unLengthByte & 0x7F;
		if ( cLengthBytes < 1 || cLengthBytes > 4 || cLengthBytes + 2u > cubData )
			return false;
		cubBody = 0;
		for ( u32 iByte = 0; iByte < cLengthBytes; ++iByte )
			cubBody = ( cubBody << 8 ) | u32( pubData[2 + iByte] );
		ibValue = 2 + cLengthBytes;
	}

	if ( ibValue + cubBody > cubData )
		return false;
	if ( cubBody + ibValue < cubBody )
		return false;

	pubValue = pubData + ibValue;
	cubValue = cubBody;
	return true;
}

} // namespace vac::util
```

```hpp
{
	if ( !cubOut )
		return;
	pszOut[0] = 0;
	if ( !pImports || !pImports->WideCharToMultiByte || !pwszIn || !pwszIn[0] )
		return;
	pImports->WideCharToMultiByte( CP_UTF8, 0, pwszIn, -1, pszOut, static_cast<int>( cubOut ), nullptr, nullptr );

}

inline void Utf8ToWide( const SystemImports_t *pImports, const char *pszIn, wchar_t *pwszOut, u32 cOut ) noexcept
{
	if ( !cOut )
		return;
	pwszOut[0] = 0;
	if ( !pImports || !pImports->MultiByteToWideChar || !pszIn || !pszIn[0] )
		return;
	pImports->MultiByteToWideChar( CP_UTF8, 0, pszIn, -1, pwszOut, static_cast<int>( cOut ) );
	pwszOut[cOut - 1] = 0;
}

// @note / sapdragon: the converter the originals actually have: only a failed conversion touches the last byte
// @orig: A1 ? ? ? ? 53 56 57
inline int WideToUtf8Bounded( const SystemImports_t *pImports, const wchar_t *pwszIn, char *pszOut,
                              int cubOut ) noexcept

	if ( nResult == 0 )
		pszOut[cubOut - 1] = 0;
	return nResult;
```

```hpp
// @binary: 42878040
#pragma once

#include "core/types.hpp"

namespace vac::util::hashing
{

inline constexpr u32 k_unHashSeed = 0x45D71892u;

constexpr u32 Djb2LowerSized( u32 unSeed, const u8 *pubData, u32 cubData ) noexcept
{
	u32 unHash = unSeed;
	for ( u32 ib = 0; ib < cubData; ++ib )
		unHash = ( static_cast<u8>( pubData[ib] ) | 0x20u ) + 33u * unHash;
	return unHash;
}

constexpr u32 Djb2LowerNul( u32 unSeed, const char *pszText ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pszText )
		return unSeed;
	u32 unHash = unSeed;
	while ( *pszText )
		unHash = ( static_cast<u8>( *pszText++ ) | 0x20u ) + 33u * unHash;
	return unHash;
}

constexpr u32 PathHash( const char *pszText ) noexcept
{
	return Djb2LowerNul( k_unHashSeed, pszText );
}

// @orig: B8 ? ? ? ? 85 D2
constexpr u32 PathHashBytes( const u8 *pubData, u32 cubData ) noexcept
{
	return Djb2LowerSized( k_unHashSeed, pubData, cubData );
}

// @note / sapdragon: zero for empty input comes from the service_lookup rebuild, PathHashBytes gives the seed
constexpr u32 ServiceNameHash( const char *pszText, u32 cchText ) noexcept
{
	if ( cchText == 0 || pszText == nullptr )
		return 0;
	u32 unHash = k_unHashSeed;
	for ( u32 iChar = 0; iChar < cchText; ++iChar )
		unHash = ( static_cast<u8>( pszText[iChar] ) | 0x20u ) + 33u * unHash;
	return unHash;
}

constexpr u32 ServiceNameHash( const char *pszText ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pszText )
		return 0;
	u32 cchText = 0;
	while ( pszText[cchText] )
		++cchText;
	return ServiceNameHash( pszText, cchText );
}

} // namespace vac::util::hashing
```

```hpp
// @binary: 42878040
#pragma once

#include "core/types.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"

namespace vac::util
{

// @note / sapdragon: the null check is ours, the original would fault on null
// @orig: 33 C0 38 01 74
inline u32 StrLenA( const char *pszText ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pszText )
		return 0;
	u32 cChars = 0;
	while ( pszText[cChars] )
		++cChars;
	return cChars;
}

inline u32 StrLenW( const wchar_t *pwszText ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pwszText )
		return 0;
	u32 cChars = 0;
	while ( pwszText[cChars] )
		++cChars;
	return cChars;
}

inline bool EqualA( const char *pszA, const char *pszB ) noexcept
{
	while ( *pszA == *pszB )
	{
		if ( !*pszA )
			return true;
		++pszA;
		++pszB;
	}
	return false;
}

inline const char *BasenameA( const char *pszPath ) noexcept
{
	const char *pszBase = pszPath;
	for ( const char *pszChar = pszPath; *pszChar; ++pszChar )
	{
		if ( *pszChar == '\\' || *pszChar == '/' )
			pszBase = pszChar + 1;
	}
	return pszBase;
}

inline void CopyA( char *pszDst, const char *pszSrc, u32 cubDst ) noexcept
{
	if ( !cubDst )
		return;

	u32 iChar = 0;
	if ( pszSrc )
	{
		for ( ; iChar + 1 < cubDst && pszSrc[iChar]; ++iChar )
			pszDst[iChar] = pszSrc[iChar];
	}
	pszDst[iChar] = 0;
}

inline u32 Read32( const void *pData ) noexcept
{
	u32 unValue = 0;
	memcpy( &unValue, pData, sizeof( unValue ) );
	return unValue;
}

inline u64 Read64( const void *pData ) noexcept
{
	u64 ulValue = 0;
	memcpy( &ulValue, pData, sizeof( ulValue ) );
	return ulValue;
}

inline void Write16( void *pData, u16 unValue ) noexcept
{
	memcpy( pData, &unValue, sizeof( unValue ) );
}

constexpr u32 AlignUp( u32 unValue, u32 unAlignment ) noexcept
{
	if ( !unAlignment )
		return unValue;
	const u32 unRemainder = unValue % unAlignment;
	return unRemainder ? unValue + unAlignment - unRemainder : unValue;
}

} // namespace vac::util
```

```hpp
enum class EProtectMode : u32
{

	ReadOnly = 0b001,
	ReadWrite = 0b011,

	ExecuteRead = 0b101,
```

```hpp
// @binary: 42878040
#pragma once

#include "core/types.hpp"

namespace vac::util::wstr
{

inline u32 Length( const wchar_t *pwszText ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pwszText )
		return 0;
	u32 cChars = 0;
	while ( pwszText[cChars] )
		++cChars;
	return cChars;
}

inline void Copy( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc, u32 cMaxChars ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pwszDst || !cMaxChars )
		return;
	if ( !pwszSrc )
	{
		pwszDst[0] = 0;
		return;
	}
	u32 iChar = 0;
	while ( iChar + 1 < cMaxChars && pwszSrc[iChar] )
	{
		pwszDst[iChar] = pwszSrc[iChar];
		++iChar;
	}
	pwszDst[iChar] = 0;
}

inline void Cat( wchar_t *pwszDst, const wchar_t *pwszSrc, u32 cMaxChars ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pwszDst || !pwszSrc || !cMaxChars )
		return;
	u32 iChar = 0;
	while ( iChar < cMaxChars && pwszDst[iChar] )
		++iChar;
	while ( iChar + 1 < cMaxChars && *pwszSrc )
		pwszDst[iChar++] = *pwszSrc++;
	pwszDst[iChar] = 0;
}

inline bool PrefixEqualI( const wchar_t *pwszA, const wchar_t *pwszB, u32 cChars ) noexcept
{
	for ( u32 iChar = 0; iChar < cChars; ++iChar )
	{
		wchar_t wchA = pwszA[iChar];
		wchar_t wchB = pwszB[iChar];
		if ( wchA >= L'A' && wchA <= L'Z' )
			wchA = static_cast<wchar_t>( wchA + 0x20 );
		if ( wchB >= L'A' && wchB <= L'Z' )
			wchB = static_cast<wchar_t>( wchB + 0x20 );
		if ( wchA != wchB )
			return false;
		if ( !wchA )
			return true;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 56 FF 15
inline const wchar_t *BaseName( const wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	// @note / sapdragon: never looks at the first char, so "\name" comes back whole. valve's quirk
	i32 iChar = static_cast<i32>( Length( pwszPath ) ) - 1;
	if ( iChar <= 0 )
		return pwszPath;
	const wchar_t *pwszChar = pwszPath + iChar;
	while ( *pwszChar != L'\\' )
	{
		if ( --iChar <= 0 )
			return pwszPath;
		--pwszChar;
	}
	return pwszChar + 1;
}

} // namespace vac::util::wstr
```

`sdk/src/util/xor_string.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "core/types.hpp"

namespace vac::util
{

template <u8 unKey, typename Char_t, usize cChars>
struct XorString_t
{
	Char_t m_rgChars[cChars];

	consteval explicit XorString_t( const Char_t ( &rgChars )[cChars] ) : m_rgChars{}
	{
		for ( usize iChar = 0; iChar + 1 < cChars; ++iChar )
			m_rgChars[iChar] = static_cast<Char_t>( rgChars[iChar] ^ unKey );
	}

	void Decode() noexcept
	{
		for ( Char_t *pChar = m_rgChars; *pChar; ++pChar )
			*pChar = static_cast<Char_t>( *pChar ^ unKey );
	}

	[[nodiscard]] const Char_t *Get() const noexcept { return m_rgChars; }
};

template <u8 unKey, usize cChars>
consteval auto MakeXorString( const char ( &rgChars )[cChars] )
{
	return XorString_t<unKey, char, cChars>{ rgChars };
}

template <u8 unKey, usize cChars>
consteval auto MakeXorString( const wchar_t ( &rgChars )[cChars] )
{
	return XorString_t<unKey, wchar_t, cChars>{ rgChars };
}

} // namespace vac::util
```

```cpp
// @binary: 33211402
#include "verify/cert_chain.hpp"
#include "crt/intrinsics.hpp"
#include "util/encoding.hpp"

namespace vac::verify
{

namespace
{

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 53 56 8B F1
void LoadSignerCertificate( const SystemImports_t *pImports, CertContextSet_t *pSet ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pSet->m_hMsg || !pImports->CryptMsgGetParam || !pImports->CertFindCertificateInStore || !pSet->m_hStore )
		return;

	DWORD cubSignerInfo = 0;
	pImports->CryptMsgGetParam( pSet->m_hMsg, CMSG_SIGNER_INFO_PARAM, 0, nullptr, &cubSignerInfo );
	if ( !cubSignerInfo )
		return;

	auto *pSignerInfo = static_cast<CMSG_SIGNER_INFO *>( pImports->LocalAlloc( LPTR, cubSignerInfo ) );
	if ( !pSignerInfo )
		return;

	PCCERT_CONTEXT pSigner = nullptr;
	if ( pImports->CryptMsgGetParam( pSet->m_hMsg, CMSG_SIGNER_INFO_PARAM, 0, pSignerInfo, &cubSignerInfo ) )
	{
		CERT_INFO criteria{};
		criteria.Issuer = pSignerInfo->Issuer;
		criteria.SerialNumber = pSignerInfo->SerialNumber;
		pSigner = pImports->CertFindCertificateInStore( pSet->m_hStore, X509_ASN_ENCODING | PKCS_7_ASN_ENCODING, 0,
		                                                CERT_FIND_SUBJECT_CERT, &criteria, nullptr );
	}
	pImports->LocalFree( pSignerInfo );

	pSet->m_pSigner = pSigner;
	pSet->m_bSignerBorrowed = false;
}

// @orig: inlined
bool LoadSignerAndIssuer( const SystemImports_t *pImports, CertContextSet_t *pSet ) noexcept
{
	LoadSignerCertificate( pImports, pSet );

	// @note / sapdragon: CERT_FIND_SUBJECT_CERT would just find the signer again for appx signed binaries
	if ( pSet->m_pSigner && pImports->CertFindCertificateInStore )
	{
		pSet->m_pIssuer = pImports->CertFindCertificateInStore( pSet->m_hStore, X509_ASN_ENCODING | PKCS_7_ASN_ENCODING,
		                                                        0, CERT_FIND_ISSUER_OF, pSet->m_pSigner, nullptr );

		// @note / sapdragon: marked borrowed, so the issuer context is never freed. a leak in the original, keep it
		pSet->m_bIssuerBorrowed = true;
	}
	return pSet->m_pSigner != nullptr;
}

// @orig: 83 39 ? 74 ? 80 79
void FreeCertificate( const SystemImports_t *pImports, PCCERT_CONTEXT pCert, bool bBorrowed ) noexcept
{
	if ( pCert && !bBorrowed && pImports->CertFreeCertificateContext )
		pImports->CertFreeCertificateContext( pCert );
}

// @orig: A1 ? ? ? ? 53 55
void GetSubjectName( const SystemImports_t *pImports, PCCERT_CONTEXT pCert, char *pszSubject ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pImports->CertGetNameStringW || !pImports->LocalAlloc || !pImports->LocalFree )
		return;

	const DWORD cChars = pImports->CertGetNameStringW( pCert, CERT_NAME_SIMPLE_DISPLAY_TYPE, 0, nullptr, nullptr, 0 );
	if ( cChars <= 1 )
		return;

	auto *pwszName = static_cast<wchar_t *>( pImports->LocalAlloc( LPTR, cChars * sizeof( wchar_t ) ) );
	if ( !pwszName )
		return;

	if ( pImports->CertGetNameStringW( pCert, CERT_NAME_SIMPLE_DISPLAY_TYPE, 0, nullptr, pwszName, cChars ) )
		util::encoding::WideToUtf8Bounded( pImports, pwszName, pszSubject, sizeof( CertIdentity_t::m_szSubject ) );
	pImports->LocalFree( pwszName );
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 8B 01
void HashCertificateSha1( const SystemImports_t *pImports, PCCERT_CONTEXT pCert, u8 *pubSha1 ) noexcept
{
	if ( !pImports->CryptHashCertificate )
		return;
	DWORD cubHash = sizeof( CertIdentity_t::m_rgubSha1 );
	pImports->CryptHashCertificate( 0, CALG_SHA1, 0, pCert->pbCertEncoded, pCert->cbCertEncoded, pubSha1, &cubHash );
}

} // namespace

// @note / sapdragon: only image_scan's rebuild opens by path, the original always goes through a mapped blob
bool OpenCertificateContext( const SystemImports_t *pImports, CertContextSet_t *pSet, const wchar_t *pwszPath ) noexcept
{
	memset( pSet, 0, sizeof( *pSet ) );
	if ( !pImports->CryptQueryObject )
		return false;

	DWORD unEncoding = 0;
	DWORD unContentType = 0;
	DWORD unFormatType = 0;
	if ( !pImports->CryptQueryObject( CERT_QUERY_OBJECT_FILE, pwszPath, CERT_QUERY_CONTENT_FLAG_PKCS7_SIGNED_EMBED,
	                                  CERT_QUERY_FORMAT_FLAG_BINARY, 0, &unEncoding, &unContentType, &unFormatType,
	                                  &pSet->m_hStore, &pSet->m_hMsg, nullptr ) )
	{
		pSet->m_unLastError = pImports->GetLastError();
		return false;
	}
	return LoadSignerAndIssuer( pImports, pSet );
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 53 56 8B 45
bool OpenCertificateContextFromBlob( const SystemImports_t *pImports, CertContextSet_t *pSet, const void *pData,
                                     u32 cubData, DWORD unContentFlags ) noexcept
{
	memset( pSet, 0, sizeof( *pSet ) );
	if ( !pImports->CryptQueryObject || !pData || !cubData )
		return false;

	CRYPT_DATA_BLOB blob{};
	blob.cbData = cubData;
	blob.pbData = static_cast<BYTE *>( const_cast<void *>( pData ) );

	DWORD unEncoding = 0;
	DWORD unContentType = 0;
	DWORD unFormatType = 0;
	if ( !pImports->CryptQueryObject( CERT_QUERY_OBJECT_BLOB, &blob, unContentFlags, CERT_QUERY_FORMAT_FLAG_BINARY, 0,
	                                  &unEncoding, &unContentType, &unFormatType, &pSet->m_hStore, &pSet->m_hMsg,
	                                  nullptr ) )
	{
		pSet->m_unLastError = pImports->GetLastError();
		return false;
	}
	return LoadSignerAndIssuer( pImports, pSet );
}

// @orig: inlined
void ExtractCertChain( const SystemImports_t *pImports, const CertContextSet_t *pSet, CertIdentity_t *pSigner,
                       CertIdentity_t *pIssuer ) noexcept
{
	if ( pSet->m_pSigner )
	{
		GetSubjectName( pImports, pSet->m_pSigner, pSigner->m_szSubject );
		HashCertificateSha1( pImports, pSet->m_pSigner, pSigner->m_rgubSha1 );
	}
	if ( pSet->m_pIssuer )
	{
		GetSubjectName( pImports, pSet->m_pIssuer, pIssuer->m_szSubject );
		HashCertificateSha1( pImports, pSet->m_pIssuer, pIssuer->m_rgubSha1 );
	}
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 83 7E ? ? 74 ? FF 76
void ReleaseCertContext( const SystemImports_t *pImports, CertContextSet_t *pSet ) noexcept
{
	if ( pSet->m_hMsg && pImports->CryptMsgClose )
		pImports->CryptMsgClose( pSet->m_hMsg );
	if ( pSet->m_hStore && pImports->CertCloseStore )
		pImports->CertCloseStore( pSet->m_hStore, 0 );
	FreeCertificate( pImports, pSet->m_pIssuer, pSet->m_bIssuerBorrowed );
	FreeCertificate( pImports, pSet->m_pSigner, pSet->m_bSignerBorrowed );
	memset( pSet, 0, sizeof( *pSet ) );
}

} // namespace vac::verify
```

```hpp
{

	HCRYPTMSG m_hMsg;

	bool m_bIssuerBorrowed;
```

`service/src/image_loader/win32imageloader.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 7ebac2a4
#include "image_loader/win32imageloader.hpp"

#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

namespace
{

constexpr DWORD k_rgunNewProtect[8] = {
    PAGE_NOACCESS, PAGE_WRITECOPY,         PAGE_READONLY,     PAGE_READWRITE,
    PAGE_EXECUTE,  PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE,
};

IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *GetFirstSection( PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS32 pNTHeaders )
{
	return IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION( pNTHeaders );
}

using PfnDllMain_t = BOOL( WINAPI * )( void *pvBase, DWORD unReason, void *pvReserved );

void CallEntryPoint( const CWin32ModuleLoader *pImage, DWORD unReason )
{
	const auto pfnEntryPoint = reinterpret_cast<PfnDllMain_t>(
	    static_cast<char *>( pImage->m_pBaseAddress ) + pImage->m_pNTHeaders->OptionalHeader.AddressOfEntryPoint );
	pfnEntryPoint( pImage->m_pBaseAddress, unReason, nullptr );
}

void FreeImportedModules( CWin32ModuleLoader *pImage )
{
	if ( !pImage->m_ppImportedModules )
		return;

	for ( uint32_t iModule = 0; iModule < pImage->m_uiImportedModulesCount; ++iModule )
	{
		if ( pImage->m_ppImportedModules[iModule] != reinterpret_cast<HMODULE>( -1 ) )
			FreeLibrary( pImage->m_ppImportedModules[iModule] );
	}
	free( pImage->m_ppImportedModules );
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 53 56 8B 75 ? 57 8B 7E
bool CWin32ImageLoader::ProcessImports( CWin32ModuleLoader *pImage )
{
	auto *pubBase = static_cast<char *>( pImage->m_pBaseAddress );
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory =
	    pImage->m_pNTHeaders->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT];
	if ( !directory.Size )
		return true;

	auto *pDescriptor = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_IMPORT_DESCRIPTOR *>( pubBase + directory.VirtualAddress );
	if ( IsBadReadPtr( pDescriptor, sizeof( IMAGE_IMPORT_DESCRIPTOR ) ) )
		return true;

	do
	{
		if ( !pDescriptor->Name )
			break;

		const HMODULE hModule = LoadLibraryExA( pubBase + pDescriptor->Name, nullptr, 0 );
		if ( !hModule )
			return false;

		auto *ppImportedModules = static_cast<HMODULE *>(
		    realloc( pImage->m_ppImportedModules, sizeof( HMODULE ) * ( pImage->m_uiImportedModulesCount + 1 ) ) );
		pImage->m_ppImportedModules = ppImportedModules;
		if ( !ppImportedModules )
			return false;
		ppImportedModules[pImage->m_uiImportedModulesCount++] = hModule;

		const DWORD ibThunks =
		    pDescriptor->OriginalFirstThunk ? pDescriptor->OriginalFirstThunk : pDescriptor->FirstThunk;
		const auto *pThunk = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_THUNK_DATA32 *>( pubBase + ibThunks );
		auto *ppfnImport = reinterpret_cast<FARPROC *>( pubBase + pDescriptor->FirstThunk );
		for ( ; pThunk->u1.AddressOfData; ++pThunk, ++ppfnImport )
		{
			const char *pszName;
			if ( IMAGE_SNAP_BY_ORDINAL32( pThunk->u1.Ordinal ) )
				pszName = MAKEINTRESOURCEA( static_cast<WORD>( pThunk->u1.Ordinal ) );
			else
				pszName = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_IMPORT_BY_NAME *>( pubBase + pThunk->u1.AddressOfData )->Name;

			*ppfnImport = GetProcAddress( hModule, pszName );
			if ( !*ppfnImport )
				return false;
		}

		++pDescriptor;
	} while ( !IsBadReadPtr( pDescriptor, sizeof( IMAGE_IMPORT_DESCRIPTOR ) ) );

	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 56 57 8B 7D ? 33 C0
void CWin32ImageLoader::ProcessSectionCharacteristics( CWin32ModuleLoader *pImage )
{
	const PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS32 pNTHeaders = pImage->m_pNTHeaders;
	IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection = GetFirstSection( pNTHeaders );
	for ( WORD iSection = 0; iSection < pNTHeaders->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection, ++pSection )
	{
		const DWORD unCharacteristics = pSection->Characteristics;
		void *pvSection = reinterpret_cast<void *>( static_cast<uintptr_t>( pSection->Misc.PhysicalAddress ) );
		if ( unCharacteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_DISCARDABLE )
		{
			VirtualFree( pvSection, pSection->SizeOfRawData, MEM_DECOMMIT );
			continue;
		}

		DWORD unProtect = k_rgunNewProtect[( ( unCharacteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE ) ? 4 : 0 ) +
		                                   ( ( unCharacteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_READ ) ? 2 : 0 ) +
		                                   ( ( unCharacteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_WRITE ) ? 1 : 0 )];
		if ( unCharacteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_NOT_CACHED )
			unProtect |= PAGE_NOCACHE;

		// @note / sapdragon: the original picks a section size for empty raw data and then ignores it, the protect
		// call still gets zero. so these sections just stay read-write
		if ( !pSection->SizeOfRawData )
		{
			DWORD cubSection;
			if ( unCharacteristics & IMAGE_SCN_CNT_INITIALIZED_DATA )
				cubSection = pNTHeaders->OptionalHeader.SizeOfInitializedData;
			else if ( unCharacteristics & IMAGE_SCN_CNT_UNINITIALIZED_DATA )
				cubSection = pNTHeaders->OptionalHeader.SizeOfUninitializedData;
			else
				continue;

			if ( !cubSection )
				continue;
		}

		DWORD unOldProtect;
		VirtualProtect( pvSection, pSection->SizeOfRawData, unProtect, &unOldProtect );
	}
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 8B 45 ? 57 8B 78
void CWin32ImageLoader::ProcessRelocations( CWin32ModuleLoader *pImage, intptr_t nDelta )
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory =
	    pImage->m_pNTHeaders->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC];
	if ( !directory.Size )
		return;

	auto *pubBase = static_cast<char *>( pImage->m_pBaseAddress );
	auto *pBlock = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION *>( pubBase + directory.VirtualAddress );
	while ( pBlock->VirtualAddress )
	{
		char *pubPage = pubBase + pBlock->VirtualAddress;
		const auto *punEntries = reinterpret_cast<const WORD *>( pBlock + 1 );
		const DWORD cEntries = ( pBlock->SizeOfBlock - sizeof( IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION ) ) >> 1;
		for ( DWORD iEntry = 0; iEntry < cEntries; ++iEntry )
		{
			const WORD unEntry = punEntries[iEntry];
			if ( ( unEntry & 0xF000 ) == ( IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGHLOW << 12 ) )
				*reinterpret_cast<intptr_t *>( pubPage + ( unEntry & 0xFFF ) ) += nDelta;
		}
		pBlock = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION *>( reinterpret_cast<char *>( pBlock ) + pBlock->SizeOfBlock );
	}
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 8B 45 ? 83 EC ? B9
CWin32ModuleLoader *LoadModuleHiddenInternal( const void *pvImageBuffer, void *pvPreferredLoadAddress,
                                              bool bShouldCallEntryPoint )
{
	const auto *pubImage = static_cast<const char *>( pvImageBuffer );
	const auto *pDosHeader = static_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( pvImageBuffer );
	if ( pDosHeader->e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE )
		return nullptr;

	const auto *pSourceHeaders = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS32 *>( pubImage + pDosHeader->e_lfanew );
	if ( pSourceHeaders->Signature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE )
		return nullptr;

	const DWORD cubImage = pSourceHeaders->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage;
	void *pvWantedBase = pvPreferredLoadAddress;
	if ( !pvWantedBase )
		pvWantedBase = reinterpret_cast<void *>( static_cast<uintptr_t>( pSourceHeaders->OptionalHeader.ImageBase ) );

	void *pvReserved = VirtualAlloc( pvWantedBase, cubImage, MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE );
	if ( !pvReserved )
	{
		pvReserved = VirtualAlloc( nullptr, cubImage, MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE );
		if ( !pvReserved )
			return nullptr;
	}

	auto *pImage = static_cast<CWin32ModuleLoader *>( HeapAlloc( GetProcessHeap(), 0, sizeof( CWin32ModuleLoader ) ) );
	pImage->m_bModuleLoaded = FALSE;
	pImage->m_pNTHeaders = nullptr;
	pImage->m_uiImportedModulesCount = 0;
	pImage->m_ppImportedModules = nullptr;
	pImage->m_pBaseAddress = pvReserved;

	auto *pubBase = static_cast<char *>( VirtualAlloc( pvReserved, cubImage, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE ) );
	// @note / sapdragon: SizeOfHeaders already counts from the file start, so this copies e_lfanew too many bytes.
	// harmless on a real module, the first section sits a page later
	memcpy( pubBase, pvImageBuffer, pDosHeader->e_lfanew + pSourceHeaders->OptionalHeader.SizeOfHeaders );

	pImage->m_pNTHeaders = reinterpret_cast<PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS32>( pubBase + pDosHeader->e_lfanew );
	pImage->m_pNTHeaders->OptionalHeader.ImageBase = static_cast<DWORD>( reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>( pubBase ) );

	IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSection = GetFirstSection( pImage->m_pNTHeaders );
	for ( WORD iSection = 0; iSection < pImage->m_pNTHeaders->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection, ++pSection )
	{
		if ( !pSection->SizeOfRawData )
		{
			const DWORD cubAlignment = pSourceHeaders->OptionalHeader.SectionAlignment;
			if ( cubAlignment > 0 )
			{
				void *pvSection =
				    VirtualAlloc( pubBase + pSection->VirtualAddress, cubAlignment, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE );
				pSection->Misc.PhysicalAddress = static_cast<DWORD>( reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>( pvSection ) );
				memset( pvSection, 0, cubAlignment );
			}
			continue;
		}

		void *pvSection =
		    VirtualAlloc( pubBase + pSection->VirtualAddress, pSection->SizeOfRawData, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE );
		memcpy( pvSection, pubImage + pSection->PointerToRawData, pSection->SizeOfRawData );
		pSection->Misc.PhysicalAddress = static_cast<DWORD>( reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>( pvSection ) );
	}

	const intptr_t nDelta =
	    reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>( pubBase ) - static_cast<intptr_t>( pSourceHeaders->OptionalHeader.ImageBase );
	if ( nDelta )
		CWin32ImageLoader::ProcessRelocations( pImage, nDelta );

	if ( !bShouldCallEntryPoint || CWin32ImageLoader::ProcessImports( pImage ) )
	{
		CWin32ImageLoader::ProcessSectionCharacteristics( pImage );

		const DWORD ibEntryPoint = pImage->m_pNTHeaders->OptionalHeader.AddressOfEntryPoint;
		if ( !ibEntryPoint || !bShouldCallEntryPoint )
			return pImage;

		const auto pfnEntryPoint = reinterpret_cast<PfnDllMain_t>( pubBase + ibEntryPoint );
		if ( pfnEntryPoint( pubBase, DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH, nullptr ) )
		{
			pImage->m_bModuleLoaded = TRUE;
			return pImage;
		}
	}

	if ( pImage->m_bModuleLoaded )
		CallEntryPoint( pImage, DLL_PROCESS_DETACH );

	FreeImportedModules( pImage );
	if ( pImage->m_pBaseAddress )
		VirtualFree( pImage->m_pBaseAddress, 0, MEM_RELEASE );
	HeapFree( GetProcessHeap(), 0, pImage );
	return nullptr;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 56 8B 75 ? 85 F6 74 ? 80 3E ? 74 ? 8B 46
void UnloadModuleHiddenInternal( CWin32ModuleLoader *pImage )
{
	if ( !pImage )
		return;

	if ( pImage->m_bModuleLoaded )
		CallEntryPoint( pImage, DLL_PROCESS_DETACH );

	FreeImportedModules( pImage );
	if ( pImage->m_pBaseAddress )
		VirtualFree( pImage->m_pBaseAddress, 0, MEM_RELEASE );
	HeapFree( GetProcessHeap(), 0, pImage );
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 8B 45 ? 53 56 57 8B 70
void *GetProcAddressHidden( const CWin32ModuleLoader *pImage, const char *pszName )
{
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &directory =
	    pImage->m_pNTHeaders->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT];
	if ( !directory.Size )
		return nullptr;

	auto *pubBase = static_cast<char *>( pImage->m_pBaseAddress );
	const auto *pExports = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY *>( pubBase + directory.VirtualAddress );
	if ( !pExports->NumberOfNames || !pExports->NumberOfFunctions )
		return nullptr;

	const auto *pibNames = reinterpret_cast<const DWORD *>( pubBase + pExports->AddressOfNames );
	const auto *piOrdinals = reinterpret_cast<const WORD *>( pubBase + pExports->AddressOfNameOrdinals );
	DWORD iName = 0;
	while ( _stricmp( pszName, pubBase + pibNames[iName] ) != 0 )
	{
		++iName;
		if ( iName >= pExports->NumberOfNames )
			return nullptr;
	}

	// @note / sapdragon: <= is valve's, one past the table still reads
	const DWORD iFunction = piOrdinals[iName];
	if ( iFunction > pExports->NumberOfFunctions )
		return nullptr;

	const auto *pibFunctions = reinterpret_cast<const DWORD *>( pubBase + pExports->AddressOfFunctions );
	return pubBase + pibFunctions[iFunction];
}
```

```cpp
// @binary: 7ebac2a4
#include "module_manager/servicemodulemanagerbase.hpp"

#include "crypto/hash/crc32.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace
{

bool ReadWholeFile( const std::string &sName, std::vector<uint8_t> *pvecData )
{
	FILE *pFile = nullptr;
	if ( fopen_s( &pFile, sName.c_str(), "rb" ) != 0 || !pFile )
		return false;
	fseek( pFile, 0, SEEK_END );
	pvecData->resize( static_cast<size_t>( ftell( pFile ) ) );
	fseek( pFile, 0, SEEK_SET );
	const bool bRead = pvecData->empty() || fread( pvecData->data(), 1, pvecData->size(), pFile ) == pvecData->size();
	fclose( pFile );
	return bRead;
}

bool WriteWholeFile( const std::string &sName, const void *pvData, size_t cubData )
{
	FILE *pFile = nullptr;
	if ( fopen_s( &pFile, sName.c_str(), "wb" ) != 0 || !pFile )
		return false;
	const bool bWritten = fwrite( pvData, 1, cubData, pFile ) == cubData;
	fclose( pFile );
	return bWritten;
}

void ApplyDevelopmentKey( CClientModuleManagerBase &manager )
{
	char szPath[MAX_PATH];
	if ( !GetEnvironmentVariableA( "STEAMSERVICE_DEV_KEY", szPath, MAX_PATH ) )
		return;

	std::vector<uint8_t> vecKey;
	if ( ReadWholeFile( szPath, &vecKey ) )
		manager.SetDevelopmentKeys( { std::string( vecKey.begin(), vecKey.end() ) } );
}

uint32_t ComputeCrc32( const std::vector<uint8_t> &vecData )
{
	return vac::crypto::hash::Crc32_t::Of( vecData.data(), static_cast<vac::usize>( vecData.size() ) );
}

// @note / sapdragon: legacycompat/steamservice.exe isn't in what we have, only its caller. the arguments and files are
// from CallFunctionAsyncInternal_LegacyCompat, the rest of this is a guess
int RunLegacyCall( uint32_t uiCRC32, int nRequest, uint32_t unFile, uint32_t cubOutputLimit )
{
	const std::string sLegacyDir = "legacycompat/servicecall_";
	std::vector<uint8_t> vecModule;
	std::vector<uint8_t> vecInput;
	if ( !ReadWholeFile( sLegacyDir + std::to_string( uiCRC32 ) + ".dll", &vecModule ) ||
	     !ReadWholeFile( sLegacyDir + std::to_string( unFile ) + ".in", &vecInput ) )
		return 1;

	CClientModuleManagerBase manager;
	ApplyDevelopmentKey( manager );
	if ( !manager.LoadModule( uiCRC32, vecModule.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>( vecModule.size() ) ) )
		return 2;

	std::vector<uint8_t> vecOutput( cubOutputLimit < sizeof( ExceptionResponse_t ) ? sizeof( ExceptionResponse_t )
	                                                                               : cubOutputLimit );
	uint32_t cubRequired = 0;
	const ECallResult eResult = manager.CallFunction( uiCRC32, MF_HIDDEN_MODULE, nRequest, vecInput.data(),
	                                                  static_cast<uint32_t>( vecInput.size() ), vecOutput.data(),
	                                                  static_cast<uint32_t>( vecOutput.size() ), &cubRequired );
	if ( eResult != ECallResult::OK )
		return 3;
	return WriteWholeFile( sLegacyDir + std::to_string( unFile ) + ".out", vecOutput.data(), cubRequired ) ? 0 : 4;
}

int RunStandCall( int cArgs, char **ppszArgs )
{
	if ( cArgs < 6 )
		return 2;

	std::vector<uint8_t> vecModule;
	std::vector<uint8_t> vecInput;
	if ( !ReadWholeFile( ppszArgs[2], &vecModule ) || !ReadWholeFile( ppszArgs[4], &vecInput ) )
		return 2;

	const uint32_t unFlags = cArgs > 6 && !strcmp( ppszArgs[6], "--hidden" ) ? MF_HIDDEN_MODULE : 0;
	const uint32_t uiCRC32 = ComputeCrc32( vecModule );
	CClientModuleManagerBase manager;
	ApplyDevelopmentKey( manager );
	if ( !manager.LoadModule( uiCRC32, vecModule.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>( vecModule.size() ) ) )
		return 2;

	std::vector<uint8_t> vecOutput( 0x2000 );
	uint32_t cubRequired = 0;
	const ECallResult eResult = manager.CallFunction( uiCRC32, unFlags, atoi( ppszArgs[3] ), vecInput.data(),
	                                                  static_cast<uint32_t>( vecInput.size() ), vecOutput.data(),
	                                                  static_cast<uint32_t>( vecOutput.size() ), &cubRequired );
	printf( "crc=%08x result=%d output=%u\n", uiCRC32, static_cast<int>( eResult ), cubRequired );
	if ( !WriteWholeFile( ppszArgs[5], vecOutput.data(), cubRequired ) )
		return 2;
	return eResult == ECallResult::OK ? 0 : 1;
}

} // namespace

int main( int cArgs, char **ppszArgs )
{
	if ( cArgs >= 6 && !strcmp( ppszArgs[1], "/runfunc" ) )
		return RunLegacyCall( strtoul( ppszArgs[2], nullptr, 10 ), atoi( ppszArgs[3] ),
		                      strtoul( ppszArgs[4], nullptr, 10 ), strtoul( ppszArgs[5], nullptr, 10 ) );
	if ( cArgs >= 2 && !strcmp( ppszArgs[1], "--call" ) )
		return RunStandCall( cArgs, ppszArgs );

	printf( "usage: steamservice /runfunc <crc> <request> <file> <limit> | --call <dll> <request> <in> <out> "
	        "[--hidden]\n" );
	return 2;
}
```

```cpp
// @binary: 7ebac2a4
#include "module_manager/servicemodulemanagerasync.hpp"

#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

namespace
{

constexpr uint64_t k_ulIdleUnloadSeconds = 1800;

} // namespace

// @orig: 55 8B EC 56 8B F1 83 BE
CWorkItemFunctionCall::~CWorkItemFunctionCall()
{
	free( m_pvInput );
	free( m_pvOutput );
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 86 ? ? ? ? 8D 8E
bool CWorkItemFunctionCall::ThreadProcess()
{
	if ( m_unFlags & MF_LEGACY_COMPATIBLE )
		m_eResult = m_pManager->CallFunctionAsyncInternal_LegacyCompat(
		    m_uiCRC32, m_unFlags, m_nRequest, m_unFile, m_pvInput, m_cubInput, &m_pvOutput, &m_cubOutput );
	else
		m_eResult = m_pManager->CallFunctionAsyncInternal( m_uiCRC32, m_unFlags, m_nRequest, m_pvInput, m_cubInput,
		                                                   &m_pvOutput, &m_cubOutput );

	free( m_pvInput );
	m_pvInput = nullptr;
	return true;
}

CWorkThreadPool::~CWorkThreadPool()
{
	StopWorkThreads();
}

void CWorkThreadPool::ThreadMain()
{
	for ( ;; )
	{
		std::unique_ptr<CWorkItemFunctionCall> pItem;
		{
			std::unique_lock lock( m_mutex );
			m_condition.wait( lock, [this] { return m_bStop || !m_dequePending.empty(); } );
			if ( m_bStop )
				return;
			pItem = std::move( m_dequePending.front() );
			m_dequePending.pop_front();
			m_bBusy = true;
		}

		pItem->ThreadProcess();

		std::lock_guard lock( m_mutex );
		m_dequeCompleted.push_back( std::move( pItem ) );
		m_bBusy = false;
	}
}

void CWorkThreadPool::AddWorkItem( std::unique_ptr<CWorkItemFunctionCall> pItem )
{
	{
		std::lock_guard lock( m_mutex );
		m_dequePending.push_back( std::move( pItem ) );
	}
	m_condition.notify_one();
}

std::unique_ptr<CWorkItemFunctionCall> CWorkThreadPool::GetNextCompletedWorkItem()
{
	std::lock_guard lock( m_mutex );
	if ( m_dequeCompleted.empty() )
		return nullptr;
	auto pItem = std::move( m_dequeCompleted.front() );
	m_dequeCompleted.pop_front();
	return pItem;
}

void CWorkThreadPool::StartWorkThreads()
{
	m_thread = std::thread( &CWorkThreadPool::ThreadMain, this );
}

void CWorkThreadPool::StopWorkThreads()
{
	if ( !m_thread.joinable() )
		return;
	{
		std::lock_guard lock( m_mutex );
		m_bStop = true;
	}
	m_condition.notify_all();
	m_thread.join();
}

bool CWorkThreadPool::BHasPendingWork()
{
	std::lock_guard lock( m_mutex );
	return m_bBusy || !m_dequePending.empty();
}

// @orig: 7ebac2a4:0x10056720 (no unique signature)
CClientModuleManagerAsync::~CClientModuleManagerAsync()
{
	Shutdown();
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 53 8B D9 56 8B 8B
ECallResult CClientModuleManagerAsync::CallFunctionAsync( uint32_t uiCRC32, uint32_t unFlags, uint32_t unCallerLow,
                                                          uint32_t unCallerHigh, int nRequest, uint32_t unFile,
                                                          const void *pvInput, uint32_t cubInput, uint32_t cubOutput )
{
	if ( !m_threadPool.BIsAlive() )
		m_threadPool.StartWorkThreads();

	auto pItem = std::make_unique<CWorkItemFunctionCall>();
	pItem->m_uiCRC32 = uiCRC32;
	pItem->m_unFlags = unFlags;
	pItem->m_unCallerLow = unCallerLow;
	pItem->m_unCallerHigh = unCallerHigh;
	pItem->m_nRequest = nRequest;
	pItem->m_unFile = unFile;
	pItem->m_cubInput = cubInput;
	pItem->m_pManager = this;
	pItem->m_cubOutput = cubOutput;
	pItem->m_pvInput = malloc( cubInput );
	memcpy( pItem->m_pvInput, pvInput, cubInput );
	m_threadPool.AddWorkItem( std::move( pItem ) );
	return ECallResult::OK;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 53 8B D9 56 57 8B B3
ECallResult CClientModuleManagerAsync::PollResponseAsync( void *pvBuffer, uint32_t cubBuffer, uint32_t *pcubStatus,
                                                          uint32_t unFile, uint32_t unCallerLow )
{
	std::unique_ptr<CWorkItemFunctionCall> pItem;
	for ( auto it = m_listCompleted.begin(); it != m_listCompleted.end(); ++it )
	{
		if ( ( *it )->m_unCallerLow == unCallerLow && ( *it )->m_unFile == unFile )
		{
			pItem = std::move( *it );
			m_listCompleted.erase( it );
			break;
		}
	}

	if ( !pItem )
	{
		for ( pItem = m_threadPool.GetNextCompletedWorkItem(); pItem; pItem = m_threadPool.GetNextCompletedWorkItem() )
		{
			if ( pItem->m_unCallerLow == unCallerLow && pItem->m_unFile == unFile )
				break;
			m_listCompleted.push_back( std::move( pItem ) );
		}
	}

	if ( m_listCompleted.empty() && !m_threadPool.BHasPendingWork() )
	{
		const uint64_t ulNow = CurrentMicroSecs();
		for ( auto it = m_mapModules.begin(); it != m_mapModules.end(); )
		{
			const auto itCurrent = it++;
			if ( ( ulNow - itCurrent->second->m_ulLastUsedMicroSecs ) / 1000000 > k_ulIdleUnloadSeconds )
				UnloadModule( itCurrent->first );
		}
	}

	*pcubStatus = 0;
	if ( !pItem )
		return ECallResult::None;

	const ECallResult eResult = pItem->m_eResult;
	*pcubStatus = pItem->m_cubOutput;
	if ( cubBuffer >= pItem->m_cubOutput )
	{
		if ( pItem->m_cubOutput )
			memcpy( pvBuffer, pItem->m_pvOutput, pItem->m_cubOutput );
		return eResult;
	}

	// @note / sapdragon: a crash report that doesn't fit is too large, everything else that doesn't fit is too small.
	// looks backwards but the original branches exactly like this
	return eResult == ECallResult::Exception ? ECallResult::OutputTooLarge : ECallResult::OutputTooSmall;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 83 B9 ? ? ? ? ? 74
void CClientModuleManagerAsync::Shutdown()
{
	m_threadPool.StopWorkThreads();
	while ( m_threadPool.GetNextCompletedWorkItem() )
	{
	}
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <condition_variable>

class CWorkItemFunctionCall

	uint32_t m_uiCRC32 = 0;
	uint32_t m_unFlags = 0;
```

```cpp
// @binary: 7ebac2a4
#include "module_manager/servicemodulemanagerbase.hpp"

std::string GetExecutableDir()
{
	char szPath[MAX_PATH]{};
	GetModuleFileNameA( nullptr, szPath, MAX_PATH );
	std::string sPath = szPath;
	const size_t ichSlash = sPath.find_last_of( "\\/" );
	return ichSlash == std::string::npos ? std::string( "." ) : sPath.substr( 0, ichSlash );
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 81 EC ? ? ? ? 8D 85 ? ? ? ? 50
bool CreateTempFileName( std::string *psName )
{
	char szDirectory[MAX_PATH];
	char szName[MAX_PATH];
	if ( !GetTempPathA( MAX_PATH, szDirectory ) || !GetTempFileNameA( szDirectory, "", 0, szName ) )
		return false;
	*psName = szName;
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 53 56 57 51 8B C4 8D 4D ? C7 00 ? ? ? ? FF 75 ? E8 ? ? ? ? FF 75
bool SaveBufferToFile( const void *pvData, uint32_t cubData, const char *pszName )
{
	FILE *pFile = nullptr;
	if ( fopen_s( &pFile, pszName, "wb" ) != 0 || !pFile )
		return false;
	const bool bWritten = fwrite( pvData, 1, cubData, pFile ) == cubData;
	fclose( pFile );
	return bWritten;
}

bool ReadWholeFile( const std::string &sName, std::vector<uint8_t> *pvecData )
{
	FILE *pFile = nullptr;
	if ( fopen_s( &pFile, sName.c_str(), "rb" ) != 0 || !pFile )
		return false;
	fseek( pFile, 0, SEEK_END );
	const long cubFile = ftell( pFile );
	fseek( pFile, 0, SEEK_SET );
	pvecData->resize( cubFile > 0 ? static_cast<size_t>( cubFile ) : 0 );
	const bool bRead = pvecData->empty() || fread( pvecData->data(), 1, pvecData->size(), pFile ) == pvecData->size();
	fclose( pFile );
	return bRead;
}

int CopyExceptionRecord( const EXCEPTION_POINTERS *pPointers, EXCEPTION_RECORD32 *pRecord )
{
	memcpy( pRecord, pPointers->ExceptionRecord, sizeof( EXCEPTION_RECORD32 ) );
	return EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER;
}
```
