```cpp
// @orig: 55 8B EC 56 8B F1 8D 45
DynamicModule_t *CClientModuleManagerBase::FindModule( uint32_t uiCRC32 ) const
{
	const auto it = m_mapModules.find( uiCRC32 );
	return it == m_mapModules.end() ? nullptr : it->second;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 53 56 57 8B 7D ? 8B C1
bool CClientModuleManagerBase::LoadModule( uint32_t uiCRC32, const void *pvModule, uint32_t cubModule )
{
	if ( !uiCRC32 || !cubModule || cubModule > 0xFFFFFF || !pvModule )
		return false;

	if ( FindModule( uiCRC32 ) )
		return true;

	if ( uiCRC32 != vac::crypto::hash::Crc32_t::Of( static_cast<const vac::u8 *>( pvModule ), cubModule ) )
		return false;

	void *pvRawModule = malloc( cubModule );
	if ( !pvRawModule )
		return false;

	auto *pModule = new DynamicModule_t{};
	pModule->m_pRawModule = pvRawModule;
	pModule->m_uiCRC32 = uiCRC32;
	pModule->m_uiRawModuleSize = cubModule;
	pModule->m_ulLastUsedMicroSecs = CurrentMicroSecs();
	memcpy( pvRawModule, pvModule, cubModule );
	m_mapModules.emplace( uiCRC32, pModule );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 8B 45 ? 53 56 57 8B F9 89 45
bool CClientModuleManagerBase::UnloadModule( uint32_t uiCRC32 )
{
	DynamicModule_t *pModule = FindModule( uiCRC32 );
	if ( !pModule )
		return false;

	UnloadModuleInternal( pModule );
	delete pModule;
	m_mapModules.erase( uiCRC32 );
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 56 8B 75 ? 8B 46 ? 85 C0 74 ? 50
void CClientModuleManagerBase::UnloadModuleInternal( DynamicModule_t *pModule )
{
	if ( pModule->m_hModule )
	{
		FreeLibrary( pModule->m_hModule );
		pModule->m_hModule = nullptr;
	}

	if ( !pModule->m_sFileName.empty() )
	{
		DeleteFileA( pModule->m_sFileName.c_str() );
		pModule->m_sFileName.clear();
	}

	if ( pModule->m_pModule )
	{
		UnloadModuleHiddenInternal( pModule->m_pModule );
		pModule->m_pModule = nullptr;
	}

	if ( pModule->m_pRawModule )
	{
		free( pModule->m_pRawModule );
		pModule->m_pRawModule = nullptr;
	}

	pModule->m_pServiceFunction = nullptr;
}

bool CClientModuleManagerBase::BVerifyModule( DynamicModule_t *pModule ) const
{
	if ( m_vecDevelopmentKeys.empty() )
		return VerifyValveSignature( pModule->m_pRawModule, pModule->m_uiRawModuleSize ) == ESignatureResult::Valid;

	std::vector<const char *> vecKeys;
	for ( const std::string &sKey : m_vecDevelopmentKeys )
		vecKeys.push_back( sKey.c_str() );
	return VerifyValveWin32Signature( pModule->m_pRawModule, pModule->m_uiRawModuleSize, vecKeys.data(),
	                                  static_cast<uint32_t>( vecKeys.size() ) ) == ESignatureResult::Valid;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 53 56 8B 75 ? 8B D9 83 7E
bool CClientModuleManagerBase::LoadDynamicModule( DynamicModule_t *pModule, uint32_t unFlags )
{
	if ( pModule->m_pServiceFunction )
		return true;

	if ( !pModule->m_pRawModule || !pModule->m_uiRawModuleSize )
	{
		pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::NoModuleData;
		return false;
	}

	if ( !BVerifyModule( pModule ) )
	{
		UnloadModuleInternal( pModule );
		pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::BadSignature;
		return false;
	}

	if ( unFlags & MF_HIDDEN_MODULE )
	{
		pModule->m_pModule = LoadModuleHiddenInternal( pModule->m_pRawModule, nullptr, true );
		if ( pModule->m_pModule )
		{
			pModule->m_pServiceFunction =
			    reinterpret_cast<PfnServiceFunction_t>( GetProcAddressHidden( pModule->m_pModule, "_runfunc@20" ) );
			if ( !pModule->m_pServiceFunction )
				pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::NoRunFuncHidden;
		}
		else
		{
			pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::LoadFailed;
		}
	}
	else
	{
		pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::None;
		std::string sTempFile;
		if ( !CreateTempFileName( &sTempFile ) )
		{
			pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::TempFileFailed;
		}
		else if ( !SaveBufferToFile( pModule->m_pRawModule, pModule->m_uiRawModuleSize, sTempFile.c_str() ) )
		{
			pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::SaveFailed;
		}
		else
		{
			pModule->m_sFileName = sTempFile;
			pModule->m_hModule = LoadLibraryExA( sTempFile.c_str(), nullptr, 0 );
			if ( pModule->m_hModule )
			{
				pModule->m_pServiceFunction =
				    reinterpret_cast<PfnServiceFunction_t>( GetProcAddress( pModule->m_hModule, "_runfunc@20" ) );
				if ( !pModule->m_pServiceFunction )
					pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::NoRunFuncLoaded;
			}
			else
			{
				pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::LoadFailed;
			}
		}
	}

	if ( !pModule->m_pServiceFunction )
	{
		UnloadModuleInternal( pModule );
		return false;
	}

	pModule->m_ulLastUsedMicroSecs = CurrentMicroSecs();
	if ( pModule->m_pRawModule )
	{
		free( pModule->m_pRawModule );
		pModule->m_pRawModule = nullptr;
	}
	return true;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 6A ? 68 ? ? ? ? 68 ? ? ? ? 64 A1 ? ? ? ? 50 64 89 25 ? ? ? ? 83 EC ? 53 56 57 89 65 ? 8B F1
ECallResult CClientModuleManagerBase::CallFunction( uint32_t uiCRC32, uint32_t unFlags, int nRequest,
                                                    const void *pvInput, uint32_t cubInput, void *pvOutput,
                                                    uint32_t cubOutput, uint32_t *pcubRequired )
{
	*pcubRequired = 0;
	DynamicModule_t *pModule = FindModule( uiCRC32 );
	if ( !pModule )
		return ECallResult::ModuleNotFound;
	if ( cubOutput < sizeof( ExceptionResponse_t ) )
		return ECallResult::OutputTooSmall;
	if ( !LoadDynamicModule( pModule, unFlags ) )
		return pModule->m_eLastResult;

	*pcubRequired = cubOutput;
	EXCEPTION_RECORD32 record{};
	__try
	{
		pModule->m_eLastResult = static_cast<ECallResult>(
		    pModule->m_pServiceFunction( nRequest, pvInput, cubInput, pvOutput, pcubRequired ) );
	}
	__except ( CopyExceptionRecord( GetExceptionInformation(), &record ) )
	{
		auto *pResponse = static_cast<ExceptionResponse_t *>( pvOutput );
		pResponse->m_pServiceFunction = pModule->m_pServiceFunction;
		pResponse->m_unReserved = 0;
		pResponse->m_Record = record;
		pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::Exception;
		*pcubRequired = sizeof( ExceptionResponse_t );
	}

	pModule->m_ulLastUsedMicroSecs = CurrentMicroSecs();
	const ECallResult eResult = pModule->m_eLastResult;
	if ( unFlags & MF_UNLOAD_AFTER_EXEC )
		UnloadModule( uiCRC32 );
	return eResult;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 6A ? 68 ? ? ? ? 68 ? ? ? ? 64 A1 ? ? ? ? 50 64 89 25 ? ? ? ? 83 EC ? 53 56 57 89 65 ? 8B F9
ECallResult CClientModuleManagerBase::CallFunctionAsyncInternal( uint32_t uiCRC32, uint32_t unFlags, int nRequest,
                                                                 const void *pvInput, uint32_t cubInput,
                                                                 void **ppvOutput, uint32_t *pcubOutput )
{
	DynamicModule_t *pModule = FindModule( uiCRC32 );
	if ( !pModule )
	{
		*pcubOutput = 0;
		return ECallResult::ModuleNotFound;
	}

	uint32_t cubRequired = *pcubOutput;
	if ( cubRequired < sizeof( ExceptionResponse_t ) )
		cubRequired = sizeof( ExceptionResponse_t );
	*ppvOutput = malloc( cubRequired );

	if ( LoadDynamicModule( pModule, unFlags ) )
	{
		if ( *ppvOutput )
		{
			memset( *ppvOutput, 0, cubRequired );
			EXCEPTION_RECORD32 record{};
			__try
			{
				pModule->m_eLastResult = static_cast<ECallResult>(
				    pModule->m_pServiceFunction( nRequest, pvInput, cubInput, *ppvOutput, &cubRequired ) );
			}
			__except ( CopyExceptionRecord( GetExceptionInformation(), &record ) )
			{
				auto *pResponse = static_cast<ExceptionResponse_t *>( *ppvOutput );
				pResponse->m_pServiceFunction = pModule->m_pServiceFunction;
				pResponse->m_unReserved = 0;
				pResponse->m_Record = record;
				pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::Exception;
				*pcubOutput = sizeof( ExceptionResponse_t );
			}
		}
		else
		{
			*pcubOutput = 0;
			pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::AllocFailed;
		}
	}
	else
	{
		*pcubOutput = 0;
	}

	if ( pModule->m_eLastResult == ECallResult::OK && cubRequired > *pcubOutput )
	{
		pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::OutputTooLarge;
		cubRequired = 0;
	}

	if ( pModule->m_eLastResult != ECallResult::Exception )
	{
		pModule->m_ulLastUsedMicroSecs = CurrentMicroSecs();
		*pcubOutput = cubRequired;
	}

	const ECallResult eResult = pModule->m_eLastResult;
	if ( unFlags & MF_UNLOAD_AFTER_EXEC )
		UnloadModule( uiCRC32 );
	return eResult;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 81 EC ? ? ? ? 56 57 B8
ECallResult CClientModuleManagerBase::CallFunctionAsyncInternal_LegacyCompat( uint32_t uiCRC32, uint32_t unFlags,
                                                                              int nRequest, uint32_t unFile,
                                                                              const void *pvInput, uint32_t cubInput,
                                                                              void **ppvOutput, uint32_t *pcubOutput )
{
	const uint32_t cubOutputLimit = *pcubOutput;
	*pcubOutput = 0;
	DynamicModule_t *pModule = FindModule( uiCRC32 );
	if ( !pModule )
		return ECallResult::ModuleNotFound;

	const std::string sLegacyDir = m_sBaseDir + "/legacycompat/";
	if ( pModule->m_sFileName.empty() )
	{
		if ( !pModule->m_pRawModule || !pModule->m_uiRawModuleSize )
		{
			pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::NoModuleData;
			return ECallResult::NoModuleData;
		}

		const std::string sModuleFile = sLegacyDir + "servicecall_" + std::to_string( uiCRC32 ) + ".dll";
		if ( SaveBufferToFile( pModule->m_pRawModule, pModule->m_uiRawModuleSize, sModuleFile.c_str() ) )
		{
			pModule->m_sFileName = sModuleFile;
			free( pModule->m_pRawModule );
			pModule->m_pRawModule = nullptr;
		}
	}

	if ( GetFileAttributesA( pModule->m_sFileName.c_str() ) == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES )
	{
		pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::NoModuleData;
		return ECallResult::NoModuleData;
	}

	const std::string sInputFile = sLegacyDir + "servicecall_" + std::to_string( unFile ) + ".in";
	const std::string sOutputFile = sLegacyDir + "servicecall_" + std::to_string( unFile ) + ".out";
	if ( !SaveBufferToFile( pvInput, cubInput, sInputFile.c_str() ) )
	{
		pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::NoModuleData;
		return ECallResult::NoModuleData;
	}

	pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::Pending;
	DWORD unExitCode = 1;
	STARTUPINFOA startupInfo{};
	startupInfo.cb = sizeof( startupInfo );
	PROCESS_INFORMATION processInfo{};
	char szCommand[1024];
	snprintf( szCommand, sizeof( szCommand ), "%ssteamservice.exe /runfunc %u %u %u %u", sLegacyDir.c_str(), uiCRC32,
	          nRequest, unFile, cubOutputLimit );
	if ( CreateProcessA( nullptr, szCommand, nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, nullptr, m_sBaseDir.c_str(),
	                     &startupInfo, &processInfo ) )
	{
		WaitForSingleObject( processInfo.hProcess, 20000 );
		GetExitCodeProcess( processInfo.hProcess, &unExitCode );
		CloseHandle( processInfo.hProcess );
		CloseHandle( processInfo.hThread );
	}

	if ( unExitCode == 0 )
	{
		std::vector<uint8_t> vecOutput;
		if ( ReadWholeFile( sOutputFile, &vecOutput ) )
		{
			if ( vecOutput.size() > cubOutputLimit )
			{
				pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::OutputTooLarge;
			}
			else
			{
				if ( !vecOutput.empty() )
				{
					*ppvOutput = malloc( vecOutput.size() );
					memcpy( *ppvOutput, vecOutput.data(), vecOutput.size() );
					*pcubOutput = static_cast<uint32_t>( vecOutput.size() );
				}
				pModule->m_eLastResult = ECallResult::OK;
			}
		}
	}

	DeleteFileA( sInputFile.c_str() );
	DeleteFileA( sOutputFile.c_str() );
	return pModule->m_eLastResult;
}

	m_mapProtonEnvironments[uiKey] = pszEnvironment;
```

```cpp
void GrowEventData( std::vector<uint8_t> *pvecData, uint32_t cubGrowStep, uint32_t cubGrow )
{
	const uint32_t cubLast = static_cast<uint32_t>( pvecData->size() ) + cubGrow - 1;
	pvecData->resize( cubGrowStep + cubLast - cubLast % cubGrowStep );
}

uint64_t CurrentEventTime()
{
	FILETIME ftNow;
	ETWWin32::GetCurrentTimeAsEventTime( &ftNow );
	uint64_t ulNow;
	memcpy( &ulNow, &ftNow, sizeof( ulNow ) );
	return ulNow;
}

const EventHeader_t *NextEvent( const EventHeader_t *pEvent )
{
	return reinterpret_cast<const EventHeader_t *>( reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>( pEvent ) + pEvent->m_cubEvent );
}

	{

CMonitoredProcess::~CMonitoredProcess()
{
	for ( size_t iChild = 0; iChild < m_vecChildPids.size(); ++iChild )
		m_pMonitor->UnregisterProcess( m_vecChildPids[iChild] );
	m_vecChildPids.clear();
}

// @orig: 56 8B F1 8B 46 ? 85 C0 7E
int CMonitoredProcess::Release()
{
	const uint32_t cRefs = m_cRefs - 1;
	if ( cRefs > 0xFFFFFE )
		return 0;

	m_cRefs = cRefs;
	if ( cRefs != 0 )
		return cRefs;

	OnFinalRelease();
	return 0;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 53 8B 5D ? 57 8B F9 83 7F
void CMonitoredProcess::AddNewEvent( const EventHeader_t *pEvent )
{
	if ( m_cubEvents != 0 && pEvent->m_unSequence == m_unLastSequence )
		return;

	if ( m_vecEventData.size() < pEvent->m_cubEvent + m_cubEvents )
	{
		const uintptr_t ulOldBase = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>( m_vecEventData.data() );
		GrowEventData( &m_vecEventData, 1024, pEvent->m_cubEvent );
		const uintptr_t ulNewBase = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>( m_vecEventData.data() );
		if ( ulOldBase != ulNewBase )
		{
			for ( const EventHeader_t *&pHeader : m_vecEventHeaders )
				pHeader = reinterpret_cast<const EventHeader_t *>( reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>( pHeader ) - ulOldBase +
				                                                   ulNewBase );
		}
	}

	uint8_t *pubEvent = m_vecEventData.data() + m_cubEvents;
	memcpy( pubEvent, pEvent, pEvent->m_cubEvent );
	m_vecEventHeaders.push_back( reinterpret_cast<const EventHeader_t *>( pubEvent ) );
	m_cubEvents += pEvent->m_cubEvent;
	m_unLastSequence = pEvent->m_unSequence;

	if ( pEvent->m_eType != EEventType::ProcessStart )
		return;

	const auto *pStart = reinterpret_cast<const ProcessStartEvent_t *>( pEvent );
	if ( pStart->m_unParentPid == m_unPid )
	{
		m_pMonitor->RegisterProcess( pStart->m_unPid );
		m_vecChildPids.push_back( pStart->m_unPid );
	}
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 80 79 ? ? 75
int CMonitoredProcess::NCompareEventTime( uint64_t ulTime ) const
{
	if ( !m_bHaveCreationTime )
		return 0;

	const int64_t nDelta = static_cast<int64_t>( ulTime - m_ulCreationTime );
	if ( _abs64( nDelta ) <= k_nEventWindow )
		return 0;
	return nDelta <= 0 ? -1 : 1;
}

// @orig: 7ebac2a4:0x10059280 (not in export)
bool CMonitoredProcess::BProcessTimeSortFunc( CMonitoredProcess *const &pLeft, CMonitoredProcess *const &pRight )
{
	return pLeft->m_ulCreationTime > pRight->m_ulCreationTime;
}

	m_cEvents = 0;

	m_vecEventData.resize( 4096 );
	m_bInCallback = false;
	m_ulNextCallbackMicroSecs = 0;
	InitializeCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
	if ( !ETWWin32::BIsETWStarted() && ETWWin32::BStartETW() )
		Schedule( 1000000 );
}

void CClientProcessMonitor::Schedule( uint32_t unMicroSecs )
{
	m_ulNextCallbackMicroSecs = GetTickCount64() * 1000 + unMicroSecs;
}

// @orig: 7ebac2a4:0x10058FB0 (not in export)
void CClientProcessMonitor::AddDeferredOperation( uint32_t unPid, bool bRegister )
{
	if ( m_bInCallback )
		m_vecDeferredOperations.push_back( { bRegister, unPid } );
}

// @orig: 7ebac2a4:0x10059D20 (not in export)
int CClientProcessMonitor::PercolateUp( int iElement )
{
	int iCurrent = iElement;
	if ( iElement < static_cast<int>( m_vecProcessQueue.size() ) && iElement != 0 )
	{
		int iParent;
		do
		{
			iParent = ( iCurrent + 1 ) / 2 - 1;
			if ( CMonitoredProcess::BProcessTimeSortFunc( m_vecProcessQueue[iCurrent], m_vecProcessQueue[iParent] ) )
				break;

			std::swap( m_vecProcessQueue[iParent], m_vecProcessQueue[iCurrent] );
			iCurrent = iParent;
		} while ( iParent != 0 );
	}
	return iCurrent;
}

// @orig: 7ebac2a4:0x10059C70 (not in export)
int CClientProcessMonitor::PercolateDown( int iElement )
{
	const int cElements = static_cast<int>( m_vecProcessQueue.size() );
	int iCurrent = iElement;
	int iBest = iElement;
	if ( iElement >= cElements / 2 )
		return iElement;

	do
	{
		const int iLeft = 2 * iCurrent + 1;
		if ( iLeft < cElements &&
		     CMonitoredProcess::BProcessTimeSortFunc( m_vecProcessQueue[iCurrent], m_vecProcessQueue[iLeft] ) )
			iBest = iLeft;

		const int iRight = 2 * iCurrent + 2;
		if ( iRight < cElements &&
		     CMonitoredProcess::BProcessTimeSortFunc( m_vecProcessQueue[iBest], m_vecProcessQueue[iRight] ) )
			iBest = iRight;

		if ( iBest == iCurrent )
			break;

		std::swap( m_vecProcessQueue[iCurrent], m_vecProcessQueue[iBest] );
		iCurrent = iBest;
	} while ( iBest < cElements / 2 );
	return iCurrent;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 53 56 57 8B F9 8D B7 ? ? ? ? 56 FF 15 ? ? ? ? 8B 87
bool CClientProcessMonitor::BGetCachedProcessData( uint32_t unPid, const ActiveProcessData_t **ppData )
{
	EnterCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
	const auto it = m_mapActiveProcessIdToImagePath.find( unPid );
	const bool bFound = it != m_mapActiveProcessIdToImagePath.end();
	*ppData = bFound ? &it->second : nullptr;
	LeaveCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
	return bFound;
}

// @note / sapdragon: the output is the raw events and then an array of pointers to the service's own copies of them,
// not to the ones in the output. *pprgpEvents points at that array. that's how valve hands it out
// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 56 57 8B F9 8D B7
uint32_t CClientProcessMonitor::NGetNewEvents( uint32_t unPid, const EventHeader_t *const **pprgpEvents,
                                               int nStartEvent, void *pvBuffer, uint32_t cubBuffer )
{
	EnterCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
	const auto it = m_mapMonitoredProcesses.find( unPid );
	if ( it == m_mapMonitoredProcesses.end() )
	{
		*pprgpEvents = nullptr;
		LeaveCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
		return 0;
	}

	const CMonitoredProcess *pProcess = it->second;
	const int cHeaders = static_cast<int>( pProcess->m_vecEventHeaders.size() );
	const EventHeader_t *const *prgpHeaders =
	    pProcess->m_bHaveCreationTime && nStartEvent < cHeaders ? &pProcess->m_vecEventHeaders[nStartEvent] : nullptr;

	const uint32_t cAvailable = cHeaders - nStartEvent;
	uint8_t *pubOutput = static_cast<uint8_t *>( pvBuffer );
	uint32_t cCopied = 0;
	if ( cAvailable )
	{
		uint32_t cubUsed = 0;
		do
		{
			const EventHeader_t *pHeader = prgpHeaders[cCopied];
			const uint32_t cubEvent = pHeader->m_cubEvent;
			const uint32_t cubNeeded = cubEvent + cubUsed + 4;
			if ( cubNeeded > cubBuffer )
				break;

			memcpy( pubOutput, pHeader, cubEvent );
			cubUsed = cubNeeded;
			++cCopied;
			pubOutput += cubEvent;
		} while ( cCopied < cAvailable );
	}

	*pprgpEvents = reinterpret_cast<const EventHeader_t *const *>( pubOutput );
	if ( cCopied )
		memcpy( pubOutput, prgpHeaders, 4 * cCopied );
	LeaveCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
	return cCopied;
}

}

// @note / sapdragon: cPids only limits the return value, every id still gets written. valve's overflow, keep it.
// the order is whatever unordered_map gives, valve's is CUtlHashMap slot order
// @orig: 55 8B EC 53 8B D9 56 8D B3
uint32_t CClientProcessMonitor::NGetProcessIds( uint32_t *prgunPids, uint32_t cPids )
{
	EnterCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
	const uint32_t cProcesses = static_cast<uint32_t>( m_mapMonitoredProcesses.size() );
	const uint32_t cReturned = cPids < cProcesses ? cPids : cProcesses;
	for ( const auto &[unPid, pProcess] : m_mapMonitoredProcesses )
		*prgunPids++ = unPid;
	LeaveCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
	return cReturned;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 53 8B D9 56 57 8D B3
void CClientProcessMonitor::OnScheduledCallback()
{
	EnterCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
	m_bInCallback = true;

	uint32_t cubRead;
	do
	{
		const uint64_t ulOldest = CurrentEventTime() - k_nEventWindow;
		const EventHeader_t *pKeep = reinterpret_cast<const EventHeader_t *>( m_vecEventData.data() );
		uint32_t iEvent = 0;
		for ( ; iEvent < m_cEvents; ++iEvent )
		{
			if ( pKeep->m_ulTimestamp >= ulOldest )
				break;
			pKeep = NextEvent( pKeep );
		}

		const uint32_t cubDropped =
		    static_cast<uint32_t>( reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>( pKeep ) - m_vecEventData.data() );
		// @note / sapdragon: V_memcpy in the original, which copes with overlap
		if ( cubDropped && m_cubEvents != cubDropped )
			memmove( m_vecEventData.data(), pKeep, m_cubEvents - cubDropped );
		m_cEvents -= iEvent;
		m_cubEvents -= cubDropped;

		uint32_t cubFree = static_cast<uint32_t>( m_vecEventData.size() ) - m_cubEvents;
		if ( cubFree < 1024 )
		{
			GrowEventData( &m_vecEventData, 4096, 1024 - cubFree );
			cubFree = static_cast<uint32_t>( m_vecEventData.size() ) - m_cubEvents;
		}

		const EventHeader_t *pEvent = reinterpret_cast<const EventHeader_t *>( m_vecEventData.data() + m_cubEvents );
		cubRead = cubFree;
		int cNewEvents = ETWWin32::NReadAvailableEvents( const_cast<EventHeader_t *>( pEvent ), &cubRead );
		m_cubEvents += cubRead;
		m_cEvents += cNewEvents;

		for ( ; cNewEvents != 0; --cNewEvents, pEvent = NextEvent( pEvent ) )
		{
			while ( !m_vecProcessQueue.empty() && m_vecProcessQueue[0]->NCompareEventTime( pEvent->m_ulTimestamp ) > 0 )
			{
				if ( m_vecProcessQueue.size() != 1 )
					m_vecProcessQueue[0] = m_vecProcessQueue.back();
				m_vecProcessQueue.pop_back();
				PercolateDown( 0 );
			}

			for ( CMonitoredProcess *pProcess : m_vecProcessQueue )
				pProcess->AddNewEvent( pEvent );

			if ( pEvent->m_eType == EEventType::ProcessStart )
			{
				const auto *pStart = reinterpret_cast<const ProcessStartEvent_t *>( pEvent );
				const auto itSelf = m_mapMonitoredProcesses.find( pStart->m_unPid );
				if ( itSelf != m_mapMonitoredProcesses.end() )
					itSelf->second->AddNewEvent( pEvent );

				const auto itParent = m_mapMonitoredProcesses.find( pStart->m_unParentPid );
				if ( itParent != m_mapMonitoredProcesses.end() )
					itParent->second->AddNewEvent( pEvent );
			}
			else if ( pEvent->m_eType == EEventType::ProcessExit )
			{
				const auto *pExit = reinterpret_cast<const VacProcessMonitor::ProcessExitEvent_t *>( pEvent );
				const auto itSelf = m_mapMonitoredProcesses.find( pExit->m_unPid );
				if ( itSelf != m_mapMonitoredProcesses.end() )
					itSelf->second->AddNewEvent( pEvent );
			}
		}
	} while ( cubRead != 0 );

	m_bInCallback = false;
	for ( size_t iOperation = 0; iOperation < m_vecDeferredOperations.size(); ++iOperation )
	{
		const DeferredOperation_t operation = m_vecDeferredOperations[iOperation];
		if ( operation.m_bRegister )
			RegisterProcess( operation.m_unPid );
		else
			UnregisterProcess( operation.m_unPid );
	}
	m_vecDeferredOperations.clear();

	Schedule( 1000000 );
	LeaveCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
}

// @note / sapdragon: pids that died stay in the map on purpose, it's what makes BGetCachedProcessData work for a process
// that's gone. the whole map only clears when the last monitored process unregisters
// @orig: 55 8B EC B8 ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? 53 56 57 8D 45
void CClientProcessMonitor::RebuildProcessNameMap()
{
	DWORD rgunPids[1024];
	uint32_t cubPids;
	ETWWin32::BEnumProcessIds( sizeof( rgunPids ), rgunPids, &cubPids );
	const int cPids = cubPids >> 2;

	auto it = m_mapActiveProcessIdToImagePath.begin();
	const auto itEnd = m_mapActiveProcessIdToImagePath.end();
	int iPid = 0;
	while ( iPid < cPids || it != itEnd )
	{
		bool bInsert = iPid < cPids && ( it == itEnd || it->first > rgunPids[iPid] );
		const bool bStale = iPid >= cPids || ( it != itEnd && it->first < rgunPids[iPid] );
		bool bAdvance = bStale;
		bool bErase = false;
		if ( !bInsert && !bStale )
		{
			uint64_t ulCreationTime;
			if ( !ETWWin32::BGetCreationTimeForPid( rgunPids[iPid], reinterpret_cast<FILETIME *>( &ulCreationTime ) ) )
			{
				++iPid;
				bAdvance = true;
			}
			else if ( it->second.m_ulCreationTime != ulCreationTime )
			{
				bInsert = true;
				bAdvance = true;
				bErase = true;
			}
			else
			{
				++it;
				++iPid;
			}
		}

		if ( bAdvance )
		{
			const auto itCurrent = it;
			++it;
			if ( bErase )
			{
				if ( itCurrent->second.m_pwszImagePath )
					delete[] itCurrent->second.m_pwszImagePath;
				m_mapActiveProcessIdToImagePath.erase( itCurrent );
			}
		}

		if ( bInsert )
		{
			const DWORD unPid = rgunPids[iPid];
			uint64_t ulCreationTime;
			wchar_t wszPath[1024];
			uint32_t cchPath = ARRAYSIZE( wszPath );
			if ( ETWWin32::BGetCreationTimeForPid( unPid, reinterpret_cast<FILETIME *>( &ulCreationTime ) ) &&
			     ETWWin32::BGetImagePathForPid( unPid, wszPath, &cchPath ) )
			{
				wchar_t *pwszPath = new wchar_t[cchPath];
				memcpy( pwszPath, wszPath, 2 * cchPath );
				m_mapActiveProcessIdToImagePath.insert_or_assign( unPid,
				                                                  ActiveProcessData_t{ ulCreationTime, pwszPath } );
			}
			++iPid;
		}
	}
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 53 56 57 8B F9 8D B7 ? ? ? ? 56 FF 15 ? ? ? ? 80 7F
void CClientProcessMonitor::RegisterProcess( uint32_t unPid )
{
	EnterCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
	if ( m_bInCallback )
	{
		AddDeferredOperation( unPid, true );
		LeaveCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
		return;
	}

	const auto it = m_mapMonitoredProcesses.find( unPid );
	if ( it != m_mapMonitoredProcesses.end() )
	{
		++it->second->m_cRefs;
		LeaveCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
		return;
	}

	CMonitoredProcess *pProcess = new CMonitoredProcess( this, unPid );
	if ( !pProcess->m_bHaveCreationTime )
	{
		pProcess->Release();
		delete pProcess;
		LeaveCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
		return;
	}

	m_mapMonitoredProcesses[unPid] = pProcess;
	m_vecProcessQueue.push_back( pProcess );
	PercolateUp( static_cast<int>( m_vecProcessQueue.size() ) - 1 );

	const EventHeader_t *pEvent = reinterpret_cast<const EventHeader_t *>( m_vecEventData.data() );
	for ( uint32_t iEvent = 0; iEvent < m_cEvents; ++iEvent )
	{
		const EventHeader_t *pNext = NextEvent( pEvent );
		const int nCompare = pProcess->NCompareEventTime( pEvent->m_ulTimestamp );
		if ( nCompare > 0 )
			break;
		if ( nCompare >= 0 )
			pProcess->AddNewEvent( pEvent );
		pEvent = pNext;
	}

	RebuildProcessNameMap();
	LeaveCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
}

{
	return ResumeProcessById( unPid );
}

void CClientProcessMonitor::Shutdown()
{
	ETWWin32::StopETW();
}

// the calling thread lives and resume has to come from that same thread
// @orig: 7ebac2a4:0x1005A6C0 (no unique signature)

	return SuspendProcessById( unPid );

	return TerminateProcessById( unPid, 0 );
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 53 8B D9 56 8D B3
void CClientProcessMonitor::UnregisterProcess( uint32_t unPid )
{
	EnterCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
	if ( m_bInCallback )
	{
		AddDeferredOperation( unPid, false );
		LeaveCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
		return;
	}

	const auto it = m_mapMonitoredProcesses.find( unPid );
	if ( it != m_mapMonitoredProcesses.end() )
	{
		CMonitoredProcess *pProcess = it->second;
		if ( pProcess->Release() == 0 )
		{
			m_mapMonitoredProcesses.erase( it );
			if ( pProcess->NCompareEventTime( CurrentEventTime() ) >= 0 )
			{
				for ( size_t iQueue = 0; iQueue < m_vecProcessQueue.size(); ++iQueue )
				{
					if ( m_vecProcessQueue[iQueue] != pProcess )
						continue;

					if ( iQueue != m_vecProcessQueue.size() - 1 )
						m_vecProcessQueue[iQueue] = m_vecProcessQueue.back();
					m_vecProcessQueue.pop_back();
					const int iElement = PercolateDown( static_cast<int>( iQueue ) );
					if ( iElement == static_cast<int>( iQueue ) )
						PercolateUp( iElement );
					break;
				}
			}

			delete pProcess;

			if ( m_mapMonitoredProcesses.empty() )
			{
				for ( auto &[unActivePid, data] : m_mapActiveProcessIdToImagePath )
				{
					if ( data.m_pwszImagePath )
						delete[] data.m_pwszImagePath;
				}
				m_mapActiveProcessIdToImagePath.clear();
			}
		}
	}
	LeaveCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
}

} // namespace ClientProcessMonitor
```

```cpp
class CEventBuffer
{
public:
	CEventBuffer() : m_vecData( 0x100000 ), m_cubSize( 0x100000 ) {}

	int GetUsed() const { return m_cubUsed; }
	int GetSize() const { return m_cubSize; }
	int GetFree() const { return m_cubSize - m_cubUsed; }
	int Peek( void *pvOutput, int cubOutput ) const;
	int Read( void *pvOutput, int cubOutput );
	int Advance( int cubAdvance );
	int Write( const void *pvInput, int cubInput );

private:
	std::vector<uint8_t> m_vecData;
	int m_cubUsed = 0;
	int m_iRead = 0;
	int m_iWrite = 0;
	int m_cubSize;
};

// @orig: 55 8B EC 53 8B D9 8B 03
int CEventBuffer::Peek( void *pvOutput, int cubOutput ) const
{
	if ( !m_cubUsed )
		return 0;

	const int cubPeek = m_cubUsed < cubOutput ? m_cubUsed : cubOutput;
	if ( cubPeek + m_iRead <= m_cubSize )
	{
		memcpy( pvOutput, &m_vecData[m_iRead], cubPeek );
	}
	else
	{
		const int cubTail = m_cubSize - m_iRead;
		memcpy( pvOutput, &m_vecData[m_iRead], cubTail );
		memcpy( static_cast<uint8_t *>( pvOutput ) + cubTail, m_vecData.data(), cubPeek - cubTail );
	}
	return cubPeek;
}

// @orig: 7ebac2a4:0x10074340 (not in export)
int CEventBuffer::Advance( int cubAdvance )
{
	if ( !m_cubUsed )
		return 0;

	const int cubSkip = m_cubUsed < cubAdvance ? m_cubUsed : cubAdvance;
	m_iRead = ( cubSkip + m_iRead ) % m_cubSize;
	m_cubUsed -= cubSkip;
	if ( !m_cubUsed )
	{
		m_iRead = 0;
		m_iWrite = 0;
	}
	return cubSkip;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 53 56 57 8B F9 8B 07
int CEventBuffer::Read( void *pvOutput, int cubOutput )
{
	const int cubPeek = Peek( pvOutput, cubOutput );
	return cubPeek ? Advance( cubPeek ) : 0;
}

// @orig: 7ebac2a4:0x10074500 (not in export)
int CEventBuffer::Write( const void *pvInput, int cubInput )
{
	if ( cubInput <= 0 )
		return cubInput;

	auto *pubInput = static_cast<const uint8_t *>( pvInput );
	int cubLeft = cubInput;
	do
	{
		const int cubTail = m_cubSize - m_iWrite;
		const int cubChunk = cubTail <= cubLeft ? cubTail : cubLeft;
		memcpy( &m_vecData[m_iWrite], pubInput, cubChunk );
		m_iWrite = ( cubChunk + m_iWrite ) % m_cubSize;
		if ( cubChunk <= m_cubSize - m_cubUsed )
		{
			m_cubUsed += cubChunk;
		}
		else
		{
			m_iRead = m_iWrite;
			m_cubUsed = m_cubSize;
		}
		pubInput += cubChunk;
		cubLeft -= cubChunk;
	} while ( cubLeft > 0 );
	return cubInput;
}

class CEventQueue
{
public:
	CEventQueue() { InitializeCriticalSection( &m_CritSec ); }

	void Enqueue( const EventHeader_t *pEvent );

	CRITICAL_SECTION m_CritSec;
	CEventBuffer m_Buffer;
};

// @orig: 7ebac2a4:0x10048AA0 (not in export)
void CEventQueue::Enqueue( const EventHeader_t *pEvent )
{
	EnterCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
	if ( static_cast<int>( pEvent->m_cubEvent ) <= m_Buffer.GetSize() )
	{
		while ( m_Buffer.GetFree() < static_cast<int>( pEvent->m_cubEvent ) )
		{
			EventHeader_t oldest;
			m_Buffer.Peek( &oldest, sizeof( oldest ) );
			m_Buffer.Advance( oldest.m_cubEvent );
		}
		m_Buffer.Write( pEvent, pEvent->m_cubEvent );
	}
	LeaveCriticalSection( &m_CritSec );
}

void WriteProcessStartEvent( uint64_t ulTimestamp, const wchar_t *pwszImagePath, DWORD unPid, DWORD unParentPid,

	memcpy( event.m_wszImagePath, pwszImagePath, 2 * cchCopy );
	event.m_wszImagePath[cchCopy] = L'\0';

// @note / sapdragon: the path when etw won't start. it diffs EnumProcesses once a second, so parent and session are 0
// and creation time is just now. child processes can't be followed from these
// @orig: 7ebac2a4:0x10048730 (not in export)
void PollProcessList()
{
	ProcessSnapshot_t rgSnapshots[2];
	memset( rgSnapshots, 0, sizeof( rgSnapshots ) );

	int iSnapshot = 0;
	while ( s_bETWStarted )
	{
		ProcessSnapshot_t &current = rgSnapshots[iSnapshot];
		iSnapshot = ( iSnapshot + 1 ) % 2;
		const ProcessSnapshot_t &previous = rgSnapshots[iSnapshot];

		FILETIME ftNow;
		GetSystemTimeAsFileTime( &ftNow );
		uint64_t ulNow;
		memcpy( &ulNow, &ftNow, sizeof( ulNow ) );

		DWORD cubPids = 0;
		uint32_t cubCurrent = EnumProcesses( current.m_rgunPids, sizeof( current.m_rgunPids ), &cubPids );
		if ( cubCurrent )
		{
			qsort( current.m_rgunPids, cubPids >> 2, sizeof( DWORD ), ComparePids );
			cubCurrent = cubPids;
		}
		current.m_cPids = cubCurrent >> 2;

		uint32_t cPrevious = previous.m_cPids;
		if ( cPrevious )
		{
			uint32_t iCurrent = 0;
			for ( uint32_t iPrevious = 0;; ++iPrevious )
			{
				if ( iCurrent < current.m_cPids )
				{
					do
					{
						if ( iPrevious != previous.m_cPids &&
						     current.m_rgunPids[iCurrent] >= previous.m_rgunPids[iPrevious] )
							break;

						const DWORD unPid = current.m_rgunPids[iCurrent++];
						wchar_t wszPath[2048];
						wszPath[0] = L'\0';
						if ( s_pfnQueryFullProcessImageNameW || s_pfnGetProcessImageFileNameW )
						{
							const HANDLE hProcess = OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );
							if ( hProcess )
							{
								DWORD cchPath = 1024;
								if ( s_pfnQueryFullProcessImageNameW )
									s_pfnQueryFullProcessImageNameW( hProcess, PROCESS_NAME_NATIVE, wszPath, &cchPath );
								else if ( s_pfnGetProcessImageFileNameW )
									s_pfnGetProcessImageFileNameW( hProcess, wszPath, 1024 );
								CloseHandle( hProcess );
							}
						}
						WriteProcessStartEvent( ulNow, wszPath, unPid, 0, 0, &ftNow );
					} while ( iCurrent < current.m_cPids );
				}
				else if ( iPrevious >= cPrevious )
				{
					break;
				}

				for ( cPrevious = previous.m_cPids; iPrevious < cPrevious; cPrevious = previous.m_cPids )
				{
					if ( iCurrent != current.m_cPids && current.m_rgunPids[iCurrent] <= previous.m_rgunPids[iPrevious] )
						break;

					KernelProcessStop_t stop{};
					stop.m_unPid = previous.m_rgunPids[iPrevious++];
					stop.m_ulExitTime = ulNow;
					WriteProcessExitEvent( ulNow, &stop );
				}
				++iCurrent;
			}
		}

		WaitForSingleObject( s_hStopEvent, 1000 );
	}
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 8D 45 ? 50 FF 75
bool BEnumProcessIds( uint32_t cubPids, DWORD *prgunPids, uint32_t *pcubPids )
{
	DWORD cubNeeded;
	if ( !EnumProcesses( prgunPids, cubPids, &cubNeeded ) )
	{
		*pcubPids = 0;
		return false;
	}

	qsort( prgunPids, cubNeeded >> 2, sizeof( DWORD ), ComparePids );
	*pcubPids = cubNeeded;
	return cubNeeded != cubPids;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 56 8B 75 ? 57 85 F6
bool BGetCreationTimeForPid( DWORD unPid, FILETIME *pCreationTime )
{
	const HANDLE hProcess = OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );
	if ( !hProcess )
	{
		pCreationTime->dwLowDateTime = 0;
		pCreationTime->dwHighDateTime = 0;
		return false;
	}

	FILETIME ftCreation;
	FILETIME ftOther;
	const bool bResult = GetProcessTimes( hProcess, &ftCreation, &ftOther, &ftOther, &ftOther ) != FALSE;
	CloseHandle( hProcess );
	*pCreationTime = ftCreation;
	return bResult;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 51 56 57 8B 7D
bool BGetImagePathForPid( DWORD unPid, wchar_t *pwszPath, uint32_t *pcchPath )
{
	const uint32_t cchBuffer = *pcchPath;
	*pwszPath = L'\0';
	*pcchPath = 0;
	if ( !s_pfnQueryFullProcessImageNameW && !s_pfnGetProcessImageFileNameW )
		return false;

	const HANDLE hProcess = OpenProcess( PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, unPid );
	if ( !hProcess )
		return false;

	bool bResult = false;
	DWORD cchPath = cchBuffer;
	if ( s_pfnQueryFullProcessImageNameW )
	{
		bResult = s_pfnQueryFullProcessImageNameW( hProcess, PROCESS_NAME_NATIVE, pwszPath, &cchPath ) != FALSE;
	}
	else if ( s_pfnGetProcessImageFileNameW )
	{
		cchPath = s_pfnGetProcessImageFileNameW( hProcess, pwszPath, cchBuffer );
		bResult = cchPath != 0;
	}
	CloseHandle( hProcess );
	*pcchPath = cchPath + 1;
	return bResult;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 81 EC ? ? ? ? 56 8B 35
bool BStartETW()
{
	ResolveImagePathFunctions();
	if ( !s_pfnQueryFullProcessImageNameW && !s_pfnGetProcessImageFileNameW )
	{
		s_unErrorFlags |= EF_NO_IMAGE_PATH_API;
		return false;
	}

	OSVERSIONINFOA versionInfo;
	versionInfo.dwOSVersionInfoSize = sizeof( versionInfo );
#pragma warning( suppress : 4996 )
	if ( !GetVersionExA( &versionInfo ) )
	{
		s_unErrorFlags |= EF_NO_OS_VERSION;
		return false;
	}

	if ( versionInfo.dwMajorVersion >= 6 )
	{
		TraceProperties_t properties;
		InitTraceProperties( &properties );
		StopTraceA( 0, s_pszSessionName, &properties.m_Properties );

		InitTraceProperties( &properties );
		properties.m_Properties.Wnode.ClientContext = 2;
		properties.m_Properties.MaximumFileSize = 1024;
		properties.m_Properties.LogFileMode = EVENT_TRACE_REAL_TIME_MODE;
		TRACEHANDLE hSession;
		if ( StartTraceA( &hSession, s_pszSessionName, &properties.m_Properties ) != ERROR_SUCCESS )
		{
			s_unErrorFlags |= EF_START_TRACE_FAILED;
		}
		else
		{
			s_bETWStarted = true;

			EVENT_TRACE_LOGFILEA logFile;
			memset( &logFile, 0, sizeof( logFile ) );
			logFile.LoggerName = const_cast<char *>( s_pszSessionName );
			logFile.ProcessTraceMode = PROCESS_TRACE_MODE_EVENT_RECORD | PROCESS_TRACE_MODE_REAL_TIME;
			logFile.EventRecordCallback = EventCallback;
			s_hTrace = OpenTraceA( &logFile );
			if ( s_hTrace == 0xFFFFFFFF )
				s_unErrorFlags |= EF_OPEN_TRACE_FAILED;

			const ULONG unEnableResult =
			    EnableTrace( TRUE, 0x10, TRACE_LEVEL_INFORMATION, &k_KernelProcessGuid, hSession );
			// @note / sapdragon: this is the session handle, not a consumer one. valve's bug, CloseTrace just fails
			CloseTrace( hSession );
			if ( unEnableResult == ERROR_SUCCESS )
			{
				const HANDLE hThread = CreateThread( nullptr, 0, ThreadProcess_ProcessTrace, nullptr, 0, nullptr );
				s_unErrorFlags |= EF_TRACE_THREAD_STARTED;
				s_hThread = hThread;
				return true;
			}
			s_unErrorFlags |= EF_ENABLE_TRACE_FAILED;
		}
	}

	s_bETWStarted = true;
	s_bETWInitialised = true;
	s_hStopEvent = CreateEventA( nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr );
	if ( s_hStopEvent )
	{
		s_hThread = CreateThread( nullptr, 0, ThreadProcess, nullptr, 0, nullptr );
		if ( s_hStopEvent && s_hThread )
		{
			s_unErrorFlags |= EF_POLLING_THREAD_STARTED;
			return true;
		}
	}

	s_unErrorFlags |= EF_POLLING_THREAD_FAILED;
	return false;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 53 56 57 68
int NReadAvailableEvents( void *pvBuffer, uint32_t *pcubBuffer )
{
	uint32_t cubRead = 0;
	int cEvents = 0;
	EnterCriticalSection( &s_EventQueue.m_CritSec );
	for ( ; s_EventQueue.m_Buffer.GetUsed() != 0; ++cEvents )
	{
		if ( cubRead >= *pcubBuffer )
			break;

		EventHeader_t header;
		s_EventQueue.m_Buffer.Peek( &header, sizeof( header ) );
		if ( header.m_cubEvent + cubRead > *pcubBuffer )
			break;

		s_EventQueue.m_Buffer.Read( static_cast<uint8_t *>( pvBuffer ) + cubRead, header.m_cubEvent );
		cubRead += header.m_cubEvent;
	}
	LeaveCriticalSection( &s_EventQueue.m_CritSec );
	*pcubBuffer = cubRead;
	return cEvents;
}

// @note / sapdragon: only start v0 and v2 and stop v0 and v1 are known. any other version is dropped without a word
// @orig: 7ebac2a4:0x10048530 (not in export)
void WINAPI EventCallback( PEVENT_RECORD pEvent )
{
	if ( memcmp( &pEvent->EventHeader.ProviderId, &k_KernelProcessGuid, sizeof( GUID ) ) != 0 )
		return;

	const uint64_t ulTimestamp = pEvent->EventHeader.TimeStamp.QuadPart;
	switch ( MAKELONG( pEvent->EventHeader.EventDescriptor.Id, pEvent->EventHeader.EventDescriptor.Version ) )
	{
	case MAKELONG( 1, 0 ):
	{
		const auto *pStart = static_cast<const KernelProcessStartV0_t *>( pEvent->UserData );
		WriteProcessStartEvent( ulTimestamp, pStart->m_wszImageName, pStart->m_unPid, pStart->m_unParentPid,
		                        pStart->m_unSessionId, &pStart->m_ulCreationTime );
		break;
	}
	case MAKELONG( 1, 2 ):
	{
		const auto *pStart = static_cast<const KernelProcessStartV2_t *>( pEvent->UserData );
		WriteProcessStartEvent( ulTimestamp, pStart->m_wszImageName, pStart->m_unPid, pStart->m_unParentPid,
		                        pStart->m_unSessionId, &pStart->m_ulCreationTime );
		break;
	}
	case MAKELONG( 2, 0 ):
	case MAKELONG( 2, 1 ):
		WriteProcessExitEvent( ulTimestamp, static_cast<const KernelProcessStop_t *>( pEvent->UserData ) );
		break;
	}
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 81 EC ? ? ? ? 80 3D
void StopETW()
{
	if ( !s_bETWStarted )
		return;

	if ( s_bETWInitialised )
	{
		s_bETWStarted = false;
		if ( s_hStopEvent )
			SetEvent( s_hStopEvent );
		if ( s_hThread )
			WaitForSingleObject( s_hThread, 1000 );
		s_hThread = nullptr;
		if ( s_hStopEvent )
			CloseHandle( s_hStopEvent );
		s_hStopEvent = nullptr;
	}
	else
	{
		// @note / sapdragon: s_bETWStarted stays set on this path, valve never clears it
		TraceProperties_t properties;
		InitTraceProperties( &properties );
		StopTraceA( 0, s_pszSessionName, &properties.m_Properties );
		CloseTrace( s_hTrace );
		s_hTrace = 0;
		if ( s_hThread )
			WaitForSingleObject( s_hThread, 1000 );
		s_hThread = nullptr;
	}
}

	s_pszSessionName = pszSessionName;
```

`service/src/signature/valvesignature.cpp`:

```cpp
// @binary: 7ebac2a4
#include "signature/valvesignature.hpp"

#define WIN32_NO_STATUS
#include <Windows.h>
#undef WIN32_NO_STATUS
#include <bcrypt.h>
#include <ntstatus.h>
#include <wincrypt.h>

#include <cstring>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment( lib, "bcrypt.lib" )
#pragma comment( lib, "crypt32.lib" )

namespace
{

// @note / sapdragon: the signature block sits in the dos stub, right after the dos header
struct ValveSignatureHeader_t
{
	uint32_t m_unMagic;
	uint32_t m_unVersion;
	uint32_t m_cubSigned;
	uint32_t m_unReserved;
	uint8_t m_rgubSignature[128];
};
static_assert( sizeof( ValveSignatureHeader_t ) == 0x90 );

constexpr uint32_t k_unValveMagic = 0x564C56;
constexpr uint32_t k_ibSignatureHeader = sizeof( IMAGE_DOS_HEADER );

// @note / sapdragon: the first slot is an empty string in the binary, so one real key
const char k_szCodeSignatureKey[] =
    "30819D300D06092A864886F70D010101050003818B0030818702818100B1260881BDFE84463D88C6AB8DB914A2E59389"
    "3C10508B8A5ABDF692E9A5419A3EDBAE86A052849983B75E3B425C18178B260003D857DF0B6505C6CF9C84F5859FCE3B"
    "63F1FB2D4818501F6C5FA4AD1430EEB081A74ABD74CD1F4AA1FCCA3B88DD0548AED34443CEB52444EAE9099AA4FE66B2"
    "E6224D02381C248025C7044079020111";

std::vector<uint8_t> DecodeHex( std::string_view svHex )
{
	std::vector<uint8_t> rgubOut;
	if ( svHex.size() % 2 )
		return {};

	const auto NibbleValue = []( char ch ) -> int
	{
		if ( ch >= '0' && ch <= '9' )
			return ch - '0';
		if ( ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'F' )
			return ch - 'A' + 10;
		if ( ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'f' )
			return ch - 'a' + 10;
		return -1;
	};
	for ( size_t ich = 0; ich < svHex.size(); ich += 2 )
	{
		const int nHigh = NibbleValue( svHex[ich] );
		const int nLow = NibbleValue( svHex[ich + 1] );
		if ( nHigh < 0 || nLow < 0 )
			return {};
		rgubOut.push_back( static_cast<uint8_t>( ( nHigh << 4 ) | nLow ) );
	}
	return rgubOut;
}

BCRYPT_KEY_HANDLE ImportPublicKey( const char *pszHexKey )
{
	const std::vector<uint8_t> rgubDer = DecodeHex( pszHexKey );
	if ( rgubDer.empty() )
		return nullptr;

	CERT_PUBLIC_KEY_INFO *pKeyInfo = nullptr;
	DWORD cubKeyInfo = 0;
	if ( !CryptDecodeObjectEx( X509_ASN_ENCODING, X509_PUBLIC_KEY_INFO, rgubDer.data(),
	                           static_cast<DWORD>( rgubDer.size() ), CRYPT_DECODE_ALLOC_FLAG, nullptr, &pKeyInfo,
	                           &cubKeyInfo ) )
		return nullptr;

	BCRYPT_KEY_HANDLE hKey = nullptr;
	if ( !CryptImportPublicKeyInfoEx2( X509_ASN_ENCODING, pKeyInfo, 0, nullptr, &hKey ) )
		hKey = nullptr;
	LocalFree( pKeyInfo );
	return hKey;
}

bool HashSha1( const void *pvData, uint32_t cubData, uint8_t ( &rgubDigest )[20] )
{
	return BCRYPT_SUCCESS( BCryptHash( BCRYPT_SHA1_ALG_HANDLE, nullptr, 0,
	                                   static_cast<PUCHAR>( const_cast<void *>( pvData ) ), cubData, rgubDigest,
	                                   sizeof( rgubDigest ) ) );
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC 83 EC ? 83 3D ? ? ? ? ? 75 ? 33 C0 EB ? 8D 45 ? 50 6A ? 68 ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? 83 C4 ? 83 7D ? ? 89 45 ? 75 ? 68 ? ? ? ? 68 ? ? ? ? 68 ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? 83 C4 ? 84 C0 75 ? CC 83 7D
bool VerifyRSASignature( const void *pvData, uint32_t cubData, const uint8_t *pubSignature, uint32_t cubSignature,
                         const char *pszHexKey )
{
	const BCRYPT_KEY_HANDLE hKey = ImportPublicKey( pszHexKey );
	if ( !hKey )
		return false;

	uint8_t rgubDigest[20];
	bool bValid = false;
	if ( HashSha1( pvData, cubData, rgubDigest ) )
	{
		BCRYPT_PKCS1_PADDING_INFO padding{ BCRYPT_SHA1_ALGORITHM };
		bValid = BCRYPT_SUCCESS( BCryptVerifySignature( hKey, &padding, rgubDigest, sizeof( rgubDigest ),
		                                                const_cast<PUCHAR>( pubSignature ), cubSignature,
		                                                BCRYPT_PAD_PKCS1 ) );
	}
	BCryptDestroyKey( hKey );
	return bValid;
}

} // namespace

// @orig: 55 8B EC 8B 55 ? 81 EC ? ? ? ? 56 81 FA
ESignatureResult VerifyValveWin32Signature( void *pvImage, uint32_t cubImage, const char *const *ppszPublicKeys,
                                            uint32_t cPublicKeys )
{
	auto *pubImage = static_cast<uint8_t *>( pvImage );
	if ( cubImage < 0x200 )
		return ESignatureResult::NotPeImage;
	const auto *pDosHeader = static_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( pvImage );
	if ( pDosHeader->e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE )
		return ESignatureResult::NotPeImage;

	const uint32_t ibNtHeaders = pDosHeader->e_lfanew;
	if ( ibNtHeaders < sizeof( IMAGE_DOS_HEADER ) || ibNtHeaders >= cubImage - sizeof( IMAGE_NT_HEADERS32 ) ||
	     *reinterpret_cast<const DWORD *>( pubImage + ibNtHeaders ) != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE )
		return ESignatureResult::NotPeImage;

	auto *pHeader = reinterpret_cast<ValveSignatureHeader_t *>( pubImage + k_ibSignatureHeader );
	if ( pHeader->m_unMagic != k_unValveMagic )
		return ESignatureResult::NoValveHeader;
	if ( pHeader->m_unVersion != 1 )
		return ESignatureResult::BadVersion;
	if ( cubImage < pHeader->m_cubSigned )
		return ESignatureResult::BadLength;

	auto *pHeaders32 = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_NT_HEADERS32 *>( pubImage + ibNtHeaders );
	auto *pHeaders64 = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 *>( pubImage + ibNtHeaders );
	const bool b32Bit = pHeaders32->OptionalHeader.Magic == IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC;
	if ( !b32Bit && pHeaders32->OptionalHeader.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC )
		return ESignatureResult::BadLength;

	DWORD &unCheckSum = b32Bit ? pHeaders32->OptionalHeader.CheckSum : pHeaders64->OptionalHeader.CheckSum;
	IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY &security = b32Bit ? pHeaders32->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY]
	                                        : pHeaders64->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY];

	uint8_t rgubSignature[sizeof( pHeader->m_rgubSignature )];
	memcpy( rgubSignature, pHeader->m_rgubSignature, sizeof( rgubSignature ) );
	memset( pHeader->m_rgubSignature, 0, sizeof( pHeader->m_rgubSignature ) );
	const DWORD unSavedCheckSum = unCheckSum;
	unCheckSum = 0;
	const IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY savedSecurity = security;
	security = {};

	bool bValid = false;
	for ( uint32_t iKey = 0; iKey < cPublicKeys && !bValid; ++iKey )
		bValid = VerifyRSASignature( pubImage, pHeader->m_cubSigned, rgubSignature, sizeof( rgubSignature ),
		                             ppszPublicKeys[iKey] );

	memcpy( pHeader->m_rgubSignature, rgubSignature, sizeof( rgubSignature ) );
	unCheckSum = unSavedCheckSum;
	security = savedSecurity;
	return bValid ? ESignatureResult::Valid : ESignatureResult::Invalid;
}

// @orig: 55 8B EC FF 35 ? ? ? ? 68
ESignatureResult VerifyValveSignature( void *pvImage, uint32_t cubImage )
{
	const char *const rgpszKeys[] = { "", k_szCodeSignatureKey };
	return VerifyValveWin32Signature( pvImage, cubImage, rgpszKeys, 2 );
}
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
MSBUILD = Path(r"C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe")

TESTS = [
    ("modules/payload_executor/tests/parity.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("tests/dispatch/dispatch_parity.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("tests/sdk/sdk_tests.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("tests/service/test_module.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("tests/service/test_module_entry.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("tests/service/service_tests.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("modules/shared_section/tests/parity.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("modules/system_handles/tests/parity.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("modules/target_handles/tests/parity.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("modules/system_info/tests/parity.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("modules/process_memory_map/tests/regression.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("modules/driver_inventory/tests/regression.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("modules/image_scan_threads/tests/thread_fixture.vcxproj", "Win32"),
    ("modules/image_scan_threads/tests/thread_fixture.vcxproj", "x64"),
]


def build(project: str, platform: str) -> bool:
    command = [str(MSBUILD), project, "-p:Configuration=Release", f"-p:Platform={platform}",
               f"-p:SolutionDir={ROOT}\\", "-nologo", "-v:q", "-m"]
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, errors="replace")
    errors = [line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if " error " in line]
    print(f"{'ok  ' if result.returncode == 0 else 'FAIL'} {project} [{platform}]")
    for line in errors[:10]:
        print("    " + line[:220])
    return result.returncode == 0


def main() -> int:
    results = [build("vac.sln", "Win32")]
    results += [build(project, platform) for project, platform in TESTS]
    return 0 if all(results) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

`tests/dispatch/dispatch_parity.cpp`:

```cpp
// Compares the whole runfunc of an original module and a rebuild, including ICE and RSA.
//
//     dispatch_parity.exe <original.dll> <rebuild.dll> <input_packet.bin>
//
// Both images are mapped by hand, the way VAC's own loader does it: read-write-execute and without
// running the entry point at load. Each case gets fresh images, because runfunc leaves state behind.
// rdtsc is patched to a constant so the session key and padding become deterministic.

#include <windows.h>

#include <array>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace
{

using PfnRunFunc_t = int( __stdcall * )( int, void *, unsigned, void *, unsigned * );

constexpr unsigned k_cubResponse = 0x1088;

std::vector<unsigned char> ReadFileBytes( const char *pszPath )
{
	std::ifstream file( pszPath, std::ios::binary );
	return { std::istreambuf_iterator<char>( file ), {} };
}

struct MappedImage_t
{
	unsigned char *m_pubBase = nullptr;
	PfnRunFunc_t m_pfnRunFunc = nullptr;
	int m_cPatchedRdtsc = 0;
};

MappedImage_t MapImage( const std::vector<unsigned char> &file )
{
	const auto *pDos = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *>( file.data() );
	const auto *pNt = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS32 *>( file.data() + pDos->e_lfanew );

	MappedImage_t image;
	image.m_pubBase = static_cast<unsigned char *>(
		VirtualAlloc( nullptr, pNt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE ) );
	std::memcpy( image.m_pubBase, file.data(), pNt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfHeaders );

	const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER *pSections = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION( pNt );
	for ( unsigned iSection = 0; iSection < pNt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = pSections[iSection];
		std::memcpy( image.m_pubBase + section.VirtualAddress, file.data() + section.PointerToRawData, section.SizeOfRawData );
	}

	const auto &relocDir = pNt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC];
	const unsigned unDelta = static_cast<unsigned>( reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>( image.m_pubBase ) ) - pNt->OptionalHeader.ImageBase;
	for ( unsigned ib = 0; ib < relocDir.Size; )
	{
		const auto *pBlock = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_BASE_RELOCATION *>( image.m_pubBase + relocDir.VirtualAddress + ib );
		const auto *punEntries = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned short *>( pBlock + 1 );
		const unsigned cEntries = ( pBlock->SizeOfBlock - sizeof( *pBlock ) ) / 2;
		for ( unsigned iEntry = 0; iEntry < cEntries; ++iEntry )
		{
			if ( punEntries[iEntry] >> 12 == IMAGE_REL_BASED_HIGHLOW )
				*reinterpret_cast<unsigned *>( image.m_pubBase + pBlock->VirtualAddress + ( punEntries[iEntry] & 0xFFF ) ) += unDelta;
		}
		ib += pBlock->SizeOfBlock;
	}

	const auto &importDir = pNt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT];
	auto *pImport = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_IMPORT_DESCRIPTOR *>( image.m_pubBase + importDir.VirtualAddress );
	for ( ; pImport->Name; ++pImport )
	{
		const HMODULE hLibrary = LoadLibraryA( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( image.m_pubBase + pImport->Name ) );
		auto *pThunk = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_THUNK_DATA32 *>( image.m_pubBase + pImport->FirstThunk );
		auto *pName = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_THUNK_DATA32 *>( image.m_pubBase + ( pImport->OriginalFirstThunk ? pImport->OriginalFirstThunk : pImport->FirstThunk ) );
		for ( ; pName->u1.AddressOfData; ++pThunk, ++pName )
		{
			const auto *pByName = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_IMPORT_BY_NAME *>( image.m_pubBase + pName->u1.AddressOfData );
			pThunk->u1.Function = static_cast<DWORD>( reinterpret_cast<UINT_PTR>( GetProcAddress( hLibrary, pByName->Name ) ) );
		}
	}

	const auto &exportDir = pNt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT];
	const auto *pExports = reinterpret_cast<const IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY *>( image.m_pubBase + exportDir.VirtualAddress );
	const auto *punFunctions = reinterpret_cast<const DWORD *>( image.m_pubBase + pExports->AddressOfFunctions );
	image.m_pfnRunFunc = reinterpret_cast<PfnRunFunc_t>( image.m_pubBase + punFunctions[0] );

	for ( unsigned iSection = 0; iSection < pNt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++iSection )
	{
		const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER &section = pSections[iSection];
		if ( !( section.Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE ) )
			continue;
		unsigned char *pubCode = image.m_pubBase + section.VirtualAddress;
		for ( unsigned ib = 0; ib + 1 < section.Misc.VirtualSize; ++ib )
		{
			if ( pubCode[ib] == 0x0F && pubCode[ib + 1] == 0x31 )
			{
				pubCode[ib] = 0x31; // xor eax, eax
				pubCode[ib + 1] = 0xC0;
				++image.m_cPatchedRdtsc;
			}
		}
	}
	return image;
}

struct Result_t
{
	int m_nResult;
	unsigned m_cubOutput;
	std::array<unsigned char, k_cubResponse> m_rgubOutput;
};

Result_t RunCase( const std::vector<unsigned char> &file, int nMode, std::vector<unsigned char> packet, unsigned cubInput, unsigned cubCapacity )
{
	MappedImage_t image = MapImage( file );
	Result_t result{};
	result.m_cubOutput = cubCapacity;
	result.m_nResult = image.m_pfnRunFunc( nMode, packet.data(), cubInput, result.m_rgubOutput.data(), &result.m_cubOutput );
	VirtualFree( image.m_pubBase, 0, MEM_RELEASE );
	return result;
}

} // namespace

int main( int argc, char **argv )
{
	if ( argc != 4 )
		return 2;

	const auto original = ReadFileBytes( argv[1] );
	const auto rebuild = ReadFileBytes( argv[2] );
	const auto packet = ReadFileBytes( argv[3] );
	if ( original.empty() || rebuild.empty() || packet.size() < 0xB0 )
		return 3;

	auto badCrc = packet;
	badCrc[8] ^= 0xFF;
	auto wrongId = packet;
	wrongId[0] ^= 0xFF;

	struct Case_t
	{
		const char *m_pszName;
		int m_nMode;
		const std::vector<unsigned char> *m_pPacket;
		unsigned m_cubInput;
		unsigned m_cubCapacity;
	};
	const Case_t rgCases[] = {
		{ "full_response", 4, &packet, static_cast<unsigned>( packet.size() ), k_cubResponse },
		{ "other_session_id", 4, &packet, static_cast<unsigned>( packet.size() ), k_cubResponse },
		{ "bad_crc", 4, &badCrc, static_cast<unsigned>( packet.size() ), k_cubResponse },
		{ "unknown_module", 4, &wrongId, static_cast<unsigned>( packet.size() ), k_cubResponse },
		{ "short_input", 4, &packet, 0xAF, k_cubResponse },
		{ "tiny_capacity", 4, &packet, static_cast<unsigned>( packet.size() ), 0xF },
		{ "small_capacity", 4, &packet, static_cast<unsigned>( packet.size() ), 0xFFF },
		{ "other_mode", 3, &packet, static_cast<unsigned>( packet.size() ), k_cubResponse },
	};

	const MappedImage_t probe = MapImage( rebuild );
	const MappedImage_t probeOriginal = MapImage( original );
	std::printf( "patched rdtsc: original=%d rebuild=%d\n", probeOriginal.m_cPatchedRdtsc, probe.m_cPatchedRdtsc );

	int cFailures = 0;
	for ( const Case_t &testCase : rgCases )
	{
		auto input = *testCase.m_pPacket;
		if ( !std::strcmp( testCase.m_pszName, "other_session_id" ) )
			input[0x0C] ^= 0x5A;

		const Result_t expected = RunCase( original, testCase.m_nMode, input, testCase.m_cubInput, testCase.m_cubCapacity );
		const Result_t actual = RunCase( rebuild, testCase.m_nMode, input, testCase.m_cubInput, testCase.m_cubCapacity );

		unsigned cDifferent = 0;
		unsigned ibFirst = 0;
		for ( unsigned ib = 0; ib < k_cubResponse; ++ib )
		{
			if ( expected.m_rgubOutput[ib] != actual.m_rgubOutput[ib] )
			{
				if ( !cDifferent )
					ibFirst = ib;
				++cDifferent;
			}
		}
		const bool bOk = !cDifferent && expected.m_nResult == actual.m_nResult && expected.m_cubOutput == actual.m_cubOutput;
		cFailures += !bOk;
		if ( const char *pszDump = std::getenv( "VAC_DISPATCH_DUMP" ) )
		{
			const std::string base = std::string( pszDump ) + "/" + testCase.m_pszName;
			std::ofstream( base + ".original.bin", std::ios::binary ).write( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( expected.m_rgubOutput.data() ), k_cubResponse );
			std::ofstream( base + ".rebuild.bin", std::ios::binary ).write( reinterpret_cast<const char *>( actual.m_rgubOutput.data() ), k_cubResponse );
		}
		std::printf( "%-4s %-18s result=%d/%d size=0x%x/0x%x diff=%u first=0x%x\n", bOk ? "ok" : "FAIL", testCase.m_pszName,
			expected.m_nResult, actual.m_nResult, expected.m_cubOutput, actual.m_cubOutput, cDifferent, ibFirst );
	}
	std::printf( "failures=%d\n", cFailures );
	return cFailures ? 1 : 0;
}
```

```py
def find_node(pe, module_id: int):
    for candidate in (module_id, PLACEHOLDER_ID):
        if pe.scan_nodes(candidate, 1):
            return cmp.find_single_node(pe, candidate, 1, "rebuild")
    raise RuntimeError(f"rebuild has no node for 0x{module_id:08x}")


def to_set(ranges) -> set[int]:
    return {i for start, end, _ in ranges for i in range(start, end + 1)}


def to_ranges(offsets: set[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
    result: list[list[int]] = []
    for i in sorted(offsets):
        if result and result[-1][1] == i - 1:
            result[-1][1] = i
        else:
            result.append([i, i])
    return result


def declared_volatile(module: str) -> set[int]:
    path = Path(__file__).with_name("volatile") / f"{module}.json"
    if not path.exists():
        return set()
    return {i for start, end in json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["ranges"] for i in range(start, end + 1)}


def compare(module: str, original: Path, node, rebuild: Path, rebuild_rva: int, noise_copy: Path, payload: bytes) -> dict:
    info, a, b = cmp.invoke_workers_with_powershell(original, node.worker_rva, rebuild, rebuild_rva, payload, 0x1000)
    noise: set[int] = set()
    for _ in range(NOISE_SAMPLES):
        _, n1, n2 = cmp.invoke_workers_with_powershell(original, node.worker_rva, noise_copy, node.worker_rva, payload, 0x1000)
        noise |= to_set(cmp.diff_ranges(n1, n2, 0x1000)[2])
    noise |= declared_volatile(module)
    real = to_set(cmp.diff_ranges(a, b, 0x1000)[2]) - noise
    envelope = all(info["original"][k] == info["rebuild"][k] for k in ("ret", "size"))
    return {
        "ok": not real and envelope,
        "ret": [info["original"]["ret"], info["rebuild"]["ret"]],
        "size": [info["original"]["size"], info["rebuild"]["size"]],
        "real_diff_bytes": len(real),
        "real_ranges": to_ranges(real)[:12],
        "noise_bytes": len(noise),
    }


def run_live(name: str, dll: str, folder: str, ids: list[int], pid_offset, work: Path) -> dict:
    research = RESEARCH / folder
    original = research / "module.dll"
    rebuild = BUILD / f"{dll}.dll"
    noise_copy = work / f"{dll}_noise.dll"
    shutil.copy2(original, noise_copy)
    pe_original, pe_rebuild = cmp.PeImage(original), cmp.PeImage(rebuild)

    packet = cmp.read_packet(research / "inputVacPacket_ScanId_4.bin")
    packet_node = cmp.find_single_node(pe_original, packet.module_id, packet.version, "packet")
    captured = cmp.ice_decrypt_buffer(packet_node.ice_key[:8], packet.encrypted_payload)
    if cmp.crc32_ieee(captured) != packet.crc32:
        raise RuntimeError("packet CRC mismatch")

    results: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for worker_id in ids:
        node = cmp.find_single_node(pe_original, worker_id, 1, "original")
        rva = find_node(pe_rebuild, worker_id).worker_rva
        if worker_id == packet.module_id:
            payload = bytes(captured)
        else:
            payload = bytes(captured[:32]) + bytes(len(captured) - 32)
        results[f"{worker_id:08x}/captured"] = compare(name, original, node, rebuild, rva, noise_copy, payload)
        if pid_offset is None:
            continue
        for label, pid in (("pid0", 0), ("pid4", 4), ("pid_bad", 0xFFFFFFFF)):
            patched = bytearray(payload)
            struct.pack_into("<I", patched, pid_offset, pid)
            results[f"{worker_id:08x}/{label}"] = compare(name, original, node, rebuild, rva, noise_copy, bytes(patched))
        target = subprocess.Popen(WOW64_TARGET, creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
        try:
            time.sleep(1)
            patched = bytearray(payload)
            struct.pack_into("<I", patched, pid_offset, target.pid)
            results[f"{worker_id:08x}/pid_wow64"] = compare(name, original, node, rebuild, rva, noise_copy, bytes(patched))
        finally:
            target.terminate()
            target.wait()
    return results


DISPATCH_REPORT_LIMIT = {"timing_check": 0x20, "system_handles": 0x14}
DISPATCH_KNOWN = {"system_info": [(0x598, 0x59B, "address of the caller image, each side maps at its own base"),
                                  (0x5A0, 0x5A7, "reads +0x114 of the caller image, e_lfanew differs")]}
REPORT_SIZE = 0x1000
RESPONSE_SIZE = 0x1088


def session_ice_key() -> bytes:
    def step(value: int) -> int:
        next_value = (16807 * value - 0x7FFFFFFF * (value // 127773)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        if next_value >= 0x80000000:
            next_value -= 1 << 32
        return next_value + 0x7FFFFFFF if next_value < 0 else next_value

    state, table = 1, [0] * 32
    for i in range(39, -1, -1):
        state = step(state)
        if i < 32:
            table[i] = state
    output, words = table[0], []
    for _ in range(4):
        state = step(state)
        bucket = output >> 26
        output = table[bucket]
        table[bucket] = state
        words.append(output)
    return struct.pack("<II", words[2], words[3])


def clear_response(path: Path, key: bytes) -> bytes:
    data = path.read_bytes()
    return cmp.ice_decrypt_buffer(key, data[:REPORT_SIZE]) + data[REPORT_SIZE:RESPONSE_SIZE]


def run_dispatch(name: str, dll: str, folder: str, work: Path) -> dict:
    research = RESEARCH / folder
    original, packet = research / "module.dll", research / "inputVacPacket_ScanId_4.bin"
    pairs = {"rebuild": BUILD / f"{dll}.dll", "noise": original}
    outputs: dict[str, str] = {}
    for label, other in pairs.items():
        dump = work / f"{name}_{label}"
        dump.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        env = dict(os.environ, VAC_DISPATCH_DUMP=str(dump))
        proc = subprocess.run([str(TESTS / "dispatch_parity.exe"), str(original), str(other), str(packet)],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=300, errors="replace")
        outputs[label] = proc.stdout

    key = session_ice_key()
    limit = DISPATCH_REPORT_LIMIT.get(name, REPORT_SIZE)
    known = {i for start, end, _ in DISPATCH_KNOWN.get(name, []) for i in range(start, end + 1)}
    results: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for line in outputs["rebuild"].splitlines():
        match = re.match(r"(ok|FAIL)\s+(\w+)\s+result=(-?\d+)/(-?\d+) size=(\w+)/(\w+)", line)
        if not match:
            continue
        state, case, ret_a, ret_b, size_a, size_b = match.groups()
        envelope = ret_a == ret_b and size_a == size_b
        if case not in ("full_response", "other_session_id") or state == "ok":
            results[case] = {"ok": state == "ok", "exit": line[:90]}
            continue
        expected = clear_response(work / f"{name}_rebuild" / f"{case}.original.bin", key)
        actual = clear_response(work / f"{name}_rebuild" / f"{case}.rebuild.bin", key)
        first = clear_response(work / f"{name}_noise" / f"{case}.original.bin", key)
        second = clear_response(work / f"{name}_noise" / f"{case}.rebuild.bin", key)
        noise = {i for i in range(RESPONSE_SIZE) if first[i] != second[i]}
        ignored = noise | known | declared_volatile(name) | set(range(limit, REPORT_SIZE))
        real = {i for i in range(RESPONSE_SIZE) if expected[i] != actual[i]} - ignored
        results[case] = {"ok": not real and envelope, "real_diff_bytes": len(real), "real_ranges": to_ranges(real)[:12],
                         "noise_bytes": len(noise), "ret": [ret_a, ret_b]}
    if not results:
        results["error"] = {"ok": False, "exit": outputs["rebuild"][-200:]}
    return results


def write_system_info_input() -> None:
    research = RESEARCH / "ptr_0x0A00C948_crc_a07ed54b_GetSystemInfo"
    packet = cmp.read_packet(research / "inputVacPacket_ScanId_4.bin")
    node = cmp.find_single_node(cmp.PeImage(research / "module.dll"), packet.module_id, packet.version, "packet")
    (ROOT / "build/system_info_input.bin").write_bytes(cmp.ice_decrypt_buffer(node.ice_key[:8], packet.encrypted_payload))


def run_suite(command) -> dict:
    argv = [str(x) for x in command]
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600, errors="replace")
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"ok": False, "exit": "timeout", "tail": ""}
    tail = " | ".join((proc.stdout + proc.stderr).strip().splitlines()[-2:])[-240:]
    return {"ok": proc.returncode == 0, "exit": proc.returncode, "tail": tail}


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--only", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--write-baseline", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--no-suites", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    report: dict[str, dict] = {}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="vac_parity_") as td:
        for name, dll, folder, ids, pid_offset in MODULES:
            if args.only not in name:
                continue
            try:
                report[f"live:{name}"] = run_live(name, dll, folder, ids, pid_offset, Path(td))
            except Exception as exc:
                report[f"live:{name}"] = {"error": {"ok": False, "exit": str(exc)[:300]}}
        for name, dll, folder, _, _ in MODULES:
            if args.only not in name:
                continue
            try:
                report[f"dispatch:{name}"] = run_dispatch(name, dll, folder, Path(td))
            except Exception as exc:
                report[f"dispatch:{name}"] = {"error": {"ok": False, "exit": str(exc)[:300]}}
    if not args.no_suites:
        write_system_info_input()
        for name, command in SUITES:
            if args.only in name:
                key = f"suite:{name}:{Path(str(command[0])).stem if str(command[0]) != sys.executable else Path(str(command[1])).stem}"
                if "--live" in [str(x) for x in command]:
                    key += ":live"
                report[key] = {"run": run_suite(command)}

    baseline = json.loads(BASELINE.read_text()) if BASELINE.exists() else {}
    regressions = passed = failed = 0
    for key, cases in report.items():
        for case, result in cases.items():
            before = baseline.get(key, {}).get(case, {}).get("ok")
            state = "ok" if result["ok"] else "FAIL"
            passed += result["ok"]
            failed += not result["ok"]
            note = ""
            if not result["ok"]:
                note = f" diff={result.get('real_diff_bytes', '?')} ret={result.get('ret', '')} {result.get('real_ranges', '')[:4] if result.get('real_ranges') else ''} {result.get('exit', '')}"
                if before:
                    regressions += 1
                    note += "  <-- REGRESSION"
                elif before is False:
                    note += "  (also failed in baseline)"
            print(f"{state:4} {key} {case}{note}")
    print(f"\npassed={passed} failed={failed} regressions={regressions}")
    (ROOT / "build").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (ROOT / "build" / "parity_report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1))
    if args.write_baseline:
        BASELINE.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1))
        print(f"baseline written: {BASELINE}")
    return 1 if regressions else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```
